description: "She became a prince to survive." Historical materials of ancient Egypt Fusion fantasy romance game "The Dawn Of A Flower"

title: The Dawning Clocks of Time: Remake
description: A story of love, war and betrayal on an intergalatic scale. A epic third person shooter with both sandbox and linear story progression. Take up arms and battle for the ages, who will decide the fate for all of humanity? Now remade in HD / 4K with cinematic presentation.

title: The Apocalypse Sacrifice
description: The Apocalypse Sacrifice is a point and click adventure game with multiple endings. You take on the role of an adventurer who has lost his memory, with the only clue being a note found in his mouth. As you recover your memories, you uncover chilling secrets hidden within the town.

title: The Butler Did It
description: Battle robots, make friends, and uncover a bizarre conspiracy to avert the apocalypse in this comedy of manners and mayhem with steampunk blasters!

title: The Bright Star Of Seraph-Katis
description: The Bright Star Of Seraph-Katis is a short text adventure game. This game combines a visual novel and an "adventure mode".

title: The Black Siege
description: The Black Plague had ravaged 14th Century Europe, turning humans into carnivorous monsters that brought destruction to the continent. Your kingdom stands as the last bastion. Build your fortress, mine resources and train troops to hold out until help arrives in this builder-defense roguelike.

title: The Bibites: Digital Life
description: Explore real digital life in The Bibites! Play god as you guide your bibites on their evolutionary journey. Analyze their Neural Network brains and genetic information as they adapt to their environments. Save your favorites and test their strength in Challenge Mode!

title: The Backrooms: Descent
description: The Backrooms: Descent is a 1-4 player co-op horror experience. You are tasked with descending into the vast levels of the Backrooms which have dangerous entities while also finding evidence of previous research teams before you find your escape.

title: The Beautiful Island
description: A short visual novel about war, peace and hope. Explore a city after a devastating war. Talk to people, try to understand, try to help. The heroes of war are dead, but you can be a hero of peace!

title: The Belligerence
description: A single player game developed to differentiate itself from existing fighting games. It can be enjoyed with a feeling closest to a real fight. The right stick-based attack and walking parry system provide sensory control. There is a mode to fight cpu and belly hard is incredibly strong

title: The Berlin Apartment
description: The Berlin Apartment tells the moving stories of inhabitants of an apartment in the city of Berlin over the last 120 years in several unique, emotional episodes as a character-driven adventure game.

title: Hundred Fires: The rising of red star - Episode 2
description: Hundred Fires is an action, stealth and infiltration game with an exciting story and incredible cinematics. This is a one man infiltration mission, you alone cannot defeat the entire Soviet army, you must use your best skills to hide, sneak away from the enemy and go undetected.

title: Thong Girl: The Video Game
description: The Adventures of Thong Girl combines classic 2D beat-em-up platforming with high-scoring arena action. Help our scantily clad super heroine defeat wave after wave of roid-raging bodybuilders, antipathetic teenagers, and gun-toting gangstas. Join in the fun with Thong Girl as she works her butt off to get to the bottom of the riots plaguing Music City.

title: Nasty Zombies
description: Team up with up to 4 players and take on endless waves of Nasty Zombies in a high-intensity, movement-focused boomer shooter. Use agility and smart positioning to survive semi-procedural maps and unlock permanent upgrades like Blessings, Miracles, and cosmetics.

title: 112 Reddings Helikopter
description:
112 Reddings Helikopter is an action game that takes place in the cities of Amsterdam and Berlin. Completely remodeled to give the feeling of flying over the city in a helicopter. The player has a total of 20 missions to complete, these are dangerous missions with the ultimate goal to bring the person at risk to safety within a limited amount of time.

The fires, traffic accidents, chemical disasters, armed robbery, factory accidents, sudden heart attacks and rescues from tall buildings are some of the many situations that will occur.

title: Ether
description: Help a Space Mercenary, Ether, complete a difficult scavenging mission in an abandoned ship. Explore 4 different biomes, each with its share of dangers, and escape a swarm of mutant space bugs.

title: James Bond 007: Nightfire
description: The PC version of James Bond 007: Nightfire was developed by Gearbox Software while Eurocom developed the home console version. It is mostly the same except for the removal of driving sections used in home console versions and some other minor modifications to the single player and multiplayer modes.

title: Solar Raiders
description: Suit up, grab your guns, and embark on a cosmic heist in this fast-paced bullet-hell roguelite. Solo or with friends, your goal is to overcome enemy packed dungeons and steal the Solar Core. Raid, loot, unlock powerful skills, create unstoppable builds and prepare to die.

title: 1-Bit Explorer
description:
1-Bit Explorer is an adventure game focused on exploration where you do NOT save the world and the world does NOT need saving.

The point is to explore to your heart's content and uncover mysteries and secrets (or don't, it's up to you, really).

title: 1-Bit Halloween
description: 1-Bit Halloween focuses on a home visit that a priest makes to a family. The game is on a single map with all the rooms of the house being visible to the player (like Dogville movie, in which you could see everything that happened in different places at once).

title: 2-Bit Explorer
description: 2-Bit Explorer is a game where exploration is king. A Lovecraftian Zelda-like. Explore the labyrinth that apparently has 1 more bit than you do and find you way out of the strange reality you find yourself in. Find the one you seek...

title: Become The Moon
description: Become The Moon is a roguelike deckbuilder and auto-battler mashup where players build powerful teams of minions from a deck they construct as they play. Will you save the moon from corruption, or embrace the chaos and become it?

title: The Murder of Dale Decker
description: Use your keyboard to uncover objects located at the crime scene. Guess words by typing to recall the space around you, uncover clues and solve the murder!

title: Echo Weaver
description: Time is your greatest resource and secrets are your only upgrades. Master an unraveling time loop in this knowledge-based Metroidvania. As the last Weaver, exploit time-altering anomalies and use what you learn to break the cycle. Explore what remains. Uncover the mystery. Perfect the loop.

title: Otter Island
description:
Inspired by various classic RPG Maker horror games, like Ib and the Witch's House

It's a warm summer day and Zachary Dove is invited to his friend Connor's summer cottage, along with their other friend, Jeremy.

They are looking forward to a relaxing day of swimming, grilling, and drinking together. Later at night, however, things start to seem strange, and quickly take a turn for the terrifying.

title: Valiant Hearts: The Collection
description: In Valiant Hearts: The Collection, find both Valiant Hearts: The Great War and Valiant Hearts: Coming Home.

title: Reveil: Funhouse Edition
description:
In addition to REVEIL, the Funhouse Edition contains the following DLCs:
- REVEIL Original Soundtrack: 14 original compositions, beautiful and haunting.
- Digital Artbook: A look behind the scenes of the game, featuring concept art and inspirations.
- Black and White Camera Filter: Use this in game for vintage horror atmosphere.
- Audio Plays: A selection of audio plays recorded with the game's voice actors, more bits and pieces from the world of REVEIL.
- Developer Commentary: Commentary by the developers to be found in-game, for even more background insights.

title: Potion Problem
description: Potion Problem is a whimsical potion making puzzler about discovery, problem solving and potions! Create potions and fulfill orders, prepare bizarre ingredients and learn the deepest secrets of the alchemists world.

title: Shovelboy: Zone X
description: Zone X is a level expansion for SHOVELBOY with a new set of 15 extremely hard levels.

title: Reign of Guilds: Black Knight
description: Continue your journey with this pack unlocking additional exclusive in-game content!

title: Shadows of Souls
description: This is an Endless Runner - Fighter game. Defeat the enemies, get upgrades with coins and prestige points, complete the levels and try to get highest score that you can in endless mode.

title: Soda Scuffle
description: A survivor game. The items in life suddenly mutate, and you will control the soda that gains special abilities to defeat one monster after another to maintain peace. Rely on your movements to avoid enemy barrage. Pick up experience to upgrade, defeat all bosses you encounter, and you will win.

title: DreamEscape
description: DreamEscape is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame where you get into Max's mind and explore his dreams and find out about him and his life.

title: Spellarium 3
description: Spellarium 3 is one of our first games in the Match 3 Puzzle genre. The keyword is 'Puzzle,' which means that sometimes (not always!) you'll complete the level faster by removing objects in the correct order.

title: Crown Wars: The Black Prince - Blood Pact Weapon Skins
description: Sometimes you need to fight fire with fire and blood with blood. Use the Order's own demonic weapons against them by equipping this weapon skin pack.

title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition - Victors and Vanquished
description: Embark on a thrilling journey with "Victors and Vanquished"! In nineteen epic scenarios, play as Ragnar Lothbrok, Oda Nobunaga, Charlemagne, and more. Your strategy and choices decide your fate: Secure your pre-order now and be prepared to conquer the battlefield!

title: Acorn Cop
description: Based on a true story, Acorn Cop is a meme game where you shoot all the acorns, but do NOT shoot any human or other living things. Enjoy and collect easter egg items. Can you do just that for 20 minutes?

title: Find Cats With Friends
description: Find Cats With Friends - gather friends, search the island for 100 mischievous cats, and bring them back in this cooperative multiplayer quest!

title: Forest Keeper 2
description: Forest Keeper 2 is a continuation of the first part of the game! Plunge back into a little adventure with the forest guardian!

title: Magic Ring
description: Magic Ring is an exciting 3D game that takes you on a dangerous journey through the desert to take part in a legendary tournament!

title: Floppa: The Dark Forest
description: Find 8 pictures of cats and don't let Big Floppa catch you!

title: Olive
description: Play as Olive, a sprightly old lady, to collect gems and progressively fill the scene with colour in this arcade runner style game. Grow plants with the coins you collect, unlock new abilities, and collect outfits to customise your look.

title: How Heavy Are My Nuts?
description: Do your Steam friends think you're too normal? Do you need a status that'll spice up their life? Introducing "How Heavy Are My Nuts?" The Game. Have the time of your life explaining this one to your father when he inevitably walks in on you playing it.

title: Bloody Hallowfest
description: What starts as the preparation for a special Halloween night event at a summer camp turns into a nightmare when someone with a bloodied axe ends the lives of all your friends. Will you manage to escape and save yourself?

title: My Bestie is a Femboy Streamer
description: Your bestie is a Streamer. You've asked him before, but he always remains elusive on the matter...

title: Command & Conquer: Red Alert, Counterstrike and The Aftermath
description:
This compilation contains:

Command & Conquer: Red Alert (base game)
Command & Conquer: Red Alert - Counterstrike (first expansion pack)
Command & Conquer: Red Alert - The Aftermath (second expansion pack)

title: Command & Conquer: Tiberian Sun and Firestorm
description: The Second Tiberium War begins in this legendary sequel to the original Command & Conquer. With his forces stronger than ever, arch villain and leader of The Brotherhood of Nod - Kane - is pitched in an epic battle against the world's war machine - the Global Defense Initiative.

title: Command & Conquer: Red Alert 2 and Yuri’s Revenge
description: The Invasion Has Begun

title: Not Alone in the Space
description: "Not Alone in the Space" is a visual novel for adults only. Young pilot Avis and his two adorable female partners explore space. What they encounter will turn their minds inside out, forcing them to break the chain of command and expose their inner desires.

title: I Commissioned Some Abstract Bunnies
description: I paid artists to hide abstract bunnies and carrots in 15 canvases. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

title: Alone Or Together
description: Two people will work together to clear the stage.

title: Fear Faith
description: Wield your sword in the right direction to defeat challenging horrors. Try to make sense of your steps through an impossible tower that changes with your decisions while trying to survive. Prove your Faith.

title: Ichorous Moon
description: Run! Race through the corrupted streets of Türme to stop the rising of the Ichorous Moon

title: My Pretty Closet
description: Embark on a forest stroll with your grandfather, only to awaken alone in a eerie cabin. Unveil buried memories, revealing parental secrets. Confront inner demons of depression and anxiety and seek for answers and peace in this unsettling yet serene psychological horror game.

title: Nebula Nomads
description: Embark on a spacefaring odyssey in Nebula Nomads! Pilot your cargo haulers through the cosmic expanse, mastering thrust vectoring as you deliver valuable packages between space stations. Earn credits, upgrade your fleet, and explore a captivating 2.5D universe. Launch into Nebula Nomads now!

title: Symphony Stride
description: Launch powerful combos in this fast and exciting deckbuilder roguelike. Choose two characters to form a team with unique combos for each pairing and embark on a procedurally generated quest of epic proportions!

title: Martha generator
description: about 20 marthas are generated and recycled each day in the middle of the ocean

title: Udongein X2
description: Reisen is now cordially invited to Hell!

title: KindergarTen 1: No Mercy
description:
The game takes place at a kindergarten, where the player is a cleaner who discover things, which is helping in the investigation. During the day, the kindergarten is open, so every morning the children are coming, and you must clean up the whole place. The kindergarten closes at 9:00 PM which means you have to be there at 8:50 PM. The game contains 5 nights of cleaning which pay you a reward of 26$ each day. Every night while cleaning, you find more and more information, that could help you solve the mystery of the murder.
Like in any other RPG Maker games the player can control the character (the cleaner) with the arrow keys, and of course the 'enter' or 'space' keys are the action buttons (which are very important in a mystery solving game).

title: KindergarTen 2: Daddy
description:
"I don't know what happened there...
Since I was there I keep hearing strange voices
in my head.
The sounds are like some children's laugh,
and sometimes they keep saying:
"Help us"
I don't know what's going on, but I
must find it out before I get mad."

title: From Eva with Green
description: From Eva with Green is a unique atmospheric pinball game.

title: Dragon Ball Z: Kakarot - Goku's Next Journey
description: Experience the final episode of the DRAGON BALL Z anime, depicting Goku's long-awaited battle with Uub! How will the battle between Goku and the reincarnation of Majin Buu turn out?

title: School Hero
description: Immerse yourself in this nostalgic yet modern blend of arcade-style action and anime storytelling, as Sakura high calls for a new Hero to rise in style. Will you answer the call and save the day?

title: Glitch Blaster's Waifu
description: Welcome to 'Glitch Blaster's Waifu,' the ultimate retro-style shoot 'em up adventure! As an intrepid hacker, you find yourself pitted against a malevolent AI that has kidnapped innocent girls.

title: Daiku no Medium Megumi
description: This small game was made right soon after Daiku no Medium back in 2019 to show its ending from a different point of view.

title: Paris Simulator
description: This is a realistic real life simulator where you can walk around Paris Interested in playing a real life simulator. This game is for you 1. Walk around Paris and see the Eifel Tower. 2. Go up to the top of the Eifel tower and walk around

title: Let's Park: Bus Edition
description: Have you ever been challenged to measure your accuracy skills?

title: Flag & Country
description: Form words, gather resources, and build your team of experts ready to explore the planet.

title: Desert Special Forces
description: Captain, you have a new mission!

title: Lunatic Taxi Driver
description: Lunatic Taxi Driver is an exciting and fast-paced game that puts you in the shoes of a taxi driver who is determined to show the world what it means to be a truly exceptional driver

title: SpHero
description: You are a Sphere, you are a Hero, you are... a SpHero! Use your Spherical powers to overcome your enemies and the trials ahead. You will be able to roll faster, bounce higher, throw fireballs or be a rolling magnet! Venture in 60 hand crafted levels and defeat 6 Boxes (bosses).

title: Saltaria
description: Enter the oceanic world of Saltaria. Build, manage and expand your steam ship. Explore islands surrounded by a vast creepy ocean covering a subterranean world inspired by Jules Verne. Hunt for legendary power crystals to empower weapons or to build fantastic machines that fight or work for you.

title: Letalis
description: Letalis presents an unconventional RPG adventure, paying homage to the classics of the Game Boy era while infusing inventive gameplay, souls mechanics and unexpected twists!

title: Troy: The Soldier
description: Troy, a turn based RPG with Rougelite aspects, is a game based around your use of cash and how much you waste. With an emphasis on music and it's Gameboy-like art style, Troy acts as a playable mixtape for whoever wants to listen to some tunes as well as play a game.

title: King Must Survive
description: In the enchanted world of the Middle Ages, it's a king's struggle for survival! Equipped with top-down shooter mechanics and rogue-lite elements, you must battle against increasingly challenging waves of enemy swarms.

title: Logic Town: Country Fair
description: Step right up and experience the all the joys of Spring in Country Fair, the newest DLC for Logic Town! From thrilling rides to mouth-watering snacks, games, and competitions, there's something for everyone to enjoy in this new bumper expansion.

title: Galactic Ascendancy
description: Humanity, having mastered faster-than-light travel, discovered a distant galaxy teeming with extraterrestrial civilizations. Join Admiral Preen in his conquest of the Andromeda Galaxy. Crush the resistance and invade their worlds.

title: Dragons and Nature
description: With powerful dragons and relatively weak animals, you can easily destroy the natural ecology, but you will eventually suffer backlash. Learning to coexist may be the key to long-term survival.

title: Hypcampex
description: Hypcampex is a 2D-Platformer that embarks you on a remarkable adventure across Planet Photonus as the legendary Electrex Bolt, where he strives to acquire the Artifact of the Hypcampex and battle through the war against the malevolent Avengers of Light, the Lavengers.

title: Battlethorne: Survivors
description: Defeat the Reaper's minions as you battle through forts, forests and castles. Gather gold to upgrade your character, slay thousands of enemies and defeat the Reaper.

title: Lio
description: Unravel the story of a boy who wakes up in a mysterious world without any memories.

title: Dice-Zee!
description: Dice-Zee! brings back a classic and beloved game that is popular across the world! Can you rank as one of the best dice scoring players in the world?

title: FourPoint: Prologue
description: Escaping while doing the right thing for each place in four places.Escape this place with items needed for the place, items that will help, and items that will allow you to do the right thing for the places!

title: Splash Carnival
description: Spash Carnival is roguelike shooting game featuring paintball weapons. Arm yourself with diverse low-durability weapons, splash the enemies and move forward! Welcome to the Splash Camival~!

title: Solitary Mark
description: This is a casual puzzle game that is very simple and easy to understand, suitable for players of all ages. Players need to eliminate blocks of the same color or shape by clicking on them, or swap positions to connect them into three or more patterns. Each elimination earns points, and special items can also be used. The game interface is simple and beautiful, with smooth operation, exquisite graphics, and cheerful music, but it will not make you feel tired while you are crazy.

title: Field of Vision
description: This is a puzzle game. The mischievous little flying dragon jumps in different clouds. Move left and right to keep the little flying dragon in the picture and above the clouds, otherwise the game will end. There are attackers and bonus balls above the clouds, try to avoid all attacking objects as much as possible, and pick up bonus balls to get higher scores. The gameplay is simple yet challenging, come and try how many points you can get!

title: Sequential Dungeon
description: Welcome to Sequential Dungeon, where 64 different levels in 8 uniquely themed floors await you in a simple yet challenging experience! Get ready to clear each of the levels in a limited amount of moves while mastering a varied array of different mechanics!

title: Magic University
description: Magic University - Welcome to the magical university, where mysterious walls hide incredible opportunities! An exciting adventure awaits you in the world of magic, where every day is filled with new discoveries and challenges.

title: Back to the Earth
description: Take an exciting journey. Find out the reason for your abduction. Help your space brothers. Alien adventures await you!

title: Command & Conquer and The Covert Operations
description: The legendary RTS game which started it all. Will you side with the humanistic GDI or bring the world to its knees with Kane and the Brotherhood of Nod. Your adversaries are without mercy. And so are you.

title: Misled Madness
description: Side-scroller platformer where you avoid hazards and race to the finish line for the fastest leaderboard times.

title: Nothing Together: Multicolor Eye Pain Theme
description: Do you like colors? Do you like a lot of colors? Do you like colors so bright they will hurt your eyes? Then we got a great deal for you! With the Multicolor Eye Pain Theme, you can now enjoy tons of amazing bright colors dynamically changing in the background!

title: Nothing Together: Banana Theme
description: Enjoy doing Nothing while looking at a black background with bright yellow texts with the Banana Theme DLC!

title: Nothing Together: Dark Fire Theme
description: Enjoy doing Nothing while looking at a black background with neon red texts with the Dark Fire Theme DLC!

title: Nothing Together: Retro Console Theme
description: Enjoy doing Nothing while looking at a black background with neon green texts with the Retro Console Theme DLC!

title: Nothing Together: Deep Purple Theme
description: Enjoy doing Nothing while looking at a nice deep purple background with the Deep Purple Theme DLC! Why would you want that? I don't know, someone in the Discord asked me to make this.

title: Nothing Together: Light Theme
description: Just doing Nothing is boring! Use the White Theme DLC to destroy your vision and see absolutely Nothing! It has never been easier to experience absolute nothingness!

title: Nothing Together: Cute Theme
description: With the Cute Theme DLC, you can look at cute colors while doing absolutely Nothing! Why would you want that? I don't know. Why would you want anything anyway, if you could have Nothing instead?

title: Nothing Together: Dark Theme
description: Experience truly Nothing with the Dark Theme DLC. Stare into the void and question your life decisions.

title: Call of Duty: Black Ops III - The Giant
description: Zombies returns in all of its undead glory with 'The Giant,' a research facility featuring the weapon-upgrading Pack-a-Punch Machine. Re-live the chaos of Treyarch's classic 'Der Riese' Zombies map, picking up the Zombies story with Dempsey, Nikolai, Richtofen, and Takeo where Origins left off.

title: Dino Park
description: Dino Park is a cozy idle game about collecting dinosaurs! Watch your dinosaurs level up in real time, earning more money for your park. Create the perfect environment for your dinosaurs to increase the chance of discovering super rare variants! Can you collect them all?

title: Midnight Custody
description: Midnight Custody is a short found-footage-style game where you wander through an eerie parking garage. It's a freaky, immersive terror fest that'll keep you on the edge of your seat!

title: Sippy Disco: Light Up The Dance Floor
description: Light up the dance floor in this cozy puzzle game! Sippy the unicorn must step on every square in the fewest possible moves to make the dance floor light up. Partner with Parrots on skates and disco balls to brighten everyone’s day!

title: Kill Will
description: Retro-FPS / Post-Apocalyptic / Sci-Fi / Pixel-Art / Old-School / DIY

title: Fallout: Yesterday
description: Fallout: Yesterday is a fan-made recreation of the canceled Black Isle's Fallout 3 (Van Buren) on the engine of Fallout 2.

title: Star Wars Galaxies: Evolve
description: A non-profit, fan-made, community-driven remaster of the classic MMORPG Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided.

title: Spark & Kling
description: Spark & Kling is a couch co-op puzzle platformer where the player will take the role of either Spark, the electric bug, or Kling the metal gel blob. They are trapped in a Homemade lab by a Mad Scientist and the players will have to overcome obstacles and work together to escape.

title: Sekiro: Long May the Shadows Reflect
description: An unofficial overhauled mod that makes the game more challenging, changing skills, items, bosses, enemies, and upgrades.

title: Oblivion Eve
description:
A roguelike action-platformer where you use upgradeable weapons to combo powerful enemies to their doom!

Overcome tough fights, platforming challenges, puzzles, and more in your effort to free the titan who is incarcerated in the shifting prison's depths.

title: Little Eidolons
description:
An open-world rpg for Pico-8, where you can catch, train, and battle with over 100 varieties of monsters!

Gameplay is performed by navigating the overworld until you encounter either a wild Eidolon or an opposing trainer, which transitions the game to battle mode. Battle mode uses turn-based mechanics across a grid to allow you to fight - until all foes are defeated!

title: Fortnite: Chapter 5 - Season 2: Myths & Mortals
description: Pandora’s Box has been opened on the Fortnite Battle Royale Island, bringing Olympus to the battlefield. Olympian legends — including Hades and the thunder god Zeus — now rule the Island in otherworldly rage. To make matters worse, they’ve brought their powers and weapons with them. Use their mythological means against them in Chapter 5 Season 2: Myths & Mortals!

title: School Of Love: Clubs!
description: School Of Love: Clubs! is a high quality Dating Sim/Visual Novel game. There are so many things you can do in the game and many more such as easter eggs, secret objects, cards etc. This will be an amazing journey.

title: Altarium
description: Altarium is a first-person, asymmetric PVP Co-Op horror game that can be played by 1-5 players together. Players can choose to play as either the victim or the evil character. Get ready, choose your role, shape your destiny, and survive!

title: Ghost Master: Complete Edition
description: Ghost Master: Complete Edition aims to add back all the cut content from the game, including ghosts and levels.

title: Timmy and the Magic Pictures
description:
Following Timmy's Sea Adventure, this is the second release in the Timmy's series of interactive stories, written by David Grossman.

Timmy finds that he can make the pictures on his bedroom wall come to life. This leads to many games and activities that improve reading and thinking skills : labyrinth, matching games, jigsaw puzzles and even play music with Timmy's xylophone.

In the options, you can set the levels of play (3), change the language and turn on/off the background music.

title: Blobby's Adventure
description: It's your virtual pet Blobby's adventure! Guide him through the virtual world until he reaches the castle in the sky. Defeat the castle boss to win the game. Collect hearts to refill your health.

title: Cathode Ray Sunshine
description:
This is a short horror game that I developed for Fantasy Console Game Jam #3 using the Pico-8 fantasy console. This game is not suited for children or those who are easily disturbed.

The objective of this game is to move around a desolated town and touch certain magic pillars. When you touch the pillars (it's a little finicky, so try to move around them a bit), a streetlight will come on near a lighthouse to signify your progress. You must light all six streetlights, at which point the lighthouse will light up. Touch the light of the lighthouse to complete the game.

title: Laser Blast!
description: Help Atom Girl defeat waves of enemies trying to stop her as she races through space. Use her ability to change into a ship and back to blast her foes into stardust.

title: Laser Blast! 3: Fury of the Wizard
description: Laser Blast! 3: Fury of the Wizard is a 2d 8-bit rail shooter in the style of Space Harrier. Enemies will periodically fly towards you. Shoot them down while avoiding their attacks. When the sun sets, defeat the level boss to win the game.

title: Laser Blast! 4: The Lunasol Encounter
description: This sci-fi themed platformer is the fourth in the Laser Blast! series. Play as the advanced robot Atom Girl and progress through a platforming level, defeating enemy forces along the way. Destroy the end boss to complete Atom Girl's mission and help save her planet from evil invading forces.

title: Story of the Mirror
description:
A short horror game developed for DarkTober Game Jam 2018 using the Pico-8 fantasy console. This game is not suited for children or those who are easily disturbed.

The objective of this game is to find the old mirror, locate the dark path and get the orbs of light. This will require navigating 3 different worlds of increasing tension and horror.

title: Conscientious Objector
description:
Conscientious Objector is a Doom 3 mod that uses the first three levels of the commercial game, stripped bare and repopulated, together with some custom code that stops the player from being able to kill anything.

Sure, you can shoot the zombies all you like, and they will fall down.. it's just that they'll get back up again... On top of this, rather than being told you're great, like most FPS games, you've got an aggressive NPC on your case and in your ear, who'd like nothing better than to see you end up as a zombie's breakfast, and is going to let you know any chance he gets.

title: Antlion Soccer
description: A multiplayer mod for up to 8 players. Antlion Soccer is a pretty simple idea - two teams (Combine vs Citizens), one pitch, two goals, gravity guns all round and a huge pile of Antlions. Score goals by punting Antlions into the opposing team's goals. Being released with vmfs and source files as it's so much fun (and simple) to generate new maps.

title: Perdition's Flames
description: The afterlife isn't what you expected. Explore a strangely modernized and bureaucratic underworld, replete with strip malls, government offices, and science labs, as well as the occasional lake of molten rock.

title: Never Gives Up Her Dead
description:
Time is running out after a meteor strikes your interstellar starship. While the crew is under full alert, only you seem to notice the strange red portals opening up throughout the ship.

Explore ten different worlds, learn the truth of your destiny, and confront the mysterious figure who has been haunting you from the start in this epic sci-fi adventure.

title: Rude Chess
description:
Use arrow keys to walk, R to restart and Z to undo

Push blocks & chess pieces onto the grey Xs

Chess pieces will try to make your life harder, this'll be explained better in-game

Wow

title: Ark of Charon
description: Build a mobile fortress on the back of a giant and mysterious walking Tree and embark on a journey in this merge of tower defense and colony simulation.

title: It's a Block-Pushing Game
description: Push block? Push block! Block-pushing! Push! Block! Push! Block! Push! Push!

title: Spectral Filter
description: Spectral Filter is a short horror game developed by Austin Schaeffer over the span of about 2 months with an original soundtrack by Cyrus Byrd.

title: Radagon Boss FIght
description: This community mod adds Elden Ring's boss Radagon in Sekiro: Shadow Die Twice.

title: The Night Wanderer
description:
"The Night Wanderer" is a hybrid of RPG and soulslike genres, characterized by unique solutions and an innovative approach to tried-and-true mechanics. The game utilizes level design known from Metroidvania games and a combat system native to soulsborne productions, which emphasizes dynamic yet tactical gameplay.

The game is based on the award-winning fantasy novel "Lord of the Ice Garden" by Jarosław Grzędowicz.

title: Nizhan Future
description: Nizhan Future is Tencent Games’ upcoming sci-fi shooter title. Under the development of TiMi Studios, the game will take you on a futuristic adventure with multiple game modes on offer.

title: Stellar Orphans
description: Indie roguelite deckbuilder in space

title: Bios Fear
description: It's up to you to save what's left of humanity from its own greed and corporate profit motives. What little remains of Earth's ecosystem is protected within giant biodomes, and the dome systems are failing. Can you find a way to fix them before all life on Earth dies?"

title: Clandestine: The Hidden Truth
description: "Clandestine: The Hidden Truth" is a first-person psychological horror game. Investigate a family homicide, manipulate reality with polaroids, and solve puzzles to unveil chilling secrets hidden within this enigmatic home of horrors. Will you come back unscathed?

title: FreeGen
description: FreeGen is a 3D tactical multiplayer first person shooter in space. It s not a space sim - it s a combined indoor/outdoor shooter. So don t look for physical realism - look for action and cunning! The gameplay demo is just a conceptual version of FreeGen which demonstrates the main idea of the game. The demo is LAN multiplayer only without Internet and singleplay (bots) which of course will be added later. In the final release most code (graphics and network engine AI etc.) and art will be changed or replaced. We just think that conceptual demo is better than conceptual art or movies and screenshots.

title: Space Will
description: Sixty basic cores, hundreds of base station equipment, and thousands of chips, you can freely cooperate and shoot through the dual-angle joystick operation in a survival Roguelike game! Explore the sci-fi space and build your strongest battleship!

title: Honkai: Star Rail - Into the Yawning Chasm
description:
Version 2.1 of Honkai: Star Rail, which includes:
• New characters: Acheron, Aventurine and Gallagher
• New Trailblaze Mission: The Devil in Velvet
• New areas: Clock Studios Theme Park and Dwlight Pavilion
• New event: Vignettes in a Cup
• New quality of life updates
• …and more!

title: Attorney Online
description: Welcome to Attorney Online, abbreviated AO, a roleplaying chatroom based primarily in the Ace Attorney universe. Sporting hundreds of player-made characters, court cases and abstract roleplays, AO has been a tight-knit community for over a decade.

title: Ultra Business Tycoon IV: Whitewater Rafting
description: The sequel to Ultra Business Tycoon III by indie developer and author Porpentine.

title: Fairest
description:
“Mirror, mirror, on the wall,” you say dreamily, gazing into its sparkling surface…

“You know,” replies the mirror, “I can do a lot more than just reflect fair faces. O, how I long to leap off this wall! I want to meet princesses, witches, and wolves … to win a throne and become a hero! What say you?”

Well, what say you, adventurer?

title: Miner Rogue
description: An open-world crafting roguelike voxel based where everything is destructible and randomly generated, daylight is for exploring, mining rare minerals, forging powerful weapons, and building your fortress. As the sun sets, monsters emerge to attack your base.

title: Dark Sky
description: Lead a party of unlikely heroes as they uncover the truth behind a planetary catastrophe in this immersive turn-based RPG. Craft and upgrade character cards into powerful combos while you battle your way through this beautifully hand-drawn alien world!

title: Crucial 2: The Refresh Update
description: Crucial 2 is a modpack for Minecraft that aims to enhance the gameplay experience while maintaining the feel of vanilla Minecraft.

title: The Little Match Girl 2: Annus Evertens
description: The little match girl is hired to assassinate a disgusting old man.

title: The Little Match Girl, by Hans Christian Andersen
description: In The Little Match Girl by Hans Christian Andersen, a little girl is forced to sell matches on the street in the cold of New Year's Eve.

title: How the Little Match Girl Got Her Colt Paterson Revolver, and Taught a Virtue to a Goblin
description: The little match girl acquires a Colt Paterson revolver and teaches a virtue to a goblin.

title: How the Little Match Girl Met the Queen of Vampires
description: The little match girl plays a magical flute.

title: The Little Match Girl and Her Friend, the Crow
description: The little match girl goes on a spooky adventure with her friend (a crow).

title: The Little Match Girl 4: Crown of Pearls
description: In The Little Match Girl 4 by Hans Christian Andersen, a prince has been born, and the titular little match girl must assemble the subtitular Crown of Pearls.

title: The Little Match Girl against the Universal Sisterhood of Naughty Little Girls
description: A short game taking place soon after The Little Match Girl 4: Crown of Pearls.

title: The Crimson Debt
description: You've lived your whole life in a single basement. Now, your cage is unlocked. You could leave this house at any moment you want. But without knowing what happened, can you ever truly be free?

title: Exanimum: The Silent Call
description: "Exanimum: The Silent Call" is a first-person psychological horror game. In this chilling experience, you will find yourself confronting terrifying mysteries and chilling secrets.

title: Kao the Kangaroo: VIP
description:
Get the VIP look!
Future proof your fashion sense with this all new DLC pack for Kao The Kangaroo!
The VIP DLC pack contains three sci-fi themed costumes including - Space Knight, Robotic, and Future Punk. All three sets can be mixed and matched with previous cosmetics, adding a galaxy of options to your fashion choices!

title: Kao The Kangaroo: Top Of The Class
description: You might not make smart moves, but at least you can dress like you do! Containing two full outfits (made up for four items) Kao can now dress with that big brain energy or mix it up to add a dash of class to an outfit, all without costing a thing!

title: Platformer Geometry Dash
description: Geometry Dash 2.2 released a brand new way to play Geometry Dash, platformer mode. Platformer Mode now allows players to move at their own pace navigating tough corridors and fighting different bosses.

title: Lost Lands: Stories of the First Brotherhood
description: A strong brotherhood is forged only in difficult trials.

title: Rain World: Deluxe Edition
description: The story of the slugcats, packaged together in this Deluxe bundle of the base game of Rain World and its expansion, Rain World: Downpour.

title: Kaidann
description: You are trapped in a strange staircase, and you must determine what is happening here and head for the exit, which is on the first floor.

title: Cross the Maze World
description: Independently develop games, 3d games, and travel through the maze world to explore, kill monsters, and solve puzzles

title: Floain
description: What is happiness? Happiness is the sea, the wind, the rainstorm -- and the eternal love "Perhaps I can also live a peaceful and happy life like an ordinary person." Stay tuned, the exciting story of the evening rain and flowing flowers

title: Submersed 2: The Hive
description: Submersed 2: The Hive is a first-person science-fiction horror game, set in the harrowing depths of the Atlantic Ocean.Face the horror of being submerged at the bottom of the ocean.

title: Stories to Tell: Run Away
description: In "Stories to Tell - Run Away" you are a young Spanish man named Mike who is staying at his grandparents' house since his parents have gone on a trip. One night his grandparents went out to dinner and Mike was all alone, or so he thought...

title: Drop Pane: Not Only Match-3
description: Drop Pane is a Tetris-inspired indie game that blends the gameplay of match-3. The swift drop of piece challenges your breadth of attention and quick reflexes, demanding a sharp mind for effective handling. The game contributes to the development of spatial and language intelligence as well.

title: I Ask The Cube Where To Go
description: This should be simpler than other similar games. I ask it many things just because of my mental state, please don't mind.

title: Dire Island
description: Caught in a sudden storm, your team's once-promising voyage ended in disaster, leaving you stranded on Dire Island. United by the need for survival, you now face the island's mysteries and challenges together.

title: Liekki
description: Liekki is a fast-paced puzzle platformer where you play as a little fire spirit and try to burn as much as possible – or as little as possible. Solve levels using different fire related powers and change levels while burning them down.

title: Road Toad
description: Embark on a whimsical journey with Road Toad, a charming arcade adventure featuring a goofy toad navigating minimalist landscapes, collecting power-ups, and facing quirky challenges.

title: Ghost Ascension
description: Challenge hordes of ghosts, create builds, and unlock permanent upgrades! Ghost Ascension is a 2D rogue-like with a strong progression system. At the end of each wave of enemies, choose the card that best fits your build.

title: Jousting in January
description: Murderize your enemy(ies). No retreat. No surrender.

title: Beater: Apocal Undone
description: Apocals have taken over the earth. Fight through hordes of Darklings in this roguelite/survival setup to cleanse the world of these apocalyptic creatures. Beater not only allows you to choose powers for your character but for the enemies as well.

title: Find The Backdoor
description: Find the Backdoor is a single-player horror game. Go through different sinister levels in order to find the next backdoor. Survive those you meet and discover all the secrets. Will you manage to complete the game?

title: Echoes Of Despair
description: "Echoes Of Despair" plunges players into the horror of an abandoned hospital, where Sarah, an investigative journalist, must survive supernatural forces while uncovering the dark secrets of the past.

title: Apocalypse Love Shelter
description: Zombie apocalypse world! You built a shelter in advance, and countless girls wanted to enter your shelter for self-protection. Female neighbor, flight attendant, female boss, celebrity... All beings are equal before the end of time.

title: Helios Horizon
description:
In Helios Horizon you play as a robot mercenary, built and employed by Helios Horizon Inc.

Annihilate endless hordes of aliens in this action-packed sci-fi roguelite to fulfill your mission. For every mission completed, and every monster slain, Helios Horizon rewards its employees. Choose between upgrades to firearms or equipment to be an even more devastating mercenary.

Even if you are destroyed, the company will reassemble you. Helios Horizon cares about its property. Your upgrades will be preserved. With every death you will become stronger.

title: Princess Polly
description: Ahoy, matey! Join the ranks of a stealthy ninja, skulking through the shadows of a haunted pirate ship to reclaim the esteemed Princess Polly and her royal kin from the clutches of Captain Pegleg and his peculiar crew—part undead, part lively dancing pirates and squawking parrots!

title: Cozy Caravan
description: Embark on a single-player, top-down journey in Cozy Caravan, where the arts of crafting, trading, and exploration come together in a beautifully cozy world. Form lasting bonds as you and your caravan journey through charming towns, enriching lives along the way.

title: Ancient Cultivatrix
description: "Ancient Cultivatrix" is a Roguelite cultivation game with tower defense elements. The world was corrupted by chaos and became utterly depraved. Please gather the surviving cultivatrices and unite them. Enhance Taoist energy and spiritual prowess together, gradually uncovering the elusive truth.

title: Rise Eterna War
description: Rise Eterna War tells the bloody tale of Arthbane, a great general who led the last stand to reclaim his homeland Ars Rare from foreign invaders. Play as Arthbane, 10 years before the events of Rise Eterna, rallying loyalists in a desperate bid to seize the capital Gaiacus.

title: Sovereign Elect
description: To become the new king, a contestant must secure the favor of at least four of the seven influential guilds in the kingdom. The contest is open to individuals of any background, fostering a diverse array of contestants vying for the throne.

title: Tavern Manager Simulator
description: Restore your fantasy tavern to its full glory. Repair, improve and expand the establishment. Cook delicious food and keep an eye on the mood of the visitors. Create a unique atmosphere for unforgettable adventures!

title: I, Chatbot: Aisylum
description: Probably one of first games in which you talk to real AIs! There are seven chatbots in the AISYLUM, the sanatorium for crazy AIs. And one of them is YOU! An small, experimental, educational indie "talking simulator", powered by generative AI on your PC.

title: Ninja Chowdown: Glaze of Glory
description: Play as Donatsu, the chubby ninja and use your secret arts to fight along 35 action packed levels, in which to collect donuts and defeat members of the evil food clans. Ninja Chowdown: Glaze of Glory is a delicious pixel art arcade that will put your abilities to test.

title: FFA Cards
description: A 6-player free-for-all strategy game. No P2W, minimal randomness—just brains, bluffing, and skill. Made by players, for players.

title: Idle Animal Anatomy
description: A colorful clicker simulator where you can yourself grow a living creature cell by cell! Watch how organs, bones and skin are growing! Feel like a real scientist by becoming a pet creator!

title: Delicious Donut
description: Donut puzzles. Very. Delicious.

title: N+1: New Life For Unemployed Youth!
description: This is an independent game of magical realism that attempts to break the barriers between virtuality and reality and find the meaning of human life in a meaningless, repetitive, boring and obscure life.

title: Martyrdom
description: Martyrdom is a psychological horror game about torture.

title: Magibrick
description: "Magibrick" is a uniquely styled deck-building game. Assemble a deck with the right Magibrick and challenge diverse enemies in different regions. Fill the board, destroy enemy bricks,play amazing combo, and occupy the entire board with your Magibricks, leaving no space for your enemy.

title: Midnight Racer
description: Arcade sythwave car game. Hey there, champ, can't sleep? Had a tough day? Or maybe you just helped yourself relax? Sit back, relax to the synthwave beats. Turn off your brain, just watch, play, and relax.

title: Echoes of the Abyss
description: Dive into a rogue-lite survivor action game, where world changes based on your Sanity. Eat or be eaten. Grow from Prey into Hunter. Build ability-combos to survive waves of creatures from the Abyss. Uncover secrets of your lost humanity.

title: Peppermint Falls
description: Peppermint Falls is a farming simulator set in an enchanting world of sweets. Cultivate delightful candy plants, explore the world with your whimsical pancake house companion, forge friendships with charming confectionary inhabitants, and discover fabled mysteries!

title: Manika
description: "Manika" is a psychological horror game played in the first-person perspective. Solve puzzles to escape from a mental hospital where you don't know why you are there and try to regain your memories. Good luck, because you are not alone...

title: Roots of Fury
description: This couch co-op Hack and Slash RPG lets you play as a scientist who shrunk herself to battle swarms of insects threatening the roots of her plants. Team up with an ant hive that serves as your base — craft weapons, plan your attacks, and fight through an action-packed underground world.

title: Hell's Scream
description: Go back in time with an old school shooter game. Imagine yourself in a violent world where mass slaughter cannot be prevented. All you can do is survive, and that's not going to be easy.

title: Surviving Ceres
description: Surviving Ceres is an open world survival game with an emphasis on crafting and base building. Export rare materials and manufactured goods to earn funding used to unlock new technologies and upgrades. Bring in colonists from earth to work advanced facilities to terraform the planet.

title: Mythic Trials
description: Mythic Trials is a competitive Hack'n'Slash in which every player will create their unique skill build. It includes hundreds of Solo trials, Battle Royale PvP, Diablo-like item loots, daily World Bosses, rankings, draft tournaments, and dozens of different skills and is playable on mobile.

title: Rimal Game
description: Dive into Rimal Game, an online multiplayer with stunning graphics and innovative gameplay. Choose diverse characters, unleash groundbreaking skills, and compete in thrilling eSports. Every moment is a chance to redefine your gaming adventure!

title: Tenno
description: Dive into the captivating world of "Tenno", where the art of the ninja takes center stage. Craft your very own ninja, molding their appearance and abilities to match your vision.

title: Poor Artifact Maker
description: The Poor Artifact Maker is a tower defense game based on Chinese fairy legends. The refiner has to explore the dangerous world in order to find his lost companion. The only way to overcome the endless ferocious beasts in the wilderness is to keep collecting materials to refine spiritual weapons

title: Duck Dash
description: A fun and simple 2D platformer game about a duck named Scruffles. Fight your way through 10 levels with a smooth feeling movement system.

title: Chromacell
description: In this sideways scrolling shmup, take control of your spaceship and navigate through vibrant pixelated environments filled with hordes of enemy spacecraft. Upgrade your ship and weapons, dodge enemy fire while blasting through each stage. Emerge victorious as the ultimate space pilot!

title: Foulbreaker
description: Welcome to the exciting fantasy world where the mix of adrenaline, strategy and magic reaches its peak! "Foulbreaker" is a bagel in the classic sense, where you will have an endless battle with frenzied monsters in a troubled kingdom.

title: Backrooms: Lost Place
description: Single-player horror game based on the backrooms universe. Your task is to pass levels, puzzles and try not to die during all this.

title: Line of Fire: Pirate Waltz
description: Line of Fire - Pirate Waltz is a local multiplayer duel of pirates. Commandeer a ship of your choosing, master maneuvering around the dangers of the Seven Seas, manage your resources and time your shots perfectly to sink your enemy and emerge as a victorious captain against your friends.

title: Neoproxima
description: Investigating a time-loop during the Cold War, light years away from Earth. Neoproxima is a text-based adventure game that combines exploration and simple RPG and survival mechanics. Plan your next loop carefully, and go as far as possible before time catches up with you.

title: SwordSpin: Arena of Blades
description: SwordSpin is a indie game in the casual genre that combines different aspects of game design, such as strategy, creativity but still retains its casualty. Players will play as a character that wields a warrior who is using a spinning sword, and his task is to fight mobs to survive in the arena.

title: S.U.S
description: Super Ultra Stickman (S.U.S) is a fast paced action RPG game challenging your skills (or lack of it) versus the world, nay, THE UNIVERSE. Choose from dozens of unique weapons to fight your way to the top of the universe and reign as THE SUPER ULTRA STICKMAN.

title: Suika Pets
description: Suika Pets is the adorable puzzle game where you combine your pets to grow your score without overflowing their container!

title: Squirrels Gone Nuts
description: Squirrels Gone Nuts is a fast-paced, multiplayer, arena shooter. Play as a speedy squirrel able to run on any surface and wield various guns. Procedurally generated arenas paired with an innovative game mode that blends capture the flag with king of the hill ensures a fresh experience every match.

title: Aquium
description: Aquium is a casual single-player aquarium diorama designer where you can create your own underwater aquarium & relax with your fish. Embark on your customized ship to navigate the ocean, collect both real and fantastical fish, and add them to your uniquely designed aquarium!

title: Laser Lightshow
description: Master a 200+ handcrafted laser puzzle campaign, then build your own. Laser Lightshow gives you a massive puzzle sandbox, a powerful in-game editor, and online level sharing—with enough possible creations that “endless” barely covers it.

title: Leaf Blowing Simulator
description: Experience the calming tranquility of blowing thousands of leaves around in Leaf Blowing Simulator, the only real-time physics-based simulator that allows you to effortlessly create your own virtual oasis. Shape nature at your own pace and find relaxation in the gentle flow of leaves.

title: Kelp Keeper
description: Take on a vital role in the ecosystem in this action-packed bullet hell. Control a charming sea otter and protect the kelp forest from an endless onslaught of devious sea critters. Skillfully dodge attacks, grab your prey, and eat them all at the surface for a huge satisfying snack.

title: Failed Trust
description: In "Failed Trust", you explore a mysterious technical center where you are sent to retrieve important documents. Immerse yourself in the world of technology, collect energy and solve puzzles to uncover the secrets of this mysterious place.

title: Livingmare Cold Calls
description: Your only fear is the fear of the unknown.

title: Blood of the Elves
description: This is a story of a high Elven prince fall from grace. He is thrown out of Solaris for his unclean blood. Finding himself exiled to the land of the lower he has to form unlikely alliances and train his vampire powers to obtain vengeance for his crown, his family and most importantly his honor.

title: Bubumbu
description: Bubumbu is a short and wholesome hidden objects game with a unique twist in which you get to help lost objects find their way back to where they belong, while exploring fully hand-drawn worlds full of quirky characters.

title: Galactic Ruler Enlightenment
description: Play campaign stories within the Galactic Ruler universe. Invade the galaxy to eliminate those who stand in your way or rally alien races to defend against the invaders. Fight battles at both planet and space across a procedurally generated galaxy. Use new unit control systems to manage your forces.

title: Small Living World
description: An ecosystem simulation running in your hands. Transform a desertic world into a lush forest. No stress, play at your own pace. This world is at your disposal. Terraform the landscape, add plants and animals. Create your perfect ecosystem.

title: Ash & Adam's Gobsmacked
description: You are a goblin in this mini-FPS roguelite. Fight your way through The Arenas where you wreck junkbots to thrill the goblin crowds.

title: Piece Quest
description: Piece Quest is an idle RPG game. Gather resources, upgrade buildings, level-up your heroes and assemble your party to create the synergy needed to defeat the strongest bosses. With offline progress included.

title: Claria's Great Maze
description: Behind the Claria's Great Maze is the last village of humanity, and the maze is also the last barrier for humans to block enemies. And you are the last guardian of magic, the last hope of humanity.

title: Duel with the Devil
description: Win the duel with the devil and save the city

title: Oathborne
description: Oathborne is a top down action roguelite hack and slash. Unlock new skills for your class as you delve deeper into treacherous dungeons with traps, bosses, puzzles, and hordes of enemies. Each dive into darkness contains a monolith which must be destroyed to open pathways in the overworld.

title: That Way!
description: Help your partner perform the heist of a lifetime! Send him instructions for how to get to each vault and make a getaway with your newly found fortune!

title: Corrupted Spirits
description: A young hunter named Cara is chosen by the Goddess of Light to bring the spirits of the land back to normal, getting rid of any corruption they might have in their souls. Along the way she will meet a few friends and allies that might try to help her on her journey.

title: Chibi Wars Kinetic Novel
description: Chibi Wars is a series of comic 'kinetic' visual novel stories... Featuring a cute Chibi artstyle following a group of Female Warriors as they face off against various denizens of hell including zombies, vampires and demons.

title: Christmas Carol
description: Christmas Carol is crammed full of gorgeous Hidden Object scenes and superb mini-puzzles, wrapped into a great storyline based on the famous Charles Dickens novel.

title: Intown Nightmares
description: A horror almanac that tells the story of events in the city of Intown, built around a science station. The town is caught up by nightmares that in the future will affect the lives of every resident, follow how the impact of the nightmares on Intown will change over time.

title: Holiday Motel Simulator
description: Start with a crumbling motel and transform it into a guest favorite. Clean, repair, decorate, manage bookings, and expand — your hospitality empire begins here.

title: Gunzo!
description: Gunzo is a Single player fps game that features, A draw bridge, enemy's you can kill, very good shooting effects, milk that heals you, really good graphics, and most importantly very fun gameplay!

title: Death World
description: After a long night you wake up alone in the bunker as a bunker security guard. Hunt, kill, gather. Do anything to survive.

title: Mayonnaise Simulator
description: Third person shooter with minor platforming. You have to eliminate the condiment threat.

title: Eggness
description: Eggnes is on a mission to rescue his wife from the evil Crack Pot, who wishes to cook her. Eggness is a difficult old-school 2D action game. It features hand drawn animations and boss battles. Now in early access, Episode 1 features 1 boss battle, 1 platform section and 1 story mission.

title: Technofumer
description: FPS Action Arcade Game.

title: Hopwander
description: Embark on a journey above the clouds in this small cozy game. Guide a charming frog through puzzles, face scary monsters and engage in conversations with quirky characters. Your froggy adventure begins now!

title: Quirkbound
description: Quirkbound is an absurd, colorful and lighthearted turn-based fantasy JRPG. Join Isaac, Clara, and Naoto as they fight bizarre enemies, collect stickers, and cook falafel for the sake of saving the world.

title: Endless Faith
description: Highly addictive and interesting, Endless Faith allows you to control the game with simple hand movements. The gameplay is easy and enjoyable. If you're looking to play during your free moments, join us, download Endless Faith.

title: Candyland: Sweet Survival
description: Uncover the ominous mysteries of an abandoned chocolate factory. Navigate eerie levels, solve sinister puzzles, and outwit malevolent entities. Collect precious candies, unveil the factory's secrets, and confront the darkness. Are you brave enough to explore Candyland's dark secrets?

title: Embers of the Evening
description: The oil is running out. The expedition is doomed. You will never reach the lighthouse. But something worse than death awaits you if you give up. Operate the engine. Explore the ship. Unveil the truth that lies beyond your reality.

title: Gug
description: Type anything, generate a creature. Outwit, outlast, and out-weird your enemies in a sandbox tactics battler with deep simulation systems, wildly varied combat and endless procedurally-generated chaos!

title: Nazizombie's Slayer
description: Immerse yourself in a top-down pixel shooter. Play as an adamantite mercenary and follow the course of events taking place in an alternate universe.

title: Roshamboss
description: Rock Paper Scissors, but with abilities that break the rules. One player picks a raid Boss, three others draft Heroes to take them down. Strategize, improvise, and read minds in this 1v3 card game–last team standing wins.

title: Froggo's Adventure: Verdant Venture
description: A Simple and Bite-sized retro 2D Platformer about a frog on another side-scrolling adventure

title: Legend of Sword
description: This is a 3D Idle ARPG . You can ride a cool mount to travel around the three worlds, and at the same time, you can use hundreds of gods for your own use. Grab the BOSS, seize equipment, and encounter strange opportunities, just to become the best immortal!

title: Pirates. Naval battle
description: This is a hardcore game, and it's not the easiest control. But if you can acquire combat skills, then exciting battles with pirate ships are waiting for you.

title: Mix It!
description: Embark on an educational space odyssey in Mix It!, a captivating Astropilot training adventure. Master the physics of light through dynamic gameplay, stunning visuals, and award-winning sound design. Explore, learn, and conquer the universe in this genre-defying educational experience.

title: Forgotten Secrets: Escape Room
description: A year ago, Professor Oliver Wood left to explore an ancient temple. Worried about not hearing from him, you decide to go yourself to find out his whereabouts. In this escape room, you will have to discover what happened to the professor while you investigate the secrets of this mysterious place.

title: Asyle
description: Lose yourself in Asyle's open world environment to catalogue and tame wondrous creatures called Zoa. Explore the world and with the help of a team of Zoa you've befriended along the way, document the wildlife and uncover the nature of the mysterious catastrophic storms.

title: Dark Ride Simulator
description: Blue Squid Theme Parks presents the VR simulator of their most popular ride The Dark Zone. No need for long trips, now you can experience this iconic ride from the comfort of your own home.

title: CrumbleMiner
description: CrumbleMiner is a Frenetic Rogue-like Pixelart Platformer without jumping! Align your explosive barrel and BLAST trough rocks collecting precious gems and ride on top of a ROCKET barrel while avoiding your death through the dangerous Crumble Mines!

title: Fight Back The Night
description: A fantasy action-adventure game in which you must use a variety of fire-based powers to defeat an army of monsters infesting your realm. Upgrade your abilities, unlock new ones, and fight more and more enemies in this bullet-hell like game.

title: Flash Diving
description: Short horror game where you survey the descent of a capsule through a hole in the middle of an ocean, with only 4 lights and your ears to ensure your surroundings remain clear.

title: Re:Ark
description: RE:Ark is a fast-paced and deadly action-shooter in crisp monochrome palette. Cleave your path through insane inhabitants of the station. Transform your abilities and learn dark origins of the tragedy that happened on The Ark.

title: Netcode Warriors
description: ⁤Dive into the datascape of 'Netcode Warriors', an anime-style arena fighter designed from the ground up to take competitive play to its limits. Engage in intense 1-v-1 fights, master unique characters and playstyles, then take your skills to the arena. ⁤

title: Dobbel Dungeon
description: Gather your party, roll your dice and embark on a quest to discover why the local wildlife has suddenly turned evil! No two adventures are the same in this dice-powered tactical RPG!

title: Brand New World
description: You are given a chance to influence the development of your characters and settlement, forcing you to think strategically and make decisions that will affect the events in the game. Enjoy this immersive game experience where your every move will have meaning and consequences.

title: Dreams of the Void
description: May Campbell moved to the island of Cassiopeia years ago to live with her grandfather. Now, she she tries to survive day by day in a rotting world. Solve puzzles, uncover truths, and help May see tomorrow's daylight in this strange narrative-driven exploration/puzzle game.

title: Click To Ten 3D
description: the number rises, in 3D

title: Sliced
description: "Sliced" is an exhilarating PvP game where players engage in deadly combat, wielding axes and spears to strategically dismember opponents in a fierce arena. Master the lethal art of combat in this relentless, blood-soaked death fest.

title: Electrobasis
description: Electrobasis is a 3d dialogue-driven game, sprinkled with platforming and puzzle quests. Meet a cast of heavenly hosts that come with a MYRIAD of issues, and help to fix (most of) them! The casino yearns for a savior - she awaits a restoration.

title: Exitus
description: You woke up, and you have no idea where you are. What a coincidence, you don't remember anything at all; could you have been kidnapped? There is only one way to find out.

title: Swordhaven: Iron Conspiracy
description: Swordhaven is a classic party-based RPG. Explore the land of Nova Drakonia, embark on quests unique to your character, discover mysterious artefacts of the ancients, and unravel a hidden conspiracy that threatens the very existence of the world.

title: Finally Free
description: A point & click top-down horror adventure game that takes place in a nightmare

title: Horror Nightmare Collection
description: The Horror Nightmare Collection is an anthology of retro-style horror games. Immerse yourself in unique stories, from eerie forest horrors to forsaken prison nightmares, pushing your nerves to the limit. Explore psychological and grotesque terrors in this dread-inducing assortment.

title: Labyrinthian Lockdown

title: TimeSplitters 2 Redux
description:
A fan-made project which aims to fix and enhance the port of TimeSplitters 2 contained in the 2016 game Homefront: The Revolution as a hidden away unlockable easter-egg.

This port of TimeSplitters 2 is rendered natively on PC and console in full HD (to 4K), with widescreen and mouse/keyboard/gamepad support. It also uses high-quality assets and audio.

This project installs into Homefront's game folder and unlocks all of TimeSplitters 2 permanently, fixes several game-breaking bugs, adds quality-of-life enhancements, and extra content.

description:
Thorgal is an adventure action game with RPG elements, set in the world of popular comics created by Grzegorz Rosiński and Jean Van Hamme. Based on a classic, well-known tale cherished by fans, the fantasy storyline aims to provide a modern and engaging adaptation.

The player will take on the role of the main character of the series, Thorgal Aegirsson - a Viking warrior with a mysterious origin. He will have to face enemies lurking for him and his family - humans and gods known from Norse mythology. Throughout the gameplay, there are many familiar RPG tasks to complete, and he will also have to confront dangerous monsters, bandits, and powerful unknown forces. During his journey, Thorgal will encounter characters previously known from the comics and visit vast, meticulously crafted locations.

Thorgal aims to interest existing fans of the series, attract new fans of fantasy and introduce this classic comic to RPG enthusiasts.

Venture into a procedurally generated world filled with monsters, dungeons, and more as you collect resources to build up your village to push back the evil that infests your world.

Rockman X Shùxué Xuànfēng has six challenges where the player faces a Maverick from Rockman X3. Players can register their names and save high scores, with a leaderboard showing the highest score from each player in each games. In five challenges the player uses X to hit (by shooting or touching) a robot with a number corresponding to the answer of the question. There is a time limit of 60 seconds to each question. The boss attacks him if the answer is wrong, and he faces the boss after making 500 points. The stage is cleared after making 1000 points, and the player can print a certificate.

title: Final Contract

Rockman DASH Zhěngjiù Dìqiú Dà Màoxiǎn is an educational game with six challenges, one being the main game mode and the other five extra challenges.

description: Destiny Online is a 2D Fantasy MMORPG and offers free-to-play access. Pet System: Capture monsters, make them pets, and have them aid you in combat. Character Dressing up System: Freely DIY your favorite style with hairstyles, headwear, clothes, back accessories, and tails.

title: Bot Patrol

Bot Patrol is a puzzle adventure about a small worker bot on its path to freedom.
Beyond traditional sokoban mechanics, Bot Patrol features abundance of extended elements, that make achieving the goal a lot trickier. Conveyor belts, cranes, energy barriers and button triggers and not at last the evil guard drones are added into the mix.
Bot Patrol is visually polished, hard but fun puzzle challenge, but not a rage inducting repetition machine - it comes with a gracious infinite Undo and Level Reset mechanics, to always be able to take that one step back, that went to far.

description: Explore vibrant worlds while uncovering the mysteries of your origin. Overcome the dangers that await you in the vast unknown fields of unexplored planets. The truth reveals itself to those who seek, but remember that your destiny depends solely on you.

title: Shatterbound
description: Work with your past (and future) selves to solve puzzles. Shatter your obstacles, be your own platform, and more in this time-looping puzzler where YOU are your own solution!

title: Happy New Year, Zeliria!: Dragon!
description: Friends! We present you another New Year's story about the heroes of the sanctuary of Zeliria! The addition to our first story is called "The Dragon" and tells how the Chinese New Year was celebrated on Zeliria. Have a nice game!

title: Construct&Conquer: The Levant in the 12th Century
description: This work is a comprehensive game that combines elements of management, strategy, and competition. The game is based on the Arab world during the Crusades. It depicts a down-and-out young lord leading his people to rebuild their homes and fight against the enemy in the desert of abject poverty.

title: PixArk: Jade Elegance - A Theatrical Odyssey in the East
description: Every performance is a canvas where performers, adorned in elaborate costumes, embody the essence of their characters and deliver an aesthetic show. Build your unique stage with your friends, watch it come true, and let it take over you!

title: My Sexy Neighbor
description: My Sexy Neighbor is an immersive real-time visual novel for adults that transports players into the tense and emotionally rich world of neighborhood dynamics and mysterious relationships

title: Yuri Sword Saga
description: This is a side-scrolling shoot 'em up game set in a beautifully drawn Japanese world where you can slay enemies and bullets with simple controls. Parry enemy attacks and use a variety of special moves to defeat powerful demons and evil monsters.

title: Housemates
description: Housemates is a daily life simulation game. A lust virus has hit the country! Play as a college student stuck inside with his landlady and housemate. Talk to them, get to know them, and importantly, 'help them out' with the lust virus!

title: Connected Hearts: Cost of Beauty DLC
description: Did you know the wicked stepmother is a witch? Now you do, and she'll want to get rid of you. Be careful!

title: Wife Massage
description: “WIFE MASSAGE” is the new game, with one beatiful wife and she needs your help. With awesome and better 3D animation!

title: Mini Treasure Girl
description: “Mini Treasure Girl” is our new game with a beautiful and naked girl in different poses. With awesome 3D animation! Much more frames and interactions!

title: Medieval Sex Jigsaw
description: Enjoy this puzzle game with medieval sex.

title: Price of Power
description: Price of Power is a wholesome adult visual novel focused on romance and adventure. Explore forgotten lands using your skills as a master hunter, romance your childhood best friend (and maybe others as well), and rediscover long-lost secrets about your world.

title: RimWorld: Anomaly
description: Darkness stirs on the rim. Survive flesh infestations, cultist attacks, shambling undead, blood rains, invisible hunters, and other sanity-shredding perils. Capture and study entities to harness the power of the void. Conduct psychic rituals and awaken an evil machine god.

title: Manor of Mystic Courtesans
description: Manor of Mystic Courtesans - This is a place to find partners of every race, gender, and alternate dimension. Gorgeous artwork, seductive partners, and a plethora of extraordinary scenarios come together to make the most wild and lascivious adult novel game on Steam to date!

title: Die drei Freunde von der Reitschule
description: Real estate sharks are targeting Laura's uncle's beautifully located riding school. To save the indebted riding school, Uncle Arthur needs a lot of money, which his son Christian wants to win by winning the big horse show. However, a mysterious accident prevents him from doing so.

title: Little Busters! Perfect Edition: TV Anime Commemorative Edition
description: The Perfect Edition of Little Busters contains new and improved bits of content, previously included in its consumer ports, as well as a 125-page fanbook full of artwork, interviews, behind-the-scenes info, and more! You also get a disk of system voices, wallpapers, and desktop gadgets for your PC, a CD compilation of the Little Busters web radio program, and promotional cards for the Weiss Schwartz, ChaosTCG, and Megami Engage trading card games.

title: My Thai Boyfriend
description: This is an LVG, a GALGAME, a visual novel, a funny and hilarious game. It's a story about love choices of a Thai Ladyboy.

title: Ronny's Climb
description: Relive the 90s in this 16-bit inspired retro platformer! Explore colorful worlds alongside Ronny and their adorable furry friends and help them jump, dash and fight their way to the top of the mountain. Can you overcome the challenges and reach the summit?

title: Crusader Kings III: Couture of the Capets
description: Inspired by the fashions of the French court in the High Medieval Era, the Couture of the Capets cosmetic pack adds new styles and patterns for clothing and hair styles.

title: Color Splash: Dinosaurs
description: Color Splash: Dinosaurs is a charming and relaxing puzzle game that will lift your spirits and take You into the world of adorable dinosaurs and art. Venture into the gallery, where you will find many extraordinary and colorful dinosaurs paintings.

title: Boxhead: Immortal
description: A deadly plague arrives as a falling meteorite lands at BOXHEAD World. Mankind with blood type B gets infected by the plague and becomes zombie like creatures. You who are trying to survive must shoot your first bullet, and trigger any explosive materials to demolish in this bloody battleground.

title: Samara
description: A punishment trip turns into a nightmare. Trapped in a haunted school and an endless time loop, you must uncover the truth and find the killer before everyone disappears

title: Dice-Zee!: Dice Pak - "Contemporary Cool"
description: Adds new brand new dice sets to your Dice-Zee! game instantly without needing to grind for DZ coins within the game!

title: Dice-Zee!: Dice Pak - "Autumn Auras"
description: Adds six brand new dice sets to your Dice-Zee! game!

title: Dice-Zee!: Dice Pak - "Serene Chromas"
description: Adds six all new dice colors and designs to roll for those hard-to-roll numbers!

title: Plinio Needs a Hand
description: Guide the father slime, separated from his family across five levels. Use your skills to manipulate boxes and overcome challenges. Solve puzzles, explore, and reunite this unique family in an exciting journey!

title: My Destiny Girls
description: Xiao Bao opened his eyes, he was surrounded by six women. He embarked on an immersive journey of love with them. Amongst them were a gaming enthusiast, a sultry dancer, a childhood crush, a sexy doctor, an innocent schoolgirl, and a wealthy businesswoman. Who would be his true love?

title: Lost In Failures
description: It is a survival, adventure, and action game set in a living and challenging open world. Experience the legendary journey of David, who suddenly woke up on an unfamiliar beach surrounded by a forest filled with mysteries and threats. He will need to explore and fight to regain his normal life.

title: Hentai Tales: Mysterious Clinic
description: There is a clinic in a back alley in this city that claims to be able to cure all ailments, and do so in a pleasant way. You heard rumors and came to this clinic. What will happen there?

title: Winterclaw
description: Winterclaw is an immersive dark fantasy sim with an in-depth companion. Discover the fire within and survive the cold.

title: Little Busters! English Edition
