Unleash your mischief, obstruct rivals, and navigate the chaotic hilarity to victory in this wild, furry showdown!

title: An Island Away
description: Set off on a relaxed adventure to explore Dewdrop Island! Climb, glide, and backflip your way around paradise to find the reclusive Island Elder.. but what's the big rush, when there's so many fun locals to meet along the way and fishies to catch?

title: Anomaly Loop
description: You woke up and found yourself in an anomalous endless place from which it is not so easy to get out. Carefully observe your surroundings to find a way out of this place.

title: Ant Keeping Simulator
description: Grow, feed and care for your colony of mighty ants in a realistic semi-idle simulation of ant keeping. Created in collaboration with ant keeping enthusiasts, Ant Keeping Simulator will be an accurate experience to ant keepers.

title: Anomalytics: From the Files of the Arcane Statistics Authority
description: As an agent of the Arcane Statistics Authority, delve into the concrete depths of abandoned warehouses, malicious start-ups, and redacted art exhibitions to log arcane phenomena. Armed with your trusty calculator and a trove of empirical equipment, prepare to combat the unknown ... by measuring it.

title: Arcadia Fallen II
description: In this sequel to the award-winning roleplay visual novel, Arcadia Fallen, you play as a senior student at Seven Wind’s Academy. Choose from three different magical disciplines, and let your choices shape the personality of your character as they navigate school life during a time of great change.

title: Black Blade
description: This is a very classic puzzle game

title: Blacklist Mafia
description: Blacklist Mafia - is not only a struggle for power and money, but also a dangerous game of survival. Who will be blacklisted, and who will become the new boss? Find out with us!

title: Black Werewolf
description: Black Werewolf: Werewolves from neighboring lands invaded your lands and began to destroy all your property. The village elder had no choice but to send you to deal with the enemies and find out what was going on.

title: Blazing Trail
description: Escape failed! All we have left is our will to survive, the endless hordes of enemies, and enough bullets to rip them all to shreds. Blazing trail. Vertical co-op shooter, offering accessible, action-packed gameplay.

title: 3D Skills Start Here
description: Want to learn Blender but don't know where to start? START HERE!

title: Blood And Fear: Part 1
description: Experience a thrilling third-person shooter game with action, adventure, and romance. Fight zombies and soldiers, complete missions, and unlock new areas. Meet characters who will help you on your journey and have fun with both story and arena modes.

title: Blood On The Thames
description: A murder mystery puzzle game with visual novel elements in a Gothic, Lovecraftian world. Collect clues, solve puzzles, interrogate suspects, and uncover the mystery surrounding the death of Mini’s husband.

title: Blood Peace
description: Blood Peace, a hyper-violent FPS, immerses players in intense cybernetic warfare. Unravel a cryptic story or dive into chaotic action. Hunt Easter eggs, survive diverse environments, and master unique skills. Join the ultimate killing machine in this fast-paced adventure!

title: Bond Blues
description: It's 2026, and you're a bail bondsman in Burlington. A fully voiced visual novel exploring the obligations of duty, and what justice really means.

title: Bone and Arrow
description: Let your arrows fly (towards friends or enemies)! Hone your skills and join your allies to demonstrate your archery prowess. Work together or against each other to survive in this fantastical world of bones and arrows.

title: Boss Simulator
description: Boss Simulator is a business simulation game with role-playing elements. As a boss, in order to take your secretary to the island and enjoy life as soon as possible, you have to PUA your employees and shape them into overtime machines, making money for you day and night!

title: BotMobile
description: How much are you afraid of heights?

title: Boxing Go
description: Welcome to Boxing GO: Where Champions Rise! Get ready to play the electrifying clash of boxing in the ring as Boxing GO brings you the most thrilling boxing matches.

title: Bunker's Shadow
description: The game is a First Person Shooter.In a huge dangerous underground, you need to save a little girl.Being lost in a huge bunker, the task is to survive and find the keys for the doors and find the way to the exit. An encounter with zombies and enemy soldiers is inevitable.

title: Butterfly Simulator
description: Embark on a serene journey with "Butterfly Simulator"! Glide through a dynamic world, unlock stunning skins, and immerse in the beauty of nature. Relax, explore, and transform in this peaceful escape. Welcome to your whimsical retreat in the heart of nature's wonder.

title: Street Fighting Simulator
description: Some strange guys from the next street came to your neighborhood, kick them out.

title: Simulator of Ukraine 1991: Play for USA
description: DLS makes it possible to play for USA

title: Solar System Simulator
description: Gravity and exploration sandbox

title: Streamer Life Simulator 2
description: In the second game of the series, competition has increased and now everyone wants to be a streamer. Are you ready to stream until your cpu burns out?

title: Rent A Car Simulator 24
description: Rent A Car Simulator. Start by renting your first car. Expand your rental car fleet by purchasing different vehicles and grow your car rental business. Drive your cars and get them fixed when they break down. Find new customers. Build and improve your rent a car office.

title: Fight School Simulator
description: Step into the world of Martial Arts, an immersive FPS Simulation where you take on the role of a martial arts instructor determined to build the ultimate dojo. From humble beginnings, guide to greatness by mastering martial arts, teaching the next generation of fighters, and standing up to rivals.

title: Hairdresser Simulator: Beards and Mustaches
description: Master the perfect shave with the Beards and Mustaches DLC! Shave, clip, and style beards to meet your clients' needs. Transform your salon into the establishment of choice for discerning gentlemen. Elevate their style and make each customer feel like a king.

title: JR EAST Train Simulator: Takasaki Line (Ueno to Takasaki) E233-3000 series
description: The Takasaki Line is a 74.7 km long line connecting Omiya Station in Saitama City, Saitama Prefecture to Takasaki Station in Takasaki City, Gunma Prefecture. This DLC includes the Tohoku Main Line section between Ueno and Omiya stations, for a total length of 101.4 km.

title: Ambulance Chauffeur Simulator 2
description: Experience the adrenaline rush of emergency response in Ambulance Chauffeur Simulator 2.

title: Candy Shop Simulator
description: Dive into a sugary world of sweetness in Candy Shop Simulator! Open your shop, create delectable pastries, manage sales, and expand your candy empire. Satisfy your sweet tooth and build your confectionery legacy now!

title: Chocolate Factory Simulator
description: Enter the world of steam and sugar and become a master chocolatier in Chocolate Factory Simulator. Craft gourmet chocolate for your customers in your steampunk workshop with the help of your automaton assistant Nougat.

title: CozyCat Simulator
description: Experience a cozy and atmospheric feline adventure in "CozyCat Simulator." Defend your territory or form alliances in this cinematic Victorian world. Engage in dynamic mechanics, from hunting mice to mischievous antics.

title: Forklift: Simulator
description: Deliver the cargo across industrial area in realistic forklift simulator!

title: Battle RC
description: Immerse yourself in this new robot combat game where you'll fight against others and build your own bots to find out who's best. Are you prepared to dominate the arena and claim victory in Battle RC?

title: Meteorite Z: The Apocalypse
description: Hardcore top-down zombie shooter, one bite and you are a zombie, you will have allies, manage your team effectively. Use many types of weapons to suppress hordes of zombies. A colorful system for dismembering opponents.

title: Planetary Parfait
description: Planetary Parfait is designed to support a wide range of scientific research tasks, including geologic mapping, feature analysis, and mission planning. Includes features to support these tasks, such as 3D visualization, annotation tools, and data layers that can be overlaid onto the terrain data.

title: Macau Midnight Madness
description: “Macau Midnight Madness” is a Romantic Comedy Yuri Visual Novel and Dating Sim. Play as Mikayla as she goes to Macau to take part in a tennis exhibition game and ends up finding the woman of her dreams along the way.

title: Let's Roll
description: Avoid various obstacles and reach goal. It is a third-person platformer action genre. Buying skills with coins will help you reach your goal

title: Zeitz Machz: Rhapsody
description: A strange location, an awkward situation, and a mysterious girl: what will these lead to?

title: Ghost Hospital: In Thousand Horror Hill
description: It is a exploration adventure in which the main character roams a magical hospital in search of a friend who has disappeared into another world. The genre is based on a comical atmosphere, with a bit of horror waiting for you deep into the story.

title: Critical Fishing
description: Take part in wormkinds heroic struggle for freedom from their archnemesis. Upgrade your arsenal, tools and submarine to decimate the fish population to reach the ultimate goal: to boldly go where no worm has gone before.

title: Shadows Unveiled: Agnes
description: "Shadows Unveiled: Agnes" is an immersive horror game where you explore an ancient abandoned apartment, uncovering dark secrets and facing unimaginable horrors as you seek the truth behind the disturbing events.

title: Moonwakers
description:
Dive into a survival roguelite by taking control of a S.E.E.D, an advanced reconnaissance android! To accomplish your mission, explore exoplanets to determine if they are suitable for humanity.

Thus, you'll need to search for vital elements necessary for life: Carbon, Hydrogen, Nitrogen, Oxygen, Phosphorus, and Sulfur. But beware, danger lurks on this unknown land, and your survival will depend on your ingenuity and skills. Traps abound, and you'll need to strategize to make it through.

Regularly, you'll have to shelter your character to escape ionic storms. Exploration will allow you to acquire new skills and enjoy more autonomy, speed, and gliding. Your biggest challenge? Managing your energy to avoid extinction.

title: Microtopia
description: Become the hive mind of a robot ant colony in Microtopia! Use pheromone trails to create, automate and optimize supply chains for your ants to follow. Collect resources, produce goods, feed your queen, grow your colony and fly out to expand the species!

title: Travel to Australia
description: Travel to Australia invites you on a whirlwind vacation through the Australian Outback. Explore beautiful beaches, unique wildlife, and more!

title: Travel to Thailand
description: Travel to Thailand sends you on another amazing adventure with the Hudsons. Pack your bags for a trip to a tropical paradise!

title: Travel to Spain
description: Travel to Spain invites you on a new adventure with the Hudsons! No need to pack your suitcases for this trip. A European excursion awaits you!

title: Travel to Mexico
description: Travel to Mexico has an exciting adventure prepared just for you! Buckle up and join the Hudson family on their latest trip to Mexico.

title: Flutter of Birds: Tori-tachi no Habataki
description: Matsui Yuusaku, a medical college student, receives a letter from his uncle, once a famous doctor in Tokyo who now manages a hospital in a small village, with an invitation to visit him and assist with the hospital work diring summer vacation. Yuusaku hopes that this work will help him to understand why he has chosen to be a doctor, so he decides to accept this offer.

title: Calamity Angels: Special Delivery
description: A rag-tag group of kooky carriers protect and trek packages through treacherous terrains in this delivery service RPG!

title: Hexonaut
description: Hexonaut is a Turn based strategy Roguelike game. Set deep in the bellows of the Legions lair, you must reach Depth 16 to retrieve an Ancient artifact.

title: Devil Below
description: A Roguelike platformer for GBJAM 5. Jump and shoot your way to the Devil below.

title: Cosmic Crucible
description: A Procedurally generated 2D Platformer/Shooter made for Gamecraft 2016.

title: Elden Gunfire 2
description: A comic, funny and cute online multiplayer third person shooter game for everyone with fantastic cartoon 3D next generation graphics and captivating gameplay.

title: Shot & Dread Online
description: A remake of Seek & Dread Online in Unity. It has several advantages over its predecessor including: enhanced graphics, more efficient net code, IPv6 support, widescreen support and bots.

title: Desert Bus Frontiers
description: Welcome to Desert Bus Frontiers, the action-packed 580 km long trip from Tucson, Arizona to Las Vegas, where Literally Nothing Interesting happens.

title: Job Joust
description: Dunk and bump your friends in this 4-Players physics party game with wacky characters.

title: Bingo Beavers
description: Build a cozy mansion for the beavers, play Bingo, and collect puzzles to unlock new daubers. With unique challenges and endless opportunities for fun, these games are perfect for any age and skill level.

title: Trizna
description: “Trizna” is a classic plot-driven 2.5D metroidvania filled with intense battles utilizing the unique features of weapons, evasions, parries, and counterattacks. Explore the mysterious and eerie realm deeply intertwined with pagan beliefs, with blade, magic and a keen mind.

title: Grotto Beasts Arena
description:
A digital fan game of the classic TCG.

Play the Solo Campaign and Online Multiplayer with all 200 card effects!

title: Cronus Monument
description: Cronus Monument is a surrealist adventure game where players must purify the world... No matter the cost.

title: Caracolino
description: Caracolino is an educational adventure game where our hero Caracolino decides to save the planet from the clutches of Dr. Cubix, otherwise, everything will turn into geometric figures. Can you imagine a square bird or a round elephant? Only you can help Caracolino take on the dreaded Dr. Cubix! So, shall we go?

title: 7 Invaders
description: Seven friendly aliens land in a country town to go to a rock concert... But some people believe they've arrived to take over the planet! Anything can happen in this fun interplanetary story, narrated by Gustavinho, star of O Enigma da Esfinge. Have an instant seventh-grade contact with the 7 Invaders, an adventure full of galactically animated screens and otherworldly activities.

title: Flicts
description: Flicts is an interactive CD-ROM based on Ziraldo's 1969 book of the same name. It tells a story about a color that couldn't fit in with the rainbow, the flags, or anywhere else, and no one initially recognizes its deserved value.

title: The Secret of Crystal Mountain
description: Adventure through a land full of mystery and wonder in The Secret of Crystal Mountain, a platforming adventure game about a delivery cat making his way through a magical world. Stranded on a mysterious island, you explore, get to know its residents and uncover its magical secrets. Run around, swim, climb, glide, fight dangerous foes and discover magical items to explore the island and the mountain's peak.

title: Urusei Yatsura: Dear My Friends
description:
Urusei Yatsura: Dear My Friends, was originally released on 1994 in Japan only, on SEGA CD.
The game is a delightful adventure game that brings to life the iconic characters from Rumiko Takahashi's beloved manga and anime series. This PC port, developed with Adventure Game Studio and translated into English, opens the door for fans worldwide to immerse themselves in the quirky world of the series.

title: Insert Three Coins
description:
Welcome, rookie. Get your three coins and try your best shot to beat all the arcade machines. This arcade have a single rule: You beat a machine, you get your coin back.

Do you have what it takes to be the arcade king?

title: The Adventures of CJ's Closet
description: A collection of stories and minigames with Christian themes.

title: Mercuralia
description: In your search for a rare bird, you are caught in the tide of a mysterious ritual, a festival of living statues, and the ruins of an ancient floating city. Mercuralia is a mix of first-person exploration with visual novel elements.

title: Clover Toshokan no Juunin-tachi
description:
On the corner of a modern town, on higher ground atop a hill is a Western building, old as though it were left behind by time. Closed for many years, it is a private library called "Clover Library". Loving books from a young age, Aikawa Chihiro wishes to one day have a job involving books. She then earns the job of a live-in custodian of the Clover Library.

With a look like that of on old photograph, strange and impossible things occur there, one after another.

The sense of being gazed upon, even though nobody should be inside. Books that moved before one knew it. Large, large shadows peering through the window. Finally, at night, people that come out of nowhere who call themselves "frequenters since the olden days".

Surrounded by these individuals- all of whom possess distinct personalities- Chihiro prepares the library for its opening day. Eventually, she's no longer able to suppress her suspicions and confusion over the continuous occurrences of strange happenings, as well as the truth behind who or what these frequenters really are.

Struck by her questions, this is their reply:

"I'm sorry. We kept our mouths shut about it. We are not human."
"In truth, we are actually books."

title: Clover Toshokan no Juunin-tachi II
description:
On the corner of a modern town, there is a private library called the "Clover Library". During the day, it seems like an ordinary library. However, when night comes, it becomes a strange library where the books take on human forms.

The cookbook, Natsume. The picture book, Riku. The book of paintings, Shikimi. The technical book, Itsuki. The book that's the latest craze, Aoi. Aikawa Chihiro, the protagonist, became the library's live-in caretaker. While somewhat inept, she continued to manage the library.

One day... The library's pet cat, Kuu, brought a single key to Chihiro.

"I wonder where this key is for? When it's night, I'll try asking everyone."

Now, on the very top floor of Clover Library, the so-called "forbidden door" will be opened.

title: Day 224
description:
There is not a day that goes by without tears,

But regardless, I must prepare because...

Today is different.

Today is the day.

title: Adolf
description: Adolf is a simplified Brazilian clone of Risk. Play up to six players against your friends and/or the generals, each with an objective. Trace your route, travel with the movement of your commands, and move your mouse toward your goal!

title: A to Zap! Featuring the Sunbuddies
description: 'A to Zap!' was a 1995 educational title for Windows and Macintosh, developed by ImageBuilder Software and published by Sunburst Communications.

title: Touhou Koukayaku The Game
description: Touhou Koukayaku The Game is a fan-made Touhou Project Mega Man clone, while using tracks from Touhou Koukayaku.

title: Pro Yakyuu Spirits 2024-2025
description:
The "Professional Baseball Spirits" series is a professional baseball game that pursues realism.

The first home game, "Professional Baseball Spirits 2004,'' was released on March 25, 2004. "Professional Baseball Spirits 2015" introduces 3D scanning technology that photographs professional baseball players from 360 degrees and reproduces them three-dimensionally.

Furthermore, we have also adopted laser scanning technology that measures the precise shape of the stadium, allowing you to enjoy a realistic baseball experience with overwhelming expressiveness.

title: Ruthnar Online
description: Ruthnar Online is a free sandbox 2D MMORPG where you can face powerful creatures to develop your character in an open medieval fantasy world and craft your own equipment with eight diferent professions. The game also features guild wars and four different factions, join one of them to defend it and raid enemy cities. Finally, when you get strong enough you'll be able to fight in the BattleGrounds: Stronghold Conquests, Combat Arenas, Survival/Battle Royale, Leagues, Tournaments and more.

title: Deep Dark Wrath
description:
Deep Dark Wrath is a hand-drawn, card collecting, dungeon crawler where you fend off countless enemies and find its source with the help of powerful Enchanted Cards.

It's a 2D Topdown Action RPG Collectathon game that focuses on being easy-to-learn, replayable with the variety of ways to dungeon dive, but somewhat hard-to-master with a mostly fixed layout Dungeon.

title: CavEX
description: CavEX, short for Cave Explorer, is a Wii homebrew game with the goal to recreate most of the core survival aspects up until Beta 1.7.3. Any features beyond will not be added. The game has been dubbed by players and fans online as "Minecraft: Wii Edition".

title: The Failure of Aniconfuku: Convention Murder Episode
description:
Unlike many internet-founded projects, this convention was successful. But close to the end of the second day, someone was found dead in convention hall C. People reported to the local police, and all suspects were gathered in the police station.

And now, Here you are.

title: Eunae Liaro in: Fowl Play
description: You are a scholar, bard, and lover of a good mystery. What you are not is a detective. But when your detective friend is murdered while working on a case of his own, it's up to you to pick up where he left off.

title: Hauntsville
description: You're a nameless traveler, stranded in a ghost town in the Cursed West. Use your wits, elbow grease, and the iron on your hip. Build a homestead, work the land, and survive against unspeakable monsters in this unique Western horror survival game - alone or with friends!

title: Classified of 2015
description:
In [CLASSIFIED] of 2015, play as a yearbook editor working at a photography studio, trying to make sense of a bizarre photoshoot at Voyager Academy.

Use context clues and sleuth through the available photos to determine who's who, and solve the mystery of what went down at this middle school.

title: Wrongly Accused
description: Explore historical locations, find and analyse evidence. Unmask the real perpetrator so that justice can be served and the Wrongly Accused can be found innocent. Use problem solving, deduction and critical thinking skills to uncover the truth and maybe even expose a conspiracy in your own time.

title: We Suspect Foul Play
description:
Hollywood, a land of dreams!

But this dream has turned into a nightmare, with the assassination of famous actress Mary Helen in her villa in the middle of the night.

You are tasked to search the scene, find clues, and reconstruct what has happened!

title: Bombox
description: Bombox is a fast-paced casual game. Players must find and defuse the correct bomb wires before the countdown on the bomb box ends.

title: Machick
description: Defeat the heavily armed army of anti-magic toads and free the forest from destruction. Machick is a casual game where you craft your own wands, vanquish enemies, collect XP, and choose upgrades to go further on the journey.

title: Ario
description: A fantasy land plagued by nightmares, a common lad trying to rescue his missing mother and an evil forces conspiration to be unveiled. Join Ario in this thrilling adventure where your crossbow and skills will determine the fate of your people.

title: Killbeat
description: Killbeat is a rhythm shooter roguelike focusing on fast and brutal gameplay with a wide build variety. Descend into Cadence Drop, a sinkhole devouring an entire city. Fight your way deeper, driven by the rhythm towards the source of the beat. Make music with guns and guts!

title: Helga's Cheese Festival
description: Hey Arnold! fan game.

title: Polytrack
description: Polytrack is a low poly racing game made by the single developer, Kodub, that is inspired by Trackmania. It has a growing community of players and high skill ceiling. It also allows players to create their own tracks to share and play with the community.

title: Kajko i Kokosz: Szkoła Latania
description: Another adventure and arcade game, after Kajko and Kokosz in the Land of Borostworów, intended for children (from four years old), entirely based on the cult comic book by Janusz Christy, or more precisely - on the volume "Szkoła lania".

title: Poe
description: In this fast-paced difficult platformer, you assume the role of Bernard and his son Poe in an attempt to find each other. Enjoy the short, but sweet story of their paths to each other that are filled with friends, enemies and other obstacles.

title: NightGhast
description: NightGhast is a first-person horror game about wicked witches and sinister widows...

title: Forgotten Magic Tower
description: A dark maze style map exploration meat pigeon game, defeating enemies in a foggy dungeon to search for treasures, finding the entrance to the next level, and gradually collecting equipment to strengthen and defeat bosses and difficult official cards

title: Tatari: Curse Road
description: A simple survival horror set in a hilly town where you must escape from a ghost. There are no puzzles, item usage, or complex controls. If you fail, try again, memorize the roads, and find your way to the goal.

title: Shatter and Spin
description: Play electronic gyro, memories of cyber childhood! In Shatter and Spiral, players will be able to modify their gyro partners and manipulate them to shatter enemies one by one!

title: Nornium
description: This is a machine girl themed air combat action role-playing game. In the world of Nornium, you can experience ARPG cosmic air combat and its Rougelike variants, manipulate the "Time Tree" to jump around in parallel time and space at will, or enjoy a leisurely slow life in the presidential suite.

title: Zurarararush!!!
description: Zurararush!!! is a twin-stick shooter that you can play easily! Wear a wig as a weapon and defeat the virus that mutated inside your body! Power up your character and wig and become stronger! Defeat a lot of enemies and feel good! It's an arcade-style casual game that you'll want to play every day.

title: Galaxy Ballerina
description: A one-minute short story about sharing the stage.

title: Puzzle: Lines and Knots 2
description: Logical puzzle game for meditation and relaxation. The goal of the game is to assemble a puzzle consisting of knots.

title: Pixel Puzzles Ultimate: Custom Cars
description: Pixel Puzzles Ultimate, redefining digital puzzling.

title: Backpacker Guild
description: Welcome to the Backpacker Guild. To vanquish wicked monsters, hire diverse mercenaries and craft powerful items to pack their bags. Only by the hands of you, the guild master, can powerful mercenaries be created.

title: MGCM Combat Edition: DLC Char: Kamisaman (Isana Hakari)
description: This is "Kamisaman", an additional character of "MGCM Combat Edition". She can use either long-reaching normal moves or excellent projectiles to develop either defensive or offensive strategies. She is a hardworking girl who guides the main character and magical girls.

title: Magic City Detective: Wrath of the Ocean - Collector's Edition
description: Who says an impending tsunami isn't a good case for a detective? The Siren Lord didn't think much of the humans, and now that one of them has made his daughter disappear... How will you solve this problem?

title: Magic City Detective: Wrath of the Ocean DLC
description: Who says an impending tsunami isn't a good case for a detective? The Siren King didn't think much of the humans, and now that one of them has made his daughter disappear... How will you solve this problem?

title: House Builder: The Atomic Age DLC
description: Hope for the best, but prepare for the worst Build new 3 houses! A house prepared to test the power of nukes, a shelter to hide from them, and a UFO house for all other unpredictable events. All that in "The Atomic Age", the first DLC to House Builder.

title: Flashing Lights: Beast Swat Truck DLC
description: Strengthen your police department forces with the Beast Swat Truck DLC!

title: Flashing Lights: Visor Lights DLC
description: Customise your police, fire and EMS vehicles further than ever before with the free Visor Lights DLC! This pack gives you access to a large variety of visor light types, and allows you to customise them extensively - including colours and light patterns.

title: Escape Simulator: Magic DLC
description: This level pack includes four new escape rooms set in the world of witches and wizards. Grab your equipment in the magic shop and then go onward to the school of magic, where three classes await your mastery.

title: DriftCE: Toyota Supra MK5 DLC
description: Expand your fleet by pulling in another legendary car: the Toyota Supra MK5. To make your new car unique, take it to your garage and make changes to its set-up to best suit your driving style. Overcome your limits and leave rivals in the dust!

title: Aura: Hentai Cards - The Dark Sea DLC
description: Long ago, the elves of the Dark Forest promised to protect the sea kingdom of Aquantis from the depth's evil creatures. Though, a war with the Demon Queen prevented them from doing so. And many inhabitants of Pentarull know how vengeful the depth's creatures can be...

title: Arma 3: Creator DLC - Reaction Forces
description: When the call comes, nothing is more important than how fast you react. Make use of unique assets in several new game modes and let your quick thinking show while in the heart of action.

title: Cursed Despair
description: Cursed Despair offers a chilling experience where you and your friends will face a mysterious monster, plunging into deep despair. Gather the necessary items to survive, perform the ritual, and stand firm amidst the darkness.

title: Dimenshift: Direction is Meaningless
description: A minimalist sci-fi 2D platformer where you shift through walls and machines. Explore and find secrets in a strange, maze-like dimension, where the laws of physics don't seem to make sense.

title: Lil Doll House
description: In this twisted horror escape game, play as Cynthia, the doll of a vengeful little girl who wants nothing more than to subject you to horrific traps designed to kill. Use strategic thinking to effectively solve action-oriented puzzles and escape with your life. But be quick, the clock is ticking!

title: JR EAST Train Simulator: Rumoi Line (Fukagawa to Rumoi) Kiha 54-500 series
description: The Rumoi Line is a 14.4 km long JR Hokkaido line connecting Fukagawa Station in Fukagawa City, Hokkaido to Ishikari-Numata Station in Numata Town, Uryu County, Hokkaido. This DLC includes the up and down lines between Fukagawa and Rumoi (total length 50.1 km), including the discontinued section.

title: Soar: Pillars of Tasneem
description: Experience a beautiful world of floating islands through the eyes of a dragon

title: Avoid Falls!
description: Your objective: conquer these heart-stopping tracks and emerge victorious without succumbing to the abyss below.

title: Casual Mahjong
description: A single-player Japanese Riichi Mahjong game. After intense battles with real players, why not enjoy a relaxed and delightful match?

title: Horror School Story
description: Immerse yourself in the foreboding atmosphere of Enspire School of Digital Art, brought to life with realistic graphics. Solve intricate puzzles and face psychological challenges to progress through the nightmarish school environment. FACE YOUR FEAR and ESCAPE THE NIGHT.

title: KanjiMemory
description: Increase your grasp of Japanese kanji character readings by playing rounds of classic Memory game where you try to find and match kanji and their readings.

title: Seven Bullets Horror
description: In this game, players have seven bullets to defeat monsters. Use bullets wisely and aim for head shots. It is also possible to avoid being found by the monsters. The game ends when the player is attacked. To clear the game, the player must find three tools and reach the goal.

title: Horror of Victim
description: Psychological horror about a girl captured by an insane family.

title: Now Open! Horror House
description: This is a simulation management and tower defense type game where players take on the role of a "Horror House Owner". Using various mechanisms and props, players aim to scare off visitors who come to challenge the "Horror House", gradually expanding and strengthening the business.

title: Mysterious Mystery, EP 1: The Duo Dilemma
description: Mysterious Mystery is a fully voiced mystery visual novel centered around the detective duo, Justin and Dakota. Solve multiple cases using Dakota's evidence gathering abilities and Justin's expert interrogation. Discover outlandish cases, meet unique characters, and become world class detectives.

title: Măgurele Mystery 2
description: After Captain Burcea's discovery from the previous game, the secret services started experimenting with what they found, but everything goes out of control and a virus is created by mistake... or was it? Peoples zombie-like starts wandering around and mutated creatures start killing.

title: School 666
description: School 666 is a 1-4 Player Co-op Survival Horror. You must escape this endless nightmare. Try to identify the correct path and survive the anomalies in this endless school. Some extremely powerful anomalies will catch you to their dimensions. Explore the reason why you are here... and don't die.

title: FunPlay School

description: Discover ‘Harmony' with the China Railways HXD1, a new Chinese electric locomotive from Just Trains.

title: Train Simulator: Feather River Canyon Enhanced: Oroville - Portola
description: The fabulous Western Pacific Feather River Canyon Route now comes to Train Simulator Classic in an expanded and enhanced edition, re-creating the railroad’s magnificent 118-mile Third Subdivision from Oroville to Portola, California!

title: Train Sim World 4: London Overground Suffragette line: Gospel Oak - Barking Riverside Route Add-On
description: An Aventra Adventure awaits in Train Sim World 4! Discover North & East London boroughs aboard modern traction, traversing a newly electrified and extended line fit for future service. Become something of a driver yourself on Gospel Oak - Barking Riverside!

title: Train Simulator: Rudolfsbahn: Bruck an der Mur - Selzthal & Knittelfeld
description: Head to scenic central Austria with Rudolfsbahn from RSSLO.

title: Train Simulator: Ringbahn Berlin Circle
description: Travel around the capital of Germany in style with this detailed recreation of Ringbahn Berlin Circle for Train Simulator Classic from developer VirtualTracks.

title: Train Sim World 4: Bahnstrecke Salzburg - Rosenheim Route Add-On
description: Go cross-border and shuttle along the rural backdrops of Europe in Train Sim World 4. Take a trip back to the early 2010s and climb aboard the classic BR 111 - tap into Deutsche Bahn regional services between Germany and Austria with Salzburg - Rosenheim!

title: The Intertwined Imprints
description: "The Intertwined Imprints" is a yuri visual novel that tells a story about youth, growth, and love. Due to an accident, Mei Yu was temporarily brought back to the village where she spent her childhood. She didn't think it was a good idea, but... she didn't feel like she had much of a choice.

title: Seal: What the Fun
description: Seal: WHAT the FUN is an omniverse multiplayer party royale game that allows up to 20 players to enjoy a range of compact plays in 10 minutes. Players can customize their characters with variety of effects and features, making the game more interactive and unpredictable.

title: Your Earth
description: This game is an earth creation simulation game that allows you to create and view the earth in various shapes.

title: Political Punchers: 2024 Arena
description: In a time where politics feel more like a battleground than a debate, Political Punchers transforms the intensity of the political sphere into an exhilarating 3D fighting game that’s both humorous and thrilling. As the presidential election looms on the horizon, it’s time to elect your fighter!

title: Spellarium 4
description: Help Eric build the Tree of Life by playing Match 3 levels as well as some additional bonus games: Spot the Difference, Hidden object scenes, Mahjong, and Solitaire!

title: Giresun
description: This is a 3rd person shooter game that you can play 1v1, 2v2, 4v4, 5v5 mods against bots.

title: Patchouli's Adventure In Doll's House
description: Let's unravel the mysteries of the Doll's House with witch Patchouli! Embark on an adventure in the mysterious and beautiful doll's House, find items, solve puzzles, and find the whereabouts of her beautiful lover - Alice. Experience a relaxed and fun story, and discover the secrets of the witches.

title: Age of Wonders 4: Expansion Pass
description: The Age of Wonders 4: Expansion Pass includes the Archmage Attire, the Dragon Dawn content pack, the Empires & Ashes expansion, the Primal Fury content pack and the Eldritch Realms expansion.

title: Screenbound
description: Screenbound is a platformer unlike any other. You move in first-person view at the same time while playing in 2d on the screen of your Qboy. Mind-bending environmental puzzles will force you to test the limits of dimensional space. Your jumping and movements are mirrored - but certain things affect the opposite dimension. Combat is in 2d and you will receive your loot in 3d.

title: OlliOlli World: Expansion Pass
description: Continue your quest for Gnarvana. OlliOlli World’s Expansion Pass includes two narrative expansions bundled at a discount.

title: A Difficult Game About Rolling: ReUpRise
description:
This is a difficult game about Rolling.
Embark on an unparalleled journey to the summit through an unforgiving landscape of mountains, waterfalls, and ancient ruins, all surrounded by the vast, unending ocean.

title: Radiant Exodus
description:
Sarah Caldwell's casual drink at a neon-lit bar turns into a night of survival.

As mutants descend from a UFO above Gleam City,
Grab your AK47 and fight back in this adrenaline-pumping first-person shooter.

title: Fractal Sailor
description:
Fractal Sailor is an experimental, atmospheric horror tech demo where you take the role of a lone sailor navigating a hovercraft through a dark and mystic fractal environment. Your objective is to refuel and reactivate abandoned stations that have collected rare resources from these fractals.

However, you are not alone...

Survive for as long as possible and immerse yourself in this chilling experience!

title: Mot's Grand Prix
description:
Step back in time to an era when folk were real folk and race car steering wheels were real steering wheels. Mot's Grand Prix is a pseudo 3D Formula 1 racer inspired by Grand Prix Circuit, Continental Circus and a bunch of other 80s/90s racers.

The game has 4 difficulty levels plus a practice mode to learn the courses without the pressure of racing.

title: Freezing Knights
description: A light co-op turn-based RPG. Take control of two knights and try to reach the end of the perilous snowy mountain paths​ by avoiding enemy attacks and powering-up your characters.

title: Alone in the Dark: Digital Deluxe Edition
description: A Love Letter to Horror Fans

title: Whiplash Taxi Co
description:
A break-neck taxi driving game. Welcome to the Whiplash Taxi Company, where our motto is "The slower you're there, the lower the fare!"

As a valued employee and taxi driver, your job is to pick up passengers and deliver them to their destination as fast as possible, by any means necessary.

Passengers are easy to spot, just look for the big red arrows over their heads.

title: Final Fantasy XIV Online: Complete Edition
description: This bundle includes Final Fantasy XIV: A Realm Reborn, Final Fantasy XIV: Heavensward, Final Fantasy XIV: Stormblood, Final Fantasy XIV: Shadowbringers, Final Fantasy XIV: Endwalker, and Final Fantasy XIV: Dawntrail.

title: The Coma 2B: Catacomb
description:
The Coma 2B: Catacomb is a Korean survival horror adventure. It is a back story of the previous game The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters, and a story bridge of all series. You are back in game as Youngho Choi, the main protagonist of The Coma 1, you must venture from the mirror dimension of reality to survive. What happened between The Coma 1 and The Coma 2? The answer is in here.

Immerse yourself in the warped Sehwa district as you encounter an engaging cast of characters, solve puzzles, discover revealing clues, and fight for survival against a relentless psycho.

Running and wielding your flashlight makes you an easy target. You must precariously balance the urgency of exploration with your absolute need to survive!

title: Asphalt Legends Unite
description: Continue your Asphalt legacy with Asphalt Legends Unite! Expand your garage and presitigious car collection as we unlock the world with crossplay, raising the stakes in multiplayer and co-op game modes, with action-packed gameplay that rewards skillful play and risk taking.

title: Space Moves
description: Space Moves is a sci-fi puzzle adventure game that features a unique game mechanic where enemies move in sync with the main protagonist (grid based movement mechanics).

title: Final Fantasy XIV Online: Complete Collector's Edition
description: This bundle includes "Final Fantasy XIV: A Realm Reborn", "Final Fantasy XIV: Heavensward", "Final Fantasy XIV: Stormblood", "Final Fantasy XIV: Shadowbringers", "Final Fantasy XIV: Endwalker" and "Final Fantasy XIV: Dawntrail". All in-game bonus items from the Collector’s Editions are included.

title: Dollhouse: Behind the Broken Mirror
description:
Enter the broken mind of Eliza de Moor, a once-celebrated singer, now trapped in the labyrinth of her own forgotten memories. The only hope for recovering her memories lies with Doctor Stern and his experimental medicine. As Eliza, you'll navigate the reality and the world behind the broken mirror, guided by the effects of the drug.

Will you be able to piece together the mystery of your past, or will you get lost in this dark and twisted reality?

title: South Park: Snow Day! - To Danse with Ravenous Shadows
description: School is cancelled and Henrietta is bored. Join her efforts to pierce the veil and she will allow you to “Danse with the Ravenous Shadows” of South Park.

title: South Park: Snow Day! - Digital Deluxe
UltraCook
description: Test your cooking & multitasking skills in this arcade Chef Sim!

title: Commando Hero 2: First Blood
description: Hero who wants to be a commando has to pass difficult tracks. Finish the track fast and enter the Leaderboard.

title: Texas Border Guard
description: This is a first-person shooter game, the late 21st century, the world is overcrowded, the world is full of hunger and viruses. Small countries have long been crowded in by refugees from all over the world. However, aliens also appeared in this world. Because the whole world is paralyzed.

title: Nine Lives Ninja: Explore!
description: Take control of a cat (who also happens to be a ninja) in this platformer with metroidvania elements! Explore the ancient cave system and find new powers to help you overcome obstacles in your search for the Fountain of Kitty Youth.

title: Blood Poker
description: The Rules are Simple. Bet with your Blood. Enjoy the Show.

title: Dragonpaw
description: Join the lazy, disgraced, idiot-moron wizard Ronan alongside his brave, powerful, attractive bodyguards Cinder and Socks on a 2.5D dungeon-crawling journey to defeat the gromnipotent Wizard Grup.

title: Save Giant Girl from Monsters
description: A flight simulator game. Save the giant girl from the monsters attacking her using a helicopter or plane.

title: Fleshless
description: Fleshless is unique fixed camera exploration game with rich lore, where you need to explore abstract world and discover it's secrets.

title: Permanent: Hope & Vacuum
description: Psychological horror, puzzles, platforming, adventure, dungeons, action, intrigue and a touching story are all terms that should be used to try to define the essence of «Permanent: Hope & Vacuum».

title: Oversleep
description: Oversleep is a first-person puzzle adventure. Navigate dreamworlds, solve intricate puzzles, and employ unique mechanics to reveal secrets and overcome obstacles. Experience a mind-bending journey through bizarre environments.

title: DinoEscape in the Time!
description: A portal opened and launched the dinosaur into the modern world, now it's up to this dinosaur to turn on 5 generators and turn on the time machine to go back to the past.

title: Sex Maids
description: Sex Maids - is an erotic game in the genre of "Arkanoid", in which you will have to break the cubes and gradually discover really beautiful and hot images.

title: The Colonists: New Lands
description: Expand your frontiers with The Colonists: New Lands! Improve your transport network with Bridges and Train Tunnels, boost your economy with the Mint and even allow your bots to discover their spiritual side…

title: I am an Air Traffic Controller 4: Airport Nagoya - RJGG
description:
This product (ATC4: Airport NAGOYA [RJGG]) is DLC for "I am an Air Traffic Controller 4".
This DLC includes control of the Chubu Centrair International Airport in Tokoname, Aichi, Japan.

title: Clue For Your Thoughts
description: Sift through the evidence to find out who did it.

title: Evil Sinister
description: You're a journalist investigating an abandoned house. Armed with only a flashlight, navigate its haunted halls to uncover its secrets. Beware, malevolent forces lurk, blurring reality and nightmare. Will you survive to reveal the truth, or become another victim of its sinister grasp?

title: Dog: The Dog Takes the Hindmost
description: Looks like Ludo, but it's DOG. In this game, you also have to safely bring your four game pieces into your home area. The difference is that they are moved using cards that have a few surprises in store for you. Team spirit is important, because you can only win together.

title: Secret with Sophia: Lite Version
description: Let Sophia whisk your troubles away... Take it easy and enjoy some soothing relaxation time with your maid Sophia, who's fully animated via Live2D!

title: Escape the Traps
description: "Escape the Traps" is an addictive and challenging game that puts your skills and reflexes to the test.

title: Sister's Curriculum
description: The Story of Tutoring Top 1% Repeat Students Sisters

title: Search All: Candles
description: Is a hidden object game in which you need to find all the candles in a large location. Candles will be placed in a variety of places, from the most prominent to barely noticeable places

title: Fuck You Witch
description: Your best friend has confessed her love for you... but the problems don't stop there. You've started to hallucinate. All this interferes with sleeping and eating, and in general disrupts your ideal lifestyle. Yell obscenities at the witch, immerse yourself in the atmosphere of the Qazaq steppes

title: Airanblade
description: AIRANBLADE is a 3D vertical progression action game, like the classic shoot 'em up games. Fight against squadrons of enemy aircrafts and gigantic bosses. Enjoy beautiful special effects and lots of explosions and lasers coming from every corner.

title: Moving Houses
description: A silly little physics-based game about moving on... or is it? Be neat, be careful, or be a chaos goblin. The choice is yours. But be warned, not all is as it seems in this quiet little house.

title: Hentai Casino
description: Your girlfriend is asking you for money, so you face a tough choice: Work hard to advance in your job, and perhaps your boss will reward you ;) OR Go to casino and trust your luck. Win money and unlock new girls!

title: I Got Gooned by a Femboy
description: Desperate times call for desperate measures.

title: Phantom Ascension
description: Dive into the intense "Phantom Ascension," a single-player action game set in a dystopian 20XX. With unchecked corporate power, crumbling governments, and rampant lawlessness, the Blacklight Gang, a coalition of criminals and mercenaries, seizes control, plunging the world into chaos.

title: My Valentine is a Femboy
description: A day before Valentine's Day a special someone just happens to fall into your lap.

title: Evolution Board Game: Flight Expansion
description: Evolution: Flight, an expansion for Evolution, introduces flying species into the ecosystem. Now your species can swoop on unsuspecting prey from above, fly away from predators, or soar to a new food source when food is scarce.

title: Cosmic Holes Junior
description: COSMIC HOLES Junior is a puzzle game where you must follow logical placement rules while constantly keeping an eye on the speed of the pieces you’ve placed. If the pieces spin too fast, they’ll explode. To slow them down, you must take into account their relationships based on the five elements theory of Chinese cosmology (Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, Water): Water nourishes Wood and controls Fire; Wood nourishes Fire and controls Earth, and so on. This game is suitable for both adults and children.

title: Stellar Monarch 2: Old Dynasties
description: Old Dynasties is the first expansion to Stellar Monarch 2, a feudal space empire builder where you feel like the Emperor not a logistics officer. The expansion focuses on noble houses and internal politics of the Empire by introducing new mechanics and events.

title: ComicBachiCooon!!
description: "Comic Bachicon!!" is an action game in which a player who has become a popular manga artist completes a manuscript by hitting characters from the manga world into frames! ! Let's hit the characters everywhere, including the pieces and the ground! !

title: Touhou: Fading Illusion - Destitute Chapter
description: The "Destitute Chapter" presents the events of Touhou: Fading Illusion from the perspective of Reimu Hakurei. Join her as she searches for answers to a series of mysterious and tragic events that will forever change her view of the youkai and Gensokyo.

title: Quack Attack
description: Join the Cubic Chaos! Get ready for a wild ride in this 4v4 FPS arena on a cube planet. Choose your animal, collect ducks, and let limbs fly in this cartoon mayhem. With collectible weapons, multiplayer and voice chat, it's a fun carnage at its finest!

title: Mini Zen Garden
description: Create your own mini zen garden in this calming sandbox game. Decorate your beautiful garden with a minimalistic set of objects. Share your garden with others, sit back, and relieve your day's stress.

title: Netghost
description: Netghost is a Crime Drama visual novel with a mystery-driven story full of intrigue, twists and turns. The story follows Ian Newfield, a cyber security engineer who transforms into a cold-blooded criminal in his struggle to protect the company he works for and aid his ailing sister.

title: Secrets of the Shore
description: Discover the allure of 'Secrets of the Shore,' where a serene island getaway takes a mysterious turn with the arrival of a storm. Forge meaningful connections with captivating characters and explore the secrets that emerge amidst the changing tides in this charming yet intriguing visual novel.

title: Meet The Animals
description: A comedic twist on the average stylized exploration indie game, find your way around this beautiful farm and interact with the animals that have been scattered across the landscape.

title: Jury: Episode 1 - Before the Trial
description: A high quality, erotic, sexy and fun visual novel - and yes, there are animations!

title: Jury: Episode 2 - The Trial of Brooke Lafferty
description: The second instalment of Jury AVN: This Episode starts where you left off from Episode 1. The trial is about to start, so get your suit on, and get your ass to court!

title: Guilty Gear: Strive - Additional Character 12: A.B.A
description: This allows the character "A.B.A" to be used in-game.

title: Elder's Will
description: A Father's Journey. A disabled father, fueled by love, scales treacherous lands with his honed crutches. Master the art of crutch combat, unleash devastating throws in battles, and navigate daring platforming to heal his ailing son. Can you defy despair in this minimalist, stylized 2D platformer?

title: Idle Devils: New Character - Belial
description: "Beelzebub" is a warrior-type character, delivering high damage while also having decent survivability. As the Lord of Sloth, she not only can push back enemy actions but also induces the "weakened" status upon foes. Radiating with feminine determination and unique charm, she exudes her own charisma

title: Backrooms: Eternal Shadows
description: Journey back into the abyss with "Backrooms: Eternal Shadows," an expansion that plunges you even deeper into the mysterious and twisted world of the Backrooms. As you step into the unknown, brace yourself for a haunting experience that transcends the boundaries of reality.

title: I Brought the Noble Girl Home
description: The future war broke out, and many noble girls were taken away by unknown creatures. You were chosen by your superiors to go on a secret mission to bring these girls back.

title: Beer Factory Crew
description: Beer Factory Crew puts you in shoes of a production facility manager. Your goal is to produce finished shipments of beer and sell them. You can manage inventories and work in progress, machine orders, worker assignements and research new items.

title: Peaches and Dreams
description: A turn-based rpg about overcoming emotional abuse and the monsters that find homes in your mind.

title: Baggage Inspector
description: Baggage inspection! The words every traveller dreads to hear! Only this time, you're not the traveller, you're the inspector. Sounds exciting? No? Ah, if only you knew the things people put in their baggage! Now you can, in this casual VR-supported work simulator.

title: Stronghold: Definitive Edition - Swine's Bay Campaign
description: 'Swine's Bay' extends the base Stronghold: Definitive Edition campaign with seven new missions and extra achievements. Under the tutelage of the wise Sergeant, continue your quest to rescue the fabled 'Jewel of the North' from the clutches of the villainous Pig.

title: Bodyrain
description: Slaughter hordes of zombies and challenging bosses in Bodyrain: a zombie FPS game! Accumulate money to acquire new weapons and gain experience to strengthen your character and clean up Dawn City!

title: Skeleton Messi
description: This is a game similar to Vampire Survivor. You are a skeleton named Messi with just a skull and a body, but you want to be the richest, the most powerful and the kindest in this world.

title: Dubio
description: Dubio is a game of tiny puzzle parcours. It offers a A challenging mix of puzzle-solving and momentum control. Jump and bounce through 100 levels that test your wits and sense of timing. Or are there more?

title: Deflectorium
description: Deflectorium: 2D sci-fi rogue-lite singleplayer. Deflect deadly shots back at your enemies to become unstoppable. With unique deflection system, you'll dominate battles while upgrading your skills and stats. Prepare for adrenaline experience where defense isn't just a tactic but an art.

title: ReRise
description: Futuristic Colosseum, W, A, S, D controlled robot wields deadly weapon to conquer by hunting creatures. Victories spawn challenges, testing limits, and intensifying crowd's roar. Steel Gladiator battles in arena, faces relentless creature horde. With each creature vanquished, Colosseum tension rises

title: Martial Law: Our Spring
description: Grey blocks of flat, Militia and tanks on the streets, the desire for a better tomorrow and your drunk buddy on the bench. Welcome to Martial Law: Our Spring.

title: Event Race: Bob's Art Table Tracks
description: Explore 'Colorful Tracks' with 3 vibrant raceways & 2 thrilling game modes: 'Last One Out' & 'Chased'. Outrace opponents or flee the deadly smoke!

title: Supreme Fighters: Javan Havan the Drunken Fist
description: A very cool drunken fist character using flames to his advantage!

title: Stacking Fairy
description: Let's stack various blocks to compete in height! It's a fun game where you can enjoy the excitement together with everyone or take pleasure in honing your skills diligently on your own!

title: Color Escape: The Love Levels
description: Discover new way to have communication problems with this love-themed level pack ♥

title: Robot Multitool
description: Robot Multitool is a puzzle adventure about a multifunctional robot. You can control a flying arm, cling to a rope, shoot, release an electric charge. You will have to go through fascinating puzzles, skill tasks and battles with robots.

title: Super Farming Boy
description: Your farm is under attack! Fly, harvest, grow crops & whack enemies with your shape-shifting one-button superpowers as you seek revenge from your evil nemesis, Korpo, who has captured your mom & friends! An action-puzzle farming sim featuring chain reactions and combos.

title: SysAdmin Odyssey: Back to the office
description: The SysAdmin simulator is a sandbox in which you can try on the role of a system administrator. Every new game day you will face different tasks and problems in the office where you work.

title: Riding to Bounce City: Babydoll Set A
description: Unique babydoll lingerie for CherryRuby, Eve, and Jeanne.

title: No Life: Zombie Survivor
description: NO LIFE: Zombie Survivor is a brutal survival roguelite where you’ll face endless hordes of relentless zombies. Choose your survivor and weapons, each with unique abilities and playstyles, and gear up for increasingly intense battles against the undead.

title: KeepUp Survival: Mountain Map
description: A small additional Free Mountain Map. Explore this cute little map, go hunting and build a nice shelter.

title: Operation Temple
description: You have to take on the role of a mercenary going on a dangerous mission, you are sent to an abandoned city to restore magical totems and destroy enemy invaders.

title: Hermetica
description: Travel back to darker times, and enjoy a roguelike deckbuilder adventure, set in XVI Century. Discover the secrets of alchemy and fight mythical beasts. Hermetica combines card tactical combat and potion crafting, with a unique medieval art style.

title: Living with Temptation: American Sunset
description: The new edition of a classic Living with Temptation contains all expansions, with redesigned gameplay, refreshed visuals, and a lot of new content. Relationship simulator where you may try to stay faithful to your wife, exploring her wild fantasies or... go wild and date other girls behind her back.

title: Folgore
description: 1959 - Olimpia, South Italy. Play as Giove Scadenza and save your fiancée from the Inferna mafia with your newfound powers. Can you survive the Folgore ?

title: Kick Me!
description: Kick opponents off rooftops in KICK ME! Multiplayer PvP madness awaits as you strategize, deploy unique abilities, and grab boosts to secure victory. Navigate dynamic arenas, and be the best kicker! Are you up for the challenge?

title: Plasma Orb
description: Dive in the beautiful and mysterious world with your Plasmorb!

title: Haunted Bloodlines
description: Haunted Bloodlines is a first person survival, psychological horror game. In the dark rooms of an expanding mansion, a terrifying story unfolds. As the mansion breathes, hidden secrets lay within its walls. Survival depends on your own sanity. Always remember time can either be a friend or an enemy.

title: SymbioPhobia
description: SymbioPhobiA is a short survival horror game, mainly from an isometric perspective that mixes action, exploration, puzzles and platforming that takes place in a futuristic and post-apocalyptic bunker that has an oppressive and claustrophobic atmosphere.

title: Iridio
description: Seized by criminals, the island designated for your research needs your help. Join Yatziri and the Wazhari tribe to liberate their hostages, explore hidden secrets, craft essential items and weapons, and strategically use fire and water in challenging puzzles and life-or-death battles for survival.

title: Mangoji
description: Mangoji — is not just a card game; it's an exhilarating dive into a world of excitement and beauty, where strategy and luck confront each other head-on. Prepare for a unique adventure, as over 150 enchanting ladies await to become part of your gaming experience.

title: Dark Web: Vigilante
description: You are Vigilantus, a master hacker fighting to fix a rotten society. Immerse yourself in a world ruled by corrupt corporations, politicians, and greedy pharmaceutical companies. Uncover dark political secrets, sabotage systems, redistribute wealth to the poor, and destroy entire corporations.

title: Forza Motorsport: 1966 Lotus Type 35
description: Forza Motorsport 1966 Lotus type 35

title: Average Maria Individual
description: Average Maria Individual is a parody of Super Mario Bros. created for Ruin Jam in 2015.

title: Livli: A Sámi Story
description: Follow Livli; a headstrong, smart Sámi girl whose village has been burnt down in late 1800's Sweden. As her people are persecuted or killed, she flees from the chaos. Embarking on a perilous journey in order to find the Bear - known as "Father Forest" he is a holy spirit and guardian deity, protecting the land and the Sámi people.

title: Coop Catacombs
description: A traditional roguelike with asynchronous multiplayer and cooperative mode. Exploring these dungeons, you will feel accompanied at all times and will be able to witness the traces of other adventurers.

title: Blackout: Uma Aventura Energética
description:
In Blackout, you have to help energy beings, Bivolt and Risoluminosa, who are in trouble. They have noticed a threatening drop in the level of positive energy on Planet Earth, one of the driving forces of the realm of energetic beings who live in symbiosis with the realm of material beings and who, if they become unbalanced, will suffer the negative effects through excesses or shortages of energy in our world.

When they ask for your help, they will tell you that, many years ago in our human time, they installed "positive energy" channels in various monuments throughout Planet Earth.
Surprisingly, when they came to inspect their positive energy sources, they realized that they were deteriorating much faster than expected. They were being covered by a layer of negative energy, unbalancing their realm and threatening our existence.

Join Bivolt and Risoluminosa and discover what's going wrong with the world's monuments.

title: Ambitious Mission
description: A legend has long been told. Whoever gathers all twelve stars known as the "Ambitious" is said to be able to fulfill any ambition. Tonight, someone in pursuit of that legend appears on the streets of Sahoro once more...

title: Traulian: O Ultimo General
description: Traulian: O Ultimo General is a medieval adventure game where you take the role of Traulian, the only survivor of the Dolbian army, in the great battle against the evil forces of Cerem. Your objective is to eliminate the monsters to avenge the death of your friends.

title: AI2U: With You 'Til The End
description:
Cute catgirl Eddie, pretty witch Elysia, and stunning AI hologram Estelle all seem to adore you—perhaps to a fault! Learn what makes them tick by exploring their homes and talking to them about nearly anything.

An overarching storyline looms over your adventures together, connecting your narrative to the dynamic NPCs. Solve puzzles and unravel mysteries alongside your lethally charming companions.

Your words and actions shape the outcome of each round, with a variety of endings waiting at the end of each playthrough. Strategize to unlock the best outcome and whisk your captors away!

title: Zero King
description: You are a Junker pilot, with only a buggy droid and a handful of zBits. With the help of fellow Junkers, you will use salvaged parts to customise your starfighters to your unique play style, then pilot them in the Grafter arenas for glory and gain. Design smart, fight hard.

title: Doom Eternal: Year One Pass
description: You pulled humanity back from the edge of extinction, but it came at a cost. The imbalance of power threatens all of creation. Now you must rise and set things right in DOOM Eternal: The Ancient Gods.

title: Insurgency: Sandstorm - Year 1 Pass + Year 2 Pass
The Desperate Flight of Hand Solo
description: An action-arcade game where you play a space pilot with one good arm who has to defend their ship from alien attacks while fueling up to warp to safety.

title: Guild Wars 2: Elder Dragon Saga - Complete Collection
description: The Elder Dragon Saga—Complete Collection includes the first three expansions: Guild Wars 2: Heart of Thorns, Guild Wars 2: Path of Fire, and Guild Wars 2: End of Dragons. You'll also receive 5 Living World seasons to continue with your journey between the expansions.

title: TopSpin 2K25: Grand Slam Edition
description: Compete on the world's biggest stages with the TopSpin 2K25 Grand Slam Edition! Get the Grand Slam Champions Pack, plus the Under the Lights Pack, New Wave Pack, Rookie Rise Pack, and the All Access Pass.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator: 40th Anniversary Edition
description:
From light planes to wide body jets to gliders and helicopters, fly highly detailed and accurate aircraft in the Microsoft Flight Simulator 40th Anniversary Edition. The world is at your fingertips.

The Standard 40th Anniversary Edition features 37 airplanes, gliders, and helicopters with unique flight models, 25 handcrafted airports, 4 classic commercial airports, 14 heliports and 15 glider airports.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator: Premium Deluxe 40th Anniversary Edition
description:
From light planes to wide body jets to gliders and helicopters, fly highly detailed and accurate aircraft in the Microsoft Flight Simulator 40th Anniversary Edition. The world is at your fingertips.

The Premium Deluxe 40th Anniversary Edition includes everything from the Deluxe Edition plus 5 additional highly accurate planes with unique flight models and 5 additional handcrafted international airports.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator: Deluxe 40th Anniversary Edition
description:
From light planes to wide body jets to gliders and helicopters, fly highly detailed and accurate aircraft in the Microsoft Flight Simulator 40th Anniversary Edition. The world is at your fingertips.

The Deluxe 40th Anniversary Edition includes everything from the Standard Edition plus 5 additional highly accurate planes with unique flight models and 5 additional handcrafted international airports.

title: 1000 Light-Years Away
description: Someone stole a time machine and it's up to you to get it back. Travel 1000 Light-Years Away to help Togard on his exciting match 3 space adventure.

title: Adventure Rock
description: Imagine a place like nowhere else, where anything could happen. It's waiting for you. Adventure Rock, play, create, explore.

title: Sailor Fuku to Femme Fatale
description:
That's it. I'm your femme fatale.
The woman who will become your absolutely destined partner and lead you to your end.
That's me. And that's you.
