description: 18 more levels of increased difficulty for puzzle lovers

title: Happy Birthday: The Horror of Christmas
description: Merry Christmas! Happy New Year! But this year Santa has a big problem! His old friend Deer ran away from home! What the hell is going on here? !

title: Pixel Puzzles Aardman Jigsaws
description:
Immerse yourself in a whimsical world of creativity with our latest digital jigsaw puzzle game, featuring the beloved characters from Aardman! Pixel Puzzles Aardman brings you iconic scenes from the lovable Wallace & Gromit to the hilarious Shaun the Sheep and much more. The game features 26 free puzzles with piece counts ranging from 96 to 425.

Dive into the enchanting world of Aardman, where every piece tells a story, and every puzzle piece placed brings you closer to the magic!

title: Pixel Puzzles Aardman Jigsaws: Shaun The Sheep
description: Pixel Puzzles Aardman, the definitive jigsaw puzzler for the PC platform.

title: Pixel Puzzles Aardman Jigsaws: The Farmers Llamas
description: Pixel Puzzles Aardman, the definitive jigsaw puzzler for the PC platform.

title: Pixel Puzzles Aardman Jigsaws: Wallace & Gromit - A Matter Of Loaf And Death
description: Pixel Puzzles Aardman, the definitive jigsaw puzzler for the PC platform.

title: Pixel Puzzles Aardman Jigsaws: Wallace & Gromit - Vacation
description: Pixel Puzzles Aardman, the definitive jigsaw puzzler for the PC platform.

title: Void Soul
description:
"Alright, we're going to rush to our target destination."

Endless revenge and twisted longing for family.
Steampunk fantasy of two emotions burning like fuse till the end begins now!

The story of an empire reigning over the desert continent and revel train confronting the empire.

title: Galaxy Burger
description: A stress-free cooking game that lets you relax! Cook up burgers for mecha cats and aliens. Play solo or with up to 7 friends!”

title: YiShi
description: A squad-based game where the player takes the role of a healer in a Whac-A-Mole attempt to keep the squad alive through healing, enchantment, and offensive spells to vanquish hordes of green skins.

title: Deck of Darkness: Infernal Depths
description: You are an artifact hunter, a seeker and purveyor of rare, magical relics. The ultimate goal of your search is the fabled Deck of Darkness, an incredibly potent arcane artifact said to grant it's bearer immortality... for a price. Journey into the Infernal Depths and face your terrifying destiny.

title: Subway Outbreak
description: In Subway Outbreak, defend and rebuild your metro station against mutant hordes in this pixel strategy game. Manage tasks like fortifying defenses, launching assaults, and gathering resources to survive 30 days of increasingly fierce attacks. Lose by death or generator destruction.

title: Primland The Magus
description: A dark fantasy 2D action game about a solitary island that has turned into hell and a girl named Magus. Collect "relics" sleeping on the island and acquire skills. Take on mysteries and powerful enemies using a variety of actions!

title: Sir Bucket
description: Sir Bucket is a choose-your-own-adventure game set in a fantasy world with over 30 different endings. Explore the world and have your story told by a wisecracking narrator.

title: MeteoStorm
description: MeteoStorm is an action packed retro shoot-em-up. MeteoStorm offers up to 25 challenging waves of exciting shoot-em-up action with 3 different difficulty levels!

title: Chuno
description: This is a game where Chuno, a mutated snail, goes on a journey and brings back souvenirs and stuffed animals. A very easy and short 2D action. Menu operations are performed using the mouse. Use only WASD or arrow keys. There is no failure or retry system.

title: Piece It!
description: A casual jigsaw puzzle experience! Listen to awesome background music and enjoy the relaxing view and sounds of nature at the end of each puzzle!

title: Chat Wars!
description: Chat Wars! is a real time strategy game playable only for a streamer with at least 30~40 viewers. Gather gold and upgrade chat viewer's Unit and spell for streamer! Collaborate with chat and streamers to win!

title: Ostera: The curse of...
description: Immerse yourself in Ostera: The curse of..., a hilarious narrative game where magic goes as haywire as your villagers! Set in an absurdly humorous medieval-steampunk world, take on the role of a village chief desperate to lift a curse and save his people from impending disaster.

title: Many Mini Typing Games
description: Chase high scores in a series of breakneck typing minigames! Keep up with keyboard-mashing cats, banana-wielding monkey-cowboys and more as you "QWERTY" your way to new heights!

title: Shy Girl's Makeover
description: College students Kenta and Ayaka are united in their love for video games – and in their feelings for each other. Will their relationship progress beyond being two close gaming friends or will Ayaka’s heart be charmed by someone else? Find out in this slice of life RPG set in modern Japan!

title: Escape Qinglong Mountain Re
description: You wake up suddenly and find yourself in a mental hospital, facing numerous severely mentally ill patients, with your life hanging by a thread. Can you escape from here?

title: 3AM Corp: The Balbazar Resort
description: Beware of Balbazar in this horror/psychological thriller adventure. Evade the enigmatic Balbazar, use your wits and homemade sleuth kit to capture proof that something ominous is happening, and make it out alive. Do not get caught. The cops aren't doing anything... perhaps there's a reason.

title: Firewall: Cyber Defense
description: A lore-based cyberspace tower-defense where you defend artificially intelligent Constructs from Corrupted bugs and viruses.

title: SoundKilla
description: SoundKilla a game steeped in Caribbean Sound Clash culture. Succeed by collecting dubplates, mastering DJ skills and conquering formidable bosses. Set against a backdrop of cityscapes and tropical islands, this game offers a unique blend of music, strategy and storytelling from start to finish.

title: Chronocide
description: Stop the undead from entering the temporal portals with traps and your weapons. Play the campaign solo or in co-op mode up to 4 players.

title: Forget Something?
description: A thrilling and fast-paced indie horror game.

title: The Simulation
description: A never-before-seen horror game is the only evidence found at a crime scene. As a retired game designer hired to investigate the case, you find a hidden mode that plunges you into a rabbit hole of the unknown. As more obscure games are uncovered, cross the fourth wall of their worlds and investigate terrifying truths that transcend their own reality...

title: Presidents Tower Defense
description: Defend the Oval Office from an endless alien invasion by harnessing the abilities of your favorite (or least favorite) U.S. Presidents.

title: Mr. Scientist
description: Mr. Scientist is a single player horror game. You are a hostage of a mad scientist and now you need to escape from his house.

title: Paraplasm: Beyond the Veil
description: You fell into this cursed house! But will you be able to cope with the paranormal activity? Solve the puzzles and try to find your way out!

title: Twilight Epoch
description: A science-fantasy action-RPG, taking a party of characters on a story-rich journey through a universe in it's dying breath.

title: Black & White Lite
description: "Black & White•plot exclusive version" is a dystopian visual novel game: black and white, sensibility and reason, freedom and order: follow your beliefs and join your camp.

title: Sticky Arrow
description: A Sokoban-like puzzle game, which can be solved using only the arrow keys.

title: Zhuzi Subdues Demons
description: This is a CRPG game, you can operate a team of 5 people to explore together. Combat is real-time, but allows players to pause the game mid-game to give orders to their team members. The controls refer to Dragon Age origins and Dragon Age II. If you like Dragon Age, you can try to play this game

title: Xeno
description: Xeno is a 2D platform game - we move left and right and jump in the game, we can shoot and, in some cases, sneak to eliminate enemies from hiding. The game will also feature the use of the environment, such as exoskeletons or vehicles of all types, and puzzles.

title: Twenty-second: Stories of Underground Kharkiv
description: The Twenty-Second: Stories of Underground Kharkiv is a quest and a visual novel that will tell you in the first person about the events of 2022 in the Kharkiv metro.

title: Forty-Niner
description: Immerse yourself in a survival and exploration game set in a procedural Wild West world. Choose your role, and set out to prove your legend on the frontier by building, mining, and battling alone or with friends.

title: Incremental Town RPG
description: Incremental Town RPG is an idle game where you manage the workforce of a small village, inputs, capital, other resources and help provide all the equipment and weaponry needed to progress and defeat creatures in distant Dungeons.

title: Virus 3D
description: Eradicate the logic viruses infecting your android baby sister in order to save her life in this fast-paced twin-stick shooter.

title: Chordioid
description: Chordioid is a unique musical JRPG where you battle to the beat. Explore a strange world, make unlikely friends, and uncover dark secrets, all while the beat goes on.

title: Slo's Home
description: Forty seeks revenge by trying to get all the information possible to unmask the real Slo, paying him back in kind. Slo's Home is a game that combines the control of an action game with the control of a point'n click adventure.

title: Castle Conquest: Medieval Strategy
description: A simple strategy about capturing castles. Build up your forces, manage armies and capture enemy fortresses. Build buildings in castles and use strategic tricks. Capture all the fortresses to win.

title: Legacy of Epstein: Foul Dreamer
description: Following the events of his "Bad Omen", Juglio arrives in the fallen city of Gettysburg to search for his friend Lenny.

title: Warrior Lords
description: Warrior Lords offers a furious medieval arcade experience, drawing inspiration from classic beat 'em ups. Battle through Western Europe wielding cold steel, delivering powerful kicks and summoning dragons. Choose from 6 unique heroes and defeat your rivals in a quest for supremacy.

title: Astral Disorder
description: As the lone maintenance worker on an unkempt space train station, navigate the chaos unleashed by a catastrophic crash and evade a relentless beast. Armed with scattered tools and state-of-the-art equipment, outsmart your pursuer and secure passage to safety aboard a distant escape pod.

title: Baseball Legacy Manager 24
description: Build the ultimate legacy as the general manager of a professional baseball team!

title: Monkey See, Monkey Doo, Monkey Kiss You
description: Monkey See, Monkey Doo, Monkey Kiss You is a gripping first-person horror adventure. Stranded in a sinister forest, evade amorous monkeys while navigating treacherous paths. Face chilling encounters, uncover mysteries, and fight for survival in this pulse-pounding tale of fear and tension.

title: Liminality
description: Liminality is a single-player exploration game focused on liminal spaces, but mainly the poolrooms. Dive into the eerie but relaxing lukewarm water of the poolrooms. Navigate through the liminal spaces, where reality blurs, and uncover the secrets that lie beneath the surface

title: Diary of a Stoner
description: Wander through the Stoner Universe and Duel with Magical Cards! Will you use your power for Good? Or Evil? Many different endings are available depending on the choices you make. You are about to embark on a wonderous stoned adventure!

title: Cursed Dawn
description: Cursed Dawn is a wave survival FPS featuring complex maps packed with secrets, dynamic spawns, and hordes of zombies to turn into gory mulch. Plan your defense, stay on the move, and master the maps. Remember: Nowhere is safe, death is assured, how long can you last until you become zombie chow?.

title: Syuukun in Mirror World
description: The game is a short walking simulator that explores a 3D space. However, the controlling character is trapped in the Mirror World, and the player must control him from the real world to lead him to the goal.

title: SGS Battle For: Hue
description: The battle of Hué is an epic fight during the audacious 1968 Tết offensive launched by the Communists during the Vietnam War. Relive one of the longest, bloodiest battles the Americans would fight against VC in that emblematic conflict.

title: Mirage: A Biplane Adventure
description: Embark on a daring journey in Mirage. Master aerial combat, navigate treacherous skies, and unravel the mystery behind invading machines. Can you save the world?

title: Farm Together 2
description: Grow your own farm all by yourself, or cooperate with your friends in the long awaited sequel to the cozy, relaxing farming experience!

title: Eternal Strands
description: Fight epic, towering creatures while blending magical abilities with an arsenal of powerful weapons to keep the world from crumbling in this third-person, action-adventure game.

title: Hydrogen Game
description: A falling puzzle game where you drop 118 different elements and aim for a high score. You don't have to know the elements! Can you see the 118th element?

title: Item Collector Ball
description: You're a ball that collects items! Explore this carefully crafted time trial platformer with a plethora of unique physics based obstacles. Unique music and retro aesthetic define this game and provide a relaxing and satisfying experience. Easy to pick up but challenging to master.

title: Kill The Clock
description: Enter mid-1900s Europe on a quest for revenge, only to find your nemesis murdered. Framed for the crime, unravel the mystery with RPG elements, offering various choices to crack the case. With each playthrough, uncover new killers and methods. Can you clear your name before it's too late?

title: Bird Year
description: Bird Year is a gentle, family-friendly arcade game where you're a bird. Feed your hungry babies and avoid the dangers of the forest all year long. Catch bugs, eat berries and dodge predators while using your chosen bird's unique abilities. Unlock bonus content including more birds and a bonus level!

title: Dead Season
description: Guide a group of unprepared strangers in their struggle to survive a zombie apocalypse, in Dead Season, a turn-based tactics game. Strategize to endure against relentless undead hordes, but beware, noise attracts more danger. Can you escape the outbreak's grip?

title: Lands of Koastalia
description: Lands of Koastalia is a relaxing city building game with a unique building system. As Mayor, your primary mission is to keep people happy. Craft natural-looking villages, manage resources within and across them, explore an island, and meet the needs of your residents.

title: Diamond Drone
description: Put your drone piloting skills to the test in Diamond Drone! Race against the clock to collect all the rubies while keeping an eye on your battery level. Don't forget to search for batteries on the floor to recharge. How skilled are you at maneuvering drones?

title: Unscripted Fate
description: The protagonist is Alex, who comes from a poor family and by this reason, from an innocent child ends up being part of a criminal organization from a young age.

title: Pinball Storm: Lokanta
description: Pinball Storm:Lokanta is a RPG game combing Roguelike and pinball gameplay. You will be part of the resistance against plutocracy. Use your marble pinball to eliminate waves of enemies, and collect resources to further enhance your pinball. Save the world from hell!

title: MrHuh
description: Fight zombies.

title: On the Bubble
description: Inspired by classic platforming games, On the Bubble is an action-packed 3D platforming experience for fans of fast-paced games. The level editor allows anyone to make their own creations to be completed at breakneck speeds.

title: Teo Dove Pro Skater 2
description: Skateboarding game in the spirit of THPS. Perform flip tricks, grabs, grinds. Insane lines. Level up your character and learn new tricks. Find hidden secrets. And challenge your rival to a classic game of skate HORSE!

title: Dirge For The Zone
description: Dirge For the Zone/D4Z is a top-down shooter with role-playing and base-building elements. Build your base, protect your people and send them to explore the Zone.

title: Football Manager Lifestyle 24
description: Can you balance football management and life simulation? Football Manager Lifestyle 24 uniquely blends both, Guide your club to glory and pursue personal ventures to become a lifestyle icon. Grow your club, manage fishing and farming businesses, make friends, and win trophies in this dynamic world.

title: Skuf Backrooms
description: Have you ever wondered what might be waiting for you when you once again leave the confines of your apartment? And you obviously didn't realize that an ordinary walk to the garbage chute could turn into your nightmare.

title: Escape From Zombietown
description: Escape From Zombietown is an Action Shooter FPS where you collect guns, grenades and consumables to help you fight off the zombies while you make your way out of town. With 20 levels filled to the brim with zombies, this game has all the zombie annihilating action you need.

title: Machorium: Muscle Aquarium Simulator
description: Machorium - Muscle Aquarium Simulator - is a relaxing idle and sandbox game where you can unwind and have fun. Use points generated by cute little decorative muscle men to unlock various items and create your ideal muscle aquarium, Machorium.

title: Shush
description: You are one of the "Waste Warriors", navigating hazardous forests to gather trash for the Eco-Collector. Collect resources, build a base, evade enemies, and uncover the dark secret hidden within the Eco-Collector to survive.

title: Programming Factory
description: What kind of sparks will programming and factories create? Watching strings and numbers run on the conveyor belt, enjoy leisure time!!!

title: Escape the Kreegan
description: Escape corruption and deliver truth to the people in the only way you know how. as a space fighter pilot! You steal a ship and flee, it falls to you to duke it out in space and deliver truth to the people. Restore peace. Restore justice. Save humanity and Escape The Kreegan!

title: Don't Let It Die
description: As the first tribe to discover fire, master its creation amidst prehistoric survival challenges. Synergize 17+ unique characters, items, and strategize to ignite your legacy and secure humanity's dawn. A solo quest for fire's mastery awaits those with the will to not only survive, but thrive.

title: Sipssassin
description: You are the Sipssassin and your mission is to drink people’s drinks without getting caught. Run, fight, sneak and drink through unique levels, tackle challenges across four different game modes, unlock new characters, tools and power ups, while discovering hidden secrets.

title: Egg Defense
description: 'Egg Defense' is a strategy game where players deploy units to defend against enemy eggs from portals. Units have unique skills. Every 5 stages, players upgrade character skills using selected cards. The game blends casual strategy with enjoyable action for a delightful gaming experience.

title: Steel Symphony
description: Steel Symphony is a 2D Action-Strategy platformer where players craft combat sentinels by selecting components and balancing stats like integrity, mobility, and weapon capabilities. Chassis, weapons, and modules shape each sentinel's role with varied abilities for strategic customization.

title: Coffee For Cthulhu
description: Coffee For Cthulhu is a Lovecraftian Comfy Coffee Shop Simulator. During the day, you serve customers, brew coffee, and keep the various coffee machines from exploding or attacking customers. During the Night you hunt for ingredients in the dark woods where the feral monsters lay in wait.

title: Buzz or Die
description: If you win, you are acquitted; if you lose, you are executed. Death row inmates compete for ratings and talk battle in the conversation deck!

title: Milfvania Ep. 1
description: An animated adult visual novel, set up in a post-soviet environment. Yes, you live with the landlady.

title: Duckside
description: Imagine DayZ or Rust but you're a duck. A persistent world survival game with PVP, PVE, crafting, base building and hat wearing ducks, wielding weapons.

title: Xīn Shéndiāo Xiálǚ zhī Wánjiépiān
description:
Xin Shen Diao Xia Lu Zhi Wanjie Pian is the second installment in the series based on Louis Cha's (better known by his pen name Jin Yong) The Return of the Condor Heroes. Players will control Yang Guo who finds out that his lover Xiaolongnü is still alive after 16 years and sets out to find her.

The game plays like an RPG. Players move Yang Guo using the mouse and battles use a turn-based system where each character out of a party of up to 3 characters can attack as soon as their meter is full.

title: A Turnabout to El Dorado
description:
Taking place several months after the events of Spirit of Justice, Phoenix finds himself alone when he takes a rather strange -- and extremely hopeless case. With an uncooperative defendant, a staggering amount of evidence supporting the police's case, and a prosecutor that clearly has it in for him, how will Phoenix turn things around? Is there even any room for doubt?

Where does the truth lie?

In the hearts of the key players, all with their own secrets and motives?

Between the trees of the dense forest, the scene of a horrific murder?

Or perhaps, in the mythical city of gold that seems to be the connecting factor between the strange circumstances of the case -- El Dorado?

title: Eighteen
description:
You awaken in a house that is not yours. You are haunted by a past that you hope is not yours. You are given a name that you fear can never truly be yours.

You are Tohya Hachijo.

...Or are you?

In this short interactive experience, take control of an amnesiac looking to find his footing in the home of a strange woman, as he discovers his past -- or runs from it.

title: The Firebrand
description:
"The pain's always the same."

An interrogation room. Sitting on one side of a table is a woman. On the other is you - a detective tired of asking questions, but desperate for answers.

Who is the woman? Why is she here? What has she done?

The only way to find out is to talk. Every conversation topic giving new leads to chase down. Some worthwhile. Others not so much.

Follow the rabbit hole until you reach the truth.

title: Didnapper
description:
Didnapper is a non-profit fan RPG Maker game originally developed by Wychkith for the ADIDAS Message Boards as a fun little curiosity before it became a full game after developer Kendrian became lead developer in 2012.

The story revolves around a princess from a unnamed fantasy kingdom named Suki who, after being betrayed by her cousin Cherisa who wanted to inherit the throne instead of her, is given the choice to join the Kidnapping Guild that held her captive in exchange of not being bound and gagged in a cell and to discover why Cherisa betrayed her.

As a kidnapper, she is tasked to kidnap girls for ransom while her guild searches for information on her cousin's whereabouts.

title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six: Vegas Collection
description: A collection of both Rainbow Six Vegas & Rainbow Six Vegas 2. Rainbow operatives take to the chaotic streets of Las Vegas as an escalating terrorist siege in 'Sin City' threatens to take world terrorism to new, uncontrollable heights in Rainbow Six Vegas. In Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Vegas 2, it is your last chance to rescue America's sexiest city from an escalating terrorist siege that will force you into heart-pounding action from beginning to end. The best are back and this time winner takes all.

title: Exoprimal: Season 4
description:
The third Capcom Collab is slated to release its set of collaborative content with Mega Man alongside Title Update 4.
It'll include suit skins, decals, charms, stamps, and emotes based on the beloved Mega Man franchise!

title: Call of Duty: Black Ops II - Nuketown Zombies
description:
Nuketown Zombies, also known as Nuketown in-game, is a Zombies map that is featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops II. It is based on Nuketown, a multiplayer map from Call of Duty: Black Ops and Call of Duty: Black Ops II.

The map was previously only available to players who purchased the Hardened, Care Package, or Digital Deluxe editions but was later made available to purchase in the system's digital marketplace.

title: Call of Duty: Black Ops II - Nuketown 2025
description:
Nuketown 2025 is a downloadable map released for Call of Duty: Black Ops II. It is a remake of Nuketown which first appeared in Call of Duty: Black Ops. While the original Nuketown went for more of a traditional 1950s theme, the new map is now in a 1960s retro-futuristic Mid-Century modern style meant to represent the "Home of the Future" for 2025.

It was available for free to anyone who pre-ordered the game, purchased a launch copy, or purchased the Hardened edition or the "Care Package" limited special edition of the game. It was later made available to download for free to everyone as well as being included in an update for Call of Duty: Black Ops II on Wii U.

title: Luminastadt
description: It's a cosy colony simulation game. Build and expand your colony by designing buildings, roads and infrastructure. Manage resources such as food, water and building materials. Manage housing, healthcare and education to keep your population happy and productive.

title: Catarsis: Catventure
description: Step into an exciting journey in Catarsis, a rogue-like action game where you are the last hope for the world. In this outlaw-like action game, surviving enemy attacks in each room will require careful choices of upgrading your character's abilities and the features of the weapons in your inventory.

title: Box To The Beat VR: Indie Electro Beats
description: Introducing the "Indie Electro Beats" DLC for BOX to the BEAT! Enjoy 10 unique tracks crafted by two up and coming artists! Feel the intensity as you sync your punches with the beats made by these talented creators. Step into the ring and prepare to be challenged as you take on these intense levels!

title: Car Wash
description: Car Wash is a cozy experience where you transform dirty, old cars into gleaming masterpieces. Enjoy the relaxing process of scrubbing, polishing, and adding the perfect finishing touch with the power of fresh soap and a hint of clean perfume!

title: Funny Farm Learning Games for Toddlers and Kids
description: Does your child like farm animals, farm life, animated puzzles and want to learn their first colors, shapes and sizes? Then get your child our new Farm Games educational game, which includes different animated levels and a ton of fun.

title: Legends of Dragaea: Idle Dungeons
description: Legends of Dragaea: Idle Dungeons is a First Person Idle Dungeon Crawler game with 6 unique races to choose, robust combat, a grand saga spanning a continent full of unique kingdoms, free-form skill system, and a guild management system to master as you uncover the secrets of the world of Dragaea!

title: Animal Farm Jigsaw Games for Toddlers, Babys and Kids
description: The ultimate farm children's game with lots of animal puzzles and farm motifs. The perfect learning game for all children, toddlers, babies, jigsaw puzzle and animal lovers. Familyfriendly!

title: Trouble Comes Twice: Bonus Stories
description: An optional DLC that adds additional post-story moments to Trouble Comes Twice! Enjoy various short stories starring the twins and their love interests.

title: Time Avarice
description: Time is your currency and challenge. Destroy crystals for time; lose it if they vanish. Every run offers new power-ups, with choices that shape your journey. Unlock more as you play, all set in a visually dynamic, arcade-inspired space roguelite.

title: Save the Frog Keita
description: This game is to help the frog Kata and his friends escape from a dangerous area.

title: Escape Blocks
description: A space themed puzzle game.

title: Cosmic Kitchen
description: Cosmic Kitchen is a 2D cooking game set in space! Your mission: Feed hungry monsters or else they will take over all the galaxies! Think fast and grab food as it flies into orbit. Use planets, asteroids and more to get cooking and save the universe!

title: Destination Paradise
description: Embark on a global adventure to uncover hidden objects in charming locations, solving puzzles across 20 captivating chapters.

title: Catch My Color
description: Catch My Color is a game that find objects by applying the appropriate colors to the sights of Korea in black and white. Have fun coloring various landmarks in different colors and discovering hidden elements!

title: Serega Madness Pixel Adventures
description: Serega Madness Pixel Adventures — is a single player horror adventure game set in a pixel world. Solve interesting puzzles while hiding from the insidious horrors waiting for you in the shadows.

title: Secret Forest
description: Discover a vibrant realm brimming with wonders, where incredible races come to life. Master a unique combat system and challenge epic foes in your quest for glory.

title: SteamRush
description: STEAMRUSH is a third-person Boss Rush game featuring fast-paced melee combat against unique bosses, punctuated by exploration segments that gradually unveil the captivating story of the isolated city-state of Haze.

title: Button Man
description: Button Man is a side-scrolling adventure game set in a fictional Nova Scotia during prohibition. After years of being the henchmen to the local bootlegging kingpin your job now is to find who killed him and protect the town from what’s coming to it. Explore Kingsport and learn the truth!

title: Deep in The Fear
description: Dive into heart-pounding terror with our co-op horror experience for 5 players. Uncover chilling mysteries, face unspeakable horrors, and survive together in this intense collaborative nightmare. Will your team escape the shadows, or succumb to the darkness that lurks within?

title: Just a Cute Capybara Puzzle
description: Just a Cute Capybara Puzzle to keep you happy.

title: The Last Tiger
description: In the game "The Last Tiger," you will control the fate of four tank commanders during World War II! You will participate in the most bloody tank battles of the Second World War.

title: NeoSprint
description: The exhilarating Atari racing classic “Sprint” series returns! NeoSprint zooms back to life as a single screen arcade racer for up to 8 players, paired with a robust track builder and intuitive sharing tools, ensuring a racing experience that satisfies speed demons and architects alike.

title: Void Foundation: Into The Void
description: Void Foundation: Into The Void is a JRPG game with SCP & Randomized dungeon exploration element. Void Foundation tells the story of a future world which human history has been rewritten due to the discovery of Void Gate Players will be recruited as void adventurers, discover the secrets of the void.

title: Automate It
description: Automate It is a factory building game that requires clever solutions to its size, power, and time constraints. Solve challenges, build and share your own levels, or open things up in sandbox mode. If you want to build it - Automate It.

title: Clone War
description: It's a roguelike game that gets stronger by winning a fight against clones.

title: Steel Effigy
description: Fight against a horde of soulless machines in this 1 to 4 player action-roguelite, hack n slash. Wield several combat defining weapons simultaneously and imbue them with elemental augments to enhance their power. Create unique builds by collecting and using powerful items to devastating effect.

title: True Idle Simulator 2
description: How long can You do nothing?

title: Mad World Survivors
description: Mad World Survivors is a casual Vampire Survivors Like game in the style of cyber-post-apocalyptic horror with elements of a simplified roguelike. Here, every decision you make can cause an avalanche of consequences for the hordes of monsters you will face.

title: Auto RiskRisk: Deluxe Pieces
description: The Deluxe Pieces sets unlocks 4 new fighter pawns and 12 new battlefield play mats for customising your team.

title: Assassin's Belief
description: This is an interesting balloon game where balloons appear randomly from the edge below the stage and disappear when they rise to the edge above the stage.

title: Everlords
description: Everlords combines the elements of real-time strategy and base management. As a mighty Everlord, you possess the godlike power to create worlds, harness the elements, and guide your devoted followers in the battle against the advancing chaos forces.

title: April 24th
description: The main character is an experienced journalist who always strives to uncover the truth. He manages to gain access to the house, which is guarded by the police.

title: They Can Fart
description: Play as a one-eyed farting creature and glide across the stars in this 3v3 online competitive gravity based multiplayer game, where you jump between planets, dodge other player’s bullet, and plant seeds to make your team win.

title: Subway
description: Detect even the smallest change and safely reach the destination station.

title: Storm's Eye
description: As a Runner, master your environment and claw your way through the endless stream of corrupted monsters chasing you. Gear yourself up on the drops of your adversaries, recycle or upgrade it, and complete objective to move forward. But beware of the Storm !

title: Catarsis
description: Catarsis unfolds in a future environment and people share this place with AI robots. In the midst of chaos scientists developed a revolutionary technology which will enable cats’ intelligence to inhabit a robotic body, allowing it to liberate the world from the ruthless rule of humans.

description: Crowborne is a 2D platformer With the ability to Melee, shoot Run and Fly around!

title: D-Day VR Museum
description: Step into the pages of history with "D-Day VR Museum", an immersive virtual reality experience that brings the monumental events of D-Day to life like never before. Transport yourself back to June 6, 1944, and witness the heroic actions of Allied forces during the largest amphibious assault in history.

title: Deadly Footprints
description: You find yourself being chased through snow-covered terrain by a relentless killer who is tracking your every move by following your footprints. Run, sneak, hide and use the items you find to evade the killer, in a pixelart horror game where every step you take could be your last.

title: Deeper Than Hell
description: Deeper Than Hell is an action roguelike for 1-4 players where you play as mysterious mage, driven by the legend of a great treasure, he goes deeper and deeper to find the legendary treasure. Wield weapons & accessories, build synergies and find out what lies deeper than hell.

title: Dark Umbra
description: Fight against the Umbral Horde on your way to take down the sinister sorcerer who doomed the world. Team up with friends or go it alone as you level up your character and collect powerful relics in this action rogue-like.

title: Daydam Knight
description: Daydam Knight is a roguelike deckbuilder game. You play as a knight who is trying to destroy demons that have attacked his land. Use your Powerful cards and destroy all the enemies.

title: Purpose Calling
description: Saving people, solving puzzles, and repairing what’s broken. Designed for young heroes aged 7-9, Purpose Calling invites players to step into the shoes of a hero who's power suit allow them to be a detective, EMT, firefighter, and construction worker to make a difference, one adventure at a time!

title: Discin
description: Discin is about throwing the disc in the basket. Experience the beauty of flight as you explore our custom-crafted disc golf courses. DISCIN currently features 3 unique courses and 4 discs with varied flight characteristics.

title: Dopamine
description: ROLL ROLL ROLL! An online 1-4 player co-op physics-based “rube-goldberg-like” gambling game! Place ramps, cannons, turrets, and other contraptions in the name of maximum Dopamine. Unlock zany items to harass your friends, avoid dangerous side effects of gambling, and survive the clinic trial…

title: Doodle TD 2
description: Doodle TD Is back and better than before, Place and smack enemies down with force in this brand new tower defense game. We added color from the original game as the evil mastermind has colored the world of doodle land.

title: Doodle Factory
description: Welcome to Doodle Factory - your ticket to the world of factory fun! Dive into building and designing with ever-changing boards. Get creative, boost your efficiency with cool upgrades, and make each factory uniquely yours!

title: Dot Hop
description: Dot Hop is a grid-based connect-the-dots game with deceptively challenging puzzles. Find a path from start to end without leaving any dots behind.

title: Dreadrun
description: DreadRun is a top-down bullet hell with roguelike elements. Where you must explore and gather various forms of loot such as guns, potions, and perks in a limited period of time in order to evade and shoot hordes of various enemies while escorting a payload to safety.

title: Dreamboat
description: This is a wonderful game!

title: Elumin
description: Worker of honor from Lindenauw, you are mandated on the Tswinoberg exploitation site. A first person exploration experience.

title: Elemental Exiles
description: Elemental Exiles is an RPG deckbuilding roguelike. Play as one of 12 heroes, each with their own personal quest, starting location and initial cards. Overcome challenging battles and adapt to unexpected narrative encounters as you grow your deck and explore.

title: Eclipse of Elysium
description: JRPG meets Western RPG: Help Aria uncover a dark conspiracy. Battle through hordes of enemies and meet complex and charming characters in a colorful fantasy-world.

title: Earth Defenders
description: During the game, you play the role of one of the army commanders who faces alien invaders.-Expand your base-Extract raw materials-Create troops-Counteract invaders

title: Endloop
description: You are trapped in an endless stairway with no end in sight. Solve twisted puzzles and maybe you will escape your fate.

title: FaceYourFear
description: Face your fear is a horror game based on a story with puzzles and a realistic and stressful atmosphere.

title: Fatal Terminal
description: A retrofuturistic co-op horror about extracting secret objects from abandoned space stations for corporate clients.

title: Fatal Falls
description: In Fatal Falls you explore the dark secrets of "The Grand Elysium", a posh luxury hotel. Interact with its guests, drink a cocktail at the bar, peruse the noble premises – the choice is yours! Just make sure you choose appropriate answers when talking to people who are mentally unstable...

title: Felbound
description: Felbound is a challenging and ruthless roguelike game. Embark on a journey into a mysterious dungeon, facing off against orcs and goblins with a plethora of weapons spells and items!

title: Floops Big House Adventure
description: Shoot, loot, and toot your way through 90's cartoon inspired Floops Big House Adventure! Floops is a wave based roguelike arcade game. Learn enemy attacks and upgrade combinations in order to take down the Monster Overlord!

title: Forgotten Mechs
description: Quick mech battle for two players. Choose weapons, explore the map and destroy your opponent.

title: Forest Fellers
description: Forest Fellers! A game about Gnomes, Trees, and chopping them. Generate wood as you hire your very own Forest Fellers (Gnomes) to fell forests YOU make. Your Gnomes will grow and level up the more they chop allowing you to get more and more efficient trees for them to take down.

title: Flying Ferret
description: In this action game, a mysterious ferret with special jumping ability and its friends are made to jump and fly at high speed from island to island over the blue ocean to fly farther and farther.

title: Fowl Swarm
description: Just another day at the farm, face seemingly endless swarms of killer chickens. They will keep coming, you can't hide. Survive for as long as you can...

title: Fresh Milk For Mars
description: A cute puzzle game in which you have to catch cows and bring them back to Mars.

title: Gaming Cafe Life
description: Manage your very own gaming cafe!

title: Ghost of Viyk
description: In the lands of Vyik, death is just the beginning. Tailor your items and abilities to create your unique battle style — and slay enemies who never play by the rules, in this Ukrainian Grimfolk roguelite action. Because the price of freedom is never fair.

title: G-Mode Archives+: Tantei Kibugawa Ryousuke Jiken-tan Vol. 14 - Rasen no Kan Satsujin Jiken
description: Two cases are intertwined in a spiral, Heading toward a sad truth.

title: Gobocore: Goblin Rescue Squad
description: Party Building Turn Based Auto-Battler about little goblins rescuing their kidnapped tribe members. Smash. Evolve. Survive.

title: Godslayer Arena
description: Godslayer Arena is a fusion of autobattlers and action-rpgs. Draft a set of synergizing spells for your Godslayer to cast and witness their power as they take on the arena. Combat is performed automatically, and success is determined through strategic build creation.

title: Golden Road
description: Hey buddy, have you ever driven around your city?

title: Granser
description: A story driven rpg inspired by JRPGS like Xenogears/saga, featuring a unique turn based battle system. Follow Saragat and his dubious allies as they untangle the web of lies and attempt to dismantle the shadowy conspiracy of "The Core", as a far greater threat will reawaken.

title: Greed and Fear and the Rest
description: You are ready to say goodbye to life, but are you prepared to face your life's truth? Navigate a grad student's life between greed and fear in his final 6 hours (and beyond) in this BL visual novel.

title: Gregg: Tower Defence
description: Play as Gregg. Gather, build and destroy your slimy enemies in this thrilling pixel art tower defence!

title: Grub Truck
description: Grub Truck is a food truck simulation game where you cook up mouthwatering meals, strategise enticing menus, set the perfect prices, complete quests and decorate your trucks with style. Invest your earnings wisely to upgrade your fleet as you build, cook, and conquer the culinary scene!

title: Hearts in Orbit: When Stars Align
description: Hearts in Orbit is a fantasy romance visual novel that follows two stars who fell in love and have reincarnated as humans. Will they remember their origins? Will they fall in love again? That's for you to decide.

title: Hell's Bell
description: GO TO HELL ... in this hand-drawn, hack-n-slash adventure. "Hell's Bell" is a story-driven brawler following Bell, who after learning a family secret, finds herself fighting endless hordes of demons in the underworld.

title: Hemlock
description: An action packed 3rd person Roguelike, With a rich tapestry of handcrafted levels, a multitude of game-changing items, and thrilling boss fights. Are you ready to face the unknown, rewrite your destiny, and emerge victorious in the fight to restore Hemlock?

title: Heroes of Latera
description: Heroes of Latera is a 3d fantasy style survivor based in the realm of Latera. Explore unique classes each with their own individual abilities and play styles. Fight through the endless waves of Eu'roks hoard as you amass wealth, experience, and a pile of bodies.

title: Hexceed: Year 4 Pass
description: This is your pass to 6 exciting new worlds to complete in hexceed! With 700+ levels to complete!

title: Hexceed: Rubrum
description: This DLC unlocks a brand new world for hexceed: Rubrum Puzzle your way through 140 new levels - levels include all previously introduced mechanics!

title: Hexforger
description: Craft your spells in ONLINE CO-OP with your friends in this SURVIVORS-LIKE! Slaughter monsters, gain gold, upgrade your spells to infinite heights. Crush challenges and unlock new spells, upgrades, pickups, realms. Up to 4 players in this unique twist on the survivors-like formula!

title: Hidden Riddles: The Amazon Mystery
description: Help the detective crack a difficult case! Hundreds of exciting levels! Hidden Riddles - The Amazon Mystery: Solve mysterious puzzles!

title: Find Kittens: The Last of Cats
description: Explore this mysterious post-apocalyptic world by finding cute cats and this black and white world will be colore.

title: Suffocation
description:
Best Friends love eachother. Best Friends care about eachother, look out for one another. Best Friends never go anywhere without eachother.

Best Friends should never lie to one another. Best Friends should never fight with eachother, make eachother jealous. Best Friends love eachother.

That's what he thinks, anyway. He's your Best Friend. Nothing more or less.

title: Hydrogen
description: Enter a post-apocalyptic Sci-Fi world in 'Hydrogen,' a thrilling Roguelite ARPG. Navigate through procedurally generated instances, each playthrough offering unique challenges, random items, and perks to level up your character.

title: Hyperbeat
description: Embark as a knight in an order chasing your potential. Featuring an original soundtrack, precision rhythm gameplay, character customization, and a story following an ensemble cast, only one question remains. What will you find at the peak of what you're chasing?

title: Hyperfield
description: Welcome to the exhilarating world of Hyperfield, a groundbreaking sports sensation that fuses the intensity of rugby with mind-bending supernatural abilities! Step onto the futuristic pitch where speed, strategy, and superhuman powers collide in an electrifying display of athleticism.

title: Incremental Island
description: Build and expand a vibrant civilization on a procedurally generated island

title: Inflatum
description: Inflatum is a cute animal rescue game. Rescue the poor hapless critter who is only trying to reach his stranded family. Save him from the hazards littering the landscape. Use gas tanks to inflate objects to come to the critter's aid.

title: InOutPath
description: You will play the role of a smart and agile kitten, learn and utilize various strange and interesting mechanisms to unlock 300+ puzzles that are extremely characteristic and full of challenges, to obtain an unforgettable puzzle-solving experience.

title: Skelemental: Monk's Fury
description: Reborn as the Skeleton Monk after a deadly betrayal, you scour a ravaged and corrupted land to find your captured lover and exact revenge on the one who killed you. Master impactful martial arts combos imbued with elemental power to avenge your own death and bring balance to the land of Mortis.

title: Interior Designer
description: Step into the world of Interior Designer. Embark on client jobs, dominate the Design League, and create stunning interiors. Shape your spaces, and unleash your style. Your masterpiece awaits.

title: Introspection
description: IntroSpection is a top-down bullethell-like action game about a man forced to confront his past. Delve into memories and blast through waves of inner demons as you explore one man's mental purgatory.

title: Into the Restless Ruins
description: A roguelike deckbuilder where you build the dungeon you fight through. Each night use your cards to expand the ruins then battle through them harvesting Glimour from the residents, so The Maiden may grant your heart’s desire. But be warned - eventually your trespassing will awaken The Warden.

title: Jumping Orb
description: Jump, challenge, collect, win!

title: Just Skill Shooter 3: 2D Edition
description: Try on the role of a shooter who opposes the whole world

title: Keepers of Ancient Lands
description: ou are one of the defenders of ancient lands. In this game, you have to destroy crowds of enemies with the help of your faithful warriors.

title: Keep It Steady!
description: Try to see how high of a score you can get in Keep It Steady! Move the paddles individual sides up and down to try to guide a small ball into the correct hole. Watch out for the wrong holes though, If you hit too many it will be game over!

title: Killer Junkyard
description: The night is young and you are fuel. Evade grotesque mechanical-human creatures as you attempt to survive until dawn in this PSX style atmospheric horror game.

title: Killmaiden
description: A fast paced singleplayer arena shooter. Choose one of three goals to win each stage, explore the tech tree and defeat 10 bosses on the way to meet the devil on stage 66. What's the highest score you can reach?

title: Kindred
description: A physics-based 2D puzzle-platformer.

title: King of Retail 2
description: Ready to build another empire? You are once again back in the role as the manager, trying to make the best of a busy store. Find the right things to sell, get the right employees and turn every stone for a profit. Can you handle the pressure or will you buck under? Welcome to King of Retail 2.

title: Knight of Nevermore
description: Knight of Nevermore is a roguelike action-platformer featuring tight combat and diverse builds. Fight skillfully, platform carefully and equip yourself wisely if you plan to overcome the challenges of Nevermore.

title: Life as a Lich
description: Embrace lichdom: research powerful spells, recruit undead legions, manage your domains, rule the underworld, and become a demigod!

title: Light and Shadow: Schatten über Empyria
description: Meet new companions, regain your memory after a stranding, join a story guild, save the world from the shadow, or plunge it into ruin.

title: Light Box
description: Roll and shine endlessly in this game! Move left, move right, avoid obstacles, and collect Life-Shields for protection. Watch out for traps and other dangerous boxes. Keep rolling and shining!

title: Over the Net
description: Simple 2,5D volleyball. Just start game and enjoy it! 2 Game Modes (1vs1, 2vs2) | 4 Arenas (Beach, Castle, School and Mars) | 6 Colours to Choose Prove that you are the best volleyball player in the world!

title: Pinbot
description: Pinbot reimagines the timeless breakout game in an immersive 3D setting. Traditional brick formations now morph into incubators nurturing alien robots, demanding swift destruction! In this robotic realm, every element is mechanized.

title: Legend of Gallant
description: An evil warlock has broken the crystal and unleashed magic onto the world. Stop the crystal's corruption and end the chaos in this Match 3 game.

title: Quest of the Dragon Soul
description: Explore a world of magical dragons, mythical demons and hidden treasures. But be warned, strange creatures are hiding in the shadows in this Match 3 adventure.

title: Star Ring
description: Novel × Otome × Simulation Development Welcome to Star Poetry Academy! You who pursue your dreams will be the brightest star in the future. ——Nine career routes, seven playable characters, and rich game systems create a unique showbiz legend

title: Nori Danshi!!
description: "Wound up? By any nori but me." A thrilling school life with 4 good-looking nori! Which "nori" will you "omusubi" with ......?

title: A Boy And His Barrel
description:
You've befriended (and apparently married) a barrel full of blueberry sauce named Violet, but the demons don't understand your love and will attack the both of you without hesitation.

Both of you must make it out alive - if either of you dies, you must restart. Defend her with the limited provisions you get, and escort her to the exit gate!

title: Space Raiders
description: Embark on an intergalactic journey in this adrenaline-pumping 2D space shooter! Pilot your sleek spacecraft through treacherous enemy armadas as you battle to save the galaxy from imminent destruction. With intuitive controls and fast-paced action, blast your way through wave after wave of alien invaders. Dodge incoming fire, shoot enemies in this thrilling arcade-style adventure. Are you ready to become the hero the universe desperately needs?

title: Vampachi
description: Dodge, evolve, survive in this survival shmup. Help vampire hunter Liz Belmont to survive until dawn. Except dawn will never come.

title: Sonic Overture '95
description:
Sonic Overture '95 is a fan-made prequel to the first Sonic the Hedgehog, inspired by 32-bit games from the Saturn era and the scraped concepts from the original Sonic the Hedgehog. It tells the story of Sonic's adventures on Christmas Island.

The game is an unofficial revival of the game known as Sonic Overture, which had a demo released in 2014.

title: Cards of Heart
description: Cards of Heart is a narrative-focused cozy digital card game mixed with a fantasy top-down RPG about a young woman’s daily mental health struggles against her inner Shadows.

title: Aladdin Magic Carpet Racing
description:
"Aladdin Magic Carpet Racing" is an exhilarating, fast-paced racing game set against the enchanting backdrop of Agrabah. Players can choose to race as either Aladdin or Princess Jasmine, navigating their way through four uniquely designed and challenging race courses. The game’s vibrant visuals and dynamic tracks capture the essence of the magical world, offering an immersive racing experience.

In each race, players will dodge obstacles, collect power-ups, and outmaneuver opponents to gain the lead. The courses are filled with iconic locations from the Aladdin universe, providing a nostalgic yet thrilling adventure. The ultimate goal is to defeat the evil sorcerer Jafar in the final showdown to win the prestigious Agrabah Cup and become the reigning magic carpet racing champion.

title: Skyworld: Kingdom Brawl - Fresh Meat
description: A free update/DLC that adds five all-new maps for you to destroy your friends on and eight new units that introduce new tactics to the game such as the ability to heal units or to slow down the enemy by freezing them. Destroy your enemies like never before!

title: Sunder For People Who Don't Have Time To Play Sunder
description: Get the full Sunder experience in just a fraction of the time! All of the action, with only 10% of the average monster count! The maps range from a few minutes to 15-20 minutes ﻿long. ﻿Play it now, and next time you're at a party, you'll have just enough Sunder knowledge to impress everyone with your analysis of the combat encounters. ﻿﻿

title: Venom Vendetta
description: Venom Vendetta is a short single tech-base-themed mbf21 map for Doom2. The main focus was to make a map with a small monster count that could be quickly completed.

title: Palworld: Pokémon Mod
description: A mod for Palworld which changes many models from the game to Pokémon characters. It was taken down by Nintendo due to copyright infringement.

title: Lost in the Amazon
description: Lost in the Amazon is an interactive CD-ROM based on the book of the same name by Toni Brandão, which provides lots of information about the region's indigenous people, animals, and plants. It also includes two games: a matching card game between animals or plants and a Frogger-style where you need to bring items back to the tent.

title: Monsty Corp: The Sequels
description: Two Timelines crossing over. Your actions will impact the future in ways you never could have imagined!

title: Monsty Corp: The Prequels
description:
Play as Maria Romanoff on her last day of work at Monsty Corp
Monsty Corp is an advanced science facility in the middle of the Australian desert, Maria, a member of the Practical AI Division, has been tasked with activating a new AI. Little does she know, this is her last day on the job.

Uncover the secrets of the past!
Find out what happened before the events of Monsty Corp, and how it became what it is today.

title: Fantasy Mosaics 37: Spooky Night
description: A nonogram puzzle game about a penguin family who spends the night at an abandoned, spooky manor.

title: Front Edge
description: Front Edge is a real-time strategy game set in a modern warfare setting.

title: Grids of Thermometers
description: Fill grids of thermometers with mercury. Numbers on the grid edges tell you how many cells must be filled in each row and column. No random guessing! Many levels to solve with logic only.

title: Vigna's Stereo Switch
description:
1-Button Rhythm Game based on 'Arknights', a mobile tower defense game by Hypergryph.

Survive waves of notes vibing to avant-garde music!

title: On Mount Ségou
description: On Mount Ségou is a short, kinetic visual novel with an atmospheric, dark fantasy story. Ellie and Captain Syna of the Azurium Air Fleet travel to Mount Ségou to offer a prayer to the Nameless One.

title: Vespera_Hotel
description: Welcome to Vespera Hotel! Please observe the precautions on manager's letter and greet our dear guests with your smile.

title: Bloodroot
description:
A war between the mages and regular humans ended with the regular humans acquiring the power of magic. Despite overcoming this hurdle, they possessed no army capable of beating the mages.
Luckily, the half-blooded witches were able to take down the lord of the mages, allowing the world to reset in peace.

The half-blooded witches of the church used their magic and miracles to dispel the crazed magic that warps the regular humans.
The heroine was one such witch.
One day, she receives information from an old church friend named Yuris regarding a certain underground city, and sets off to explore it.

title: Pilapila
description: An indie puzzle game about rearranging blocks to reach your goal.

title: Osmar: A Primeira Fatia do Pão-de-fôrma
description: Have you ever thought about how the first slice of bread feels? That's right, the one nobody eats, the one they always leave aside! That's what you'll discover in this exciting story: Osmar, the first slice of bread, and his friend Cookie are on a mission to find the box of candies.

title: Tarde Animada
description: Join the funniest gang on the Internet and spend an afternoon playing with super cool characters! Tarde Animada mixes an adventure game with various kinds of games. Have fun wandering around the Bugigangue club! Commanding Gustavinho, you meet all the characters, talk to all of them, and choose who you want to play with! It's like spending an afternoon with your Bugigangue friends! Each of them has a different game! You can play target shooting, penalty shootout, cook, mad scientist, and much more!

title: Wonderland: Gold Saint In Adventure
description:
Garen, who was in the Twin Wombs of the Holy Kingdom, inexplicably arrived at the mysterious place full of magma when he woke up and also wore a retro knight costume. , is the best thing to do in the future.
Garen exited the Cave of Flames and heard someone calling his name: it was the Cancer Saint, DeathMask. Deathmask was also transported to this strange world when he woke up from his sleep. It was very likely that all the Golden Saints were involved.
The best way to deal with the disease is through a first battle in a different world, Gallon and Dis fought their adventure in the mysterious different world of Fontainebleau. What is the problem? What is the problem? What is the problem?

title: Super Roll Out
description:
"Super Roll Out" is the exciting debut game from Project8024Games, blending the charm of classic Nintendo 64 and Sega Dreamcast titles with modern gameplay elements.

Take control of Ballu, the determined protagonist on a mission to halt the havoc caused by the nefarious Dr. Marblous. Journey through diverse worlds,

solving puzzles and gathering shattered Mega Gems to restore peace and thwart tyranny. Explore numerous worlds filled with challenges and uncover thrilling mini-games along the way.

Can you rescue the planets from impending destruction and restore order to the cosmos?

title: No Players Online
description: you find an abandoned fps game on an old computer. you decide to play it.

title: Travel to France
description: Travel to France invites you to visit the country of love! Explore the country, see world-famous sights and enjoy the world-class cuisine.

title: Marvel First Alliance 2
description:
Marvel First Alliance 2 is a beat 'em up where you can choose between tons of famous characters from the Marvel universe to lead a fight against the forces of evil led by Red Skull, who is trying to take over the world.

Marvel First Alliance 2 has four different playing modes. In all, you can visit eight different zones divided into more than twenty levels packed full of enemies, including some special bosses.

title: Marvel Infinity War
description:
Adam Warlock warns the earth of the Infinity Stones being sought by Magus, and so earth's heroes divide into teams to collect each Gem. These gems are placed into the possession of The Enchantress, MODOK, Selene, Ronan the Accuser, and Russia's superheroes.

In the end, the gathering of the heroes is what allows Magus to collect them all and try to wipe the floor with them.

Marvel Infinity War is a module created by ZVitor, based on the Marvel Comics Universe, and is a sequel to the Marvel First Alliance series. The game has 80 playable characters plus one secret character. There are also over 36 bosses to contend with. The game uses a six-button control scheme. Each character has at least one special move and an ultra move. There are also many special assist characters to summon.

title: Grovesong
description: Explore the still and calming Grove. Draw music in the air. Each note has it's distinct colour and sound. Make your own calming songs by mixing the Colours and Sound of the Grove.

title: Vaer
description: The Light of the Sun is dying. Collect energy and return it to the sun to save the light. Made in under 48 hours for Ludum Dare 39.

title: Zealot's Curse
description: Obey your Masters. Destroy your enemies. Created for #7DRL.

title: Tripper
description: The game is one long difficult level. Get to the end of the level in the best time you can.

title: The Punniest Pun Messter
description:
What if you're cursed to make others laugh?

The 'Jester' is an entity who grants children happiness, but he was just another persona of myth... Until one day he appears on your windowsill and bestows his powers upon you. Now you're inflicted with a pun-curse, and thus begins your journey to cure yourself!

Upon changing schools, you meet three boarders who seem to have something to do with your curse...

But little do you know that your curse isn't really what it seems to be...

title: Jest Messter
description:
A comedy-mystery otome visual novel.

Oh no! You're stuck with a pun-curse "gifted" by the mysterious Jester, a mythical entity known to bring happiness in exchange for your memories.

Armed with the worst dad jokes known to mankind, you transferred to the prestigious Marney High in hopes to uncover the Jester's identity... and hopefully make new friends along the way!

Luckily, your new classmates are just as weird as you are: a stuck-up scholar, a brainrot-loving memelord, a two-faced actor, a weapon-wielding roommate, and a secretive senior with a dangerous secret...

So be careful who you trust! As sinister plots start to unravel around you and your classmates, you find yourself tangled in their web of secrets and schemes.

And maybe... your pun-curse is the key to solve them all?

Commercial remaster of "The Punniest Pun Messter".

title: Caixa Mágica de Estórias
description: The Caixa Mágica de Estórias brings you four wonderful stories, written by Lúcia Pimental and Alice Góes, with animated illustrations, soundtrack and narrated text. You'll also have fun with memory games, puzzles, crosswords, and coloring.

title: Elden Ring Reforged
description: ELDEN RING Reforged (ERR) is a mod by Kirnifr and ivi, with assistance from Poeconcept, Hanalove and Cavou. ERR is a thorough revision of ELDEN RING's balance and mechanics. The mod covers enemies, boss fights, hitboxes, animations, equipment, the camera, and more. Main features include unique camera parameters for boss fights, improved enemy hitboxes, reworked scaling and leveling, a new Runeforging system to encourage open world exploration and make NG+ more rewarding, changed gameplay mechanics that fix many of the vanilla game's issues, new Spells and Weapons, and more!

title: Gyakuten Vocaloid
description:
A very serious crime has taken place in the Vocaloid world and only a top lawyer can find the truth and that lawyer is... wait... Hatsune Miku!?
Exactly! Put yourself in the shoes of Miku to solve the case that looms over the court in this fan-game full of tension and ideal comedy for lovers of Ace Attorney and Vocaloid, discover the truth behind the contradictions in the testimonials and prove that your client is innocent!

title: Junkfood 2: Summertime Slotter
description: Junkfood 2 is a Boom compatible Speedmapping Community Project held in Meowgi's Pacifist Paradise Discord Server which features 83 newly designed slaughter levels; This time, with a summertime theme! The basic premise was to make "Junk Food" slaughter (BFG spammy, high monster count maps) where not a lot of time is spent deliberating about layout/detailing/fight design and other things that can bog a mapper down. It's just good BFG fun.

title: Gentei Shooter
description: Gentei Shooter is a fast paced bullet hell game where defeating a certain enemy can drop weapons. The weapons you can get from a triangle are better than the default shot, but they have limited ammo.

title: EWar
description: EWar was an unofficial multiplayer version of Grow's tabletop game War.

title: Watashi Koso ga Gakuen no Joou-sama
description:
What? An otome game where you become a sadistic high school girl and aim to become the queen of the school!?

Yes, it's time for women to be "aggressive" too!!

"Watashi Koso ga Gakuen no Joou-sama" has the heroine take the lead and swing the handsome guys around. It's a ♀＞♂ Romance Simulation Game! !

Whether it’s kabedoning them or pushing them down… "I" will be the one doing all that!!

title: Gunslinger Solitaire
description: Travel the Wild West while earning money as a solitaire cowboy.

title: Dr. Despicable's Dastardly Deeds
description: Make the world a better place, one dastardly deed at a time in this match 3 comedy game that lets you be the mad scientist. Each invention gets more ridiculous and has a twisted purpose that Dr. Despicable and his minions eagerly await.

title: The Hungry Lamb: Traveling in the Late Ming Dynasty
description: A travel text adventure game with Chinese traditional style. Player will escort four girls to Luoyang in order to discover the truth and make decisions along the way. This game involves themes of “Revenge, Cannibalism, etc.” the darker sides of life, but still expect to convey a positive emotion.

title: Planisphere 2
description: Planisphere 2 is a replica of New York City.

title: Imp Encounter
description: Based on the infamous fan fiction Impse, Imp Encounter adds in a cutscene based on the story in the middle of the game.

title: Sonder
description: Experience an innovative co-op adventure where two players have to work together. Engage in collaborative puzzle solving and dynamic combat with each player having unique abilities. Delve into a psychological narrative that explores the essence of humanity.

title: Odyssey of the Anachronistic Tome
description: "Odyssey of the Anachronistic Tome" features Patchouli Knowledge who was pulled into a strange, forgotten Gensokyo from a long abandoned canon with the gameplay inspired by the very first Touhou! This is our little alpha build for the Touhou Game Jam 13 with the theme "Retroactive, Retrospective, downright... Retro". Thank you for checking out our game! This is not only the first thing we've ever worked on as a group, but the first game any of us have ever worked on as individuals and with only a 72 hour time budget... sorry if the game explodes lol.

title: Jewel Match Royale
description: Restore magnificent castles in a royal match-3 adventure.

title: Jewel Match Royale 2: Rise of the King
Fables Mosaic: Cinderella
description: Experience Cinderella story through logic puzzles!

title: Fables Mosaic: Little Red Riding Hood
description: Help Little Red Riding Hood to bring candies to her Granny! It features a collection of colored puzzles solved by logic, while following the Little Red Riding Hood Story.

title: Fables Mosaic: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
description: Help Snow White to find true love! It features a collection of colored puzzles solved by logic, while following the Snow White Story. Are you ready to solve the puzzles as the story develops?

title: My Favorite Notification
description: A 5 minute Visual Novel made in Bitsy, about a Discord call between two trans friends.

title: Champions Arena
description: Champions Arena is a turn-based gacha RPG. Collect unique Champions and engage in real-time turn-based PVP battles!

title: Pinball League: Hardhat Zone
description: Pinball League: HardHat Zone is a 3D pinball game that allows players to experience this classic game in a whole new way. although the construction theme is not as glamorous as it could be and the sound effects tend to lag behind a little, the graphics are highly polished and really help to draw players into the game. the two player mode also helps to ramp up the fun factor by allowing friends to go head to head to see who has the best skills.

title: Le monde d'orathos
description: The elf world wanted to learn creation magic, but the kingdom didn't want it. The king decided to create an island for any inhabitant who wanted to leave, but no return was possible. A young elf wanted to act... He discovered something strange that the king was hiding.

title: TerraFirmaCraft+
description:
"Survival Mode as it should have been." TerraFirmaCraft Plus is a fork & continuation of the mod TerraFirmaCraft, for the sandbox survival game Minecraft.
The mod aims to continue off where TerraFirmaCraft (Classic) ceased development.
TerraFirmaCraft Plus is developed by one of the former developers of TerraFirmaCraft (Classic).
The mod focuses on "believability" rather than "realism", & includes an overhaul to world generation, crafting systems & more.

title: Shardfall: FitQuest VR
description:
Beautiful Worlds, Endless Enemies, and Unlimited Exploration.
Take on a huge range of fierce enemies with different fighting styles. Attack with powerful jabs, crosses, hooks and uppercuts. Defend yourself with blocks, jumps, ducks and dodges. Think and adapt to survive.

title: 3x9 Kingdom: Road of Adventures
description:
Playing as Oleg or Olga, you will go on an exciting journey into a 3x9 Kingdom to help the kids return home.

During the story, you will meet many characters of Russian folklore, such as The Gorynych Snake, Baba Yaga, The Mermaid, Chernomor, and many others. Some creatures will need your help, while others will try their best to keep the kids in the 3x9 Kingdom.

title: Star Wars: Deathtroopers
description: Star Wars: Death Troopers is a FPS/3rd person action adventure video game. It is a game based on the novels Death Troopers and Red Harvest, both written by author Joe Schreiber. The game is divided into: Story Mode, Onslaught Mode and Multiplayer.

title: Shaman's Mask of the Rune Magic
description: Non-linear platformer action game about a shaman and his mask.

title: Superscout
description: "Superscout" is a live-action interactive movie game where you will unravel the secrets of the girls you meet. The love beyond lifetimes, never let it go; the kindness in this life, engraved in your soul. Your choices will change your loved ones’ fate; those who love you will change yours...

title: Dark Hunting Ground
description: "Dark Hunting Ground" is a minimalist style of pixel construction brush treasure game. As a new member of the Hunter Association, players will hunt monsters against the void, gain trophies and experience in battles, and challenge the source of void erosion with your unique construction ideas.

title: Leaving The Hospital
description: A difficult to control horizontal plate escape game, players control patients to escape from the hospital, the game has a difficult control system, the game includes two-person cooperation and two-person racing mode, hope to bring you some joy.

title: Koishi Adventure
description: Koishi Adventure is a 2D top-down slash-and-shoot Touhou Project doujin RPG, where you'll be adventuring in the absurd and brutal world of Lotusland from the perspective of the Komeiji Koishi~ In the game, you can explore dungeons, collect equipments, and constantly strengthen your party~

title: Absolute Fear: Aooni
description:
20 years after the birth of the legendary horror game "AOONI"...
A completely new first-person, 3D horror stealth action "Absolute Fear -AOONI-" is now available!

title: Tower Defense: Infinite War - Infinite Starter Package
description: This content requires the base game Tower Defense: Infinite War on Steam in order to play.

title: Pixel Puzzles Traditional Jigsaws: Chihuahuas
description: Pixel Puzzles, your number one place for digital jigsaws.

title: RocketRecoil
description: Change the past by propelling yourself towards the future. Or something like that. Just blow yourself up with rockets to move around. The game's hard to play.

title: PicoTrains
description: A retro-styled railway management strategy game!

title: Mereonozis 2D: The Kingdom of Gremlins
description: A puzzle-bazed metroidvania. Help the robot to repair the station. But there are gremlins who will try to break everything you've just fixed!

title: Minotauros
description: Minotauros is a single-player horror game that lets you experience the challenge faced by the hero Theseus. Explore, fight or flee when the Minotaur finds you. You're both hunter and prey. Find the secrets of the labyrinth to win.

title: Nine Realms: Dawn Touch
description: Rule the god of thunder and challenge all the gods of the nine realms! In this Rogue-like, hack and slash game, develop your strategy and skills, subject all the gods who challenge you to your wrath, and become the only god of the universe.

title: The Croaker
description:
The Croaker is a very fun, feature-packed game where you can collect apples. Where's the fun in that? Well, these apples you collect are used all throughout the game: You can buy skins, powerups, unlock many achievements, and compete on leaderboards against the top players!

There are 50 campaign levels, where the protagonist, Jeremy, gets trapped in a simulation and must escape without the antagonist of Virtual Guy finding him. Not only that, there are going to be brand new Bonus Levels every few updates just to keep adding content to the game.

title: Starpoly
description: Discover strategic depth in our space board game! Use star-currency to buy interstellar sites. Compete with friends in turn-based matches, utilizing the Starbridge for tactical advantage. Accumulate currency for the Lottery, offering rewards and site boosts. Achieve cosmic success

title: Topac Battle
description: Topac Battle is a cozy and relaxing idle game. Buy Topacs and Level them up, trade for a higher rarity, and become the master of the chill battle scene. Customize your Park as you progress from a simple park to your dream setup with rare exotic monster and ultra-rare color variants!

title: Amelie And The Lost Spirit
description: Dive into the intense "Amelie And The Lost Spirit," a single-player action game set in a horror environment. Help Amelie find her way out of the witch's realm. Seek help from your Ghost friends as you try to escape the witch's clutches to your freedom.

title: Lullaby in Dreams
description: An adventure game project for children. A cave-in in a dungeon begins an adventure in an unknown land, for some an isekai, for the others an adventure in search of answers.

title: Car Mechanic Simulator 2021: Jeep RAM Remastered
description: Car Mechanic Simulator 2021 - Jeep | RAM Remastered DLC includes 6 cars: 2016 Ram 1500 Yellow Sport - 2013 Ram 3500 - 2012 Jeep Grand Cherokee SRT8 - 2012 Jeep Wrangler - 1949 Jeep Willys Civilian - 1942 Jeep Willys Military - V8 HEMI 345 - V8 HEMI 392 - V6 Pentastar G - I4 WIlys L134

title: VR Harem Sex: Mai DLC
description: Immersive harem experience in VR space! High functionality and freedom with lesbian play, cross-sectional views, big tits/poor tits, and more!

title: Flint's Hints
description: Flint's Hints is an escape-room-like puzzle game where you investigate your surroundings to appease your fussy pet cat, Flint. Search for hints to figure out what he wants and how to give it to him, but be careful with what you investigate. Some things are meant to be left alone and forgotten...

title: Run Run Bird!
description: Embark on a whimsical journey into the enchanting world of our beloved animal friends with "Run Run Bird!"

title: Recycle it!
description: In "Recycle it!", you embark on an exhilarating journey as a bold bottle with an insatiable curiosity, daring to explore the vast expanse of the house while its inhabitants are absent.

description: Aidan in Danger is a retro-style 2D platform game. The player takes on the role of Aidan, the guardian of the last dragon. Face challenging levels, menacing creatures, and an interdimensional villain, all while enjoying beautiful graphics and an exciting soundtrack.

title: Finding Sparky
description: 'Finding Sparky' is game in which an extremely ordinary boy, Tom, goes on an adventure across a haunted village to retrieve his kidnapped dog. With Tom, defeat the ghosts and (a slightly big) animal friends to get to the bottom of the case and find out what the hell dog kidnapper really wan

description: Immerse yourself in the fascinating ancient world of cube puzzles, where each step reveals a new mystery. You will explore different zones, each filled with unique puzzles that require the use of cubes to solve them.

description: Embark on an adventure to find out the reason for the appearance of monsters on Mt. Fuji. "Fujisan Nobori" is a game where you defeat boss monsters on each floor and ascend towards the summit. Be the first in your country to reach the summit.

title: Jötunnslayer: Hordes of Hel
description: Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel is a gripping roguelike horde-survivor game set in the dark realms of Norse Mythology. Fight waves of enemies to earn divine blessings of ancient Norse Gods, explore hostile worlds and face powerful bosses. Become a god-like warrior in this ultimate showdown.
