description: Addictive and difficult, combining precise jumping and mental endurance. Explore this universe with double jump, dash, dilemmes, choices, 3d and 2d. Each level is unique, for an unforgetable experience.

title: Ramen Oil Simulator
description: Use the mouse to drag and move the oil droplets, aiming to gather the floating oil into a cluster.

title: JDM: Rise of the Scorpion
description: Experience the automotive culture of Japan with a free prologue to Japanese Drift Master. Learn about the story of the rebellious high schooler Hatori and race through the winding roads at Haikama Lake. Discover the places where drift was born!

title: Thorns: Police never sleeps
description: Thorns. Police never sleeps is a kinetic visual novel about an alternative future. After global warming, cities were separated by a giant ocean. Our story begins in one of these cities.

title: Rise of Industry 2
description: Navigate the competitive industrial landscape of vibrant 1980's USA! Make strategic manufacturing decisions, optimize production chains, acquire technologies, and expand your global business network with key contacts. Opportunities await those savvy enough to capitalize on them!

title: Blood On The Dusty Trail
description: In this thrilling audio book, we follow the story of Caleb, a young outlaw who finds himself on the run after a robbery. As he navigates the dangers of the Wild West, his gang of outlaws plan their get away.

title: Mochi Sprint
description: You have become a "Mochi". A perfectly round Mochi. Navigate through 2D scrolling dungeons, avoiding brutal traps, and aim for the goal (mortar). That's all there is to the game.

description: Travel to Poland in 1772, experience life as a servant, and solve a mystery at court!

title: Find Eden
description: In this cute adventure game you play as Timmy, who was magically teleported into the realm of cats. Unravel the mystery of Eden and awaken the fighting spirit of the felines. You solve puzzles, defeat monsters, upgrade new powers, all while meeting quirky cats in a classic hand-drawn 2D style.

title: Shui's Odyssey
description: This is a puzzle game that combines text and images. Players use visual illusions to piece together fragments of memories from Alzheimer's patients, in order to reconstruct the truth of the story and witness the passage of time for three generations.

title: Minigames Mayhem
description: Minigames Mayhem is a fun collection of minigames, that can bring joy for players not only in single-player but also with friends in your living room or across vast distances. Try to beat the high scores, compete with others, and bring mayhem on other players in many simple but fun games!

title: Idle Hero TD
description: Endless idle tower defense game full of deep strategy and combat mechanics. Unlock and upgrade dozens of epic fantasy heroes to defeat an infinite swarm of enemy monsters. Strategize hero placements, synergies, and skills for an effective defense, then sit back and let the auto-battler do its thing!

title: Combat Cat
description: A fast-paced, side-scrolling, bullet hell with an inventory system where a player can upgrade their weapons and player stats to survive as long as possible.

title: Circus Challenge
description: Many people are afraid of clowns, but what scares the clowns? Dive into a nightmare world where you will face many risks in the ring. Be careful with every step you take and overcome obstacles to escape from your nightmare.

title: The Dilemma
description: When you open your eyes in a dark labyrinth, what should you do? Find the right path and escape from this labyrinth!

description: Red Light is a retro-styled extraction shooter where you take a mission to raid an abandoned Soviet R&D Institute filled with mercenaries and living results of human experiments to solve the mystery of your disappeared brother.

title: Zeta Wave Infinity
description:
Enjoy in this adrenalinic arcade game with the beatiful AI pilots named
ZETA and OMEGA

description: Welcome to Tiny Ski Resort! Where pixel art, skiing, multiplayer races, and a beautiful story all come together.

title: Taco Terror
description: TACO TERROR is a boomer shooter set in a cyberpunk future where capitalism rules everyone - except for you. Run, gun, choke, dive, jump(?), and slide your way through the forces of T.A.C.O. Take back New TACO City from these forces of fried evil before you become too... delicious.

description: Embark on a thrilling trilogy as Vinnie, Kiro, and Shorty battle urban gangsters and the Italian mafia. Upgrade weapons, immerse in a bloody tale, and enjoy enhanced gameplay features. Fight, upgrade, and chase your targets in this action-packed adventure!

description: Navigate office intrigue in Dale & Dawson Stationery Supplies! Complete tasks, uncover the carrier of illegal leads, and outsmart coworkers in this strategic multiplayer game set in an early 2000s office.

title: Street Race Kings
description: You are brought into a racing league, the SRK. Once you can qualify and prove yourself to the league, you then make your way to the top, racing against various competitors, and taking down stage bosses to move up in rank! Multiple vehicles, customization, open world maps, and more!

title: Run Dungeon
description: Run Dungeon combines the heart-pounding action of an endless runner combined with the strategic depth of an RPG. An infinite dungeon full of monsters, loot, traps, spells, and bosses awaits you.

title: Big Adventure: Trip to Europe 7 - Collector's Edition
description: AviGames presents the seventh game in the hidden object series of "Big Adventure: Trip to Europe". Embark on a journey through beautiful European countries and look for hidden objects in old Europe and Scandinavia, play exciting mini-games and collect souvenirs from different countries.

title: Jetrunner
description: JETRUNNER is a parkour FPS, with cel shaded, comic like visuals, and a gameplay loop that can be best described as Trackmania meets Titanfall. Rich, expressive movement, and tight gunplay is what JETRUNNER is all about.

title: A Storm Unsung
description: An action roguelite with a multitude of unlockable characters. Challenge procedural dungeons generated by an AI Dungeon Master who controls the pace of combat and the frequency of random events.

title: Super Blockbuster
description: Super Blockbuster is a retro action-puzzle game. Kick blocks to solve tricky puzzles and take on a diverse cast of enemies, all in gorgeous pixel art, inspired by the golden age of 2D puzzle games.

title: Try to Wake Up : The Legend of Trevis
description: Legend has it that if you fall into a deep sleep while your body struggles to survive, Trevis will welcome your soul into his labyrinth. If you want to wake up, take a good look around and don't overlook any anomalies...

title: Shoko
description: Capture and battle hundreds of different monsters to complete your bestiary. Shoko is a game with waves of enemies to defeat and Roguelite elements in a cute, colorful, hand-drawn universe.

title: Trivia Trials
description: It's about Trial and Error. Show your resilience by passing all 20 random Questions and Riddles before your Time runs out, or admit to your weakness and surrender. It's your choice. Do you have what it takes?

title: Unnatural Selection
description: Four Player Party-Shooter Featuring Cute Animals Wielding Wacky Guns! Play as animals and fight your friends to win the tournament, eliminating the most players to win the round!

title: Rivers of Chaos
description: Conquer the galaxy in this cinematic, battle-simulator. Each playthrough offering a completely unique galaxy, over 100 total specialized ships to command, and distinct commanders to lead your people. Pick your favorite faction and lead your forces into a dynamically generated battlefield.

title: Aston
description: The aim of the game is to find the passwords of the encrypted doors in the rooms and finish the game.

title: Necrophobia
description: Start your life anew at Heaven's Gates Academy. Learn new subjects, make new friends, experience what you've never before deemed possible. Change your fate, and the fate of those around you- your decisions matter greatly.

title: Cellular Survival
description: Cellular Survival is an action shooter with heavy Rogue-like elements. Choose your path, equip yourself, and push forward and overcome the perils that stand in the way of your survival. The fate of the microscopic realm rests in your hands.

title: Ember Point
description: Ember Point is a red-hot, combat-focused, third-person action game. Play as a disgraced defector, Gravitus, from a militaristic mega-corporation. He is stuck cleaning up the mess his former employers left behind — all while wielding a top secret “cure” for a gruesome disease.

title: Fall Words
description: Fall Words is a challenging physics puzzle game that has you type letters to drop them and collect all the asterisks. Letters have different shapes and physics and based on that there are various mechanics in the game: bridge, domino, hanging, rolling, and more! Try it now and see how words fall!

title: Mutant Football League 2
description:
Mutant Football League 2 is an over-the-top, arcade-style football game packed with thrills, strategy, and unrelenting action. Created by the original designer of Mutant League Football and Mutant League Hockey, MFL2 takes brutal gridiron battles to the next level, delivering deep strategic 8-on-8 gameplay, bone-crunching hits, and outrageous mutants that parody your favorite players.

Prepare yourself for the most brutal football experience ever. Step into diabolical arenas filled with deadly traps, where victory isn’t just about scoring points – it’s about survival. Win the traditional way by outscoring your opponent or force a forfeit by racking up a body count that leaves the opposition in shambles. Outwit, cheat, and dominate your way to victory in the most chaotic, carnage-filled football game yet. Whether you're a die-hard sports fan or just looking for wild, unpredictable fun, MFL2 delivers an experience like no other.

title: Robo Pose
description: Robo Pose is a difficult game about Robot that needs to strike the right Pose in order to overcome procedurally generated obstacles.

title: Jupiter Junkworks
description: Fast paced arcade puzzle action awaits you in Jupiter Junkworks! Complete arcade puzzle contracts to earn resources while rebuilding and upgrading a ruined spaceship junkyard. All set in a sci-fi narrative campaign mode where you'll join an unlikely trio of travellers as they overcome challenges.

title: CloudStudy
description: An online study room shared by players around the world. Those who work hard for their dreams are welcome to join.

title: Swords & Bones 4
description: The fourth installment of Swords & Bones immerses you in a new fantasy adventure, with pixel art in a side-scrolling action-platformer style. In this latest chapter, harness the power of magic to emerge victorious!

title: Spaced Out
description: Retro, classic, couch-buddy competition in space! Simple controls make it easy for friends and family to join in the fun!

title: Spellbrew Express
description: Low wages, high adventure – every delivery is a magical struggle. Bounce, blast, and cast through treacherous ruins and vibrant forests in this movement-based 2D platformer. That goblin brew atop the mountain won't deliver itself. Time is money— get moving!

title: Multiplayer Spiders
description: Multiplayer Spiders - You and Your steam spider friends must stop the invading spiders from spinning their web of fear.

title: Whelm
description: A mysterious island has fallen into disrepair and only you can save it. Rescue animals, replant seeds and repair machines. We're counting on you, young penguin.

title: Desert Of The Undead New Frontiers
description: Slaughter the undead to save your town in this 8 bit action run-n-gun

title: Vindefiant
description: A disgruntled employee is fired from his job, sparking a path of rage and destruction. Lead Alyx through his journey of vengeance and creatively kill enemies in this pixel-art adventure where you, are the villain.

title: Last Ride
description: Last Ride is a supernatural investigation game where you explore haunted sites, gather clues, identify evil spirits, and use the right methods to capture them while learning to protect the human world.

description: Dodge Barrage is a chaotic sports-fighting game, where you’ll need quick reflexes and aggressive plays to take down your opponents. Play with up to four players either locally or online.

description: Truth Universally Acknowledged is a short dating sim with 4 love interests that takes place in a whimsical high school setting.

title: MistsBook
description: "MistsBook" is a deck-building roguelite game where automatic chain reactions form the core gameplay. where you can play all the cards you draw with just one button press. You will collect patterns, symbols, and seals to uncover clues and reveal the pages of this book that has no beginning or end.

description: Shoot pearls, fire harpoons, and collect treasure under the mysterious "Pearl Island" in this new single-player, ocean-themed coin pusher game!

description: Earth's surface has been dessimated by radiation from The War. The only remaining safe havens are found under the seas. Now you must cook, craft, and survive alone in your submarine, delivering vital supplies to the Starving Survivors - all while battling monsters both real and imagined.

title: Midnight Cruise
description: As you progress, you'll need to find keys and open locked doors. Solve puzzles and find passages. A first-person game with elements of horror. Explore the ship and its cabins, collect batteries for your flashlight. Ability to use the camera Solve puzzles. The darkness can conceal various secrets.

"I have to use my skills! Gosh!!" "I'm so excited! I'm back!!" "What is that? A UFO!!" "Something is chasing me from behind!!"

description: Take to the stars in the retro-futuristic adventure-RPG, Beyond Galaxyland! Spanning the very cosmos, join Doug and his plucky, gun-toting guinea pig, Boom Boom, on an exhilarating, planet-hopping journey to save Earth itself.

title: Boring Movies
description: Challenge your friends to identify famous movies based on your most boring possible description of the plot! Can you stump them or are your friends actual true cinema fanatics that can name Citizen Kane from the most minute detail?

title: Syon
description: A 2D horror to find and repel anomalies. Light the lantern of the girl and the ability of the ghost to fight back.

description: CyberTaxi Lunatic Nights is a free roam taxi driving simulator set in a dark-noir Prison City. As a cab driver you have to find your wrongfully accused sister and rescue her from this dystopian city-facility. Complete unique missions, defeat lurking thugs and maintain your fuel level to succeed!

title: Scarecrow vs. Big Butt Birds
description: Defend crops as a scarecrow with a hand-tapped gun. Aim carefully against plump, persistent birds. Enjoy tacos in this quirky simulator!

title: The Collection
description: A First person, Short story indie horror game with an immersive atmosphere.

title: Epic Pixel War
description: An action roguelike where you send armies of powerful units with different powers to fight against hordes of enemies, upgrading and finding new units as you go.

title: Quadbots: The Rise of Chrono
description: Embark on a cosmic quest to retrieve shattered NOVANGEL orbs, conquer colossal guardians, and ultimately defeat Chrono. Dive into an action-packed adventure with epic battles and a gripping storyline.

description: A short walking sim game where after a car crash you wander into strange lands. Chop some cactus and turn an old mill into a concert hall. That's your life now.

title: Odd Sequence
description: Odd Sequence is an indie-action game with armed bots and RPG elements in platformer gameplay. Geometric characters and a flat, minimalist art style give this game its uniqueness. Odd Sequence focuses heavily on the combat aspect and the attack customization.

title: Feed

title: StarsKnight
description: This is a game that constantly iterates and updates. Before the final version, different gameplay will be updated to get through the iteration period. The final iteration of the game's main mode will be a galactic demon city game with a big map and a big story background!

description: Step into the feathery shoes of a daring pigeon in the heart of a bustling park with Pigeon Simulator Survival! This one-of-a-kind game promises a whimsical and utterly entertaining adventure that's bound to tickle your funny bone and keep you coming back for more.

description: Survive the siege and keep your vessel afloat in "Shark Siege", where the deep blue sea is your adversary, and courage is your strongest ally. Join the voyage, if you dare!

description: A short-and-sweet 1-bit adventure game with real-time combat. Engage in ranged or close combat to defeat supernatural monsters. Upgrade your tools to progress deeper into the woods.

description: It's all in the name.. outrun them.

description: Landoria is a cartoon fantasy strategy game where you begin your campaign in a procedurally generated world as one of the faction leaders to capture strategic locations and defend against the opponents' siege together with your heroes to expand your territory.

title: Project: Debug
description: In a city devastated by catastrophe, you're the lone survivor among nightmarish swarms of insects. Armed with bravery, cunning, and diverse weapons, navigate ruins of a once-vibrant metropolis, battling relentless waves of monstrous bugs. Survive, reclaim, conquer the infestation.

title: Besiege: The Splintered Sea
description: Dive into The Splintered Sea expansion, introducing water to Besiege for more machine-building conquests! Battle your way through a 10-level oceanic campaign, explore an all new sandbox, and harness 8 new blocks to unleash chaos on the high seas!

title: Destroy Blocks
description: Control the spear and throw it, break all the blocks in the level to win, score points, complete the level, earn coins and go to the next level.

title: Path Weaver
description: Path Weaver is an interactive puzzle game where you can solve puzzles by controlling your characters and placing the right scenes in the right timelines, as if you were filling a storybook. Different puzzles are waiting for you in many places, from pyramids to Aztec temples.

title: Five Elements: Ghosts Delivery
description: This is a minimalist puzzle game where players control ghosts with unique traits to transport five elements between nodes. By applying the rules of generation and restraint, they transform or eliminate elements to reach specified quantities and objectives.

title: Can Bullet
description: BANG BANG BANG! CAN BULLET has come to your PC! Just shoot the cans and get rid of yesterday's, today's, and tomorrow's frustrations. A simple roguelike shooter, also good for a mid-afternoon coffee break.

title: Cohabitation Life
description: The protagonist begins cohabiting with his girlfriend, Kanako Tsukishima, whom he started dating in college. Compared to their sweet romance, living together presents many practical challenges. Players must plan their daily lives, balancing academics, lifestyle, and romance.

title: TowerDefenceDesigner
description: A tower defense game with edit and challenge modes. Players customize levels with terrain, enemy paths, tower placements, lighting, enemy/trap attributes, initial coins, and health. Share custom levels via a creative workshop for doubled fun with others.

title: Komadori Inn
description: Your boring life changed, when you started to work at the Komadori Inn. A picturesque forest by the sea and beautiful co-workers make the perfect place for relaxing.

title: Bully Ball Soccer
description: A minimalist, multiplayer game where you are Bully, the only ball in the world who can play soccer. Host or join sessions for quick, laid-back matches with friends or strangers. Roll, jump, fly, and dash your way to victory in this simple physics based soccer extravaganza. (Good connection required)

title: Voyeur Villa: Harem Manager
description: Will you be able to handle a harem of kinky girls? Voyeur Villa is the safehaven for voyeurs, coming to watch the sexy shows starring you and your staff full of cute, exhibitionist girls. Grow your business through the nightly shows, carefully orchestrated to fit the guests' viewing desires!

title: Color Fear
description: Today on the Color Fun Coloring Show they want Viewers to Help them Find out Who is Breaking into Their House.

title: SOVL: Reptilian Kingdoms
description: This is a Faction Pack for SOVL - Fantasy Warfare. It adds the Reptilian Kingdoms to the game.

title: Hop Spring Girl
description: "Hop Spring Girl" is a 2D platform action game where you aim to reach the top by controlling hopping.

title: Darkchaser: Battletide
description: [Darkchaser: Battletide] is a survivor-like game where players enter a world ravaged by monsters, arming themselves with various skills and relics to engage in fierce battles against countless enemies, becoming stronger through challenges!

title: Custom Order Maid 3D2: Mature, Level-Headed, and Dependable Secretary Maid GP-02
description: "Secretary Maid" is now compatible with the following content added in "CUSTOM ORDER MAID 3D2 It's a Night Magic + GP02." 1. Marriage system 2. Private maid mode 3. Empire life mode

title: Custom Order Maid 3D2: Mature, Level-Headed, and Dependable Secretary Maid GP-01fb
description: "Secretary Maid" is now compatible with the following content added in "CUSTOM ORDER MAID 3D2 It's a Night Magic + GP01fb." The following two events will be added. ・Sexy love date play ・Happy happy morning!

title: Custom Order Maid 3D2: Mature, Level-Headed, and Dependable Secretary Maid GP-01
description: "Secretary Maid" is now compatible with the following content added in "CUSTOM ORDER MAID 3D2 It's a Night Magic + GP01."[Empire Life Mode]・In this mode, you can see a conversation between maids you created!

title: Rope-Kun Adventure
description: A very unique rope action game in which the main character "Rope-kun", who wields a rope, overcomes various gimmicks! The possibilities for ropes are endless, from carrying objects, to bouncing balls, to tying up and defeating enemies! Overcome with him the many difficulties that await you!

title: Body Pay
description: Body Pay is a casual puzzle game where you pay for products brought by customers by pressing the appropriate control keys. As you move up the stage, overcome the increasing number of products and customer interruptions to achieve the target score and continue your secret story with the girls.

title: Swing Into Zero-G
description: Fast-paced multiplayer racing game set in the vastness of space. Compete against friends or online rivals in intense races, where quick reflexes and strategic use of diverse skills determine the victor. Embrace the challenge of swinging your way to victory in this exhilarating space-themed race!

title: Crystal Guardian
description: Crystal Guardian is a tower defense game featuring survival and time control elements. Defend the crystal against enemies from different biomes every night, and during the days, gather resources from various biomes to alleviate hunger and thirst, aiming to survive until the 100th day.

title: Knockout City: Private Server Edition
description:
Team up and duke it out with rival Crews in Knockout City, where epic dodgeball battles settle the score in team-based multiplayer matches. Throw, catch, pass, dodge, and tackle your way to dodgeball dominance!

With the Private Hosted Server Edition of Knockout City, you can host a server for others to connect to, or jump into a Crew Vehicle and join the fray after connecting with others. The dodgeball battles don’t ever stop!

title: Hentai Misuzu
description: What could be more beautiful than hentai?

title: Fabled Lands: The Serpent King's Domain
description: Navigate through the dense, trap-filled jungles, ascend the unexplored Plateau of Dragons, unravel the haunts of Tarshesh, and challenge the immortal Serpent King. Beyond the treacherous seas, discover mysterious islands and seek fortune among the perilous ports of Ankon-Konu.

title: 1Bit Castle: Remake
description: Dive into 1BIT CASTLE: REMAKE, a strategic action-packed tower defense game. Choose heroes and perks to fight off evil monsters. Enjoy captivating pixel art while protecting your treasures in this addictive adventure with endless mode!

title: Criminal Attraction
description: You are a cunning FBI agent. Four beautiful girls are robbing banks. Infiltrate their gang and let yourself be carried away by your feelings towards them. Love? Hate? Passion? Lust? Find the evidence to frame them and send them to jail, or, fall in love with them!

title: Gem's Hentai: Ultimate Puzzle
description: With very high quality illustrations made by a real artist, this is the ultimate puzzle. You should arrange pieces and enjoy artistry, have fun.

title: Tekken 8: Eddy Gordo
description: Capoeira master Eddy Gordo joins the tournament! Having survived a life-or-death crisis, Eddy stands up again and vows to save the world from Kazuya.

title: Rune Defender
description: Rune Defender is a grid based tower defense game. You build towers during the day and defend against the undead during the night.

title: Omega Mouse Zero
description: Enter the Omega-Verse, a captivating Metroidvania, Multiverse adventure where each dimension guards secrets waiting to be uncovered. Immerse yourself in the dynamic world of this 2.5D platform/shooter and discover the thrilling blend of exploration and action that awaits!

title: Circoid
description: One-button precise, dynamic 2D platformer. Collect pixels, open doors, avoid obstacles and enemies. Find your way to the finals and unlock the next levels.

title: Interweaver
description: Embark on a hauntingly beautiful journey in Interweaver, a whimsical puzzle platformer. Play as the Weaver, a necromancy student on a quest to rescue familiars from the clutches of Sepultus Academia. Unravel mysteries and use magic to weave your way through captivating landscapes.

title: DachStudio Puzzle Box:: Illumarie's Fantastic Characters
description: 20 beautifully hand drawn fantasy character paintings from Illumarie to puzzle.

title: Mesh Replica
description: Enter the sci-fi clash of this hide-and-seek game. Play as one of four mighty Hunters armed with high-tech gadgets to track down elusive Slugs. Or slip into the slimy skin of up to twelve Slugs, mastering sneaky and ingenious abilities, while hiding by morphing into various objects.

title: Hentai Elf
description: Hentai Elf - beautiful elves need your help.

title: Lustful Apartment
description: "Lustful Apartment" is an adult visual novel game that follows the life of a young individual in an apartment complex within a small town. Filled with beautiful girls, romance, sex, and love, the game combines high-quality graphics with steamy animations, turning your wildest fantasies into reality.

title: One Iced Latte With Your Breast Milk, Please!
description: Help the cute barista Moka-chan and goth barista Karina-chan make Milk Milk Coffee the most popular place in Tokyo! Brew coffee in a relaxing atmosphere, guess customers' wishes, beat competitors, win the hearts of critics and pretty girls.

title: Dark Skies 2: Keepers of Nemansk
description: A whole new Journey in Nemansk awaits you! 5 Years after the Nemansk Incident you enter the Area as a young Mercenary named Dima. Experience a whole new Story set in the fictional Nemansk Region and explore dangerous new environments!

title: Kubits Gallery
description: Kubits Gallery is a logic game for casual players where you will have to solve nonogram grids to repaint the vanished paintings inside museums around the world. Solve puzzles at your own pace more than 120 levels in various fictional galleries.

title: Threads of War
description: Battle City with rogue-lite progression. Overcome increasingly difficult levels, create your fighting builds, defeat bosses, and liberate Ukraine from dark forces. The campaign can be played cooperatively, allowing players to compete with and support each other.

title: Oh No! I Died and Woke Up a Greek God!
description: Oh No! You died and were reborn as a god on Mount Olympus! Your goal is to find a way back to Earth! The problem? Gods keep falling in love with you! Go on dates, party through the night, and find out what’s happening on this crazy mountain!

title: Twilight Bastion
description: Twilight Bastion is a retro-styled soulslike 3D Metroidvania that places you in a torturous labyrinthine castle where skeletons, the undead, and gothic black knights await around every corner.

title: Bunniiies
description: These rabbits are crazy, they can't stop hugging each other! The only solution is to run this farm! Will you be a super breeder of love-crazed rabbits?

title: Galactic Love Utopia
description: You are a writer who gets kidnapped by aliens and are taken to a space station run by a mysterious rich backer who selects a single writer from each known intelligent alien species. You are the only human on a writer's retreat space station filled with different alien species.

title: Lumina Veil
description: Lumina Veil, a horror game with a modern twist! Step into the shoes of a popular streamer on a journey into a strange new game. As you dive deeper, you'll find yourself escaping the isolation of your own world, only to discover that the lines between fantasy and reality are beginning to blur.

title: Succubus Dungeon
description: Welcome to Succubus Dungeon, an exciting sidescroller game that offers an innovative mix of eroticism and adventure! Immerse yourself in a world full of possibilities where you can interact with other characters and explore certain fantasies.

title: Lyndaria: Lust Adventure
description: Lyndaria: Lust Adventure is a non-linear erotic visual novel set on a lost island inhabited by Furry tribes. The naive but courageous character - Maya is waiting for exciting adventures, dangerous and savoury!

title: I Got Sticky with a Femboy
description: Anticipation makes the "heart" grow fonder.

title: Royal Card Clash
description: Defeat the royals in this solitary card game! This game is a total reimagining of classic card games like Solitaire, with just you and a deck of playing cards. You will have to think carefully and play your cards right to achieve victory.

title: Reborn: Episode 1 - New Life
description: Reborn is a choice-based visual novel for adults centered on the life of a teenager in college. Become a student at the most prestigious college on the continent and experience all the delights of college life! Sex, humor, romance, drama and deep plot. All this is waiting for you in the game Reborn!

title: Battle Marine
description: SHOOT 'EM UP! Battle Marine is a simple naval barrage STG. A barrage of intense shots! Shoot 'em up! Shoot 'em up! Chain bombs with detonation, powerful laser sweeps, and jumps to collect medals! Enjoy a RETRO but NEW and exhilarating STG experience!

title: Start with 50 Gold Coins
description: This is an easy to use but difficult to pass game. It is suitable for players who like challenges and constantly break through themselves. You need to use your skills, strategies and resource management skills flexibly to survive and grow in this experience.

title: Chess Tools
description: Learn to play chess with Chess Tools. Learn with tutorials, various tools and learn from many famous games from some of the greatest players!

title: Phantasm
description: Horizontal Shooter set in space. Choose from three different classes of ship with different play styles. Includes Visual Novel story progression after each stage.

title: OneFistZone
description: Undefeated in underground fighting, Yahiroako went pro. However, her first match was against with a superhumanly strong opponent!

title: Demon's Regalia: Colosseum
description: A Turn-based Combat Fighting game featuring monster girls, monsters, and human warriors alike; to earn wealth and glory in the colosseum!

title: Hentai Tales: The Neko Returns
description: You once lived a happy life with your three adopted cats, but one day they died. When you grieve at their graves, a miracle happens. The cats have transformed into catgirl and come to repay you for your kindness in raising them. What will happen?

title: DogDogDog
description: "DogDogDog" is a horror adventure game set in modern times. Recently, you have been feeling like someone is stalking you, making you anxious with the feeling of being watched and hearing noises everywhere. Suddenly, you recall your past pet dog, only to encounter a "DOG" in the present.

title: Anomalous Deception
description: A PSX-retro-style first-person survival horror game that takes place in a underground bunker that is randomly generated for each playthrough! Discover its secrets and mysteries of what led you down there in the first place.

title: Arcane Lands
description: Arcane Lands is an open world game dedicated to building, exploring, and unlocking islands. Explore the island, grow crops, unlock skill, collect pets, use rune to open the way to automation, defeat hidden super bosses, and unlock the secrets of the archipelago!

title: Cargo Master Transporter
description: Embark on an adrenaline-fueled journey as you assume the role of a seasoned Cargo Master Transporter in this pulse-pounding gaming adventure.

title: Customer Disservice
description: Customer Disservice is a fast-paced soul-crushing hostile work environment game designed to put your minimum wage skills to the test. Using the information provided in your handbook, determine what sales are allowed or disallowed by company policy and enforce appropriately.

title: Clock Out
description:
Medium-sized speedmap in a vanilla-flavoured underground industrial setting.
This was originally intended for Doomworld community project "Isolation" but Derek "Afterglow" MacDonald ended up spending more than the allocated 12 hour dev time.
These mapping restrictions are followed:
- Must not use of F_SKY1. - Must use damaging NUKAGE1. - Must place health items on FWATER1. - Use of Cacodemons encouraged.

title: Autotag
description: Embark on a heart-pounding adventure in Autotag, where classic tag meets a twist of mayhem! Armed with powerful weapons, outsmart opponents in the destructible arena, and prove your skills in intense online multiplayer battles. Are you ready for the ultimate game of tag?

title: Savoring Sword
description: Explore procedurally generated dungeons, fight monster girls, interact with your surroundings, collect items, and gain weight!

title: Central Killing Agency
description: In this 2d pixel art game, it's 1953 and you're playing as an agent hired by the Central Killing Agency to kill Fred Olsen. Experience multiple endings in this short, narrative-driven adventure.

title: Molementum
description: Molementum is an online party platformer in which you and up to three friends compete to become the best thief. Upgrade your mole's abilities to aid in your criminal escapades. Compete, steal, and heist in this wacky, fast-paced game.

title: Dreamland: Chapter 2
description: Welcome to Dreamland! A town which hosts the wildest college spring break activities filled with hot girls, parties and sex. However, if you look close enough, you'll discover that Dreamland also hides a dark and horrifying mystery which haunts you and your friends...

title: WolfQuest: Anniversary Edition - Hellroaring Mountain
description: Hellroaring Mountain rises above the Yellowstone River in north-central Yellowstone, several kilometers west of Slough Creek. This 8x8 kilometer map offers all the gameplay of the main Yellowstone maps with a few special new features.

title: Extinction Rifts
description: Extinction Rifts is a fast-paced FPS where you get stronger as your combo increases! Inspired by classic shooters, you will battle your way through secret enemy headquarters and destroy the Ancient Monoliths with your devastating gauntlet!

title: Bosstack
description: A turn-based command battle game where you choose skills and jobs to fight against bosses in sequence.

title: Recursion
description: A first-person point and click adventure set in a strange facility. Solve puzzles, read strategically placed notes, press buttons, potentially die, and hopefully escape the worst Monday you’ve had in at least a week.

title: Magic Research 2
description: Welcome to Magic Research 2, an incremental RPG from the creator of Magic Research. Learn countless spells, face powerful foes, and command a team of Wizards who can cast spells for you as you journey to find or create the Philosopher's Stone.

title: The Highlands of Jurgald
description: Fantasy Game

title: Histerya
description: Endless survival horror game where you survive strange creatures in a retro-inspired PS1 experience.

title: Sync
description: Launch the SYNC protocol, where you are the ultimate weapon. Your job is to commandeer different robotic synth’s abilities in a high-octane, first-person frenzy. Master the art of SYNCing, and control the pace of battle.

title: Banana
description: A digital simulator of the handheld game of the same name.

title: Exverse
description: Dive into 2085 with Exverse, a gripping FPS that merges intense shooter gameplay with innovative Web3 mechanics built on Unreal Engine 5. Humanity clings to survival in space after a cataclysmic event rendered Earth a wasteland. As the planet's flora unleashed a deadly toxin, the race to save or abandon Earth divides humanity.

title: Around the World Mosaics
description: A nonogram game with 80 puzzles set in 8 countries.

title: Around the World Mosaics II
description: Another nonogram game with 80 puzzles set in 8 different countries.

title: Holiday Jigsaw Valentine's Day 3
description: 500 romance themed photos to put together.

title: Drill and Dig!
description: Join inventor Polly on a journey into the underground world in the casual roguelike game "Drill and Dig!". Your goal is to find lost artefacts using an upgradeable drill. Descend deeper, discover resources and upgrades, avoid hazards and show off your digging skills! This game is suitable for a wide audience. It provides a pleasant pastime and enjoyable gaming sessions!

title: Genshin Impact: Two Worlds Aflame, the Crimson Night Fades
description:
Version 4.6 of Genshin Impact, which includes:
• New character: Arlecchino
• New story quests for Arlecchino and Cyno
• New areas: Sea of Bygone Eras and Nostoi Region
• New quality of life features
• New main event: Iridescent Arataki Rockin' For Life Tour de Force of Awesomeness
• …and more!

title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Scions of Ithelia
description:
Prove your strength to Malacath and defend a demiplane of Oblivion in the Scions of Ithelia dungeon DLC.

Two Challenging Dungeons

Venture into two 4-player PvE dungeons, Oathsworn Pit and Bedlam Veil, coming soon to both the Crown Store and ESO Plus memberships.

Oathsworn Pit

A training ground for Malacath's chosen now lies soaked with the blood of the faithful, and the God of Curses demands you enact revenge on behalf of the fallen.

Bedlam Veil

Cultists have invaded the Bedlam Veil, located within the demiplane of Maelstrom. It’s up to you to defend this ancient vault and the mysterious relic it protects.

Rewards for the Worthy

Survive both dungeons to unlock unique rewards, including new item sets, collectibles, achievements, and more not found anywhere else in Tamriel.

title: Slay the Spire II
description:
The iconic roguelike deckbuilder returns!

Craft a unique deck, encounter bizarre creatures, and discover relics of immense power in Slay the Spire 2 - featuring new characters, cards, events, alternate acts, and more!

title: Kill Knight
description: KILL KNIGHT is an ultra-responsive arcade-inspired isometric action shooter. Condemned to eternal sufferance, deep within the voids of an eldritch arena, you must wield an arsenal of devastating weaponry to obliterate swarms of otherworldly horrors - and MASTER THE DEMON WITHIN.

title: Vampire Survivors: Operation Guns
description:
Grab your blaster, join Contra Force, and be the bullet hell in Vampire Survivors: Operation Guns

Assemble a squad of classic Characters and arm yourself with an explosive arsenal of arcade weaponry in this action packed expansion for Vampire Survivors. Blast through thousands of fearsome foes and bonkers bosses from throughout the lauded lineage of Contra games. Persist determinedly through prodigious stages inspired by iconic Konami series, but be prepared for a bullet-hell of a fight, because if your trigger finger lacks stamina, Earth may lack a future.

The DLC adds 11 characters, 22 weapons, 1 large stage, 1 bonus stage, 30 in-game unlocks and a 6 chapter adventure.

title: Never Alone 2
description:
Discover a world of fierce, frozen beauty in Never Alone 2, the upcoming 3D sequel to the BAFTA award-winning adventure drawn from the Iñupiaq storytelling tradition. Journey through the breathtaking Alaska wilderness as Nuna and Fox, her spirit companion, along the way unearthing an epic mystery that threatens your entire community.

Never Alone 2 is being developed using an Inclusive Development process with the Alaska Native community. It tells an original story from an award-winning Iñupiaq writer and draws from tradition and stories that have been shared across generations. Designed to be played co-op (online and couch), Never Alone 2 invites you to explore environments ranging from the harsh frozen tundra to forest valleys filled with ancient willows as you traverse beautifully realized landscapes that are filled with wonder. Together you will work to navigate these wilds, forge connections with the spirits, and experience how the Alaska Native people have survived and thrived for over 10,000 years in one of the harshest and most breathtaking parts of the world.

title: UnderMine 2
description: Delve back into the heart-pounding depths of the Undermine in this action roguelike sequel! Uncover ancient secrets, battle fierce foes, and conquer Delvemore Castle with a friend by your side!

title: Darkest Dungeon II: Kingdoms
description: Kingdoms is a free standalone campaign game mode coming to Darkest Dungeon II. This new game mode challenges players in a desperate race against the clock to find and defeat a monstrous threat before it overwhelms and destroys the Kingdom. Journey across the land to gather resources and battle evil incursions, all while defending a network of safe haven Inns.

title: RKGK
description: Turn heads. Drop jaws. Be bright. In this single-player 3D platformer, you’re the only one who can take down Mr. Buff and his lackies to restore color and life to the citizens of Cap City. Accompany Valah and the RKGK crew on their journey to take down the oppressive B Corp.

title: The Last Spell: Dwarves of Runenberg
description: Protect the haven of Runenberg, lead Dwarves with unique abilities into battle and discover new exclusive Perks, weapons and items in the first DLC of the acclaimed tactical rogue-lite. Dive once more into the chaos of The Last Spell to unleash your unique new weaponry upon the Hordes of Evil.

title: Brotato: Abyssal Terrors
description: Brotato is a top-down arena shooter roguelite where you play a potato wielding up to 6 weapons at a time to fight off hordes of aliens. Choose from a variety of traits and items to create unique builds and survive until help arrives.

title: Old World: Behind the Throne
description:
Old World - Behind the Throne introduces the machinations of the royal court with new mechanics, rivalries, and the ability to leverage your power with opulence projects that bring you closer to victory.

New historical characters take center stage in the role of advisors, viziers, aristocrats, and courtiers. These rising stars bring their own ambitions, desires, and drives with them. Will Alcibiades change his allegiances multiple times throughout his life or will you be able to put an end to his double-dealing antics? Will you let Enlil-nadin-sumi successfully usurp the throne of Babylon? Or will Harpagus betray your ruler after a long life of service? Let others manage your cities and befriend them, or watch as they turn into dangerous rivals fueled by a thirst for power.

title: V Rising: Legacy of Castlevania
description:
In collaboration with Konami Digital Entertainment, Stunlock Studios proudly presents Legacy of Castlevania!

The mighty hero of the Belmont Clan, Simon Belmont, is here to challenge all of Vampire kind. Wielding his legendary Vampire Killer and an infamous arsenal of holy weaponry, no night stalker will be safe from his righteous crusade through Vardoran. Defeat him and unlock the secrets of a brand new weapon, the whip, adapting new combat abilities that embody the grace and precision of the deadly Vampire hunter!

Legacy of Castlevania is a free update releasing as part of V Rising's 1.0 update as it leaves Early Access. The new whip weapon is now a permanent addition to the game and there will always be some way to learn it, while Simon Belmont’s presence is indefinite.

title: The Rogue Prince of Persia
description:
The Rogue Prince of Persia is a 2D action-platformer developed by Evil Empire in collaboration with Ubisoft. The game combines fast-paced parkour movement with roguelite combat and progression systems. Players control the Prince as he battles enemies and explores procedurally generated levels filled with traps and hazards.
Each run offers new weapons, upgrades, and choices that influence gameplay and replayability.

title: Agujero
description: Agujero is a Deep Hole Crawler made for Dungeon Crawler Jam 2024.

title: Bestiario
description: Bestiario is an exciting turn-based combat JRPG based on Spanish mythology and folklore, full of surprises. Should we call it an ÑRPG?

title: Lost Chronicles
description:
Investigate the disappearance of a child and unravel the secrets of a deceptively quiet town called Forest Hill.
“Lost Chronicles” is an adventure game in the genre of Hidden Object, with plenty of mini-games and puzzles, unforgettable characters and challenging quests.

title: Gunvolt Chronicles: Luminous Avenger iX - Extra Song: "Raison d'être"
description:
Lola's got a new song & outfit!

Rack up over 1000 Kudos to hear Lola's new single "Raison d'être" and see her new Idol Mode outfit by using the "Outfit Changer" ability.
The song has also been added to the jukebox.

title: Quickerflak 2
description: Quickerflak 2 is a retro-hardcore room-beater time-attack super fast-paced minigame.

title: Waiting for Instructions Run
description: Speed and accuracy are key! The "Waiting for Instructions RUN" is a RUN game in which you must use your typing skills to avoid obstacles. Use your typing skills to lead the human waiting for instructions to the goal in a situation where one fingertip can change his fate!

title: Chaos Trigger
description: Go back and forth in a hail of bullets , use all kinds of weapons to take down your enemies.

title: Ai no Karakuri
description: The vast institute is home to numerous enemies and gimmicks. Use electromagnetic rifles, killer rays, and infrared rays to overcome the strongest enemies and gimmicks!

title: Artificial Fashionista
description: Fashion police, open up! Collect clothes, put together fashionable outfits, and impress your captors — for a chance to regain access to the outside world!

title: Kart
description: A kart racer?! On PC?! with Steam Workshop support for tracks, racers, and more?! Playable offline or online, with friends or otherwise!? Yeah, you're not dreaming; this is real!

title: Lost in Art: A Miniature Realm
description: Explore the miniature universe filled with Eastern mythology, forgotten folk tales and surprising historical events in this puzzle adventure game. Step into real artworks, unreveal mysteries by solving unique puzzles, and be the hero of the miniature folk.

title: Parts Unknown 2024
description: Parts Unknown is an online multiplayer fighting game aiming to recapture the spirit of old fighting platformers with a unique twist.

title: To Be A King: Volume 2 - Part 1
description: Continue the exciting story of a general thrust into uncertain circumstances. Factions all want something from you. Choose who to bed or wed. Compete or consolidate with your foes. Discover more about the factions fighting for dominance in Caudium.

title: Qualle Party: Bonus Maps
description: This DLC gives you 3 more maps in the game.

title: Wartales: The Tavern Opens!
description: Manage and expand your own tavern in this management and simulation expansion for Wartales. During your adventures, secure wealth and prestige for your troop.

title: Dying Under Nightfall
description: Are you ready to test your mettle and prove your worth in the ultimate test of platforming prowess? Enter the fray, brave adventurer, and dare to conquer the impossible in our spine-tingling jump and run experience.

title: Dungeon Chamber
description: Dungeon Chamber is an action game, with an isometric view and character evolution. Three playable classes, MAGE, BARBARIAN and ROGUE(DLC). Acquire exclusive powers and adventure through 10 chambers for each hero. Unique ranking system for each chamber and hero.

title: Dungeon Chamber: Rogue
description: Rogue class hero. Rogue has a crossbow, with freezing arrows, as his main weapon and the difficulty is moderate.

title: Droom
description: Droom is an adventure game of choice-based progression. The rooms are inhabited by a variety of alien life forms, and your choices are the key to success. As you progress through the levels, the threats in the rooms increase and the path becomes more difficult.

title: Drop It: Block Paradise! - Builder Edition
description: Builder Edition is all about using various physic game mechanics, like gravity, bouncy blocks, bombs and more to safely get the Stars to the ground floor to solve Physics-based Puzzle levels. Play the 150+ included levels and then try your hand at making your own and sharing them with the community!

title: Drift Boom Boom
description: Drift Your way around 40+ Race Courses, BOOM Fire missiles, shotguns, and more, Boom Blow up your friends in Split-Screen. Just watch out behind you on the final lap!

title: Dreams and Bubbles
description: It is a game that combines maze exploration and action shooting elements.

For Japanese and Chinese language players on PC, Bethesda.net login issues have been resolved, fixing access to mods. Alongside this exciting update, Fallout 4 will be available to purchase on the Epic Games Store. Fallout 4 also will be Steam Deck verified.

There's even more content in the Fallout 4 updates, including the following free Creation Club items!

- Enclave Remnants brings the Pre-War cabal, The Enclave, into the Fallout 4 storyline. In this new quest, “Echoes of the Past,” can you stop The Enclave from spreading their dangerous ideology and gaining a foothold in the Commonwealth? Along with workshop items and the Enclave Colonel uniform, we are including the following previously released Creation Club content including Enclave Weapon Skins, Enclave Armor Skins, Tesla Cannon, Hellfire Power Armor, X-02 Power Armor, and the Heavy Incinerator.

- Makeshift Weapon Pack: Ever thought a piggy bank would make a great weapon in a pinch? This weapon pack includes a variety of unconventional objects that have been transformed into deadly weapons, such as: a baseball launcher, a nail gun and a piggy bank.

- Halloween Workshop: Leftover from an ill-fated Halloween party, thrown by the New England Technocrat Society, these 38 new Halloween decorations include witches, cauldrons, ghouls and more! Decorate for Halloween or make your settlements spooky all year round!
