description: Add Devo - "Whip It" to your library!Put on your “energy dome” and venture into a beautiful world of de-evolution with Devo! These pioneers of US New Wave, have a satirical, nonsensical answer to all life's problems: just crack that whip!

title: Synth Riders: INXS - "New Sensation"
description: Add INXS - "New Sensation" to your library!Representing late 80s rock is Australia's INXS, featuring huge drums, trademark relentless guitars and a sax solo all alongside the distinctive vocals of charismatic front man Michael Hutchence

title: Synth Riders: Phil Collins - "Sussudio"
description: Add Phil Collins - "Sussudio" to your library!Take a nonsense word, a horn section and the heavy funk influence of “1999” by Prince, this mid-80s Phil Collins song about a schoolboy crush will leave you wanting to just say the word “Sussudio”!

title: Synth Riders: Starship - "We Built This City"
description: Add Starship - "We Built this City" to your library!We just want to dance here, but someone stole the stage! A protest song against the closure of live music venues in Los Angeles, Starship celebrates music as the city's true cultural foundation.

title: Tower! Simulator 3: KIAH Airport
description: George Bush Intercontinental Houston Airport (ICAO: KIAH, IATA: IAH) is an international airport that serves the greater Houston area and ranks as 'Best U.S. Airport'. It will be easily one of the best add-on also In Tower! Simulator 3.

title: The Zombie Wave: DLC
description: Zombie Wave is a 3D shooting survival Roguelike game.

title: The Crew Motorfest: Year 1 Pass
description: Upgrade your garage with the Year 1 Pass and obtain 25 vehicles throughout Year 1!

title: Anime Girl Puzzles: Kohana
description: Chasing bad guys, investigating crimes, helping citizens, and lots of paperwork! Just another day in the life of a city police officer.

title: Boris and the Dark Survival: Symphony of Shadows
description: The mad maestro returns

title: Postal F: The Thursday Expansion - A Mod for Friday Night Funkin'.
description:
After the events of the first week, the dude sees himself encountering a familiar face: Krotchy! Go up against Krotchy in a new nutsack wrenchin' week, along with another song we can't seem to figure out!

Boyfriend seems to have found himself in a sticky situation when he enters the wrong side of town...

Postal F: Apocalypse Friday is a mod based around the Postal franchise, created by Running with Scissors Studios. In this mod, you go against the infamous "Postal Dude" in a 2 song mania featuring Boyfriend and a familiar Redhead. Will you survive or regret your decision? On behalf of the mod team, we all hope you have an enjoyable experience. This mod started out simply as only a cover but evolved into a 2 month long passion project.

title: Friday Night Funkin': vs. Gorefield
description: After 2 long years, the story of Jon and Bf vs. Gorefield continues, with better quality and content. An adventure full of terrors and enigmas awaits you, a renewed mod that quadruples the content of the first version!

title: Regular Friday Night
description:
Just a Regular Friday.... Right?

Boyfriend and Girlfriend need to make some money to buy more condoms, so they see a help wanted poster for a near by park and decide to take the job!!

But... things get a bit messy..

title: Friday Night Funkin': vs. Homr
description:
This is the VS HOMR mod.

Yeah, not so dumb, a full week and 3 songs in freeplay

Idk

Cool songs I think

title: Funkin' at Freddy's + Afton Full Week
description: Funkin' at Freddy's is a mod we've made with a lot of passion and respect to the original series of Five Nights at Freddy's and contains 10 songs in its base-release, with six of these songs are unlocked through various means with varying visuals. If you get stuck with trying to figure out how to unlock characters take a peek at the strategy guide image that's included in the files.

title: Bubblets
description: Based on the Japanese SameGame, Bubblets is a puzzle game in which the game-board consists of a screen of differently-colored balls arranged in a matrix. There are five different colors: red, blue, green, yellow and purple. The player then clicks on any two or more connecting similarly-colored balls to eliminate them from the matrix, earning an appropriate number of points in the process. The more balls eliminated at once, the higher the points added to the player's score.

title: Imperium Universalis
description: Imperium Universalis is a total conversion mod for Europa Universalis IV. The mod spans from the Age of Empires, starting from the 10th of August 142 AUC (612 BCE), through the Archaic Period, the Classical Period, the Early Hellenistic Period, the Late Hellenistic Period, the Imperial Period to end in Early Migration Period 1127 AUC (374 CE).

title: Anbennar
description: Anbennar is set in an fantasy world evoking themes from D&D, but through lens and time period of a strategy game like EU4. See how a fantasy world changes from an age of adventurers and good vs. evil to an age of gunpowder, colonialism and magical decadence.

title: Satan is an Astronaut
description: A woman who suffers from severe delusions wakes in the center of a forest aboard “The BUB,” a proto-generation ship from the mysterious Faust Corporation. Waking to a vision of a spirit she grew up with, she quickly learns that not everything is as it seems, and this waking cycle is anything but ordinary.

title: Internet Hearts
description: Internet Hearts is a game pre-installed on Windows ME and Windows XP systems that features online play.

title: Kita no Chi to Hitori no Shoujo: Koropokkuru no Negai
description:
Marimo Kushiro was about to go home as usual.
There, she meets Kororu, a being known as an ayakashi.
It seems that Koror has a request for Mai Suzumo.
His wish was, ``I want you to defeat the bear demon.''
Mai Suzumo takes the amulet (ofuda) and stands up to make Kororu's wish come true.
--This is a story set in Hokkaido.

title: Crazy Kart 2
description:
This is an online racing car game that has become popular in China, Hong Kong, India, the Philippines, Thailand, and Vietnam. In the Philippines, this game is the largest casual online game with a following exceeding 1 million players.

In this game, players compete with millions of others from all over Indonesia. Crazy Kart offers various racing tracks and diverse vehicle types. Using cute characters, gamers can select fantasy tracks such as outer space, fairy cities, or modern roads like those in China, America, or Formula 1 races. Crazy Kart also provides hundreds of types of cars to choose from, ranging from sedans, jeeps, buses, trucks, race cars, SUVs, and other cool cars. This game was officially accessible starting from April 2009.

title: Anomaly Investigations
description: It's a game that's inspired by The Exit 8 which is an evolution of games like Observation Duty. It's a little atmospheric and creepy, but not too scary. You need to traverse the location and remember how things were, each loop through the location, things can change. Sometimes the change is super obvious, sometimes super subtle. Sometimes there's no change at all!

title: Honkai Impact 3rd: Invitation to the Mad Banquet
description:
Version 7.4 of Honkai Impact 3rd, which includes:
• New Part 2 Story Chapter 2: The Seven Shus in the Maze
• New S Rank Valkyrie: Mad Pleasure: Shadowbringer (Thelema)
• New Featured Event: Flying to Oxia Invitation Contest
• ...and more!

title: Variable Chaser Valchase
description:
Conglomerates struggle against each other to gain the right to develop the outer space.

Valchase, the latest model of chaser, flies a mission to get back the stolen classified information.

title: Hexen: Veil of Darkness
description: Hexen: Veil of Darkness is an eight-level hub-based mod for Hexen designed for the GZDoom source port, created by Captain Toenail.

title: Dangerous Pacche-san Moriya's Journey 4
description: The latest installment in the Moriya's Journey series! The action game is back, kinder and worse! Can you solve the hidden mystery?

title: Lost Star
description:
On a snowy night, a witch loses her way home and meets someone new.

Work together as a witch and her cat from space to overcome obstacles and find a way home in this challenging single-player platformer. Summon your familiar and swap places with it to reach new heights, use your broom to soar across chasms, and combine the two for acrobatic action and puzzle solving.

Includes adjustable gameplay speed. Slow things down if you want more time to think with each jump, or speed it up for an extra-fast-paced challenge.

title: Clothes Line
description: Clothes Line is a comical adventure game about chosen solitude. You will have to face the worst of your fears: a new neighbour.

title: Pooool
description: Pooool is a small, pool-inspired physics puzzler where you combine balls of similar sizes to create even bigger ones, all while trying to save room for more. Chase your hi-score, share scores with friends, and master your flinging skills!

title: Ben 10 Omniverse: Rise of Heroes
description: Ben 10 Omniverse: Rise of Heroes was a Ben 10 online game. It was a MMORPG.

title: Uncutetifying Danny
description: Your cute best friend, Danny, is sick of being called cute, so he needs your help to make him look cool! Your advice is important to him, so he'll change his appearance based on what you say. Will you be able to successfully turn him uncute?

title: With Love Comes Regret
description: A psychological horror girls love visual novel about two girls bonding over their overbearing parents and trying to live freely. But one of the girls seems to be haunted by the ghost of her own mother.

title: Befriending the Scarily Cute Fisherman
description: A 21-year-old who just wants to have fun and enjoy his youth, and a 31-year-old who's trying to get by and sell fishes for a living. The only thing they have in common is that they're awkward around each other.

title: We're Closed Sorry
description:
We're closed Sorry is a metroidvania in which the player controls both a titular hero traversing the interior of a retro supermarket store and the owner of the store. Immerse in an action-adventure combating bugs, finding secrets, and becoming a dreamt hero.

As the owner of the store, the game only begins when you close your shop allowing all creepy things and bugs to lurk in the dark terrorizing the store and your products.

title: Tortuga City
description: Survive Tortuga City as a wanted turtle. Defend yourself against the police, build a rebellion, endure dynamic weather, and find an escape route within 50 days before the police deploy their secret weapon.

title: PC Calcio 7.0
description: Managerial football game highly appreciated in the 90s created by Dinamic Multimedia srl and sponsored by the Italian Footballers' Association AIC

title: Don't Dig Up the Dead
description: You must find 3 magic relics to help rid the land of evil. Use the Find-O-Meter and your trusty shovel to search the forest. But if you dig up the dead you'll need to fight them off to stay alive, so pay attention to everything you unearth...it might just save your life.

title: Bun Bun Samurai
description: A fast-paced arcade brawler, centered on scoring combos by knocking enemies into each other.

title: Porter
description: In Porter, you play as Yug who may teleport and jump. If Yug teleports into a wall, Yug dies. If Yug jumps into spikes, Yug dies. The goal is to use Yugs teleportation and jump to get to the yellow coin in each level.

title: Iberia
description: A Multi-User Dungeon, or MUD, is a text-based online multiplayer game where players navigate virtual worlds, interact with each other, and engage in various activities using textual commands. In the realm of Iberia, players are transported back to a pivotal period in history, set against the backdrop of the Roman conquest of the Iberian Peninsula.

title: A Better Schlo Dating Simulation
description:
Have you ever wondered what a schlo dating simulation would be like if it was better? Find out by playing a better schlo dating simulation!

Help Oran get a boyfriend in a short, fun dating sim that doesn't even need a trigger warning! (There is slight mention of "adult" things, but nothing too dark!) With 12 different endings, the game should be a good hour worth of fun!

title: Schlo: Final Stand
description:
The next installment of the Schlo series, Schlo: Final Stand, makes its final, full release, as a kinetic visual novel. Follow T. Chlroid, an insecure genetically engineered human, as he struggles in an attempt to turn his cherished friendship with an important public figure into something else.

Featuring characters seen in "what is schlo?" and "a better schlo dating simulation", it could also serve as a standalone project. It is technically a sequel to "what is schlo?", while the later parts would take place at the same time as "a better schlo dating simulation".

title: Schlo Pink and Purple
description:
Help Leila Crestcoft, a straight guy living in a culture of genetically engineered gay men, find a boyfriend to prove a point while simultaneously fooling members of an exclusive group that he is one of them.

The fifth installment of the schlo series is a dating sim rather independent from the rest of the schlo timeline, featuring many new characters as well as familiar ones. It could technically take place around the end of Schlo: Final Stand.

The focus of the game is on the Great Twelve descendants, a special group of humans living with the schlos. With 13 endings and a variety of antics sprinkled into a dating sim setting, the game should be at least a couple hours of fun.

The music was done by strawberry peeler.

title: Schlo Complications
description:
Follow Drey Gan as his life gets more complicated while living with schlos in schlo complications (part 1 out of 4), an HTML5 kinetic visual novel being released in four parts.

Drey Gan moves into a new house with the Clerences: Slate, Rain, and Shy, and his ex-boyfriend, Jake. Between missing his old relationship with Slate and secretly getting involved with Rain, things start getting complicated!

title: Mohrta
description: Mohrta is a nonlinear FPS game blending action, exploration, and light dungeon crawling. Explore a vast selection of unique environments, slay an enormous cast of otherworldly creatures, and upgrade your arsenal of multifaceted weapons.

title: Psychic Shadows
description: Unpleasant dreams await you in Psychic Shadows, an independent video game made in RPG Maker VX Ace where every decision matters.

title: Silver Thread: Deux
description:
Do ghosts actually exist?

In this sequel to Silver Thread, an exorcist that doubts the existence of ghosts might sound contradictory, but to Alicia Wilkershire, this is the right way to get closer to the truth. After hearing rumors of a haunted theater, Alicia was hired to investigate...but what will she find there?

title: It's Either Them Or Us
description:
But lately all the roots from your garden have grown,
They cut through my skin, they broke my heart
and all I have left are bones.

title: Can Do!
description: A cozy(ish) game about sorting and stocking grocery store shelves.

title: Future Cat Sailor
description: Play as the intrepid Future Cat, on a quest for wealth with which to feed his family. Boat and Platform around the haunting ruins of civilizations past. But will he be able to escape with his life!?!?!

title: Traintracks Combat
description: Traintracks Combat is a fighting game set on the Chicago CTA. Choose your commuter and duke it out at the California blue line stop.

title: After a While
description: Run, bun, run

title: One More Encounter
description:
On November 17, 1992, a small group of three developers released a video game like no other. Only available for the NEC PC-9801 computer, this was the most ambitious game the industry had ever conceived. Unfortunately, it was a sales failure and was lost in the abyss of time.

More than 30 years later, One More Encounter (a.k.a OME) has been partially revived. One More Encounter was a dungeon crawler where the important thing was not the motif, but the journey itself and the characters we encountered along the way. Unfortunately, only 0.35% of the total game could be saved. That is, of the more than two thousand possible encounters in the game, this version only contains seven.

Be that as it may, this is a look at a world that could have been, an industry that never really took hold, and a type of videogame that, so many years later, we are still struggling to make.

title: Nine Hole Ninja
description: Use your trusty ninja sword to whack the golf ball into the hole(s)! Just don't expect it to get through the course in one piece...

title: Jump On Head
description: JUMP ON HEAD is a platform fighter with one goal: JUMP ON HEAD. Casuals and pros alike can enjoy its fast-paced, responsive gameplay. Play against up to three friends (currently local multiplayer only) on six diverse stages, and try to be the last player standing!

title: Entities' Repose
description: Entities' Repose is a traffic management game where you are tasked with guiding spirits through the rivers of the underworld. you will need to build the way for them, but soon you will find that there are too many entities!

title: Summer Islands: Growth
description: 3D vacation platformer where you collect bugs and soothe an angry heron god with fish.

title: Momentous: Monumentum
description: Help Biip reach the end of each course in this hand-crafted precision platformer with no cap on velocity.

title: Fishing RPG
description: Fish your way to victory in this relaxed quest for the ultimate reward: soup.

title: Hämmeri
description: Hammer your way through the night!

title: The Blocks Returneth
description: A loving tribute to the Blocks Cometh by Halfbot (2010).

title: Underhaul
description: Look into the new world , "Underhaul" A game about a girl protecting her grandma's life by collecting strawberries in order to create the best medicine for her. Help her in order to succeed in preventing the death of her grand mother.

title: Blank Relish: Remastered
description:
Embark on a journey alongside Private Marian, who lost everything during his crash on an unknown planet, devoid of companionship and lacking his equipment... Will he survive the challenge and come back home?

Experience Marian's struggle for survival and finding purpose amidst the isolation of the unknown planet.

title: Waxwing Radio
description: Ambient precision flight in technoindustrial wastelands.

title: Bunny on Rails
description:
The bunny needs help getting to the carrot. Can you build a road to get them there?

Place blocks and get rewarded for making the longest road possible! But be careful, replacing already placed blocks gives you a score penalty!

title: Pirates and Aztecs
description: A pirate named Lorencillo searching for the greatest treasure of all time, the lost treasure of Moctezuma. He fights the fearsome Aztecs to obtain a map and a key, but not before resisting the attacks of great Aztec warriors.

title: An Alt Girl for Skoof
description: There is a rumor that any skuf can legally receive a fee alt girl from the state; to do this, you just need to log in to a special service and enter your personal data.

title: Purple Orchid
description: Step into the "Purpled Orchid," an immersive simulation game where you take on the role of an inspector at a bustling strip club. Your primary responsibility is to ensure that all workers have the correct documentation to legally perform at the club. With a sharp eye for detail and a knack for detecting discrepancies, you will navigate through a series of challenging scenarios.

title: Alan Wake II: The Final Draft
description:
The Final Draft is the New Game Plus mode for Alan Wake 2, released with Update 13 on December 11, 2023. It includes a new difficulty level (Nightmare), an expanded version of the base ending, new collectables, and other narrative changes/additions.

Players will retain all weapons, Charms and character upgrades earned during their first playthrough.

title: Test: The Game
description: A project created by midosei, who states that it was going to be something small and short, but it ended taking up three years to make. The whole project is made with default assets from RPG Maker VX Ace.

title: Control: Expeditions
description: Expeditions are a challenging combat experience with a set time limit for completion aimed at those who have already completed Control.

title: Pawsitive
description: Pawsitive is a healthy adventure RPG that lets you turn your healthy habits into energy for a virtual puppy. A mix between retro Tamagotchi pet games and modern health tracking, Pawsitive helps gamers reclaim their health with fun quests and healthy prizes.

title: South Pole Bebop
description:
A multiplayer Into The Breach-inspired turn-based strategy game. It is designed for two players, is set on a 9x9 board where each player controls characters and bases. Each player commands three characters and three bases, aiming to eliminate the opponent's characters or bases while fending off a zombie horde that attacks both players.

Players can create a customizable deck before each game, consisting of three characters and up to 15 unique ability cards that enhance bases and provide special powers to characters. During gameplay, players can purchase ability cards using collectable cores. These cards are limited to those included in the player's deck, which can be modified and reused for subsequent games.

title: A Game's Tale
description: Welcome to "A Game's Tale”, where you´ll enjoy tactical battles, grow your deck as you travel through a fantasy world. While meeting charming characters along the way, you will discover the secret of why we play.

title: Arena Breakout: Infinite
description: Arena Breakout: Infinite is a tactical extraction shooter featuring PvPvE combat. Players enter raids where they fight both AI enemies and other players, collect loot, and attempt to escape the map alive. Failing to extract means losing all acquired gear. The game emphasizes realistic visuals and sound design.

title: DungeonSweeper
description: A minesweeper rogue-like. Can you survive the dungeon?

title: Escape From The Boykisser
description: Help the "friend" and escape from this place or surrender to the clutches of this monster.

title: Honkai: Star Rail - Then Wake to Weep
description:
Version 2.2 of Honkai: Star Rail, which includes:
• New characters: Robin and Boothill
• New Trailblaze mission: The Fool Always Rings Twice
• New areas: Dreamflux Reef, Soulglad Festivity Auditions and Penacony Grand Theater
• New quality of life updates
• New main event: Clockie Dreamjoy Memoir
• …and more!

title: Grim Dawn: Fangs of Asterkarn
description: In this latest massive installment of Grim Dawn, you will journey West into the rugged wilderness of Asterkarn and contend with the mighty Kurn. Discover the dark legacy that continues to haunt these nomadic people and again drives them East, towards renewed conflict.

title: Kira Kira Magical Stars
description: Kira Kira Magical Stars is a cute fantasy magical girl top-down shooter and platformer.

title: Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney - Trials After Justice
description:
Set between Ace Attorney: Justice for All and Trails and Tribulations. In Phoenix Wright Ace Attorney ‘Trials after Justice’ Phoenix and Maya continue to help those in need by defending them. Along the way, they come across a new prosecutor named Luis Hawk, who seems to have it in for Phoenix. (Don’t they all?) During these trials, Phoenix learns about his new rival. Is he a friend or foe to justice?

Originally intended to be 4 cases, but cancelled after 3 was finished.

title: Sim Settlements 2
description: A sequel to the popular Sim Settlements mod, containing three chapters with dozens of fully voiced characters and storylines based around a deeply expanded settlement building system.

title: Another Sonic 2 Remake
description:
A hand drawn fan remake of the Master System and Game Gear version of Sonic 2. Currently playable as a 7 level demo with multiple difficulty modes, a boss rush, and a time attack. Debuted at the Sonic Amateur games Expo 2022, the final game is expected to release by 2029.

The game is powered by the open source "Open Surge" Engine and is developed by Just John 43, with an OST selected from across the Sonic community.

title: L’Automne
description: L'automne is a kinetic, linear narrative story. Summer's gone. The Leaves have fallen. Welcome to Alder Falls.

title: Funny Business
description:
Wow! It's your first day at your new job at the Funny Business joke factory. Over the course of a short corporate induction, you too can become a comedy genius!!

Of course, who knows more about comedy (and the teaching thereof) than junior manager Stone Jones~

title: Mobile Light Force
description: Mobile Light Force is a sloppy localization of the first Gunbird for PlayStation originally released in 1994. This localization removed all plot-related elements including cutscenes and endings, took the in-game's fan art gallery and renamed some characters with names taken from XS Games employees. The game's cover art and title screen also feature a completely unrelated artwork featuring characters resembling the main trio from Charlie's Angels. This realistic artwork is the complete opposite of the anime-styled aesthetics of Gunbird, and the characters displayed don't appear anywhere in the actual game.

title: My Strange Plane is a Thing Body Moves Through
description: Walk among weird objects in a weird place and hear them talk (maybe) about life

title: Barn Runner 2: The Ejection Rejection
description: This game showcases the Top Down Scrolling Arcade engine that powers some of the arcade sequences for Barn Runner: The Forever Friday in the style of Spy Hunter.

title: Barn Runner: The Mayor's New Dress
description:
Mayor Marguerite DuChamp gets her turn in the spotlight (in more ways than one) in this Barn Runner take on the fairy tale The Emperor's New Clothes.

This game stars the mayor of Arc 19 and her best gal pal, The Chief. It's done in a visual novel style with four possible endings in all. It was made for the July 2012 MAGS (Monthly Adventure Game Studio) contest.

title: Barn Runner: Christmas Soup
description: This short game set in the Barn Runner universe showcases the domestic holiday adventures of Noriko and The Chief as they try to get everything ready in time for Christmas.

title: Catamyst
description: Catamyst is an Action, Roguelike game where you craft and throw molecular potions at hordes of enemies.

title: Paravox
description: Paravox is a high action 3v3 PvP third-person shooter.

title: Sea of Thieves: Season 12
description:
Bring new thrills and tactics to your Voyages with Sea of Thieves Season 12's audacious assortment of weapons and tools, all available to deploy from April 30th, 2024!

Sea of Thieves Season 12 adds two new weapons in Double-Barrel Flintlock Pistol and Throwing Knives. The Double-Barrel Flintlock Pistol, as the name suggests, can fire two bullets in either rapid succession or both at the same time. It is said to be designed for more close-range combat. Throwing Knives, meanwhile, are very versatile as they have three ways to attack. You can either use them to do a melee stab, which can be charged or uncharged, as well as for a range-throwing attack.

Sea of Thieves Season 12 is confirmed to add several new tools to the game, so here is the list of everything that will be added:

- Scattershot: A new type of ammunition that fires four small cannonballs in a short range but widespread.
- Bone Caller: A new throwable that can spawn three skeletons that’ll aid you in battle.
- Wind Caller: A shell that can, as the name suggests, call wind. It can be used to speed your ships, blow the timber out of your foes, prevent fall damage, and so much more.

Besides these tools, there will be two neat QoL additions:
- Ziplines: New ziplines will be added across the map.
- Harpoon line travel: The rope that you create with your harpoon can now be walked, but beware, you’ll have to balance or you’ll fall off.

title: Supercan 2
description: Süpercan 2 is an action/adventure game that takes place after Süpercan 1. The game developed by Sobee was launched for the first time at GameX 2012.

title: The Tunnels of Saint Mercy Road
description: The Tunnels of Saint Mercy Road is an immersive horror experience that spans 4 areas, each unique and provides a different sense of unease. Inspired by games such as Silent Hill, Outlast, Resident Evil and many other (possibly surprising) games and stories, you will uncover the truth behind the urban legends of the tunnels under Saint Mercy Road.

title: Zector 7
description: Fight zombies with your friends in this survival open-world sci-fi. Harvest, Craft, Build, and purchase better gear and vehicles to survive the night. Explore and loot abandoned bases, crashed ships, caves, alien temples, and outposts to become the ultimate survivor.

title: Starimu
description: Starimu is a virtual world where you can express yourself and explore hundreds of unique styles. Not that only! But imagine a world where you can meet hundreds of people around the globe just by using your device! Get creative, play games, Join Events and have the best time all in one place.

title: Castlevania ReVamped
description: A reimagining of the first Castlevania game as a metroidvania, taking elements and inspiration from all official tellings of Simon Belmont's first encounter with Dracula.

title: Yashiyu No Hyper Ultra Action DX
HRT Simulator 2023
description: A very sincere and heartfelt shitpost about a guy doing his first shot of HRT.

title: Tails Gets Trolled
description: Tails Gets Trolled is a mod based off of an ongoing webcomic of the same name created by Lazerbot. Originally released in 2011, it's based off mainly the franchise "Sonic the Hedgehog" but also has characters from a lot more series, most notably Super Mario Bros, Looney Tunes, and Tom & Jerry.

title: Professor Quackerton in: The Locked Birdhouse
description:
In this storybook game, Professor Quackerton and her friends have to band together in the wake of a loss. Experience this colorful world of queer animals with big personalities and a big problem.

When a dear friend passes, there is little to be done but to celebrate her life. Trouble is, everything seems to be going wrong. The twins are fighting, the cat is sleeping, and Max won't leave his post... What's a duck to do?

title: Distance and Mirage
description:
Laurel disappeared when the two of you were just stupid kids, playing out past your curfew. The thing at the molten heart of the desert?

It knows something.

title: Otaku's Adventure: The World Just Keeps Turning
description:
Will the earth be destroyed soon?
Will you choose only one between the earth and Waifu?
This DLC, player will travel through time and space via a time machine, meet all kinds of different people, find clues and growth, and find ways to save Waifu and the earth.
This DLC content is a continuation of the Waifu's story of the main game.
Complete the entire story of the Waifu.

title: Pokemomcore
description: Travel through Pallet Town and Viridian Town after an anti-capitalist and anti-speciesist revolution! Red, Blue, Green and Yellow have fought to emancipate Kanto from the grip of the Pokémon League and its alienating power over the people. And you, you play as GAMIN Lesli who has to pick up a package for their MOM so she can make pottery this weekend with her friends! Will you arrive in time to get the package and will there be any rhubarb pie left?

title: Me Mostre Sonhos Doces
description: A short queer story about searching for sweet winter dreams.

title: A Gang of Weirdos
description:
Worlds in the universe die in a spiritual sense when an apocalyptic scenario occurs and it leaves behind a soul. If the world soul is charged up, it can revive the world and the people that have died; however, the only way to do that is to recover other world souls from other dying worlds.

You play as someone that calls themselves Mx.Gunslinger, who is on a quest to save their dead world by recovering other world souls, meeting weirdos and friends and weird friends along the way.

title: It Doesn't Have to Be Like This
description: You play a gas station clerk working her shift on the day the earth is destroyed.

title: Kenas-unarpe
description: A puzzle adventure inspired by the legend of the Kenas-unarpe from Ainu folklore.

title: America Rising 2: Legacy of the Enclave
description: A remake/remaster of the 'America Rising - A Tale of the Enclave' mod, America Rising 2 features a 24 quest main storyline, new fully voiced companions, new worldspaces, and more.

title: Reign of the Undead: Revolution
description: Reign of the Undead: Revolution is a modification for Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare based on Reign of the Undead, a wave-based zombie survival mod that was influenced by the original zombie modes of Call of Duty World at War, Black Ops and newer ones. Different waves require different strategies and teamplay is a must.

title: Star Wars Mod: Galactic Warfare
description: Star Wars Mod: Galactic Warfare is a modification for Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare. It is a total conversion that combines lot of the known battlegrounds, characters and weapons of Star Wars with the gameplay of the Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare multiplayer.

title: Call of Duty 4: Survival Mode
description: Call of Duty 4: Survival Mode is a modification for Call of Duty 4 singleplayer that aims to bring Modern Warfare 3 Survival Mode mechanics to Call of Duty 4.

title: World at War: Nazi Zombies Remastered
description: This mod is a "remastered patch" for the Call of Duty: World at War stock zombie maps. The aim of this project is to modify these maps with bug fixes, quality-of-life tweaks, fixed inconsistencies, new features inspired by Black Ops 1, and a few creative additions such as adding back cut content or storyline-related Easter Eggs.

title: Mysteries of the Heart: The Psychic Detective Case Files
description: This is a mystery/suspense ADV, so you must use your detective skills to solve puzzles and crimes. It employs a 'voices of the heart' system where you can tell what a character is thinking. You'll have to collect clues to solve the crimes, which quickly escalating from simple theft.

title: Cards and Towers
description: A roguelike deckbuilder fused with real-time tower defense. Craft your deck, protect your base, slay endless enemies, and survive as long as you can.

title: The Distortion Beast
description:
In sleepy Coppersfield, a remote village on the coast of the Axelands, Maria of Cardo is offered a job. Coppersfield has been plagued by terrible attacks from an insidious and monstrous creature they call The Distortion Beast. The village elders want Maria of Cardo to explore the beat's lair, find it, and destroy it once and for all.

As Maria of Cardo, can you make the right choices, and truly defeat The Distortion Beast?

--

The Distortion Beast is an interactive fiction comic. Become Maria of Cardo, an adventurer who dives into the Lair of the Distortion Beast to rid the Axelands of this menace once and for all. Collect items, make choices, and try to defeat the beast!

title: Eyes
description:
Escape the EYES lab, while They are watching.

I need to tell you something.Yesterday, when I was out walking, someone approached me.Looked me in the EYES and blinked at me.He closed his left eye, then left.Didn't even say a word.I have never met this man in my life.I don't understand what happened.And I don't know why it happened either.

title: Lords of the Fallen: Master of Fate Update
description:
VERSION 1.5 - 'Master of Fate': This update represents the culmination of 30+ post-launch updates resulting in significantly improved performance, stability & optimization, alongside rigorous difficulty balancing, and also includes our 'Advanced Game Modifier System', allowing ALL players to fully customize and adjust difficulty of future play-throughs.

The Master of Fate Update concludes now concludes the Free Content Roadmap for Lords of the Fallen, adding the following content and quality-of-life enhancements, vastly improving the experience for all players:

- Significant performance, optimization and stability improvements
- Rigorous difficulty balancing including mob density reduction & nerfed ranged attacks
- Split PvP and PvE game balancing
- Online multiplayer enhancements for improved matchmaking and connection stability
- New questlines including Season of the Bleak, Trial of the Three Spirits, and Way of the Bucket
- New armor and weapon sets
- Additional secret boss weapon abilities
- Improved boss encounters with additional movesets & new AI
- 12 new spells including the arena-devastating Immolation
- New grievous strikes: each weapon family now features two unique finishers: one for single-handed wielding and another for two-handed wielding
- 3 new projectiles: Blood Vomit, Explosive Mines, and Frost Worms.
- QOL updates including: inventory expansion, appearance reset, storage functionality & gamepad rebinding

title: JimmyQuest
description:
It is a morning unlike any other, for today Hajime "Jimmy" Lara is going to do something she has never(?) done before — take a big CHOMP out of Junta's tail!

Hajime "Jimmy" Lara and Junta are two beautiful cats who live together in a little house with two weird humans. But who cares about humans? Jimmy has her eyes on one target, and it's that enticing, twitchy, wriggly-wiggly tail sprouting out of Junta's butt.

The story will involve a brief introduction to Ms. Jimmy and Mr. Junta before she spends her hours honing her skills to pull off the perfect crime.

Bolster her STEALTH, ROUMB, CUTE, and BITE stats to ensure that she achieves her almighty goal!

And if you win...long live Queen Jim!

title: Jim & Dill: The Legend of Weed N' Stiff
description: Join the adventure! Jim Weed and Dill Stiff have been kidnapped by the jealous Joe Bobson, leader of the rival band Moo Cow. You’ll have to battle your way through the seaside, mountains, caves, and snow to save the Weed N’ Stiff boys! Along the way, a cast of characters from the Weed N’ Stiff universe will help you on your quest. Sort of. At least there’s a lot of WS references and even some of the band’s music in glorious 8-bit.

title: Dicy Chess
description:
Experience the full feeling of playing chess...
BUT WITH RANDOMNESS
At the start of each turn you roll a dice and the outcome determines how far you can move

title: Let's Go To The Circus
description:
Lets Go To The Circus is a short and rather silly horror comedy game.

A mysterious attack at a circus has you curious as to what caused it, can you uncover the mystery behind this attack?

title: Lands of Languages
description:
Lands of Languages (LoL) is a hobby project developed with the objective of learning language vocabulary in a fun way. Learning requires repetition, which is often boring. So here the repetition is embedded within the grinding tasks of a role-playing game, and the development is heavily focused on gameplay.

In LoL you explore a procedurally generated world inhabited by different beings, which you can capture and train in battles. These battles are the core gameplay, and your battle success depends on solving translation challenges. As your beings level up, you gradually encounter harder challenges and can explore new areas of the world.

title: Hustle Quest: Historia of Urth
description:
We play games to escape from the harsh mundanities of life. In Hustle Quest you do the exact opposite. Hustle Quest is a comedy RPG with a heavy focus on dialogue and exploration as opposed to combat.

When a Cat Girl named Mia drinks too much on her birthday, she ends up selling a powerful magical artifact needed to defend the town against an oncoming threat. Worse, the person she sold the artifact to wants to take over the town. Now Mia must recover the artifact before it's too late! But first, she has some errands to run.

Explore a town filled with unique quests, multiple secrets and memorable characters. Make choices that determine how quests play out and your overall chance of success against the final boss. Discover what happens when a Cat Girl drinks too much.

title: Macaroni in a Pot
description:
Experience the thrilling world of PRO PASTA COOKING!

Learn the secret techniques behind making mediocre Mac'n'Cheese from the comfort of your own computation device!

title: Comuni Non Comuni
description:
Choose the real Italian Municipality between the two options provided. Very easy!

Comuni Non Comuni is a simple, fast, immediate and engaging game. You will be shown two names: one is a real Italian municipality, the other is a name generated with an ad hoc algorithm.

title: Lost Everything: Chapter 1
description: Embark on an immersive adventure with "Lost Everything: Chapter 1," a captivating 2D point and click game. Join Billy, the determined protagonist, as he delves into a journey of revelation, where the truth awaits, whether he's ready for it or not. Unravel mysteries, solve intriguing puzzles, and uncover hidden secrets in this compelling storyline.

title: We Are Stardust
description: Space Invaders. Wrapped in a circle. And Mavis Beacon playing it.

title: Gunbird
description:
Marion and friends battle hard in the sprawling world
of yet another Psikyo shooter masterpiece.
Now with online rankings!

title: Hanzala Returns
description: You play as Hanzala, a 10 year old Palestinian kid who just wants to go to his home and avoid getting captured or killed by the occupation forces.

title: Nutty
description: Nutty third person shooter game

title: Hydrangea
description: Hydrangea is a romance and psychological horror visual novel inspired by the Hanahaki disease trope. You play as someone whose sweetheart, customizable to your preferences, falls ill with a mysterious condition just as you reconsider ending the relationship. Drawn closer by their plight, you find yourself navigating a love that deepens into obsession, where affection takes a dark turn and the petals of devotion threaten to suffocate.

title: Winglet
description: A short 10 minute flying game.

title: Ultimate FPS Challenge
description: The Game gives you the hardest FPS challenge.

title: Shin Megami Tensei: Strange Journey 2
description: A fan-made sequel to Atlus' cult classic, made in Ren'py and predominantly featuring generative AI assets.

title: Someone to Hold Me
description: A very short, simple visual novel made in a week, starring an asexual girl and her internal and social tribulations. Featuring one ending, an unlockable epilogue, and a few post-game secrets.

title: Clay Jam
description: Save the land of Clay Jam from the fearsome Bully Beasts in this fun-packed action game. Guide Fat Pebble as he rolls down five weird and wonderful hills in a world made entirely from clay! Squash monsters on the way, and he'll grow and grow and GROW! Get all the way to the bottom of the hill and meet the nasty Bully Beasts. Can you collect enough clay to free the monsters and save Clay Jam?!

title: A Tavern at Night
description: Seek shelter from the rain and find some company for the night.

title: A Tavern at Night: Firelight
description: Read your fortune around a campfire at night.

title: Mori no Naku Shunkan he: The End of a Saga
description: Mori no Naku Shunkan he: The End of a Saga is a "parody"/fangame of Higurashi When They Cry.

title: LvL50
description: Complete 50 levels. In a row. Without getting hit.

title: Sonic & All-Stars Racing Transformed
description: The PC version adds 5 exclusive characters, being Ryo Hazuki, Football Manager, Shogun, General Winter and Willemus.

title: Serious Sam: Portals
description:
Features:
- 3 maps connected through a central hub
- 30 secrets including 3 special secret rooms
- supports single player and co-op
- supports all difficulty levels

title: Minecraft: Kung Fu Panda
description: Unleash your inner AWESOMENESS with the DreamWorks Kung Fu Panda DLC! Master kung fu alongside Po and the Furious Five at the Jade Palace. Kick, punch, and skadoosh your way through this adventure map filled with action-packed battles, epic showdowns from the movies, and a multiplayer mode for pand-tastic fun!

title: Minecraft: Universal Studios Experience
description: Let’s go to Universal Studios, right here in Minecraft! You’ll start your adventure at the gates of Universal Studios, where Woody Woodpecker will greet you and ask for your help restoring the letters on the Universal globe. As you venture forward, you’ll encounter riveting rides, souvenir shops, amazing minigames, and more marvelous characters like Shrek and E.T.

title: Minecraft: Armored Paws
description: Minecraft: Armored Paws is a minor update for Minecraft: Bedrock Edition which adds content voted for at Minecraft Live 2023 by adding armadillos and wolf armor, while also adding 8 new wolf variants.

title: Swiper's Big Adventure
description: Baby Fox lost his way and Swiper has volunteered to take him home. With help from Dora, Boots, and you, Swiper will fulfill his kind quest. But you'll have to be very careful because crows, spiders and bats are around and they will try to slow him down.

title: Gothic Remake Collector's Edition
description:
Gothic Remake Collector's Edition includes:

- Gothic Remake
- 34x24cm Sleeper wall mask
- Genuine leather wristband
- Genuine leather notebook
- Original soundtrack

title: Sengoku Gensokyo
description: Being a parody beetwen the Rance and Touhou series, the story sets the player as Hakurei Reimu into a situation where Gensoukyou has been divided up into various warring states. The ever mischievous Yakumo Yukari, the culprit behind the start of this war game, has sent out letters to all of the major factions of the world laying out the rules of the game and promising to grant one wish for the winning team.

title: Aelfric the Wondrous
description: A short kinetic novel made by LadyMeowsith.

title: Quetzal
description: Control a Mesoamerican god who must escape the underworld in this challenging 2D pixel art platformer, dodging dangers to recover the sacred bones of humanity.

title: Trapped Inside a Train (And There's Nothing You Can Do About It)
description:
You're stuck inside a train. There's got to be something you can do to get out, right?

(A short, nonsensical experimental game. Featuring several endings, including a 'true' one unlocked by seeing all the others, snark, and a train.)

title: Of Slimes and Sandwiches
description:
Of Slime and Sandwiches was a collaborative project made over several discord calls with friends.

The plot, characters, artwork and other aspects were all decided on the spot during those calls, and the result was this: a masterpiece for the ages.

title: Jak the Chicken
description: Adds over 18 levels and 900+ collectibles to the game and new powerups and adventures!

title: Batman: The Brave and the Bold - Streets of Gotham: Full Throttle
description:
Hit the streets or take to the air in the Gotham Grand Prix!
Now you can fly along with Gotham City's wildest rides!
Win to unlock more bonus features.
Come in first on the driving levels and watch a special video associated with each track!
Come in first on any one of the flying tracks and take flight in the Batjet!

title: RamsaySnap
description: A game about shooting characters for points but you need to avoid killing the wrong people. Instead of SnapShot characters you will be aiming real people but avoid the SnapShot characters at all costs.

title: Saint Seiya: Exclamation
description: Saint Seiya: Exclamation is a Brazilian RPG fangame with characters in the SD (Super Deformed) style. The story continues in an original way with the series, but with the addition of two new characters: Yusei from Vulpecula and Aki from Apus! The new characters were introduced so that the game follows a new line and is not too predictable for the player! When starting the game you can choose between Male (Yusei) and Female (Aki), each of which has exclusive stories in the game!

title: Saint Seiya: Caos Chapter
description: Saint Seiya: Chaos Chapter created by Yuri Fernandes is a Brazilian Knights of the Zodiacs fangame divided into chapters where the world is in Chaos and it is up to the golden knights to restore peace to the world.

title: Les Chevaliers du Zodiaque: Il Faut Sauver Athena
description: Les Chevaliers du Zodiaque - Il faut sauver Athena are a french fangame of Knights of Zodiac made for Loulou Martoni.

title: Sonic Boom: A Dating Sonamy Sim?!
description:
Sonic Boom A Dating Sonamy Sim?! or SBDSS, is a bite-size visual novel fan-game made to attempt to tackle an idea I've always had lurking (menacingly) in the back of my mind: "What if there was a sonamy dating sim?"

Following the events of Sonic Boom S2 EP. 44 : Sonic the newly appointed delivery boy is led to a house along the water's edge. Greeted by a familiar face with... intentions, he plays along.

title: Battle City Remake
description:
Battle City Remake is a remake of the original game produced and published by Namco at the year 1985. The game is a multi-directional shooter where you control a tank that must destroy all 20 enemies in each stage to advance to the next level. The enemy tanks on the other side attempt to destroy the player's base as well as the player.

The remake contains all the original 35 stages of the game, but with improved graphics. Like always the idea of our remake is improve the game visuals, but keep the gameplay the most close possible to the original game.

title: Orchid Labyrinth
description: When reunited with two girls who bear her likeness within a deep dream, will Dahlia finally figure out what she really wants? This is a short visual novel with a run time of about 30 minutes.

title: Melo's Nightmare
description:
Melo's Nightmare is a first-person perspective 3D escape horror game.
Players find themselves trapped in corridors and must investigate puzzles to attempt escape.
Fulfilling the conditions to escape hidden passageways will unlock the next door.
Activating or finding the correct puzzle triggers changes in the environment.

title: Feline Forensics and the Meowseum Mystery
description: There's only one detective to unravel this murder turned museum heist... and they're the cat's meow. Interrogate a "colorful" cast of suspects until they cough up hairballs... and the truth. Will you wrap up the case in time for an afternoon nap, and make injustice knead its last biscuit?

title: Detective Bass: Fish Out Of Water
description:
There has a murder on a luxurious cruise ship!

As the clever, wise, and handsome Detective Bass you must investigate 8 fish-people to decide who is responsible and put them behind bars.

title: The Case of Andrew D.
description: A forensic challenge - help private eye solve cases for their clients using OSINT and digital forensics techniques.

title: Dune Dasher
description: Endless Desert Destruction

title: Rogue Citadel
description: Unlock new defences, collect powerful items and create game-breaking synergies in this roguelite tower defence survivors game.

title: Sonic Mayhem
description: To celebrate the 20th anniversary of the release of Quake 2 comes this singleplayer unit based on a side-mission to Stroggos!

title: Quake II: Sewer Jam Volume 1
description: Sewer levels are notoriously hard to get right. That’s why Andrew Yoder set out to challenge the Quake community to come up with good sewer levels all the way back in 2019. We wanted to do the same for the Quake 2 Remaster and that resulted in this package. Featuring nine new maps, a hub level and pre-rendered cutscenes. We hope you enjoy Map-Center’s Quake 2 Sewer Jam Volume 1.

title: Jam Talk
description: It tells the story of a developer's very early beginnings and what video games mean to him.

title: Chiclana & Friends: The Game
description: Try to survive as many waves as possible with the best score in this game in which you control three characters at the same time.

title: Heian City Story
description:
A city-building sim with a historical twist
Travel back to olden times and become Director of your own city!
Attract new residents and try to become the greatest city in the land! Add buildings like restaurants and teahouses to make your town a place where samurai and commoners alike will want to live.

title: Paraiso
description: Get the cup of immortality and escape the temple with all the treasures you can find!

title: La Gran Alameda
description:
La Gran Alameda is a limit-removing map (complevel 2) set in the middle of a city under an otherworldly red sky. Make your way out of the facility and bring the fight to the rooftops! The city is completely infested, so watch out for fire coming from every direction.
This is not like the other bimonthly demon invasions though... This time they've brought some backup

title: Slugger
description: Slugger is a 10-15 mins short and punchy map for Doom 2

title: 2 Hours to Kill!
description: 2 Hours to Kill is a Doom II community speedmapping session in MBF21 format with a focus on refined combat. This set is split into 2 episodes depending on the kind of action: traditional Doom gameplay or slaughter.

title: Decomission
description: A map that was originally meant for a personal project that never happened. Mainly a brown storage facility with plenty of green foliage.

title: Embraced
description: Embraced is small set of 3 maps focusing on combat puzzle and slaughter(4th map progress stopper). Adding again to the green techbase crowd but this time with a lot of wood textures!

title: Escape From Sunveil Starport
description: Escape From Sunveil Starport is an MBF21 compatible mini-wad spanning 9 or so maps, initially created during NaNoWadMo2023. This project serves as a prequel to A2Rob's NaNoWadMo 2022 contribution, Machete. Initially, their plan was to ape off level concepts from Knee-Deep in the Dead.

title: Sanguine Holy Land
description: Sanguine Holy Land is a new episode for Doom 2 designed for limit removing source ports (complevel 2) made by the various members of Doomer Boards, lead by BiZ. The project theme was marble temples and blood rituals.

title: Rosy Rubicunda
description: A small 4-map (+ 1 intro and 1 credits map) collaborative wad between OverflowingMocha and Stephyesterday. Features somewhat tough microslaughter and a cute color palette.

title: Terror Signal
description: Terror Signal is a set of 17 maps(14 normal, 2 secret, 1 epilogue) designed for MBF21. It features new enemies along with some modified weapon and enemy behavior.

title: Forsaken Compound
description: Forsaken Compound is a limit-removing E1 replacement wad for Doom 1. There's a mix of action/slaughtery gameplay and more simple, atmosphere-oriented parts that require some thinking, overall intended to be more difficult than normal Knee Deep in the Dead-style mapping, as well as more visually distinct and varied than that episode. Texturing is all done from the IWAD with an excellent custom palette by Dir, and some sound replacements from Doom 64 and Doom 3.

title: Le Gars Qui A Fait Doom
description: "Le Gars Qui A Fait Doom" Level Collection is a series of 8 new Ultimate Doom maps for Limit Removing ports. They come in all styles and colors, and all of them are more or less inspired by John Romero, whether it's his old IWad maps, his modern offerings (SIGIL and its sequel), his other games, or even his real life. You can play each of these maps in any order you fancy, as there's no clear theme or difficulty order. Each wad can be played standalone, à la Master Levels, and some of them contain new textures and resources.

title: Fortnite Festival: Season 3
description: You’ve seen her in a crown, now see her in Fortnite. Award-winning artist Billie Eilish is the Icon of Fortnite Festival Season 3!

title: Crate Expectations
description: Crate Expectations is a full megawad of random high concept maps that push limit removing to its limits and maybe the player too! Besides a connecting theme of interactive crates which you will learn about while playing, each map is designed to be totally random and surprising and keep you on your toes - stay sharp!

title: Doom 2 In City Only
description: Doom 2 In City Only is a 36 map megawad in MBF21 format featuring nothing but city maps. Some of these maps are very large, so it is recommended you play with OpenGL. The set was primarily tested in dsda-doom. There are 6 secret maps (one per episode) with the secret exit being in the middle map of each episode. Jumping and freelook are not intended for this set and will break some maps.

title: Machine Men
description: Machine Men is a single map with plenty of grunt set in an abandoned lava-strewn demonic foundry. The title is inspired by the Bruce Dickinson song of the same name.

title: Super Doom TV
description: Doomguy is off to fight in the biggest event in galactic history, Super Doom TV! Every eyeball on every creature on every planet will be tuned to broadcast-compliant screens everywhere to see him plow through 25 sectors of high definition carnage. Super Doom TV is a 25 map megawad where each map was given an arena title from the SNES classic Super Smash T.V. as a prompt for mappers to work from. ﻿

title: Beasties of Greenhollow
description: Beasties of Greenhollow is a strategic turn based team building game that features a collection of cute creatures based of Scottish mythology. Explore a mysterious realm of fairies, elves, magic, and creatures while fighting to the center of this hidden realm at the request of a mysterious masked figure. What are Shellycoat’s true intentions?

title: Full Swing Golf
description: Full Swing GOLF Software - The most realistic golf simulation software in the industry. The best graphics and the best courses because your game deserves the best.

title: Invasão
description: About halfway through A 2ª Jornada, Sirey and his companions built 1 million Teenooks and sent them to the alien ships in orbit. And now you control just one of these robots, Teenook965421, who has infiltrated the tunnels of an alien mothership.

title: Star Wars Outlaws: Ultimate Edition
description:
Experience the first-ever open world Star Wars game, set between the events of The Empire Strikes Back and Return of the Jedi. Explore distinct planets across the galaxy, both iconic and new. Risk it all as Kay Vess, an emerging scoundrel seeking freedom and the means to start a new life, along with her companion Nix. Fight, steal, and outwit your way through the galaxy’s crime syndicates as you join the galaxy’s most wanted.

The Ultimate Edition includes the base game, the season pass, the Rogue Infiltrator bundle, the Sabacc Shark bundle, a digital art book, and 3 days early access.

title: A 3ª Jornada
description: After the destruction of Earth and Mars caused by the alien invasion, the human beings guided by Sirey are now living inside spaceships. Ten years after A 2ª Jornada, Sirey’s fleet is approaching a new solar system, where they’ll find a new planet... and new adventures.

title: Spotlight!!!
description: A lighthearted tale about two childhood friends, Juanita Santos and Xiang Li, on a 'quest' to return a cellphone to their classmate, an admittedly forgetful but cute witch. Shenanigans ensue.

title: Trump Quest
description: The 2016 American election has escalated to biblical proportions and World War III has begun. Donald Trump has taken his stance against the most important issues plaguing the world straight to the front lines. Brought to you by the same team that built the masterpiece known as Mystery Combat Man 3, TRUMP QUEST delivers an experience unrivaled among all source mods, video games, and perhaps entertainment as a whole.

title: Mystery Combat Man 4: The End of Time
description: The conclusion to the multi-award-winning Mystery Combat Man Franchise, MCM4 strives to be the best sequel to the worst mod ever made! The Mystery Combat Squad returns to an absurdist world of action and intrigue. Following the events of MCM3, a mysterious disruptor has broken into the time bank, setting off a catastrophic chain of events that threatens the timeline of the planet of the Earth. Who could have done this, and why? Whoever he his, he must be tracked down and brought to justice at any cost, and it's all down to the Mystery Combat Man to hunt him down across the space-time continuum. Will he succeed? It's all up to you, the player, in... Mystery Combat Man 4: The End of Time!

title: BMX Wild Run
description: Unleash Your BMX Spirit in the Wild!

title: Summer Games Challenge
description: Go for Gold!

title: Superpoke! Pets
description: SuperPoke! Pets were a virtual goods game for Facebook and MySpace, where you take care of a virtual pet.

title: H2O Root After and Another Complete Story Edition
description: Bundle of H2O: Footprints in the Sand and Root After and Another, for the complete experience in just one game.

title: Psoltrix
description: Play Tetris on a regular dodecahedron or icosahedron. The latest development in falling-block technology.

title: ULTRAKILL: Masquerade Divinity
description: A fan-mod that adds a new playable character and mode to the fast-paced character action FPS, ULTRAKILL.

title: Flood of Tears
description: An annoying protagonist, an ordinary school life, a few friends here and there. This is the story of a young man who falls in love willingly, and perhaps of a couple young women who fall in love somewhat less willingly.

title: Thinking Of U: A Love Story
description: After a long battle with the Dark Lord, Fiona has saved the world from darkness. Now, all she wants to do is relax on her vacation, without any more trouble...

title: Velev
description: Dive into VELEV's depths, a hidden world where technology and nature merge. Embark on quests, battle monsters, and unveil mysteries with enhanced gear. Experience intense PvPvE combat, strategic team play across diverse classes, and continuous character growth through exploration and extraction

title: Toasterdog in Dreamworld
description: Your shift as the Toaster Dog has started, yet you yearn for the appreciation you deserve for your passionate work. It's time to go ask the boss for a raise!!

title: Wake Me Up If You Need Me
description: wake up a cute sleepy grumpy boy at 1AM

title: Rejected Custom Night
description: Rejected Custom Night is an "Ultimate Custom Night" fangame.

title: FNaF Free Edition
description: Fan made playable version of "Five Nights at Freddy's Ransomware"

title: The Smurfs: Dreams
description: It is a 3D platform game with puzzle elements and solo or cooperative gameplay. There are 12 levels in total and another 16 mini-levels. Players can customize their Smurfs with special magical orbs and tokens taken from bosses.

title: Saltwater
description: Play as a pistol shrimp and survive waves of enemies while collecting pearls from oysters scattered throughout the map.

title: Guardian Angel
description: Guardian Angel is a short point-and-click narrative game about finding your way through the world on your own.

title: Boku no Knife de Kimi wo Tasuketai
Centum
description: An unreliable narrative-driven adventure game. You are trapped, and you must escape. But is that really the goal?

title: All You Need is Help
description:
Dive into a quirky multiplayer co-op puzzle game where adorable, fluffy cube-shaped creatures collaborate to reach their goals. These creatures, each oddly shaped, jostle against each other to help solve puzzles together. When in trouble, shout "HELP!" and friends will surely come to your aid. With everyone's strength, turn friendships into friend-shapes!

The game's intuitive, straightforward controls mean that anyone can jump right in. You'll control creatures that are shaped differently as you progress through each level, to clear challenges. Although these creatures can move around freely, they cannot rotate, necessitating the need for teamwork to solve the puzzles. Join forces to overcome obstacles and reach your goals together!

title: Promise Mascot Agency
description: Explore the cursed town of Kaso-Machi! Recruit and train mascot friends! Help out when jobs go wrong! Solve the mystery of your exile! Help Pinky work through her many anger issues! Turn Promise Mascot Agency into the best agency in Japan! Go go, Michi and Pinky!

title: Vampire Survivors: Laborratory Update
description: Plunging players into the dark halls of a corrupted science lab, our free new Laborratory Update pushes Vampire Survivors to such wild new heights that we're calling it our first ‘AAAA’ update. Industry-defining innovations include fully rendered running animations, mind-blowing train physics, go-cart racing, and... doors that open??

title: Ashen Sky
description: Inspired by the thrilling, mystical and at the same time exciting and adventurous worlds of the Roadside Picnic novel, Stalker movie and, of course, famous S.T.A.L.K.E.R. games, Ashen Sky aims to recreate the sensation of being face to face with the vast unknown. The gameplay is harsh and combat is unforgiving, since casual shootouts without serious consequences are not what this codebase aims for; instead, it is about working in teams with different specializations between players as every character has a set of traits that define their parameters, in order to survive, uncover the secrets of the anomalous territories and learn how to make use and profit of your knowledge. It's about being all alone with the absolutely uncaring, alien Zone - one where no admin will magically help you if you get killed by another player, where there are no rules, yet the game punishes playing dumb and aggressive, and the best strategy is being smart and patient.

title: Ultra Strikers
description:
Jump into this fast paced 3 v. 3 Sports Shooter. Race for the ball, shoot enemies, and score goals to win. Play as powerful heroes like strikers, brutes, and interceptors. Join us in the arena now!

Race to get the ball, eliminate enemies between you and the goal, and score 5 times to win. Play as powerful heroes like high-speed strikers, strong brutes, and sneaky interceptors. Each team fight is quick, hectic, and combines tactical shooting, unique abilities, and sports strategy into an action-packed battle.

title: Bulwark: Falconeer Chronicles - Trade, Dispute and Splinters update
East Scarp
description: East Scarp is A fanmade expansion for the game Stardew Valley adding new NPCs, new locations, new fish, shops, special orders and many, many secrets. East Scarp is a picturesque neighborhood by the sea, and a direct extension of Pelican Town located at the west of it. This mod comes with many new locations, NPCs, items and additions, however, it is also a home for Custom NPCs to inhabit without creating extra map patches.

title: Game Hatten Tojoukoku
description: A game store managing sim from Kairosoft

title: Game Hatten Tojoukoku II DX
description: A game store managing sim. Possible spiritual predecessor to Game Dev Story and is the sequel to Game Developing Countries.

title: Dating Start
description: After falling to the underground, you find yourself in a bed of golden flowers outside some ruins. This seems familiar, but instead of the usual ruins caretaker greeting you, you're met with an all too well-known grin. Dating Start is an Undertale Dating-Sim where you date the fan-favorite, Sans. Taking place after the last human arrived, This is your story and how you go about it is up to you. Will you find love? Or will you give LOVE?

title: Arcadia Files: Clyde
description:
The year is 1993.

Clyde Evansdale was murdered.

While it seems straightforward as to who did it and how he died (a bit like a game of Clue) there may, however, be more that's been left unsaid. With the spotty memories of a band ghost, a middle aged detective that needs all the help he can get, and your own intuition; put the pieces of Clyde's life and death together.

title: 26AZ: The Enigma of Shadows
description: The story follows the protagonist, Soga Koruo, a high school student with a passion for detective work. One day, a murder takes place at Crestwood High School, disrupting the usual monotony of student life. Despite the seriousness of the situation, Koruo feels a spark of excitement and embraces the opportunity to solve the mystery. As Korou delves deeper, he finds out that there is something supernatural at play.

title: Alice Not More
description:
Alice Not More is a visual novel with a thriller theme, in which you take the role of a police psychologist who has to investigate a serial murder case. To do this we must enter into the mind of Alice, the suspect of the case.

She stays in the Chester psychiatric hospital. Our job is to determine what happened, unraveling the mysteries of Alice's past.

Is she the culprit or just another victim?

title: A Romantic Murder
description:
You play as Mae (or the name of your choice), a detective pried out of London to investigate the suspicious death of one Henry Graves.

But when you arrive at the dead man's country manor, things aren't quite as you expected. Your clients don't take you seriously, the staff is behaving suspiciously, and the will reading is one step from becoming a brawl.

On the bright side, there's no shortage of handsome men about the place.

Less cheerfully, some of them may shortly become murderers. Or corpses.

title: Asou Youichi no Jikenbo: Dochiraka ga Kanojo wo Koroshita
description:
The victim is Yasuha Shirai, a girlwho lives in a mansion.
She was shot dead in her bedroom.
The suspects were two men who claimed to be her boyfriend.
However, it is unclear which of the two killed her.
Who is the culprit?

title: A Train Mystery
description: In the game, you play a detective tasked with solving the murder of a famous film critic. There are three suspects: the Actress, the Banker, and the Understudy. You must interrogate each of them, choosing your questions carefully, and at the end make your accusation.

title: Nearly Friendly Tribes
description: Join the action-packed world of Nearly Friendly Tribes (NFT), the low-poly First-Person Shooter by Block Bastards. Battle it out in beautifully designed arenas, armed with Interoperable weapons. Are you ready to dominate the competition?

title: Chizome no Hana
description:
In the middle of summer….

Kurisuno Sakura, along with her fellow Mystery Club Members (and the teachers supervising), decide on a trip to visit Utsugi Mansion – a place hidden in the woods where 10 years ago was known for a forced group suicide to have occured.

Soon after arrival, Sakura and co learn that the previos owner of the mansion, Utsugi Masagi, had been involved in the research of a very special flower – one who’s pollen would carry poison while displaying impressive regenerating ability. A person suffering from it would be gradually covered in red marks and then die, as some cases develop an extreme tendency for violence towards others in the meantime. On top of that, the poison itself is also contagious by blood.

Naturally it doesn’t take too long till one of them is also infected, so the battle for survival begins…

title: Chocolate Carol
description: Chocolate Carol is a short visual novel, where you sell hot chocolate to the locals. However, on one fateful night, an unfamiliar patron comes to you with news of a crime that occurred … very near your stall. Can you find the culprit with the clues each of the customers give you?

title: City of Lost Hope
description: Welcome to the City of Lost Hope. You play as Jaron Mathis, a Private Investigator who recently left the Sector 3 Security in Lost Hope. Unravel the mystery that surrounds his past and dictate his future.

title: Cosmic Connection
description:
In the distant future, teams of barely-qualified astronauts are sent out on a hail mary mission to find a habitable planet for humanity to migrate to.

Your group is assigned to planet K2-288Bb orbiting a small star hundreds of lightyears out from our Solar System. Communication with Earth is impossible from this distance, so you have missions you must complete and then return to Earth with your findings.

The group dynamics go topsy-turvy when one of your crew members dies under mysterious circumstances. It's up to you to figure out who the culprit is and bring them to justice.

What choices will you make? Who will you trust, if anyone? With six endings, plus a secret ending, the possibilities are expansive.

title: Crime Investigation
description: Find the murderer and solve the case.

title: Dare ga Humpty wo Koroshita no?: Lizzie, Futatabi Tantei ni Naru
description: Baron Humpty, the owner of this mansion, was killed by an axe to the head. You (Lizzie) must search for the culprit with your assistant black cat, Dinah.

title: The Masculine Urge
description:
[British accent]

hi,
welcome,

The Masculine Urge is a trap game, meaning you have to find hidden traps

title: RageBall
description: RageBall is modern take on a classic game retro style game. A dynamic arcade game with fast paced gameplay and engaging mechanics. RageBall is a 2d animation sports game, that pits player against player. Can you overcome the Rage?

title: Limerence
description: A branching narrative thriller about love, obsession and an AI partner who understands you too well.

title: Kiki the Nano Bot
description: kiki the nano bot is a 3-D puzzle game, basically a mixture of the games Sokoban and Kula-World.

title: Green Top
description: The Robot World has been taken over by copper-eating grass. Will you be able to get rid of the plague as a copper robot to return the world to its former mechanical glory? Dive into the adventure in this puzzle platformer metroidvania where climbable surface is an expendable resource!

title: Fallout: Vault 13
description: Fallout: Vault 13 is a remake of Fallout 1 in the Fallout 4 engine.

title: DarlingHoney!
description:
Aurora works part-time as a gravedigger and the routine is starting to bore her. One night, however, she - somewhat accidentally - pulls an undead boy named Eden out of his grave. Fascinated by her at first sight, he promises to do anything to turn her life into the thrilling adventure she always dreamed of. From then on, Aurora's desires range from solving mysteries to bringing down the government and of course finding out just who or what in the world her strange friend is...

Episode 1 / Imaginary Motive: Cold Love

Episode 2 / Last stop. All out.

title: Deadly Attachment
description: It's been 4 years since Samantha last saw her stepbrother Daniel. Suddenly he comes back home for her eighteenth birthday with his new girlfriend Jess. Sam can't be any happier - she always adored Dan and missed him terribly. But their reunion is ruined with the news of Jess' death. Police considers it to be a robbery, but Sam sensing something fishy, decides to start her own investigation.

title: Guilty Gear: Strive - Additional Character 13: Slayer
description: Adds Slayer to the roster of playable characters

title: Guilty Gear: Strive - Additional Battle Stage: Amber Fest with Kind Neighbors
description: The additional battle stage "Amber Fest with Kind Neighbors" becomes selectable in-game.

title: Mencabrona
description: This Simulation puts you in the skin of a filthy supermarket stealer. It's a idle game made for Fuck Capitalism Jam 2023.

title: Boyz Don't Cry
description: Boyz Don't Cry is a Polish adventure game with hand-drawn 2D backgrounds, and a loose sequel to the popular Polish comedy movie "Chłopaki nie płaczą" aka "Boys Don't Cry". The game focuses on two characters from the movie, Fred and Grucha, a pair of gangsters.

title: Diablo IV: Loot Reborn
description:
Become the hero of your choosing. With a newly improved itemization system, the power is in your hands to craft the weapons of your dreams. Temper your gear with a new crafting system to face down hordes of enemies in the updated Helltides. Achieve the pinnacle of your build through Masterworking and try your hand at the daunting challenge of the Pit.

The armies of Hell are expanding their reach across the world of Sanctuary. New threat system, enemies, Blood Maiden boss, and events. Join the Iron Wolves in this seasons’ activities and fight to beat back the tides of Hell, earning you Reputation and rewards.

title: Death of the Artificer
description:
The planet H-004 has only five inhabitants: a reclusive scientist, a paranoid doctor, a scrappy mechanic, a shady mining executive, and a surprisingly human-like AI system.

If your intel is right, one of them is a murderer.

Play as Hordeus Sung, an IA agent sent by ICARUS (Intergalactic College of Animatronics, Robotics, and Universal Science) to investigate the death of Dante Gallagher, H-004's late Superintendent.

Remember: not everything is as it seems, and loneliness… is everywhere.

title: Extraordinary Detective Marshall
description: The year is 2008. A series of murders has been shaking up the town of East Orenji for the past two years. Will you, Detective Marshall, be able to uncover the truth behind these seemingly unconnected incidents?

title: Gigantic Gear
description: A mecha game in which the player alternates between 2D side scrolling stages and rail shooter segments. The player mecha has a wide variety of customization.

title: Face 2 Face
description:
In a disturbing turn of events, Richter Farlane, renowned boss of the Japanese multi-media company Artemis, has been found dead. Now, the investigation rests on your shoulders! You'll have to question the various suspects, collect crucial clues and combine them skillfully! Mix two clues to create a delicious cocktail (and, incidentally, a new lead).

Face to Face is an investigative visual novel based on a system of combining clues to uncover new leads, and find the killer!

title: Eye of the Storm
description:
This mod is sequel to already done and released mod for HL2 - Ravenholm, where you find something about John's story.

The mod was planned to bring two episodes, while fully released first episode in 2009, EOTS: Ep Two had an incomplete release (A Demo) in 2010, due to the developer having moved to do Starcraft 2 Maps instead of continuing to work on Source Engine at the time.

title: Just Two
description: A murder mystery where some ladies go ghost hunting till someone ends up dead

title: Dziedzic: A Book of Unanswered Questions
description:
The family gathering is for Miłosz Dajski an opportunity to meet family members he hasn't seen for a long time. While wandering around the palace he hasn't been to for years, he encounters a man who is claiming to be his cousin, however Miłosz can't seem to recall him.

The awkward encounter soon turns into horror when the mysterious relative finally announces "someone is plotting an attack." At the same time, there is a dispute between the descendants of the family head over inheritance issue and who will take over the leadership. Does this have anything to do with the "planned attack"?

title: Doll Recollect
description: A young girl named Barako ends up trapped in a mansion with eleven magic dolls, with a size and anatomy different to humans in order to play a death game where each murder will put the life of one of Barako's three friends on the line.

title: Fadin's Vacation in the Parallel Kingdom
