description: Fadin's Vacation in the Parallel Kingdom is a 2D action-platformer that combines elements of Shoot 'em up, Beat'em up, and Metroidvania to challenge players. Explore the parallel realm with Fadin and embark on exciting adventures while facing formidable enemies and uncovering hidden secrets.

title: Kona Project
description:
When she suddenly found herself in an unknown hospital ward, she couldn't remember even her name. She didn't remember her name, how she got there, and most importantly - who she was. In her memory, there was only a field overgrown with equally white flowers, and calm, tired voice... A locked door haven't given any hope for escape - from that crushing emptiness around, from that emptiness in her heart.
But once she will hear her name from that stranger, she will never be able to forget...

title: Cubin
description: Cubin is a first-person platform puzzle game that immerses you in the LGA experience. Complete 60 experiments to discover the truth about this simulation.

title: Game with Friends
description: It's a virtual hangout game that aims to bring you together with your friends and have a good time. This platform promises to give you unforgettable moments by combining the fun competition of board games, the excitement of arcade-style racing and the different experiences offered by various games and entertainment.

title: MapleStory Mayple Island
description: Happy 19th anniversary, MapleStory! Explore the numerous events, mini-games, and shops filled with one-of-a-kind goodies at Mayple Island. Experience the adorable new class, Forest Child Lynn, and her versatile kit that will be influential in any party environment. Play through the newly revamped [Hieizan] Theme Dungeon with quality of life and balance improvements. Organize your outfits and decorate all your characters with the return of the Cash Shop Transfer event. Create a Zero character at any time of the year now that Zero creation is no longer limited to specific seasons!

title: Aliens: Redacted
description: Aliens: Redacted is a fan-made retro-style 2.5D shooter set in the Alien universe in the year 2171. You take on the role of Sgt. Braun Rodriguez, a mercenary for the Weyland-Yutani Corporation, tasked with investigating a distress call from the prison transport USS Boethiah crash-landed on LV-059, a planet suspected of Xenomorph activity.

title: Condemned
description: Condemned is a small Heretic episode designed explicitly for ZDoom. There are 6 normal levels, 1 atmospheric interlude level, and 1 secret level.

title: Die Rowdy
description: Die Rowdy is a 44 map megawad created as the thirty-third edition of the Pineapple Under the Sea Speedmapping series in December of 2023. Loosely Christmas themed and highly Die Hard themed, each map was made with a skyscraper prefab and an elevator, courtesy of ViolentBeetle's Hellavator, of which players will be required to find a red keycard in order to advance to the next floor.

title: Endoom Mapping Contest 2024
description:
The ENDOOM Mapping Contest 2024 was an event organized by endoomer, the member of LegacyZ and the Russian Doom Community, on Doom Power forum. The task was to create a brand new level in a decent period of two months on a favorite theme, using any suitable resources, formats (from the list) and source ports. The map creation period lasted from January 3, 2024 to March 3, 2024.

All maps were divided into two independent groups corresponding to their formats.
Classic group: Vanilla, Limit-removing, Boom, MBF21.
Modern group: ZDoom, GZDoom, Eternity, Zandronum.

title: Evil Returns
description: Evil Returns is a 32-map megawad. There ﻿are various styles of maps including various themes such as easy maps, small, medium & large maps, puzzle maps, a couple joke maps, slaughter style, high-contrast, hell-themed, tech base, and even a hotel-themed map.

title: Lineal Distancing
description: Lineal Distancing is a community project with the gimmick of for ﻿each 1024x1024 block from the origin, no more than 64 linedefs can be placed.

title: Maiden Voyage
description: For some, a maiden voyage may end in disaster...A 32 Map Limit Removing Megawad designed for pistol starting.

title: The North
description: A PS1 style exploration game. Talk to NPCs and try to solve a murder onboard an arctic icebreaker ship trapped in the ice. You play as Doctor David Barclay, the ship's surgeon and the one man above suspicion. Interact with the crew to get clues but beware, you are not a well liked or respected member of the HMS Ectorius.

title: Goodnight Universe
description: You are Isaac, a 6-month-old baby, developing mysterious psychic powers. What you want most is to be loved and accepted by your family, but a secretive tech corporation wants you for their own.

title: Oneiro Man
description: Oneiro Man is a 30-minute game aiming to be fun and humorous. In it, you'll have to write reports and play various mini-games. The game features 3 different endings, depending on your performance at work.

title: Idle Colony
description: A condensed incremental experience, where you build a colony to collect and merge bigger and bigger fruits. Combine game-changing technologies and special upgrades to find the best synergies and take your cash flow to another dimension.

title: A Faerie's Tale
description: A Faerie's Tale is a light-hearted and playful fantasy story about accepting change and finding a new home.

title: Akiko Gold: The Queen of Adult
Alice no Yakata 3
description:
A collection of five mini-games with Alice from the Rance series.
The first two games in this series were only available on Japanese computers. It includes a quiz game "TokuSakari quiz Rerorero", fighting Prince Patton, a female teacher in agony hell visual novel with two endings - one good and a darker one

title: Amy to Yobanaide
description:
Amy to Yobanaide follows the story of a high school girl named Emi who has fallen in love with her younger step-brother, Tomomi. On her eighteenth birthday, she decides to confess her feelings to him. However, their lives take an unexpected turn when debt collectors seize all of her father's possessions, and Tomomi mysteriously disappears. Determined to find him and share her feelings, Emi takes on a quest to locate her step-brother.

As she searches for Tomomi, Emi discovers an alternate personality within herself named Amy. While Emi is shy and modest, Amy is driven by a desire to fulfill her deepest fantasies.

title: Arabesque: Shoujo-tachi no Orinasu Ai no Monogatari
Qusha
description:
In "Exorcism", a game in the style of Vampire Survivors, you gain experience and currency to strengthen your magical abilities and attributes by slaying massive amounts of demons with your ever increasing magical powers.
It is a course example for an indie game creator class launched by Lao V and Mo Hua and therefore is not particularly long, but free to experience for everyone.

title: Perimeter: Legate Edition
description: Perimeter is a real-time strategy game with a destructible world. Utilize the environment for resource gathering and defense against enemies. Immerse yourself in the millennia-spanning history of the Chains of Worlds and lead a faction in the struggle for survival.

title: A Matching Game
description: This is a simple, single player game of selecting two cards and trying to find more matches than your opponent. The further you get into the levels, the more difficult the opponent gets.

title: The Sleeping Sickness
description:
The Sleeping Sickness is an interactive short story that allows the player to guide the main character's actions.

Each day, the player chooses where Grayson investigates. The player’s choices will lock and unlock future locations, change dialogue, and alter the story. Choices matter in The Sleeping Sickness.

While The Sleeping Sickness includes sounds, graphics, and interactive sections, it focuses on the story.

The game is designed to play like a choose-your-own-adventure book and is an excellent choice for horror fans, avid readers, and lovers of creepy pastas.

title: Star Academy: Audition!
description: Play as either Lisa, Kyomi or Brittany, as you audition to become a student in the Jorvik's Performing Arts school

title: Darwin's Dilemma
description: Darwin's Dilemma is a puzzle video game originally for Classic Mac OS. It was developed by André Ouimet and published in 1990 by Inline Design. The goal is to match creatures together. After enough matches the creatures will "evolve" into new ones, and these new creatures must be again matched so they can evolve, and so on.

title: Hairy Trees Massacre
description:
When Lucy was 10 years old, she and her dad were attacked by a giant hairy humanoid while on a camping trip. Lucy managed to escape but her father was taken by the creature and he was never seen again.
20 years later, Lucy returns to the forest where her father was taken, in order to face her fears and get closure. Instead, she'll get a....

title: Baby's Town
description:
town of Baby
lazy baby game stitched together from photos and old assets + scribbles

title: Tower of Minak
description: A semi non-linear loopety loop map. Takes place in a tower in the sky that has a lot of books for some reason.

title: Grit Under the Eyelid
description: Grit Under the Eyelid is recycledoj's first solo release for Quake, for Arcane Dimensions 1.8 Patch 1. This is primarily single player focused, and makes some pretty extensive use of the jump boots for exploration, and includes a lot of platforming as a result.

title: Freyja's Demise
description: Quake map for Arcane Dimensions version 1.81

title: Ferric Oxide
description: A map for Copper 1.3 inspired by parts of E1M6 & Episode 3, and with trains.

title: Ruins of the Unforgotten Souls
description: Small medieval map for alkaline 1.2.2 with singleplayer, coop and deathmatch support.

title: BeHop Ranger And The Spicy Wizards
description: A remix of a remix of a remix in moonlight!

title: Gibtropolis
description: A relatively complex, somewhat non-linear city map.

title: Blessed Agony
description: Blood opens the way...

title: SM228: Vanilla
description: 18 maps + a start map using good old "vanilla" id progs and id textures!

title: Throne of Belial
description: This small debut Quake map offers an intense and immersive experience within a dark and ominous environment. Players will journey through a perilous dungeon teeming with lava, metal, and stone structures, along with eerie torch-lit corridors. The ominous glow of lava running along the border of the level and the subtle smoke enhance the atmosphere, casting haunting shadows across the desolate hallways.

title: Cogito Ergo Sum
description: You, your world, your vassals, and your domain are all the dream of gods from beyond the heavens. In the midst of these interlopers' visits you have woken up, and been cursed with the knowledge of the true nature of your reality.

title: Nola1
description: This Place is not Pure is Nolatron's first serious attempt at a Quake map.

title: Enforced Entropy
description: Spacebike's first quake map is a large but linear id1 tech base featuring a decent balance of both regular encounters and horde encounters. It has a high monster count and may be quite tough.

title: Witch Wrath
description: You come back to your house, but you don't find your spellbook where it should have been. Someone has stole it! And looks like you got some company too. Time for plan B: Guns.

title: Inamorata
description:
Ever wanted a hot vampire girlfriend, but you’re too asexual for your own good?

Play as Ronnie, the swoon-worthy, buff heroine of this comfy, cozy visual novel, and see if you can win over the stylish and beautiful Cece.

title: Neo Sonic Universe
description: Neo Sonic Universe is an action game developed and published by Alexandre Martins in 2003.

title: Sonic Universe 2
description:
Two months after Sonic, Tails, and Knuckles' adventure in Sonic Universe 1, Robotinik returns. He calls Shadow to help him, but Shadow doesn't accept because he lost badly two months ago...
Robotinik doesn't like it and leaves.
So Shadow turns good and tries to support Sonic & co. against Robotinik (again!!).
Now Robotinik is back stronger than ever! He takes the Master Emerald and leaves!
Help Sonic & Friends get the Master Emerald back!

title: Sonny Legacy Collection
description: Sonny 1 and Sonny 2, updated for modern hardware, team up in the Sonny Legacy Collection. Traverse a story-rich world where strategy meets supernatural in a quest for identity and survival. Master tactical turn-based combat and discover the truth behind Sonny's resurrection in these classic RPGs.

title: Women's School Simulator 2022
description: A school simulator game that reproduces a girls' school with cherry blossoms(sakura) on a small island like an anime.

title: Supercharge
description: Supercharge is a mapping resource and gameplay mod for GZDoom/Zandronum, with new and altered monsters and weapons, based on the creator's own wad Paradise. It upgrades weapons and monsters, normalizes damage ratings across the board, and has instant weapon switching that allows players to combo attacks together.

title: Marble Abduction! Patti Hattu
description: Marble Abduction! is a brand new kind of rolling experience. Hand-crafted levels, intuitive and customizable controls, the highest visual quality and reliable and robust physics make for a truly out-of-this-world marbling experience!

title: Tooi Tooi, Yakusoku: Tune of Memories
description: It’s been two months since Gen’s close friend Kotone passed away from sickness. All she left was a letter asking him to go treasure hunting together. Along with it was an old map. Since it is his final promise to her, he sets out on this journey to find something precious.

title: Sonic FGX
description: Its a Sonic Fan game created by Gamer Dee. Is a Side-Scroller Platformer based on the Sonic Advance series

title: Unconditional Fate's Season 1 Wrap Up!
description: A short game made to celebrate the completion of season 1 of the webcomic, Unconditional Fate, which is based on "The Little Mermaid" by Hans Christian Anderson. Season 1 Wrap Up reveals some untold stories of the characters that live within Unconditional Fate's universe. Made in RPG Maker the game features both puzzles and visual novel segments.

title: Sonic PC
description: Sonic PC is a fan game developed and released by Physik Multimedia in 1998, packed in with Sonic Klik & Play Collection. The game is currently only available in Sonic Klik & Play Collection, as the original game has yet to be found. It uses 32-bit conversion images of sprites from Sonic the Hedgehog CD and Sonic the Hedgehog 2, instead of the original 16-bit sprites.

title: Disney Dreamlight Valley: Thrills & Frills
description: The 10th free update for Dreamlight Valley brings Daisy Duck to the Valley, the new building Boutique to expand the Magic of Touch feature, the A Day At Disney Star Path, new features on Valley Visits and new items (and a new interface) on the Premium Shop.

title: Eyeless Jack
description: Your house was foreclosed, so you moved in with your brother, whom you hadn't seen for 10 years. Everything seems fine at first, but soon enough, you'll find yourself in a traumatic experience.

title: Raccoon Out
description: Tired of getting you food stolen by raccoons? No more! In this cozy and wholesome game, you can defend yourself against those raccoons.

title: Vampire+Hunter
description: A micro visual novel about a wounded vampire hunter, who's trying to kill his elusive target.

title: The Legend of the Astera Stone
description: A mage and a vampire hunter team up to retrieve a stolen artifact from a cunning vampire's castle.

title: Stonemachia
description: Stonemachia is an adventure in which you can fight and explore a world distorted by the Plague of angels, taking on the role of Zefiro, a pawn capable of transforming into other chess pieces. Venture into the lands of Medhelan and prepare to face armies of angels transformed into statues and objects inspired by Italian art, architecture, and folklore! Fight with a variety of abilities and precise timing in a parry-centric game, where the shield can truly change the outcome of every encounter! Discover the various transformations and their unique abilities to experience a Dantesque epic and uncover the secret of the chess pieces...

title: Running Late
description:
You're late to school! Run, slide, leap, and kick your way through the city in this action-packed platformer to reach your school on time.

Play as Ayumi, a Japanese high school student whose tardiness gives her superhuman powers. Climb up the sides of buildings, jump great heights, and do everything in your power to get to school before you're RUNNING LATE!

title: 100 Minutes of /vr/
description: 100 Minutes of /vr/ is a fourteen-map communal episode replacement for Doom II designed for Boom-compatible source ports by various members of 4chan's retro videogames board. All maps were speedmapped within a 100 minute time-frame. The project was released on December 26th, 2018. It is the third installment of the Minutes of /vr/ speedmapping series and the first installment to be made for Boom-compatible source ports, with previous installments being vanilla compatible.

title: Wizard Wars
description: Wizard Wars is a Half-Life mod that pits teams of spell flinging wizards head to head in a magical maelstrom! Wizard Wars lets you choose from nine different sorcerers, each with varying strengths and special abilities, to battle other mages in a variety of settings and objectives.

title: Where Winter Crows Go
description: Would you risk living together with a stranger in an isolated cabin to avoid the freezing cold?

title: Gyakuten Touhou
description: Gyakuten Touhou is a visual novel & adventure style game based on the Gyakuten Saiban/Ace Attorney series. The player assumes the role of Aya Shameimaru as a defense attorney as she proves her clients not guilty using investigation, evidence, and cross-examination.

title: Gyakuten Touhou 3
description: Sequel of the Ace Attorney parody game Gyakuten Touhou with 5 new cases.

title: Gyakuten Touhou: Zoukan Gou
description: A side-game from Suicaya-san's series of Ace Attorney-like games, Gyakuten Touhou.

title: Gyakuten Touhousai
description: A side-game from Suicaya-san's series of Ace Attorney-like games, Gyakuten Touhou.

title: Planetaries
description: A sci-fi open world survival adventure. Set in a time when humanity has expanded its reach beyond the confines of Earth, immerse yourself in a rich galaxy. Craft, build, mine, trade, explore, and fight your way through a universe brimming with endless possibilities.

title: Rogue Light Deck Builder
description:
Rogue Light Deck Builder is a digital wooden board game.

Your house needs a deck. You have a hammer. You have wood and you have nails. The light outside is faulty. You work, you earn. Freedom is $1,000,000.

Build a deck. Use your hammer. Drive the nails in. Scrimp and save. Freedom is just around the corner.

title: Strange Toilet: The Forgotten Shit
description: In the quiet neighborhood where Nathan and Sarah live, there is an ominous presence. A potential threat from a murderer on the loose. The residents did not expect that on this peaceful evening, they would be confronted with a grim reality they never anticipated

title: Squishy Pastries
description: The goal of Squishy Pastries is to get as high of a score as possible by combining pastries of the same type. The larger the pastry, the more points for combining it. Each of the pastries is a soft body, so they are squishy. If any of the pastries leave the wooden box for more than 5 seconds, the game is over!

title: Mega Man: The Rulers of Space
description: A fan-made 16-bit SUPER remake of the GameBoy "Mega Man V" (aka Rockman World 5).

title: Casa dos Ossos
description:
In a not too distant future...

Robin Chavez is an astronaut on a mission. She is tasked with mapping and cataloging the planets of a newly discovered galaxy, a fact that has shaken life on Earth. To tell you the truth, her mission has been a success. There's only one planet left, named TauCeti-75.

..but not everything works out. As it approaches the planet, Robin's ship short circuits and slowly loses power, until crash-landing on the unknown planet. With her ship out of operation, Robin finds herself alone with Nieborg, her little robot helper. What will she do now? Well, find out playing the game!

title: Maeve's Academy
description: Maeve's Academy is a sandbox-style visual novel game in which players assume the role of the the first man to step into the magical realm, attending H.G. Academy alongside his childhood best friend.

title: Hart's Toil
description:
Hart's Toil is a puzzle-adventure game inspired by the cruel game design of La Mulana and NES games. Solve 2-4 hours worth of puzzles and collect items that will allow you to solve more puzzles. Defeat the witches of the underground to gain the materials needed for a ritual that will let you escape hell.

The mechanics of the game are simple. You can move in 4 directions, interact with things in front of you, and use items in your bag. The environment and roaming creatures can damage you, and you will die if your HP reaches zero. Some items may require MP to function, specially items used to kill enemies.

The puzzles are mean and intentionally obscure. It is recommended that you play along with a friend sitting by your side and solve the puzzles together.

title: Across the Abyss: Voidborn
description: Enemies are your best weapon in this mix of Vampire Survivor and Hades! Slash and throw probes at bio-engineered foes, while meeting quirky characters and wielding elemental powers against an evil galactic mega corp. Get stronger, go further, and conquer the chaos!

title: TriMatch
description: TriMatch, the addicting puzzle challenge where you must match colorful triangles to score big and conquer each level! Strategize and align triangles based on their colored sides to rack up points and unlock the next level. Dive into the world of TriMatch for an addictive and brain-teasing experience that will keep you coming back for more!

title: Dark Discoveries
description: In this chilling horror experience, immerse yourself in the eerie confines of a desolate house consumed by anomalies set loose by a devastating virus. Equipped with only a camera and flashlight, your sole objective is to document evidence of these sinister aberrations while navigating the looming threat of their lethal grasp. Prepare for spine-tingling encounters around every corner, where each photograph captured could mark your demise. Will you unravel the origins of the virus before succumbing to its sinister machinations, or will you become yet another casualty swallowed by the abyss? This game combines elements of horror and puzzle-solving, promising a gripping and immersive journey into darkness.

title: Second-Loop
description: Second-Loop is a single-player FPS action game with sandbox physics puzzle solving, — you're the robot pilot in the heart of a futuristic dystopian world. Control your mech in intense combat, and use your ability to manipulate gravity + assemble mechanical parts to solve physics puzzles.

title: Life Simulator 2017
description:
LS2k17 is a historical game in which you are propelled into the France of a very distant era, in 2017.

Thanks to its super-powerful game engine and breathtaking graphics, you'll enjoy a unique, breathtaking experience.

In this ultra-realistic simulator, you'll be free to do absolutely anything you want. You can relax, work or even save the world! LS2k17 is your new life.

(Warning: the game is played entirely in the Windows console and may require Internet Explorer or something similar)

title: Sundy Stairway
description: Join Sunday, a 14-year-old boy who moves with his family to Calendar Town, where mysterious deaths and suicide cases seem to occur. Tragedy will come when one of his relatives is found dead in his home. Help Sunday to discover the mysteries of this town in this visual novel rpg with dreamcore and aesthetic style.

title: Kindergarten 3
description: Kindergarten 3 is the long awaited threequel to the Kindergarten series! Explore a new school with old and new friends...and new ways to get ruthlessly murdered.

title: Yowie
description: You just crashed your car in the remote Australian wilderness. You are injured and being stalked by a murderous Yowie. Will you escape with your life or fall like so many before you to the monster?

title: Shrouded Space
description: After ten long years of solitary confinement on the Empress Xyra's prison planet, you have just been summoned for a special work detail. Could this finally be the opportunity you have been looking for to escape and put all this behind you?

title: Suboptimal
description: Suboptimal is a small horror Point & Click adventure game where you must escape the submarine you are commanding, one way or another...

title: Frontier Fugitive
description:
America, 1876, you are the infamous gunslinger Ben Blake, somewhere in the wild west.

You escaped the shootout at Bodie after killing the towns crime boss and now you're on the run from both outlaws and the law alike. Can you loot, shoot, escape and triumph against all odds to become the perfect Frontier Fugitive?

title: Deme Game
description: A fangame made for a twitch streamer and vtuber deme. Currently in early development since February 2023.

title: Gulliver in the Land of Giants
description:
Gulliver in the Land of Giants is a Russian educational game based on the second part of Jonathan Swift's satirical masterpiece best known as "Gulliver's Travels".

The game contains several modes:
- Animated audio book.
- Game (Boy or Girl), 2 different kind of games depending on which gender chosen.
- English lessons for digits or colors.
- Painting book.
- Audio drama, which is the same as animated audio book but with no visuals.

title: Supra Mayro Kratt
description: werid raceing game

title: Mach K9
description: A physics, wave based roguelite where you smash aliens out of arena to defeat them and choose upgrades between waves.

title: Nitro Street Run 2
description: Nitro Street Run is back and bigger than ever! Relive your most exciting moments in all-new modes: Classic Race-Takedown-Escape the Cops-and Duels. The game is enhanced even more by a new upgrade system and totally revamped graphics. This is the sequel you've been waiting for!

title: Prison Loop
description: Embark on a journey of anomalies and repetition in "Prison Loop," a captivating indie puzzle game. Trapped in a mysterious temporal loop within a high-security prison, your objective is to observe anomalies throughout the environment.

title: After Doom
description: "After Doom" takes place between Doom II: Hell on Earth and Doom 64,

title: Rivals of Aether: Speedrunner Mario
description: A mod which adds Speedrunner Mario from the Something About series by TerminalMontage to Rivals of Aether.

title: Rivals of Aether: 100% Accurate Fox
description: A mod which adds 100% Accurate Fox (aka Melee Fox) from the Something About series by TerminalMontage to Rivals of Aether.

title: Biocatalyst
description: Biocatalyst is a short horror visual novel set in the late 1990s with a PC-98 aesthetic.

title: Prey at the Altar
description:
You are the chosen lamb of the Church of the Hound, a sacrifice to summon an ancient god to cleanse this earth of its sins. It's an honor!

You want this. You want this very badly. Everyone wants this for you. The Church, its people, its god. So the choice is obvious.

You are the lamb. Prepare yourself for slaughter.

title: The Primrose Path
description: A piece of Interactive Fiction written by Nolan Bonvouloir.

title: Pine: A Story of Loss
description: Alone in the forest glade he shared with his wife, a woodworker struggles to accept her passing. Help him hold on to cherished memories of their life together as he struggles to care for himself and his now empty home. Pine is a single-serving game focused on telling a beautiful, emotional tale.

title: Sanae's Sylphid Breeze
description:
This is a remake of the old version.

Sanae has Kirby's signature method of dispatching enemies by using the ability of inhaling with extreme power. By pressing X button repeatedly, Sanae is able to fly for as long as she likes to reach higher platforms or to find secret item locations.

title: Flowers of Asphodel
description: The Doors of the Great Library rarely open-- to let anyone in, or out.

title: Marvel First Alliance
description:
A fan-game made by a brazilian developer named "Zvitor" that launches Marvel First Alliance as an indie game created with the popular OpenBor engine. The game is a beat’em up inspired by the likes of Streets of Rage and Double Dragon and features a dream team that will certainly please any Marvel fan. But best of all, it features simultaneous four-player action in one computer!

All in all, Marvel First Alliance is one of the finest examples of the freeware fighting genre, offering dozens of characters that many players are sure to appreciate. "

title: Winch it Out
description: Tired of the same old Two-Button Gas-and-Go car games? This one's for you!

title: Tiny Garden
description:
Tiny Garden, build your own magical garden inside a 90s toy
Plant your vegetables and trade them for furniture to customize tiny gardens in this delightful mix of farming, puzzle and strategy

title: Globeba
description: Your magic tome has been stolen by the weather wizard Ogro! Use your summoning magic to plant helpful tubers and mandrakes to make your way through three handcrafted dungeons. Overcome foe after foe to retrieve what is rightfully yours and reunite with your floral friends!

title: Monuments of Mars 2
description: Monuments of Mars 2 is an eleven-level episode WAD for Doom II designed for limit removing source ports created by various members of the Doomer Boards community, led by Jon Vail (40oz). It is the forty-sixth entry in the ongoing Doomer Boards Projects. The project is an add-on sequel to the first DBP in celebration of the series' fourth anniversary. It is intended to be loaded with and continue from its predecessor and starts at MAP08.

title: Look Closer!
description: Look Closer! is a single-player horror surveillance game. Monitor haunted locations through cameras, spotting and reporting anomalies like moving objects and sudden intruders. Sharp observation skills are essential to survive the eerie challenges.

title: Kirakira Slimes
description: Kirakira slimes are adorable, chubby and defenseless creatures. They're vulnerable to most of the world's perils by themselves, but together they’re unbeatable. Fuse, combine and power up your slimes in this indie puzzle game, either by playing in local versus or all by yourself!

title: Awful Kidnapper
description:
In Awful Kidnapper, you play as a horror fan, living deep in the woods. One day you decide to kidnap someone to make your dark desires come true.

But, guess what - It's not that easy to keep someone hostage!

Your victims are weirder than you'd think!

title: Roped In
description: An (optional) NSFW wild west love story between you and your lifelong cowboy best friend.

title: It Lives Within
description: You're finally ready to leave your past behind and move on. But apparently, moving on means enrolling at a community college in a supernatural town overflowing with monsters and dark magic...

title: JumpStart Math for Kindergarteners
description: JumpStart Math for Kindergartners is a game released in 1999 that teaches kindergarten math skills. Hopsalot helps the residents of CloudTown prepare a surprise birthday party for the giant Guthry.

title: Combat Jam 1
description: Mappers were given 48 hours to make a combat focused level. No fancy textures. No lighting. No detailing. Just pure gameplay. It features multiple unique combat scenarios, a hub map and a boss fight.

title: Alea Lacta Est
description: A hybrid of ideas and gameplay mixed together in a brand-new campaign for Quake 2. Be warned though, it's a little biased towards the old school way of playing.

title: Space Station Proto Speedmap Jam
description: 1st Prototype Speedmapping Map Jam for the Quake 2 Remaster, focusing on an open ended "space station" theme, hosted by the Map-Center Discord server.

title: N64 SP Map Jam
description: The first ever Single Player Map Jam for the Quake 2 Re-Release, hosted by the Map-Center community. Featuring nine new maps in the N64 theme, a hub level, and a final boss, as well as custom pre-rendered cutscenes.

title: Capslock
description:
Capslock is a casual game focused on design and testing your imagination. Choose between 100 skins, 195+ custom keys, 220+ symbols and more (so far) to test your designs and make unique keyboards. Relax as you listen to the 'clicky' sounds, chosen to help you unwind and immerse into a keyboard building environment.

Start from scratch - solve the puzzle of dragging and dropping each key into its' slot to build out your keyboard, or dive straight into designing and auto-fill all your keys with the press of a button! You can edit one key at a time, or make changes to your whole board - we hope Capslock moves at a pace which suits you.

title: Countryballs At War
description: Immerse yourself in Countryballs at War, an extraordinary strategy game combining the strategic depth of turn-based mechanics with thrilling real-time combat. Published by SHN Games, you will take command of your armies, carefully manage tax rates, negotiate peace treaties, and even puppet weakened countries to establish your dominance on the global stage.

title: Tubedle
description: A webgame that lets you see how well you know your favorite youtubers

title: Depths of Despair
description: Welcome to Depths of Despair, a thrilling solo/multiplayer game where you must fight off waves of enemies to survive for a set amount of time. With each wave, the enemies become stronger and more challenging to defeat. Can you and your team hold out long enough?

title: Final Doomer
description:
Final Doomer (also known as Final Doomer+ after the update) is a gameplay mod featuring 9 weapon classes themed after official and community-made megawads. Barring the Doom 2-themed class, each set replaces the entire arsenal with new weapons that have altered functionality and stronger damage rates while still fitting into a vanilla template.

TNTguy's chaingun replacement is a pair of machine pistols that fire weaker bullets but at a splintering rate. The Ancient Aliens weaponset swaps the rocket launcher for the Photon Scepter, which fires a ball of light that explodes wider the farther it travels. The mod's simplicity combined with its creativity make it a very easy mod to use with mostly any wad.

title: Casino Simulator 2024
description: Casino Simulator: Build, manage, and expand your own casino from scratch. Hire staff, design your casino, and delight customers by offering the most popular games. Enjoy the thrill of the casino experience!

title: FoxCode
description: FoxCode is a casual, accessible shooter perfect for unwinding. With intuitive gameplay, it welcomes all skill levels to dynamic battles. Stands out for diverse maps, from urban to natural, ideal for light, thrilling entertainment.

title: Sonic Rumble Party
description: Ready, Set, Rumble! Join Sonic in this intense arcade royale game set in Dr. Eggman's diabolical Toy World. Collect legendary skins, all-new emotes, and build skills as you progress through this action-packed game! Mayhem is best with friends!

title: QuakeWorld
description: QuakeWorld is an official source port of Quake that enhances the game's multiplayer features with improved TCP/IP support and addition of client-side prediction.

title: SkateLab
description: A 100% physics-driven skateboarding sandbox. Experiment in a world with unconstrained physics, create spots, record clips, and skate online with your friends.

title: Apex Legends: Upheaval
description:
When Alter emerged from her dimension into another (with her past held close to the chest), she had only two things: her interdimensional traveling Void tech, and a desire to have fun. She stole the fanciest of foods, learned to fight through dicey situations, and took on odd jobs for personal favors–though she didn’t have a problem double-crossing her clients if it was more beneficial or amusing. Never needing to stick around for the consequences of her actions eroded any sense of morality or responsibility she had. She could focus on what was important: making sure life was never mundane.

Alter was drawn to worlds on the edge of complete destruction. Whether something devastating was already happening or she helped usher in the apocalypse herself, she was there to watch whatever catastrophe ensued. It was only in those moments, after all, that people took off the masks they always wore and she could see their true selves.

Finding these world-ending events was a toss up. Sometimes she’d find what she was looking for, and on others, she’d have missed the main event in worlds already ruined. But in some of these ruined worlds, Alter began to notice an interesting commonality…

Many of these worlds hadn’t met their end by some random event; they had been destroyed by the same person.

[Redacted]

title: Forgotten Skies
description: Discover the mysteries of Forgotten Skies, a fun platforming adventure where ancient secrets and hidden dangers await in this captivating adventure game. Forgotten Skies is a hilarious 3D Platform-Adventure developed and published by Chrysalis Interactive.

title: Gigantosaurus Dino Sports
description: On your marks for a roar-some sports party for one to four dinos. These eight chomp-sized games are enormous fun – but watch out for Giganto!

title: The Oregon Trail: Deluxe Edition
description:
The Oregon Trail Digital Deluxe bundle includes the full experience :
• "THE OREGON TRAIL" BASE GAME
• THE "COWBOYS AND CRITTERS" DLC

Physical additionally comes with:
- Reversible coversheet
- 3 Postcards

title: Celestia: Chain of Fate
description: A romance-fantasy visual novel that delivers a captivating player driven narrative. Enrol at Celestia Academy and uncover your heritage. Delve into a fantastical realm and unearth your magical potential as a hybrid. Forge new friendships and build affections based on your love interests.

title: Metaphor: ReFantazio - Collector's Edition
description:
Collector's Edition Includes:
Base Game
Steelbook
Soundtrack
Artbook
Homo Tenta Metallic Pins
Sticker Sheet
Kingdom of Euchronia Cloth Map
Costume & Battle BGM Set DLC Voucher
Shujin Academy School Uniform (7), Battle BGM & Battle Jingle Set
Yasogami High School Uniform (7), Battle BGM & Battle Jingle Set
Gekkoukan High School Uniform (7), Battle BGM & Battle Jingle Set

Samurai Garb (7), Battle BGM & Battle Jingle Set
Etrian Odyssey Series Classes Costume (7) & Battle BGM Set
Atlus 35th Anniversary Digital History Book + Soundtrack

5x Revival Medicines (Revives an ally)

title: Akimbot
description: In the action-adventure platformer, Akimbot, blast your way through armies of robots, pilot spaceships and forge your own path to save the universe from impending doom! Set in a sci-fi world where only robots exist, travel the galaxy and experience non-stop robot mayhem and explosive action!

title: Nerobi
description:
This indie game is a 2D scrolling platformer with several elements typical of a graphic adventure, featuring some cinematic sequences. It is all hand-drawn.
The gameplay is definitely challenging. It requires coordination and timing, and you have to use your wits. Different powers are unlocked as you go along, expanding the gameplay experience.
In addition, scattered around the world, there are several hidden cards to collect.

title: Wanderer's Guide to Ocean and Islands
description: Wanderer's Guide to Ocean and Islands is a game that combines elements of a walking simulator and a visual novel.

title: Clothing Store Simulator
description: Manage your own clothing store. Arrange displays and help your customers. Expand your store as your business grows!

title: Total War: Warhammer II - Rakarth
description:
Since taming the infamous black dragon Bracchus as a youth, Rakarth has long held a reputation as the most cruelly talented of Naggaroth’s Beastmasters. It is a claim none dispute, as he soars high over the battlefield on the mighty beast before diving into the fray in a murderous blur of talons and teeth.

Voiced by actor Iwan Rheon, Rakarth begins play on the Isle of Albion and leads the Thousand Maws faction. As he claims victory in battle and captures key settlements, new monsters of all kinds are added to his Beast Pens where they may be recruited into his armies.

title: Ninkyo Dantai
description: Ninkyo Dantai is a 3D top-down, role-playing video game developed by TeamCS1. It is the first mainline title in the Ninkyo Dantai franchise developed as a turn-based RPG.

title: Control Monger
description: Control Monger is a freeware team-based vehicular FPS.

title: Talon
description: Talon is a 6DoF multiplayer sci-fi flight combat game blending elements from FPS, flight sim, and space combat for adrenaline-fueled high-speed action in a team-based tactical shooter with colorful weapons and plentiful explosions. It became freeware on November 24th of 2023.

title: Veins Like Tapeworms
description: Who needs a moral compass when you have a god in the gutter?

title: FreeWorld
description: FreeWorld is a defunct MMORPG developed from 2002 to 2008.

title: Dark Roast Cafe
description: Summon demons to help you run your business, and work yourself to boost their performance. Decorate the interior, keep the place tidy and pick the best employees to fulfill your customers' needs!

title: Zwift
description: Where fitness meets adventure. There’s never a dull day of indoor training in the amazing worlds of Zwift. Explore endless roads and unlock your fitness goals.

title: Senran Kagura: Peach Beach Splash - Sexy Soaker Edition
description: The digital "Sexy Soaker" edition includes the same DLC pack as the physical LE containing the Soaking Wet High School Uniform costume, a set of colorful bikini costumes, the Futomaki Roll Bazooka special weapon, a Bebeby pet card, and a special set of skill cards, and a downloadable soundtrack containing the same 47 music tracks included in the soundtrack CD of the physical version.

title: Crawlspace Multiplayer
description: A nightmarish playground awaits beneath the floorboards. Join forces with your friends to conquer the crawlspace and retrieve the baby dolls that are trapped in its depths. But watch your back... killer dolls thirst for your fear. In this suffocating battle for survival, teamwork is your only lifeline. Can you mend the ventilation system and escape, or will the crawlspace become your eternal tomb?

title: One Hell of a Maid
description:
'One Hell of a Maid' is a short game, where you play as a maid cleaning one's apartment.

Submission to Ludum Dare 55.

title: LocoSoccer 2
description: LOCOSOCCER 2 is a crazy fast-paced physics-based casual football game that you can play everywhere with anybody or against anybody.

title: Without a Voice: Blooming Edition
description: DLC for Without a Voice that builds upon a free April 2024 update with full voice acting, an extra full completion bonus, and unlockable achievements. The DLC includes: four new epilogues, two new illustrations, and a built-in artbook viewer.

title: Hell's On Hold
description:
Become The No. 1 Summoner Support in Hell!

Hell's On Hold is a short (yet technically endless) game.

Take calls from disgruntled demons as you try and fix their summoning rituals! Use the book generously provided to you by our partners at SCRYN to assist demons put together their summoning rituals.

Try to beat your friends, or to earn your keep to stay another week in hell.*

*NOTE: You are not paid for your time as a Summoning Support Employee

**NOTE: You're here forever.

title: Dynamite Joe
description: Dynamite Joe is a game where you avoid cops and monsters as you dash to escape prison by collecting keys to get on the next level.

title: Garten of Banban 8: Anti Devil
description: Explore the most obscure levels of Banban’s Kindergarten. Survive the new deceives and mysteries that await you. Uncover the truth behind the place, and find the whereabouts of your missing child…

title: Graveyard Shift at Freddy's
description:
"Graveyard Shift at Freddy's" is a small Re-Imagining of the original Five Nights at Freddy's, with new twists and turns! Featuring brand new mechanics, visuals, characters, and an entirely new story for you to unravel.

Venture into "Freddybear's Eatery and Fun", watch feeds, and ensure nothing gets damaged.

title: Shootrush
description: A runner where you have to avoid obstacles while defending yourself from robots who want to kill you.

title: Escape Academy: Tournament of Puzzles
description:
Hit the road with Coach Yoach and experience all new arenas, game modes, power-ups, and PUZZLES! Solve your way through giant, replayable arenas filled with secret passages, alternate routes and randomized puzzles.

Journey to Egypt’s Tomb of the First Escapist, the rain soaked and tech-infused Hackannery, or everyone’s favorite Escape theater The Showman’s Studio!

Face off against fellow Escapists in three new competitive modes Escape Race, Tic-Tac-Toe, and Scavenger Hunt, featuring all different mechanics!

And if you thought things couldn’t get wackier, Tournament of Puzzles features exciting new Power-Ups! Deploy distracting traps against your opponents or or gain an advantage by utilizing assists and secure the win.

More of a solo solver? Not a problem! Coach Yoach is happy to let any Escapist puzzle their way through the arenas in single player mode. See how fast you can conquer each course and compete for your best time!

title: Classic Marathon
description:
From the team that brought you Aleph One, the classic sci-fi FPS Marathon from Bungie on Mac revived for modern hardware by the fan community.

Alien forces have boarded the colony ship UESC Marathon in the Tau Ceti system, in orbit around humanity’s first interstellar colony. The situation is dire, and as a security officer assigned to the Marathon, your duty is to defend the ship and its crew from the alien threat.

This classic 1994 Bungie FPS had a foundational influence on the genre, and is now maintained by the fan community. Experience authentic game play using the original data files, with achievements, optional widescreen HUD support, 3D filtering/perspective, positional audio, and 60+ fps interpolation, just in case the original is too authentic.

title: Our Souls Never Sleep
description: Player will face choices that determine their fate and the fates of the friends they make along the way in this psychological horror game.

title: Forgotten Playland
description:
Forgotten Playland is a free-to-play, social party game that takes place in the quiet solitude of a long-forgotten and abandoned house, where a whimsical world unfolds.

Within the dusty rooms and forgotten corners of time, an enchanting realm comes to life as the once-discarded toys left by their owners embark on a magical journey of their own.

Welcome to Forgotten Playland, a realm where the PlushKyns breathe life into a world of games and adventures.

title: Classic Marathon 2
description:
From the team that brought you Aleph One, the classic sci-fi FPS Marathon 2: Durandal from Bungie on Mac revived for modern hardware by the fan community.

Fresh from your triumph on the colony ship Marathon, you are seized by the rogue AI Durandal to do his bidding in a distant part of the galaxy. Within the ruins of an ancient civilization, you must seek the remnants of a lost clan and uncover their long-buried secrets. Battle opponents ancient and terrible, with sophisticated weapons and devious strategies, all the while struggling to escape the alien nightmare…

This classic 1995 Bungie FPS is now maintained by the fan community. Experience authentic game play using the original data files, with achievements, optional widescreen HUD support, 3D filtering/perspective, positional audio, and 60+ fps interpolation, just in case the original is too authentic.

title: Classic Marathon Infinity
description:
From the team that brought you Aleph One, the classic sci-fi FPS Marathon Infinity from Bungie on Mac revived for modern hardware by the fan community.

Marathon Infinity takes the closed universe of the Marathon series and blows it wide open. The solo/co-op campaign, “Blood Tides of Lh’owon,” is a 20-level scenario sporting new textures, weapons, and enemies. More than that, the scenario sheds a surprising new light on the story’s characters and the meaning of events. Having defeated the Pfhor and reawakened the ancient remnants of the S’pht, the player now faces a world where friends become enemies and all is not what it seems…

This classic 1996 Bungie FPS is now maintained by the fan community. Experience authentic game play using the original data files, with achievements, optional widescreen HUD support, 3D filtering/perspective, positional audio, and 60+ fps interpolation, just in case the original is too authentic.

title: PainKeep Arena
description: PainKeep Arena is a "Mission-Pack" designed for use with the registered version of Quake III Arena. PainKeep Arena not only offers brand new weapons, but also rich environments packed with tons of new sounds, new special effects, great new features, and lots of surprises.

title: Rocket Arena 3
description: All the goodness of Rocket Arena 2 and much much more. Rocket Arena 3 will redefine what a mod can and should be, going beyond simple gameplay and map additions and adding to the core engine itself. Thanks to the power of client side code in Quake 3, a huge number of features never before thought possible will now take Rocket Arena 3 to that next level. Welcome to the next generation of Rocket Arena, and the next evolution of Quake.

title: PainKeep
description: PainKeep is a DeathMatch-only “mission-pack” designed for use with registered Quake. PainKeep not only offers brand new weapons (with new pickup and view models), but also a new rich environment with tons of new sounds, new special effects, great new features, and lots of surprises.

title: Rocket Arena 2
description: Rocket Arena 2 is one of the most popular Quake 2 mods of all time. It's innovative "multi-arena" maps allows players to choose from up to 10 arenas on a single level, and have matches going on in all of them simulatnously. The refined "pickup" mode introduces players to the fast-paced teamplay style of Clan Arena.

title: Endless Crimes of the Future
description:
Do not fear falling, you have cybernetic limbs. Use the scrolling coloured button on your ship to direct its course. Find the scrolling coloured buttons on the ground and use them to call your ship to pick you up.

Humanity has been enslaved by unknown forces. You are a time traveller and a rebel outsider living high above the city. What can you even do in the face of such a situation?

title: Abstract Ritual
description:
You are searching for the entrance to the secret world.
You are just a natural explorer I guess. It's cool.

Please excuse the spirit monsters being a bit mean, they are just stressed out.

title: The Pyramid Gate
description: The Pyramid Gate is a short but very atmospheric little adventure created by developer Strangethink for the "lowrezjam". Players will explore a very obtuse and surreal environment to see if they can unravel the mysteries of the various pyramids around.

title: Maria-sama ga Gyakuten: Etape de l'hiver
description: This sequel contains a double parody, featuring a courtroom showdown that is being released here in digital format for the first time.

title: Cubed and Dangerous
description: Cubed and Dangerous is a charming stylized twin-stick shooter that seamlessly merges action roguelike mechanics and action RPG mechanics into an exciting run-based experience.

title: Valkyrie: The Magical Odyssey
description: A fantasy sidescroller for DOS based in norse mythology.

title: Bighead
description: Everything seems fine on a Saturday night, you're about to watch a horror movie with your partner, when suddenly something happens. Dive into this nightmarish story about big heads

title: Gensou Sekai: Eastland Saga
description:
Reimu travels alone at first, but new heroines can be obtained as the player progresses through the game's story by exploring the game world and defeating opponents.
The battle system is turn-based with the protagonists and antagonists on different sides of the battlefield, using various commands such as: attack, magic, heal, defend and run.

title: Castlevania Chronicles III: Dracula's Curse
description:
A fanmade remake of Castlevania III: Dracula's Curse by studio WarMachine.

Experience Castlevania III like never before!
Enhanced visuals, mechanics, and new abilities such as item crashes, updated spells and forms, fully remastered OST, and much more!!!

"Do you have what it takes to face me?!"

It's always better to play with friends, and this time you get to keep ALL your partners along the way!

title: Zeta Wolf: First Bite
description: Explore the budding friendship between Carly and Siona — two girls whose personalities couldn't be more different! Will their friendship blossom into something more? Or will their selfish desires drive a wedge between them? Find out in this lighthearted prequel to Zeta Wolf Chronicles!

title: Airships: Lost Flotilla
description: Airships: Lost Flotilla is a steampunk autoshooter where you fight your way through waves of enemies on your way to a safe harbour. Destroy your foes, harvest wreckage, and upgrade your ship.

title: Bloodrails
description: Bloodrails is a fast paced Instagib capture-the-flag mod for Quake which features unique movement mechanics such as axe-dashing, skiing and grappling hooks.

title: Nunna
description: Nunna is a turn-based combat game with rogue-lite and deck-building elements. Defeat the enemies in front of Nunna and end her journey.

title: Ridgeside Village
description: An expansive mod for Stardew Valley, Ridgeside Village adds over 50 new NPCs, a new location, new items, new shops, new festivals, custom music, custom quests, and more!

title: Blissful Acres
description: Blissful Acres: Immersive Farming RPG! Slay monsters in a vibrant world with quests & secrets. Cultivate crops, automate tasks. Invest riches to expand farm & upgrade gear. Wield powerful weapons against foes. Unique blend of farming & action-packed adventures for epic odyssey!

title: Make Ten
description: Select numbers that add to ten, to remove them from the board. How high can you score in just 2 minutes?

title: Sonic Riders X
description: A re-imagining of the Sonic Riders games with the creators' own ideas to put a new spin on it.

title: Kokodi
description:
In a world without adults, kids fight each other for power and sweets!
Kokodi is a third-person extraction shooter set in a fantasy environment.

title: Zelda 64: Recompiled - Majora's Mask
description: A static recompilation of The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask for PC and Linux, with many enhancements like widescreen support, auto saving and higher resolution. It works through Zelda 64: Recompiled.

title: DinoLauncher
description: A mod launcher for Dinosaur Planet which applied the latest patches for the game, which is otherwise unplayable in its original form, and has a high quality models feature.

title: Relaxing Simulator
description: Discover the calm and serenity. Immerse yourself in a world full of natural beauty, relaxing and soothing activities. Explore places and find your inner balance. Escape the everyday stress and find peace in this digital sanctuary of relaxation.

title: Qdoom
description: QDOOM reimagines the legendary first episode of DOOM (1993), Knee-Deep in the Dead, in the Quake engine. Go toe-to-toe with a deadly tag team of both Quake and DOOM foes in this double-dosed love letter to id Software’s genre-pushing franchises.

title: Half-Life: The World Machine
description: You are Flynn Weißhaupt, a computer engineer of Black Mesa who worked on the Gibson, a powerful supercomputer. Now with the Resonance Cascade, it is your mission to retrieve the data of the Gibson and destroy it. Because The Gibson is too powerful to fall into the hands of alien forces or the military.

title: Comfy Maps
description: Ever wanted a relaxing Half-Life map just to chill in? Here are 2 meditative-type maps (sunset and night settings) allowing just that. There’s a bit to explore and you can sit on the chair or couch if you like.

title: Tuca Quest
description: Tuca Quest follows the titular Tuca (Lactuca Optima) as he gets sent on an adventure against United States President Joe Biden. Tuca constantly finds himself in new and bizarre locations throughout his quest. You'll have to make many decisions which will alter your playthrough. Can you get the true Tuca ending?

title: My Little Life
description: A desktop companion that lives on the bottom of your screen. Expand and decorate their home to keep them happy. Help them live their best life while you focus on yours.

title: Dynamite Duchess 3: Carnival of Souls
description: Explore Heaven, Hell, and Purgatory (and invade a few of your friends' heavenly suites) on a quest to save your mother's soul. Fight weird monsters, talk to annoying NPCs, and solve a few vexing puzzles.

title: Stardust Kids
description:
Deputy head of the UFO study club wasn’t prepared for what the inspection of club’s property will bring. The long-awaited summer break has to be postponed until Kurt finds the lost item — a home planetarium.
A story about friendship and bonding under starry sky.

title: Dawn Chorus
description: Dawn Chorus is a wholesome, non-linear romance furry visual novel set in cold and snow-clad Norway.

title: Star Chef Simulator
description:
Welcome to Star Chef Simulator, where your dream of running your own restaurant is about to become a reality! Immerse yourself in the exciting world of culinary entrepreneurship as you build and manage your restaurant from the ground up. Unleash your inner chef and dive in the art of cooking with more than 10 delicious dishes from around the world. Cook with a variety of different ingredients, techniques and recipes to create culinary masterpieces that will delight your customers. Use various kitchen appliances such as the deep fryer, oven, stove or mixer and create unique dishes!

Hire, train, and manage your employees to keep your restaurant running smoothly. Build a strong team to handle the hustle and bustle of a busy kitchen. Customize your restaurant, from the walls to the floors, from the decor to the equipment. Create a unique dining experience and watch customers flock to your establishment.
Keep an eye on your finances as you make decisions to grow your business. Manage employee costs and invest in upgrades to attract more customers and increase profits. Provide top-notch service to your guests to earn rave reviews. Listen to feedback and strive to deliver a memorable dining experience that keeps guests coming back for more.

Are you ready to take the helm of your own restaurant and become the ultimate culinary star chef? The world of gastronomy awaits you!

title: Return of the Quack
description: Matt Furie and Chevy Ray Johnson Team up for this side scrolling shooter featuring Matt Furie's whimsical characters.

title: The Quizard's Domain
description:
Pub quiz meets pub brawl in this fast-paced, hero-based Battle Quiz!
Show off your brains AND brawn with up to 4 players locally, in a fusion of classic trivia/quiz elements, social deduction games, and fast-paced 2D action brawlers.
Crash, smash, and dash your way to the right answer, take a slower and more deceptive approach to fool your opponents, or forge completely new strategies across the varied playable characters and arenas.

title: The Whale Island
description:
"It's just a legend, isn't it?"

A legend of an ancient whale island, one no one believes in after so many years. Is there really lost magic there? Tisha makes Fran a promise.

"I'll take you to the whale island."

title: KeeperFX
description:
KeeperFX is an open-source remake and fan expansion of Dungeon Keeper.

The main goal of KeeperFX is to preserve and expand upon the original Dungeon Keeper experience, offering many new features, improvements, and much more while staying true to the original feeling of the game. You can delve into the original campaign and deeper dungeons, or enjoy levels and campaigns created by the community. There are an additional 13 bundled campaigns and 2 bundled map packs and many more to download from the Workshop.

title: Akiko Hard
description: Akiko is a special agent who arrives to a suspicious school as a new teacher to investigate rumors about its dark secrets.

title: Threat Assessment
description: Small metal/base Coagula-type void level with a high enemy density.

title: The Bonehoard
description: Large blue/metal level with caverns, blood, bones and otherworldy parts.

title: The Frater Fracas
description: Medium sized IKbase map.

title: Coven of Ebony
description: Blue medieval episode with 4 levels (+start/end map), some new monsters and fairly tough gameplay.

title: Clériga
description: After 82 years of Xyvran's defeat, Clériga must venture herself into her palace to repair the seal she put on the demon that prevented her infinite regeneration. This surreal horror experience puts you on edge as you need to find your way to the top of the castle while enemies slow you down, making you die slowly but surely, as your blood is being absorbed by the second.

title: FuryDough
description:
FuryDough is an action roguelite where donuts are everywhere, and you will hate them. Break through mazes, fight with a crowd of zany doughy adversaries, find and destroy Dough Mixers.
This is not a sweet dream, but a real nightmare.

title: When I Said "It's Ok To Be Cringe" I Didn't Mean Like That
description: A freeform exploration game about walking around and talking to people and interacting with things and nothing interesting happening.

title: Sverigespelet
description: The band Tripple & Touch is without a drummer and it is up to you to find them one somewhere in Sweden. Use Flight, Train, Bus, or Boat. In order to buy the ticket, you must either win it or earn it (by answering questions, with three answer options). At the beginning of the game, you receive a mission, and through it, you might figure out in which city the Drummer is located. But there are also clues that you can win or earn. There are plenty of video clips with the Tripplets, and you'll see them as encouragement when things go well - or not so well... You can have up to five real players taking turns, or if you're playing alone, up to five opponents who are in the game. This game was released to promote and train for the Swedish edition of "Who Wants to be a Millionaire?"

title: Where Are They?
description: Where Are They? is a game of Where's Waldo? Are you able to find all the hidden things?

title: Cyber Russia
description:
Welcome to the gritty world of CyberRussia, an online game set in a futuristic, cyberpunk version of Russia where players navigate through a complex web of crime, corruption, and power. In this virtual world, players can choose diverse roles such as law enforcement officers tasked with upholding order, prosecutors fighting against corruption, judges arbitrating cases, ambitious deputies shaping policies, and governors wielding influence over regions.

However, the allure of the dark side is equally tempting. You can venture into the underworld, joining criminal syndicates to become a notorious bandit or mastermind. Engage in illicit activities, from bribery to smuggling, but beware—the watchful eye of the federal security service is always present, ready to pounce on any misstep.

For those seeking alternative paths, there's a chance to invest in land, cultivate crops, and engage in trade, all within the cybernetic landscapes of future Russia. Become a miner, extracting precious resources, or rise as an influential entrepreneur amidst the neon-lit chaos of this immersive, cyberpunk universe. The choices are yours to make, but the consequences are as real as the digital world around you.

title: Gooba Ball
description: A physics-based puzzle game where you combine colorful balls to achieve the ultimate form -- Goober! Combine two of a kind until, like I said, Goober… What more to do you freakin’ want?

title: Dragon Quest: Legacy of the Lost
description: Dragon Quest: Legacy of the Lost is a fangame highly inspired by Dragon Warrior 7. The game will feature the shard system and time travel aspect found in Dragon Warrior 7. The underlying story, however, is not the same and besides the time travelling portion, no plot sequence will be taken from Dragon Warrior 7.

title: TerrariaCraft
description: TerrariaCraft is a mod for Minecraft: Java Edition that adds content from Terraria, a 2D game by Re-Logic, by completely changing how newly created worlds look with custom terrain generation, bigger and deeper caves to explore, and many more new features and mechanics than just that! Explore a finite island to find resources and biomes, fight against mobs to survive, and progress through the mod!

title: The Call of the Rats
description: jimmy wakes up in the middle of nature and he can’t find his pa. help him find his pa.

title: Prototype Textures II
description: 23 small to medium-sized maps using khreathor's Prototype texture wad and Dumptruck's SMP progs

title: Progs_dump
description: SM188 is a speedmap pack themed around the new progs_dump tools.

title: Project Homecoming Haven
description:
Play as a Trauma Cleaner; a housecleaning service that receives requests from bereaving families to clean up rooms and houses left by the deceased.

In your job, you will learn about those who left the world of their own volition or others. Learn about the life they lived, choose belongings of the deceased to be given to their families, or keep them for yourself to grow your Trauma Cleaning business.

title: Evernight
description: A romantic tale about a human raised among faeries.

title: Sweetest Monster
description: A middle-aged man has an encounter with a cute catgirl in the dead of night - but all is not as it seems.

title: Master Detective Archives: Rain Code Plus
description: A brand new dark fantasy detective action game from the minds behind the Danganronpa series! Yuma, an amnesiac detective-in-training, and Shinigami, the spirit haunting him, tackle unsolved mysteries in a strange city caged by unending rain.

title: Sheepy
description: Get the sheep reunited with its fellow sheep while avoiding slimes.

title: Jelly Battle
description: A simple pet care sim with puzzle-style battles! Take care of your jelly – feed it, play with it, clean it, customize it, and guide it through battles with other jellies!

title: Dominion Synergy
description: Dominion Synergy is a Third Person Arena multiplayer game, designed by a eSports pro to bring a fun, fast-paced high fragging experience with fair, balanced mechanics to ensure that the better player & team always win every match. Featuring a Quick Switch multi-gun system, the skill gap is vast for you to grow your pro comp capabilities & display your greater prowess over all who may challenge you!

title: The Island of Killer Cacos
description: A UDMF DOOM2 wad

title: Wretch
description: Find the violent stalker hiding inside an abandoned school. Piece together broken lore and solve a long lost mystery. What happened here and who's to blame??

title: Realm of Chaos: 25th Anniversary Edition
description: This revised and recharged version of the classic wad features new graphics and sprites, an included DeHacked patch with original story sequences and aut﻿omap names, and a major facelift to every single map with permission from the original creators. The fights are badder, the progression is clearer, the lighting is sharper - but the original soul is wholly intact, and it remains 100% vanilla compatible!﻿ Perhaps the bigges﻿t addition of all, this edition of Realm of Chaos features a full custom soundtrack of 35 never-before-heard MIDIs courtesy of Cammy!

title: Skuld no Bug Taiji
description: A game included with the Oh My Goddess CD-Rom. The player guides Skuld to destroy bugs with her hammer

title: Sting Operation
description: A Twist on the Arcade Pacman Formula! Use Real Time Strategy to command a group of police officers trying to catch criminals.

title: Phantasmal Garrison
description: A four level wizard/medieval episode with a start map. Features exploding barrels, cutscenes and a few new monsters (dragons and boss).

title: YOU ARE MY HOME
description:
In an unlabeled cartridge, you see footage of your life from angles you've never seen before. Someone's anime drawings tell you that you need to "really real know".

Are you sure you want to?

Made for the A Game By Its Cover 2021 Jam.

title: Baking Time
description: Get ready for the ultimate bakery game that will satisfy your cooking fever and love for pastries!

title: The Whims of the Gods
description: The Whims of the Gods is a city-building game where you can play solo or join forces in co-op to shape an ancient civilization, manage people and resources, face divine challenges, and survive under the ever-watchful gaze of the gods.

title: Slimelon
description: Try to defeat the chaos generated by a multitude of slimes, each one cuter (almost) than the other. Discover all the fusions, collect them... And try to be the best (temporary) slime breeder!

title: Gakuen Idolmaster
description: An idol raising simulation mobile game in The Idolmaster series featuring a completely new branch of idols. Enroll in Hatsuboshi Gakuen to learn the ropes of being a producer by partnering up with various idol students to help them raise to the top!

title: Combat
description: A reimagining of Atari's 1977 Combat. This game uses a sci-fi aesthetic, depicting hovertanks battling in futuristic environments.

title: Garn47
description: Garn47 is surreal low-poly 3D platformer with horror elements where you explore an odd world in order to earn badges, find secrets, and help a friend reunite with a loved one.

title: What the Fog
description: What the Fog?! You’ve been sucked into a cursed boardgame! Now you and a friend will need to work together to survive. Run, jump, dash, and shoot to escape swarms of angry monsters in this chaotic co-op roguelite from the world of Dead by Daylight.

title: Oneirophobia
description: Oneirophobia is a survival horror game with elements of psychological horror, thriller and drama. Experience the role of a person suffering from a fear of dreams. Run, hide, and be quiet. Help the main character overcome his fear by going through all the nightmares of our subconscious.

title: Dead by Daylight: Dungeons & Dragons
description: Dead by Daylight: Dungeons & Dragons brings the realm of fantasy horror into The Fog with new Killer, Vecna and new Survivors Aestri Yazar and Baermar Uraz (one character with 2 playable options). A new Map, Forgotten Ruins, is available for all players.

title: One Piece: Starboard
description: An RPG Maker MZ adventure game inspired by the One Piece series, set 20 years after the events of the original story. Take control of Alphonse D. Orion, a mysterious amnesiac with a wish to see the stars of the Grand Line.

title: TRIB3
description: TRIB3 is a cutting-edge, multiplayer combat game by Flux Point Studios, blending intense action with strategic gameplay. Set in a dystopian future, players engage in fierce battles, employing a variety of weapons and skills to dominate opponents and rise through the ranks.

title: Roskur's Run
description: Roskur's Run is an evolution of classic 90's "Hedgehog" physics-based platforming with a deeper move set, upgrades, and a non-linear world to explore. The loop: Explore > Collect > Upgrade > SPEED RUN > Unlock > Explore

title: Dead by Daylight: Castlevania Chapter
description: So comes the very night incarnate, accursed and ravenous, for darkness is Dracula’s domain. With the ability to transform into the vile denizens of the woods and conjure unnatural flames, all mortals shall succumb to The Dark Lord’s vengeance.

title: Retaliate
description: Retaliate is a vertically scrolling space shooter with the unique gameplay mechanic being that the player starts with no ammo. Instead the player has a shield and is able to use it to both destroy enemies and absorb their weapons. Absorbed weapons can then be fired by the player.

title: Hellmouth Pizza
description: Welcome to the Hellmouth team! Our mission is to bring chaos, disarray and high quality customer service upon this world! Prepare pizza according to the pictures of orders! Add cheese, Mysterious tomato sauce (which is definitely NOT ketchup) and toppings! And then put the pizza into the oven! Do it in time and do it right or you will anger your customers! Gladly for you, we have a special "Irritation meter" which also serves as the Oven's chimney! It will help you prepare for some unexpected layoffs! But don't you worry about messing up the order, you have a colleague who will gladly "delete" all of your delicious mistakes, you just have to poke him. Good luck on your shifts!

title: Midnight Mayhem
description: A team of humans vs an invisible monster with ever evolving abilities. Co-op pvp horror game best played with friends!

title: Foguetão 2000
description: early 2000's Portuguese educational game

title: Nightswimming
description: It's a quiet game about driving around delivering packages during a virus outbreak. Understanding how the interface works and discovering all you can do with it is part of the game.

title: A Ghost Porno Page By Page
description:
AGPPBP is a game about reading a trashy ebook someone sent you, because that someone loves you, and you love them back :)

AGPPBP is also very short, lasting about 5 minutes, if you want to read the whole thing :)

title: Halloween 1
description:
This is a fan-made game based on John Carpenter's Halloween (1978 movie).

Everything seems fine while you're babysitting Tommy on Halloween night, until you receive a creepy phone call and someone tries to open the door. This unravels a horrifying nightmare where you have to fight for your life.

title: Stupid Cars
description:
These drivers are, you guessed it… STUPID!
They need your help. Using Hand Tracking or Controllers, select their vehicles to change speed and guide them as they merge into the flow of traffic. But be careful, these cars can’t stop… if there’s a collision, it’s all over.
Perfect for casual players, but also offering optional challenges for the purists. Adjustable playing position to get you right down into the action and, for a more immersive experience, try Mixed Reality Mode.
Designed to be one of the most challenging "One More Go" games around, it features.

title: The Purge Club: Kyuusai! Shukusei Circle
description: In the name of the client, pretty and shy Seina will punish you!

title: Furcadia: The Second Dreaming
description:
In 2012 Furcadia launched a Kickstarter campaign to renovate the entire game in a series of updates called The Second Dreaming. This campaign was successful, and raised more than $100,000.

In 2016, Furcadia released "The Second Dreaming Part 1", which added new 32bit world building tools, character enhancements, a web based character creator and editor, and other massive updates to the graphics engine.

title: Alzara: Radiant Echoes
description: Restore peace to a world torn apart in this 3D turn-based RPG inspired by Japanese classics. Combine the elements to unleash spectacular attacks, solve magical puzzles, and bring the world together.

title: The Legend of Heroes: Trails through Daybreak - Ultimate Edition
description: The Ultimate Edition includes the Base Game and the following DLC: Advanced Set, Costume Set, Accessories Set, Starter Set, Voice Set and Bonus Set.

title: The Legend of Heroes: Trails through Daybreak - Digital Deluxe Edition
description: The Digital Deluxe Edition includes the Base Game, Costume Set, Voice Set and Bonus Set DLCs.

title: The Legend of Heroes: Trails through Daybreak - Accessories Set
description: This set includes the following DLC: Glasses Set, Sunglasses Set, Sun Visor Set, Mask Set, Backpack Set, Inner Tube Set, Costume: White Rabbit, Costume: Dog, Costume: Fox, Costume: Cow, Visual Ambience Set, Character Xipha Cover Set and Illustrated Xipha Cover Set.

title: South Park: Snow Day! - Snowball
description: The all-new snowball is perfect tool for all those who mastered the other weapons in the game. Unleash devastating new effects on enemies and grant powerful supporting effects on your allies too.

title: Megaton Musashi W: Riding Board Effect Set 1
description: A pack containing 4 cool effects to customize the newly added Riding Board!

title: Megaton Musashi W: Riding Board Effect Set 2
description: A pack containing of 3 cool effects to customize the newly added Riding Board!

title: Megaton Musashi W: Riding Board Color Set

description: Guide your football team in their quest to become Super League Champions.

title: Pinball FX: Pacific Rim Pinball
description: Go big or go extinct. Prime your senses for a neural handshake and step into the cockpit of a Jaeger. It is on you to cancel the apocalypse!
