description: Celebrate your passion for PAC-MAN's Pals with these cosmetic items as you eat to compete!

title: Pac-Man Mega Tunnel Battle: Chomp Champs - Lunar Animals Pac
description: Show off your favorite Lunar Animal style with these cosmetic items as you eat to compete!

title: Oniko Kororin Game
description: Characters from Onigiri High School are now available as cute puzzles! Supported by UUUM, the song in the opening movie is actually NMB48! Roll the rice balls, stack them high, make them big, and go through various gimmicks to avoid red spots (!?) Get the "Legendary Salmon"!

title: Hole io: Warzone
description: Wear army skins and visit the new Military map with your friends!

title: Quarterstaff
description: Often outnumbered, never outmatched – carefully plan your moves to single-handedly save a besieged fantasy realm from the clutches of a sorcerous conqueror.

title: Kindred Vale
description: Embark on a heart-warming journey to the alpine town of Kindred Vale. Discover mystic spirits and restore their trust. Use their magic to explore the breath-taking mountains, to gather, craft, and forge strong relationships with those you meet along the way to return the town to its former charm.

title: Kanna Maze
description: In an isolated lab beneath the earth, a childhood friend is resurrected. Amidst sealed walls, a spree of killings unfolds. In a godless abyss, parallel worlds entwine like a maze. Where does one find the path to the sole universe of bliss?

title: IL-2 Sturmovik: Battle of Stalingrad Deluxe Edition
description:
Aimed at history fans, this bundle includes the base game with its Stalingrad career mode, two additional collector's aircraft, and three historical, hand-crafted campaigns that build upon each other to create the 45-scenario saga of the Stalingrad front - Blazing Steppe (11th IAP pilot on Yak-1 series 69 in August and September 1942), Fortress on the Volga (I./JG 52 Staffel commander on Bf 109 G-2 in September and October), and Ice Ring (505th ShAP pilot on IL-2 mod. 1942 in November and December).

In total, this bundle contains 18 player-controlled aircraft, a pilot career mode, individual scenario missions, and a mission generator on the large map of the Stalingrad region as it was in 1942 and three historical campaigns.

title: Valheim: Ashlands
description: The world is heating up and in the south something is stirring... The creatures of the Ashlands come to life as the biome update is here at last!

title: Infernulia
description: "INFERNULIA" is a Yume Nikki type videogame where you explore the dreams world (Inferno) of Violeta, the Dreamer.

title: Omori x Yume Nikki Crossover Fangame
description:
Madotsuki goes on an adventure with her friends in Headspace!

Battle enemies and find useful effects!

title: Assassin's Creed Shadows
description: Experience an epic historical action-adventure story set in feudal Japan! Become a lethal shinobi Assassin and a powerful legendary samurai as you explore a beautiful open world in a time of chaos. Switch seamlessly between two unlikely allies as you discover their common destiny. Master complementary playstyles, create your shinobi league, customize your hideout, and usher in a new era for Japan.

title: Pixel Paint Together
description: A relaxing color by numbers game! Color with your friends! Lots to paint! No hidden fees!

title: Zelda 64: Recompiled
description: Zelda 64: Recompiled is a project that uses N64: Recompiled to statically recompile Majora's Mask (and soon Ocarina of Time) into a native port with many new features and enhancements. This project uses RT64 as the rendering engine to provide some of these enhancements.

title: Knights Vault
description: Knights Vault is simply a multiplayer Souls Like Platformer. Run, jump and dodge roll your way through many environments and obstacles while fighting other players in your lobby, only one knight will stand victorious vaulting their way to the grand treasure!

title: Chalicebound
description: Chalicebound is a short dark fantasy point & click adventure, mainly inspired by Shadowgate and Vermis.

title: Mbembe Radio
description: This is a horror adventure game. Let's take on the challenges presented by the radio and make the journey home enjoyable. Fun may also include some fear.

title: Risky Roads
description: Running across the road is a very challenging task for a little chicken. Lots of very fast cars and unexpected obstacles. You need a good reaction to help this cute little guy. Don't forget that he has friends and they also want to cross the road.

title: Ghost Teen Escape from Limbo
description: Make use of your newfound ghostly abilities to make your way back to the world of the living!

title: Glyphs of Gitzan
description: Explore mysterious ruins and uncover their secrets by mastering the glowing glyphs!

title: Sled Riders
description: Discover incredible winter sled races on exciting tracks against other racers!

title: All Elite Wrestling: Fight Forever - World War Joe
description: AEW: Fight Forever World War Joe DLC features Samoa Joe - the only wrestler to hold the AEW, ROH and TNA World Championships, PLUS the all-new Japanese shrine map, two new attire options and 11 new moves including signature taunts.

title: All Elite Wrestling: Fight Forever - Elite Beats and Stampede Expansion
description: AEW: Fight Forever Elite Beats and Stampede Expansion is FREE to ALL AEW: Fight Forever players and features five new music tracks and 20 new skins! A very special thank you to the fans that made AEW the fastest growing wrestling promotion.

title: Cardfight!! Vanguard: Dear Days - Additional Special Set
description: All cards from Festival Booster 2023 (Reprints Removed) and a portion of cards from Clash of the Heroes available!

title: Snail's Knock Out!
description: From the asymmetrical party action game 'Goonya Monster' designed by Terada Tera , a spin-off work has emerged! Enemy in sight? Throw bombs! Blast away! "Snail's Knock Out" is a casual shooting game. Blast away the undead appearing in stages with increasing speed and relieve accumulated stress!

title: Octo's Balloon Challenge
description: From the asymmetrical party action game 'Goonya Monster' designed by Terada Tera , a spin-off work has emerged! Master the art of flying balloons and balancing on a seesaw to collect lots of Souls! Challenge yourself in this new sensation game where 'buoyancy' is the key!

title: Pirarucu's Money Rush
description: From the asymmetrical party action game 'Goonya Monster' designed by Terada Tera , a spin-off work has emerged! "Pirarucu's Money Rush" is a side-scrolling shopping rampage game! At each stage checkpoint, which changes with every play, you can purchase items to gain an advantage in the game.

title: Toad's Soul Hopper
description: From the asymmetrical party action game 'Goonya Monster' designed by Terada Tera , a spin-off work has emerged! "Toad's Soul Hopper" is hopping action game where you aim for the top from bottom to top! Will he soar into action with weapons in hand to stop Anemone's mischief and save his friends?

title: Saikko-nee to Death Game
description: This is a game about sisters who have decided to participate in a death game, and have to collect bills and deposit them into an ATM in order to survive. Explore to achieve your goals while avoiding TVs that will kill you if you see them, dangerous floating objects, and more.

title: 1000 Seconds
description: 1000 Seconds is a roguelike – Defeat enemies, gather resources, and upgrade your orb to escape the temporal limbo, but you only have 1000 seconds to reach the end, so be as fast as possible.

title: 100 Crime Cats
description: Join the cutest adventure in the Detective Crime Location, full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of Crime locations as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game.

title: 100 Forest Cats
description: Join the cutest adventure in the Forest Location, full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of Forest locations as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game.

title: 100 Korea Cats
description: 100 Korea Cats - Join the cutest adventure in the Korean themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of Korean places and Cats as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. Can you find them all?

title: 13Z: The Zodiac Trials
description: Go solo or team up with up to three friends in online co-op for this fast-paced, anime-inspired action roguelike. Master stylish hack and slash combat, craft overpowered builds, and conquer mythological trials to claim the title of the thirteenth Zodiac.

title: 1 to 1 Humanoid Edible Toys
description: A story about Ambiguous Affection, Appetite, and Tantalizing Desires.

title: 9Shot
description: This game is purely for catharsis; there's no main storyline and it will never conclude "9Shot" is a first-person shooter game set in a zombie-infested Tokyo streets. Your objective is simple: survive against waves of zombies for as long as possible. Earn points by killing zombies to upgrade weapons

A game in an underground palace where you can control a smiling face to dodge the burning fireball through WASD to get the key, and finally find a way out through one door after another. There are no save games for this game, and it will be restarted every time you quit.

title: 9 Dystricts
description: Build your own flying vehicles in this action-packed roguelike dystopia.

title: 3D Puzzle: Pirates
description: Collect a 3D puzzle, transferring things to the right places to create a beautiful place.

title: 49 Keys
description: It all began when you opened that letter. Penned by your late master, it details how you are now heir to his mysterious legacy. You set off for the island on which he'd spent his final years... and so a truly unsettling journey begins, a journey into the deepest secrets of magic and the occult.

title: 9th Dawn Remake
description: Rediscover the magic of the 9th Dawn series with this complete re-imagining of the original game. Venture into a massive 2.5D open world. Explore 45 new dungeons in top-down or first-person view, craft weapons, raise pets, play a deck-building card game, and take down the Castle of Maltyr!

title: Rise of Robots
description: Rise of Robots is a Roguelite Shooter where you build a powerful weapon as you fight to survive ever increasing swarms of robots. Stack powerups to create a unique weapon each run and beat the challenge on each map

title: 100 Istanbul Cats: Extra Content
description: By purchasing DLC, you will get extra content in the game 100 Istanbul Cats. Get an extra level with 100 more adorable cats!

description: Collect a 3D puzzle, transferring things to the right places to create a beautiful place.

title: 3D Puzzle: Hospital 2
description: Collect a 3D puzzle, transferring things to the right places to create a beautiful place.

title: 3D Puzzle: Hospital 3
description: Collect a 3D puzzle, transferring things to the right places to create a beautiful place.

title: 3D Puzzle: Old Sea Port
description: Collect a 3D puzzle, transferring things to the right places to create a beautiful place.

title: Berry Bash
description: Survivor - Welcome to Fruitland. Your task is to Improve yourself more efficiently than the residents of the city. Improve your skills, weapons and unlock new items, but don't forget that the Fruits and Vegetables are getting stronger too!

title: Half Plan
description: Enter a world of immersive infiltration action and intense gunplay in this VR FPS action shooter.

title: Star Mountain
description: Star Mountain is a fast paced 1v1 game where you must race to get a star before your opponent. Build your own platforms, and block your opponent to get to the star first! Featuring character customization, online and local multiplayer, and full controller support.

title: The Netcode Conflict
description: Welcome to 'The Netcode Conflict'! We are working on a futuristic open world survival shooter with an amazing setup. Let`s start with us our development and create with us the next epic game.

title: Apomo District
description: Explore a world that changes everyday where you’ll hunt weird monsters called ‘Apomo.’ Catch and cook fish to get buffs, collect bugs to cast spells, and find gear to fit your play style.

title: The Giant Crab in Space
description: Take control of the Giant Crab and travel to distant star systems on your quest to free the galaxy from a tyrannical alien empire.

title: Byte
description: Byte is a tactics RPG that adapts the classic novel Dracula. You play as Jonathan Harker, Dracula’s real estate agent, completing work tasks while exploring the castle, speaking with its inhabitants, and hacking into computers.

title: Luminleaf Chronicles
description: "Luminleaf Chronicles" is the story of a group of cat girls who set out on an adventure to purify the world's water. In this game, you can choose different characters to go on your own adventures with others.

title: Volt Recharge
description: Race customizable RC cars in intense multiplayer battles! Split-screen, unique abilities, and dynamic tracks await. Get ready to dominate the competition!

title: Card TD
description: CardTD is a hybrid tower defense and a deck-building game. Packaged with a ton of user freedom in playstyles with a progression system that lets you play at your own pace. Defend your base from waves of toybox like enemies by playing cards to gain resources and towers to defend yourself!

title: Beat the Fed
description: Run the Federal Reserve in this macroeconomics time-traveling simulation game. Apply monetary and fiscal policies and monitor and assess the impact on unemployment, inflation, and other key economic metrics. Can you Beat the Fed?

title: Project Rebearth
description: The game is set in a post-apocalyptic utopia where you rebuild society after a global collapse. A massive online multiplayer where everyone plays on an exact replica of planet earth. Grow your town, trade with other players, face challenges and discover the rich history of the planet.

title: A Dungeon Is You
description: Tower defense X Incremental idle! Design your own dungeon (maze). Summon and place different defenders against hundreds of personally designed waves. Explore multiple systems, including an arpg like item system with every system improving each other. No resets or prestige! Continuous combat!

title: CatboyZoom
description: Become a catboy and zoom through the many handcrafted worlds in this FPS Platforming Speedrunner! Master your control over the source-inspired movement system and leave your best times for others to challenge!

title: Drewdler
description: Drewdler is a puzzle platformer where you launch Drew in their orb of armor. Use the unique ability to draw lines and navigate through levels, collect gravity crystals and get back to the portal. Piece levels back together, and save the world!

title: Word Turtle Island
description: Word Turtle Island is a nature dungeon action shooter where you use words as weapons to rescue books and readers in danger from creatures destroying the most powerful library in the galaxy. After battle, help the books and readers get where they need to be in your book sanctuary home base.

title: Heraean Games
description: This game may contain content that is not appropriate for all ages or for viewing in the workplace: general adult content. Contains content that is not suitable for all ages, sexual themes.

title: Riser of Babel
description: Avoid all obstacles and get high as you can! Riser of Babel is endless 2d jump platform puzzle game. Stack different style blocks for your character and run for higher score! Master stacking tower and challenge for avoid falling debris and critical lighting!

title: Under Canopies
description: Under Canopies is a serene exploration and survival experience. Set your own pace as you immerse yourself in activities like building and decorating your cabin, animal husbandry, crafting delicious meals, and uncovering the hidden secrets and valuable resources scattered throughout nature.

title: Farkas: the Last Redhaft
description: As the last survivor of the dojo, the responsibility is on you. Parkour your way through the most dangerous mines. Slash the enemies in the forest and master the art of the sword.

title: Shadows of Betrayal
description: Dive into Shadows of Betrayal, a horror/thriller visual novel about recent high school graduates, who head to a remote cabin for a celebration of sorts. Navigate friendships, delve into (optional) romance, and brace for suspenseful twists. Can you survive the unexpected, and what will it cost you?

title: Breaking Bricks
description: Get ready to experience the thrill of BREAKING BRICKS, an addictive arcade game that will captivate players of all ages. With 40 challenging levels, you’ll have a blast breaking bricks and progressing to new stages. The goal of BREAKING BRICKS is simple: use your skill and quick reflexes to destroy all the blocks on the screen. But it won’t be as easy as it sounds! As you advance through the levels, the blocks become tougher, requiring smart strategies to overcome each challenge. What truly sets BREAKING BRICKS apart are the exciting power-ups you’ll discover throughout the game. These power-ups range from extra balls to multiply your score, to powerful weapons that destroy multiple blocks at once. Each power-up adds an extra layer of excitement and strategy, keeping you on your toes and eager for more. With its fast-paced action and intuitive controls, BREAKING BRICKS delivers an engaging experience from start to finish. Every level provides a sense of achievement as you progress.

title: Mayonaka 10 Chome
description: Currently, in the town of Mayonaka, abnormal phenomena and terrifying apparitions have been witnessed. If you encounter them, never approach,Please turn left at this road. If there are no abnormalities, please turn right. Will you be able to safely navigate through the eternal road of terror?

title: Ponder
description: A fishing simulation game set in a lush fantasy world.

title: Neverdaunt:8Bit
description:
Neverdaunt:8Bit (N8) was an online massively multiplayer virtual sandbox created by Robot Loves Kitty. In the game, players would explore a "dreamlike world of floating islands and fallen stars where nearly anything can happen." Players could fight, build, socialize, and shop. The game also included a visual programming language called Tronics that allowed players to program devices within the game.
N8's servers were shut down in May 2012.

title: Saihate Station
description: A love-and-hate bromance exploration horror ADV that depicts the codependency and perverted love between two men.

title: Grim Dungeon
description:
Grim Dungeon is a vertical slice of a JRPG project, made with Godot.
Crawl through the dungeon and defeat the final boss by using your abilities intelligently.

title: Touhou Flower Fight
description:
Create Your Own Party!

Combine numerous characters and cards to create your own party.
You can freely mix and match them to create the optimal team,
and the tactics and play style of your party will be determined by your choices.

title: Witch's Doll
description: Witch's Doll is a first-person psychological horror game with realistic graphics. Beware, something is lurking in the dark. Get ready for intense jumpscares.

title: Los Pingheros
description: Duck, dodge and toss. Los Pingheros is a multiplayer brawler for up to 8 players online or local. Join hectic battles in various modes and strive to become the ultimate Pinghero in Mexico by snowing your opponents out of the arena.

title: Zelda 64: Recompiled - Ocarina of Time
description: A static recompilation of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time which aims to add many improvements over the original console version.

title: Seekl
description: After clicking an old link on a forum, you’ve stumbled into a server of strange hackers, each with their own axe to grind. They’re (reluctantly) willing to give you some lessons, but is there something else to gain during your time here?

title: Terra Swoop Force
description: GDL has assembled an elite elytra task force for a top-secret, high-risk mission. Step into your Thermal Flight Armor; it’s time to begin the flight of your life!

title: Chaotic Customer
description: A Dark Deception fangame.

title: Dark Deception: Malicious Mall
description: Fan-game of Dark Deception.

title: Sapo 3D
description: A 3D/Pixel-Art Platformer With Classic Elements Where You Will Control an Acrobat Frog. Collect Golden Flies to Unlock New Worlds, Levels and Other Surprises.

title: Shield Strike
description: Shield Strike is a competitive game where players use shields as projectiles, in addition to the unique abilities of each of the 8 characters. Made for up to 4 players, VS or Coop, and with a challenging journey in story mode.

title: Archean
description: Archean is a realistic, immersive engineering sandbox and full scale space sim. Featuring Earth 3 billion years in the past, in the Archean eon.

title: Nine Floors
description:
In Nine Floors, you are a student who has finished the horror of high school classes.

Avoid your classmates, you don't want trouble, that evil janitor... he surely won't let you go home...
How scary, go down the nine floors, and if you find something strange... Turn back and return the way you came.

title: Dünnes Eis: Das Spiel zum Song
description: Dünnes Eis is a point-and-click short story by award-winning game designer Jan “Poki” Baumann, who has won numerous awards for games such as the Deponia series. Since 2021, Poki has dedicated himself to his music and band Baumann Bergmann Pokinsson.

title: Starward
description: "Starward" is a 3D competitive game that combines mecha girls with classic GVG fighting gameplay, with 1V1 and 2V2 battles as the core. In "Starward", players can control mecha girls with distinct personalities and different fighting styles, and experience a three-dimensional combat experience that goes beyond the ground through fighting shooting, agile operation, and tactical formulation.

title: Bad Flesh
description: A small game made for #lowrezjam23 that missed the deadline. Too busy eating bad flesh.

title: YuckFu!
description:
In Yuckfu! you control a little spacecraft and your task is to collect as many "fuckits" as possible, while avoiding to crash into the walls/floor/ceiling.
Fuckits become solid if you do not collect them within a certain amount of time - decreasing your remaining space to move on the screen.

title: Cadence Crisis
description: music

title: Nightmare at Famine Springs
description: A Lonely Child prepares to Trick 'r Treat for Halloween.

title: Office Paradox
description:
Jim has a boring job in an office in those big commercial buildings.

On Halloween, Jim was heading home, but when he took the old elevator down, he found himself in a different and scary situation.

Will you be able to hang on and survive this challenge?

title: Mujou no Erasmus: The Erasmus Two-Faced Stories
description: Two original short stories told using characters and settings from The House in Fata Morgana.

title: Twenty One
description: You wake up in a velvet-draped casino that seems suspended in a void, run by faceless dealers and watched by an unseen Host. You're told you owe a "debt of existence" and must earn your right to live another day by beating the Quota — a cash target that rises with each round. You have 5 rounds to meet or exceed the quota, or… you're out. Permanently.

title: Let Me Sleep
description: A spooky puzzle adventure, in which the task is to help a rather sleepy fellow catch some rest… In a haunted house. Look for secrets, avoid obstacles… And Let Him Sleep!

title: Across the Obelisk: Nenukil, the Engineer
description: Nenukil, the Engineer is a Hero Pack that introduces a brand new Scout class character with a powerful gameplay mechanic and a unique dynamic skin. Unlock a pet with a potent debuff ability and discover untold tales of one of the heroes of The Obsidian Uprising.

title: Across the Obelisk: The Obsidian Uprising
description: In The Obsidian Uprising, you'll travel 30 years back in time to the dwarven city of Black Forge and discover a thrilling new Across the Obelisk story. Disaster looms over Black Forge. Gather your band of heroes, restore peace and battle your way back to present-day Senenthia.

title: Sand Land: Deluxe Edition
description:
The Deluxe Edition includes:
• Full game
• My Room Furniture Set: Army Base
• My Room Furniture Set: Hideout
• Speed Demon Pack
• Beelzebub Decal Set

SAND LAND is an action RPG where you become the main character as Beelzebub, a Fiend Prince. Lead your company of heroic misfits and explore the legendary world of SAND LAND created by Akira Toriyama.

Use your tact and imagination to develop tanks and other vehicles for your adventures utilizing a wide array of part combinations.

title: Muse Dash: Hatsune Miku Collab DLC 2 - Rin·Len's Mirrorland
Muse Dash: Hatsune Miku Collab DLC - Miku in Museland
Abandoned Moons
description: Embark with your friends to explore abandoned moons in search of resources and valuable loot in a cooperative first-person horror experience. Level up and assemble a complete arsenal of tools, gadgets, and helper robots to accomplish the mission.

title: Turn Based Boxing
description: In this turn-based (optional auto-battler) simulation game, you'll recruit, train, and manage a roster of boxing champions as you strive to build the ultimate fighting dynasty.

title: Weekend in Waimanalo
description: Weekend in Waimanalo is a romantic comedy yuri visual novel and dating sim. This is a game about love, respect, friendship, self-exploration, and mental health. Explore this hidden side of Oahu, get to know interesting characters, and see how your decisions affect where Rachel ends up and with who!

title: The Nightmare House
description: Escape from the nightmare mansion alive. In the protagonist's workplace, rumors of a nightmare are spreading. A terrifying dream where one is chased by something horrifying, and if caught, never wakes up again. Navigate through the mansion of horrors, fleeing from monsters, and attempt to escape.

title: Heart of Shadows
description: This is a simple 2D role-playing game. Explore different levels, defeat monsters, collect equipment and skills, and become more powerful.

title: The Strong High School
description: The Strong High School is said to be attended only by strong characters. Before you know it, "you" will be enrolling in THE STRONG HIGH SCHOOL. ---

title: Eqqo
description: Eqqo is a heartening tale of a mother, a blind child and an Egg - voiced and captioned in many languages. A multi-layered story full of symbols and metaphors about hope, love, nature and everything that connects us. It has four to five hours of exploration and puzzle solving in sacred lands and monumental temple rooms, as well as 25 hidden parchment scrolls to find and reveal new parts of the legend.

title: Fallopian Frenzy! Come Again?
description: Ten years ago (2014) I made my first game. This is that game. Mostly intact. I'm sorry.

title: FlowerRock
description: FlowerRock is a 2D platformer for players who love intense boss fights and an mysterious story. Something happened to this world, powerful enemies and secrets litter the landscape. Unlock upgrades for your laser to blast stronger enemies and unravel the story of what happened to this forsaken world.

title: I Commissioned Some Bunnies 6
description: I paid artists to hide bunnies and carrots in 15 artworks. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

title: Devices Tycoon
description: Devices Tycoon is a unique business simulator that will make you feel like the owner of a company that creates your own devices! In the game you can create your own smartphones, tablets, laptops, smart watches, headphones, operating systems and even your own processors!

title: A Surgery Beyond The Heart
description: This is a pix word puzzle adventure game based on RPGMaker.With serval different choice,you will get total different endings. You need to play the Germany returned genius doctor Shen Yi to find the dark side of the hospital.

title: Deadlands Duel: Time Rift Rumble
description: Deadlands Duel is a wave-based zombie defense shooter that takes place throughout all of history via time travel. You will fight hoards of zombies with various weapons and armaments. Choose one of four class types to specialize your gameplay to fit your desired role in this team-play focused arena.

title: Rail Maze 2
description: Navigate 100+ original puzzles, build railroads, and outsmart PIRATE foes on rails. Create your levels with the Level Editor and solve limitless challenges created by other players. Unleash creativity and conquer the rails in this thrilling puzzle adventure!

title: Lunarium
description: Lunarium is an atmospheric fantasy A-RPG. Play as Ave, a light-armored knight, who teams up with Lune, a mysterious Starfarer. Together, they journey to save a dying world, engaging in challenging battles to retrieve the lost glow of the stars and forsaken memories, unveiling cosmic secrets.

title: Natures Ascendancy
description: Natures Ascendancy" is an exhilarating open-world survival game where players explore a mysterious alien planet, uncover ancient secrets, and survive its treacherous environments. With stunning visuals and immersive gameplay mechanics, embark on an unforgettable journey of discovery and survival.

title: Knowledge Domination
description: Knowledge Domination is a multiplayer knowledge and strategy game. Players attempt to conquer each other's territories by answering questions correctly. Gain special powers by rolling dice and catch your opponents off guard . If you lose your capital ️, you lose the game.

title: Round My Corners
description: Round My Corners transforms your desktop with smooth, rounded edges, seamlessly integrated for a sleek look. Customize effortlessly, enjoy low resource consumption, and elevate your digital experience. Join the Round Corner Cult and embrace the future of desktop aesthetics today!

title: ScarQuest
description: Raise armies to dominate, seize, and reign over the planet as its ruler.

title: Legacy of Sin: Ill-Boding
description: The world as we knew it no longer exists. Join the few remaining survivors, lead them, and build your city, feed your people and organize your defenses to survive the hordes of enemies attacking your kingdom, mankind's last kingdom, our hope. Can you turn a small village into a great realm?

title: Tornado Emergency
description: A storm chasing simulation/strategy based game that immerses players in the thrill of tracking and intercepting tornadoes.

title: Gun Shop 3
description: Do you like guns? Many people sure do! Gun Shop 3 is a real-time storefront simulator with a sprinkling of first person shooter mechanics on top. Choose your location, design your store, stock the shelves, and then flip that sign to “open for business”! The demand is there. Can you supply it?

title: Escape from the Cannibal Family
description: Never get caught! Jack up the doll's vision! Feel their presence!

title: Fern Light
description: Play as Wanda, a 17-year-old on a quest to uncover a Polish legend's secrets. Solve puzzles, explore captivating landscapes, and dive into a richly hand-drawn world of mystery and magic. Ready for an unforgettable adventure?

title: Dimachaerus
description: Dimachaerus is a Hack'n Slash game in which you have to face hordes of enemies using weapons found in the scenario, use different weapons and make different combos to defeat the zombies that have dominated the kingdom, but be careful too you're fragile like an undead.

title: The Spewnicorn
description: Build the ultimate deck of cards and wield it to defeat the Gatekeepers! A cute and colorful roguelike full of fantastical whimsy!

title: Owe Money Pay Money
description: Big Chief embarks on a quest for justice & cold hard cash in this retro brawler. Packed with eye-popping pixel art, 8-bit bangers, & a Singaporean twist, it’s as bizarre as beat ‘em ups get. Welcome to Owe Money Pay Money (O$P$)!

title: Kenoma: Action Without Action
description: Answer the question of mortality in this sidescroller inspired by point-and-click adventures of old. Wander the depths of a world split in two. Confer with gods, locals, and other travelers. Solve problems through intuition and a collection of odd trinkets. Choose: death, or eternal life?

title: Adorable Dog: Gnomeageddon
description: The Gnome Legion has attacked! Save your friends, defend the village and bring the fight to the gnomes! Travel to unique worlds and recruit your animal buddies to help destroy those gnome once and for all!

title: Better With A Friend
description: Better With A Friend is a collection of hand drawn mini-games that you can only play with somebody else on a Steam Deck.

title: Gunpowder Massacre
description: Gunpowder Massacre is a 2D action shooter with Rogue-Lite elements set in a steampunk atmosphere. Play as one of the only survivors after the MP-2000 virus changed the world. Survive the hordes of enemies, defeat as many as you can, and showcase your skills to put your name in the Hall of Fame!

title: Fantastic Frolic
description: Embark on a whimsical quest to save the world in Fantastic Frolic. Play as Lil' J, Esther or Gorf and use your unique abilities to defeat monsters and uncover the truth behind the volcanic explosion prophecy. Explore a vibrant world, gather resources, and level up in this delightful adventure.

title: Trench Tales
description: A story-driven third-person action game set in a dark, alternative world between WWI and WWII. Harness unique powers, customize your arsenal, and navigate haunting Gothic landscapes. Battle fallen soldiers as you uncover the mysteries of this realm.

title: Death Education
description: Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of an old abandoned Soviet school and find out what's going on inside its walls from the first person in the new psychological horror Death Education. But be careful, something is already watching you.

title: I Think
description: One day, the programmer came up with an idea. If he could get AI to learn his diary, he could create himself in the electronic world.

title: Lil' Airport
description: Lil' Airport is a an idle airport management game. Build and manage your own airport directly on your desktop. Expand your airport from a small airstrip to a bustling travel hub. Schedule flights, delight passengers with amenities, face emergencies - or just watch the planes go by.

title: BackRooms: Lost
description: Backrooms: Lost supports multiplayer, allowing 1 to 4 players to navigate mysterious environments, evading lethal entities while striving to escape. All future content updates, like new levels and game modes, will remain complimentary. The multiplayer mode will launch alongside the initial release.

title: Search and Rescue: Snowman From Outer Space
description: SNOWMAN from OUTER SPACE!Snowman from Outer Space appeared in nearby mountains!Save yourself or Fight them if You dare!

title: Endura
description: Follow the journey of ex-convict, Jack Jr as he traverse the broken realm of Yagra to finish vital deliveries by utilizing grappling mechanics akin to Spiderman but with guns and swords, and hunting down titans reminisce to Monster Hunter.

title: RadioWave
description: Welcome to RadioWorld! An amazing attraction filled with robotics with the latest artificial intelligence and robust systems put in place for all ages to come and enjoy... or at least that's what RadioWorld was before the incident. RadioWave is always watching. Do you have what it takes to survive?

title: Endless Casual Drive
description: This is an immersive leisure solo journey. All you have to do is focus on driving and enjoy driving. Slowly gain peace and return to yourself in the white noise brought by the engine and the environment.

title: SpinSweep
description: Control a spinning cleaner and clean up garbages. With just movement controls, cleaning tools will combine one after another, bringing surprises and exhilaration. Let's use unique cleaning tools on various stages to aim for high scores.

title: The Flame's Heir
description: The Kingdom is protected by the Sacred Flame, a source of power that can only be used by the Flame's Heir. This individual comes from a very long lineage of warriors that wage an eternal war against evil. Vaynard, the son of a veteran of war, is called upon a quest he could never anticipate.

title: The Last Vampire Hunter
description: As the last of a long lineage of Vampire Hunters, Beaumont Lacaster finds himself in the doorsteps of Nosferatu's Castle. By defeating him, he can rid humanity of the curse and evil of vampires. Will he be able to defeat Nosferatu?

title: ChronoClone
description: The final project for a team of high school seniors as part of their game design class, Chrono Clone is a free to play puzzle platformer with multiple levels.

title: Chowdown Kitty
description: Meow we're talking! Chowdown Kitty is a Match 3 puzzle game where your goal is simple: Find treats and fill up the bowls of hundreds of adorable feline friends - then fill up your living room with a whole cat-alogue of kitties dressed up for the occasion!

title: Chibi Escape
description: Long ago, you were cursed. Now you have to fight for your life by either killing hopeless Chibies, or by trying to escape the map. Loot chests, hide from the Killer, use special abilities, collaborate with others, betray them. Do everything to escape from the map alive.

title: Shadow and Darkness
description: You are a explorer of new planets. As it turned out, other planets are inhabited by shadows that are very hostile. Your task is to survive several waves to win.

title: Clean Sweep
description: A 3D, comedic, character-driven, action-RPG where everyone in Cleanland is a personification of a cleaning product! As the town janitor you'll befriend the residents of Cleanland and team up with them to fight germs!

title: Fully Dogomatic
description: An auto shooter where you create a ring of guns around you to mow down thousands of enemies! You may be an adorable corgi, but that won't stop you from designing the ultimate arsenal of fully customizable, realistic weaponry.

title: Scorching Earth
description: Scorching Earth is a 32-map vanilla megawad for Doom 2. Inspired by Hellbound by Z86, Scorching Earth features highly detailed maps that are connected to each other to give the wad continuity.

title: Silhouettes
description: You see them in your dreams, only you can solve the riddle. Immerse yourself in crime, fantasy, horror events.

title: DGGWare
description: DGGWare is a collection of meme based micro games in the vein of WarioWare. The game centers around streamer Destiny's community and covers topics from gaming, politics, philosophy, debate, art, culture and drama.

title: Eldritch Tactics: Lichtmond
description: Eldritch Tactics: Lichtmond is a turn-based strategy game based on german folklore. After her untimely demise, the Burgund queen Kriemhild and her allied troops find themselves trapped in the Anderswelt where they face an onslaught of undead creatures as well as their own steadily declining sanity.

title: Rune Seeker
description: Rune Seeker is a strategy card game with a turn-based format, developed to become a tactical universe.

title: Let's Café
description: Let's Café is a cafe business simulator game with a quirky and cozy atmosphere. Manage your menu as you experiment and discover new recipes, keep your ingredient budget balanced while shopping to soup up your store, cook quickly and creatively, and serve up smiles to an array of characters!

title: It Started With Hairs
description:
A 5-10 minute visual novel about the horror of having a body.

Content Warnings for descriptions of body horror and self harm.

title: Subaru no Kishi
description: A fantasy SRPG.

title: SuKuBus-Mission
description: SuKuBus-Mission is an erotic role-playing game about a group of perverts trying to avoid the extermination of all lust.

title: Ninja Stealth 5
description: Ninja Stealth 5 is the new game in the series with a new challenge for you. Be stealth, evade from lasers, cameras, motion detectors and security guards. Collect all computers to beat the game.

title: The Great Conclovince of Mithrithnogg
description:
Enter the realm of Agrippa, where ancient gods and nightmare-inducing creatures rule supreme! This action-adventure game blends psychological horror with an intense story, which challenges players to survive in a reality distorted by malevolent forces.

In a realm where the line between reality and madness blurs, the face of the ancient god Agrippa lies atop a mountain, commanding legions of grotesque and contorted creatures. Once an artificial humanoid, now wields god-like powers and harbors a deep resentment towards his creators.

Agrippa's torment is relentless; he creates an alternate reality where every living being is a twisted reflection of Mongol, designed to break his spirit and mind.
You are the shadow of Agrippa, tasked with finding a suitable replacement for Mongol now that he is no longer of any use to him!

title: Ghost Dance
description:
David Lynch, filmmaker, artist, and musician, has not made a video game. He certainly did not make this video game. If he were to make one, however, maybe it would be something like this complete conceptual and artistic mess.

In this game you traverse a series of horror scenes directly indebted to Lynch films and artworks cobbled together in an incoherent fever dream. In this world, 'Lynch' is struggling to rebuild his creative world / abstract psychological state and he needs your help. Only you can traverse the inane dreamscape of Lynch's creations and make some sense of the terrible things that are about to be unleashed. But beware: not all is as it seems.

title: Connie and the Essence of Chaos
description: Connie and the Essence of Chaos is a cute 2D adventure inspired by past platforming classics. JUMP and PUNCH your way through 6 distinct and colorful worlds on your quest to defeat the evil overlord Lucilate and free the island of Cuisinia from his reign of terror!

title: They Grew Lungs and Drowned
description:
Explore the wreckage.

Speak with the survivors.

The Permanent Food Source has run dry.

Time to move on.

title: Serial World
description: "SerialWorld" is a comedic yet serious RPG. Whether you've played deck-building games before or not, everyone can enjoy this adventurous tale. Embark on a journey into the mysterious world to solve the city's disturbances!

title: Food Devils
description: You're the last chef in a post-apocalyptic world. Attract adventurers with monstrous food, make them sign contracts with the Food Devils and organize expeditions to collect wicked ingredients! Customize your characters, build the perfect restaurant and plan every move in this Strategy-RPG Roguelike.

title: Dwellink: War of the Nine
description: Dwellink is a dark fantasy creature collector RPG, set in a universe under siege. The Great Link opened portals connecting the Nine Worlds of Kohara, allowing ferocious Dwellers to spread chaos and destruction. It's up to you to discover the source of the cataclysm and end it once and for all!

title: Waffle House
description: Waffle House is a set of 9 MBF21 maps by a small group of people who decided to get together and answer a simple question: "What is bro waffling about?". Maps are balanced for pistol start, target port is DSDA, and difficulties are implemented.

title: Orca
description: Orca is a very short, single map-long WAD visually influenced by rd's Eden, and otherwise inspired by the song scp2.mid.

title: Farlands Journey
description: Farlands Journey is a colorful classic adventure platformer game where you play as a little witch fighting the evil forces. Embark on an adventure to recover the stolen heart of your Magical Academy. Discover various magic spells and hats with unique effects. Defeat monsters and their bosses. Solve puzzles by combining platforming skills and magical spells. Collect gems and spend them on upgrades in Magical Academy.

title: Signy & Mino: Against All Gods
description: Signy & Mino: Against All Gods is a new kind of combo RPG where you and your pup piece together flashy combos to dismantle a plethora of enemies! Discover your hidden powers as you find yourself hurtled into a conflict amongst the gods.

title: Skyblock Chaos
description: A skyblock sandbox crafting and building adventure

title: My Adaptation In(to) Human
description: It's a visual novel horror game that's published on Steam.

title: Make It Stop!
description: A 3D shooter that places the player in the cockpit of a ship traveling through the bloodstream, fighting off viruses.

title: Club Penguin Avalanche
description: Club Penguin Avalanche is an unofficial revival of the beloved Club Penguin made by fans, specifically crafted for and by Brazilian players. Featuring a dedicated launcher, this nostalgic virtual world offers a unique and immersive experience reminiscent of the original game. Players can waddle around as penguins, explore various places, and participate in fun activities and minigames, just like in the old Club Penguin.

title: Mugengikyou: First Disaster
description:
A Touhou Project doujin bullet-hell action RPG with Reimu as the protagonist.

The game is split into two parts, action and battle.
If you run into enemies or traps during the action stage, you'll start the battle portion.

title: Leaf's Odyssey
description: Leaf's Odyssey is a turn-based game where you fight various monsters in order to solve each puzzle. Every move can be predicted and anticipated. Failure is not punished; you can undo and try a different approach as many times as you want.

title: Mugengikyou: Second Departure
description: Mugengikyou: Second Departure is an Touhou fangame and one of the Mugengikyou series.

title: Math for the Real World
description: The player manages a rock band and must secure funds to producing music videos and become successful by managing the budget efficiently. This is achieved by completing objectives like keeping on schedule and ensuring the van does not run out of fuel.

title: Kebab Simulator
description: Cook kebab in comfort of your home

title: Sacred Earth: Reverie
description: Sacred Earth - Reverie is a fantasy RPG with visual novel elements, inspired by both classic and modern JRPGs. Explore dungeons, interact with your allies and the townsfolk, build your characters with equipment, abilities, and perks, and test your might against foes in thrilling turn-based combat.

title: Hyakusen no Jou ni Kawatareshi Toki
description: Hyakusen no Jou ni Kawataresi Toki is a Japanese RPG, released by Eushry on PC in 2024.

title: FaithEater
description: In a world where humans hunt the Gods for a chance at hope, you have betrayed the Faith Eaters. Given the highest punishment, you've been thrown into the Cathedral at the End of the World, where the God of Death Muerte has been imprisoned. You expect it to devour you without mercy. Instead, it offers you hope. The very same hope the Faith Eaters have taken away.

title: Favor
description: Survive Z's obsessive intrigue in 'Favor'; a yandere horror VN

title: Happiness Inc.
description: Inspired by Shark Tank, this short romcom visual novel lets you present yourself and answer your prospect client's questions to convince him to marry you. Good luck, and show off your flirting skills in a business manner.

title: Social Democracy: An Alternate History
description: Play as the Social Democratic Party of Germany in 1928, and try to stop the NSDAP from taking power. Guide the party through elections and parliamentary politics, and deal with the Great Depression and the spiraling political violence that characterized the late "Weimar Republic".

title: The Knight Dance
description:
Gather 'round, young and old.
Listen as I regale you with the tale of two lovers: one as sure as the other is stubborn.
Dancing shoes, a few stolen hours each night, and an important decision to be made.
Does love truly conquer...or is love never enough?

title: Werewolf Party
description: Test your deception skills in this thrilling first-person multiplayer game. Play with 4-11 people, taking on diverse roles—from a cunning werewolf to an observant villager, each equipped with unique powers. Pay attention to detail, listen for vocal cues, and use your perception to win.

title: Death in Unison
description: Survive the world's deadliest psychopaths. Experience a unique 2-player co-op experience that puts your teamwork and communication to the test. Complete your duties alone or with a partner in a prison like no other.

title: Solarys The Witch of Fire
description: Take control of the witch, Solarys, and fight your way through beat-'em-up styled levels, using kicks, punches, and fire magic.

title: Businessmen
description:
a group of businessman just arrived in delfino square, and they want to make sure they own all the coins around here.

traditional laws of physics don't apply for business.

title: Kaetram
description: Adventure through a large world, unlock secret areas, complete quests, and collaborate with others to defeat bosses and become the best!

title: Jurassic Tower Defense
description: Welcome to Jurassic Tower Defense! Command your defenses and fend off waves of dinosaurs in this thrilling tower defense game. Strategically build turrets and manage resources to protect your base. Are you ready to rewrite history and bring about the extinction of the dinosaurs?

title: Our Winding Road
description: Former heroes try to save their relationship.

title: Curse of the Juniper Tree
description: A story about two siblings and a cursed tree. Wishes come with a price.

title: Swiped! Double Shots of Love
description:
"Swiped!: Double Shots of Love" is a romantic visual novel featuring a slightly older cast of 4 main love interests. You can customise your MC's name and pronouns.

This game features cussing, I'd usually recommend for a slightly older audience due to the cast of dateables.

title: Casual Desktop Game
description: Casual Desktop Game is a fanmade revival of the old Desktop Destroyer game featuring community content. Relieve stress by smashing your desktop or unleashing war. Create mods and share them with the community.

title: Temple of Shadows
description:
Embark on an epic adventure as Sabastian Harrington, a passionate archeology grad student turned explorer, in search of his missing professor. Six weeks ago, Dr. Albert J. Montgomery III announced the discovery of a hidden temple, but he never returned. Now, Sabastian must dive into ancient temple ruins, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover hidden secrets. Will you reveal the mysteries within the Temple of Shadows?

Navigate the enigmatic Temple Ruins and unlock the secrets of the Temple Gate. Venture into the labyrinthine caves beyond, a realm filled with ancient mysteries and hidden dangers. Your mission: uncover the truth and track down the elusive Dr. Montgomery. Embark on this thrilling adventure and face challenges that will test your courage and wits at every turn. Can you reveal the secrets that lie within?

title: Cell of Empireo: RTC - Interlude
description: An interlude between Cell of Empireo: Isoi Sanemitsu no Records and Cell of Mirage.

title: Somnium Tenebris
description: Somnium Tenebris is a 5-player, investigative horror game set in a Lovecraftian world. Explore the depths of the ocean with your team as you uncover evidence in your efforts to identify the megalithic creature... and escape before it's too late.

title: Skyblivion
description:
Skyblivion is the ultimate fan-made experience for the Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion, bringing the game into the newer engine of the Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim. This process combines Oblivion’s impressive award-winning open-world that is renowned for its incredible gameplay, memorable quests, and expansive world space with the advancements in gaming that have been made in the last two decades. Set in the Elder Scroll’s Third Era, during the cataclysmic Oblivion Crisis, you must help to restore the Imperial throne and repel the demonic Daedric invasion.

Skyblivion will feature the remastered entirety of Oblivion’s mainland, Cyrodiil, from the wintery slopes of the Valus and Jerall Mountains to the swamps of Blackwood and warm-beachy shores of the Gold Coast. Skyblivion will bring the return of many classic Oblivion mechanics like spell crafting, a complete class and attributes system, underwater combat, and NPC disposition.

In addition to recreating Oblivion’s systems and porting them into the Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim’s engine the project has taken great care in providing new improvements and additions. Skyblivion offers fans remastered graphics, weather, and lighting, an expanded soundtrack, new gameplay mechanics, and even a limited selection of bespoke minor quests with original voice acting to further flesh out barren areas of Oblivion—all for free!

Once Skyblivion is released in 2025, fans will have access to the entirety of Oblivion’s pre-DLC world space, systems, and quests available for play. But that’s not the end of the project! Following a period of bug-fixing and community-supported updates the project development team will move on to working on Oblivion’s nine additional content releases plus the Shivering Isles expansion.

With Skyblivion you experience the best of both worlds: The complex and detailed RPG experience of Oblivion paired with Skyrim’s newer systems, graphics, and quality of life improvements. Will you close shut the jaws of Oblivion once more in 2025?

A outbreak just started!

A small town needs to protected themselves and wait for rescue to come.

Infecteds are all over the place! There is hope: they can't resist the daylight, but they can thrive at night.

Remains Of Nightfall is a strategy-shooter tower-defense in development.

title: Steam Prison: Beyond The Steam
description: The Heights are a gorgeous utopia. The Depths, a filthy industrial wasteland. Our heroine, raised in the Heights, has nothing but contempt for those below. Now an observation mission requires her to descend into that world, and the gears of fate have begun to turn.

title: Act Normal!
description: ACT NORMAL! is the first-ever ultra-realistic physics sandbox dating sim! All you need to do is to eat food and impress the girl, just like in real life.

title: Shadows of Progakko: Kuro
description: Progakkos were used to protect young people after a disease called "Blackout" emerged in a near-war situation between two countries. Adam starts living in Progakko, but doesn't trust the people around him, until he meets a girl who changes his life.

title: Cosmic Rain
description: Use spooky blobs from the Cosmic Rain in this Match 3 game to obtain power and achieve your ultimate goal of learning how to be a blobmancer!

title: Shards of Epoch Past
description: Eldritch entities invaded and destroyed your reality! All hope is long gone! Cling to your life for as long as you can in this simple, yet addictive, free-to-play platformer with Lovecraftian themes.

title: Phantom Watcher
description: Phantom Watcher is a chilling horror-strategy game. Survive the haunted hospital's mysteries, navigating ghostly behaviors in a unique CRT aesthetic. Each playthrough is a new eerie challenge. Dare to uncover the secrets?

title: Faint Call
description: Faint Call is a psychological horror game about a police officer investigating a distress call from someone at a notoriously cursed house.

title: Holy Clash Cards
description: With stunning visuals, immersive soundscapes, and intuitive gameplay, Holy Clash Cards offers an unparalleled gaming experience that will captivate both newcomers and seasoned veterans alike. Will you rise to glory, or will your faith falter in the face of adversity? The fate of your army awaits.

title: Two Sides of Hell
description: Blast through procedurally generated alien hellscapes in this twin-stick roguelite platformer. Transform between human and demon to unleash devastating combat and survive the endless cycle of chaos.

title: Gender Neutral Chess
description: A chess variant where you can transform pieces on the fly to add excitement to the classic game.

title: Magic Lantern Festival
description: Magic Lantern Festival is a hyper multitask 2D bullet hell. Players are required to recreate their brain in order to dodge all the magic bullets and answer random quizzes simultaneously.

title: Load Shedding
description: Load Shedding - Bad Dudes have taken over the island and stolen all of the power, it is up to You to stop them!

title: Keep Health!
description: Keep Health! Is a regional arena type rogue-like game, players will become a defender in the game, control several weapons against a variety of germs. Get a variety of weapons and items in the game to strengthen the guards, so as to overcome difficulties and complete the breakthrough.

title: Fly Fly Monster Truck 2
description: Get ready to fulfill your childhood dream of driving a monster truck in Fly Fly Monster Truck 2!

title: The Beauty
description: "Explore the nuanced dynamics of popularity in 'The Beauty' where players navigate the complexities of social integration and self-transformation.

title: Twizzle Puzzle: Dinosaurs
description: Twizzle Puzzle: Dinosaurs - is the perfect puzzle game for a fun and rewarding pastime.

title: I Don't Fall
description: You are Bellerophon, a hero who dreams of becoming a god and rises to the heavens and beyond. Overcome obstacles and trials to reach the heavens and become a god! But for some reason, Pegasus is the only one who seems excited.

title: Path To Dragon
description: A casual and short 2D precision platformer, starring lil-dragon on a journey back to his family.

title: Click On Ladybugs Together
description: Can you and your friends find all 100+ ladybugs in this panoramic level? Difficulty: Medium (but has small objects)

title: Fluxed
description: You have invented a Time Watch, and traveled back in time to stop a bomb from detonating in a building in New York City, which started World War 3 and thus destroyed most of humanity. You get 4 loops of the same 2 minutes in which to find the 3 terrorists, find the code, and diffuse the bomb.

title: Curse Bringer
description: In this text based game you assume the role of Sister Constance, a member of a secret organization responsible for delivering the Death Curse to marked targets. A new job has been assigned to you, but in order to end your target you must gather the ingredients and make choices.

title: Spookids
description: Spooky Land is a mysterious and treacherous place, but none of that will stop a group of mischievous kids' search for candy! Defeat monsters, avoid traps and collect candy in this shoot'em up adventure for up to 4 players coop.

title: Spooky Cooking
description: Have a nice Halloween in a lovely and casual way with a one-button game that tries to bring back the competition of the arcade era, where you need to shoot a pumpkin towards to a cauldron while dodging obstacles, a simple mechanic that's easy to understand, but hard to master, this game can please casual gamers as well as hardcore ones.

title: Thursday the 12th
description: In this first person adventure, you help our friendly serial killer Johnny in his routine, searching for all the stuff he needs to prepare for his big day. Interact with the items you find or inspect them to know what’s going through Johnny’s mind.

title: Tower of 100 Floors
description: Explore a creepy, demon-filled dungeon with 100 floors and save your city from certain doom with Sewer Cat and his partner Dirty Paws in this classic rogue-like style adventure!

title: Worship The Demon Lord With Friends
description: A 2-player party game where you compete with a friend to see who is the best worshiper of the demon lord!

title: Nemesis Tamatou
description:
You play a character named "7735", thrown into a deadly Game Show known as "Nemesis Tamatou" for the entertainment of the enigmatic "BLB Crew" and their stream viewers. On your way, you can buy upgrades in the shop aiding you on your journey, meet new friends along the way (or kill them for cash) and experience the overall insanity (along with a subtle identity crisis).
This game is based on the personalities and the humor of the BLB Show Youtube Channel.

title: Junk!
description: Do you have what it takes to be a Scrapper, or are you just another piece of JUNK? Battle with your friends, random opponents, or an AI trainer to unlock new robots, abilities, and customizations. JUNK! is a fast paced, arena 1v1 PVP brawler.

title: Panomino
description: The falling-block deck-builder that lets you reshape your blocks!

title: DOSMan: Space Aliens in Space!
description: Planet DOS is under attack by Space Aliens, DOSMan needs to fend them off and defend his home planet.

title: Skull and Bones: Deluxe Edition
description:
Enter the perilous world of Skull and Bones, a co-op pirate open world action-RPG experience, to become the most infamous pirate kingpin!

Deluxe Edition includes two additional missions plus digital art book and soundtrack.

title: Sker Ritual: Deluxe Edition
description:
An intense, round-based, zombie horror shooter by Wales Interactive. Play solo or up-to 4-players online, facing relentless waves of Quiet Ones whilst solving mysterious missions, uncovering Easter Eggs, upgrading steampunk weapons and obtaining Miracles — a vast network of Celtic God powers.

• Old-school round-based FPS action
• Play solo or up-to 4-players online
• Story continued from Maid of Sker ‘evil' ending
• Optional objectives & hidden Easter Eggs
• Supercharged ‘Elites' with unique abilities
• Collect and enhance 'Miracle' powers
• Explore free reward systems ‘Dread Levels' and ‘Sker Pass'

title: The Talos Principle Collection
description: This bundle includes The Talos Principle: Deluxe Edition and The Talos Principle 2.

title: Beat of Montezuma
description:
Rhythm and music style game with 80-s vibes will surprise you with new mechanics.
Go through portal labyrinths of the mysterious supreme idol and collect all coins.
Don't waste time, feel the rhythm of Montezuma!

title: Prison of Illusion
description: A young vampire is imprisoned in a supposedly abandoned castle. Help him escape from this magical prison.

title: MX vs. ATV: Legends - Ultimate Edition
description:
The Ultimate Edition includes the full game, 9 DLCs with over 60 additional tracks plus the 2024 Vehicle Pass with over 30 original manufacturer vehicles!

Get this ultimate bundle for a special price!

title: Clear Skye Thinking
description:
Alice Shah doesn’t want to go on holiday to Scotland, and she most definitely doesn’t want to go to grey, dreary Skye.

Alice has a love for elegant, classy clothes, and she spends hours on her appearance every morning. Alice considers herself a sophisticated, elegant lady, and she has no desire to go tramping through muddy fields to visit crumbling old castles.

Unfortunately for Alice, however, her dad is determined to spend their summer in Skye so he can meet up with a former friend, Ian Carter, and his family: his wife, the haughty Hilda, and their ginger spawn, the loud and boisterous Piper.

Alice hasn’t seen Piper since they were small children, and she has few memories of her. She doubts that she’ll be able to get on with anybody who lives on a teeny-tiny island full of sheep, but Alice is pleasantly surprised.

Piper isn’t as abrasive as her father, or as stuck-up as her mother. Piper is cheerful and laid-back, and she takes a liking to Alice almost at once.

A friendship begins to blossom between the two girls – but what will happen when Alice’s holiday ends and she has to go back to London?

title: Roomba Ruckus
description:
Why do cats randomly bolt around the house at 10:51 PM?

The answer, my dear reader, is simple. They're protecting their homes. You see, cats have been fighting an endless war for centuries against a nearly invisible menace: Dust Bunnies.

Every night, these mischievous little creatures rise up from the cracks in the floorboards to cause havoc, but our faithful felines stop them in their tracks.

In all this time, all the cats have been able to do is break even. They stop the bunnies, but expend all their energy for the day simply holding them off until the next. (Why do you think cats nap all the time? They're exhausted!)

Today, though, the tides turn in the cats' favor with the latest technology on offer.
Enter: The Roomba

With this dust-defeating droid, the cats don't need to lift a paw to protect their people! Finally, they can diligently defeat their fearsome foes!

title: A Missing Salesman
description: A missing salesman - This is a short first-person horror game (psx/ps1). At first glance it may seem that the game is quite simple, but to understand its meaning you need to go through it carefully to the end. The game has a tense atmosphere, screemers and sharp sounds.

title: Compress Space: Expanded
description: A puzzle-game where you can compress space.

title: Drill Core
description: Corporate greed meets strategic planet-mining in Drill Core! Drill to the heart of planets while managing workers, researching cutting-edge tech, and fortifying against alien attacks. Will you prioritize efficiency and risk your workers' safety, or focus on defense for survival?

title: Seaburn
description: Seaburn is a choice-based political simulator where your choices affect the future of the planet. Play as a policymaker as you sign legislations, respond to events, and attend interviews with drama-seeking journalists. Try to balance your popularity with the environment's health.

title: Tetram

title: Crabity
description: Embark on a cosmic adventure as a duo of two robot crabs stranded in the vastness of space. See the world from a different angle and utilize the power of gravity to escape the space station and return back to Earth!

title: Neverseas
description:
Ahoy, captain! Welcome and join us to find out the untold tale of Neverseas, where time and space is a dream and you are a sand grain in an endless lost sea that careless wanderer can fall into. The main question is are you brave enough to dive into it?

Neversas is an open-world sandbox action RPG from a third-person perspective. The game takes place in the era of graceful sailing ships and pirate romance, and you are invited to try yourself in the role of a real captain of a sailing ship. Here you have to manage a team, monitor the condition of ships, improve and modernize them, and you must also not forget about individual equipment, because on land you will not protect several of the modern capabilities of your ship.

title: Code Of Superheroes
description: A strategic turn-based game where you play a superhero in a randomly generated world. Battle villains, play side games and experience many different adventures with lots of choices and variation.

title: H Girl 4

title: The Rainman

title: Drone Adventure
description: Drone, Guns, Open World, GPL3

title: InstaTok Tycoon

description: A grand and intense tower defense science fiction game, where you only need to purchase once to enjoy all the content of the game.

title: Falco Tunes

This DLC is entirely centered around that mysterious weirdo that you love to love, with new dialogue, new events, and lots of Magic Man-themed furniture to make a shrine out of. We see you.

"Magic Hat" House Exterior, Magic Hat Rug, Lectern, Candelabrum, Summoning Circle, Tattered Curtain

In this 2D platformer, switch between Baby Bear, Mama Bear, and Papa Bear to navigate a variety of obstacles, as you roll, jump, swim, and smash your way through 50 challenging levels in 5 unique worlds!

title: D-Hospital
description: Survival Escape ARPG Control the protagonists as they explore a dangerous hospital overrun with mutants, find other survivors, and search for an escape route.

Over the course of 6 weeks, Ling seeks to find out more about this world in order to unravel the mysteries surrounding his own life... and his own death.

title: Up Down All-a-Round

title: Flame Protector: Sliding Kill
description: Keeping the flame burning is your only purpose. Flame Protector is a casual survival game where you protect the flames from an ever-increasing number of enemies until they reach the end of the flames.

title: Guard the Tower!
description: A tower defense game filled with 15 varied levels across 7 biomes and 14 unique monsters with 3 increasingly harder difficulties to challenge even the most experienced of tower defense gamers lurking in their strongholds.

title: Silenus
description: Uncover the secrets of an oil refinery operated by an obscure organization in this short, atmospheric narrative adventure.

title: Count to Ten
description: In this arcade-style game, chasing higher scores becomes an addictively fast-paced quest for precision. Count to Ten challenges you to tap numbered shapes in sequence, ramping up the challenge with every success. Pure, quickfire fun!

title: Knights of the Round Peg

title: Friendship Island
description: Escape from friendship island plagued by aliens. Classic FPS

title: Necromancer's Revenge
description: Become a necromancer betrayed by the Demon King. In this game combining survival, roguelite, and tower defense elements, defeat monsters, collect souls, and place totems. Summon the Demon King for revenge!

title: Lost Light: Bright Mates
description: "The object, becoming a light that dispels darkness, will shine as a hope to illuminate the world." Yes, that's a light bulb. A hard action adventure game where a brave light bulb overcomes shadows with its gleaming and daring rolls, aiming for an electric lamp.

description: A First Person Puzzle Game in which you fix the Logic behind the Puzzle, and then solve the Puzzle to verify what you fixed.

title: Feet Paradise
description: What is a paradise for the feet? It's when your feet are tender and gentle, when your feet are kissed and just admired. This is exactly Feet Paradise!

title: Sakura Isekai Adventure 2
description: The second part of the Sakura Isekai Adventure series. A yuri fantasy story about Aki, a young woman on a journey to rescue a kidnapped priestess alongside her companions, who might be more than just fellow party members.

title: Buzz is a VTuber: I want to be famous, even if it's just a game

title: Knight Runner: Blade and Bolt
description: Fight your way through an endless forest, slaying monsters, dodging traps, and chasing the highest score possible in this simple yet addictive pixel art runner.

title: Interplayer
description: Pick up the tokens, write the source code, and repair the data that your doctor has deleted! Write source code that achieves the input and expected output pairs set for each stage. The code is written in tolerance, a dedicated language.

title: Silencio
description:
Everything you see is hand-modeled in clay and animated frame by frame using the stop motion technique.

It is an experience of less than a minute that took several days to complete.

Achieve silence.🫀

Flop, slide, leap, and rocket around the city filled with zany future friends and mysterious architectures. Play eclectic mini-games where you will discover whether surgery can be joyful, if aliens have feelings, and how to deal with a bad boss.

title: Downward: Enhanced Edition
description: Enjoy the best version of Downward, with improved graphics and new assets... Live or relive a unique experience, as this new version adds new alternative endings.

title: Global Farmer
description: Farm the world in an immersive top-down management game that lets you choose your farm's location anywhere on the real-world map! Want to experience a rich strawberry harvest in the French countryside? Or challenge the hot sun in South America? The choice is yours!

title: Many Crimes of Serenity Falls
description:
You are Ashley Rose, a brilliant detective about to enjoy her long overdue vacation in a remote mountainous village: Serenity Falls.

Of course, your getaway gets interrupted. Of course, there was a murder.

A child is found dead, circumstances are mysterious, and every damn person in this town has something to hide

Look for clues, interrogate townsfolk, and deduce conclusions in this retro-style detective mystery puzzle!

title: No Loose Threads
description: A detective game about the complications of working for a LOT of legal entities.

title: thread and Needle
description: A mixed up conversation between a mixed up spy and his informant.

title: Vincent's Chocolate
description: Emily travels to the family home to attend a birthday party. However, an unexpected event will trigger a series of events that will make him question whether his family is hiding any secrets.

title: Withering Gardens
description: Follow the aged-up detective in the dystopian future, trying to regain his memories back.

title: Punch Club 2: Iron Fist
description: Build the robot champion and unravel the secrets of a mysterious AI in the new DLC for Punch Club 2: Fast Forward!

title: ONF: Tatakau Rasetsu he

Parody of the visual novel ONE ~Kagayaku Kisetsu e~
Mizuka and Akane routes are retold with health bar concept, parody and numerous immediate death situations.

title: Factory Outlet Simulator
description: Factory Outlet Simulator is a very comprehensive clothes manufacturing and selling game. You can produce the products of world famous brands in your factory and sell them. Or you can expand your business and create your own brand. Use your business acumen to lead the market from zero to the top!

description:
A Spectacle Fighter Card Game.

Play with 6 unique decks and fight your way through a gauntlet of foes. Not only do you need to fight to survive, but also pull off combos to maximize your spectacle points and please the crowd. Can you make it to the final boss and emerge victorious?

description: You have lost the love of your life. Overwhelmed by grief, you sit by her tomb, flipping through the pages of the journal that chronicles your life together.

title: Project Kinesis
description: Project Kinesis is a video game that blends card game combat, dice rolling, and collectable elements. Start by selecting your initial faction, then advance through each story chapter, collecting powerful cards to enhance your abilities.

title: Xenosphere
description: Drift, spin, dash, and golf your way in a journey through interstellar glyph space.

title: Woyo!!
description:
A french retro styled RPG inspired by Earthbound and Conker's bad fur day.

Play as Sam, freshly arrived in Montreuil City (in Paris's outskirts) from his native countryside, who finds himself embroiled in a series of incredible adventures.
Set off to discover this mysterious world, where you'll meet colorful characters who'll help you get to grips with local customs.
Learn to harness the power of the Shtrak to face down the dangerous enemies that stand in your way (pigeons, bandits, stroller moms and other hoodlums) and maraud them like a true narvalo de la Croix de Chavaux ! Will you be able to get out of trouble, or will you find yourself in the middle of it all ?
Your fate is in your own hands!

title: The Missing Sock
