title: The Cold Case
description:
You're one of our best element but were put in here after some ... trouble in your previous investigation.

You have a natural detective mind and are able to visualize the situation from the data noted during the investigation.

Put your experience to use and you may have the right to get back on the field

title: The Lightshield Report
description:
Alan works in Sentient Resources for the Dark Lord Xysryhfrx, and it appears multiple monsters in the underdungeon have claimed to have killed Gordon Lightshield, mid-level hero, in order to claim the eon-end bonus.

Ask each of the claimants what their story is, and provide the Dark Lord with a report as to who actually got the kill, and deserves the bonus.

title: Roomba Out!
description:
What's more annoying than the noise made by a Roomba? NOTHING! It's never a Shiba Inu's responsibility to withstand such an artificial "idiot."

Because you know what... they can ONLY turn RIGHT! So loud and unintelligent, the robot doesn't deserve to stay at my house. It's time to throw it out.

Roomba OUT! is a strategy game where the player needs to control the Shiba Inu to "guide" the Roomba out of the house, based on the fact that the idiot robot can only turn right when facing obstacles.

title: Roomba Rail Rider
description: Play as an extremely cool bird grinding on a plasma trail behind a winged roomba, as you shoot floating crystals to the beat of the music!

title: Primo Richards: Case 1
description: Detroit's number one detective in his first case! Play the role of Primo Richards as he solves the murder of a rich debutante in the city. Filled with an abundance of characters, locations, clues, twists and turns, you are challenged with finding the true culprit in the mystery.

title: Lost in Immortal Island
description:
Eternal life is a fascinating thing forever.

A long time ago, there were three mysterious islands hidden in the mist-shrouded sea. The ancient Chinese emperor Qin Shi Huang once sent Xu Fu to the east to find these islands, where the supreme secret of eternal life was hidden, but Xu Fu never returned......

What happened in between? Try to find the answer.......

title: Call of Duty: Black Ops 6
description: Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 is a first-person shooter co-developed by Treyarch and Raven Software, published by Activision in October 2024. It is the seventh entry in the Black Ops sub-series, set during the early 1990s Gulf War era. The game features a single-player campaign, competitive multiplayer with an omnidirectional movement system allowing players to sprint, dive, and slide in any direction, and a cooperative round-based Zombies mode. It had the longest development cycle in Call of Duty history at four years, during which the team rebuilt core Black Ops systems in a new shared engine.

title: Cyber Sleuth Simulacrum
description: Drinks, punks, capitalism, a Cyberpunk Neo-noir Visual Novel

title: Zoltan's Curse
description:
This is a game where it's up to you to decide how much of the story is enough.

You highlight words in dialogue by clicking and dragging, which gets you cards. Then, you use those cards to uncover a part of the story

title: Fractal Factory
description: factory puzzle game

title: Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader - Void Shadows
description: “Void Shadows” is the first DLC for Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader, offering a massive amount of content with about 15 hours of gameplay and a new romanceable companion.

title: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun - Forges of Corruption
description: You had a hell of a blast purging the heretics? Grab your holy chainsword, trusted bolter, and prepare for another adrenaline-pumping shootout, cause your favorite Ultramarine is back ! Bring Boltgun’s bloodfest to another level with its new DLC: Forges of Corruption. Dive into a brand new campaign consisting of 5 levels with varied environments inspired by the grim dark lore of Warhammer 40,000.

title: Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector - Astra Militarum
description:
For the Emperor!

Astra Militarum, the backbone of the Imperium’s might, are ready to fight in Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector. Sixteen new units are available to defend and fight for the Emperor.

title: Spirits of Mystery: Whisper of the Past
description: Your peaceful summer retreat is interrupted by Dark Reapers kidnapping your mother and chasing your Aunt. What do these dark spirits want? Are you going to be next? On your journey to save your family you will uncover a dark secret that your family has covered up for many years. Can you restore the bonds of trust or will those that you love remain lost forever to hatred and revenge? Find out in this charming hidden-object puzzle adventure game!

title: Warhammer 40,000: Darktide - Secrets of the Machine God
description:
Warhammer 40,000: Darktide releases its next update on June 25, 2024, on PC and Xbox Series X|S. This new update features (but is not limited to):

New Mission: explore a derelict Mechanicus research station in Atelium Foundryplex Omega V.
New Weapons: introducing the iconic Bolt Pistol, Ogryn’s first two-handed weapons, the Pickaxes, Shockmauls and a new double-barrelled Shotgun.

title: Talisman: Digital 5th Edition
description: Are you ready to experience Talisman like never before in Talisman: Digital 5th Edition? Play the newest digital adaptation of the iconic board game.

title: Warhammer 40,000: Mechanicus II
description: Fast-paced tactical combat meets strategic management in this sequel to the acclaimed Warhammer 40,000: Mechanicus. Take control of either the ancient and deathless Necron legions or the techno-religious acolytes of the Omnissiah, with the fate of a world in your hands.

title: Deer in the Headlights
description: Deer in the Headlights is a game about the strained relationship between a young deer and her dad as they drive to the airport. Navigate through a branched narrative to try and repair their relationship (or not).

title: Tiny Chao Garden DX
description:
Sonic Adventure and Sonic Adventure 2 had Chao Adventure. Sonic Adventure DX and Sonic Adventure 2: Battle had the Tiny Chao Garden. The Steam releases of those games have... nothing! That's where this project comes in. Designed to use the .chao format introduced by Fusion's Chao Editor and utilized by krzys2's Chao Exporter/Importer, this game allows you to interact with your Chao just like in the original Tiny Chao Garden!

More than just a simple recreation, Tiny Chao Garden DX has new enhancements and will feature more in the future! You can view a Chao's stats by opening the full menu, view item stats and descriptions in the shop and store your goods in a new inventory system.

title: Crown Wars: The Black Prince - Sacred Edition
description: The War of Crowns rages on. Knights, brigands and a mysterious evil force run rampant throughout the land, sowing destruction. Lead your domain into battle in this turn-based tactics and strategy game.

title: Space Fishing
description: Space Fishing: Explore, catch, win! Are you ready for a unique fishing experience in space? Explore different regions with your custom spaceship, catch exotic fish, and win unique rewards. An unmissable experience for space adventure enthusiasts!

title: Summoned By Accident
description: Summoned by Accident is a text based rpg focused mainly on m/m content with character driven plot. In it, you explore and run into inhabitants of the world. Some friendly, some foe. Inspired by other text based games and some videos.

title: Sheep Sweep
description: Sheep gone missing! Join a goofy solo or coop adventure. Use various tools in a fully flammable world, crack unique puzzles, bypass obstacles and safely recover all the missing sheep.

title: Cricket Captain 2024
description: Build your own dream team with Cricket Captain 2024. New commentary from Daniel Norcross tells the story of your matches. Honours boards showing every international century and five-wicket hall across all formats at every ground. Score predictor helps you manage your matches.

title: Voxel Project
description: Voxel Project offers an immersive sandbox experience set in a fully destructible voxel environment. Explore a dynamic world teeming with vehicles, dynamic fire mechanics, enemy NPCs, voxel gore, weapon customization, and a bunch of additional features to discover.

title: Vest A Life
description: The world is finally in an unreturnable condition. war, chemicals, nuclear, global warming, and widespread plastic pollution causing problems that are too late to fix, and now all humanity pays the price for it. Play as a survivor in Post-apocalypse 'Phuket'. Find resources in the MMO world of VAL.

title: The Necromancer's Pact
description: Ready to step into a world where curses came? Embrace your new life as Potman, fulfill the pact, and unravel the mysteries of the 'mancers. Where the wardrobe gets lighter, and the adventure gets heavier!

title: Marudachi
description: Marudachi is an action puzzle game that uses different Maru's abilities to let Maru get into the place they can't go on their own.

title: The Young Captain
description: It's a test of strategy, resource management, and leadership as you navigate the delicate balance between preparation and confrontation.

title: Undead Onslaught
description: "Undead Onslaught" is a Bullet Heaven RPG where you ascend as the villain. Master unique mechanics and strategic combat to dominate a dark, evolving world.

title: Nightfall Wardens
description: "Nightfall Wardens", a co-op horror survival game set on a reality TV show. Survive haunted zones, manage your Fear, and win sponsorships for survival boost. Will you entertain and survive, or succumb to the shadows?

title: Hunt: Showdown 1896 - The Reckoning Son
description: This DLC contains one Legendary Hunter, two Legendary Weapons, and one Legendary consumable: The Prodigal Son (Legendary Hunter), Soldier's Brother, (Drilling), Brave Charge (Scottfield Model 3 Swift), Breach Blast (Dynamite Stick)

title: Escape The Void
description: Escape The Void First Person is a single-player cooperative horror exploration game. In this game consisting of different levels, your only goal is to survive and find the exit. While doing this, you will need to use your logic, solve puzzles and take each step carefully. You must be alert to the..

title: Necromancia
description: NECROMANCIA! A skele-puzzle type game where your bones and your wit may guide ye through the delving of the dungeons and catacombs. Take command of your undead hordes and collect the spreads to form the ultimate sandwich!! The only brain your minions will be eating is yours!

title: Meta Match
description: Meta Match is a unique take on the popular match-3 formula. Move the player block across the board and swap places with neighbouring blocks. Unleash the power of Metamorphosis mode and let the scores soar to unimagined heights!

title: Mr Mitty and the Itty Bitty Kitty Committee
description: Disaster has struck the island of cats! A ferocious storm has snatched the committee's important letters, plunging the feline paradise into chaos. But fear not, Mr. Mitty, is on the case!

title: Northgard: Garm, Clan of the Hounds
description: The Sons of Ragnarök, as they have come to be known, are indeed as destructive as the event their past leader, Hvedrung, worked so hard to unleash. Freed from the gods' restrictions, they might indeed be the nightmare Northgard feared…

title: From Them
description: A short first person wave defense surrounding mutant creatures invading your town. Collect materials and fire power from the hardware and gun store, build traps to defend yourself, and survive 6 nights. Comes with Unreal Engine 5 project files.

title: Pampas & Selene: The Maze of Demons - Pirate Software's Ferret Sanctuary
description: This DLC contains a special Ferret Pet in collaboration with Pirate Software! 100% of developer proceeds from this pack will be used to support Pirate Software's Ferret Sanctuary. Have your very own furry ferret friend follow you around!

title: Puffin Planes
description: A casual airline management game set on a globe. Supports singleplayer and Steam co-op.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2022: BR Diesel Brake Tenders
description: This pack contains 3 types of British Railways (BR) brake tenders, 2 prototypes and 1 main production variant, which includes 3 different types of bogies, with 3 different period liveries in clean and weathered versions.

title: Cyber Commander: Zombie Revenge
description: Cyber commander: Zombie Revenge is an exciting game in the Tower Defense genre. Build ingenious lines of defense to withstand the next onslaught of monsters. Will you have enough strategic skills to survive another night?

title: Just Find It 4
description: Lots of Difference-Finding Fun in Just Find it 4!

title: Rogue Bot Adventure
description: Rogue Bot Adventure is an on-rails 3D platformer. Your goal is to collect the 10 parts of your ship and escape the enemies and hazards of this mysterious planet, including robots, lasers, acid, meteors, and more. Jump, slash, and reflect using your ancient artifact.

title: The Best Treasure
description: The Best Treasure is a precision platformer game where an adventurer enters a mystical cavern inhabited by felines. He must gather treasures as a bargaining chip to save his brother, transformed into an insect by dark magic. Each jump and climb brings you closer to the cure and the true treasure.

title: Sail the Seas
description: Sail the Seas is a sailing, trading simulator set in 18th century, spanning whole world

title: Coffee Mania
description: Experience seven nights in the apartment, being dependent on coffee, prepare for power outages, make sure the mining farm doesn't break down, exercise caution in the darkness. You won't be alone for sure!

title: Shoot Star
description: Enjoy boss battles in a cartoon world! "ShootStar" is a 2D shooting action boss battle game.

title: Pretend Cars Racing 2
description: An old school top-down racer with split-screen multiplayer, track editor and night and day transitions.

title: Swing Scale
description: Swing Scale is a game that uses centrifugal force to explore various worlds and aim upward. Adjust the length of the wire, adjust the speed, and push the limits.

title: Fuel Station Simulator
description: Transform an abandoned fuel station into a thriving business hub! Manage, customise, and expand your empire!

title: Generality 4
description: This pack has a little bit of everything, although it's mostly focused on QoL features and basic tech mods. The main idea, much like the rest of the Generality series, is to feel like its own game, totally separate from Minecraft.

title: Girls are Weird
description:
Girls Are Weird is a short dating sim. You can't win, so it's just like talking to a real girl.

Created for Pirate Kart 2 in 2 hours

title: Mecharashi
description: This is a SRPG which you use mechas in turn-based combats. It was the new "Front Mission" game for mobile, but it had to change names, while it still holds almost the same gameplay

title: SkateCat
description: Embark on a purr-fect 8-bit adventure with SkateCat, the ultimate platformer game where you step into the paws of a fearless feline skater!

title: Love Palette: Koi-iro Palette
description:
"Love Palette - 恋色ぱれっと -" is a visual novel game where the protagonist Takumi, who leads a fairly fulfilling school life, repeatedly goes on dates with the beautiful girls of the school to deepen his relationships and find a cute girlfriend.
A Bishojo Game released in 2015 under the "Yuki Ichigo Chocolat" brand has been reworked for the "PandaShojo" platform for players around the world to enjoy.

title: Rainbow Diamonds
description: Travel the galaxy in this pixelated 2D adventure

title: Color Water Sort
description: It's time to show how smart you are! Test your puzzle-solving skills in this water sorting game!

title: SnowRunner: Season 13 - Dig & Drill
description: Season 13: Dig & Drill is included in the Year 4 Pass. Requires the base game SnowRunner to run.Authorities in Almaty need your help to kickstart a new mining venture! With 2 new vehicles, run surveys, deliver equipment and reopen a cargo airport.

title: Jujutsu Kaisen: Cursed Clash - Hidden Inventory/Premature Death
description: Includes playable characters, character costumes, and additional scenarios for use in Jujutsu Kaisen Cursed Clash.

title: Yohane the Pathelion: Change set "Nightwicked Night"
description: A new costume that can be a great master is now available!

title: Aery: Peace of Mind 2
description: Calm down from the hassle of your daily life, experience the feeling of flying, and immerse yourself into beautiful and atmospheric landscapes.

title: Escaping DandyLand
description: Strange, colorful and unusual; Escaping DandyLand is unlike any else preceding in the genre of frustration platformers. Can you traverse the central spire and escape? Can you piece the secret of its true nature together?

title: Five Nights at Roner's 2
description: Searching for fast money, you stumble upon an ad for a paranormal investigation. Upgrade your office, maintain your systems, and above all else: don't let them get to you. It's easy work, right...?

title: One Chance
description: One Chance is an addictive game that puts your reaction time to the test.

title: Hotel Overloop
description: You've stucked into a loop in the mysterious hotel. Find anomalies to escape the hotel's loop.

title: Martian Routine
description: Martian Routine is casual 3D walk simulator game about astronaut on Mars with puzzles. You will embark on a journey across the Red Planet and walk through the Martian desert landscapes, repairing vehicles and solar panels to survive and move forward.

title: Aria Skies
description: Soar to new heights in Aria Skies, a 2.5D indie fighting game featuring free-flying movement that anyone can pick up and enjoy!

title: Fool's Gambit
description: A rogue-like turn-based card strategy game where you have to play and beat an unknown opponent in a game of Blackjack with tarot cards.

title: Nomu
description: In "NOMU," navigate the undead-infested Nevada desert, scavenging supplies, fortifying your vehicle, and evading relentless zombie hordes. Beware the Wendigo, a sinister creature of myth preying on the lost and desperate. Will you defy the odds as a survivor or succumb to the apocalypse?

title: Medieval Chaos
description: Survive in this Medieval world for as long as you can, evolve your weapons and collect different skins!

title: Turf Battles
description: Become a legend as you amass PK Points, conquer & defend islands/turfs from enemy players for valuable rewards, and progress through the game in all of its PvE and PvP glory.

title: Parlor Board 3D
description: 3D Board Game with Dice

title: Ghostein
description: Guide a boy, hide him and escape from the Nazi camp using posters! Ghostein is a short stealth game. You control the ghost of the father, who died in the gas chamber, who returns to save his son from the same fate. With the posters you give the command that the boy needs to do.

title: Live Day
description: This is a game that combines construction, shooting, and tower defense with a third person apocalyptic theme. In the apocalyptic environment, let players build apocalyptic strongholds that are suitable for their survival.

title: Solnox: Grimoire of Seasons
description: Become the master of seasons in this tactical turn-based deckbuilder. Dominate the ever-changing battlefield by unleashing the four seasons and utilizing their terrain-altering effects. Learn to create perfect synergies & guide your three sorcerers to victory against unholy creatures.

title: Hidden Chibis in Combinis
description: Hidden Chibis in Combinis is a FREE hidden object game asking you to find cute Chibis hidden in Combinis. Can you find them all?

title: The Sacred Memory
description: The Sacred Memory is an ADV-visual novel with an exciting plot, mysterious events and vibrant characters. Reveal the secrets of MEMORIAL as the superpowered youngster!

title: Phantom Line
description: Join the paranormal SWAT. PHANTOM LINE is a co-op (1-4) shooter set in the post-nuclear European continent. Your mission is to search and contain paranormal events and activities (anomalies) hidden from the public eye, in an open world map full of dynamic events.

title: Deathless: The Hero Quest
description: A roguelike deck-building game set in the universe of the Tales of Old Rus that features epic Slavic heroes and monsters.

title: Echoes in the Deep: A Fateforge Tale
description: It’s time for one last heist. How you achieve it is down to you. Explore the Free City, prepare and equip your crew, keep them loyal and navigate the difficult choices you’ll need to take to succeed.

title: Backrooms: Liminal Conflict
description: Backrooms: Liminal Conflict is a PvP backrooms game with different factions.

title: The SpudFather
description: In "Spudfather," become Spud, a charming secret agent on a veggie-fueled mission. Use charisma to disarm foes, especially the beauties who make Spud blush. This ain't your average garden - it's a world where bad guys are ripe for the pickin'!

title: PixAnt Farm (Idle)
description: This idle game allows you to simulate and grow a colony of pix-ants. You can watch as they autonomously explore the screen, eating pellets, and earning you new ant colorations and automatic feeder upgrades. You can also give the ants names, and interact with them in various ways.

title: Ghoul Fright
description: Ghoul Fright is a physics based FPS Survival Beat em up with a 90/2000s cartoon vibe, fight dangerous Ghouls as you cause destruction and chaos in your way while hell unleashes in heated Ghoul waves. ¿Ready to Fright?

title: I Commissioned Some Butterflies 2
description: I paid artists to hide butterflies and flowers in 15 artworks. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

title: Xi-Portal
description: Unravel the Mystery of Xi-Portal You'll have the chance to join a diverse community of students and explore the exciting world of Xi-Portal alongside captivating characters such as Schneider, Hikari, Ayako, Ai, and KakaMigu.

title: Mound of Music
description: "Mound of Music" is a game dedicated to the art of MUSIC, presenting a captivating sci-fi story. Experience unique gameplay that lets you explore humanity's past through the universal language of music. Embrace beautiful classical music from around the world, fate and the truth are about to emerge.

title: Miko Sniper
description: Sakura Miko and 35P are ready for battle! Miko Sniper is a chaotic shooting game where you get to shoot, burn and explode your enemies!

title: Nocturnal Relics
description: In Nocturnal relics you play as May who is trying to escape a monster while trying to get out of a museum. Is the monster in her head or did she release an ancient evil into the world?

title: Pyradice
description: Challenge your friends in building the pyramid! Can you judge the greed of your fellow players correctly? Only then will you become the next ruler of Pyradice!

title: Escape from Hornhead
description: Escape from Horn head is 3D horror game. You need to find the keys and potions before he catches up with you. Explore the rooms, look for objects and avoid the pursuer. Try to find the best way, remember the movement of the Horned-headed demon chasing its victim, that is, you.

title: Survival 2099
description: Survival 2099 is an open world survival crafting game. Human beings have been discharging nuclear wastewater into the sea for a long time, and Marine creatures are slowly mutated by radiation. In 2099, the apocalypse comes, and the terrible creatures after mutation begin to attack human beings.

title: Roiders
description: Become an asteroid miner and loot your way to supremacy! Fight waves of vicious aliens or battle against your friends.

title: Office Dreaming
description: Office Dreaming is an exciting 3D puzzle game for finding objects in a cozy office. There are many items on the location, there are numerous tables, office equipment, gaming tables and other office decorations. The player must explore every part of the location to find the necessary items.

title: Cubic Tetris
description: Have you tried 3D tetris?

title: AsiaKingdom
description: AsiaKingdom is an exciting hidden object 3D puzzle game in an Asian setting. There are many objects on the location, there are numerous pavilions, fountains, bridges and other Asian decorations. The player must explore every part of the location to find the necessary items.

title: Dish Up Fruit
description: Dish Up Fruit is a 3D puzzle game where you combine fruits and arrange them on a plate. Enjoy the colorful design and changing fruits as you play. Load up on lots of fruit and beat your high score now!

title: Charming Hearts
description: "Charming Hearts" is a real-life interactive dating game. Players will meet, get to know, and fall in love with different types of beauty. Every choice will lead to a completely different chemical reaction with "her"; every entanglement, the sweet love is entangled and pulled.

title: Throw Bro
description: Throw Bro is a Gameboy style 2D platformer where you throw things to solve problems and beat enemies!

title: Secrets of the Heartbeat
description: Confronted with life's peak, diverse romance beckons. Do you choose the allure of a charming secretary or the wisdom of an independent yoga instructor? Will you pursue distant celebrities or seek the sincerity of a working girl's love? Each choice shapes your journey.

title: Laruaville 15
description: Help the Alien restore his crashed UFO and find the way home!

title: Felon-E
description: Felon-E is an investigation game where players must infiltrate a secret robot sect, interact vocally with NPCs to collect clues, and gain the trust of the robotic priest Colbert Metalcreux to solve the mystery.

title: Bullet Rain
description: This Game is a classic First Person Shooter. As it is still in development features and weapons will be added step by step. We hope you will enjoy our work!

title: Neon Village
description: This game is a fusion of a "roguelike deck-builder" and "match-3 puzzle". Collect unique residents to create explosive synergies and develop a village glittering with neon!

title: The Legend of Lumina
description: A block pushing puzzle game with metroidvania style progression, set in a serene forest world.

title: Super Dash
description: Dash through enemies, collect power ups and survive waves of enemies in this fast paced bullet-hell

title: Unearthing Invasions
description: A 3d tower defense game set in space. Protect the last resource outposts from the ongoing Alien attacks! Can you hold out in these ever increasing difficult waves of enemies and protect the last of your resources and Energy?

title: Harvest Hustlers
description: Harvest hustlers is a chaotic couch co-op farming game for one to four players. Working together, you and your fellow farmers must grow vegetables, feed animals, cook and serve orders to the demanding farmers market visitors before they leave in anger.

title: SuperSuperMarket!
description: WELCOME TO MARKETING CITY!" SuperSuperMarket! is a tycoon based on time and money management ! Build, sell, improve your shop and your character to stay in town...

title: Empty Shell: The Loop
description: Empty Shell: The Loop will take you into The Loop, a secret facility built on a Japanese island in the middle of nowhere. Volunteers are forced to enter the eerie rooms of the complex, seemingly without an exit. But what is that massive door in one of the rooms? Is there perhaps a way to escape?

title: Moonlight Rabbits
description: Dive into the serene world of Moonlight Rabbits, an idle game where you help adorable rabbits build a tower to the Moon by collecting carrots. Unlock unique rabbits, enjoy relaxing gameplay, and achieve your lunar dreams in this charming adventure!

title: Burger
description: Burger is a clicker cooking game where you just click to make burgers — more and more burgers! Thinking about pizza or eggs? Think again, because it's all about burgers!

title: The Storyteller
description: The Storyteller is an indie game developed by a single person, where one player becomes the storyteller narrating mysterious tales, while others attempt to unravel unexpected solutions. A multiplayer experience blending suspense and questionable humor.

title: Blinding Lite
description: Blinding Lite is an action-adventure platformer that focuses on tight acrobatic platforming. Venture forth and save the Elementals from their capture! Experience a flowing move set, a world brimming with character, and a world painted in NES colors!

title: Love Red
description: This is an independent game! It's quite difficult! You need to have love, courage, and wisdom to pass the level! It has a unique gameplay. I hope you can experience endless fun from it! This is definitely worth it! Hope everyone likes it! I will do better!

title: OneKind
description: Three bad friends on a farm... Fast or slow, brave or master of hiding, everyone is the enemy... However, the only owner of the farm... Remember, the most reliable defence is hiding... This game invites you into an exciting world, whether you are a hunt, a huntsman or a spy!

title: Sea of Change
description: Sea of Change is a game that blends exploration with strategic base defense. Build, defend, and expand your base against waves of enemies, all while uncovering the mysteries of a dynamic world that shifts with every playthrough. Set sail to find islands and collect resources. How long can you last?

title: Snowsquall Grip
description: Escape the snowy nightmare or be trapped forever — your call.

title: Team of Titans
description: The evil Mirror Clan holds dominion over the region of Latos. Everyone has lost all hope, except for one. An unlikely hero must build a Team of Titans and bring an end to the reign of tyranny.

title: Delivery Driver Service
description: Let's work together to rebuild the region's infrastructure and overcome the challenges left behind by the devastating hurricane. By doing so, we can create new opportunities in the world of Delivery Driver Service.

title: Dustland Delivery
description: Dustland Delivery is a post-apocalyptic survival business simulator. Scour the wastes for profit, complete missions to grow your trading empire, and assemble a rag-tag band of adventurers to turn your city into the capital of the Dustlands. Danger lurks around every corner—but no risk, no reward!

title: Farmageddon: Undead
description: Farmageddon Undead is Tower Defense, Strategy game based on post-apocalyptic Story. Step into the role of a farmer who must save the world! Lead the world leaderboards! This game won't give you anything for free. Prepare yourself, you might suffer.

title: Moccoletti
description: Prepare for chaos on the stage tonight when a game of Moccoletti starts! Lead a merry chase through the gardens, hiding in the dark to protect your candle while using your fan, snuffer or blow-dryer to blow your friends away in Moccoletti: a 2-4 player arena shooter with wind instruments.

title: Soul Interface
description: You explore an alien machine, learn to operate it, create virtual organisms, and grow an artificial ecosystem inside it. You design species down to individual atoms and watch them fight for survival. You then send successful species to other players to leech energy from them and power your machine.

title: Cyber Clutch: Hot Import Nights
description: Cyber Clutch: Hot Import Nights is a high intensity arcade combat racer set in a neon future. Compete in ranked online races, unleash tactical abilities and outdrive rivals across chaotic circuits. Choose your ride, customize your style and dominate the track.

title: Crack it Up!
description: Crack it Up! is a trading card collecting game. Order booster packs from your 90s computer, crack them up, sell your duplicates and rarest cards for profit and complete your collections!

title: Alone in the School
description: A girl who has lost her memory must collect five scattered memory fragments in the school to remember the events of that day.

title: S.I.P. SE: Safety is Power
description: The story revolves around a 23 year old unemployed NEET, Makoto Asaka, who is otherwise an "ordinary" citizen of Wakui City living in a rundown apartment. Makoto doesn't have any money but has been skirting the law for some time through tax evasion, abuse of Japan's basic "National Pension System", and odd jobs or "gigs" working under the table, becoming more behind on his fiscal obligations by the day. However, there is another odd phenomenon that has developed in Wakui City that Makoto did not immediately become aware of known as the "New Stalking Law", which grants protection and partial asylum to qualified candidates who have garnered the attention of unscrupulous parties. This system was put in place at Wakui City to divert resources to an emerging problem that the local police could not manage on their own, and is designed for rather extreme cases. In order for it to work, the "PG (Public Guardian) System" was created to assign benefactors who perform tasks on the behalf of their clients.

title: Bond
description: Bind together to solve puzzles!

title: Fest Guests
description: Open world one man survival game. Save your hometown from alien invasion - other people are abducted. First fight with simple weapons until you get alien technology. The battlefield is every street, shop, office, apartment, subway, etc. in a highly interactive city.

Players will be integrated into the deduction story, using AI assistants to deeply investigate clues, examine evidence, and uncover the truth behind the case through logical thinking and deduction.

description: I know, it should be one "s". I don't mind. In a surreal and mysterious world, a piece of heaven fell onto a hill below the sky. Since that day, none have seen the top of that hill, even though all have longed to. You intend to change that... don't you? This is a top down pixel art rpg.

title: Yee-Haw!!

title: Yesterday's News

title: World Fantasy 2
description: World Fantasy 2 is a classic RPG set in a fantasy world where there is an eternal struggle between the forces of good and evil. The protagonist will travel through the game world hoping to find the four heroes who once defeated the evil.

title: Would You Sell Your Soul
description:
Immerse yourself in a mysterious story where you make the choices and decide the ultimate fate of others!

Comino is a new graphic novel app that aims to share many different types of stories, whether it is mystery, romance, thriller, supernatural, slice-of-life, young love, or others, there is sure to be something for you!

title: Wrestler Rush
description: Wrestler Rush is a first-person, chair-throwing, backstage wrestling, kerfuffle where you concuss wrestlers backstage with an array of weapons from chairs to bowling balls across the UK wrestling independent scene!

title: Wrong Escape
description: An escape room puzzle game

title: Halls of Greed
description:
Dive into the immersive roguelite RPG experience of Halls of Greed where every decision shapes your fame and fortune. Halls of Greed delivers a thrilling blend of intense PvPvE combat, the hunt for rare loot, and strategic extraction mechanics that will keep you coming back for “just one more round.”

Set in a world teeming with ancient magic and sinister creatures, players will embark on perilous journeys to extract valuable treasures from treacherous dungeons. But beware, fellow adventurers lurk in every shadow, ready to thwart your progress and claim the spoils for themselves.

Create characters from a diverse selection of classic fantasy archetypes, each with unique abilities and playstyles. Will you embrace the devastating spells of the mage, the discipline of the knight, the precision of the ranger, or the ferocity of the primalist? Each class offers a distinct approach to how you dominate the battlefield. Whether you're engaging in one-on-one duels or clashing with rival parties in team-based skirmishes, every encounter offers unique advantages and disadvantages so choose wisely!

However, the true measure of success lies in your ability to collect rare and powerful loot scattered throughout the crypts, castle ruins, and dungeons. Uncover legendary weapons, enchanted artifacts, and valuable resources that will enhance your abilities and secure your dominance on the battlefield. Be sure to extract through one of the magical portals using a keystone and return to camp where you can improve your character, level up your loadout, and give yourself key advantages for the next run!

title: Cabin Crew Life Simulator
description: Welcome to Cabin Crew Simulator, the pioneering flight attendant simulator by SOGA Std. Dive into the glamorous world of aviation and kickstart your career by ensuring passenger satisfaction and safety. Navigate through exciting tasks on each flight, from serving gourmet meals to managing in-flight emergencies, providing an unparalleled passenger experience.

title: Meet Me at The Workers' Club
description:
An interactive reconstruction of Alexander Rodchenko's Workers' Club, originally exhibited at the 1925 World Expo in Paris.

The virtual copy of the constructivist installation is accompanied by posters, photographs, and breezy texts tracing the historical context of workers' clubs in the Soviet Union, as well as personal musings about the role of the artist in a time of revolution.

The game functions as a walking simulator or interactive art exhibit, and players can look at individual works to find out more.

title: Twisted Screens
description: In Twisted screens, you take control of Tessa an employee of Razzycat entertainment as she find herself in the Abandoned ATR facility with horrible experiments running loose in the facility. Tessa must team up with A.I companion Legsy to escape.

title: Major League Curveball
description: Welcome to the Major Leagues! In Major League Curveball, you dodge, strike, and get smashed by homing balls as you compete against players in this fast-paced, last player standing sports brawler.

title: Unpossess
description: Unpossess is a 1-4 co-op exorcism simulator game set in the early 1900s. Players take on the role of exorcists responsible for addressing cases of human possession.

title: Cupiclaw
description:
Cupiclaw is a cute & frantic claw machine roguelike deckbuilder.
Grab unique prizes, build powerful combos, face chaotic machines… and claw back your relationship!

title: Pavement Pummel
description: Welcome to Pavement Pummel, an exhilarating multiplayer physics-based bike racing game. Engage in thrilling races against players worldwide across diverse landscapes. Master the art of strategy, skill, and speed. Navigate through city streets, mountain trails, or off-road terrain.

title: RiseExplosion
description: Easy rolling action game. Surmount the obstacles to get to the goal.

title: DeafBlind
description: DeafBlind offers an immersive sensory deprivation experience, simulating what life might feel like if you were both deaf and blind. This game invites you to navigate a world shrouded in silence and darkness, challenging you to adapt and explore in entirely new ways.

title: Naomi Clicker
description: Naomi Clicker is a simple illustration collecting game. Click on Naomi and collect & combine items to collect Naomi’s illustrations!

title: Bodacious Babes: Holidays
description: The Bodacious Babes are heading home this holiday season, come meet all the girls. Work your way through over 30 unique puzzle levels to unlock 100+ HOT and SEXY photos of the babes.

title: Arena of Block Puzzle

description: Hey! Wanna rise to the top at a festival stall? "Ultra Mushroom" is a high-energy game where you run a mushroom stall at a three-day festival and see how much you can earn. Gather mushrooms in the mountains by day and sell them at night. The key? Rhythmic banter and Ultra Mushrooms that bring joy!

description: Goblin Kart Rescue is a top-down racing game, with 24 short but challenging tracks against a CPU opponent. After saving all the princesses by winning in story mode, try beating your own time in Time Attack, or see how many races you can clear in the difficult Endless mode!

title: Shadow of the School
description: The player finds himself in an abandoned school, which was once a place of study for local schoolchildren. The protagonist is a paranormal researcher who came here to solve the mystery that shrouds this gloomy location.

title: Intimate Abode
description: "Discover a unique experience of self-discovery and pleasure in the game 'Intimate Abode'. Explore your apartment and enjoy intimate moments in different locations, trying out different dildos and dildos. Release your sensuality and immerse yourself in a journey of personal pleasure."

title: Blue Land
description: Craft, fight, explore, and play with your friends! In this Open-World, 2D, CO-OP experience, you can do that all! The choice is yours...

title: Unknown Rules
description: Unknown Rules is an independently created multiplayer online horror game that supports 1-4 players.

title: Silverpine Creek
description: Explore the chilling village of Silverpine Creek, trapped in fog and fear. Unravel its dark history as a reporter trapped within, facing the malevolent witch Korana. Realtime Physics gameplay, immersive VHS-style visuals, and reactive AI heighten the suspense in this harrowing tale of survival.

title: Shadows in the City
description:
Discover the hidden secrets of NeoCity in "Shadows in the City", the detective novel that immerses you in a world of mystery, conspiracy and futuristic science. He accompanies intrepid detective Alex Mercer as he confronts the shadows that lurk in the alleys of this futuristic metropolis.

Facing corporate conspiracies, political corruption, and banned scientific experiments, Mercer will unravel the truth behind the disappearance of scientist Claire Reynolds. The city, a crucible of technological advances and hidden shadows, becomes the scene of an epic confrontation between light and darkness.

title: Dear Elonai
description: Travel back in time in Dear Elonai, a noir point and click game and try to avoid the death of your love live.

title: Ball-it Hell
description: Dodge! Strike back! This is a fast-paced barrage arcade game. Move the character to dodge bullets. Pick the right time to strike bullets back and destroy enemies to get gold coins. Unlock more characters and powerful skills. Keep challenging yourself to get higher scores and rankings.

title: Archipelago Explorer
description:
Your sailing ship has been drifting with the tide for weeks - there is no wind.

Finally you dropped anchor near a chain of islands that you recognise - the Biuso Archipelago. The only information you have about the area is an unfinished book from one of your former shipmates.

You have been chosen to go ashore, figure out which island you’re on, and scope out possible water and food supplies.

title: Doctor Voldritch's experiment
description:
This game is not really intended for first time recreational hypnosis, LavLabs has an introduction to hypnosis and Mezmaglitter's new age route is better suited.

This is a sci fi visual novel intended to hypnotize you with suggestions/triggers and a bonus QnA at the end. For those not familiar with hypnosis, the game is suppose to relax you and make you calmer (think of it similar to a guided meditation app but with a science-y theme). I didn't make it with the intention for people new to hypnosis at all. Please research hypnosis before doing it, especially recreational hypnosis.

title: Mezma's Revenge
description: A new addition to the past hypnotic visual novels involving 2 new hypnotists, each with their own style. You can pick New Age Bloof for a meditative journey, Dr. Voldritch if you miss his devious mad scientist charm or if you want something more intense, Elijah, a scheming super villain who likes brainwashing.

title: Medivination
description:
A relaxing journey into the soul; Medivinations is a combination of meditation and divination, where the goal is not to predict the future but to ground yourself to the present. The goal is to be able to replay over and over again as each reading is random and up to you to decide if it works with your vibe or not as you're the true guide of your life, wanderer✧∘* ✧･ﾟ

You will be guided by a funky little bunny to chill out and let go of stress with various calming readings from planets, tarot, zodiac and more!

It's a short game, about 3-5 minutes but can be replayed as each reading is random.

title: There's No Socks
description: Have you ever struggled to find the second sock? That's because there's no socks! There's No Socks is a hidden object game with a selection of 4 locations and random socks to find for each of them.

title: Escape from Somnium
description: Escape From Somnium is a fan-made AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES x Zero Escape crossover fan game, featuring over 5k words and high-resolution, 4K graphics.

title: What's on Agenda
description: A short, chill social clicker where you shape the narrative of the newly formed SARO Federation. Follow Jan Eteri, a prominent lawyer, and see how propaganda changes society's perception.

title: Hypnotica Quest
description:
Welcome to Hypnotica Quest! You find yourself in a strange little sleepy town that is obsessed with hypnosis. Your curiosity gets the better of you and you sign up for an experiment at the laboratory at the end of the street.

This is a little walking simulator game where you get to experience actual hypnosis, giant rats, magical guinea pigs and meet the famous (or rather) infamous Doctor Voldritch.

title: Visit Bloofpiter Today
description: Doctor Yakov Voldritch can't afford to rent his evil diabolical mind control lab and so he must take on a research mission by the Great God Bloof (God of the fluffy alien bunny people) to pay it off by logging strange organisms. You will come across many fancy mushrooms, strange hypnotic blobs, dog worms and even (yes!) some spooky horror (be warned).

title: Totally Spies! Cyber Mission
description:
Totally Spies! Cyber Mission is a brand-new story set in the world of the new Season 7 of the Totally Spies! series.

Playing as Sam, Clover and Alex, players will be plunged into the heart of Singapore, where every street and every corner holds secrets to be discovered. Whether playing solo or in local multiplayer mode for up to three players, they will have the opportunity to master the art of infiltration, solve complex puzzles and, thanks to a variety of fashionable gadgets, save the world with style!

title: Marble Mechanics
description: An immersive VR experience, invites you to construct a marble run and simulate the mechanics of marbles running on the track. The track consists of elements that are easily customizable by simply grabbing them. From funnels and loops to spirals, splitters, and both vertical and horizontal turns, these track elements can automatically align themselves for a smooth marble run, making construction fast and easy. Group track elements together so you can grab the entire group. You have the ability to duplicate and delete individual track elements or entire groups, and save favorite groups to the Track Box for reuse at any time. Infinite undo/redo functionality is always available, and you can save your favorite runs for sharing, restoring, and simulating later.

description: Season 3 Episode 6: G-MaVision! The twins, faced with the truth behind their parents' disappearance, finally get G-Ma back for her years abuse.

title: Cool Kid Cody: Season 3 - Episode 07
description: Season 3 Episode 7: Age of Ultra-Prom! Peter's ready for another flight, but Chill Haven isn't. A particularly strange prom night should fix that!

title: Meet My Teacher: Math DLC
description: Fully unlock the MATH Teacher library with 30 additional pictures! Extend your limit from 10 to 40 unlockable pictures.

title: Meet My Teacher: Chemistry DLC
description: Fully unlock the SPORT Teacher library with 30 additional pictures! Extend your limit from 10 to 40 unlockable pictures.

title: Meet My Teacher: Sport DLC
description: Fully unlock the SPORT Teacher library with 30 additional pictures! Extend your limit from 10 to 40 unlockable pictures.

title: X8: Fallen Angel DLC
description: Descend upon the battlefield in blazing fury and infernal fire with the Fallen Angel Pack!

title: X8: NEO-19 White DLC
description: Blast the competition away in style with the NEO-19 White Pack!

title: Mojito the Cat: Sushi Skins
description: Expand your cube-shaped friend collection with this 4 new sushi based skins

title: Apollo Justice: Ace Attorney - Appeal to Truth
description: Appeal to Truth is a four-case fan game developed in PyWright, taking place in alternate timeline during the Apollo Justice era.

title: A Super Effective Turnabout
description: A Pokemon X Ace Attorney crossover fangame.

title: Hexepta: Mayor Attack
description: After a young law student named Argus Hakan ends up defending in a trial on his mentor's behalf, he is thrust into a series of cases the following week, all involving various crimes that seem to target the mayor. Argus can solve these cases as they come, but there is clearly something more going on behind the scenes.

title: Acquittal: Induction
description:
Acquittal: Induction, the first installment in a planned series, was born from inspiration from Capcom's Ace Attorney series and is in many ways a homage. Alternating between investigating criminal cases at the crime scene and defending clients in heated courtroom trials, it inherits its basic mechanics from the classic visual novel series, while taking and running with those core concepts.

It has been on an indefinite hiatus since April 06, 2018.

title: Hexepta: Logic Hack
description: Argus Hakan becomes a defense attorney at Hexepta Legal Academy, a law school that follows it's own legal system. The game was cancelled mid development.

title: Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney - The Jakkid Series
description: Set in an alternate universe, Phoenix Wright must defend... anyone who needs it. Whether they live in his world or not. This game features ten extremely high-quality fanfictions made by the author Jakkid166. The game is mostly faithful to the source, including the author's writing style and language, though there are a few changes made for gameplay purposes. No censorship -- Phoenix Wright can and will say fuck!

title: Scrapbook Memories
description:
Your first year attending Divine Crown Academy will be your last—time to make the most of it!

As a new transfer student to the prestigious Divine Crown Academy, your third year of high school is sure to be one to remember. The academy’s after-school clubs are full of colorful personalities, but four students in particular catch your eye. They make fast friends, but your bond may go deeper than you expected…

How will you make this a year to remember?

title: Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney - The Return of Ryunosuke Naruhodo
description:
Phoenix Wright has just returned to England after an exhausting adventure in the town of Labyrinthia and is ready to relax for the rest of his stay. However, he soon gets involved in a string of mysteries that lead to him reviving a great ace attorney who disappeared a hundred years ago.

Follow defence attorneys Phoenix Wright and Ryunosuke Naruhodo as they fight for their clients' lives in the Crown Court of London while seeking the truth behind the rampage of the Doctor from a hundred year's past!

title: Kai
description: KAI is a game of Exploration and Adventure between the sidereal space and underwater depths. Skillfully lure and guide groups of fish to solve puzzles, access new areas and uncover the truth behind the mission entrusted to you, Akira, and the other crew members aboard the ship.

title: Fortnite: Chapter 5 - Season 3: Wrecked
description: Ah, the wasteland… the possibilities seem as vast as the grains of sand. So vast that the “Wasteland Warriors” don’t want to give up control. This band of marauders brings a whole new meaning to scrappy crew — each one is an automobile expert who’ll tread on any rebellion. In Fortnite Battle Royale Chapter 5 Season 3: Wrecked, get in the driver’s seat and bring the Nitro to these vehicular villains!

title: New Year, New Nanos
description: In Fusionfall Retro the New Year, New Nanos update was released to celebrate FusionFall's 11th anniversary. This update added a wave of 4 new World Nanos and their respective Nano Missions. All of these Nanos were based on characters only found in FusionFall.

title: Genshin Impact: An Everlasting Dream Intertwined
description:
Version 4.7 of Genshin Impact, which includes:
• New character: Clorinde, Sigewinne and Sethos
• New main story quest: Chapter IV: Act VI - Bedtime Story
• New story quests for Clorinde and Sigewinne
• New gameplay mode: Imaginarium Theater
• New quality of life features
• New main event: Mutual Security Enhancing Simulation
• …and more!

title: Tomb of Thunder
description: 7 maps long (including a secret level) SP campaign for Quake by aDaya, using Copper 1.15 as a base while adding new features

title: Roberto el Lagarto
description: Take on an exciting stealth mission as Roberto the Lizard, a cunning thief. Use special abilities to avoid enemies while you steal valuable treasures in a museum full of challenges.

title: JASBIAC
description: A daily game where the player have to guess the genres of three albums by just their cover art

title: Home Together
description:
Home Together is a real-time adult game made in unreal engine 5

Create your own characters in an extensive character creator
Save and share creations with other players
Invite your creation to your house and have adult fun together
Play as male in first person and female in third person
Choose between many adult sex poses across the house
Voice acted female character
Experimental VR support

title: Assassin's Creed III: Tyranny of King Washington - The Betrayal
description: The Tyranny of King Washington: The Betrayal is the second of three downloadable content packs in The Tyranny of King Washington. The episode begins with Ratonhnhaké:ton arriving in the city of Boston as a prisoner of General Israel Putnam.

title: Assassin's Creed III: Tyranny of King Washington - The Redemption
description: The Tyranny of King Washington: The Redemption is the third of three downloadable content packs in The Tyranny of King Washington.

title: Relics of the Oracle
description:
In Relics of the Oracle, step into the forgotten and the unknown in a first-person adventure that blends classic adventure mechanics with real-time 2.5D exploration. Embark on a journey through time and mystery, exploring a game that has resurfaced after decades of being lost and shrouded in urban legend.

Experience a metafictional narrative that pulls you into its depths as one of the first to rediscover this long-lost title. Navigate through hauntingly beautiful landscapes ranging from dense, whispering forests to the desolate ruins of an ancient civilization. Each environment is meticulously handcrafted to challenge your wits and reward your curiosity.

Inspired by adventure games like the Zork series, Relics of the Oracle holds that classic gameplay close to its heart and invites players to get lost in its atmosphere.

title: Ace Attorney - The First Turnabout Redux
description:
A fan game re-creation of the first Ace Attorney case... but (slightly) more realistic.
Visual novel-type game with dialogue choices, play as a lawyer defending your client in court, use real trial procedures such as direct examination and impeachment.

title: Turnabout Curtain
description:
Taking place two years after the events of Turnabout Succession, Apollo has been living the good life. Well, as good as you can get, considering his "boss" is as eccentric piano-playing, poker-cheating Machiavellian schemer (his daughter fairing no better); his cases filled with complication after complication, and his former mentor...

Well, we don't talk about him these days.

But that all changes when he takes a seemingly simple case of a high judge and sets in motion a chain of events that threaten to ruin Apollo and all those he holds dear...

title: Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney - Legal Panels
description: Phoenix Wright: Legal Panels is a wacky, tongue in cheek hybrid crossover series based off of various other series and drawing characters from different games, comics, anime, and other sources.

title: Phoenix Wright: BEST Attorney
description: The award show has come to town and they are prepared to give awards made of rare gold to the best lawyer in Los Angeles. After debate, they narrowed the candidates for the award down to two lawyers: s spiky blue suit man named Phoenix Wright and loud red boy, Apollo Justice. Phoenix must prove himself to be the best lawyer in the country because if he doesn't win, his life may be thrown into absolute chaos!

title: Damion Shard: Ace Attorney
description: The CEO of Shard Corporation, Lord Shard, is also a renowned prosecutor, as has been his family's tradition for generations. But after a mysterious incident atop the Shard Corporation building, a cloud of secrets hanging over the past of the Shard family was revealed. Lord Shard's son, Damion, was forever changed by that incident. Soon, Damion decided to become a defense attorney, a decision that astonished his family. However, Lord Shard decided to create a small law firm so that his son could practice as a defense attorney. But with each case he takes, Damion discovers that there is quite a lot that he doesn't know about the Shard family, and eventually uncovers a dark secret about his own past...

title: Ace Gambler: Phoenix Wright
description:
Once he was an attorney, a defense attorney. First - a rookie, but with the time, he became much famous, than before. His name became of synonym of the truth and justice for those, who sought them. Until a day came when he has lost his badge and his lawyer job. Still he has found a new way in his life...
...a poker game...
While at the same time keeping his "old habits" with himself, which means his never ending search of truth and justice for all. Once - Ace Attorney, now - Ace Gambler Phoenix Wright.
Game will be won!
And Truth will be found!

title: Casey Taylor: Ace Attorney
description:
Casey Taylor: Ace Attorney is set around 20 years after Spirit of Justice,
and it is a story about a recently graduated attorney who had just founded his own law firm with his grandfather.
His expertise for the moment is civil lawsuits, but he will come to learn that some insignificant looking cases can hide the biggest conspiracies.

title: Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney - Truth and Consequences
description:
Set just a few weeks after Spirit of Justice, Phoenix Wright and his friends take on five brand new cases!
Meanwhile, a notorious serial killer has come out of hiding to target Miles Edgeworth.
Can Phoenix figure out who this killer is before they come after Edgeworth himself?
And does the fact that a prosecutor from his past has returned have anything to do with this current dilemma?

title: Irwin Ego: Ace Attorney
description: Irwin Ego Ace Attorney is an Ace Attorney fangame, featuring an entirely unqiue cast of characters set far in the future.

title: Restaurats
description: А restaurant management simulator, where players take on the role of a company of rats striving to be the best in their field. Players are tasked with managing all aspects of the restaurant, starting from cooking dishes and drinks, to serving visitors and developing the establishment

title: Yunyun Syndrome!?: Rhythm Psychosis
description: “Yunyun Syndrome!? Rhythm Psychosis” is a rhythm adventure game about a psychotic hikikomori girl - also an avid anonymous poster - who corrupts the world with her severe brain rot from listening to too many denpa songs. Yunyun all over this world with your degen otaku-posting.

title: Dooblets
description: This adventure supports 2 - 4 players! Play through 4 unique worlds filled with challenges and puzzles with your friends!

title: It sucks, y'know
description:
A short game about you and your mom.

But instead of feeling like home, why does it feel like the opposite instead?

title: Die drei???: Plan der Chamäleonbande
description: A wave of sophisticated robberies is keeping the whole country on tenterhooks. The well-camouflaged "Chameleon Gang" is said to be behind it. Strangely enough, the places and times of the burglaries coincide with the tour schedule of a popular singing duo. Are the musicians behind the crimes? Bob goes along on tour and investigates undercover. But where are Justus and Peter?

title: The Stray Laboratory
description: Avoid your fears, survive the experiments, explore your prison and figure out a way to escape. The stray laboratory is a puzzle / horror game designed using PS1-era mechanics and graphics combined with modern-day physics and lighting capabilities. The Stray Laboratory is inspired by games such as Resident Evil, Silent Hill and Maniac Mansion, as well as movies such as The Shining, Psycho and Guest House Paradiso.

title: Vibin'Vendetta
description: VIBINVENDETTA is a traditional fighting game inspired by classic flash games from the early 2000s. You play as 14 different characters from the group known as Vibing With the Gang, with their own unique powers and fighting styles, across two different stories and twenty stages. The game is still actively being developed, with it currently in it's second version.

title: Stars Collapse
description:
The game tells the story of a young man named "Sunam", who gets trapped in the Stars Park place on his first day working there.

A virus has taken control of the restaurant, unleashing chaos and putting our protagonist in a lot of danger from familiar faces, who will take the role of our animatronic killers.

All of this while he discovers the truth of the death of one of the founders, years ago...

title: The Cursed Tape
description: A short horror game about a mysterious videotape that someone slipped under your door. Do you dare to watch it?!

title: A Maiden's Serenade
description: The Mermaid Festival is an annual festival that takes place in the coastal town of Suminoe and on the night of the festival, Takumi meets a girl with a beautiful singing voice. From this chance encounter, Takumi's daily life slowly begins to change. The 7th project by developer, feng.

title: Setsuna ni Kakeru Koi Hanabi
description:
In the 2040s in Japan, the near-future sport "Jindou" boasts a high popularity as the sport of the people. And the the most famous of all the Jindou performances is the "Daihouen".

Suzakuin Nadeshiko, although currently still a school student, has been fantastically making a name for herself as a pro swordswoman. On the other side, the protagonist Takizawa Kazuma, a washed-up pro swordsman, competes in underground Jindou matches to make ends meet.

One day, these two who were born and lived in completely different worlds had a fateful meeting.

"Kazuma-san, your swordsmanship is the real deal. Fight with us in the Daihouen and let's make it to the top!"

"...yeah. If we could that'd be great"

The pair, captivated by Jindou, are drawn to each other's swordsmanship and seek each other. With Takizawa Komari and Hanabusa Palvi joining Team White Wolf too, they eventually make big waves on the stage of the Daihouen.

If they win, glory awaits. If they lose, they fall from grace. With their beliefs held in their breasts, the swordsmen step out into a battle they can't afford to lose in the intense world of pros.

Swordsmen live in the moment. The "moment" you let slip will never come back-- in which case, set your soul alight.

title: Midnight Fishing
description: Midnight Fishing is a short retro-style horror game, where you collect fish while staying alert for people and creepy monsters sneaking up and killing you.

title: Shrek Playtime is Ogre 2
description: 10 years after the first game I have made a sequel to it. Fair forewarning though: This game is hard as balls. If you actually manage to beat "the shrek challenge", do let me know!

title: Shrek Playtime is Ogre
description:
It is time for some extreme Shrek action!

It started as a joke between me and my friend, but then it kinda evovled into a serious game.

Move and jump with arrow keys,
punch with spacebar,
select powerup with ctrl and alt to use them.

There are 13 passwords in total! Can you find them all...?

title: Pegglo
description: Join Pegglo, the hedgehog hero, in this Peggle-like game with a roguelike twist! Tackle a series of unique levels, master critical hits, and choose powerful upgrades. Every game is a new adventure!

title: 4 Leaf Clovers
description: An edutainment game with a few stories revolving around a group of animal friends living together in a house, along with a plethora of minigames

title: All in Abyss: Judge the Fake
description: Asuha, a self-proclaimed gambling prodigy, challenges the Witch ruling the gambling district. Poised to win, she is defeated by a mysterious power. An adventure of gambling, exposing frauds and earning fortunes through poker.

title: Hell Survivors
description: Hell Survivors is a survival roguelite where countless hordes of demons rise from the abyss. Compose a multitude of mighty builds and eradicate waves of nightmare creatures. Will you be able to survive Hell?

title: Metal Pear
description:
YOUTUBE HEADQUARTERS is the name of a highly armed office in the depths of FUENGIROLA where MASI is held captive by LMDSHOW. It is the mission of ILLOJUAN, one of the members of the PATXINGARS secret army, to follow KNEKRO's instructions and infiltrate YOUTUBE HEADQUARTERS to defeat LMDSHOW and rescue MASI. FORWARD ILLOJUAN!"

Game made for IlloJam 2024

title: Doom: The Dark Ages
description: A single-player first-person shooter and prequel to Doom (2016). Set in the dark medieval world of Argent D'Nur, players control the Doom Slayer in a grounded, weighty combat style that emphasizes strategic engagements over the acrobatic mobility of previous entries. The game introduces a Shield Saw for blocking and parrying, new melee weapons, and drivable vehicles including a cybernetic dragon and a massive mech. The narrative focuses on the Slayer's origin story with expanded cutscenes and character development.

title: The Earl Street Massacre
description:
Working in an abusive work environment is quite tiring, especially for a chronic workaholic. But at the end of the day, your cozy little home and your loving wife awaits. Well... Most times they do. Follow Thomas Grey, as he gets home after a long day of work at the office. Ready for nothing more then to rest and prepare for the next tiring day back at the office, he goes through his usual nightly routine. Unfortunatly for him, someone else already has different plans for him....

'The Earl Street Massacre' is a short horror game, with simple, pixelated graphics. As mentioned above, you follow Thomas Grey, going through his nightly routine, his night getting progressively worse every passing second.

title: Pet Cemetery
description: In the quiet woods of Illinois, a regular guy's peaceful country life takes a sinister turn after an accidental death sets off a bizarre chain of events. As he navigates the mysterious consequences, the secrets of the woods slowly unravel, revealing an eerie connection between lives. Brace yourself for a journey into the heart of rural Illinois, where a single mistake leads to a chilling and enigmatic tale that blurs the line between life and death.

title: Onírillo
description:
Accompany IlloJuan in one of his many dreams without any explanation. What will be the goal of this dream? Where does everything really happen? Is it really all a dream? All these and many more questions will or will not be answered in this adventure created by BlotYolo Games.

Enter the dream world and discover its deepest secrets!

Created for IlloJam.

title: La pesadilla de Illojuan
description: Game made for Illojam, the jam of the Illojuan community.

title: B.O.B.
description:
Entry for #flappyjam.

You are playing the red guy falling and trying to avoid the laser of that grey robot thingy by jumping from side to side.

title: Illo Somnium Rapid Eye
description:
Colonel Andrew has assigned agent John Salchichón of the "Delta" team the mission of rescuing General Mark, who was held hostage by the terrorist organization calling itself "Alpha", to this day the leader or team leaders.

You must infiltrate the organization's operations castle and rescue the target alive, our intelligence has reported that the team has been doing cloning experiments, possibly, their army is made up of clones of their best soldiers, you must be cautious.

title: IlloScape: Into the Illoverse
description:
Hello!, this is my project for the "IlloJam 2024", the objective of this Jam was to make a game within a period of "1 Month" for Illojuan, so the game focuses on its lore.

It is a small "roguelite" Arcade game which begins while you are sleeping and you hear a voice telling you that Masi (your girlfriend) has disappeared, you must overcome 4 Worlds with their respective enemies and bosses to reach her.

title: The Frozen Dead Wait
description: In the heart of the frozen wilderness, a man's search for his daughter spirals into madness and horror.

title: Hostia me acabo de acordar de lo que he soñao hoy, que puta paranoia
description:
What could Juan have dreamed this time? Find out in this frenetic roguelike!

Travel through 8 scenarios, face different enemies using the weapons you find and try to reach the end of this adventure.

title: Grand Prix Racing Universal
description: Welcome to Grand Prix Racing Universal: where the spirit of rally racing meets the pursuit of Grand Prix glory on a variety of thrilling circuits! Prepare to immerse yourself in the ultimate console racing experience, where every curve, every straightaway, and every overtaking opportunity will test your skills to the limit.

title: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine II - Ultra Edition
description: Pre-order the Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2 Ultra Edition to receive the Macragge’s Chosen DLC and play up to 4 days before release.The Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2 Ultra Edition includes the base game, the Ultramarines Champion DLC and the Season Pass.Embody the superhuman skill and brutality of a Space Marine and defend the Imperium in spectacular third-person action in solo or multiplayer modes.

title: Perika Game
description:
Perika Game is a puzzle and collectibles game where your ingenuity will be your est ally. Will you be able to overcome the challenge and get all the fruits?

Inspired (obviously) by Suika Game, this project arose for the IlloJam convened mainly for members of the community of the well-known spanish-speaking streamer IlloJuan.

title: El Camperillo
description: This game was created for Illojam #1 and to no one's surprise I didn't deliver it on time. This is a cooking simulator where you have to prepare meals for suspiciously well-known customers who enter your establishment. Done in 1 and a half month with Godot 4.2.

title: Television Trivia
description:
How well do you know your Television Trivia?

Test your knowledge with some of the most popular Television Shows.

Television Trivia has never been so much fun. Challenge yourself or have a TV trivia night with friends and family in Party Mode! Choose from some of the most popular television shows including The Simpsons, Game of Thrones, The Office, Friends, Star Trek, South Park, Grey’s Anatomy, The Sopranos, and Seinfeld.

title: Space Base
description:
Space Base is an action-packed tower defence game, where you aim to protect your planets from the incoming forces of enemy ships and aliens by any means necessary. Build up your defences as stronger and stronger waves of enemies arrive to reach the highest score possible.

In space base, your ever growing arsenal of towers will give you a large variety of playstyles, allowing for the player to decide what they want to go into every battle with. Alongside this, a choice of different planets, difficulties, and fun unique game-modes keep the player on their toes, making every game unique and different for a fun experience.

The game is constantly evolving, with new content being added all the time, so every time you come back there are new challenges to face with new forces to put against them. Do all you can to unlock everything and become the best space warrior you can be.

title: Air Tennis
description: Fan game based on the visual novel Air developed by Key.

title: There's Always a Madman: Do Your Worst
description: Play as the vengeful secret agent Virginia West and take on a silver-loving madman called The Silver Fox in this single-player interactive spy novel. Surveil your enemy, get revenge for your partner's demise, and maybe - just maybe - save the world along the way. Don’t do your best … Do your worst!

title: Impossible Island
description: You're an ex-pirate stranded on a mysterious island and you need to hunt and build houses to survive. You must face challenges and enemies. You must solve mysteries and open locked doors. Explore this mysterious island alone or with other pirate friends

title: Eye of the Summoner
description: You are the Eye of the Summoner. Protect your tower from the fiendish hordes of paladins attempting to destroy it. Summon your beloved creatures of the darkness and fight to keep the flame of your beacon alive for as long as possible.

title: Yapori Minigames
description: Yapori Minigames is a multiplayer game with mini-games and several playable characters! Various different and challenging mini-games, such as the meteor mini-game where you have to dodge meteors until time runs out, a soccer mini-game where you have to score a specific number of goals before time runs out to win, and more!

title: Master Level Maker
description: Make an interesting map by yourself and share it with the world，freedom 2d platform game。The game includes a wide variety of props and items, and players can even create their own material packs. There are also triggers that can be used to create even more exciting levels.

title: Have a Good Day
description: Explore a zombie-infested post-apocalyptic world in Have a Good Day! Delve into abandoned houses in search of vital resources, but be careful, time is against you! Do you have what it takes to survive in this hostile world and find the resources before it's too late?

title: One Way Lane
description: Riley faces the adjustment of entering adulthood. But in order to establish a happy future she must first face what is haunting her in the past. Will you get lost in wonderland or come out a new you?

title: Scrabbleman
description: A word puzzle game that combines elements of Hangman and Scrabble.

title: The Orange
description: In a forgotten universe lies a legendary orange: the Orange of Infinity. Press it to shape existence itself and confront the darkness.

title: S. Prysm Destroyer
description: A 2D platform shooter where you DESTROY!! Get Elemental Powers from the Prysms and help Amor defeat the Primordial Threats agains Humanity! Get cute costumes and be stylish!

title: JR EAST Train Simulator: Narita Line (Choshi to Chiba) 209-2100 series Kashima Line (Kashima-Soccer Stadium to Sawara) 209-2100 series
description: The Narita Line：75.4 km long line connecting Matsugishi Station in Chōshi City to Sakura Station in Sakura City.The Kashima Line：17.4 km long line connecting Kashima-Soccer Stadium Station in Kashima City, to Katori Station in Katori City. This DLC includes two lines in one DLC.

title: Phantom Dash
description: Phantom Dash is an open world 2D Platformer where you must collect Coins!

title: Mercapolis
description: Build and manage your own supermarket. Place orders for seasonal products, stock them on the shelves, and get ready to survive a workday full of surprises. Hire employees and keep your customers happy in Mercapolis.

title: Shopping Simulator
description: "Shopping Simulator" is your ticket to a virtual mall adventure! Dive into diverse stores, manage budgets, and make friends in this nostalgic Scratch-style game. Ready to shop 'til you drop? Let's go!

title: The Adventures of Prince Shiratama: Climb the Mountains
description: Aim for the top of the mountain with Prince Shiratama. Highly difficult platformer game with a casual appearance.

title: Beat Battle
description: Beat Battle is a local multiplayer rhythm game for 2-4 players! Hit the arrows in time with the music to earn power-ups that can sabotage your opponents and help you emerge from the dance battle victorious.

title: Beauty Girl Chronicles: Island Obstacle Challenge
description: On the beautiful Moon Island, an adventurous obstacle challenge is about to begin. Participants must overcome various obstacles. Only the bravest and smartest girls can emerge victorious, Let's embark on this adventure together and explore the wonderful world of courage, friendship, and victory!

title: Reincarnated as a Rookie
description: Reincarnated as a Rookie is a game of fighting monsters and leveling up. Users can obtain resources through quests to purchase and build equipment, trap pets and grow!

title: Astro Wars
description: Astro Wars is a Free Multiplayer Space Strategy Game. You start at the edge of the galaxy where you can build up, colonize and take over planets in competition with players from all over the world!

title: Sorelle
description: Welcome to the magical world of Sorelle: a whimsical 3D puzzle-platformer that immerses you in the magical seaside town of Isola Chiara. Play as sisters Alessandra, Bella, and Capri as you explore the magic of sisterhood in a puzzle-solving adventure to restore magic and save the summer festival.

title: Tunnel Escape
description: Embark on a journey to save humankind as you kick, shoot and loot your way out of a secret underground laboratory in this rogue-lite exploration RPG/ADV with strategic, turn-based combat.

title: FUBG: Fight Unknown Battleground
description: FUBG is a Multiplayer Shooter Game by GameX with Seven Different Game modes. 1. Team Death Match 2. Capture the Flag 3. Conquest 4. RUSH 5. Kill Confirmed 6. Free For All And 7. Search & Destroy. Player can Play strategic battles across diverse maps and various combat styles to claim victory.

title: Mouse Killer
description: Mouse killer - free bullet hell game which is 100% mouse only game! Kill the annoying vegetables and collect achievements.

title: A.V.A: Global - Busters Content
description: Enjoy Brand New Busters Mode. Unlock 2 Mode Stories, Play 6 Characters and more!

title: A.V.A: Global - Busters Content: Lilly Edition
description: - Receive Unique Soldier Box x 1 - Unlock 1 Character Skin: Lili Uniform. - Get 10 Ultimate Box. - Obtain Busters Game Ticket x 1.

title: Werewolf: The Apocalypse - Purgatory
description: A choice-driven RPG thriller set in the World of Darkness universe. Step into the shoes of Samira, a young werewolf refugee in Poland, as she battles dark forces and loneliness, caught between rage and despair. How will your story unfold?

title: Forge Simulator
