description: You are trapped in an endless labyrinth. You must find hidden resources scattered throughout the labyrinth to craft your own sword. Overcome the dangers of the labyrinth with your crafted sword, survive, and escape.

title: War Room: Blitz
description: War Room: Blitz is a single-player, turn-based strategy game based on the historical WWII German bombing campaign conducted against the United Kingdom. Test your management skills as well as your intuition, and defend your land & protect your people.

title: Clickout
description: Introducing Clickout, a 2D Comedic Clicker game that injects humor into the traditional clicker experience! Prepare for a unique twist: The Button, your primary clickable object, assumes the role of a witty antagonist, progressively escalating its insults as you rack up clicks aka score!

title: Rat Quest
description: In this platformer, jumping will be your main mechanic as you climb the level, each jump matters, if you miss a jump, you have to restart. You may be small but so are the platforms.

title: Battleships and Carriers 2
description: Casual WW2 naval turn-based strategy: attack/defend, search & destroy, build ships, subs and aircraft. Clear and simple combat and move. Fast, re-playable board game style strategy, with 70 unit types. Different missions/campaign objectives (Destroy, Conquer, Defend, Escort, Kill-Them-All).

title: Satan Moans
description: Are you ready for an adrenaline-fueled adventure with "Satan Moans"? In this horror-packed game, you'll explore the supernatural events surrounding a teenager returning home in the dead of night. Are you ready to dive into a suspenseful universe?

title: Vlad Voievod Dracula: Dungeons of Egrigoz
description: A Classicvania (linear Metroidvania) game where you play as Vlad Tepes Dracula, the Voievode (Warlord) of Wallachia. While being a prisoner to the Ottoman Court, Dracula descends into the dungeons of Egrigoz Castle to recruit a great warrior held as prisoner by the Ottoman Turks.

title: Cats of the Tang Dynasty
description: Find the adorable cats amidst the tragic love story of Emperor Xuanzong and Consort Yang!

title: Alpine
description: ALPINE is a multiplayer game about climbing to the very summit of a mountain. Any mistake by a player or the team can be fatal. You play as brave mountaineers whose goal is to conquer the peak.

title: #!/Bin/Bash
description: #!/bin/bash is a typing adventure game using linux terminal commands as controls. Yum some cake, touch some loot and bash those enemies!

title: Snatched
description: Play as an alien and use your wits to lure humans back to your spaceship

title: Rusty Flesh
description: Rusty Flesh is a sci-fi horror puzzle platformer for the Game Boy Color where you switch gravity instead of jumping. Explore the different areas of a derelict spaceship putting together all the pieces of its lovecraftian mistery, and enjoy its retro-futuristic aesthetics.

title: Bananamania
description: Check out our all-new 8-bit banana-style game! We think you'll like it! Let us know what you think! We are working with dedication to bring this game in full to you guys very soon!

title: Contain: First Responders
description: This DLC contains the cosmetics of tactical gear of the first responder team.

title: Bugnauts!
description: Embark on a thrilling 3D projectile action adventure in Bugnauts! Swing your net to battle giant bugs and save your island home from an evil resort tycoon. Fight, collect, and explore in this action-packed game for all ages.

title: Maze Endless
description: "Maze Endless" is a challenging adventure casual game that tests your wit and luck. In this endless maze journey, players will experience an unprecedented adventure. Starting from the simplest maze, gradually challenge more complex levels, unravel their mysteries, and find the exit.

title: Sands of Supremacy
description: Sands of Supremacy is a singleplayer, side-scrolling strategy/resource management hybrid 2D game set in a desert landscape on an unknown, futuristic planet. The game combines survival, strategy, and resource management elements to create a challenging and engaging gameplay experience.

title: Bunny Space Odyssey: The Countdown
description: Seek out and collect bunny helmets scattered across the laboratory. But wait, bunny helmets with ears? Perhaps the veil of mystery will be lifted, revealing why we're collecting these ear-topped helmets?

title: Hidden Arcade
description: Find the 300 hidden Ghosts spread throughout 3 different Arcade Game Worlds!

title: Apples And Bananas
description: Embark on an epic fruit-filled adventure as Jack the Apple, battling brainwashed banana soldiers in this top-down 2D pixel shooter to stop Dr. Banana's evil plans!

title: Kidnelis
description: Truths, lies & imagination. Improve your short term memory, understanding, concentration & literacy skills. Read, choose, replicate and more importantly: when in doubt, discuss!

title: Clawpunk
description: Clawpunk is a challenging, fast-paced, melee 2D action game with roguelite elements and multiple characters, where the player can run rampant in a destructible environment that rewards a reactive and aggressive play style.

title: Echoes of Extinction
description: Open World Prehistoric Horror Survival set on a mysterious island inhabited by dinosaurs and tribal humans. Survival is a test of resilience and adaptability. Players must carve their path in this challenging world, competing for territory, resources and ultimately, their own survival.

title: Farmer's Shop Simulator
description: Create your own farm. Harvest crops, take care of animals, sell goods, set prices at your discretion, hire staff, expand, design, and build your dream farm.

title: Interwoven Emotions
description: Indie narrative puzzle platformer where you follow the character along their journey of defeating emotions and finding purpose.

title: Guns Demons
description: Get ready to dive into explosive action and pure adrenaline with Guns Demons, the vehicular combat game that redefines the genre. In this thrilling universe, cars don't just race—they're armed with a devastating array of firearms, ready to unleash chaos on the road.

title: Animal Tracker
description: Explore a fantastical island where fantastical new creatures await! Run, jump, and glide your way to discover new animals to photograph and become the next great Emergent Organism Researcher in this single-player island exploration game! What surprises await you on the island?

title: Philosophers Lab
description: Navigate this robot's intricately designed home, immerse yourself in a calming Lo-Fi soundtrack, and interact with a rich selection of literature for relaxation and focused study in this interactive exploration experience.

title: Master of Fried Rice
description: Fried rice————Wok stir-frying————Rice dynamism realized by physics calculation! Complete the best fried rice by using various ingredients!

title: Whispers of the Eyeless
description: Guide your Cult. Oversee your Sanctum. Stay in the Shadows. Serve the Dead Gods.

title: Lost Estate Agent
description: Lost Estate Agent - is a survival horror game a real atmosphere of abandoned mansion.

title: Rine: The Trail of Fireflies
description: Embark yourself in a journey about light, fireflies and a cute little blue fox. Help Rine befriend the fireflies along the way. They will guide him to solve the mystery of the missing light.

title: Loop: ClassRoom
description: Every school has some terrifying rumors, and you certainly don't want to be a part of these rumors.

title: Nucleares: New Generator Set
description: This state-of-the-art generator boasts a 50% longer lifespan compared to other models, ensuring reliable and long-lasting performance.

title: ArchWilio
description: Our protagonist finds themselves stranded in a dense forest, desperately seeking your guidance to escape this verdant labyrinth.

title: Night Town
description: "In this game you're a resident of Night Town, a town where sleeping at night is taboo. What's really happening there?The game addresses the issue as subtle and bright as possible, it won't be too dark on the road ahead. There is mystery, and there is love.So, how will you choose?"

title: Crying Room
description: be sorrow like dev! he just a weirdo... of course and his computer really suck so bad that making game so on low resolution!.... how ironic is that :\

title: Gate Guardian
description: Gate Guardian is a casual fantasy roguelike with rich build options. You are the guardian of the Gate of Life, who protects it from Death. Create combinations of skills, improve and radically change them with modifiers. Survive Death!

title: X-Plane 12: Aerosoft - Airport Berlin-Tegel
description: Our airport Berlin-Tegel for X-Plane offers a very accurate and realistic recreation of the airport with high-detailed models and textures.

title: X-Plane 12: Aerosoft - Airport Berlin Brandenburg V2
description: Being infamous for its construction delays, the German capital's new airport is finally open and available for X-Plane!

title: X-Plane 12: Aerosoft - Helgoland
description: Helgoland XP is a scenery for X-Plane that recreates Germany's only island in the open sea at a high level of detail and with many thrilling new options.

title: X-Plane 12: Aerosoft - St. Tropez
description: Based on the latest image sources, highly detailed objects were created at and along the airport. In addition, the villages La Mole and Le Moulin Roux were upgraded with individual autogen. The photo texture covers an area of approx. 26km² and thus covers the entire traffic pattern.

title: X-Plane 12: Aerosoft - Airport Zurich V2.0
description: The Airport Zurich is the largest airport of Switzerland, now in a brand new version for X-Plane. This completely new scenery is full of details, including every building and the entire airport environment, De-Icing and all features you would expect from a modern X-Plane scenery.

title: Undersea 8
description: You are trapped in a dangerous undersea ruin. Let's escape from the deep sea with observation and quick situational judgment.

title: Hell's Underground
description: Descend into the eerie depths of the London Underground in this spine-chilling horror game. Navigate through claustrophobic tunnels and ominous sewers while evading terrifying monsters. Every step brings you closer to escape... or to your doom.

title: No Work No Life
description: This game is a roguelike horror game. Beyond the door lies a completely white space where you must pick up items, offer them as sacrifices, and survive for as long as possible.

title: Humay
description: It is a fantastic adventure game.

title: Colonies of The Remnant
description: In a post-apocalyptic world, found and develop your own colony under the threat of the undead. Be cautious against enemy colonies or form alliances. Engage in action-fueled battles against the undead and other humans using FPS or TPS game modes. Formulate your strategy and survive!

title: Raid Run
description: Raid Run is a game inspired by fake mobile game ads. Your character automatically travels through the level where you must face increasingly difficult enemies, grabbing power ups and evolving your skills along the way. Attacks and skills are fired automatically. Conquer 3 levels with 3 difficulties.

title: Heroic Assault
description: Heroic Assault is a reverse tower defense game where you prepare your army to go through the infested lands of defenses. Choose wisely your units depending on the layout of the defenses and equip them with unique abilities.

title: Meow Moments: Olympicats
description: Join the Olympicats in Meow Moments: Celebrating Together! Celebrate sportsmanship and unity with cats and characters from around the world. Enjoy diverse sports, peaceful competition, and the joy of friendly games.

title: AutoBulletSurvivor
description: Jump into the world of AutoBulletSurvivor! Survive on a post-apocalyptic surface devastated by nuclear war. Collect items, evade powerful enemies, and gather supplies for the underground shelter. Grow stronger with each run and experience the thrill of survival.

title: Survivor World
description: Conquer obstacles, and strategies for victory. Blue vs. red teams race to a goal, relying on intellect and skill, not wilderness survival. Only team success counts. Ready for the ultimate showdown?

title: Rustwing
description: Rustwing is a twin stick shooter rougelike, where you play as a mercenary spaceship sent on a journey across the habited space. Navigate from star to star, battle the scattered factions of humanity, customize your weaponry, acquire powerful upgrades and become a legendary pilot!

title: Nightmare Files: Clap Clap
description: Clap Clap is a short indie horror game that puts you in the shoes of a house sitter, experiencing strange occurrences in a seemingly ordinary home.

title: Cats Clicker
description: The cutest game in the world. Cats and kittens with idle clicker gameplay. Meow!

title: One Box One Goal
description:
You're in a box and you have to climb as high as possible... if you can make it.
One Box One Goal is a game inspired by Getting Over It with Bennett Foddy but made in third person.

title: Whisker President
description: Whisker President is a comedic, casual point-and-click game set in a cartoon style oval office. Armed with only a laser pointer and some glue, help the purresident achieve political success by making him stamp the bills, all while ensuring that distractions don't get in the way.

title: The Mare of Jonah
description: A first-person psychological horror/mystery adventure where you play as a small boy trapped in an unknown and dark mansion. Try to survive the vengeful evil spirits lurking in the dark while exploring the rooms and corridors in hopes of finding clues that may lead to a way out of this horror.

title: Doot-Type
description: 2D Side Scrolling Shoot Em Up action. Cinematic cut-scenes carry the story on a quest to locate Mother Gator's secret weapon. Unlockable cheats will mix-up the gameplay or enjoy a randomizer mode. Game includes commentary by the developer and musical composer on the process of making the game!

title: KartMania Silver
description: Invite your friends to have fun with you playing KartMania! A Kart game where you race around the tracks in the universe of Silver Games games, use and abuse special items to get ahead of your friends and thus win first place! Speed ​​to glory in KartMania Silver!

title: Hard Void
description: Lead your space-faring species across galaxies and multiple dimensions to build an Empire in this strategy game. Design your spaceships, assemble your fleets and fight for the supremacy. Colonize planets, asteroids and the space itself! but beware, you aren't only dealing with just other species.

title: Labyrinth Hotel
description: Labyrinth Hotel is an immersive, first-person, action-adventure game where the player wakes up locked in a jail cell and must escape, but the only way out is through the Hotel. Contains 20 unique levels, 4 bosses, many unique characters, a cool crt effect, and many secret levels.

title: The Remake of the End of the Greatest RPG of All Time
description: The Remake of the End of the Greatest RPG of All Time is the last hour of a lost (nonexistent) JRPG, "remade” in 3D pixel art complete with director’s commentary, the digital manual, and archival footage.

title: Fantasmigon
description: Fantasmigon is an original turn-based strategy set in a vibrant fantasy world. Engage in thrilling battles and tactical gameplay as you lead your band of characters through challenging encounters

title: Proyecto infernal
description: Infernal Project offers a real survival challenge. Survive in a toxic volcanic arena. Face random enemy waves, collect scarce resources, and make strategic decisions to stay alive. Test your endurance and see how long you can last in this intense survival simulator.

title: Pantless
description: Pantless brings a hilarious twist to the rage-inducing game genre inspired by Getting Over It with Bennett Foddy. In this third-person, physics-based game, players control customizable characters hilariously devoid of pants, navigating through chaotic and fun challenges.

title: HyperFantasy Mimesis
description: Deconstruction of an RPG. Monsters are gone. Humanity doesn't want to be saved. Your biggest enemy will be the UI.

title: Rastignac: Wastelands
description:
Rastignac Wastelands is a survival shooter set in a vast, procedural open world where every decision matters.
Play as a wanderer in a desolate wasteland, scavenging resources, crafting weapons, and fighting to survive against hostile creatures and rival survivors.

The world of Rastignac evolves with each run — no two journeys are the same. Explore abandoned ruins, hunt for rare loot, and adapt your strategy to the dangers of the wastelands.
With its blend of exploration, survival mechanics, and fast-paced combat, Rastignac Wastelands challenges you to endure in a hostile, ever-changing environment.

title: Seal the Rift
description: Discover an endlessly replayable roguelike deckbuilder. Craft a unique deck to overcome the challenges ahead. Collect powerful relics, harness potent magic and skillfully make use of the "Boost" mechanic to Seal the Rift!

title: Set Sail! Arena
description: Set Sail! Arena is a 4v4 PVP Arena Action game. Face off against your friends as Pirates or British, across unique maps and modes. Customise your character and fight with swords, pistols and a variety of Power Weapons!

title: SongBird: FlingAThing
description: A unique, stylish platformer based around flinging yourself as fast as possible in any direction. Venture deep into the "Songbird Short Stop" to fix a cash register that won't scan milk in this exhilarating precision platformer.

title: Sparrow
description: Trapped in a mysterious mansion, a tiny sparrow must survive deadly encounters with horrific creatures as it unravels the mansion's dark secrets and desperately tries to escape. Explore vents, crawlspaces, secret rooms, and more to uncover the gripping story and world of Sparrow.

title: Split Decision
description: Your seemingly simple boxing judge gig gets a little complicated as you are offered to fix matches for profit.

title: Luna's Eyes
description: A first-person horror adventure set in a red-tinted otherworld. Use clues from Luna the cat to escape from the otherworldly house.

title: Spice Trade
description: Spice Trade offers a chance to rewrite history with Abu, a young man challenging European dominance. As he inherits land in Baghdad, Abu enters the spice trade to thwart European trade monopoly. Can he reshape Europe's fate? You decide the outcome in this game of strategy and empire-building!

title: Aikyam
description: Dazzle the hearts of disgruntled villagers with extravagant turn-based battles and rally them against demons in this Bollywood-inspired fantasy RPG!

title: [REC] Paroxysm
description: You're a horror content creator, venturing into frightening locations to captivate your audience. You're attempting to attract more viewers by recording paranormal events. However, these horror-filled adventures will one day come back to haunt you, at a high cost.

title: Carpe Dino: Seize the Date
description: “Carpe Dino: Seize the Date” is a journey back in time with a romantic twist. Face the dangers of ancient Pangea, get involved in a few intrigues, and choose a mate to get through the Great Dying. Be ready to decide the future of the entire Dinosaur world… World, which is wider than you imagined.

title: K!ll All Litterbugs
description: Headbox Games, in association with the Gambler 500 and Sons of Smokey, needs your help to save the planet! No one knows exactly where these toxic monsters came from, but you'll discover the sinister plot while you run and drive your way through this open world action game.

title: Mountain Boy
description: Climb towering mountains and overcome unique challenges in this vibrant, non-violent platformer. How high can you go?

title: Funky Panic Attack
description: Can Luna navigate this funky world to find Halloween? - Talk to strange and compelling characters! Freeze obstacles and activate the fast Chili Pepper Mode, but beware - it also makes you uncontrollably jumpy!

title: Bunny Alice in Wonderland
description: On this fantastical journey, you will use your extraordinary observation skills and, along with your companions, overcome all obstacles and challenges, bravely moving forward!

title: Alchemy Mastery
description: A game where you take part in an immersive chemical laboratory simulation. Produce various mixtures using equipment and substances. Use mostly mouse controls to pour chemicals from vessel to vessel.

title: Metal Dogs: New Dog Addition - Labrador Retriever
description: This is a DLC that adds playable dog breeds to the shooting action game "METAL DOGS".

title: Songs of Conquest: Rise Eternal
description: Embrace the darkness in your endeavor to crush the Stouthearts. Raise the dead to serve once more. For the scholars of Loth know that death is not the end, it is merely the beginning.

title: Journey to Earth
description: You are an experienced astronaut, stranded in space. Will you reach Earth, or will you get lost in space and die?

title: Arsene Lupin: Once a Thief
description: Witness the Origins of a Legend - Experience Arsène Lupin's transformation from humble burglar to folklore hero in Arsène Lupin: Once A Thief, a detective adventure game set in the early 1900s.

title: Idylls of the Lunar Maria
description: Idylls of the Lunar Maria is a charming "match-3 builder" roguelite adventure. Chat with rats, defeat demons.

title: Rising Army
description: Rising Army is a strategy auto-battler game where you can train and equip every single troop, upgrade your camp, and recruit new warriors. Experience a campaign in an open world and take on epic battles.

title: Safelight
description: Safelight is the debut first-person puzzle horror game from STEALTH Studios. Navigate through a vacant cruise ship stuck at sea, as you uncover the mystery of how entire portions of the ship have vanished.

title: From Fire Emergence
description: Survive unspeakable nightmares in this third person action-horror. Play as Sergeant Aaron as he answers a distressed call for help deep in the British countryside.Defeat vile demons, solve puzzles, explore & progress in an unrivalled, atmospheric world, whose events, will have you gripped with fear.

title: Tomb Nightmares
description: One excerpt from the adventure story of two treasure seekers. Explore the mysterious dungeon, pass all the tests and get out alive! The catacombs full of mysteries are waiting for you!

title: Footage
description: FOOTAGE is a short bodycam shooter styled game witch uses unreal engine 5 latest technology to get stunning graphics and amazing gameplay. FOOTAGE has lot of action packed moments with multiple levels with different difficulty's to help make the game a longer and a more fun experience.

title: Trash Pandamonium
description: Get ready for Trash Pandamonium: the ultimate couch co-op party game! Control colorful raccoons, beat the trash out of opponents, and dominate dynamic maps full of hazards. Customize your raccoon, gather your crew, and prepare for pandamonium!

title: Singalongsong
description: Singalongsong is a simple rhythm game that takes players through her daily life with fun levels, lively hand-drawn animations, and delicate original music.

title: Fearless
description: Dive into Fearless, a thrilling single-player zombie shooter. Navigate through an island overrun by the undead to rescue your sister. Are you "Fearless" enough to face the hordes and emerge victorious? Embark on the adventure today!

title: Puppet: Hide And Seek
description: Puppet: Hide And Seek - is a 7 vs 1 multiplayer horror game where one player takes on the role of a brutal Killer and seven other players are Survivors trying to escape from the killer.

title: Gym Bullies
description: Gym Bullies is a game with a story that you are racing with time and testing your typing skills~

title: Colony: Part I The Moon Castle
description: Humanity has experienced many technological revolutions in 200 years. Thanks to these revolutions, it can be expanded into space. They established colonies on Mars and the Moon. However, with the surprise attacks on the Moon colony, the youth began to experience difficult times..

title: Roboban: Colors
description: Roboban: Colors is a single player Sokoban style puzzle video game in which you control robots that have to reach their recharge sites, but not before ordering the boxes in their corresponding destination.

title: Moon 2999
description: Moon 2999 is a RPG game about Units & resources management, single-player or co-op action missions game set in a lunar base and its nearby space environment.

title: There's No Socks: The Extra Challenge
description: Are you ready for the extra challenge? Test yourself against 5 additional levels and in the dark mode!

title: Nutz Revenge
description: Embark on a nutty adventure in this action-packed 2D platformer! Join Pete & Penny Peanut, Sgt Acorn, Walter Walnut, and Peggy Pistachio as they team up to enact their revenge upon the evil rodent gang. With vibrant visuals and a world full of collectables, prepare for a nutty journey like no other!

title: EleBall
description: EleBall is a casual platformer about a circus elephant, who tries their best to catch falling objects while simultaneously keeping balance on a bouncy ball.

title: Countryballs: The Heist
description: Countryballs: The Heist is PWA's comedic stealth adventure where you become a master thief for eccentric clients. Customise your Countryball's disguise to explore maze-like countries. Plan, sabotage, hide and trick to outwit guards and traps - or create your own thrilling heists for the community.

title: Crazy World of Caleb
description: Help Caleb get his girl back. To save her, Caleb needs to brave various locations. Run, Jump and Dash to avoid different type of enemies and make it to your destination.

title: Mausoleosis
description:
David received a very concerning letter from his mother, asking him to go pick her up as she's lonely and scared.
However, there's a problem: David's mother has been dead for 20 years.
He could have ignored the letter...but he didn't.
David decides to go to the mausoleum where his mother was buried in order find out the truth...

title: Maid Cafe on Electric Street
description: Maid Cafe on Electric Street is a leisurely maid cafe adventure set in the otaku haven of Nipponbashi, Osaka.

title: Love Undying: A Kiss Before Dawn
description: Hunt your prey as a vampire on windswept Victorian moors—but who will capture your unbeating heart?

title: Every Hue of You
description: Every Hue of You follows the deeply personal and thoughtful journey of Twyla: A jeweller battling grief who awakens the power to enchant her creations with the energy of emotions.

title: Blunted in The Malen
description: Join the individual story of Sharp, a revolutionary living in the corrupt city of Malen. Solve various puzzles with 2.5D visuals, uncover the mysteries of the locations, and untangle the knots in the story.

title: Chikoku no Mokushiroku: Ver.2.00
description: This update includes revised visuals, dialogue and a new bonus story.

title: Moonless Moon
description: When night falls, she wanders into another world... Moonless Moon is a text-based adventure game following a girl as she travels through a variety of different worlds.

title: Ban: The Prologue of Gucha Gucha
description: 【A richly coloured horror and mystery tale】"BAN: The Prologue of GUCHA GUCHA” is a third-person horror adventure game. Experience the messy horror from the perspective of the protagonist, who is caught up in the whirlwind of events in a certain town in Japan, Utagacho.

title: Burggeist
description:
Burggeist is a real-time action strategy that features the use of height differences and the terrains as part of your tactics.
Move around the field, quickly analyze the situation, choose the effective move to create and defend your Tower.

title: Leap Year
description: Leap Year is a clumsy platformer about knowledge and discovery. Explore a compact, hand drawn world filled with hidden paths. Understand the game’s secrets to reach new areas and collect all the pages of your calendar.

title: Rejuvan
description: Make money, rejuvenate, repeat. Find about all wonder of this modern factory game in which your whole purpose is making money. Watch out for any surprising unnatural weather-related events as they may greatly impact your game experience.

title: Species: Unknown
description: Species: Unknown is a 1 to 4 players co-op survival horror. Complete high-risk missions aboard an abandoned ship while being hunted by an unknown creature. Survive and upgrade your gear to face each new threat that lurks in the dark.

title: Moto Rush Reborn
description: Feel the pulse of retro-futuristic Tokyo veins urging you to go faster, drawing you deeper. Surrender to the speed, let the thrill consume your essence. Each surge, each flicker of light, is your path to glory or oblivion in 'Moto Rush Reborn'. Is your soul worth this speed?

title: PaCc and Bomber: Maze Blast
description: Pac and Bomber: Maze Blast combines strategic bomb laying with frantic maze navigation. Dodge enemies, set traps, and blast your way through intricate levels. Can you master the maze?

title: Shiling
description: The protagonist "Luo Ling" travels following vague memories in her mind, during which she discovers a child "Wuyi," who claims to be pursued by monsters and seeks help. They agree to stick together and find home.

title: The Last Match Girl
description: Finding the Place to Return, A survival horror of ashes and light. In a city where the dawn never comes, Scavenging for food, scavenging for life, And yet you are still alive. ………"Welcome home."

title: Intonight
description: In "Intonight" dive into an emotional journey under dazzling neon lights, where love collides with betrayal. Witnessing your girlfriend's infidelity at a nightclub shatters your world, pushing you to seek a fresh start amidst nightlife's temptations and challenges.

title: Gallery X
description: "Will you be the next one to get out of here alive?" GalleryX, a horror game that focuses on observation and memory.In the dim environment, there are more than 60 anomalies, 2 endings, different experiences,waiting for you to explore.Please watch out for enemies.

title: Arisen Force: HeroTest
description: Experience stylish-action battles and beautiful pixel art, summon heroes across time and space, and challenge the magic tower to save the heroic spirits and goddesses!

title: Bella Wants Blood
description: Entertain the god-like Bella’s thirst for blood in this absurd bite-sized roguelike terror defense game.

title: The 9th Station of M.t...
description: While being careful of any abnormalities, continue down the mountain path that continues like a cycle and try to escape safely.

title: Haunted Paws
description: Haunted Paws is a Cozy Coop Horror game where you will play as two Puppies trying to rescue their human friend in a haunted mansion. Create your puppy, explore spooky environments and defeat evil creatures in an action packed adventure!

title: The Tome of All Tales
description: The Tome of All Tales is a minimalist old-school shooter that offers a new story every day.

title: RewindGirl
description: Running, jumping, rewinding— A time-leap action puzzle where you cooperate with your past self!

title: S4U: Citypunk 2011 and Love Punch
description: This is a modern adventure of young adults seeking love and meaning. Return to 2011's Castor Yard, tap on your keyboard, and make those letters dance: Use your online persona to make meaningful decisions for your clients and yourself.

title: Ace Attorney: Turnabout Of A Legend
description: Apollo returns from his trials abroad to attend Chief Prosecutor Edgeworth's 5 Year anniversary project. Only to find his mentor, and dear friend Phoenix Wright murdered. With an old co-worker and friend accused, it is up to Apollo to prove her innocence, and find Phoenix's true killer! Investigate the crime, while uncovering more of the corruption ring at the Prosecutor's Office.

title: Piggy One Super Spark
description: PIGGY ONE SUPER SPARK is a single-player action game starring Xiamy, Yuez, and a lost newborn baby they happen to find. Follow the trio in their chaotic but heart-warming adventure!

title: Nightmare Operator
description: NIGHTMARE OPERATOR is an action horror shooter about hunting Youkai in the haunted ruins of Tokyo. Combat fuses the tense, shooting gameplay of classic survival horror, with the skill-based mechanics and execution of fighting games and spectacle fighters.

title: Gold of Skulls
description: "GOLD OF SKULLS" is a new Free-to-play, client-based collectible card game with NFT integration. It blends heroic turn-based auto-battler mechanics with rich RPG elements and deep tactical gameplay. Players will lead teams of fantastical heroes through intricate PvP and PvE battles in a world where the lines between life and death are deeply entwined.

title: Mia Fey: Ace Spirit Attorney
description: Follow Mia Fey, the original Turnabout Lawyer, as she uncovers the secrets of DL-6. Murder after murder, incident after incident, Mia Fey is one step closer to the the truth about DL-6. But at the same time, she's also getting herself into a cutthroat world of law, where all is not what it seems. In fact, the law system is broken. Prosecutors getting replaced every week, the prosecution department short on prosecutors... Utter chaos in the law. The ultimate question: will Mia Fey survive the world of law, and will she uncover the truth about DL-6? Or will she die trying?

title: Roku and Rei
description: Dive into the world of Roku and Rei, a puzzle game where the protagonists move in reverse directions! Use their ability to interact with color-coded objects and tackle mind-bending challenges.

title: Destiny of Heroes
description: Destiny of Heroes is a twin-stick, squad-based shooter set in occupied Indonesia at the end of World War II. Fighting Dutch and Japanese colonizers, you will lead the struggle for independence, in a heroic struggle against foreign tyrants. Liberty or death!

title: Stories of the Dreaming World
description:
Stories of the Dreaming World is a collection of short stories put together in RPG Maker VX Ace. Though some of them may seem unrelated, they are small pieces of a bigger puzzle.

The stories follow the perspectives of different characters involved with a certain world. An immortal alchemist. The fledgling god of a newborn world. A homunculus and the weight of knowing.

And perhaps more?

title: Strange Antiquities
description: Become the custodian of a store dealing in occult antiquities. Explore the quaint and gloomy town of Undermere, where strange goings-on and dark mysteries abound. Find and identify arcane artefacts, use your collection to aid the townsfolk with their unusual problems — and remember to pet your cat!

title: The Terraces
description: A classic Doom 2 city-style map originally made for the cancelled community project "Plain Ol' Doom 2". Originally designed as a Map 20 replacement. Level layout is a based on "Central Yharnam" level from From Software's Bloodborne, and the visual theme is a homage to Viggles' Brigandine.

title: The Civvie 11 Massacre
description: 20 new maps created by Civvie's discord in a contest with a hub map.

title: Mouldy Old Void
description: Mouldy Old Void is a single-level PK3 for Doom II using the GZDoom source port. It was designed by zrrion the insect and uses the music track. In 2015 it won the Doomjà-Vu contest.

title: Kenny vs. Spenny: Versusville
description:
Based on the TV series Kenny vs Spenny (starring Kenny Hotz and Spencer Rice), Versusville is free to play and features 4 different games that can be played in real time in either single or multiplayer online modes.

The four games are Residence Evil, Wasteball, Kart Dart & Grave Rave. High scores were featured on the website for the game when it was active.

title: The Dragon's Turnabout
description: This trial follows the first bad ending of Dual Destinies

title: Anothereal
description: Accompany Astra as she discovers the world outside her solitude and uncovers the mysteries of the Real. Engage in shmup-style combat encounters to leave an impact and fight back against the ones who would challenge her EXISTENCE.

title: 2Ship2Harkinian
description:
2Ship2Harkinian is a mod of the famous Nintendo 64 game,
This mod adds quality of life improvements to the game, like Widescreen resolution, HD textures and compatibility with modern controllers, while making it playable on Windows.

title: A House for Alesa 2
description: One year after the events of A House for Alesa (note: canon ending is ending F having kept your tongue intact), Alesa receives a call from a detective who confirms her worst fear: Mr. Bob and his family are back and they are coming for her. Will Alesa survive the night? How many more horrors must she endure? Is there another house of horrors waiting for her?

title: Rolling Lee
description: A game where you control a rolling ball named Lee!

title: My Time at Sandrock: Monster Whisperer
description: Embark on an exciting adventure in Sandrock! Utilize professional tools to discover and capture a diverse array of adorable monsters, forming special bonds with each one. Your pet adventure begins now!

title: Robert on Earth
description: Running a special underground farm in the distant and desolate future, exploring various crop abilities. Mining, fishing, meeting new robot friends, discovering new unknown areas, and exploring the truth that belongs to you

title: Co|incidence
description: "co|incidence" is a FVN produced for Renpy.

title: Water: Transformer
description: This is a platform jumping game, you can obtain different abilities by transforming between solid, liquid, and steam three forms, thus crossing obstacles and solving puzzles. The workshop allows you design and share their own created maps with the players all around the world.

title: Fire Showdown
description: "Fire Showdown" is a classic ARPG game with a retro style. The game can bring players exquisite graphics experience, hearty combat experience and rich and spectacular game experience.

title: Fishing Fishing
description: Fishing Fishing is a first person fishing simulation role-playing game where you will travel to multiple provinces in China, experience different scenery and cuisine, and use a variety of fishing gear to fight against big fish.

title: Echoes of The Backrooms
description: "Echoes of The Backrooms" is an indie horror game that masterfully captures the unsettling atmosphere of the Backrooms and the uncanny eeriness of liminal spaces. This game excels in creating an immersive experience with its cinema-quality visuals and meticulously crafted environments.

title: Earthborne
description: Explore, fight, craft and develop an automated technological civilization complete with airships and robotic drones!

title: Hamstörm
description: Hamstörm is a turn-based puzzle game where you play as a dwarf hamster who must go warn his people of the imminent invasion by the Chedd'Ore clan. Help Hamstörm make his way through the various mines, now infested with terrible rats!

title: Avaricity: New Shadows
description: A twist on the classic turn-based RPG style with the full intent on you growing with the environment!

title: University Days: Season 1
description: Step into the shoes of a Student at an all-but-ordinary University, where there seems to never be a dull day with hot women around every corner. Just so happens that you could just be the most wanted guy at this University... Who will you fall for?.. And who will fall for you?

title: Reflection Link
description: Locked inside a facility that erases memory, seven people must recover what they've forgotten to earn their freedom. Explore escape-room puzzles, piece together broken relationships, and uncover the truth behind the sins none of them remember committing in this branching path visual novel.

title: Micron Defense Force
description: A Roguelike Tower Defense in space with missions to conquer. Can you hold against the spreading alien bosses? Build and upgrade towers against the corruption. Choose your technologies and warpspeed your way to victory.

title: Undead Kingdom Survivors
description: Prepare to face the relentless onslaught of the undead! Clear the undead realm either solo or with up to 2 friends in online multiplayer. Choose powerful abilities to vanquish hordes of undead. Upgrade stats and unlock new heroes as you strive for survival in this intense roguelite bullet hell.

title: Show Me How To Live
description: "Show Me How to Live" is a minimalist aesthetic shoot 'em up game, in which we control a ship that must navigate and understand the perspective of a person capable of seeing the senselessness of life but unable to do anything about it.

title: Cappadocia Puzzle
description: Cappadocia Puzzle is a classic puzzle that offers you to put the picture together from a huge number of details! You will find as many as 15 puzzle levels with juicy graphics and an History-style plot that you will need to add up.

title: BomberHit
description: BomberHit is an action-packed multiplayer game where you defeat your opponents by detonating bombs. Think strategically, develop tactics, and conquer your adversaries in labyrinthine battles! Engage in combat with friends or online players and fight to become the ultimate bomber!

title: Fork Road
description: Fork Road is a first-person immersive atmospheric game with new gameplay , Be prepared to face fears you've never faced before

title: Mysterious Voyage: Set sail
description: Here, you can freely sail your ship, explore the endless ocean, and find hidden islands and treasures!

title: Vertig8
description: In Vertig8, explore a vertical world unlike any other. Ascend through a skyscraper, engaging in strategic gameplay and exhilarating action. Join internet celebrities in this unique multiplayer experience. Experience Vertigo and redefine your gaming adventure.

title: Fear Calibration
description: Who are you? What time is it? How long have you been in this place? In this horror-puzzle escape room, uncover the dark secrets hidden within the shadows as you solve your way through the empty classrooms of your school–or what seems to be of it. Do you really think you can escape this madness?

title: Unsought
description: Unsought is a 360° subjective exploration, panoramic horror adventure game. It takes place in a provincial town in 1990s Japan. You are an elementary school student lost in an empty town, but will you be able to return home?

title: Towerheart
description: Towerheart is a simple sokoban-style puzzle game where you can swap with objects.

title: Chained Runes
description: Plan your chain of runes as well as possible, analyze your opponents, and build up an optimized deck to reach King Gormnoq.

title: Smile Simulation
description: Psychological-surreal-analog-survival horror game. Find the smiles and get out.

title: Tyga
description: Welcome to Tyga! It's your job to help us deliver lifesaving medicine to those who can afford it. With enough hard work, someday that could be you! See you on the road Tygan!

title: Lunar Lander Redux
description: Explore a rough space landscape in a fragile capsule. Good for an hour of fun or frustration depending on skill. Physics mostly accurate.

title: Sea of Brave: Beast Island
description: Explore a unique island, find allies, and defeat the fearsome minions of Captain Kingg, in this new Sea of Brave adventure, a turn-based, single-player, deck-building, strategy roguelike. Don't let them capture you!

title: Everlasting: Tomorrow
description: Embark on a harrowing journey with Alice, a college student, and her classmate Adrian, as they venture to a desolate town in search of a special cave. Uncover the chilling mystery surrounding Alice's strange nightmares and their connection to the town. The horror awaits.

title: Don't Kill Them All
description: Don't Kill Them All is a turn-based strategy game with base-building, where you play the Orcs, the most feared creatures of the land. In the midst of an economic crisis, your Warlord is prepared to do whatever it takes to bring glory to the clan. Something has to change, and fast!

title: Croquettes Gang
description: Keep an eye on your master, steal his kibble and achieve your dream!

title: Dangerous Land
description: Dangerous Land is a first-person strategic game enriched with elements of exploration and action. Assume the role of the ruler of your settlement, manage and develop it in real-time, recruit and upgrade units, take care of resources, and participate in epic battles.

title: BackRooms's 1995: The Lost Footage - Chapter1
description: My name is Jacob, and I'm 25 years old. I've heard a lot of rumors about an abandoned house where people claim to see strange things. But I'm not here for that. I'm here to find my brother. He disappeared in January of 1970, I'll do whatever it takes to locate him, no matter what.

title: Musgro Farm
description: Plant crops, combine them intro recipes, and distribute them for sale in this incremental factory game. Optimize your layouts and reinvest in your infrastructure to maximize your output. Gain experience to unlock new technologies and expand your ever-growing farm.

title: Little Duck Adventure
description: Together with your friend, help two cute ducks through many trials. Work as a team to get the big picture. And remember, communication is the key to success.

title: My Girlfriend is... Centaur
description: Step into an extraordinary romance despite physiological disparities. Can you navigate a relationship with a centaur girl and overcome the challenges together?

title: Mr. Pompy's Extravagant Quiz
description: Think you're smart? Prove it by stepping into Mr. Pompy's Extravagant Quiz—an educational experience for clever kids and curious minds! Just don't disappoint Mr. Pompy.

title: Booster Racers
description: Are you ready to show your competitiveness? Here is Booster Racers, a chaotic racing game that you can play together with a friend in local multiplayer, or you can play alone too if you have no friends.

title: Benny's Backrooms
description: A co-op horror where you and your friends (if applicable) explore a seemingly infinite expanse of eerie creature-infested liminal spaces, armed only with a glorified vacuum and specialized equipment to help you locate and extract a rare substance in the name of science.

title: Speedy 500
description: Speedy 500 isn’t just a race; it’s a quest for immortality. Strap in, rev those engines, and chase the chequered flag. The countdown begins—500 miles await!

title: Digital Exorcist: CF1_Defrag
description: After the mysterious death of a Superstar Idol, disgraced DATA Agent Sawyer must face his ultimate challenge yet, being an undercover high school teacher while also keeping the Mississipi Inaka safe from Daemonic influence.

title: Find Kittens: The Last of Cats - Extra Level
description: New challenge for your observation in this cozy and addictive object search game.

title: Trash Can Tactics
description: Ever since the Nature's Legacy Institute has opened their doors to all, there have been an odd string of thefts - not of rare artifacts, but rather of the food from the cafeteria. Play as either a museum staff member, or an intelligent raccoon, in this asymmetrical PvP heist game.

title: 666: El día del portal
description: Action-platformer game with dual scrolling and multidirectional shooting.

title: Abandoned Hut
description: Explore scary places in this first-person horror game. Interact with characters, solve puzzles and discover that bad intentions can lead to catastrophic consequences.

title: Aeronesia
description: Aeronesia is a non-linear platform RPG with emphasis on exploration, combat, dialogue and quest-based progression. After an accident transports you and hundreds of other people into an alien world, it's up to you to find a way to survive and discover some means of getting back home.

title: A Great Hunger
description: A short Visual Novel where a demon offers a woman a terrifying proposal: to kill the man she once loved.

title: Age of Privateer
description: Age of Privateer is a real-time card battle-based roguelike deck-building game. Combine various cards to create a powerful deck and explore the vast seas. Can you uncover the secrets hidden in the ocean and find the ancient treasure?

title: You Are A Chat AI
description: "You are a chat AI" is a simulation game. No real AI is used, and the player pretends to be a chat AI and converses with NPCs. This game consists of two parts: "conversation" and "learning". The appeal of the game is that players who normally use AI can experience being used on the other hand.

title: AI Solitaire
description: AI Solitaire features Klondike Solitaire and Pyramid Solitaire, 18 different deck styles, and has password protected parental controls. The base game is offered for free and can be played as is without any cost forever.

title: AI Solitaire: Anime Cuties
description: AI Solitaire - Anime Cuties provides 12 new decks to use with AI Solitaire! This DLC is themed around beautiful girls in an anime style.

title: All the Darkest Places
description: Step into Alex, an upcoming college freshman battling depression. Living with his widowed father, Alex prepares to move in with Laura, a friend of his late mother. Guide Alex through university life, navigating personal struggles, forming connections, friendship and support.

title: Alpha Nomos
description: It’s time to wield the beat! Play as Cello and slice through an army of rogue puppets in a vibrant, melody-twisted world. Combat pulses to the soundtrack - time your moves to the beat to unleash show-stopping combos and perfectly choreographed chaos!

title: Almost Dungeon
description: Almost Dungeon reverses the roles by making you play a Dragon protecting his Dungeon. Arrange the corridors into a labyrinth of your liking and fool the adventurer who dared to enter your lair. Place traps in his way as fast as possible to get rid of him before he finds and slays you !

title: Alice's World
description: Alice's World is a story-driven 2D adventure puzzle game. Amidst desolate ruins and deserted cities in a world filled with death, the young girl Alice hears "your" voice from in front of the screen. You must guide her forward, solve the mysteries, and reach the top of the tower.

title: A Letter From Mom
description: On the morning of your 14th birthday, you receive a party invitation from your missing mom. The address leads you to a cult village. In this point-and-click puzzle adventure, you play as Nero, a black cat, as you unravel the mysteries behind your mom's disappearance.

title: Alchemic Beasts
description: Alchemic Beasts is a monster taming RPG adventure where you breed and transmute creatures using alchemy to forge powerful monsters. Join Zeig, a thrill seeking daredevil, as he harnesses his alchemic beasts to defeat the creature known as the legendary Demon King.

title: AI Solitaire: Painted Ladies
description: AI Solitaire - Painted Ladies provides 12 new decks to use with AI Solitaire! This DLC is themed around beautiful women rendered in the style of traditional fantasy art paintings.

title: Angry Tiny Sun
description: Unleash your dominance in the arena with explosive power-ups, strategic plays, and electrifying combos in our adrenaline-pumping 'Hot-Potato-With-Physics' style combat! Angry Tiny Sun has absolutely zero Pay-To-Win Features!

title: Androsystem Idle
description: Produce Androids and create a Fleet that will help you conquer new planets. Mine valuable minerals that will further increase your production capacity.

title: Anders: The Dark Coast
description: In "Anders: The Dark Coast," dive into a sinister underworld after a fateful encounter. Unravel the mystery with Anders and friends as they confront a malevolent gang, leading to a deeply personal reckoning with the elusive leader, Jayden.

title: Animal Bomb Chess
description: This is a Chess games. You can choose your animal at the beginning of the game. animals with their own characteristics, manipulate them to obtain props on the map, and use them. Although the process may test one's luck, you must still make every effort to survive until the end.

title: Ant Attack
description: Ant Attack - A peculiar blend of Clicker and Tower Defense.

title: Annuit Coeptis
description: Deckbuilder. Roguelite. Metaprogression. Words are a weak attempt to describe reality - in Annuit Coeptis you use cards to wreak violence across a land poised upon the brink of destruction. Will you defy the End of the World?

title: Another Realm
description: You awaken at the shores of a land seemingly far from home, your boat wrecked, not really knowing what actually happened. Your only option is to find civilization and hope to find a way home. Not all is as it seems, as Jimmy will soon find out!

title: Anime Girl Puzzles: Honomi
description: In the elegant serenity of the imperial palace, Honomi practices the Geisha arts. She is ready to do anything her master desires.

title: Anime Girl Puzzles: Sana
description: It's harvest season on the Yamaguchi farm! Sana is busier than ever, making sure her crops are collected on time.

title: Anime Girl Puzzles: Suki
description: Quiet in the library! Suki is very protective of the books and documents in her archives, and she can be very strict with rule-breakers...

title: Animeahikoaprinceaverse A4: Prince Akihiko & Princess A
description: When the prince of the kingdom was cursed, rendering his magic uncontrollable, However, the curse weakened when the prince was near his two fiancées. One of his fiancées managed to discover the origin of the curse, and they embarked on an adventure to lift the curse from the prince.

title: An Agonized Mind
description: An Agonized Mind is a minimalist, survival horror, 2D top down shooter. Explore corridors filled with mutilated human experiments as you run and shoot your way to freedom. Gather resources and upgrade yourself, choosing to be robotic or human as you fight horrors of the compound.

title: Anchors: Start
description: Anchors:start is a Cthulhu style 2d shooting game.The game requires players to explore in various maps generated by the program,find and bring back equipment,and live in a base full of doomsday atmosphere.When you explore the map,you see some strange things,calm down.Maybe that's truth!

title: Ancient Savo
description: Raise a family in the pristine woodlands of ancient Finland. Manage your homestead, craft tools and items, barter for goods, live off the land. Continue as your offspring, start new homesteads. Plan wisely to survive in the wilderness where cold, hunger and accidents are your enemies.

title: Ancient Scroll
description: Ancient Scroll - the game is a mixture of an adventure game and classic quests. You have to go to an abandoned ranch in search of an ancient scroll. Where an exciting adventure awaits you, hiding many mysteries!

title: Bloodgrounds
description: Delve into roguelike arena combat and city management where core gameplay features strategic battles, town development, and character growth. Command Gladiator units and navigate various mechanics for a comprehensive gaming experience.

title: Bloobs Adventure Idle
description: Inspired by RuneScape, Bloobs Adventure Idle is a skill-based idle RPG with 24 skills, prestige progression, over 100 pets, and a unique banked-time system. Train, craft, and conquer at your own pace.

title: Bloxolotl
description: Bloxolotl is a cozy puzzle game all about cute block-shaped Axolotls and connecting them together.

title: Blue Hunter
description: Welcome to hell! Forge your own path as a Blue Hunter and turn into a god! Create your own army of undead monsters and beat all the monarchs that stand in your way. How far can you go?

title: Zopa
description: Meet the new game! In the role of Little Red Riding Hood's relative, you will go on a forest adventure. Throw explosive pies, meet wolves, pigs, gnomes and other inhabitants of the forest. Funny cutscenes, voiced dialogues, unique locations - every step is a new challenge!

title: Blunder The Sea
description: Use movement and your spear gun to take down underwater baddies. The goal? Treasure of course!

title: Blumgi Soccer
description: Blumgi Soccer offers a refreshing take on soccer. With big kicks and a dynamic physics system, every level invites you to strategize, kick, and score in ways you've never imagined. Get ready for a soccer experience like no other!

title: Bluff with Ash
description: A story of retracing memories. In your recollections, defeat the oncoming saboteurs and get the truth. Even if it is a tragedy.

title: Board Game Party
description: This is a 3D game integrating various classic board games. Players can engage in online battles, strategize against AI, or enjoy local mode with friends. It offers an immersive gaming experience with realistic graphics and a global leaderboard.

title: Containment Search
description: You are in an abandoned garage warehouse and have been locked up. will you survive the horror that awaits you there or will you stay trapped there forever?

title: Someone's Outside
description: You had a long day at work and just arrived home. However, something feels off.

title: The Torture House
description: In September 1994, Victoria Atkins, a young aspiring model, was traveling through Cooke County, Texas, in search of job opportunities when she suddenly disappeared. While it was initially believed she had simply become lost on the road, days passed without any sign of her. But what no one could imagine were the horrors of the ultra violence she would experience in a place that could easily be described as hell, The Torture House.

title: Micro Tanks
description:
The Classic Artillery Tank Game!
Time To Get Shell-shocked!
Micro Tanks is that fan favorite artillery tank game from your childhood. Destroy the enemy in classic mode or free for all mode firing at will.

title: The British Trivia Challenge
description: How well do you know your British Trivia? Test your knowledge in The British Trivia Challenge!

title: Wrestling Trivia
description: How well do you know your Wrestling Trivia?

title: Kids & Family Movie Trivia
description:
It’s Trivia for the Entire Family!

Test your knowledge on Family-Friendly Movies.

title: Shadow Hush
description: In 'Shadows Hush' infiltrate 'Guard' to unveil sinister experiments. Stealth mastery is key. Unravel secrets with cunning, aided by your radio partner. Will you save the world?

title: Big Helmet Heroes
description: Throw yourself into an epic 3D beat'em up adventure with adorable knights, full of surprising worlds and situations. Grab your buddy and play in 2 player co-op to save the princess, but this is only the beginning!

title: Epitaph: Soutai no Aitai
description: Windy and Dokuo go on a journey through various isekai as dimension-hopping heroes, facing a different Demon King each time.

title: Super Sexy Swiss
description:
What's the mission of the S.S.S.C.F.A.T.T. - Super Sexy Swiss Cardio Frenetic Ambulance Transplant Team?

To deliver a living heart along with some MASSIVE FUN!

title: Skull and Bones: Season 2 - Chorus of Havoc
description:
Clash against emerging threats - from the eccentric Hubac Twins, to a colossal megalodon stalking the seas.

Earn new exclusive rewards through time-limited festive events, including the Dragon's Regatta and Summer Fiesta.

Discover more ways to expand your pirate empire, from new features like Ship Upgrades and Fleet Management, to new opportunities like Manufactory Defense and Buyout.

title: Turnabout Bakeshop
description: ​It's not easy going legitimate. When Winfred Kitaki is fatally shot behind the counter of the Kitaki Bakery, Wocky is charged with premeditated murder. But don't worry! Apollo Justice has come back to the office, and he has a plan, a witness, and an airtight argument. The only problem is, he also has the worst defendant ever.

title: AI.VI
description: A mercenary robot is forced out of retirement as the P.A.S.C.A.L. Gigacorporation conquers his planet to squeeze it dry. Combine your FPS and tower defense skills, then send the corporate invaders to the scrapheap, seize the means of production, and take the planet back for the worker bots!

title: Banana Ranch
description: Banana Ranch is a Boys Love (BL) / Gay dating sim game, mixed with farming and ranch management gameplay aspect. The story follows Ban (changeable name) who suddenly comes to a world with no human.

title: Ava and the Half-World
description: Face a horizon of forgotten myths, sunken relics and mysterious creatures! Fly, shoot and explore your way up the Sidereal Riptide, a dark expanse of water and the cradle of infinite drifting islands.

title: Paris Belle Epoque
description: A 2.5D adventure game mixing stealth, puzzles and actions in Paris at Belle Epoque. Anna, a young chemist, develops accidentally a murderous formula. Teamed up with her former laboratory rat Spunky, she will have to learn clandestinity, escape from Police to reveal the danger of her discovery!

title: Isonzo: Expedition Units
description: The ‘Expedition Units' pack expands the German faction with a set of winter themed uniforms and accessories, plus a set of battle hardened elite troops. It contains two sets of uniforms for all classes, plus a wealth of headgear options.

title: Killer Klowns From Outer Space: The Game - Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
Digital Deluxe Content Includes:
2 Human Characters (Mike & Debbie)
2 Klown Skins (Fryzo & Sundaze)
1 Movie Klown Skin (Bibbo)
Digital Soundtrack
Digital Art Book

title: Capes: King City Edition
description:
In addition to Capes, the King City Edition contains:
- The complete Supporter Pack DLC
- 8 Alternate Hero Skins: Change your outfits to battle crime with new style.
- Digital Artbook: A look behind the scenes of the game, featuring concept art and inspirations.
- 24 Wallpapers in 4K: Enjoy characters and environments in beautiful illustrated images.

title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Into Madness
description: A free compilation of several previous gameplay ideas in the same vein as FNaF World: Update 2.

title: Murky Divers
description: Co-op diving horror. Eliminate all traces of your employer's failed experiments from their abandoned underwater labs. Navigate your submarine, dive down with your crew, remove all corpses, but watch out for the abyssal terrors lurking.

title: Ridgeside Village: NPC Adventures
description: Ridgeside Village's official content pack for NPC Adventures!

title: Hiragana Hero
description:
Learn to read, recognize, and use hiragana as you guide Keen Reflex through a 50-floor labyrinth in an addictive and educational dungeon crawler RPG.
Learning to read [i]hiragana is the first step in your Japanese learning journey and it's the first hurdle that learners struggle to get over.
This addictive RPG dungeon crawler will have you reading Japanese in record time and cut out all that boring study.

title: Lavender Memories
description: A three minute experience

title: Running Memories
description: Running throgh a series of overlaying memories

title: The Nameless City
description: The Nameless City is a narrative-driven first person adventure inspired by Lovecraft's short novel of the same name. It has lo-fi 3D graphics inspired by the PSX era and uses AI generated images to convey concepts alien to the human mind.

title: A House for Alesa 3
description: One year after the events of A House for Alesa 2, Alesa and Greta decide to move away from the city and buy a house in a nice small rural town. However, unbeknownst to them, something wicked is taking place in the town. Now, the worst nightmare imaginable is about to begin...

title: Gay Joker
description: Gay Joker is a mod for Persona 5 Royal that allows Joker to romance the guys!

title: The Booty Creek Cheek Freak
description: The Booty Creek Cheek Freak is a 2022 short parody slasher horror game developed by Jordan King, and produced/published by Puppet Combo.

title: Traffic Race 3D 2
description: Traffic Race 3D 2 is a tribute to retro racing, race solo or split screen with a friend. Prove that you are an awesome driver by reaching the 1st place on the online leaderboards

title: Oh no! I'm about to fall in love!
description: The user takes on the role of the male protagonist Lu Shichuan and embarks on a journey of time and space with a photo. They meet seven beautiful women with completely different personalities and appearances. The final chapter of who you can stay with in the world is up to you to decide.

title: Airplane
description: An indie game where the goal is to defeat as many waves of enemies as possible, or have fun and weaving through buildings.

title: Amazing Curves Racing
description: Amazing Curves Racing: the simple, fast, and efficient racing simulator, where you start or join a race in seconds. The online multiplayer physics engine hides lag well and the tire model works directly on cubic 3D surfaces, for a high-speed racing experience not available anywhere else.

title: Amazônia Viva: Animais em Extinção
description: Embark on this adventure through the Amazon Rainforest, where you will take on the role of the legendary Curupira, the guardian of the forest. With the goal of saving endangered animals, you will face incredible challenges and learn about the rich biodiversity of the world's largest tropical forest.

title: Ameena: Witchborn Duelist
description: Embark on a dark fantasy quest, navigating procedurally generated realms. Master strategic card duels to avenge your mother against the underworld's greatest demon. Experience a blend of magic, strategy, and deep revenge in this ever-evolving adventure.

title: Amerta
description: Amerta is a Zombie Typing Survival Game. Type as fast as you can! Survive zombie waves. SHOOT by TYPING!

title: Apocalyptic Shadows
description: This game is set in a fictional post-apocalyptic Western Europe. They must use their wits and skills to survive in dangerous environments. On the road of adventure, players will encounter thrilling moments and feel an unparalleled tension and sense of accomplishment.

title: Aquarium Land: Armadillo
description: Adopt a little armadillo and explore the aquatic world together!

title: Aquarium Land: Baby Seal
description: Adopt a baby seal and explore the aquatic world together!

title: Aquarium Land: Parrot
description: Adopt a lovely parrot and explore the aquatic world together!

title: Aquarium Land: Puppy
description: Adopt a cute puppy and explore the aquatic world together!

title: Antisuns
description: Antisuns is a tactical RPG set in the far future. Command your crew in turn-based combat across multiple spaceships. See enemy moves ahead of time, and come up with the perfect response. Push your luck for greater rewards. If you fail, go back in time, for another randomly-generated run.

title: Arbo: Arena Tactics
description: ARBO: Arena Tactics is a sci-fi-themed PvP turn-based tactical strategy/CCG hybrid that pits players in a fast-paced battle of wits and theorycrafting as they command Squads of futuristic Heroes to engage in combat in an interactive hextiled arena.

title: Archery Simulator 2
description: Archery Simulator 2 is a thrilling game that is perfect for those who love to test their archery skills.

title: Architect Simulator
description: Manage your own architecture firm! Would you prefer to design one skyscraper or many residences, or maybe all at once? Create buildings, beautify the city, sell land plots, manage a warehouse, hire employees, buy real estate, and watch your health.

title: Bob Fight
description: BobFight is a hilarious party game for 2 to 4 players where you play as quirky characters in a series of chaotic mini-games. Take on your friends in uproarious challenges, earn crowns, and become the undisputed king of the party! Who will be the last Bob standing? Find out in BobFight!

title: Bomber Royale
description: A retro arcade experience.

title: Bonds of Yachiyo

Through crafting and exploration, you will discover the town's history and find a way to solve its monster problem once and for all.

title: Honcho
description: Take on the Keiretsu and reclaim your grandfather's rightful spot amongst Japan's financial elite. Use your bespoke kei truck to deliver packages, purchase real estate and expand your company to show them you're more than just another Sukeban.

title: Honor Battle
description: **Honor Battle**: Dive into the heart of conflict in this thrilling action game, where you stand as the last line of defense against a brutal terrorist insurgency.

title: Horatio: Connector 13
description: Akio's accidental encounter with "Horatio’s Life" leads to a mysterious journey intertwining his past with a parallel world. Unravel secrets, confront otherworldly threats, and uncover the truth in this atmospheric adventure.

title: Horatio: Connector 13 (Chapters 1-12)
description: Akio's accidental encounter with "Horatio's Life" leads to a mysterious journey intertwining his past with a parallel world. Unravel secrets, confront otherworldly threats, and uncover the truth in this atmospheric adventure.

title: Hot & Lewd: Miami
description: Get ready for an exciting world of vibrant colors, high speeds in Hot & Lewd: Miami. In this dynamic visual novel, you will meet the main character, a young guy who just graduated from the police academy but chose a life of wild parties and extreme street races over serving as an officer.

title: Horse Runner DX
description: Lead your herd. Survive the chaos. Grow and guide your ever-expanding horse herd in this fast-paced arcade roguelite runner. Stack unique power-ups, master the trail, and push your limits in addictive high-score runs to climb the global leaderboard.

title: Horror In Hongdae
description: Solve the mystery of the disappearance of a real estate tycoon. This adventure/visual novel game will unveil the secrets hidden behind the facades of a neighborhood in Seoul, with some being frightening and others holding pleasant surprises.

title: Hornet the Vanguard
description: "Reveal all, deceive all." Hornet the Vanguard, a mystery-solving adventure game. Solve mysteries and gather information in the exploration part, and uncover the truth in the deduction part! …The key to the case is always with buddy.

title: House of Golf 2
description: House of Golf 2 delivers an engaging multiplayer golf experience with over 100 unique holes to conquer. Gather up to 4 players for lively couch play sessions, showcasing your skills with jaw-dropping shots. Compete in live tournaments for exciting rewards and leave your mark on the world of golf!

title: HSHS
description: HSHS! Turn me on is a virtual interactive romance game designed for women. You will take on the role of Pricilla Tang, a new entrant live streaming operations assistant, you will encounter him amidst the hustle and bustle of daily life, leading to a destiny that is uniquely yours!

title: Impawlse
description: Take care of your kittens, decorate their space, play with them.... It's all about kittens! The ultimate cat experience awaits you!

title: Impostor Online
description: Impostor Online is a 4–16 player social deduction game of murder, lies, and paranoia. Every match you're dealt a secret role: investigate, heal, deceive—or kill. Someone at the table wants you dead. Find them first, or make sure they never find you.

title: Industring
description: A minimalistic urban planning puzzle. Manage resources and building locations. Accumulate knowledge points and discover the secrets of the destroyed planet

title: Infantry Attack: Drone Squad
description: Equip yourself with new drones and show your opponents who's the real boss!

title: Infantry Attack: Strike from Above
description: Equip yourself with a new secondary weapon and show your opponents who's the real boss!

title: Infinite Coaster
description: What speed would make the roller coaster go off the track? Experience a realistic yet crazy riding of Roller Coaster now! Can you reach the end safely in limited time? Accelerate the roller coaster boldly but cautiously, feeling your heartbeat and excitement now! Try now!

title: Infinite Survivor
description: Fight your way to survival with tons of abilities and Survivors to choose from. Create the ultimate combination of Survivor and Abilities in this rogue lite, bullet hell action adventure. Unlock new Survivors and use unique abilities to achieve the ultimate goal of survival.

title: Inkression
description: Enter the world of Milly Sommerville, a troubled tattoo artist tasked with capturing the remnants of her nearly-demolished neighborhood through her art. Walk the streets of her dark world, reconcile with her own past, and redefine the meanings of impressions in this first person narrative game.

title: In Search of Heroes!
description: Calling all Heroes! The age of knights is in its twilight, but the people still require your aid! Venture through various randomly-generated locales, complete quests and take down fearsome bosses. Return to your home estate to construct new buildings, equip powerful weapons, and rally new heroes!

title: Insectum: Epic Battles of Bugs
description: Immerse yourself in the epic battles of "Insectum" and unleash the power of your monstrous insects. Face off against your rivals on the battlefield by strategically using cards.

title: In Memoriam
description: In Memoriam brings you back to one of the darkest times of Argentinian history.

title: Instant Armory
description: Instant Armory is an application that allows you to design arms, armor, and equipment for fantasy tabletop roleplaying games.

title: In The Disorderly Courtyard
description: This is a platform puzzle game, The game mainly tells the story of playing the female lead and repairing the virtual world. The game takes 2-3 hours and features unique cartoon rendering technology, global dynamic lighting, and a blend of sunrise and sunset colors and light sources.

title: Java Journey
description: Embark on a caffeine-fueled escapade! Play as a brave coffee cup reclaiming stolen treasures from tea slimes. Navigate charming landscapes, overcome obstacles, and solve puzzles. Join the whimsical adventure and taste victory!

title: Jesus Christ Simulator
description: 'Jesus Christ Simulator' is a new take on the 'Superhero Simulator' game genre. You are tasked by God your Father with fixing the broken system that humans now live in. Armed with Unlimited Miracles, Flight & Superpowers, you will change the world and help its people. You are THE Ultimate Superhero!

title: Jianghu Chronicles
description: Jianghu Chronicles is a Wuxia-themed clan simulator, which focuses on simulating Jianghu clans and experiencing realistic battle. Set up a clan of your own, recruit disciples, complete missions... And eventually make your clan second to none by improving its power and reputation.

title: Jin Ping Mei
description: This game is adapted from the classic novel Jin Ping Mei. The protagonist was born in a merchant family. His parents died young and left him a pharmacy. On his 25th birthday, he made a vow: I will spend the rest of my life with wives and concubines, rich as hell...

title: Jordi & Oslo: The Lost Tail
description: Cute 2D Point-n-Click of the adorable comic book characters Jordi and Oslo the dragon.

title: Pixel Puzzles Ultimate Jigsaw: Mini Beasts
description: Pixel Puzzles, The Number #1 place for Jigsaws!

title: John Fox
description: John Fox is an elite warrior and super soldier who saved the leaders of various States. He was a professional mercenary who retired with honor. But now his beloved pet, Milo, has been killed. You have to avenge him!

title: Josh Powlison's Button: Mildly Remastered Edition
description: Press a button. Increment a number. Change reality. The instant classic returns for a mildly remastered electric boogaloo on modern computer systems. Once again experience the euphoria of button pressing with Josh Powlison's striking developer commentary to guide you.

title: JosPlays' Escape: GameJam April 2024
description: ESCAPE! Collect the 5 tools and escape from this creepy attic. Keep the score high by avoiding ghosts and collecting the ghost diamonds, but keep in mind with every diamond you collect, more ghosts will appear and they will become harder to avoid.

title: Journey of Reincarnation
description: 【Reincarnation Roguelike Retro RPG】Battle is fully automatic with no commands! Support the characters who think for themselves and do their best by collecting “Jewel”. Repeatedly reincarnate and aim to conquer dungeons that change their appearance each time you enter them!

title: Journey of Harvest
description: Welcome to Hope Town! You will be given an abandoned land where you can collect resources, assemble production lines, upgrade equipment, start adventures, harvest rewards, etc. I believe that in the near future, you will be able to unlock the secrets of the mine and enjoy this harvest journey.

title: Kado Hunter
description: As you are stranded in Vanada, you're meeting the sisters Aya and Chiyo. After you get to know what is happening, you decide to help them. In your journey as KADO HUNTER you will collect KADOS, fight against monsters, solve quests and get ready to explore Vanada.

title: Kadin the Soul Eater
description: A Story driven game, where choices can branch. Pretend to be a mortal with so called friends.

title: Just You
description: "Only One Must Remain Alive" thrusts you into a relentless battleground where survival hinges solely on your individual prowess.

title: Just Walk
description: One Character, One way and One Button you must never let go of.Just Walk.

title: Karting with Animals
description: "Karting with Animals: The Wild Race" flips the script on traditional racing games, infusing the thrill of speed with the unpredictability of the animal kingdom.

title: Karm: Early Access Archives
description: KARM brings back '90s FPS look and feel in a lovecraftian world.

title: Karjala
description: VHS bodycam horror in the atmosphere of Soviet Backrooms. Karelia is a country of rivers, forests and lakes, where the modern world comes in contact with superstitions and ancient rituals. Soldier Solnyshkov agrees to take part in a strange experiment of his command.

title: Kana
description: Start your Japanese learning journey by learning the fundamentals! In Kana, you get to practice Hiragana and Katakana, which are two of the writing systems in Japanese.

title: Kalasta
description: Kalasta is a roguelite deckbuilder fish game with real time strategy mechanics. Play cards to spawn fish, feed them and defend your fish from waves of monsters!

title: K-Bot
description: K-Bot is an innovative puzzle casual game that cleverly combines classic block stacking and path planning game elements. Players need to strategically move within a dynamically changing play area to achieve the goal of clearing lines.

title: Keaton's Adventure
description: Traverse the newly formed Milkdromeda Galaxy to restore balance and stomp out the Ultralite invasion!
