title: Kittentegy
description: Are you ready to accept the challenge and stand up for the delicious cheese? In the Kittentegy game, you have to stop the mice from stealing the cheese from the houses. Your strategic skills and decisive actions will be the key to victory!

title: Kitty Collapse
description: Kitty Collapse offers an explosive first-person experience. Armed with diverse weapons, players demolish towering structures filled with mischievous cats. Each level brings unique challenges, with maps ranging from bustling cityscapes to tranquil countryside settings

title: Koitsugi: Legend of the Water Guardian
description: Play as Kaida, a koi who is reluctantly thrown in to save, not just her pond, but the entire river from a poison that turns the habitants into raged filled monsters. In this story driven action-adventure you will slug it out with some of these river dwellers, friend and foe, to save your home!

title: Korean Rail Driving Tour: LRT Busan-Gimhae
description: This game is a railroad simulation game that allows you to experience actual railroad operation based on 1080p, 60 frame video footage of the driving direction of an actual train. Get feeling of being a train driver just by operating the accelerator and brakes. Enjoy S.Korea’s beautiful scenery!

title: Kunkun League
description: Damn! Kunkun, unable to bear the humiliation from Xiao Hei, turned to Lao Da to learn basketball skills. Lao Da's challenge is to find exploding basketballs.

title: Kun’tewiktuk: A Mi’kmaw Adventure
description: Kun’tewiktuk: A Mi’kmaw Adventure is a fantasy adventure game inspired by Mi’kmaw legend and folklore. It chronicles the adventures of siblings Wasuek ("Flower") and her brother U'n ("Fog"). They get separated one summer morning and they go on an adventure through the spirit world to reunite.

title: Lade's Sandbox
description: A voxel-based sandbox game

title: LaughterLost
description: LaughterLost takes you through a surreal journey of work and family life. Face psychological twists, narrative choices, puzzles, and unexpected unique confrontations! Will you break this dystopian cycle of everyday life?

title: Leap 'n Bump!
description: A sexy platformer, now with an extra game expansion. Solve the underground tunnels mystery and help the Endless Forest in the extra content!

title: Le Dernier Don
description: Following a tragic event in an orphanage caused by horrific human experiments, an orphan tries to find other survivors while danger still lurks.

title: Legend of the Master Baiter
description: A fun and unique fishing RPG anybody can enjoy! Beings known as fishgirls show themselves before only a select few worthy fishermen. Fish inhabiting lakes, rivers, and the sea take on bold new forms! Try to collect them all!

title: Leo: The Square
description: Leo: The Square is a minimalist 2D platformer where players guide Leo, a square character, through various levels filled with puzzles and challenges. Explore unique environments, solve puzzles, and uncover the secrets of Leo's journey in this atmospheric adventure.

title: Let's Learn Xaad Kil
description: Let's Learn X̱aad Kíl (Alaskan dialect) is an interactive self-study program designed to help those curious about Haida and to help them be as familiarized as possible. It includes games, activities, and a picture glossary.

title: Life of Kanji Island
description: Life of Kanji Island is a game that helps you understand the ‘meaning’ of Japanese Kanji characters. Survive the island where all elements are composed of Kanji and master the Kanji!

title: Light Bearers 2
description: Light Bearers 2 is a fast paced hide and seek, asymmetrical multiplayer horror game. A Shadow is trying to corrupt all Light Bears. The Light Bears must use their movement and cunning. To keep each other from becoming corrupted by darkness.

title: Light Unseen
description: An underground adventure with magic and fantasy-like monsters with a story where actions affect the outcome

title: Lilly And The Murder In A Dream
Limelight
description: Cast various lights on your enemies to destroy them, conquer a hundred randomly generated dungeons and defeat bosses. Always in the Limelight!

title: Lost In Memories
description: Step into the eerie shadows of an old haunted house in 'Lost in memories,' a gripping narrative-driven game that will unravel the mysteries of the past. As you wander through the decaying corridors and dimly lit rooms, you will gradually piece together fragments of memories.

title: Love Island
description: Tired of the hustle and bustle? Take a tour to Love Island! Play this match-three game with RPG elements to seduce all those charming anime girls!

title: Love Sucks: Night Three
description: This is Love Sucks:Night Three, the third and final part in your mission to get laid and not die doing it. When sexy monsters are out to kill you for their own mysterious goals, it's date or die! So far you've manged to both live and die through two nights, but will you get out alive?

title: Lower? Higher!
description: your pawnshop will usher in guests with different needs every day, bargain with them, let the income soar! With the expansion of pawnshops, activities such as sending shop assistants and responding to emergencies are also essential. you seem ordinary transaction may cause the butterfly effect.

title: Lukewarm Massacre: The Spirit of Light
description: Lukewarm Massacre: The Spirit of Light tells a comedy-horror adventure of three forest spirits. Join them in finding their kidnapped friend!

title: Manludo 2
description: EN: Awake on an alien space-station, shape your journey through decisions, crafting your own interstellar adventure. EO: Vekiĝu en ekstertera kosmostacio, formu vian vojaĝon per decidoj, kaj vivu vian propran interstelan aventuron.

title: Man I Just Wanna Go Home
description: Man I Just Wanna Go Home is an "MSPaint-noir" visual novel with 13 endings, a unique visual style and a killer 80s inspired soundtrack. The story revolves around a delivery person stranded in an unfamiliar part of the city under the devastating rain. All he wants is to get home. Help him!

title: Malvinas: La Ultima Carta
description: The last survivor of a battalion (a teenage soldier) must protect the last letter of his fallen comrades. Undergo the hunger, cold and violence the Argentinean soldiers had to endure during the war on the islands.

title: Making Friends
description: Guide the misanthropic witch Morrigan as she creates a homemade friend of her very own in this short and sweet sapphic visual novel!

title: Magic Venue
description: Defeat waves of enemies drawn to your powers! Grow stronger and travel between worlds and dimensions! Magic Venue is an action roguelike game where you battle enemies, build your skill deck, devise strategies, get defeated, but always come back stronger!

title: Master of Pieces: Jigsaw Puzzle - Glass Dreams
description: Unique Puzzles Not Found Anywhere Else. These 36 detailed stained glass puzzles will immerse you in a world where the intricate beauty of mesmerizing patterns comes to life.

title: Master of Pieces: Jigsaw Puzzle - Timeless Heritage
description: Step into the past with Timeless Heritage, where every puzzle holds a piece of the history. Enjoy 36 gorgeous puzzles.

title: Master of Pieces: Jigsaw Puzzle - Unknown Worlds
description: Find your favorite puzzle among a pack of 39 wonderful images - from ethereal dreamscapes to whimsical fantasies!

title: Master of Pieces: Jigsaw Puzzle - Whispers of Nature
description: Try 33 detailed pictures with busy backgrounds, ideal for puzzling, immerses you in the beauty of the natural world.

title: Pixel Puzzles The Musical
description: Pixel Puzzles Musical, listen to your favorite bands as you puzzle.

title: Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Generations - Birds 2
description: Puzzles of Birds!

title: Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Generations - Music
description: Puzzles of music!

title: Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Generations - Red Things
description: Puzzles of Red Things!

title: Tamaniwatori's Puzzle
description: This is a simple and sometimes tricky 3D puzzle game in which the egg-shaped chicken "Tamaniwatori'' hatches eggs. While avoiding the natural enemy "Tamawani", advance on the various scaffolds set up, hatch all the eggs, and aim for the goal.

title: Twizzle Puzzle: Horses
description: Twizzle Puzzle: Horses - is the perfect puzzle game for a fun and rewarding pastime.

title: Puzzle Garden
description: A short, casual puzzle game where you utilize unique land layouts and crop abilities to maximize your profit.

title: Puzzlemazed
description: Classic Arcade, 2D, Puzzle and Mazed, pixel art. Easy to Play, Hard to Complete. Puzzlemazed is one genuine medieval challenge. The ancient lands of Atlas, dominated by three kingdoms. Humans coexisted with the Titans in perfect harmony, Discover the history of one great adventure.

title: Roll: A Puzzle Contraption
description: Roll is a creative puzzle game where you build contraptions out of stickers to roll, fling, and guide a hamster to its goal. Collect stickers as you complete puzzles, then build your own wacky contraptions for Hammy.

title: Stick Robot Puzzle
description: A puzzle game that combines "Slide Puzzle" (you cannot stop until you hit a wall.) and "Sokoban" .

title: Art Jigsaw Puzzles
description: Like jigsaw puzzles? Hundreds of famous painting jigsaw puzzles welcome you to challenge.

title: OG Puzzlers: Spring 2K24
description: OG Puzzlers: Spring 2K24 is an puzzel game with stunning nature pictures . You have to assemble a single image from random generated indivdual pieces. Combine all of the smart singel frames into one big image and unlock the next level.

title: Hidden Cats in Jigsaw Puzzle
description: The beautifully hand-drawn art of the Hidden Cats Series levels from Nukearts is now in a Jigsaw Puzzle game! Enjoy the free content from Paris City and get more from DLCs.

title: DachStudio Puzzle Box: Mystical Worlds by RiaStarchild
description: 10 beautifully hand drawn mystical worlds from RiaStarchild to puzzle.

title: Digital Meow
description: Digital Meow is a vaporwave platformer where a little cat journeys through a digital world to find a new home. Overcome lasers, spikes, and cannons in this nostalgic and challenging adventure!

title: Curse of Dares
description: Frau and her friends talk about how they could not stay the night in a haunted house. Frau doesn't believe in ghosts, so she said she would spend the night alone at an abandoned school nearby to prove that ghosts don't exist.

title: Ares Breathes
description: Ares Breathes is a classic survival horror game in which you explore a recently destroyed Martian colony, given shape as a late 90s style low poly game complete with tank controls and static cameras.

title: Art Diff
description: Find the differences between the 2 pictures. Many public domain artworks are used to create the levels. Some levels have animation.

title: Art Dash
description: A short Rouge Like game about shapes and colors, its a shooter about using color to your advantage to pop enemies. Inspired by games like enter the Gungeon and binding of Isaac!

title: Armored Suit Solgante
description: Lieutenant Will, an armored suit pilot, works diligently to combat threats to the nation. Unfortunately, in his struggle to fight against terrorists, he's implicated in one of the very schemes he's fighting against.

title: Armadillo Assault
description: Armadillo Assault is an online multiplayer, action-platformer shooter, inspired by the glory days of couch multiplayer fun. Re-creating the magic of local multiplayer in an online environment, Armadillo Assault offers a unique experience for players looking to have a fun online PvP experience!

title: Arkhe
description: 52 biomes, 520 items, and endless progression, the first cooperative (up to 4 players) roguelike in a dark fantasy aesthetic.

title: Hotel 77
description: You are trapped in an endless lovecraftian hotel. Observe your surroundings and avoid eldritch anomalies in order to reach the exit.

title: UnderKingdom
description: This is a top-down automatic shooting light ROGUE game. You will use various fruits to fight. Pick up the fruits to destroy the enemies!

title: Because The World Died
description: Retro pixel art role-playing game in a harsh and dark world, focused on survival and understanding your past. Why? Because The World Died. Features include nonlinear plot with many viable endings, dark humor and text-based combat (no animations).

title: Watching Paint Dry: Too
description: A comedy based FPS. Interesting maps, modes, and secrets

title: Painted In Blood
description: Trapped in the haunting realm of an artist's twisted nightmare, engage in intense combat with grotesque enemies and monsters, experience unpredictable horror events that unfold dynamically, seamlessly blends classic retro FPS elements with modern elements.

title: S.T.A.R.W.I.E.L.D.
description: S.T.A.R.W.I.E.L.D. is finally here! Embark on an exhilarating space journey where you'll explore the surface of a mysterious planet on a motorcycle, complete thrilling missions, and battle formidable foes!

title: Really Simple Golf
description: Really Simple Golf is a climbing platformer golf, that blends chill vibes with precision driven adventure. Embark on an adventure across vibrant courses, mastering tricky shoots, navigating obstacles, and sinking those perfect putts.

title: Where Are We?
description: Trapped in an unknown space for unknown reasons, the two adventurers must now turn their teamwork for finding treasure into one for survival and escape! Will adventurers escape from the unknown space and get treasure again?

title: Beyond Reason
description: Beyond reason is a knowledge-based time-loop game about surviving a tiny open world. Master fluid first person combat, while uncovering the island's secrets. When you die, you take nothing but your knowledge of the world into the next loop.

title: Cabin Corpse
description: Cabin Corpse is a story-driven adult horror visual novel. Filled with suspenseful story telling, compelling characters and a dash of mature themes.

title: Calamity
description: The world’s first hyper clicker game with challenging controls. An ambitious solo-developed title packed with strategy and boss battles! Challenge yourself with infinite leveling and extreme difficulty!

title: Cage of Roses
description: A haunting gothic romance set in the 19th century. Follow Meike, a young woman from an impoverished noble family, as she’s swept off her feet by the mysterious Magdalena: a vampire who possesses a dark secret.

title: Calangos e Coxinhas
description: Manage your stocks, organize your resources, cook snacks and make friendships.

title: CaliaQuest
description: CaliaQuest is an erotic hypnosis roleplaying game where you are the brave hero, on a quest for the Princess. Can you make it through six chapters full of branching paths, monster girls, and seductive women and complete your quest, or will you fall in love along the way?

title: Catch Thieves
description: Feeling stuck in the same old routine and craving some excitement?

title: ChingMing
description: As a Taoist from the Heavenly Master's Mansion, you will come down the mountain to experience various demons and monsters on this land. You need to personally build a camp, search for food, establish defenses, and do everything you can to survive.

title: Christmas Countdown
description: Join Santa's elves in a festive race against time to wrap presents and fill Santa's sleigh before Christmas Eve in this fun and cheerful game for the whole family.

title: College Basketball Manager
description: Take charge as head coach in College Basketball Manager. Recruit your dream team, whether that be through All-Americans or hidden gems. Strategize gameplay, schedule games, run practices, and manage your staff, because you are in control. The court is your canvas – create a powerhouse.

title: Comet Angel
description: Comet Angel is a sci-fi visual novel with point and click puzzles. Help the mysterious alien Faerie return home by bringing it the food it needs to fly, and help Izzy and Nat learn to understand themselves and each other.

title: ComplexToe
description: Strategize boldly, move swiftly, and unlock the potential of intricate thought!

title: Cosmic Outpost
description: Cosmic Outpost is a turn-based strategy game where you build an outpost on a new planet. As pioneers, you will construct an outpost while defending against enemies. Gather enough materials to build a spaceship to explore new worlds and expand humanity's frontiers!

title: Cosmotots
description: A frantic third-person Team Deathmatch arena shooter. Flank your enemies using hidden teleporters, tunnels, and floating islands. First team to 30 takes the glory. Get your loadout ready, engage in intense matches, and conquer the stars!

title: Covert Crew
description: A Superpowered SRPG! Covert Crew is a 2D strategic roleplaying game inspired by the classics of old with a modern twist.

title: Retrieval
description: RETRIEVAL is a first-person psychological horror game where you explore a looping house, collect scattered memory fragments, and search extracted keywords in an old computer terminal to uncover a tragic truth.

title: Clay God
description:
Before you is a set of cards. Every card holds a scene. Every card is a piece of the puzzle. The choice of which ones you flip is yours.

You will experience the scenes of this tale in a random order. By the end, all players will have the same information -- but the journey to them is bound to be different for everyone.

title: Before the Needle Lifts
description: You and your girlfriend Sayori investigate a series of strange disappearances around your town.

title: Ace Attorney But Plotagon
description: A Pywright Adaption of the "Phoenix Wright But Plotagon" Youtube series.

title: Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney - Tails Abuse In Court
description: An Ace Attorney fan game based on Whoisthisgit's Tails Abuse In Court videos

title: Downfall to the Turnabout
description: The case takes place about half a year after the events of Apollo Justice: Ace Attorney. Apollo has had a few cases (mostly arranged by Phoenix) after the test trial, but nothing worth noting. However, when Phoenix gives him a call about a new case, Apollo has no idea that that would be the beginning of his eternal downfall.

title: PyWright Tutorial
description: An interactive casemaker tutorial made in PyWright.

title: ShowMeSpeed
description: 2D Single / Multiplayer speedrunning / racing platformer, enriched with items and timer.

title: A New World Of Turnabouts
description: Two young rookies face off against each other in the courtroom, both on their first case, and both familiar with each other. What starts off as a simple case of murder, soon becomes a dark plot that ties in to a case from 12 years past. The prosecutor seems to know more about the situation than the others, and soon finds himself having to fight a demon related to his past...

title: Ace Attorney Online: The Game
description: A Pywright game that replicates the Ace Attorney Online experience.

title: Myles Wright: Ace Attorney
description: 23 years after the events of Spirit of Justice, a new defense attorney steps up to the plate. Myles Wright, the son of Phoenix Wright, has finally achieved his dream of continuing his father's legacy. With his attorney badge proudly pinned on his lapel, he jumps on the first cases he can get. Unfortunately, his eagerness comes back to haunt him as he's thrown into a series of events that turn his world inside-out. With a serial killer hot on his trail, can Myles live up to his father's namesake? Or will he fall, just like Phoenix Wright did 8 years ago?

title: Jack Mason: Ace Attorney
description: We play as Jack Mason, an old friend of Phoenix Wright that traveled to his country to finally meet him, after a long time and finishing his law studies. He was told to rendezvous in an unusual place: a courtroom lobby? And, apparently, there's also a trial today? What? A certain Larry Butz was arrested for car theft and murder!? But he doesn't even own a license!

title: Andalusian Roulette
description: A game about sleeping siesta in a small rural village in Spain while socializing with some odd fellows.

title: Midsummer Leg's Dream
description: Enter a whimsical dreamscape where every step reveals a new surprise. Level up to uncover short, unexpected clips. Embrace the quirky journey of a leg in a world where dreams and reality blur — exactly as it should be.

title: TalkTics: Double Served
description: This light-hearted summer comedy game invites you to talk to people and make it to the end as fast as you can. Step into the whimsical world of Alice and Nick, navigating the quirky challenges of modern life with special charm.

title: Moves Away
description: Moves Away is a psychological horror. The story is told from the perspective of Dave, an ordinary man who bought an auto repair shop.

title: Memories of Bust
description: Dive into a thrilling roguelike deckbuilder where strategy meets chance! Use your own deck to beat your foes in a Blackjack-inspired combat system. Push your luck in a procedurally generated dungeon where every draw could be your last. Will you gamble your way to victory or fold under pressure?

title: FindIt
description: Try to find all the hidden objects, left clicking on them to collect them. The goal is to find all the objects to finish the level, or the episode.

title: FindIt: Bonus Maps 1
description: This DLC includes another 5 special maps, extremely cool and beautiful, which will make you love the game even more, and a few more new objects to look for.

title: Sausage Legend: Arena
description: Sausage Legend is a 3D physics-based fighting game where players clash their sausages in battle. You take on the role of a medieval slave, forced to fight in the "Sausage Duel," a pastime of the nobility. To gain your freedom, you must emerge victorious in this mad contest.

title: Equiverse
description: Experience the ultimate ecosystem simulator! Equiverse is a cozy simulation game where you care for different species of animals, earn income by keeping them happy, unlock helpful companions, and defend against invading monsters. Can you keep your ecosystem thriving?

title: Treepury
description: TREEPURY is a game where you hire adventurers, deploy them to production buildings, and defeat monsters to make your guild bigger and better.

title: Butanooo! Simulator
description:
How are you, Paco? How are you? It's me Er Pelusa.
You told me that if I knew of any job to let you know, so I got you a good job.

title: Dynasty Warriors: Origins
description: Experience an unrivaled sense of realism on the battlefield, fueled by exhilarating 1 vs. 1,000 action and the rush of massive armies! A nameless hero conquers the turbulent and chaotic Three Kingdoms in this latest DYNASTY WARRIORS series entry.

title: Ballad of Antara
description:
In a distant land, a mist-like phenomenon devastates the common world with unknown malice. Begin a perilous journey, seek towering, divine creatures, retrieve those twisted and lost ""essences"" of the land.

-Become Emissaries, powerful entities that wield the force of fundamental essences. Experience unique classes, gameplay capabilities, and enticing, mysterious stories.
-Explore the Para, the otherworldly dimension where danger lurks at every corner. Seek the truth inside, and recover the essences of the world.
-Explore handcrafted gameplay space with intricate, exploration oriented level design.

title: Silent Hill 2: Deluxe Edition
description:
Silent Hill 2 Remake is a ground-up reimagining of the 2001 psychological horror game. It follows James Sunderland as he searches for his deceased wife in the fog-shrouded town of Silent Hill. The remake features entirely rebuilt visuals in Unreal Engine 5, over-the-shoulder gameplay, reworked combat, and new voice acting.

The Deluxe Edition contains the main game, a digital artbook, the digital soundtrack, and Pyramid Head Mask (pizza box).

title: Legend of the Time Sword: Episode 1
description: You awaken in a strange place. A giant floating head has brought you here and commands you to get a legendary "blade thingy". As soon as you touch the sword you realize that you are able to travel back in time to help your past self to solve the strange puzzles lying ahead in a watery dungeon.

title: Ludical
description:
Your soul is trapped in lines of code. What will you do?

Thanks to science you can now upload the consciousness of a human being inside a computer. The Gametoy which is the first fully immersive Video Game Console is finally out to the public! In which reality and digital video games collide. The lives of many can now last forever in a computer.

However, something goes terribly wrong with all the consoles across the entire globe. The minds of young and old have been trapped in all the machines. You the child of an employee that works at a company called "Technologic" must figure out what went wrong with the system. As you multitask beating video game levels and avoiding the dreaded rouge AIs that resemble nightmarish versions of what it is like to have a family. You will soon realize no one is to be trusted.

title: Truncheon Titties
description: A Dark Medieval Porn game centered around exhibitionism, big ole titties, abuse of authority, blowjobs, spanking, bullying and revenge. Join the Royal Guard and fight against the criminal scum. Make your choice to show your tits or swing that truncheon!

title: Daisy Dangerous
description: Daisy Dangerous is a short but captivating 2D puzzle and precision platformer that immerses players in a dark, treacherous world filled with intricate challenges, strongly based on the 1989 classic, Rick Dangerous. Players will guide Daisy through a series of perilous levels that require keen environmental awareness and precise movements to navigate successfully.

title: Project: Emplorer
description: You are the pilot of a micro-robot that travels through tissues, collecting 'samples' from the cells it kills and harvesting samples more efficiently.

title: Astrune Academy
description: A fantasy RPG of a tale of fighting magical girls!

title: A Sunday Afternoon
description: Help the insecure Lucas, and his sassy best friend Carol, explore a watercolored São Paulo and solve puzzles to complete a sticker album to gift his secret crush, Leo, in this cute-as-heck visual novel!

title: Level Up: The Playable Rap Album
description: The one of a kind 2D side-scrolling adventure that combines action-packed gameplay with a hip-hop album. Created by a 2 time Ninja Warrior and Nerdcore Rapper Creative Mind Frame get ready to immerse yourselves in a lyrical hip hop journey through an immersive 16-bit experience.

title: Momochiyo's Mononoke Taji
description: Ninja Puzzle Battle

title: Nether Heroes
description: Immerse yourself in Nether Heroes, an intense action-platform roguelike game. Conquer challenging dungeons, face menacing creatures, and defeat powerful bosses on your epic adventure.

title: Tipsy Woods
description: Enter a pixelated nightmare as you navigate a haunting forest in search of 8 bottles, all while evading a relentless monster. Can you survive the terror and escape?

title: Sparedevil
description: Sparedevil is an arcade FPS with the graphic charm of classic '90s bowling alley animations.

title: The Rule of She
description: A soul about to be reborn mistakenly enters a world of strange tales filled with rules. Beware! This place is fraught with danger, and to successfully complete the rebirth, you must follow the rules of this world. The world will correct any soul that violates the rules. Will you comply or defy?

title: Trilingual
description: Welcome to the planet, Triangulus. Can you solve the hidden mysteries of each island and escape with your brain intact? Scan these ancient runes to decode a new alien language. Use this alien language to grow plants, move trains, and even save the Trilings of the planet.

title: Minimalist Tower Defense: The Last Tower
description: After the Battle of the Britain, the war to eliminate geometric creations continues Mount Fuji, Cape Storm, Bering Strait, New York And the ultimate goal: the South Pole...

title: Harem Nanka Nozondenai!: Undesired Harem
description: A sudden harem situation?! His heart must decide between 4 beautiful girls!

title: Koishi Adventure: Barrage Forbidden - Scarlet!
description: Twenty years ago, a red mist mutation occurred in Lotusland, Hakurei Reimu traveled to quell the revolt! This time Reimu decided to take only a *machete* and her beloved yin and yang jade!

title: ZomGoBo
description: ZomGoBo is a shooter game where the goal is to increase character skills and escape from the dungeon. Once the character is fully built up, the high-score mode is unlocked, where the objective is to achieve as many points as possible.

title: The Sims 4: Riviera Retreat Kit
description: Bask in the rustic scenery surrounding your secluded, peaceful pool with The Sims 4 Riviera Retreat Kit.

title: The Sims 4: Cozy Bistro Kit
description: Stop by your favorite hole-in-the-wall bistro and take in the antique ambiance of The Sims 4 Cozy Bistro Kit.
The game consists of finishing several levels, solving by clicking with the mouse or using the keyboard to complete the tasks.

title: AI Fightclub
description: Create the world's strongest AI by customizing appearance, attack method, attack timing, and other factors

title: Alister In Wonderland
description: Welcome to wonderland, a place of dreams. Take on the role of Alister Hinch and go on a journey through this surreal realm of enchantment and wonder. Experience making friends in this realm... Now, what ending will you choose to have?

title: Apocalyptic cat
description: Apocalyptic Cat is an atmospheric hardcore platformer about a little black cat's journey in a post-apocalyptic world. Overcome toxic clouds, spikes, and obstacles, striving to fulfill his last dream of reaching paradise.

title: Artovya
description: Dive into the bizarre land of Artovya in a thrilling CCG! Master five distinct factions—Fantasy, Alien, Futuristic, Horror, and Interdimensional. Forge your strategy with unique mechanics and thrilling battles across fantastical realms. Unleash your creativity, build your deck, and dominate!

title: A Ruthless World
description: Embark on an adventure through a ruthless, 80s-inspired platformer world.

title: Asbak
description: Asbak is a fast-paced hack-and-slash platformer where you chase down and slay demons born from humanity’s darkest fears. Move fast, hit hard, and keep the nightmares at bay!

title: Asili Forest
description: Asili Forest: Guide V12 on a heroic quest to save humanity in this visually stunning 2D platformer adventure, Embark on an epic journey with V12 in Asili Forest, where nature and technology collide in a captivating tale of bravery and discovery.

title: A Tale of Sand and Bone
description: A Tale of sand and Bone is a story-rich action-roguelike adventure. You play as Shai, a fallen warrior bound to a vengeful spirit as you climb and fight your way to claiming vengeance against the gods.

title: Atlas Online
description: Welcome to Atlas Online, the 2D MMORPG pirate game! In this exciting pirate adventure, fight for your own glory, conquer islands with your alliance, embark on new adventures, and rule the seas!

title: Atomic Exile
description: Atomic Exile is a top down post-apocalyptic extraction shooter set in the desert wastelands of near future America. You will visit enclaves, explore devastated ruins and encounter NPCs such as other survivors, raiders, mutated beasts and rogue machines.

title: Atomic Warfare
description: Atomic Warfare is a thrilling and strategic game that allows players to represent a country in a high-stakes battle.

title: Automata Streetcar
description: An interactive, digital-media art project that uses historic streetcars as a metaphor to explore ideas about connection, communication, and community. Primarily intended for gallery / museum installations - or you can build your own Arduino-based controllers to play at home!

title: Azaran: Islands of the Jinn
description: A retro adventure inspired by 90's adventure games and Arabian Nights. Explore dungeons, solve puzzles, and collect awesome treasures

title: Awagame
description: Explore the world's oceans with a sea turtle that has the ability to inflate bubbles! Bubbles can be used as bullets or shields. But be careful not to over-inflate the bubbles and suffocate! Watch your timing and jump out of the water to breathe. Turtles are lung-breathers.

title: Avian Colony
description: Avian Colony is a survival simulation game that places you in the role of the ruler of a floating colony in a harsh sky world. Your main goal is to ensure the survival and prosperity of your colony by managing resources, planning strategically, and defending against threats.

title: Board Wars: Trick Or Treat
description: Board Wars ToT is a couch-op, local multiplayer board game intended for family/friend game nights. Take turns rolling dice to manually RUN across the board to Trick-Or-Treat and deliver more candy than the other players!

title: Nine Treasures of Liuyin
description: This is a dark, soul like role-playing game, trying to create a different experience in this genre. The protagonist fights against a powerful enemy in this city in search of a divine artifact.

title: Whistling Waters
description: Catch as many fish on as possible to meet your boss' quota and avoid damaging your steamboat.

title: Battle Babes: Love & Death
description: Battle Babes is a fast-paced strategy trading card game. Collect, strategize, and battle your way to victory with 9 powerful hero decks! Experiment with 300+ unique cards each with their own special abilities. Customize your decks and defeat the Succubus Queen's Court!

title: Sayo
description: A world where snow falls, a landscape of dream-like memories.

title: I Commissioned Some Bunnies 7
description: I paid artists to hide bunnies and carrots in 15 artworks. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

title: Vojna
description: A soldier searches for documents in a desolate zone at night. Suddenly, a voice on the radio, claiming to be a fallen enemy, warns that any negotiation error could awaken evil forces in the forest.

title: The Aching Aversion
description: A 3D RPGMaker Horror game about exploring a weird bunker. The bunker will have different horrors waiting in it depending on how you broke into it! 7 different routes to 9 unique endings! An ending collecting game!

title: Beer Simulator
description: You are single? You have a very hard work and small salary? Then this game is just for you. In this game you can earn beer just by clicking on beer. Upgrade your beer, sell your beer, earn gold, purchase more beer without becoming an actual alcoholic.

title: Basket Brawl DX
description: Embark on a quest with Himari and her friends! Traverse 40+ rooms, unlock characters, and groove to chiptune tunes in this speedy platformer.

title: The Dungeons Of Algoduul
description: Delay your death for as long as possible after finding yourself trapped in a neatly kept Dungeon full of skeletons without legs! Use your Fireballs, Powers, Physics and even use your enemies against each other as you stumble through your very own well lit purgatory!

title: Beneath the Cardboard: Be Happy
description: You will have to survive the cold New Year's Eve, look for food in the trash in the world where no one cares about you. This is an adventure where you have to survive Christmas, a holiday that has never been so cold before...

title: Bot Loop
description: Embark on a roguelike turn-based adventure where simulations become your battleground. Possess a powerful robot, face the Glitch and navigate an ever-evolving loop of challenges.

title: Starduster
description: STARDUSTER is a musical and arcade game wrapped in an abstract aesthetic with neon lights designed for players who enjoy difficult challenges and seek to push their own limits.

title: Crisis in the Kremlin: The Cold War
description: PERESTROIKA - CONTINUATION OF OCTOBER Crisis... Crisis has caught up with the Motherland of the Revolution and lurks in its very heart - the Kremlin. Lead the country through the most difficult times. "Crisis in the Kremlin" opens up huge prospects for you.

title: CaveVox
description: CaveVox — the ONLY first-person voxel roguelike with permadeath. Live as your character: descend into a deadly dungeon, fight monsters, gain loot, and return to the surface for your next descent. Each expedition is unique — solo or with a party of adventurers, your choices shape your journey.

title: Scunner's Run
description: A fast, twin-stick shooter micro-roguelike with bullet hell elements, chunky weapons and satisfying destruction. Your AI friend AL-4N will help you along the way with new weapons, upgrades and vague moral support, as you attempt to beat the Scunner's Run.

title: Necromancer for a Week
description: Reanimate monsters, choose their ideal moveset and form the perfect 3-monster-team to dominate the competition in this turn-based strategy roguelike. Use action points each turn on brutal combos and strategic positioning to be crowned champion of the annual Necromancer Tournament!

title: First Law
description: Escape the ice caves of Europa and return home in this retro inspired 2D sci-fi platformer. Journey through ice caves using Newtonian physics.

title: RnGesus Slayer
description: RnGesus Slayer is an exhilarating roguelike deckbuilder where your cards come from a slot-machine! Customize your slot-decks, twist fate to your advantage, and together with your wife, challenge RnGesus in your epic quest to become the ultimate Demon King.

title: Reclaim Earth
description: Reclaim Earth is a base-building, colony management, survival game where you play as a semi benevolent robot crash-landed on a post apocalyptic Earth. You must build your base, enlist the help of humans, and defend against hordes of mutated bugs.

title: Supernatural
description: Detective Wyatt confronts a chilling mystery as he investigates a housemaid's disappearance. Unearth sinister secrets as you navigate through a haunted house, where every shadow hides a lurking terror.

title: I Hate My Waifu Streamer
description: Draw the attention of the streamer at any cost, before someone else does it. Write comments, chat, make donations to your waifu, but do not dare to hate her!

title: Survive In Ankara
description: Welcome to Survive in Ankara! Are you ready to defeat the creatures that attack you, either with your friends or alone? I'm sure you can overcome these creatures with 5 customized characters. Join this adventure and destroy all creatures on 5 different maps

title: I Commissioned Some Butterflies 3
description: I paid artists to hide butterflies and flowers in 15 artworks. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

title: The Bell of Time
description: The Bell of Time is an adventure, puzzle and combat game where you'll play a teenager brought to a mysterious mansion. Explore this mansion with its horror-like visual and audio ambience, fight against the supernatural and solve puzzles using never-before-seen mechanics!

title: Honeydew
description: Discover your destiny in Honeydew, an enchanting adult visual novel of self-discovery and romance, unraveling the secrets of a diverse and captivating world. With lush art, branching narrative, full narration, and a player-driven story, embark on an adventure where every choice defines your path.

title: The Crusade Is Nigh
description: The Crusade is Nigh Or TCIN is a game consisting of rpg, rts, and tower defense elements where you fight to control up to 5 lanes while trying to keep your base alive from enemy attacks using strategy & skill

title: Jumpers' Mountain
description: Join our little friends on this adventure, jumping between platforms to uncover the paths of 'Jumper's Mountain'. However, beware, as there are many secrets to reach the top, and a miscalculated jump can be quite costly.

title: Beer Runner
description: Run through wild and crazy pubs, jump across insane platforms, and drink so much beer as you can! The bartender refused to give you free beer.. time to teach him a lesson and become the one and only Beer Runner!

title: Funky Rock Hoppers
description: Jump, dodge and flap yourself out of danger as a funky rockhopper. See what distance your penguin can reach while dodging various objects as well as sharks, birds and UFOs!

title: The End of You
description: The End of You is a short, emotional narrative game about love lost, the ghosts of the past, and the painful crawl towards closure.

title: Click On Lanterns Together
description: Can you and your friends find all 100+ lanterns in this panoramic level? Difficulty: Easy

title: Reflect
description: This is a simple and complex puzzle game about light. You need to use Optical components to direct lights and lit up the rings.

title: Sensei! I Like You So Much!
description: Sensei! I Like You So Much! is a fangirl simulator. Step into the shoes of a passionate fan girl and embark on a journey through the vibrant world of fan culture in this immersive simulation management game.

title: Click On Candy Together
description: Can you and your friends find all 100+ candies in this panoramic level?

title: Click On Red Pandas Together
description: Can you and your friends find all 100+ red pandas in this panoramic level?

title: Sentry System
description: Sentry System is a tower defense roguelike where you collect, modify and upgrade your sentries while progressing through a network of challenging encounters.

title: Roll 'n' Watch
description: Roll 'n' Watch is a simulated marble racing game where we bring the marble customization, beautiful tracks, customization, and the randomness of the beloved trending races you watch below those videos on social media.

title: Grasp of Dread
description: Grasp Of Dread is an asymmetrical multiplayer horror game where one player takes on the role of a monster from another world and tries to escape, while the other four players are monster hunters who seek to deal with the undead as soon as possible.

title: Quest of Peril
description: Dive into the dark world of a Dying Earth, in this Idle exploration rougelike with turn based combat

title: Literally Every FNF Mod Ever
description:
Uh Oh, the man Bob is angry and you made them angry and they are so angry man, what did you do to make them angry? Honestly don’t know I’m just a game description.
Some parts of the Bob mod close the game unexpectedly and trigger a link to open that might trigger any anti-virus software to detect it as malware, please be aware that this is a fnf mod and not a trojan virus. If Bob asks for your personal information, please give it to them as it might be important.

for legal reasons this is a joke

title: Whimsical Wizardry
description:
Whimsical Wizardry is multiplayer party game about casting spells at your friends. Turn eight maps and four game modes into a chaotic battlefield as you scramble for victory! Who will be the best worst wizard of them all?

Cast 20 unique spells at your friends and enemies, each with their own wacky effects! Customize your wizard before heading into battle.

Whimsical Wizardry is developed by Silver Standard Studios, an independent game studio based out of Ottawa, Ontario.

title: Horror Family: Flight
description: Horror Family - Flight is a time-loop horror game set on an airplane.

title: Night Project
description: Night Project is the first game to introduce you to the history of corporate Degrees Intertainment. As you progress through the game, you will be able to find notes that will fully describe to you the entire deep history of the largest corporation in this game universe. The main antagonist is not a successful experiment of the Degrees Laboratories companies, called the "Kili project". Your task is not only to search for keys and notes, but also to simultaneously deceive the AI, whose task is to scare you as much as possible.

title: Lake Minnewaska
description: Lake Minnewaska is a narrative driven first person fishing game. Fish, explore, and uncover the secrets of Lake Minnewaska as you guide Sosa's journey in becoming a better father.

title: Tower Defense: Last Castle
description: In the depths of an ancient forest, your castle the last human stronghold stands as the final bastion against a monstrous horde. Strategize your defense by employing soldiers, traps, towers, and even the monsters themselves.

title: Pixelitos: Spritle Royale
description: A creature-collecting teambuilding autobattler with over 130 unique elemental creatures to collect and battle with! Assemble a team of Pixelitos to face opponents in 6v6 auto battles. Face off in online asynchronous multiplayer, online versus with friends, or in the single-player campaign.

title: Vribyss Refuge The Escape
description: While fleeing from the Kexxrans, Isla falls deep into a cave. As she searches for a way out, she encounters mysterious beings trapped there that may be able to help her get out. Discover the mysteries of Vribyss in this short-action role-playing story-driven game!

title: Starstream
description: Starstream is a 3D action-adventure shooter. In it, the brave Arlen must reclaim Castle Starstream, seized by the corrupt Lord Nova. Arlen battles through the Keep, Great Halls, and Startower to confront Lord Nova and free the Castle.

title: Pelago
description: Pelago is a creature-catching adventure game! Explore the islands of Pelago and befriend the creatures that live there. Build your perfect team to overcome any challenge and unravel the mysteries of the islands.

title: Permanence Break
description: A sci-fi first-person puzzle game based around object permanence. Move and look around rooms in order to pick which objects you see and which you don't.

title: Grave Realms
description: Grave Realms is a fast and fun, arcade style twin-stick shooter with RPG elements. Powerups and elemental projectile attacks help carve your way through waves of unique enemies. Using the powerful Purge system, you decide your gameplay style! Can you survive the Grave Realms?

title: Malware
description: In order to induce users to install malware, unscrupulous software vendors try their best to hide malicious installation options in the installation programs of normal software. Can you avoid the numerous inducements set by software vendors and install pure software on your computer?

title: War of The Titans
description: Your people have been driven from their homeland by war. The elders speak of an ancient land where gods and men lived as one. After months at sea you land on a mysterious island that the elders believe is your ancient homeland. Rebuild your civilization, and uncover the secrets of your ancestors.

title: Ground to Dust
description: Navigate your way through a hostile underground facility in this two-dimensional side-scroller inspired by games like Hollow Knight and Metroid. Fight everything from a cleaning robot to a businessman trying to sell you goods while actively killing you. There are over 20 levels to explore in this non-linear platformer.

title: Poolrooms
description: Welcome to Level 37, commonly known as the Poolrooms, a psychological horror experience that immerses players in an eerie, otherworldly environment.

title: Runeflame
description: Runeflame is a point-and-click fantasy adventure with an open world and an emphasis on puzzle-solving. Guide your custom character through the immersive world of Runeflame, where secrets and magic have minds of their own.

title: Fluff's Adventure: A Tale of Fur and Steel
description: Fluff's Adventure: A Tale of Fur and Steel is a 3D third-person puzzle game with platforming elements. The game is focusing on non-textual storytelling, exploration and puzzles centered around fluffy furballs called "Fluffs". It creates a wholesome atmosphere in a stylized and colorful environment.

title: Sparky: Hills of Death
description: Hito Corporation immerses players in a dark universe where the monster, Sparky, comes to life in a sinister way, blurring the boundaries between reality and game. While cyber security expert Zac and his girlfriend Marina face strange events both in the game and in real life.

title: Gasping.2
description: GASPING.2 is a single player survival game, a dangerous and abandoned game world where only you and your companions exist. If you can tolerate loneliness, then explore it, which requires patience.

title: Elf Defense
description: Players can place characters, sell characters, set up automatic skill release, skill synthesis and more by clicking the mouse. The game provides an intuitive and easy to understand interface and operations, so that players can easily play the game.

title: Purge Party
description: See what's coming ahead and select your targets with the FEARBOARD battle system, a fresh take on turn-based combat. Explore a nightmarish world full of secrets, and make unlikely friends and enemies along the way.

title: Cyber Assasin
description: Cyber Assassin is a fast-paced arena shooter where you control a robot annihilating waves of enemies. Survive, upgrade your character after each wave, and become more powerful to dominate the arena!

title: Rap Pop Jump Core
description: Rap Pop Jump Core is a hardcore action platformer demanding constant movement, quick decisions, and combat. Navigate a vibrant city by leaping between platforms. One mistake, and you fall to your fate. Escape swiftly!

title: Dungeon Digger
description: Dungeon Digger is a roguelike game about a brave dwarf seeking legendary treasures. Descend deep underground, mine valuable minerals, craft upgraded gear, and battle spiders, golems, worms, and ghosts to become a cave hero!

title: Titleless Tale
description: An auto-battle RPG. Gather randomly generated rare equipment and companions to train your party and take on formidable foes.

title: Station Zeta
description: Run, jump, shoot, and think your way to safety in this retro-inspired 2D puzzle-platformer. Station Zeta is out of control, and you'll have to deal with crazed robots, terribly designed station machinery, and blatant safety hazards as you try to make your escape across 35 levels.

title: 5 Minute Raid
description: A boss raid where the boss is also a player!A team of 3 guardians. 6 classes 12 perksAn abomination from the 3rd dimension, ready to singlehandedly destroy the worldOnly 5 minutes until the destruction of the 2nd dimension!A casual quirky 1 vs 3 asymmetrical PvP experience: 5 Minute Raid!

title: AI Solitaire: Handsome Heroes
description: AI Solitaire - Handsome Heroes provides 12 new decks to use with AI Solitaire! This DLC is themed around handsome men in a variety of artistic styles ranging from phtorealistic to comic book styles.

title: AI Solitaire: Lovely Ladies
description: AI Solitaire - Lovely Ladies provides 12 new decks to use with AI Solitaire! This DLC is themed around beautiful girls in a photorealistic style.

title: Northern Song Dynasty
description: A real-time strategy game based on the history of the Northern Song Dynasty. The player can experience the fun of conquering cities, directing the country, and ultimately uniting the world through their own efforts in the simulated historical background of the game!

title: Zlin City: Arch Moderna
description: Build charming miniature diorama cities and train routes in a magical world inspired by the 1930s–40s. Create cozy towns, craft detailed rail networks, and relax to an original soundtrack. Inspired by real historical events and the architecture of Zlin.

title: Z-Ape: Tower Defense
description: Z-Ape is a unique tower defense and first person shooter mash up game. Hordes of enemies attacking your base, it's up to you to stop them by placing towers or fighting them on FPS mode with guns, or both!

title: Within: Hannah's Journey
description: In this turn-based JRPG, discover Hannah's strange journey into the confines of her nightmares and memories. Taking part in a mysterious place where all her regrets, mourning and mistakes reside.

title: Wizlite: Everybody loved RPGs
description: “Wizlite” is an RPG that merges the old-school command battle system with the popular roguelite genre. It offers gripping moments during battles and while unlocking treasure chests, as well as strategic decisions about whether to advance or rest based on remaining health and spell count.

title: Wizwag
description: Explore a charming, mysterious world in a classic, top-down action adventure! Investigate monster-infested dungeons, collect items to unlock new moves, and solve puzzles to uncover the truth, with help from some unusual friends.

title: Phoots and the Pineapple Throne
description: Take action as a demon from another world takes over your home island. Play as Ridge, a Phoot who lost his memories and must save the island from being destroyed. Travel across hand drawn environments, unlock weapons and spells, and defeat challenging bosses.

title: Wonder Wand
description: Embark on a spellbinding adventure in a strange land that’s brimming with puzzling dungeons, bouncing slimes & zany encounters in WONDER WAND, a 2D puzzle game about a confused fox with a magical wand.

title: Woohoo!
description: Woohoo! is a compilation of casual puzzle and arcade games.

title: Woohoo!: Game - Pool Frenzy
description: Pool Frenzy is a game where you shoot the white ball to hit the other balls into the pockets in the lowest amount of time. You also must not let the white ball fall into a pocket. There's 3 pool tables, 3 ball orientations and 2 ball group counts to choose from.

title: Woohoo!: Game - Skee Madness
description: Skee Madness is a game where you roll the ball with force down a table and then the ball flies through the air towards a group of holes. You earn points depending on which hole the ball goes through. There are 3 game modes.

title: Woohoo!: Game - Triangles
description: Triangles is a game where you lay triangular shaped tiles next to each other on a grid. The numbers in the three corners of a tile must match the numbers of the touching tiles in that affiliated corner.

title: Woohoo!: Game - WordSearch
description: WordSearch is the classic game of finding words in a grid of characters. Every level is random. Every level uses a random subject and picks random words for that subject. The placement of the words are random too. You won't play the same level twice. Use your mouse to select the words in the grid.

title: Word On The Hook
description: An exciting intellectual fishing game, where as a “fish” you need to catch words and earn coins!

title: World Heritage VR: Swedish Farmhouse
description: Virtual World Heritage: Fågelsjö is a VR rendition of the Fågelsjö farmsteads from the 1700s, located in the Hälsningland area of Sweden.

title: Narcis Crosswords
description: Narcis Crosswords is a crossword game that is bundled in with the Persian software Narcis Dictionary. The game is made to help English learners understand the language better using crossword puzzles.

title: Heaven Over It
description: The theme is to go up, and your mission is to get to heaven. It's a vertical scroll platformer, indie and single player action game. It is controlled using only the mouse and can be completed in a few minutes.

title: Ace Attorney: Ultimate Justice
description: Ultimate Justice is a fan-made crossover between the murder mysteries franchise of Ace Attorney and Danganronpa. It will follow the lawyers of the Wright Anything Agency as they defend students of Hope’s Peak in various murder cases.

title: Terezi Pyrope: Ace Attorney
description: Tavros is accused of Murder by an old FLARPing buddy in a Court-Only Tutorial case.

title: Odens öga
description:
Odens Öga is a third-person action game with twelve levels. Players must find and collect keys to unlock gates to the next level. The worlds are populated with monsters, including aggressive wolves and rabbits. Players use ranged missile attacks and limited flight abilities to combat these creatures.

There are seven characters to choose from, differing only in appearance. Points are earned by defeating enemies and collecting amulets. Other collectibles, like stones and chests, boost health or reduce monster damage. Stepping on anthills affects player abilities, either positively or negatively. Players have three lives per level and must restart the level if all lives are lost.

title: Honkai Impact 3rd: Crusade of Chasing Shadows
description:
Version 7.5 of Honkai Impact 3rd, which includes:
• New Part 2 Story Chapter 3: A Crime Foretold
• New S Rank Valkyrie: Lone Destruction: Shadowchaser (Lantern)
• New Featured Event: Lantern Against Shadows
• New Event: Non-Stop Stage Clears Carnival
• ...and more!

title: Swingmania
description: Swingmania is a Virtual Reality rhythm game where you slice the notes!

title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III - Season 4
description:
A disturbing discovery can change everything. A mysterious DNA bomb has been found at Popov Power in Urzikstan, and it’s up to you and your squadmates to unlock the mystery behind this potentially devastating weapon and prevent catastrophe. While you obtain various DNA samples during the ominous Critical Countdown Event, you can also further explore the multitude of bunkers across Urzikstan, potentially unearthing new ways to exit.

The potential outbreak seeps into Multiplayer, with a worldwide assortment of core 6v6 maps, plenty of exhilarating modes, revered weapons, new perks, destructive killstreaks, and battle-ready recon and hazmat inspired gear throughout the Battle Pass, so you can stay protected while remaining deadly calm and effective. One slip-up could alter everything, so suit up, drop in, uncover the truth, and stop the threat!

title: The Bathhouse Restored Edition
description: The Bathhouse | 地獄銭湯 Remake is a Japanese horror game that revolves around working at a bathhouse. A complete revamp of the original bathhouse.

title: Touhou Danmaku Maze
description: Developed by Ice Fall Creative, Touhou meets Maze Play in this Hand-Drawn Comedy Arcade game featuring the strongest fairy in Gensoukyou!

title: Turnabout Train Or Shine
description: The familiar case is presented in a new, more rational and grounded, but also more wholesome and satisfying way. Using the simplistic but enjoyable Ace Attorney mechanics, approaching the same case from different angles, this will be an enjoyable experience for those that know the case very well and cannot get over it.

title: New Hope
description:
New Hope is an LGBTQI+ inclusive story starring Justin, an 18-year-old high school senior with two very big secrets. He's gay and trying to hold onto his secrets until finally finishing senior year and moving off to college. But when he loses his songbook, things take an unexpected turn as Justin begins to message a mystery guy who shares the same secret.

Being gay isn't the only thing Justin's trying to hide, however.

title: Wingless Fairies
description:
Wingless Fairies is a first-person stage play about becoming someone new again.

YOU ARE: Fawn-Mar Evangeline, a Great Fairy in training. It's your first day shadowing at your friend Velvet's gay bar / dressing room hybrid. Your role is simple on paper, but being a mentor to all who walk through the door will take more vulnerability than you know. Enter Rain.

title: Star Defender 4
description: Star Defender 4 is a simulation-arcade game developed by VADZIM KAMKOU and Awem Studio. It was originally released in 2008. It was published by Awem Studio.

title: Look_in_Dark
description: This game was created within the Touhou Game Jam held on Touhou Station in August 2021 and is a derivative work of Touhou Project.

title: Flip-Flip
description:
Flip-Flip was created at Touhou Game Jam.
This game is a Touhou Project fan game.

title: Flip-Flip plus
description:
Flip-Flip plus was created at Touhou Game Jam.
This game is a Touhou Project fangame.

If Flip-Flip was not enough for you or you have the skill, give it a try!

title: Day of the Hamster
description:
Day of the Hamster is a point & click graphic adventure game in the style of Day of the Tentacle. It's a short and sweet experience about escaping from a locked vault.
It's a sidequel to Day of the Sandwich.

title: Otaku Simulator
description:
Otaku Simulator is a simulation game who the goal is to protect player's reputation
You can kill all of yours enemies who want to destroy your reputation.

title: Shoka
description: The most grueling and unfair Isekai turn based RPG made with a budget of literally $0 (got RPG Maker VXA from a steam key giveaway), most will fail over and over and over until they eventually gives up and quit. Will you accept the challenge or chicken out? The choice is yours to be made. I pride myself on my ability to create a game with consistent power scaling and no plot holes.

title: Cosmo Mambo No. 5
description: Space Mambo Shooter.

title: Metal Dragon
description: METAL DRAGON is a 5 map episode for doom2.wad using primarily metallic and industrial textures sourced from otex with some relatively difficult, but not extremely intense gameplay.

title: Puzzles and Pieces
description: Puzzles and Pieces is very small set of monsterless vanilla puzzle maps made by Christophine Place, and makes use of Patchtex (by Gothic) and plenty of mapping tricks and exploits. Each map is set in a small comfy environment to walk around and solve little brain teasers in.

title: Spectrum Descent
description: Spectrum Descent is an MBF21-compatible project with a colorful, gothic aesthetic by The Afternoon Crew, led by Ludi.The wad features a fully bespoke soundtrack, lots of custom textures, and a wide variety of gameplay styles.

title: Eureka fountains
description:
A map made by RataUnderground to test the Eureka editor.
Lost in another place, in another time... The fountains of Eureka were a citadel that could only be accessed through portals.

title: Sonic Robo Blast 2: The Chaotix
description:
The Chaotix Are Here!

Six unique characters, six unique playstyles! Play as Espio, Mighty, Charmy, Vector, Heavy, and Bomb in SRB2!

title: The Front Yard
description:
"Meat embraces you whole."

Chicago, 1883.

At the epicenter of bloody beef and pig innards live Fergal Byrne and Eoin Kairys, two New Yorkers who've moved to The Yards for work. Their days are drawn out, miserable, and smelly as they survive work just to sleep another night.

The Front Yard is a short, visual-novel-style RPG Maker game following the monotonous and mundane lives of two best friends who've been consumed by the guilt of living and meat they work with.

title: Perfect Love
description: A horror-romance visual novel where you shape Milo Change, a student in one of the classes that you attend, into your desired, Perfect Love.

title: Yass or Pass
description: "You're a totally voluntary and in no way kidnapped contestant on the hottest speed dating game show in this reality!"

title: One-sided Loneliness
description: 'One-sided loneliness' is a short clicker game, where you take care of a cute alien goat boy. Made for Summer Slow Jams 2023: Idle, using creative theme 'Mutation'.

title: Late Night Hunger
description: Enter a quiet town where Alex, a 9-year-old boy, lives a normal life. But when the clock strikes midnight, his house turns into a place of mystery and fear. Dark hallways, hidden rooms, and strange shadows transform his familiar home into a creepy adventure.

title: Batman
description: A remake that was in the works for a long time and was on-hold a few times. One of the best games for ZX Spectrum ever created, surpassed only by its successor Head Over Heels, which was also remade by our team. Help BatMan find seven pieces of the BatCraft scattered around the caves, mansion and other places. In the end find the BatCraft and finish this adventure.

title: Mobile Quest GB
description:
In an alternate universe where the Mobile Adapter GB made it outside japan, one company released a "massively multiplayer" online game that could be played without raking up phone bills, allowing it to garnering a strong player base...

Until today when it was announced the servers would be going down. Out of the blue you get an email from a friend you partied with numerous times before, telling you to log in today for one final quest before the game dies.

title: Maskerade: The Deadpan Cry
description: Maskerade is a first person narrative oriented Survival Horror game, where you incarnate a young girl who has been kidnapped and forced to work as a ballerina in a terrific and mysterious cabaret, from which she must find a way to escape from the clutches of the Madame who runs it.

title: Backrooms: Between Lost Dimension
description: Backrooms: Between Lost Dimensions is a horror game that immerses you in the surreal world of the Backrooms. Trapped in an endless maze of monotonous rooms, you must solve disturbing puzzles and face sinister creatures to find an escape. Is your escape just an illusion?

title: It's Our Revolution
description:
It's Our Revolution! is a freeware "puzzle RPG" by Wood Penguin made in RPG Maker VX Ace.

The goal of the game is for the unheard youth to gather a following to sway the king. Unfortunately, as your ensemble grows, you'll find it becomes a little difficult to get around...

title: Edward's Sewer Adventure
description:
"I'm going to tell you the story, the story of how I got lost in the sewers..."

In Edward's Sewer Adventure

You explore the depths of the sewers found on Pine Island. Located beneath the city, hidden from plain sight, many things can take place in the dark. Strange noises have been recorded. Are you brave enough to venture into the dark and damp smelly sewers? Or are you chicken...
You will meet friends unlooked for and evil forces on your journey.
You will experience revolutionary 3D-Graphics. A true stable of cutting edge PSX technology.

title: Touhou: Wandering Souls
description: Wandering Souls is a 2013 action role playing game developed by Estheone using RPG Maker VX. The player takes the role of three characters; Reimu, Marisa and Sakuya as they try to collect all wandering souls and travel to Edge of Heaven to find out who is responsible for the incident of Kekkai (barriers). The player starts with Reimu while Marisa and Sakuya will join later. Only one can fight while others act as supporting characters. Each character has a different special move, weapon and accessories; but have the same basic moves such as double jump, air dash and hyper mode. There are four barriers and each require different conditions to be unlocked. Sometimes enemies drop money and the player can use it to purchase items, weapons or accessories at Rinnosuke's shop. Wandering Souls also features hidden paths, an extra final boss and new game modes with higher difficulties which can be unlocked upon game completion.

title: Low Frequency
description:
After a catastrophe you are left adrift on your old ship hoping to find life.

Although not human...

title: Road To Siren Hills: Dark Journey
description:
Your car has died in the middle of nowhere.
The only thing you see is darkness and a flashlight lying on the grass.
Your only option is to go on foot, but where will the journey lead you to?

title: Altcode
description: Hordes of robotic ships from another world threaten the earth. As the newly self-aware hive mind of every CRT monitor display humans threw away to replace with fancy flat screen plasma tvs, you have to prove your worth and defend those who originally created you. Maybe they will want you back?!!

title: Legacy of Kalevala
description: Legacy of Kalevala is a re-engineered, re-envisioned and re-maked version of the original Legend of Kalevala flash game!

title: Purrfect Apawcalypse: Infamous Furiend?!
description: This is the PA series third Fan-game!

title: Purrfect Apawcalypse: Ideal Finale!!!
description: This is the PA series fourth Fan-game!

title: Tiny Hawk: Pico Sk8r
description: An isometric bird-based demake of the Tony Hawk's Pro Skater series.

title: Riviera: The Promised Land
description: In Riviera: The Promised Land, you'll follow two fierce warriors--each armed with godly weapons--in a mission to defeat demons once and for all. The adventure included lets you experience more than 30 hours of role-playing gameplay, complete with minigames, multiple endings, and secret paths and items. The game's unique item system allows items to function differently depending on which characters equip them.

title: Grit & Valor: 1949
description: Command an elite squad of Mechs in this alternate World War 2 dieselpunk real-time tactics roguelite. Think fast, battle the Evil Axis forces, and neutralise their HQ. Upgrade your Mechs and Pilots, and develop new strategies to defeat the enemy!

title: Erina to Kima no Miyako
description: Erina, an engineer and a self-proclaimed adventurer, finds herself in Era Sheila after wandering from place to place fulfilling requests in pursuance of the romantic adventuring dream. The city is named after a famous adventurer, who happens to be one of Erina's aspirations as an adventurer herself. Little did she know, the city had another moniker, widely known as the City of Machines. Just what does this city, one full of sex-starved men, have in store for Erina?

title: Below, Rusted Gods
description: You are the lifeline supporting an expedition into the unknown. Keep both yourself and your squad alive by interpreting instrument readings, explore the facilities, and uncover something ancient and eager to be born.

title: Catastrophe Crow
description: Catastrophe Crow is a game that emulates Nintendo 64 graphics and gameplay. The game started off as an ARG, and has now become a full length game.

title: Super Crate Box Together
description: A Super Crate Box mod that introduces local and online multiplayer modes with support for up to 4 players.

title: Phantom of the Twilight
description: Enjoy a sweet romance with vampires in this otome novel adventure.

title: Honko's World
description: Honko is lost in the forest of some mysterious alien world. Help Honko find his home planet.

title: Fohh
description: Explore a mysterious world with a mysterious magical companion!

title: The Crawler
description: In the middle of a forest, a group of kids stop by a supermarket to grab some snacks. As they wander through the aisles, strange things start to happen. They soon realize they are not alone. The main character must uncover the secrets of the supermarket and find a way out before it’s too late.

title: The Cornfield Road
description: This is a short horror experience where you find yourself stuck in a mysterious road, tring to get back home. But are you really safe walking all by yourself?

title: Tiny Adventure
description:
Welcome to Tiny Adventure!
A tiny tiny adventure in a big, big world.

title: Laundry Night
description: You take a late night trip to the laundromat to do your laundry. It's incredibly peaceful when no one else is around, and you don't have to wait for a washer to be available. But, out of nowhere, spooky things start to happen. Will you survive the night?

title: Tap It Away
description: Tap the blocks to make them fly away and clear the screen. The blocks will only fly in one direction. As player progress, the blocks form bigger and bigger shapes, and the blocks themselves change form. There are more than 600 tapping levels with a variety of game mechanics.

title: Babies vs. Monsters
description: Babies Vs Monsters is a bullet hell rogue-like game with RPG elements. Designed with cartoonish animations, this game offers various characters, level designs, and challenging boss battles that are both fun and difficult!

title: Rags to Liches
description: A small, third-person, action, tower defense game where you play as a peasant who gets tired of adventurers breaking into his house. Place down towers and fight off waves and waves of "enemies." Progress through the story and see just how far one man will go to protect his beloved llama.

title: Hive and Seek
description: Hive and Seek is a side-scrolling strategy base-building game where you clear randomly generated Roguelike stations infested with monsters. By rallying robots and clearing rooms, you will be able to destroy hives and recapture the station piece by piece.

title: Sonic Robo Blast 2: Heroes
description:
A Sonic Heroes inspired level pack for Sonic Robo Blast 2 by STHE1230.

Team mechanics implemented like in the real Heroes game. There is a total of 34 emblems to find. Each level is a combination of act 1 and 2 from the original game. The Chaos Emeralds are hidden in the levels, think you can find them all?

title: SUGOI
description: SUGOI (Shut Up and Get On It) is a collaborative level pack created as a community project led by TehRealSalt. It was inspired by DUMP, a similar project from the ZDoom community. The premise of SUGOI was to encourage community members to make a level in a limited timeframe, similar to the Official Level Design Contest but without the competitive aspects. Any community member could contribute, regardless of their mapping experience, and all submissions made in good faith were accepted, regardless of their quality. The mapping phase lasted from July 9th until August 9th, 2016. Afterwards, TehRealSalt compiled the results into a level pack, which was released on September 6th, 2016. The project was much more successful than originally anticipated, receiving 30 maps from 25 different contributors. Its success inspired two sequels, SUBARASHII and KIMOKAWAIII.

title: Kimokawaiii
description: KIMOKAWAIII (also known as SUGOI 3, full title: KIMOKAWAIII Is My Origin, KIMOKAWAIII Always Waits And Is Intensely Interested) is the third and last entry in the SUGOI series, a series of collaborative level packs created by community members under the supervision of TehRealSalt. It contains 56 levels and features work by more than 60 different contributors, created over the months of April and May 2018 in two phases, with the first consisting of collaborative work on levels like the previous iterations (labeled KAWAIII) and a latter phase focused on the creation of custom boss fights (labeled KIMOIII), which later were merged into a single project. The level pack was initially released on August 17th, 2019, and is specially notable for bringing about the last patch of its current version of SRB2, v2.1.25, that catered to PolyObject bugs and a further expansion in the number of freeslots.

title: ​Outer Wilds: A Thrilling Graphical Text Adventure
description: The original text adventure prototype for Outer Wilds, released to the public in celebration of the original game's fifth anniversary.

title: Bloodrun
description: Completely redesigned Quake III Arena, it is already having 6 champions, following the same principle as in Quake Champions, it is planned to add more champions and add way more other champions. All mechanics and engine is Quake III Arena based, but the rest (maps, damage, weapons, champions) will be different.

title: Ad Nauseam
description:
Ad Nauseam is an intricate choice-heavy psychological thriller about an amnesiac facing both real and mental horrors within a world akin to an endless, liminal hospital. The game itself is what I like to call an RCN (Roleplay & Click Novel) - a fusion genre of Visual Novel, RPG, and Point-&-Click games that centers around distressing content and how people choose to cope with trauma. Uncover the secrets of this strange world, and the ones lying within your own forgotten memories. Will you accept your limitations, or will you dive deep into delusion for a chance at hope?

Can you face the world? Can you face yourself?

Are you sure?

title: Letter Bunny
description: Take on a cozy adventure as Anne, a small and determined bunny with a heart of gold. Explore the peaceful island, deliver many packages and discover that behind every letter is a unique story! Make new friends, help people out and most importantly, have fun!

title: Grapefruit
description: Grapefruit is a research-creation project exploring the concept of videogames rules by Salen and Zimmerman through the work of Yoko Ono, specifically the event scores or performative instructions published in Grapefruit.

title: Dah-Varsity
description:
In this game, you’ll explore different STEAM topics like cars, math, music, books, space, and creating things. It’s a chance for you to learn while playing! When you play Dah-Varsity, you’ll learn about different jobs that match your interests in STEAM!

The game aims to help young adults develop a basic understanding of STEAM and entrepreneurship topics and foster the foundation for advanced STEAM learning and professional careers in the future.

Join the Dah-Varsity community and get ready for an awesome adventure filled with STEAM! Learn, have fun, and show the world what you can do.

title: A Second Mario Bros. X Thing: Analog Funk
description: A Second Mario Bros. X Thing: Analog Funk is the sequel to A Super Mario Bros. X Thing: Prelude to the Stupid. Also developed by Talkhaus through the Super Mario Bros. X engine. Much like the first game, players can pick between 5 playable characters: Demo, Iris, Kood, Sheath and Raocow himself.

title: Make a Good Level Contest X3: The Movie - The Contest: The Game
description: A collaborative level design contest by the SMBX/SMBX2 community, released in 2021, and having taken over a third of SMBX's life cycle to be completed.

title: 2K1X Subzero Heroes
description: The final episode in SMBX's 2k1x series.

title: Make A Fun Awesome Boss 3: Friendship Always Best
description: A collaborative boss design contest held by Talkhaus in the Super Mario Bros. X 2 engine and released in 2023.

title: Doki: Chapter 0
description: A Super Mario Bros. X2 episode by Doki containing a original cast of characters.

title: Salomónico
description:
An interactive experiment inspired by the story of King Solomon.

This is a personal and clumsy relationship about imparting your judgment in crazy situations with sword blows.

You could say that it is in bad taste in many moments, it even gives you the option of cutting a baby in half.

title: A Day for Soft Food
description:
In A Day for Soft Food the player controls the hungry cat of a household. Its master (called "the Provider" in the game) is sound asleep in his bed, ill from some unknown sickness. His state of misery has left his faithful pet with barely anything to eat, and even the slightest mewl seems to annoy him. Can food be found without waking him up?

As with most modern interactive fiction, the player types in full sentences describing their intended actions (LOOK AT THE PROVIDER, MEW, and so on). The game requires a Z-interpreter to run.

title: Innocence: A Seduce Me Story
description:
Before the demon war, there was a brilliant kingdom.
Within its walls lived a beautiful succubus princess.
She was a beacon of hope and peace to her people.
With such a heavy crown to bear, the princess found solace and affection in her childhood friend.
Does he truly love her in return?
--This is a prequel to the 2015 visual novel "Seduce Me the Otome"--

title: Pizz'Amore
