description: From the creator of The Stanley Parable and The Beginner’s Guide comes Wanderstop, a narrative-centric cozy game about change and tea.

title: Battle Suit Aces
description: Lead a plucky crew against a star-consuming threat in this charming character-driven, card battling RPG. Brought to you by the creators of the award-winning Battle Chef Brigade, recruit ace pilots, upgrade their mecha Battle Suits, grow meaningful friendships and captain your personalized adventure.

title: Rogue Eclipse
description: A spacefighter for the new age. Master your piloting prowess in an epic sci-fi setting, take down swarms of starfighters, merciless armadas and colossal behemoths in a roguelike campaign that spans the cosmos. Easy to learn, tricky to master, and impossible to put down.

title: Dosa Divas
description: Platform through a vibrant world in an upgradeable mech and cook delicious meals. Fight off corpos in turn based combat, discover new recipes, build up your reputation with local communities, and bond with friends and family on a journey to taste everything life has to offer.

title: Battle Aces
description:
Welcome to a fast paced and action-oriented real time strategy game where you defend your base, advance your tech and attack the enemy’s core. Battle Aces is a RTS game made for everyone, for those new to the genre or longtime fans, as well.

Customize a specific Unit Deck before each match, limited to 10 minutes, making for intense battles, full of strategic depth at its highest levels of play.

title: The Finals: Season 3
description:
Season 3 was the third season of THE FINALS. It launched on June 13, 2024, and ended on September 26, 2024. It was revealed on June 7, 2024, at Summer Game Fest. The season followed a predominately Japanese theme.

This season was sponsored by ENGIMO, introducing the all-new arena Kyoto and the tournament series World Tour, alongside OSPUZE, which sponsored the OSPUZE Expo, and DISSUN.

New content introduced in Season 3 includes:
- Arena: Kyoto
- Game Modes: World Tour, ranked Terminal Attack
- New cosmetics
- New Battle Pass
- Weapons: Recurve Bow, Dual Blades, Spear
- Gadget: Thermal Bore
- Specialization: Winch Claw
- Progression: New career levels
- Team text chat on PC

title: Battle Vision
description: Battle your way to fame and glory in this cosmic tactical puzzle-battle roguelike! Recruit your ultimate team, equip them with powerful abilities and take them on a season-long run of domination in the universe’s most-watched battle-sport!

title: Mossfield Archives
description: A game about building and exploring connections.

title: Petal Runner
description: Hop on your bike and join Cali & Kira as they explore the sun-soaked city of Sapphire Valley and train to become Petal Runners! Make deliveries, meet new friends, play minigames, and discover a wholesome slice-of-life story about growing up and letting go.

title: Cozy Grove: Camp Spirit
description: All those who are lost deserve kindness. Help cute, ghostly bears find peace in this relaxing sequel to the beloved life-sim game Cozy Grove, where kindness rules and new crafting, building, and camping island adventures await.

title: Koira
description: Save a puppy and embark on a musical, hand-drawn adventure. Journey together to the heart of a magical forest. Run from danger and discover your powers.

title: A Little to the Left: Seeing Stars
description: Seeing Stars is all about multiple solutions, with 100 stars to discover across 38 playful puzzles, and some extra cute visitors too.

title: Tides of Tomorrow
description: From the makers of Road 96 comes a groundbreaking narrative adventure. Your choices shape the story for other players! Follow in your friends’ footsteps, face the consequences of their actions and choose the fate of this plasticpunk world.

title: Cult of the Lamb: Unholy Alliance
description: Summoned by blood and born in corruption, a wicked new ally can join the holy Lamb in LOCAL CO-OP! Crusade through dungeons, slay heretics, build your cult, and seek new powers together... But that's not all!

title: Tenjutsu
description:
In Tenjutsu, you play as a renegade yakuza hellbent on defying her former associates and loosening their grip on the Secret Garden City. Revealed at this year's Devolver Direct, this fast and fluid rogue-jutsu is the latest game from Sébastien Benard, designer of the acclaimed Dead Cells.

Four powerful crime syndicates control the city, ruling with an iron fist. To defeat them, you must master a brutal brawling system and build a diverse arsenal of weapons, upgrades, and martial arts techniques, breaking their hold on the streets in a flurry of violence.

The city is reborn as these sinister organizations fall to your fists, tackled in any order you wish. The ruined streets become vibrant and full of life, and you can spend gathered resources in shops and restaurants to help you on your quest.

Shape the city to fit your play style, unlocking new weapons, combat moves, and new areas. Just don't take too long: the longer you spend preparing, the stronger your enemies will become.

title: The Talos Principle II: Road to Elysium
description: Road to Elysium is a three-part coda that allows you to dive deeper into the world of The Talos Principle 2, reunite with beloved characters, and put your puzzle-solving skills to the test through a series of thought-provoking new stories.

title: Possessor(s)
description:
Possessor(s) is a fast-paced action side scroller with combat inspired by platform fighters, a story told through dangerous characters, set in a deep interconnected world ready for exploration.

Play as Luca, the host, and Rehm, her less-than-cooperative counterpart, as they explore a quarantined city ripped apart and flooded by an interdimensional catastrophe. Their only hope of survival is by learning to co-exist.

Possessor(s) takes place across the interconnected sprawl of a destroyed mega-city, from collapsed skyscrapers to an abandoned aquarium, all riddled with secrets. Hauntingly beautiful 3D environments form a stunning backdrop over which hand-drawn and animated characters, and mysterious sci-fi horror action take center stage.

Choose multiple paths in an open-ended world structure as you look to uncover the truth behind the catastrophe. Meet a cast of engaging characters, each with their own heart-breaking story to follow in the aftermath of the devastation.

Gameplay is centered around tight, fast-paced platforming with a range of unique movement abilities that extends to its tense, precise, combat. Balance ground and air attacks, replete with combos and juggles as you encounter a variety of deadly enemies and challenging bosses. Find and unlock a wide array of powerful weapons and upgrades to bolster your arsenal and explore previously inaccessible areas.

title: Can of Worms
description: A game about going to your yearly fishing ritual with your can of worms.

title: Sluggy's Tiny Adventure
description: Free yourself from your glass prison and kill the wizard.

title: Matchbox: Driving Adventures
description: Ignite your imagination and jump into your vehicle to tackle missions and win races.

title: The Act of Misdirection
description: The Act of Misdirection is a short horror story about magic both fake and real, on the stage of Victorian England. It was nominated for a XYZZY for Best Story of 2004.

title: The Big Catch: Tacklebox
description: Crack open the Tacklebox to show off your platforming prowess and fishing skills in this free prologue to The Big Catch.

title: Kava
description: Kava is a new single player experience for Red Faction with an estimated casual playtime of 2-3 hours, putting it roughly on par with the length of the Red Faction base game. Set a short time prior to the events of the Red Faction campaign, Kava casts the player in the role of Kava Xarel.

title: The Curse of Orion The Next Encounter
description: This is the ultimate training phase of your Red Faction probationary period. If you survive you will prove yourself as the chosen one to liberate Mars from Ultor when the time comes. Many miners have been sent to this realm, none ever make it back.

title: VS Cartoon Cat
description: VS Cartoon Cat is a mod developed by Keneth YT And ToK. The mod is based on Trevor Henderson's monsters and creatures, including Cartoon Cat. The mod also has various fanmade versions of Cartoon Cat.

title: Large PonPon
description:
Our hero's girlfriend, Rurika, suddenly informs him that she is being transferred to Paris. However, after only a few months, she gives up her job and comes home; she is pregnant. Following an extremely hot argument, she leaves him without telling him where she is going.

Our hero goes looking for her and learns that she has checked into an obstetrics ward. Here at the hospital, he accidentally runs into Yukari, an old childhood friend from school. He also starts up a hot relationship with a married woman named Touri, who is staying in the next hospital room. His girlfriend really starts to get jealous of his other playmates. Will he fulfill his obligations to Rurika, or will he keep going after hot, new babes?

It is 0verflow's debut work and most characters belong to the core families of 0verflow's works.

title: TheExit8NYC
description:
In this first-person game, you are trapped in an endless underground passage.
Carefully observe your surroundings to reach “Exit 8”.

Do not neglect any anomaly, floor 0 is a model without any anomaly, look at all the objects carefully.

If you find any anomalies (object different from the floor 0), turn around immediately this will take you to the next floor.

If you don't find any anomalies, go ahead to go up one floor.

If you make a mistake you will start again from floor 0.

Your objective is to exit via exit 8.

move using the wasd keys
You will find various options such as volume, mouse sensitivity and several graphics options in the "ESC" menu.

title: All Systems Dance
description: Automation is not the answer; DANCE is the key to disruption! Help liberate citizens of a consumption-obsessed, corporate dystopia in All Systems Dance: an expressive dance battle adventure. Connect moves, express yourself, feel the music. Join The Movement. The revolution will not be choreographed.

title: Croakwood
description: Croakwood is a creative, relaxed town building simulation game about frogs and nature! Design and create structures, plan and decorate towns, and explore an ancient forest to guide the growth of a charming community of tiny amphibians as they settle into their new life in the lush and wild woods.

title: Sandara: City of a Thousand Eclipses
description: Use your cards to roleplay in a harsh world where your home is slowly sinking into the sands. Enter the city of Sandara and build your deck, make allies, enhance your abilities, and manage your resources before the eclipse ends your life.

title: Slay the Princess: The Pristine Cut
description:
Slay the Princess is a choice-driven psychological horror visual novel with dramatic branching, light RPG elements, and hand-penciled art.

The Pristine Cut is the definitive version of the game. It features expanded content including 3 new chapters, never-before-seen Princesses, expansions to familiar routes, a new ending, over 1,200 new hand-penciled frames, over 2,500 new lines of dialogue, and over 35% more content overall.

title: Minecraft: Camp Enderwood
description: Welcome to Camp Enderwood, the island summer camp of your dreams...and your nightmares! Participate in parkour, archery, hide n' hunt and more to earn marshmallows and roast the elusive s'more. Beware the spooky woods and creatures in the dark as you explore and venture beyond the camp.

title: Squeakross: Home Squeak Home
description: In Squeakross: Home Squeak Home, solve and transform puzzles into furniture to decorate the perfect home for your rodent friend. Collect hundreds of decorations, accessories and stickers in this cozy game full of charm!

title: Critter Café
description: Welcome to your Critter Café! Seek out fantastical Critters in need of your help and build a new home together. Renovate your café, bond with your Critters, and uncover the secrets of mysterious portals to give every Critter a cosy home.

title: Ila: A Frosty Glide
description:
Set foot on a magical island and immerse yourself in a whimsical small open world as ILA, a spirited young witch-in-training with her trusty skatebroom. Explore, find secret places, collectables, and improve your magic and flying abilities as you make your way to the summit.

Explore a whimsical small open world as ILA, a spirited young witch-in-training. Start your journey fueled by determination and your trusty skatebroom. Find secret places, collect valuable items, and improve your magical flying abilities.

Who needs a broom when you have a skatebroom? Soar through snowy mountains and enchanted forests, feel the wind as you cross stunning landscapes. Master and upgrade the magic of your to soar higher and farther.

Explore ILA’s small open world at your own pace and relax. Find hidden nooks, uncover treasures, and unlock secrets flying on your skatebroom. Each discovery rewards you with valuable items and deeper lore, enriching your magical journey.

Collect special items and coins to personalize ILA’s outfit with stylish hats, capes, and skatebrooms to reflect your unique style. As you progress, access new skatebroom upgrades to improve ILA’s flying powers.

Feel the magic and enjoy the captivating original soundtrack composed by Joaquim Scandurra (Sku), which builds up and grows with you as you approach the summit.

title: Tiny Lands 2
description: Take your perception into a new dimension with the relaxing sense of photorealistic miniature scenes in Tiny Lands 2. Find the differences and stories by exploring handcrafted 3D dioramas. Can you find them all?

title: Magical Bakery
description: Experience a life full of magic, challenges, and the joy of creating sweets that will leave a spellbinding impression on your customers. Become the ultimate magical baker and prove yourself worthy to inherit the Magical Bakery!

title: Pretty Coo'
description:
Lost and alone in an unfamiliar town square, I guess it's time to make friends with the local wildlife!

By feeding and guiding your feathered friends, you'll overcome various obstacles to make your way back home, and maybe even cause some mischief along the way!

title: Prisma
description: Prisma is a captivating 2D Japanese-inspired RPG featuring innovative turn-based combat with never before seen strategic use of camera lens and filters. Your camera empowers you to manipulate the world through lenses and filters, turning battles into a mesmerizing interplay of strategy and artistry.

title: Heaven Crawler
description: Heaven Crawler is an atmospheric, isometric action roguelite dungeon crawler with RPG elements. Explore The Womb, a forgotten, man-made tower that reaches the heavens. Collect powerful items and strengthen your character on an epic journey to the top. And remember: Bring her back!

title: Naughty Geese
description: Naughty Geese is a 2D pixel art platformer. You control a biker goose who tries to keep his offspring safe from predators. As they like to escape and enjoy the scenery, Dad needs to go after his "Naughty Geese" every time. Enjoy unique gameplay that pays homage to classics of the genre.

title: The Path into the Abyss
description: "The Path into the Abyss" is a hardcore first-person open-world survival shooter set in Buenos Aires with a backdrop of cosmic horror, combat mechanics, dynamic AI, and looting.

title: Curilemu
description: Curilemu is an adventure-horror game inspired by the myths and legends of Chilean Patagonia. Immerse yourself in a haunting world filled with Lovecraftian horrors and ancient mysteries. Fight colossal beasts and discover what is behind the plague to heal this island and restore the cosmic balance.

title: Super Crane HD
description: Retro match 3 about a Bug juggling at his job, BUT NOW IT'S BETTER Match 3 drops to clear them, but your tool changes constantly, so watch out! Be a Bug, Do a Work, Match a 3

title: Codex: Eternal Eclipse
description: Embark on a quirky adventure with four unique main characters as they seek their truth, battling gods, colossal corporations, and bizarre foes along the way. Unravel the mystery of the Eternal Eclipse and uncover the ancient secrets of the world!

title: Kimi ga Ita Kisetsu: Primary
description:
Maejima Masaki is an aspiring photographer presented with an opportunity to study under a world famous photographer, due to a photo he took of one of the 4 Isumi sisters with whom he is close to which managed to attract attention. However, he must make a choice of whether he wishes to pursue that opportunity or not.

It became âge's debut work due to the troubled development of "Kaseki no Uta" and at the time received heavy criticism about the game system and storyline.

title: Dredge: The Iron Rig
description: Gather, craft and deliver your way through the mysteries of The Iron Rig, revisiting areas from Dredge to investigate ancient disturbances stirring in the deep. Assist the Ironhaven Corporation in constructing facilities that unlock items, gadgets and more, but what are they truly here for?

title: Reflection by Delphinium Interactive
description:
Reflection is an 02A2 Visual Novel Game Jam Submission!

This game was made in five days by a small team.

title: Happy Bastards
description: Happy Bastards is an open-world tactical RPG with turn-based combat in which you assemble a squad of unruly mercenaries to explore, fight, and loot. Let the bastards do the dirty work while you give the orders, reap the rewards, and enjoy the high life. Who needs XP when you're famous?

title: Memory Clash
description: Memory Clash is an engaging multiplayer memory game set in a fantastical world filled with magic and mythical creatures. Players immerse themselves in an enchanting realm where they compete to uncover and match pairs of magical cards. Each turn reveals a new challenge, testing the players' memory and strategy skills as they aim to outwit their opponents. With vibrant fantasy-themed artwork and dynamic gameplay modes, Memory Clash offers an exciting and challenging experience for players of all ages. The game supports both cooperative and competitive play, allowing friends and family to enjoy the adventure together or against each other in epic memory battles.

title: Goat Simulator 3: Multiverse of Nonsense
description: In a world where everything went wrong (and it was all your fault) you must now help the guardian of the Multiverse to save it before it’s too late. This is… Goat Simulator 3: Multiverse of Nonsense

title: Eriksholm: The Stolen Dream
description:
Experience an isometric, narrative-driven stealth game set in the stunning city of Eriksholm. When Hanna’s brother, Herman, disappears and the police begin to pursue him, her search sets off a chain of catastrophic events that will not only alter their lives but also the destiny of the entire city. Join your allies, outsmart relentless enemies, and use your cunning to uncover the truth behind Herman’s disappearance — where greater powers are at play than you ever imagined.

Follow Hanna’s adventure through the vibrant streets of Eriksholm, a sprawling Nordic city inspired by the elegance and grit of early 1900s Scandinavia. In this world, every shadow offers a hiding place, and every corner hides a new challenge. Allies and quick reflexes are your greatest tools as you unravel the city's secrets and outsmart your pursuers.

title: Nikoderiko: The Magical World
description: Join Niko and Luna on their quest in Nikoderiko, a vibrant platform adventure. When the duo discovers an ancient relic on a magical island, the villainous Grimbald of the Cobring Gems Company snatches it away. To save the island and its tribes, they must navigate seven unique worlds with the help of their animal friends and defeat the Cobring army. With family-friendly design, couch co-op, and music by David Wise, Nikoderiko promises a magical, mysterious journey for all ages.

title: Sinned Arena
description: Sinned Arena is a classic arena shooter inspired by timeless 90s games. You are trapped in Hell with other unfortunate souls, fighting among each other for demons twisted pleasures. Fight for your way out this dark place but beware, demons aren't there just to watch.

title: Ivor
description:
A blood-pumping throwback FPS set in a Norse-inspired world. The undead have risen and Ivor, the Drengr, has awakened. Take up your axes, load your shotgun, and get to killing.

This game was originally created for the 2021 E1M1 Game Jam held in November. That version of the game, along with a brand-new arena mode, are now available to download for free!

title: Sonic PC Port Remake
description: The Sonic PC Port Remake is a Sonic creepypasta game created by JohnKun and JoeDoughBoi.

title: Dishop
description:
In the year 2063, human civilization teeters on the brink of collapse as the world descends into a devastating chaos, wrought by resource scarcity, relentless warfare, and rampant pollution. However, tragedy reaches new dimensions when an unexpected event ravages the Earth.

An outlaw, sentenced to the death penalty for a series of heinous acts, emerges as his dark past intertwines with the struggle for the survival of all humanity. At the heart of the chaos, the fate of the human race is at stake in a colossal confrontation, where the indomitable will of an anti-hero challenges the relentless force of an unparalleled event.

title: Mekkablood: Quarry Assault
description: The Year is 2082. You play the role of Bill, a grizzled, and extremely hairy robojockey. It's up to you to take the reigns of Bill's Mekk, with your friend Rusty, to get your revenge against TorxCorp, who's trying to steal your mining claim.

title: Reverend
description: A short horror game made for a PS1 game jam in just over a week, where you, a fugitive on the run, find shelter in an old church. Reverend Jim Jagger takes you in, asking only for a bit of help around the place in return. But as you go about your tasks, something about the place feels off.

title: Ashes: Hard Reset
description: Ashes: Hard Reset is the prequel expansion for Ashes: Afterglow and is a linear campaign in the style of 2063. Take the role of the veteran scav Walker as he guides a team of elite soldiers into The City. As events spiral out of control Walker finds out that a long forgotten foe has caught up with him... and that not all injuries are of the flesh.

title: Neon Rain
description: Neon Rain is a hybrid between a Metroidvania and a Boomershooter.

title: Stuck At Lv. 1
description: Stuck At Lv. 1 is a roguelike action RPG in which the player plays as a protagonist who is cursed and is unable to "level up" his vampiric abilities, and must work around this restriction. Explore the Vespera Realm, steal enemy attacks and find out the truth about your curse!

title: Meme Mayhem
description: Hurl emojis and battle the internet's biggest stars to rise as a meme master in Meme Mayhem! Collect powerful perks and relics, enjoy a darkly comic social media story, and assemble the ultimate emoji attack stack in this roguelite idle RPG.

title: A Growing Adventure
description: Explore and grow a world in which a fantasy RPG adventure awaits.

title: Minecraft: 15 Year Journey
description: It’s time for a (literal) trip down memory lane! A lot has happened in these 15 years, so we’ve packed some of our most nostalgic moments, marvelous dimensions, and accidental proudest inventions from our past into a free map by Oreville Studios. The doors to the Minecraft Museum are open and admission is free, so what are you waiting for? Let’s head inside!

title: Hidden Cats In Japanese Village
description: This hidden object game provides a relaxing experience as you search for 100 hidden cats scattered throughout a charming Japanese village

title: Age Maniax: Isumi Yon Shimai Saigo no Hi
description:
One day protagonist meets with four sisters, who due to certain events starts living in his house. But he has to go to Europe to follow a story, and they decide to go together with him. They make reservations in an old castle which had reports of a princess' ghost, a legendary wolf, a lake monster and a crashed UFO surrounding it. And this is not even the beginning of the events to unfold around the sisters ...

A crossover between multiple âge works, various characters from other companies games such as Hateao, PHANTOM and Pure Mail make appearance.

title: Caution Ahead: Part 2
description:
This is the second installment of a three-part series featuring a run-and-hide type horror experience, with each part consisting of three chapters.

You follow the story of John Rand, an experienced search and rescue officer stationed at Richburg National Park.

After the events of Part I, John continues his relentless search and rescue mission. He must venture further into the depths of Richburg National Park before it's too late to save both Michelle and Elena.

* Chapter 4: The search.
* Chapter 5: Run for your life.
* Chapter 6: Almost there.

title: Hazing: Night Shift
description: A young police officer arrives at a country house after a disturbing call... This VHS tape captures the horrors that happened to him.

title: Fallout 76: Skyline Valley
description: Expand southward to Skyline Valley – a brand-new region of Appalachia. Investigate the cause of the electric storm circling overhead and unveil the mystery around Vault 63 and its dwellers, including a shocking new Ghoul type – The Lost.

title: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33
description: Lead the members of Expedition 33 on their quest to destroy the Paintress so that she can never paint death again. Explore a world of wonders inspired by Belle Époque France and battle unique enemies in this turn-based RPG with real-time mechanics.

title: FragPunk
description:
FragPunk is the new free-to-play 5v5 hero shooter poised to break the rules of combat.
What makes FragPunk different is the introduction of Shard Cards that can affect the playing field for all players.
Shard Cards are voted on by players before each round and can change the entire playing field – from making player’s heads big to your team into zombies when you are downed.
FragPunk has a low barrier entry but a high-level of gunplay mechanics making it a great choice for casual gamers to hardcore FPS fans alike.

title: Winter Burrow
description: Winter Burrow is a cozy woodland survival game about a mouse returning home to restore their childhood burrow. Explore, gather resources, craft, knit warm sweaters, bake pies and meet the locals.

title: Life is Strange: Double Exposure
description: Max Caulfield, photographer-in-residence at the prestigious Caledon University, discovers her closest new friend Safi dead in the snow. Murdered. To save her, Max tries to Rewind time – a power she’s not used in years… Instead, Max opens the way to a parallel timeline where Safi is still alive and still in danger! Max realizes the killer will soon strike again – in both versions of reality. Only Max can Shift between the two parallel timelines to solve and prevent the same murder.

title: Atomfall
description: A nuclear disaster has left an area of Britain in tatters. Atomfall, a new survival-action game, will see you explore, scavenge, craft, barter and fight your way through beautifully recreated scenery in search of answers.

title: Gears of War: E-Day
description: Experience the brutal horror of Emergence Day through the eyes of Marcus Fenix in the origin story of one of gaming's most acclaimed sagas.​ Fourteen years before Gears of War, war heroes Marcus Fenix and Dom Santiago return home to face a new nightmare: the Locust Horde. These subterranean monsters, grotesque and relentless, erupt from below, laying siege on humanity itself. ​Built from the ground up with Unreal Engine 5, Gears of War: E-Day delivers unprecedented graphical fidelity.

title: Die Feen
description:
This appears to be an island or a peninsula.
This is because the Nider and Loub tribes do not have the ability to draw maps, the Erlmutel tribe does not have the personality to travel far to draw maps, and the Ferns are not even interested in topography, so there is only one person who knows it well. There was no one there either.

title: Parity Shot Integral
description: Parity Shot Integral is a doujin side-scrolling shooting game featuring three playable characters. The game was distributed at Comiket 69.

title: Among the Wild
description: Among The Wild is a first-person farming game where you wrangle fantastical creatures, build and manage your own idyllic farm, and set out to explore uncharted corners of a strange universe.

title: Star Birds
description: Star Birds is a cheerful asteroid base-building and resource management game. Discover and mine countless asteroids, create production networks and guide your colony of spacefaring birds to new interstellar horizons!

title: Lorn Vale
description: A free-roaming post-apocalyptic Survival Sandbox RPG in which you must weather the unrelenting brutality of a dying world. Shape your own unique journey, forge alliances. Make difficult choices in this systems-driven game full of procedurally generated events. Amidst the ruins, your story begins.

title: Ale Abbey
description: Build and expand your monastery, craft recipes and brew holy ales in this unique brewery tycoon. No pre-made recipes in Ale Abbey, oh no. It's a canvas for true beer alchemists. It's as simple as: brew, sip, repeat. Welcome to Ale Abbey!

title: Devyat' princev Ambera
description:
Devyat' princev Ambera is an adventure game based on Nine Princes in Amber (1970), the first novel from the Chronicles of Amber series by Roger Zelazny. It follows the adventures of Carl Corey, who wakes up in a hospital with amnesia, escapes and starts searching for answers. After a while he discovers his true identity, his mission and a fantasy world hidden from the eyes of mere mortals. A lot of work has to be done.

The gameplay is linear and consists of several loosely connected elements: a simple point-n-click adventure, a number of quick-time events and 9 stand-alone puzzles. The story is told through dialogs that follow the text of the novel closely. The game comes with 2D hand-drawn characters and pre-rendered backgrounds.

title: Sumerian Six
description: Lead an unlikely team of commando scientists behind enemy lines to fight Nazis, uncover arcane mysteries, and wield experimental technology to turn the tide of WWII in this real-time tactical stealth adventure.

title: Down the Shaft
description: Down the Shaft is a first person horror game where you take on the duty to keep an Elder God forever contain within the cave. In order to do that, you must keep the machines that maim them active. But beware, their minions are on the loose and they won't let you do your job so easy.

title: Copa City
description: Organize high-stakes football events in the first football tycoon! Get the urban space and the stadium ready, ensure safety, and provide fans with an amazing football fiesta! But stay alert: Your decisions will not only influence the city but also the emotional rollercoaster for football fans!

title: Tempopo
description: A psychedelic soundscape in the sky. Puzzle through the seasons by conducting chaotic Tempopo to rescue musical flowers. Design and populate your melodic garden, then let the music play!

title: Little Critters 2
description: Embark on an epic journey in "Little Critters 2," where survival and adventure intertwine in a captivating world filled with vibrant landscapes and unpredictable challenges. As the latest installment in the beloved Little Critters series, this game takes you on a thrilling adventure like never before.

title: I Am Your Beast
description: I Am Your Beast is a shortform covert revenge thriller FPS about getting hunted across the North American wilderness by the military-industrial complex--and turning the tables.

title: Crescent County
description: Crash headfirst into this witch-tech open world, drifting and driving on the back of your new motorbroom. Make deliveries, trick out your broom, and race your new friends (and crushes) as the sun sets. Decorate your flat, sort your life out, and discover what it means to find home.

title: Generation Exile
description: Generation Exile is a turn-based city-builder taking place aboard a generation starship where instead of extracting more and more natural resources to meet your populace’s needs, you only have what you brought with you. Rebuild the ship’s fragile ecosystems before the ship reaches the end of its journey. Procedurally generated characters and storylines mean that every journey — spanning several hundred years — will be uniquely yours.

title: Adventure II
description: An expanded version of the original Colossal Cave Adventure written by by Peter Luckett and Jack Pike that adds news areas and increases the max score to 440 points. While the original, complete source code is thought to be lost, a modern reconstruction, known as Adv440, was developed by Mike Arnautov in 2001, compiled in Perl based on the Fortran66 code that was still available.

title: Hotel Galactic
description: Hotel Galactic is a cozy management game inspired by Studio Ghibli's classic pictures. Build the tourist destination of your dreams, oversee and unite your staff to forge a quirky family, and make new friends as you explore this wholesomely nostalgic world.

title: Phoenix Wright: Legends of Liability
description:
In an unexpected turn of events, Redd White is your client to protect his company, Bluecorp, from a class action lawsuit. In his most difficult case yet, Phoenix Wright has one job to do: To actually read Bluecorp's TOS (Terms of Service).

Explore Bluecorp's headquarters by examining areas and talking to employees, uncovering many dark secrets as you solve the mystery behind one of the biggest lies in the industry.

title: Streets of Fortuna
description: Use your wits to survive the generated chaos that is living in the Streets of Fortuna. A free-roaming sandbox game about growing from street rat to a tradesman, a priest, a smuggler, an alchemist, a spy, or perhaps someday a leader to rival the Overlord.

title: Phoenix Wright: Turnabout Cuddles!
description:
It's your first day as a new recruit at the Wright Anything Agency!

But just as you're settling in, someone gets murdered! It's up to you to solve the case, and maybe find love if you have the time!

title: Stormforge
description: Stormforge is an open-world survival crafting game for up to 8 players. You are Stormforged, with the ability to brave and harness power from magical storms. Explore, fight, forage, craft, build, and defeat bosses in this epic, fantasy game. Survive the Storms and thrive!

title: Gunboat God
description: Become the all-powerful Gunboat God in this fluid shoot 'em up. Carve the waves as you stylishly fight hordes of monsters in hundreds of quick-fire missions. Transform your Gunboat and upgrade your weapons, skills and abilities to take on giant, challenging, multi-stage bosses!

title: Ace Attorney: The Dark Age of Love
description: A VN based around the nice lawyers of the Ace Attorney games.

title: Athena Cykes: Ace Attorney - Trials of time.
description: Two years after what happened in Khura'in, Athena Cykes - an attorney, encounters a bunch of strange cases, with her ex co-worker: Apollo, being in Khura'in, and her boss - Phoenix Wright's sudden dissapearance, she has to solve the cases on her own, discover all the mysteries, and find out how they are all connected. And also find her boss. Will she do it? I don't know, that's for you to find out.

title: Phoenix Wright: Hidden Traces
description: "Phoenix Wright - Hidden Traces" is a German fan game for the well-known Ace Attorney series for the NDS. This part takes place between the second (Justice for all) and the third (Trials and Tribulations) and tells a completely new story. The player once again takes on the role of Phoenix Wright, a criminal defense lawyer who has to deal with a wide variety of cases and people.

title: Phoenix Wright: Comeback & Turnabout
description: Phoenix Wright: Comeback & Turnabout is a fan game developed by Squall for the Ace Attorney game series and takes place chronologically after the official second part of the series (Justice for All).

title: Is this Game Trying to Kill Me? Preface
description: This is a small free prequel to the Is this Game Trying to Kill Me?. An old cabin deep in the dense forest, a strange computer, and a game that's trying to kill you!

title: Space Junk Scavenger
description: Repair your spaceship by salvaging parts off shipwrecks nearby.

title: Non Stop Driver
description: If you slow down you die, if you speed up you live!

title: Asteroid Dodge
description: An arcade style game where you have to dodge lots of asteroids in order to be first in the world leaderboard.

title: Soulkin
description: Soulkin is a tactical roguelite game blending strategic monster-collecting and turn-based combat. As the summoned heroine, Nadia, you’ll harness the power of Souls to bond with magical creatures and lead them against the encroaching corruption threatening Ankiril.

title: Primado Reig 103
description:
This game adapts a real story that is happening right now (June 2024) in the building of Primado Reig Avenue number 101-103, in Benimaclet, Valencia, Spain.

But if it weren't about that building, I could go on any other.

title: Kingdom Hearts Integrum Masterpiece
description: Experience the full story of KINGDOM HEARTS! The journey begins in KINGDOM HEARTS -HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX- as Sora, Donald, and Goofy battle the Heartless, making friends and having spectacular adventures along the way. The story culminates in KINGDOM HEARTS III + Re Mind, where our heroes take on tremendous challenges and persevere against the darkness threatening iconic Disney and Pixar worlds.

title: ChromaGun 2: Dye Hard
description: Shoot paint, mix colors, and solve puzzles in this adventure about friendship and redemption. Just don't enter that portal to another universe, and everything will be perfectly fine.

title: Deathwish Enforcers: Special Edition
description: A gritty, non-stop blood bath from the creator of Insanity's Blade, Super Battle Princess Madelyn and the recently released GuardGrave. And a parody of beloved 60s and 70s classic action films, heroes and villains. Deathwish Enforcers... There's gonna be hell to pay!

title: Extra Ordinary
description: Short retro-inspired game based on Extra Ordinary (2019) a supernatural horror-comedy film directed by Mike Ahern & Enda Loughman. You play as Rose, a (mostly sweet and mostly lonely) Irish small-town driving instructor, who must use her supernatural talents to save the daughter of Martin (also mostly sweet & lonely) from a washed-up rock star who plans to use her in a Satanic pact to reignite his fame.

title: Nothing Door
description:
A puzzle game from a dark dimension.

The Nothing Door is your only escape. But the door is fickle. It lets nothing through... except you. Where will it lead you?

title: Alan Wake II: Deluxe Upgrade
description:
Unlock the Expansion Pass and exclusive cosmetic content with the Alan Wake 2 Deluxe Upgrade

Alan Wake II Deluxe Upgrade includes:
- Expansion Pass
- Night Springs Expansion (additional story content)
- Lake House Expansion (additional story content)
- Nordic Shotgun Skin for Saga
- Crimson Windbreaker for Saga
- Celebrity Suit for Alan
- Parliament Shotgun Skin for Alan
- Lantern Charm for Saga

title: Tom Clancy's The Division 2: Season 1 - First Rogue
Skull and Bones: Season 3 - Into the Dragon’s Wake
Prince of Persia: The Lost Crown - Divine Trials
description: Prince of Persia: The Lost Crown - Divine Trials is a free content update that introduces a series of challenging platforming and combat trials. Accessible via a special door in the Haven after acquiring the Rush of the Simurgh ability, the trials are divided into four memorials, each unlocking upon obtaining specific time powers.

title: Prince of Persia: The Lost Crown - Mask of Darkness
description: Prince of Persia: The Lost Crown - Mask of Darkness is a story DLC. It adds new biomes, enemies, bosses, abilities, and a new outfit as Sargon explores a distorted dimension known as the Mind Palace.

title: The Crew: Motorfest - Season 4
description:
Time to get ready for what's coming next, Festival-goers!

With Ubisoft Forward fast approaching, we wanted to thank you all for an amazing first year, your continued feedback, and for making The Crew Motorfest what it is today!

We have some exciting news to share with you next week, but before that, we wanted to give you a first look at what's coming for the end of Year 1:

Season 4 will be your next stop at Motorfest - and trust us, your customization skills will have to reach new heights as we kick off a brand-new playlist.

title: The Crew: Motorfest - Season 7
description:
The Crew Motorfest Season 7 is out now and brings two new Playlists, one on day one, the second on August 6, 17 new vehicles, and new quality-of-life improvements to the game, all for free.

Available immediately, the new Playlist, Ferrari Supercars, adds the Enzo Ferrari Museum to the island of Maui, seven main events, more than 25 challenges, six photo ops, six feats, and the yet-to-be-released Ferrari F80 supercar. Players will be able to explore the museum on a journey through Ferrari's most legendary models, guided by Michele Pignatti Morano, Director of the Ferrari Museums.

title: The Crew: Motorfest - Season 5
description:
A brand-new Hawaiian island will be added to the game at the launch of Season 5 - in November 2024 - for free!

Maui, a captivating jewel in the Hawaiian crown - the island embodies an exquisite blend of culture, adventure, and natural wonders, thus offering an enchanting setting for the Motorfest Festival.

From the vibrant energy of Kahului urban grounds to the awe-inspiring landscapes of Haleakalā National Park and its bamboo forest, going through the iconic Ohe’o Gulch sacred pools with its cascading waterfalls, Maui beckons with endless exploration.

Maui will add a whopping 345km of total road network to the game, with 229km of that being asphalt and 190km of dirt roads. So, get ready for some amazing island exploration!

title: The Crew: Motorfest - Season 6
description:
Season 6 is just around the corner, and we've partnered with one of the most prolific brands that specialize in getting your blood pumping!

Red Bull are here to shake things up across the paradisiacal islands of Hawaii! Get ready to rev your engines and experience the next evolution of The Crew Motorfest! Season 6 brings a fresh wave of thrilling content, including new Playlists, expanded locations, 17 new vehicles, exciting gameplay updates, and overall polish.

title: Anno 117: Pax Romana
description:
In the latest instalment of the award-winning Anno strategy franchise, it’s your destiny to shape the Roman Empire in the year 117 AD. As governor, will you encourage economic growth or expand your rule through dominance? Lead with rebellion or unite a diverse culture?
The cost of peace is yours to decide.

title: The Book of Buja
description: Explore the vast, open world of Darrow. Solve puzzles and collect the six Stalm Pirate remains. With the help of the Zapra Viti Hourglass and your ability to peer into a corpse's demise, uncover the mystery behind the Queen's untimely death.

title: Cienie
description: Cienie is a mystery-thriller visual novel with supernatural elements set in the Polish town of Sypniewo. You follow Tomasz Tyszko, a law university dropout who now interns at a private investigation agency run by Markus Waldner. After five individuals are reported missing in the town, Tom tries to unravel the mystery behind the disappearances while navigating the complexities of relationships and adulthood.

title: Viper-V6
description:
Viper V-6 is the first in the long-running Viper series of animated adult games. It contains three separate stories:The Devil Came* tells the story of a teenager named Ogawa, who was unpopular in his class and summoned a demon to exact revenge. But the demon turned out to be female, so his wishes naturally assume a different direction...

Afternoon describes a scene during a beauty contest. The defeated participant thinks that she was unfairly judged, but her fury at the winner turns, in front of the amazed spectators, into erotic desire...

Double Impact features two young female detectives, Miho and Kumi, who pretend to search for jobs as maids in order to infiltrate a mansion in which mysterious disappearances have been taking place.

All the three stories are very short and can perhaps be better described as "scenes"; the entire game can be completed within several minutes. The interaction is reduced to absolute minimum, with an occasion decision to make, and is available only in The Devil Came (in which it is also possible to die if the player makes a wrong decision); the two other stories are non-interactive, the only input being pressing the return key to advance to the next scene. What sets "Viper V-6" (and the whole series) apart from most other Japanese adult games - beside the "three stories in one" concept - is the fact that most of its sex scenes are animated.

title: Viper-V8
description:
The second entry in Sogna's long-running Viper franchise, Viper V-8 has the same format as its predecessor: three separate short stories with minimal interaction and animated sex scenes.

The three stories are:Friday the 18th*: Obviously, a parody on horror movies, telling the story of three young girls who were sexually assaulted by mysterious masked men when camping near a forest.

Demon's Night is set in medieval times and describes a battle of three young heroes against a vicious demon. One of them is killed in battle, while the other (a girl) is captured by the demon; the remaining warrior, a young man named Ryu, has to rescue his friend.

Alien Wars takes place in the future. A young space pilot named Sylvie is ambushed and captured by aliens who have nothing else in mind but to have sex with her...

There is some rudimentary interaction in all the three stories: "Friday the 18th" allows the player to switch from one heroine to another (even though there is only one correct way to do that); "Demon's Night" has a scene with pseudo-RPG turn-based combat (pre-determined results); both "Demon's Night" and "Alien Wars" offer some menu-based choices to make, some of which will lead to Game Over.

title: The Wisdom of the Minotaur
description:
The minotaur is a creature that stands at the boundary between human and animal. To be in-between boxes is to be a monster, something to be ostracized. So, really, you ought to choose if you want to be a man or a woman already. Don't you know the consequences if you don't?

A short, surreal kinetic novel about gender.

title: Make a Good Mega Man Level Contest 3
description:
Make a Good Mega Man Level Contest 3 is a Classic Mega Man Level Design Contest turned into a fully-fledged fangame, and the largest one yet!
Clear the contest entries, explore the hub worlds and witness the overarching plot unravel as you soak in the game's myriad of content!

title: Once Upon a Galaxy
description:
Once Upon a Galaxy is a mobile based card battler brought to you by Million Dreams.

Recruit a rag-tag squad of fairy book characters, heroes from legend, scheming villains and treasure hoarding dragons as they do battle across the galaxy where last one standing wins.

title: Facing Demons: Chara Battle
description: You finally reached the Final Coridor completing another Genocide route. You once again faced your nemesis - Chara Dreemurr, but this time something seems off. Ready your chainsaw, darling! The last actor is on the scene!

title: BugBurgh
description:
Care for a little village of cute lil bugs!
Explore the forest, forage for food, gather resources, construct little houses and buildings, watch the little village grow and try to keep everyone happy!
How many bugs can you care for? How many bugs is too many bugs?

title: 3 Kings
description:
In this pocket roguelike strategy game, you have to build a kingdom powerful enough to withstand the other king's invasions and be crowned the king of kings.

3 Kings is a 2024 Promotional demo of 9 kings before its official release in 2025.

title: Armor Battle
description: A simulator of the handheld game Armor Battle.

title: Destiny Star Girlfriend 3
description: In the final(?) route of this award-winning VN series, Seiji survives an attempt on his life by Kanoko, aka secret magical girl no. 3. The leads all point to a childhood tragedy and a certain deep-space Majin, so why him? And will Kanoko leave the dark side to save Seiji—and mankind—from herself?

title: Astérix: Hunt for the Boars
description: A digital simulator of the LCD handheld game of the same name.

title: Baseball
description: Step up to the plate in Baseball, a simple yet thrilling game where you control all the action on the field. Choose between easy, medium, or hard difficulty to match your skill level and start swinging!

title: Caccia al Ladro/Heathcliff
description: A digital simulator of the handheld game Caccia al Ladro/Heathcliff.

title: Sonic Frenzy Adventure
description: Sonic Frenzy Adventure is a retro-style fangame developed since 2004, featuring 11 zones and 5 playable characters, including two original ones. The game introduces unique mechanics such as a revised ring system with four levels, various shields with passive effects, and special powers exclusive to Sonic. Players explore each zone, ending in a boss fight, with a storyline focused on defeating EggRobo's mechanical empire. Achievements track high scores and hidden collectibles, and the game offers character-specific routes and challenges.

title: Abaddon
description: Abaddon is a first-person psychological horror game steeped in Lovecraftian elements. Descend into a haunting story as you take on the role of Jimmy, searching for his missing brother Georgie while confronting his past in a nightmarish world.

title: Ronin's Requiem
description: In Ronin's Requiem you play as a ninja who has fallen from grace and now, to regain his honor, he has to eliminate an army of demons in a foreign land. Ronin's Requiem is a fast-paced platformer with solid gameplay and fast-paced combat.

title: Dawn of Defiance
description: You are the Defier, subjected to a mythic plot across ruined isles. In this Greek myth-inspired survival craft, ascend from weak soldier to god-like anti-hero. Build impressive Greek structures, craft and upgrade your gear, and face down the trials of Gods with up to 3 friends.

title: Vampire: The Masquerade - Reckoning of New York
description: Vampire: The Masquerade - Reckoning of New York is a narrative game set in the World of Darkness Universe. Play as one of the members of the Vampire Clans in a shifting political landscape between the Camarilla and the Anarchs while trying your best to survive.

title: Prezzemolo in un Viaggio da Sogno
description: "Prezzemolo in un Viaggio da Sogno" is the second PC video game based on the mascot of Gardaland , the dragon Parsley . It is the sequel to "Prezzemolo in una giornata da incubo" and, like its predecessor, in addition to being a point and click adventure , it has some voice actors from the animated series also inspired by Parsley.

title: Keychain
description: Keychain is a short game made by Ivan Zanotti & fran43 for GMTK Game Jam 2019. In Keychain your survival depends on how you use the keys you find.

title: Pokemon Garbage Gold
description: To begin, Garbage Gold is a trashmon hack, meaning the player will only be able to obtain and use weak Pokemon. In most cases, these Pokemon will be less than 425 BST (combined base stat total). There are some exceptions, but this is the general rule. A wide variety of encounters are available, and are significantly different from vanilla Heart Gold. Evolution levels are changed, and some Pokemon wont evolve at all if the evolutions are too good.

title: Hunter Moonstrike
description: Hunter Moonstrike is the first survival game integrated with artificial intelligence. In this game, all npc have their own unique story and you can see the story of the game from their point of view. Talk to any person, ask any question you like, they will answer and think they are alive

title: Cessate il Fuoco/Heathcliff
description: A digital simulator of the handheld of the same name.

title: Donkey Kong
description: A simulator of the Game & Watch Multi Screen port of Donkey Kong.

title: Donkey Kong "Special Edition"
description: A second simulator by the same creator for the Game & Watch Multi Screen port of Donkey Kong. This version has additional features.

title: Donkey Kong II
description: A digital simulator based on the Game & Watch Multi Screen handheld under the same name.

title: Tear Ripple
description:
Please see what i can't see. say the word that i can't say
A letter from me to you

title: The Raphael Parable
description:
The Raphael Parable is a community-made modification for The Stanley Parable, being the most popular mod created for the game along with Experiment 427 and the Escape Pod Ending Overwrite Mod.

The Raphael Parable expands the Office to contain several new areas, new visual assets such as furniture, and new Narrator dialogue. Unlike the main game, The Raphael Parable only contains two endings.

title: Matchbox's Pizza Adventure
description: A Short Pixel-Art Platformer Game!

title: Experiment 427
description:
Experiment 427 is a free modification for The Stanley Parable. During development, the modification got abandoned and never got finished. There is a beta version, however.
The mod begins when a player activates the Confusion Ending and clicks on the Confusion Schedule. The player is then teleported out of the map on the opposite side of the Confusion Schedule and begins a new adventure. The mod was also going to customize the game's textures, add new objects, change the main plot, and add new rooms.

title: Raining City: Millions Recollections
description: One night, Luxuan woke up soaked in blood, a mysterious black hole in the palm of her hand – and millions pouring out of that hole, like an unstoppable fountain of wealth. Still in shock, Luxuan has to evade the monsters that rushed to her and her new riches. A strange story begins in a gloomy city…

title: Restore
description: In this RPG, take on the role of Shouichi, who is summoned to another world alongside Azuha and Emily. With your abilities sealed, you'll need to rely on your wits and teamwork to survive. Will you be able to protect your friends and get them back home safely?

title: Currents
description:
Currents is a puzzle game about guiding ships on the open ocean.
Dodge rocks, swing on whirlpools, and outrun pirates, using only ocean currents!
And for added challenge, try to complete each level under par!

title: The Destiny Star of Girlfriend: Episode of Fujiko
description: A mini-episode of Destiny Star Girlfriend for the sub-heroine Yonamine Fujiko.

title: Five Nights with Mac Tonight 2
description:
Ever since the Mac Tonight commercials came in, McDonald's has been swarming with Customers for their new night hourly openings. One McDonald's made so much profit, they decided to step up their advertising and order a set of new animatronics to entertain the customers while they eat! That's where you come in.
The animatronics were recently shipped to a Storage Facility that McDonald's owns that keeps old belongings in there from the past moments. The animatronics are as of now being stored in there until the Staff at the McDonald's get the place set up properly before the Animatronics arrivals.
You're were hired to work in their Warehouse due to word that people have been breaking into the Warehouse, and stealing or even vandalising the property.
These animatronics were spent a fortune on, and McDonald's cannot afford having parts of them stolen or even destroyed. Don't let anyone get in.

title: Destiny 2: Echoes
description: An aurora spreads across the stars, and from within its shimmering confines, a mysterious object materializes and falls to the surface of Nessus. Travel to the planet and begin your search for this object, known only as an Echo.

title: StarCraft: Evolution Complete
description: StarCraft: Evolution Complete is a full remake of StarCraft: Brood War, including the campaigns and all 3 races with all of their units, buildings, abilities, researches, upgrades and art.

title: Ribbit Rampage
description: An arcade-style top-down shooter where your only weapon is your froggy tongue. Eat hoardes of enemy insects in frantic, high-precision fights that demand clever decision-making. Don't get surrounded - it's one hit and you're croaked.

title: Flintlock: The Siege of Dawn - Deluxe Edition
description: The Flintlock: The Siege of Dawn – Deluxe Edition includes the base game and three customization packs for Nor.

title: Lexibble
description: The first release from Finger Games Studio. It's a word game with roguelike mechanics that allow you to improve your letters to score the maximum points.

title: Marvel vs. Capcom: Infinite & Beyond
description: A mod conversion of MVC:I that overhauls the functionality, art, and playstyle of general characters in the game, including the addition of a new 4-player, 2v2 mode where all 4 characters actively fight on-screen at the same time.

title: Sword and Plow
description:
An RPG mixed with a gardening game!

Can a farmer slay an evil dragon?
Grow and eat your food to gain strength
Drag items with the left mouse button.
Use and equip items in your inventory with a right click. Drag seeds onto the farm plot squares to either side of your inventory to grow crops.

title: Trabi Racer
description: On streets in Poland and all of Europe we can still see these cars. With Trabi Racer you can expierience racing with this cultic machine. Characteristic sound of engine, box-shaped view, 5 car versions and tuned supermachines from the beggining of 1980!.

title: Funny Racer
description: Funny Racer is a 3D kart racing game for young audiences. Funny Racer requires time, skills and great agillity, because opponents are really crazy!

title: Love Eternal
description: Wander a castle built of bitter memories in Love Eternal, a psychological horror platformer with devious trials and an unsettling, experimental narrative. Find a way out - or live in Shelter forevermore.

title: Auld Lang Syne: Cat and Mouse
description:
Auld Lang Syne: Cat and Mouse is a visual novel made in RPG Maker VX Ace.

It's a Granblue Fantasy fangame about two Zodiacs of many years in the past.

You don't need to know much about Granblue Fantasy, only that its setting is a world of floating islands with its own fantasy races, and that there's a group of characters inspired on the Chinese Zodiac/the Twelve Divine Generals.

With the exception of the minor NPCs and Dormouse, it's all original characters and story.

title: Pizza Delivery: A Short Thriller
description: A horror/thriller about what may happen when delivering a pizza late at night.

title: Elegy of Fate
description: Embark on a unique RPG journey as a resurrected hero. Obtain the sealed power of a malevolent deity in a ring, evading the pursuit of a goddess. Explore the world, awaken legendary heroes, and shape your destiny with a formidable order of knights. Uncover the long-buried tales of this continent.

title: Multiversus: Season 1 - Puns & Villainy
description: The relaunch of Multiversus comes with a new season. Included are new cometics, maps, and characters such as The Joker, Jason Voorhees, and Banana Guard.

title: Air Garden
description: A tiny cozy idle incremental game where you grow plants and pop bubbles to clean the air.

title: How Would You Survive?
description:
How Would You Survive? is an education program based on the book series of the same name. It covers Egyptians, Aztecs and Vikings. The premise is that it shows children the ropes of the people's lives in those time periods in case the player should become one of them. The program mostly consists of interconnected, narrated slides which contain explanations about the subject in question.

It also contains a quiz. Here the player chooses a difficulty level (which only changes the number of wrong guesses before the game is over) and is presented with 10 multiple-choice questions. The goal is to answer all questions before all wrong guesses are spent. When a wrong answer was chosen, the game creates a link to the appropriate slide. After reading it, the player can switch to the quiz and try again. Normally the quiz covers only one time period except for the masterquiz option which is about all three periods.

title: Street Cleaner 3
description: In this 8 bit retro action platformer sequel, you play as the eponymous Street Cleaner taking back the streets of San Diego from punks, ninjas, and now some weird spooky creatures! You're not alone, though. You can switch at will between the Street Cleaner, whip wielding rival turned ally Cogex, and high-school girl brawler Honoko who each bring their own attacks and abilities.

title: Misericorde Volume Two: White Wool and Snow
description:
Sister Hedwig is having a bad time.

It wasn't long ago that the Mother Superior dragged her out of her cell, forcing Hedwig to break her oath to God as an Anchoress and face the outside world. Acting as a spy for the leader of Linbarrow Abbey, Hedwig was given one seemingly simple task: Discover who really murdered Sister Catherine.

Hedwig has tried her best, but she is no closer to solving the mystery. Things just keep getting more and more complicated: Why can't any of the Sisters give her a straight answer about what happened the night of the murder? Who--or what--is the mysterious figure that haunts the abbey? And just who was Sister Catherine?

In White Wool & Snow, Sister Hedwig must steel herself. Time is running out, and so is sympathy for her situation. It's understandable that being thrust into the waking world after a life of quiet reflection as an anchoress would require some adjustment, but if Hedwig wants to save an innocent man she will have to get serious fast. Can she navigate increasingly difficult social situations, maintain her cover, and make the progress the Superior demands?

title: Fun Fruit Merge
description:
A different take on the highly popular watermelon merging game.

A casual game where the goal is to merge different fruits to get the watermelon, it takes inspiration from the merge 3 puzzle game format and adds it's own twist.

title: Re;Lord 3: The Demon Lord of Groessen and The Final Witch
description:
This is the third and final episode in Escu:de’s Re;Lord series. Following the liberation of Herford and Cologne, Iris was captured by Adler’s Jäger unit. Since she possessed too much sensitive information to fall into enemy hands, including the concealment of his own magic and plans for a rebellion, Wilfried pursued them into Greiz instead of going after the third witch.

Greiz is a middle-sized city in the center of Groesen, and it is home to the capitol. However, there were no trains entering the castle town, and the hustle and bustle of the past was eerily missing. Surprisingly, it was also under the territory of the third witch. He was forced to fight on two fronts, as fate also seemed to conspire against him. Wilfried’s final battle has begun.

title: Squaretrail: Lines of The Frame
description: Squaretrail: Lines of The Frame is a puzzle and adventure game where you progress by rotating square-shaped worlds. Your main character is a cube and you have to overcome different challenges in each level.

title: Overwatch 2: Season 11 - Super Mega Ultrawatch
description: Gear up for an epic showdown as Ultrawatch faces mythic Calamity Empress Ashe, celebrate 100 million heroes with the return of Pink Mercy discover ancient mystique and modern technology in the new Runasapi map, and more!

title: Silly.tiff
description: The official sequel to Sunky.MPEG!

title: Basketball FRVR
description:
Basketball FRVR is a simple and easy to learn, yet amazingly fun Basketball hoop shooting game. Play for as long as you can and get bonus points by not hitting the rim.

Practice your Basketball hoop shooting skills.

The game has no time limit, but the moving basket is a challenge for event experienced players.

If you like a simple basketball challenge, this is the game for you!

title: Unbirth
description: Unbirth is the first 3D game from Frictional Games.

title: The Grass of Genesis
description: This third-person action-adventure seems to be akin to the beloved Tomb Raider series and the adrenaline-packed John Wick film franchise. The gameplay video showcases a prototype that introduces various gameplay elements and engaging animated cinematic sequences.

title: Frog Fall
description: Eskweenkleh Brahvoh, I made you to escape this labyrinthine prison. Forget their gravity; you bring your own. Embrace confusion; leap over the impossible, roll on, and, kohn ehl fahbohr dehdyohs, bounce high enough to charm the world’s corpse.

title: A Place in the Sun
description: A Place In The Sun is a short point & click adventure game with an interface similar to the classical games from Lucas Arts. You play the protagonist in his endeavour to make some coffee to survive yet another night of overworking, while trying to handle his complaining ex-wife as well as to cope with his bad conscience regarding his neglected daughter. For players familiar with adventure games it shouldn't take more than 30-45 minutes to complete the game, while for players unfamiliar with the genre it will probably take a bit longer.

title: Yield! Fall of Rome
description: Forge your Kingdom amidst the Ruins of Rome! As the world crumbles, rebuild civilization and shape your destiny with every decision. Unleash your strategic prowess, conquer provinces, and explore dynamically generated campaigns that promise endless challenges!

title: Chicky Woggy
description: A digital simulator of the handheld game Chicky Woggy.

title: Crazy Chewy
description: A simulator of the handheld game of the same name.

title: Miro and the Flower of Youth
description:
Miro is a single-player, 2.5D action RPG where you embark on a heartwarming journey of exploration, platforming, and rebuilding. Take control of Miro, a mutant with a big heart, and set out to restore your hometown and surrounding areas after a nuclear fallout caused by his creator, Vitto.

Explore vibrant yet desolate environments teeming with secrets and hidden areas waiting to be discovered. The game rewards curiosity and exploration, offering extra challenge and replayability for those who seek it.

Dive into turn-based combat that allows you to strategize your moves and abilities. Action commands during battles add an interactive element, increasing engagement and rewarding skillful timing. Unique partners with diverse abilities join you on your journey, offering strategic options in both combat and exploration.

A richly crafted narrative unfolds as you explore the world, uncovering its mysteries and meeting unforgettable characters. The game’s lighthearted atmosphere and humorous tone create a fun and memorable experience.

Intuitive controls and easy-to-understand mechanics make the game welcoming to players of all skill levels. Playful and whimsical art style with a focus on creating a cheerful and inviting atmosphere.

title: Exit16: Byilhan Hotel
description:
"Exit16: Byilhan Hotel" is a "walking simulator" & "Spot the Difference" game. The game challenges players to unravel hidden anomalies strewn across the enigmatic corridor of the Byilhan Hotel.

Each floor of the hotel presents a unique canvas, with some adorned by the peculiarities of anomalies while others maintain an eerie semblance of normalcy. Your task is to discern the subtle nuances that distinguish the ordinary from the extraordinary, as every object, every angle, and every shadow holds a potential clue.
Traverse the hallways with caution, for not all anomalies reveal themselves readily.

If you suspect there is an anomaly, turn back. If you believe everything is normal, that there are no anomalies, do not turn back and continue down the corridor. If you make a mistake, you will know by looking at the level number. If the number has increased, you have made the correct choice. If you return to level 1, you have made a mistake and will need to start over (the anomalies will be different). The goal is to reach the final level.

Navigate the twists and turns of the Byilhan Hotel, unraveling its mysteries one anomaly at a time.

Explore, solve puzzles, and uncover lost memories while evading sinister plushie robots. Use weapons, set traps, and find hideouts to survive and reveal the truth

title: Joyville 2
description: Joyville 2 is a first-person horror-puzzle adventure game set in an abandoned children's camp. You will explore the camp and encounter its magical inhabitants. By solving puzzles and overcoming challenges, you will travel between two parallel worlds, uncovering the secrets of this enigmatic...

title: Swampify
description: A top-down puzzle game where you place hexagon tiles to build a river and restore a swamp ecosystem

title: Shovel Knight: Dig - Fate and Fortune
description: The Fate and Fortune update is packed with even more adventure, including a brand new challenging quest called Knightmare Mode, sweet mementos to unlock and show off in the HUB, and tons of quality of life improvements to make your journey even smoother. We can't wait for you to dive back into Shovel Knight's epic journey and experience this expansive and FREE addition to the game.

title: Shovel Knight: Dig - Wicked Wishes
description: Be careful what you wish for as you climb the ranks at Hoofman's Adventurer's Guild, where a plethora of quests and mysteries await! Discover new Relics, mini-games, Accessories, secrets, and crucial gameplay enhancements, too! We can't wait for you to dive back into Shovel Knight's epic journey and experience this expansive and FREE addition to the game.

title: Shovel Knight: Shovel of Hope DX
description: Shovel Knight: Shovel of Hope DX is an enhanced edition of the pixel-perfect adventure. Jump, battle foes, and dig up treasure as you quest to defeat the Order of No Quarter and The Enchantress. DX adds 20 playable characters, online multiplayer, and new features like rewind and save states.

title: Lust for Lucre
description: Lust For Lucre is a fantasy-themed match-3 dating sim combining strip monster battles and dungeon exploration. Romance 14 unique damsels and explore perilous dungeons. Use your lust and lucre to upgrade stats and acquire powerful items in this adult adventure.

title: Sword Phantom
description: A high speed stylish Action Game about 2 girls in the future world! Use your gun, sword, and fist to finish the enemy and save the world! The game also contains many equips and underwears to dress up your character.

title: Home: Mother
description: The "HOME" series is a miniature word game based on different native family backgrounds. Explore each room, collect information clues through solving puzzles and finding objects, and infer and restore the protagonist's secrets and life story.

title: Cybercum 2069
description: CYBERCUM 2069 - is an erotic game in the genre of "Arkanoid", in which you will have to break the cubes and gradually discover really beautiful and hot images.

title: Super Sized Rescue Squad
description: Super sized Rescue Squad is a high energy 2D Platformer where you run, jump, and try to rescue as many little civilians as possible. All while fighting an evil cult hell bent on world domination.

title: DragonMirrored with Hyoga & Magma
description: The two dragons, the main characters, move symmetrically during the puzzle as if they are mirror images of each other. Over 300 puzzles appear in the game. As the game progresses, various gimmicks appear one after another.

title: Girls of The Tower: Journey To Chaos
description: In "Girls of The Tower: Journey To Chaos" ,players can choose a character to embark on the adventure of chaos. In battles, players can use original monsters as minions to fight, and equipped items will gain more powerful abilities through enchantment.

title: SOVL: Ratkin Clans
description: This is a Faction Pack for SOVL - Fantasy Warfare. It adds the Ratkin Clans faction to the game.

title: Not an Aim Trainer
description: A young girl escapes into new realities through video games and her art, adventuring through different aim training scenarios; she aims to be the best.

title: Holy Grain
description: Holy Grain is an absurd and hilarious roguelike, packed with tons of events, crazy battles, and one simple goal: blindly follow the counselor's orders. Your army's gonna have your back as you smash through those objectives, and the entity will always be there to protect you.

title: Granblue Fantasy: Relink - Emote Expansion Set: I Work Out
description: This pack includes new emotes for characters to use. • Push-ups • Sit-ups • Squats

title: Dungeon Full Dive: True Supporter Dice
description: This special pack features uniquely designed digital dice, crafted exclusively for our most dedicated supporters. Ideal for collectors and enthusiasts looking to add a touch of exclusivity to their gameplay.

title: A House 4 Alesa
description:
Rpg Maker horror about a social worker trapped in a house of horrors.
4th game in the series (excluding the remake) and direct sequel to A House for Alesa 3

title: Rocket League: Season 15
description:
Rocket League gets a punk rock makeover for the “SoCal” Season 15! Swerve into Salty Fest and start breaking conventions.

Put your hands, horns, and cars in the air and make some noise for the launch of Rocket League Season 15! This Season sounds off on June 5.
⁠
⁠In Season 15, hit the ground spinning on a grassier new variant of Salty Shores. Just take it easy on the donuts as you tear up the field with Rocket League’s newest sports cars!

title: BeatRider
description: Mioi and the others, as apprentice Tuners, embarked on a six-month investigation in Baixiang City. As their mission progressed, the city's normalcy began to unravel, with dissonance and disturbances growing increasingly frequent and severe.

title: Monsterburg
description: What's better than a quintuple bloody burger, or nuggets and fries fried in human fat? You wanna taste? You bet. Just don't forget to wear diapers. If you can eat everything on our menu and make it to the toilet, our monsters are sure to scare the hell out of you !

title: Devil Cult Party
description:
Bring about the doom of mankind, and watch out for competitors!

Human sacrifices, studying the occult, selling merch, bringing back the dead and transforming cultists into demonic abominations is all part of the business. Get to work, the world won't end itself!

title: Wyrm Climb
description: a silly foddian where you control 2 ends of the same wyrm

title: Dontrel Dolphin
description: May Dolphin is in trouble, and Dontrel must save her. Travel across treacherous landscapes as you fight and dodge your way to victory. Use Cannon Caliber, the magical sword, to aid Dontrel during his quest.

title: Blocked-Out!
description: Conceptualized during the development of Hamtex, this is a community project focused on Block-Outs for Classic Doom.

title: Doomium II
description: A sequel to DOOMIUM I, this is a megawad worth of maps that are Short, Straight Forward, and with Frantic Action, from industrial compounds, concrete cities, mountain ranges, fragments of realities, and many more! The megawad contain 6 episodes of 5 maps each with the addition of a secret for each episode, each episode have it's unique theme, including industry, brutalism, and natures, and the classic void levels for the finale episode.

title: Jiffy Bag
description: Jiffy Bag is a collection of 32 random maps made by Jimmy over the last 5 years or so. The maps all vary quite dramatically in theme, and are similar only in terms of size and design - given the short time Jimmy had to make these in, his general approach to mapping is pretty obvious in how each map plays and is structured, but this should hopefully contribute to a well-rounded, consistent end product.

title: Morituri Te Salutant
description: It's time to test your mettle in a Grecco-Roman-ish single adventure map, Morituri Te Salutant! Doomguy has found himself summoned to an ancient, crumbling villa - the court of the Red Emperor. The Emperor is conspicuously absent, but he and his cronies watch with great interest from afar as you rip and tear your way through his tests. Will you make it through the trials, or will you be split from nose to navel? Play and find out.

title: Otherworldly Ossuary
description:
Don't give up skeleton! Fight your way out of space purgatory.
You are already dead, but everything here wants you 7 feet under.

Otherworldly Ossuary﻿ is a small MBF21 single map with cramped puzzle-like combat.

title: Revenge of the Speeddemons!
description: REVENGE of the Speeddemons is the eighteenth Pineapple Under the Sea Speedmapping series event. Featuring 7 maps, each from a unique author, ROTS promises to throw the player headfirst into an action movie of their own starring. Fit snugly into the lead role as you blast your way through hundreds of demons mercenaries across an occupied Earth. The Rowdy Rudy resource pack replaces nearly all of the monster bestiary as well as the majority of the weapons.

title: Crystal Cliffs
description: This is a medium to hard difficulty single map mixing up puzzles and small scale slaughter

title: We Live Inside A Dream
description:
We are like the dreamer who dreams, and then lives inside the dream...but who is the dreamer?

We Live Inside a Dream is a first person interactive experience combining elements of the FPS, horror, puzzle, driving and stealth genres. Experience the uncanny town of Snoqualmie: The Hotel, Double R Diner, The Sheriffs Department, The Convenience Store, The Red Room and much more.

Uncover the mystery of the missing Deputy and answer the question of...who is the dreamer?...but be cautious as the road may not even lead you there...

title: Plants vs. Zombies: Garden Warfare - Zomboss Down
description: Zomboss Down features a brand new Gardens & Graveyards map "Cactus Canyon," where Zombies have crash landed in the desert and need to fight their way to a local golf course and destroy a secret Plant facility located under the 18th hole. 8 new characters have also been added as well as hundreds of new CRAAAZY customization items to collect! In addition, this pack also contains hundreds of tuning/balance changes, and bug fixes.

title: Lost Chakras
description: A physics-based puzzle game made for all ages.

title: Project Walker
description: Attempt to escape the maze while being hunted by the Walkers.

title: Reverse Snake Extreme
description: Classic game of snake but with a twist. Control the food and try not to get eaten or touch the lava. Survive for four minutes and win or die trying.

title: Wild Eclipse
description: Help Pieto traverse dangerous terrain and avoid the natural disasters thrown at him.

title: Bunker Game
