description: A short, post-apocalypse, story-driven point-and-click game about companionship and legacy.

title: Oyasumii
description: Relive the nostalgia with Oyasumii, a horror and exploration game inspired by PSX and N64 classics. Enter liminal spaces and face surreal terrors in an adventure that challenges your skills and sanity. Are you ready to relive the golden age of video games with Oyasumii?

title: Sonic Nexus
description: Sonic Nexus was a game created by Nexus Team, headed by Slingerland. The game used the Retro Sonic engine by The Taxman who joined the project in 2008. The game began development in the summer of 2006 and had three demo releases, two at the Sonic Amateur Games Expo and one during the summer of 2008. It is a critically acclaimed fangame, garnering comments such as, "absolute perfection of the classic Sonic style" from SAGE visitors and various blogs. The character lineup consisted of Sonic, Tails, and Knuckles.

title: Murderlings
description: Control a murder of crows and hunt prey before you starve to death. A finished version of its game jam prototype for IndieCade's Community Jam 2015. The theme was cooperation.

title: Loser Simulator
description: The game "Loser Simulator" invites players to plunge into the life of an ordinary person named Bari, for whom everything goes awry. We have to help him overcome a series of failures and ridiculous situations in one day.

title: Otome Sekai no Arukikata
description: Set in a near-future Japan after its society became completely dominated by women due to the rampancy of radical feminists and the country introducing the "Gender Segregation Act" decades ago, you are Katagiri Yui, originally a child soldier in the defense forces who eventually got to hid in a remote village under a fake identity, who is ordered by Mother, an social management AI, to attend the training school of the Security Force, a women's armed forces with your adoptive sister.

title: Dontrel Dolphin 2
description: Mr. Grim has stolen 60 power gems from the palace, and he also captured a lovely dolphin by the name of May. Dontrel arrives at the palace to recover the gems throughout the realm in an epic quest to save his girlfriend. Here is where the action starts.

title: Rectangulong
description: A silly game about hitting a ball back and forth. Play against a friend or a computer in 12 levels awesome style.

title: Britney Spears' Theme Park
description: A fan game for the pop icon of the century

title: ZDog Hotel Hero Z
description: ZDog Hotel Hero Z is a game where a dog must fight in a hotel to collect as many bones as possible within a minute

title: Subject:Love
description:
Love. A feeling coveted by writers and detested by those who live by logic.

A natural sensation that arises at the most unexpected moment to bring out the best in you.

But what happens when someone who has never felt it before tries to understand it? How far can this person go?

A heartless witch and six confused boys join this journey for an answer.

Now. Will they find love, or will another feel awake inside them?

title: Wonder Ball
description: An action 3D platformer with fast-paced gameplay and low-poly style graphics, inspired by the greatest classics of the genre. Full of platforming levels, combat arenas, many collectibles and secrets. Explore five worlds of Cyberland and save them from the malicious Virus and its army of bots!

title: TomHanksFrThMmrs
description: A Point-and-Click starring Tom Hanks. Made for Hanks Jam.

title: 12 Vengeful Ghosts
description:
12 Vengeful Ghosts is Touhou Project meets 12 Angry Men.

This game is a narrative bullet hell very loosely inspired by the aforementioned film. You play as one of twelve ghosts responsible for deciding the fate of a mortal, but those other ghosts aren't nearly as forgiving as you.

title: Aoki Shinjuku
description:
Shinjuku, 2017. Sharp rise in temperature resulted in flood of huge territories.
Deck runs an "information store" and gets a request to investigate a "NOKIA" program. At the same time a big package is delivered that turns out to be a girl who awakens from Cold Sleep and remembers only Shinjuku of 20th century prior to the huge flood...

title: Myror i Brallan
description: Myror i Brallan [Ants in the Pants] is a Swedish children's game based on the children's TV programme of the same name. The game was published in 2001 by Young Genious.

title: Naisu Gaisu Survivors
description:
Try out this small and charming take on the survivors genre

Fight hordes of enemies and level up to try to beat the final boss.

Every level up you have the choice between:

Getting stronger and choosing from a variety of different power-ups
Adding to your fina lscore multiplier

Balance your strength with your score multiplier to try to gain the highest score possible.

Choose between 5 different starting characters characters and 3 levels.
More characters are there to be unlocked!

title: The Caldecott Caper
description: The lowest form of life in the Sixth World is that of the corporate rent-a-cop. You are paid a paltry wage for the privilege of defending the megacorps' ostentatious wealth from the desperate gangers of the Orkland Sprawl. Enter a world of turmoil, greed, and violence, as you struggle for survival with the help of a few hand-picked allies.

title: Golden Axe
description:
Progress is made through the game by fighting through Death Adder's henchmen, including men armed with clubs and maces, skeleton warriors, and knights. Players are able to attack using their weapon, jump and cast spells that hurt all enemies on the screen. The force of this magic depends on the number of "bars" of magic power currently available. The bars are filled by collecting blue 'magic potions' attained by kicking little sprites who then drop the potions. These sprites appear during regular levels and during bonus stages in between levels. The male warrior Ax is able to cast earth spells. The dwarf Gilius, casts lightning spells and the female warrior Tyris casts fire magic. Each character has a different number of maximum magic bars and varying ranges of attack.

Various steeds known as bizarrians are found in the game. These can be ridden when the enemy rider is knocked off, or if one is found dormant. The least powerful steed is known as the Cockatrice, which can be used to knock down enemies with a swipe of its tail. The more powerful dragon, which can either shoot fireballs or breathe fire, is found later in the game.

title: LXD: Red Honey
description: A strange machine appeared in the sky, breaking down much of the plant life across the region into their core elements, including your humble garden. Collect and harness the power of these fragments in order to rebuild your world piece by piece. Explore 6 unique areas in order to find and defeat the evil that sought your world's destruction.

title: Dolls' Domain
description: You find yourself in a dollhouse - can you escape, or will you meet your fate? Navigate through the escape room-style puzzles, and avoid being caught by the creatures who exist in this place, and gain your freedom from the dollhouse!

title: Guess the Flag!
description:
Embark on a global journey with the game “Guess the Flag!”

Test your knowledge of 255 countries, islands and international organizations in 6 addictive modes. Test your memory by matching the flag to the name of a country or play the reverse mode. If you are already an expert in flag knowledge, you can try the mode in which you have to write the name of the country yourself. Feel the thrill of matching locations to a country and, for a change, immerse yourself in the unpredictable random mode that combines all the challenges.

title: Itazura Madness
description: Itazura Madness is an first-person cartoony roguelike with 4 playable characters, 7 bosses, 100+ items and 60+ weapons

title: Basic Platformer
description: A platformer with puzzle elements made for the Vircon32 virtual console.

title: BFDI: Branches
description: BFDI: Branches is an all-new platformer game with Firey, Leafy, Coiny, and Pin! Featuring multiple characters with varied gameplay, a story mode with branching paths, a complete level editor, and an online level browser!

title: Run Forrest Run
description: A side-scrolling Puzzle 'n' Run made for the Hanks Jam

title: Nonogram Animals
description: Use your logic to paint beautiful images in this relaxing puzzle. The gorgeous visuals and relaxing soundtrack will help you forget all your problems and have a great time!

title: Drifto: Infinite Touge
description: No campaign, no cutscenes, just beautifully simple scenery and a whole lot of tyre smoke. How far can you get?

title: Died
description: Survive amidst colleagues turned into monsters due to a virus leak in this horror game. Explore the 10-floor underground lab to uncover the secrets.

title: Dice Player One: Trailer
description: "Dice Player One" is a roguelike strategy game where dice reign supreme! Roll your dice, seize pivotal moments, and transform limited chances into boundless opportunities. Conquer challenges, unearth hidden secrets, and master the art of dice manipulation!

title: GameLib
description: GameLib is an application that brings together several 3D multiplayer mini-games, such as Werewolves Online, Ludo, Connect 4 (4 in a row). GameLib features an in-app voice chat function, so you can communicate with other players during the game.

title: For Whom the Stars Shine
description: "Some stories are best told to none," she whispered. Long ago, the stars disappeared. Then, a man returned them. Few would believe such a thing; fewer still can recall how he bent heaven's ear. However, you won't find the tale in books or archives—only in the hearts of those who were there.

title: Pennon and Battle
description: "Pennon and Battle" is a turn-based strategy war game. As a lord, you will play a crucial role in the revival of the kingdom! Lead heroes and armies to expand territory in Ruachland, utilize tactics and magic to eliminate enemy forces, and create your own legend!

title: Project: Cube
description: Project: Cube is an asymmetrical 1vAll action party game set in a simulation world. If you are the Survivor, your goal is to survive the time. If you are a killer, your goal is to kill everyone within the time.

title: Flying Tobacco Eggs
description: Welcome to the exciting world of Flying Tobacco Eggs, an exciting arcade game with pixel graphics and addictive gameplay!

title: MoonMan Adventures
description: Lunar was on a routine mission when something went wrong. He crashed on a hostile planet and must now find a way home.

title: Call Me Hero
description: Players will transform into the male protagonist Lin Feng, meet three beautiful women with vastly different appearances and personalities, and embark on an exciting love journey with them, becoming their heroes in the process.

title: Getting There
description: Getting There is a narrative adventure game telling the story of the world after what is only known as The Collision. After the death of her lover Kirsten, Lauren gets in her van and journeys across the strange and quiet world in search of civilisation.

title: Jaro Adventures
description: Jaro adventures is a 2d action/adventure platformer. You play as a character Jaro and through levels try to defeat enemies that get in your way. Try to collect as many coins as those will buy you character upgrades.

title: Two Doors
description: Immerse yourself in a gripping horror game where you repeatedly enter the same room. Spot subtle changes and choose the correct door to advance. With 3 difficulty levels, this game offers a thrilling challenge for every player. Will you survive the nightmare?

title: Nowhere Near
description: Do you believe in ghosts? As a skeptical video blogger, you will travel to France to one of the most cursed places - the abandoned Lagarde psychiatric hospital. Will you be able to capture something. or someone.

title: Resonating Worlds
description: Resonating Worlds is a Turn-based strategy game, with a lot of Character customization and progression. Mysterious towers have appeared in the world of Atuhm. These towers are a connection between worlds. But the towers bear a dark secret, that waits to be uncovered...

title: Tour de Drone
description: Tour de Drone - Race Your drone around A.I. enhanced 3D photorealistic holographic paintings of locations from around the world.

title: Brick Breaker Infinity
description: Break bricks, collect power-ups, endless levels for high scores. Test your skills, adaptability, and strategy. Addictive and fun! Let's play!

title: Z-Factor
description: Story-driven RPG with survival elements. Open seamless world, first person view. Adventures on an island where intelligent life has been destroyed by a zombie virus.

title: Rogue Defense
description: The first of its kind, a Tower Defense Roguelike. Unlock, build, upgrade, expand, and defend with a continuously expanding path from multiple directions which you can influence.

title: Cute Dogs Slide
description: Cute Dogs Slide is a fun game where you rearrange tiles to complete adorable dog pictures. Perfect for puzzle enthusiasts, it challenges your skills and offers a delightful experience with each cute dog image you solve. Ideal for all ages!

title: Garden Paradise
description: "Garden Paradise" is a casual and relaxing game that you can freely design your ideal garden by dragging and placing various units. The game offers a wide variety of unit types and you combine these elements to create unique garden layouts.

title: Solridge
description: Solridge is an educational video game aligned with third-grade Common Core competencies. As the player, you will obtain gold by helping the townsfolk with their problems. If you want to save the village from disaster, you must continue gathering gold and growing stronger!

title: Parse-O-Rhythm
description: Parse-O-Rhythm is a rhythm game about slashing errors in files to fix them. Slice and dice your way through files with nothing but the mouse and two buttons!

title: Rust Rivalry
description: A futuristic sci-fi first person shooter where combatants fight for the fate of their home.

title: Persnippety
description: Never lose a clipboard snippet again. Easily copy, paste, and sync text and images from your clipboard.

title: Abrakajumpa
description: Jump your way to the top!

title: Future Swashbuckler
description: This is a swordplay game in which you fight well for five days to get a good evaluation from your employer. You fight by switching between controlling two characters.

title: Nakamers: La Huida
description: Escapa del colapso de una civilización que está a punto de extinguirse. Acompaña a Xioon en busca de su familia perdida mientras intentas ponerte a salvo de los desprendimientos y sorteando los ríos de lava. Sumérgete en una historia épica llena de emociones.

title: Codename: God
description: Randall is your typical nerdy kid living a normal, unexciting life in the 80s. Secretly in love with the most popular girl in school and bullied by the soccer team gang, one day he meets you, a divine entity who can change everything!

title: Ima Survivor
description: IMA SURVIVOR - Shipwrecked on a remote island, You have to try to survive on Your own.

title: Shadow of Pharos
description: Shadow of Pharos is a short first-person horror game.

title: Troma Presents Poultrygeist
description: Crack the case of a chicken massacre and prevent a town of lawn mower lovers and suburban chicken farmers from destroying each other while managing a looming magical threat.

title: Confidential Mission
description: Join the fight and make your mark in the battle for global peace in Confidential Mission.

title: SOF: Enemy from the future
description: Lead the SOF squad and defend the world against alien invasion! Engage in thrilling turn-based battles and uncover the mysteries of enigmatic extraterrestrials. Your time has come – join the fight and safeguard our future!

title: Starlines
description: Explore the galaxy along with a beautiful girl and imbibed incredible feeling from the exciting brain of your gameplay.

title: Dead for Dread
description: Dead for Dread is an exciting game in which you take on the role of a brave hero who goes into the dark labyrinths to retrieve a stolen artifact. Embark on a dangerous journey through mysterious dungeons full of mysteries and sinister creatures.

title: Mechieval
description: The twilight of the plague-ravaged Middle Ages. Pilot a five-story-high mech, unleashing torrents of ammunition, dancing with magic, and hunting the demons spreading pestilence in this frenzied top-down shooter.

title: Figure Adventure
description: "Figure Adventure" is a trendy game with the theme of hand-made figures, which integrates card cultivation and placement and hang-up gameplay!

title: Meow Path
description: A puzzle game in which you have to figure out how to draw a path across the entire board. To lead the cat to its favorite toy

title: Little Herbal Baker
description: Little Herbal Baker is a cozy and laid-back game where you play as Lilia, a novice baker who has freshly arrived in a town called ‘MILKYWOOD’ in the fantastical world. Taking over a bakery formerly managed by a master baker, you are now embarking on your journey to become a master baker.

title: Widen
description:
WIDEN is a psychological horror experience focused on atmosphere, exploration, and story-driven puzzles.
Navigate the city's empty streets, live through past distorted memories, and survive against creatures that feed on fear.

title: Holy Light
description: It is a popular elimination game with its dazzling color matching and extremely smooth visual expression.

title: Project Juggler
description: FPS/Task Management Action Game

title: Tehnodrom
description: "Tehnodrom" offers exciting gameplay, a variety of enemies and weapons, and the ability to make strategic decisions that affect the course of the game. The game is intended for fans of casual games in the 2D platform style who love challenges and want to test themselves as a brave tehnodrom pilot.

title: Crimson Capes
description: Crimson Capes is a soulslike Action-RPG taking place in a Sword & Sorcery setting. Engage in fluid 2D pixel art swordplay, hunt witches, track monsters and experience the age of high adventure.

title: Roll Five
description: Roll Five is the dice game roguelike. Play this exciting deckbuilder where you compose creative dice figures, discover your favorite prisms, all in a pixel art medieval fantasy ambiance.

title: Where wh..?
description: "Where wh..?" ("何处") is a point and click puzzle game based on Lowpoly art style, you need to find the different and hidden resources in the screen, travel through nine worlds, explore the unknown areas, various gameplay, melodious music, suitable for all people to get started easily.

title: Hunt Me
description: HUNT ME is a co-op horror survival game for 1-4 players. Gather the ingredients for the ritual, weaken the threat and banish it. Be careful, you're also the prey!

title: Cat Memories - Find the Hidden Stories
description: Explore a surreal handcrafted world in Hidden Kitties Memories. Find lost souls of kitties and help them remember their favorite moments with their humans. Each discovery transforms the kitty and reveals its touching memory. Immerse yourself in this unique hidden object adventure.

title: Alien Strike: Blasting the Intruders
description: The earth has been invaded by aliens, and even though they are still in training, a group of soldiers are trying to save their city while trying to understand why it happened so quickly.

title: ZombCube
description: ZombCube is a first-person, cross-platform, zombie survival, wave based game. Play solo or with friends all over the world destroying the evil ZombCube's. Use teamwork, leadership, and skills to be the best and rank on the leaderboards.

title: Times Tables Games
description: Get ready to multiply the fun with Times Tables Games!

title: Rolldown
description: Race against your friends in this fast paced and exciting game. The goal is simple: be the first ball to roll down to the bottom of the hill.

title: Rubber Sharks
description: Plunge into the tranquil existence of the sweet poolside life with the amazing company of peaceful Rubber Sharks. This adventure invites you to revel in the bliss of your cherished poolside sanctuary. But could there be a mystery hidden in this peaceful scene, or even more?

title: Escape From Castle Frankenstein
description: Escape from Castle Frankenstein is a thrilling platformer game where you play as Frankenstein's monster, a creation desperate to flee the dark halls of Dr. Frankenstein's ominous castle. Will you outsmart Dr. Frankenstein and gain your freedom, or will you be trapped within these walls forever?

title: AneeMate
description:
AneeMate is a PvPvE creature extraction shooter where survival means more than just staying alive—you must rescue, evolve, and fight for the future of the AneeMates. Built in Unreal Engine 5, this high-intensity adventure blends exploration, combat, and AI-driven strategy, creating a dynamic and unpredictable battleground.

Explore, Catch, Level Up—Decide the Fate of AneeMates

title: Gunnel Vision
description:
Gunnel Vision was made in 3 days for the Blockjam on Humble Bundle and was developed by Ludosity. It is now available for free on itch.io and is featured in Scrap Pack 4 on Daniel Remar's website.

Gunnel Vision is all about guns. The more guns the better.
Pick up a gun - shoot a gun. Pick up two guns, shot with two guns. Pick up 100 guns - MAYHEM! In Gunnel Vision you don't need an inventory - use your entire arsenal at once until your vision is blocked by it - with nothing left to see but the enemy dead center.

title: Once a Porn a Time: Porn and Cards
description: Porn and Cards is an adult visual novel/turn-based card game with stunning 2D visuals and a fun, immersive narration in the Galactic Wild West

title: The Isles of the Seven Moons
description: The Isles of the Seven Moons is a First-Person Ritual Sacrifice Adventure where you explore a surreal and relaxing environment while completing an ancient ritual in order to meet the Moon-Sage.

title: Fanastasis
description: A spirit attempts to find its memories.

title: Argus
description: Medieval fantasy game about religion and philosophy, featuring yuri and ossan bromance.

title: Vitris
description: A tetris-clone style puzzle game for the Vircon32.

title: Fierce Soldier
description: A side-scrolling shooter for the Vircon32.

title: 100 Waiting Cats
description: Join the cutest adventure in the funny waiting situations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artworks of While Waiting themed locations as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. ️ Can you find them all? ️

title: Simple Tennis
description: A Pong clone for Vircon32.

title: 100 Aztec Cats
description: Join the cutest adventure in the Azcte-themed with Cats in Ancient World! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of Ancient themed locations as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game.

title: Stray Cats in Cozy Town
description: Welcome to Cozy Town, where every day is International Cat Day! Be a part of a village community where every stray is respected, loved and fed. Explore the charming streets and alleys to discover all the stray cats in this hidden-object game.

title: Click on piña coladas together
description: Can you and your friends find all 100+ piña coladas in this panoramic level?

title: Click On Staplers Together
description:
Can you and your friends find all 100+ staplers in this panoramic level?

Search an incredibly detailed hand-drawn environment for staplers. When you find one, click it to mark it as yours. The game is won once everything has been found, and a scoreboard will be displayed showing who found what. No time limit, just you and your friends. Singleplayer is available too!

title: Search All: Veggies
description: This is a game in the "search for objects" genre in which you need to find all the vegetables in a large location. Vegetables will be located in a variety of places, from the most visible to barely noticeable places

title: Jet Set Radio: MiniMix
description: A year in the making, it's finally here. Jet Set Radio MiniMix v1.0

title: Department of Collections
description: A tasked based fully procedural online co-op sci-fi horror game that can be played both casually or more hardcore. Descend further into the facility using the elevator to discover truths about the facility while avoiding hazards and threats and completing tasks for the Department.

title: Habbo Hotel: Origins
description: Habbo Hotel: Origins is a restored version of the 2005 version of Habbo Hotel with a fresh, community-led approach.

title: Cyber Citizen Shockman Zero
description: Experience the revival of a retro but timeless co-op action classic

title: Rise & Fall: Online Digital Edition
description: Risse & Fall is a game involving strategic units positioning, territory control and opportunity seizing designed by Christophe Boelinger (Dungeon Twister, Earth Reborn, Archipelago, Living Planet...). Each player leads a nation trying to expand and progress in a fantasy world.

title: The Croaker: The Ice
description: An Ice-Themed Expansion Pack with tons of new levels!

title: Star: M
description: Diverse worlds, diverse battlefields, diverse gameplay, diverse appreciation, and diverse fun!

title: Queen of The Hill
description: You are a Queen Ant who has taken her colony's survival into her own hands. Fight off hoards of enemies while also being a good mother Hatch swarms of (questionably intelligent) children to gather food for the nest Aid your swarm as it grows up big and strong

title: Cyberpunk Inquisitor
description: The world's first rogue-lite point-and-click adventure! As an Inquisitor in a dystopian cyberpunk world, enter a Megabuilding and solve the immersive, procedurally-generated murders within. Talk to witnesses, collect evidence, identify the culprit and unmask the truth!

title: Skylark 64
description: A 64-bit 3D Collect-a-thon Platformer where you play as A flying squirrel who can glide, run, jump and roll in open non-linear levels collecting Acorns, Soul Leaves and 7 pieces of armor with unique power-ups! You can even play with a friend in Split-Screen Co-op!

title: Project Evolve
description: Take control of Azula in this action-packed beat-em-up adventure game, where you will recover your abilities as you progress through the simulation. Use close combat attacks and powerful electrical strikes to defeat your enemies and reach the end!

title: The Hardest Game in the Universe: DLC 3
description: The DLC 3 for "The Hardest Game in the Universe" has arrived, bringing an extra dose of difficulty and challenging new enemies. Get ready to tackle complex environments, new traps, and a variety of cunning adversaries.

title: OMSI 2: Add-on Zürich Tram Linie 11
description: Having a tram as a vehicle in OMSI 2, now you have the opportunity to drive through the mere center of Zurich and enjoy the classical, intact and divine architecture of this unique worldwide famous city.

title: Train Simulator: EA-692
description: A Romanian rail icon arrives from developer Train Motion.

title: Train Simulator: Payerbach - Wien Hbf Route Add-On
description: Explore the east side of Austria from Wien (Vienna) to Payerbach with this Train Simulator route from RSSLO.

title: Train Simulator: ÖBB 4748
description: Take control of this modern electric multiple unit from RSSLO, as you drive across the Austrian / Italian border.

title: Hamlet in a Pond
description: Hamlet in a Pond is a unique looking relaxed city builder. Live out your creativity and build your own little slice of paradise in a tiny pond - with no pressure like goals to reach and no stress from juggling resources.

title: Duck Creator 2
description: Duck Creator 2, Create your own Duck but better version!

title: Genso Manège
description: Follow Emma as she fights to reawaken her magical powers in order to aid a unique cast of characters, all of whom are trapped inside a travelling amusement park. Having lost memories from youth, Emma must rediscover her past through love and friendship in this stunning dream-like fantasy otome.

title: Free Stars: Children of Infinity
description: Experience a stellar space adventure and the sequel to The Ur-Quan Masters. Travel through hyperspace, engage in fast-paced combat, discover weird worlds, and meet a unique cast of truly alien aliens as you uncover a mystery that threatens the galaxy.

title: _Turing
description: "_turing" is a new sci-fi adventure game that allows the player to chat with the heroine during the story and teach her feelings to the AI heroine, thereby changing her personality and the outcome of the story. What will happen to you and Iris after you learn about her feelings?

title: One of Them
description: One of Them is a Social Deduction sci-fi horror game. Up to 12 players are playing either as a Human Astronaut trying to escape, or as a disguised Alien Beast out to kill everyone.

title: Sinderfury
description: From a team of two developers, an INDIE co-op action RPG for 1 - 4 players. Warning: This ARPG has very little hand holding, and is designed for more hardcore players looking for a challenge. The systems are in depth, the bosses are brutal, and the demons are unrelenting.

title: Uphill
description: A precision platformer that allows you to alter the environment.

title: Ragdoll Mayhem Maker
description: I love ragdolls and I love physics, so I thought I would mush the two together with a level editor and make a cool sandbox game for people to play around in. Currently, there is a very basic JSON-based level editor and 20 pre-built levels.

title: Whiskers Wonderland
description: Whiskers Wonderland: a game where your pops sent you to find something that was lost in a restaurant, but be warned, Mr Whiskers doesn't like trespassers and you unfortunately are one, so he's after you... You do remember another robot named Dr Mouser. Ready to find what happend to him?

title: Finch & Archie
description: An episodic co-op murder mystery in which you play as one half of a crime-fighting duo: Jack Finch the detective or Archie the police dog! Use your skills to find evidence, interrogate suspects, and catch the culprit in a gritty 1930s setting.

title: Peter's Journey
description: Embark on a journey of this text anime quest with RPG elements! Walk through beautiful locations, overcome challenges and make Peter’s dreams come true. Every step you take matters. And don’t forget to take the diary - you’ll need it!

title: Project Werewolf
description: Enter a world full of mystical dangers in the merciless northern Sweden. Uncover the dark secrets of the werewolves as you fight for survival in a relentless open world. Will you solve the puzzle of the beasts and conquer them?

title: Trainz Plus: BR Diesel Brake Tenders
description: This pack contains 3 types of British Railways (BR) brake tenders, 2 prototypes and 1 main production variant, which includes 3 different types of bogies, with 3 different period liveries in clean and weathered versions.

title: Trainz Plus: Model Trainz - Freemont Mills
description: Model Trainz: Freemont Mills is inspired from the Jan. 2024 issue of Model Railroader by Steven Otte. While small, there are plenty of operations that can be performed which can turn into a challenge.

title: Trainz Plus: Pro Train - Sequoia Valley
description: Climbing through the steep Sequoia Valley, this route set in the Badgers Pass county connects Fox City and Elk River to Wilmington and finally Sequoia Falls. This route includes 4 new sessions, and CP AC4400CW and SD40-2 locomotives, and UP SD40-2 locomotives.

title: Trainz Plus: Milton Valley Railroad
description: The Milton Valley Railroad (MVR) is a fictional railroad based in North Carolina, its reach extending at the height of its power all the way north to Canada and south to Georgia. The MVR as represented in this route is currently in the 1960s transitional era, featuring both diesel and steam locos.

title: Trainz 2019: Pro Train - Sequoia Valley
description: Climbing through the steep Sequoia Valley, this route set in the Badgers Pass county connects Fox City and Elk River to Wilmington and finally Sequoia Falls. This route includes 4 new sessions, and CP AC4400CW and SD40-2 locomotives, and UP SD40-2 locomotives.

title: Trainz 2019: Model Trainz - Freemont Mills
description: Model Trainz: Freemont Mills is inspired from the Jan. 2024 issue of Model Railroader by Steven Otte. While small, there are plenty of operations that can be performed which can turn into a challenge.

title: Trainz 2019: BR Diesel Brake Tenders
description: This pack contains 3 types of British Railways (BR) brake tenders, 2 prototypes and 1 main production variant, which includes 3 different types of bogies, with 3 different period liveries in clean and weathered versions.

title: Trainz 2022: Model Trainz - Freemont Mills
description: Model Trainz: Freemont Mills is inspired from the Jan. 2024 issue of Model Railroader by Steven Otte. While small, there are plenty of operations that can be performed which can turn into a challenge.

title: Trainz 2022: Pro Train - Sequoia Valley
description: Climbing through the steep Sequoia Valley, this route set in the Badgers Pass county connects Fox City and Elk River to Wilmington and finally Sequoia Falls. This route includes 4 new sessions, and CP AC4400CW and SD40-2 locomotives, and UP SD40-2 locomotives.

title: Trainz 2022: Milton Valley Railroad
description: The Milton Valley Railroad (MVR) is a fictional railroad based in North Carolina, its reach extending at the height of its power all the way north to Canada and south to Georgia. The MVR as represented in this route is currently in the 1960s transitional era, featuring both diesel and steam locos.

title: A Tale of a Legacy
description:
Dery Marlon, a young vagabond who has just settled in a camp on the outskirts of the city of Zippar, receives a misterious letter in which an unknown man gives him a considerable part of his inheritance.

In order to collect the inheritance, he will have to travel far and wide across the Kingdom of Arval, traversing many villages and regions of the kingdom. This adventure will lead him to discover who the mysterious Feyer Golesh is and the motives behind leaving him the riches.

Love, betrayal, mystery, tension and entertainment blend together in this adventure that will delight the fans of classic graphic adventures.

title: Kart Heros Ultra
description: A micro Racing game, spanning accross multiple levels. Players can race AI with multiplayer and local support coming soon.

title: Fiesta Animal
description: Fiesta Animal is a party multiplayer game 5v5 online. Play with friends and your family! cooperation and friendship are your best tools to victory. Run, jump, swimming and laugh as much as you want!

title: The White Canvas
description: The White Canvas is the story of Nico Sales, a very ironic painter without inspiration and with a lot of personal problems. Midas, the most important patron in the world has arrived at his city. Nico needs to find him and convince him to take care of his artistic career. This won't be very easy for Nico because feels depressed and anxious due to his lack of inspiration. Moreover, Midas it's very evasive and discret. Will Nico be able to find Midas and convince him? Try to help him and you will find out a lot of interesting things about the charismatic painter Nico Sales. -- Thanks to David Silva for his help.

title: Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous - A Dance of Masks
description: A Dance of Masks is the sixth and final premium DLC for Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous in Season Pass 2, one last love letter to the Knight Commander and their loyal companions

title: Fairy Tail 2
description: The sequel to the 2020 "FAIRY TAIL" console game has finally arrived! Play as Fairy Tail guild members such as protagonists Natsu or Lucy, and experience first-hand how the dramatic events unfold in the series' climactic Alvarez Empire Arc. Enjoy epic battles against Zeref, the Emperor of the Alvarez Empire, his team of elites, the Spriggan 12, and the Black Dragon Acnologia.

title: Fantasian Neo Dimension
description:
The father of Final Fantasy, Hironobu Sakaguchi, and renowned composer Nobuo Uematsu return to deliver an original RPG story. Experience an enhanced version of FANTASIAN, initially released for Apple Arcade in 2021, with brand-new features, including English and Japanese voiceovers and an additional difficulty option.

In FANTASIAN Neo Dimension, assume the role of Leo as he journeys to recover his memories and solve the mystery of a strange mechanical infection destroying his world.

Experience an original and modern take on the beloved turn-based battle system, with a wealth of unique mechanics and strategic combat that shake up the classic RPG formula, and explore a multi-dimensional universe come to life, set against the backdrop of over 150 charming hand-crafted dioramas.

title: Mio: Memories in Orbit
description: MIO: Memories in Orbit is a 2.5D side-scrolling metroidvania platformer. Players control a robot named Mio who explores a vast spaceship called the Vessel, gaining new abilities such as wall climbing, dodging, grappling, and gliding while fighting machines that have gone rogue. Combat emphasizes aerial fighting, and players can equip modifiers that adjust their abilities at the cost of modifier slots. Currency called Nacre is used to purchase upgrades and is lost on death, and fast-travel devices serve as save points across the ship.

title: Looney Tunes: Wacky World of Sports
description:
Compete against friends and family with the Looney Tunes squad in basketball, soccer, golf and tennis.

Play your way solo or in four-player local co-op and choose the characters that best suit your play style.

Avoid wacky obstacles and gain power-ups to incite chaos as you control your favorite Looney Tunes all-stars!

title: Metal Slug: Attack - Reloaded
description: Metal Slug Attack Reloaded is a remaster of the original Metal Slug Attack. Build the strongest team you can and crush enemy bases with a variety of strategies and hundreds of characters.

title: Phantom Brave: The Lost Hero
description: Join Marona and her Phantom friends on a mission to defeat the sinister Shipwreck Fleet! Recruit Phantoms, bind them to objects, combine them with Gadgets, and even merge them with Marona herself in this Play-It-Your-Way RPG.

title: Marvel vs. Capcom Fighting Collection: Arcade Classics
description:
Marvel vs. Capcom Fighting Collection: Arcade Classics is a 2024 fighting game compilation developed and published by Capcom.

It includes Marvel Super Heroes (1995), Marvel vs. Capcom: Clash of Super Heroes (1998), and Marvel vs. Capcom 2: New Age of Heroes (2000), marking the first time these titles became available on new platforms since the seventh generation of video game consoles, as well as the first faithful console port of the beat 'em up title The Punisher (1993) and the first new console versions for X-Men: Children of the Atom (1994), X-Men vs. Street Fighter (1996), and Marvel Super Heroes vs. Street Fighter (1997) since their initial console releases.

title: Ace Attorney Investigations Collection
description: EUREKA! Miles Edgeworth moves beyond the courtroom and straight to the crime scene in Ace Attorney Investigations Collection with revamped graphics, new language options, bonus features, and more! Featuring two remastered titles - Ace Attorney Investigations: Miles Edgeworth and the Western debut of Ace Attorney Investigations 2: Prosecutor's Gambit - it's a perfect package.

title: The Hundred Line: Last Defense Academy
description: A new adventure from the creators of the Danganronpa and Zero Escape series! 15 students are tasked with defending a school from grotesque monsters for 100 days. Can they make it to the end? And will they survive long enough to uncover the truth?

title: Romancing SaGa 2: Revenge of the Seven
description:
Romancing SaGa 2: Revenge of the Seven is a full remake of the groundbreaking non-linear RPG Romancing SaGa 2, which originally launched in Japan in 1993.

Embark on an adventure featuring both new and classic SaGa franchise features, complete with Japanese and English voiceovers, original and rearranged compositions, and much more! This is an ideal entry point for new players and provides an amped-up experience for longtime fans.

title: Disney Illusion Island: Mystery in Monoth
description: Curious clues are popping up across Monoth, and Dash Dolphin needs your help to find them. Locate clues, close cases, and solve this brand-new detective mystery.

title: La Salamanca
description: "La Salamanca" is an inmersive first-person psychological horror experience, a story-driven game where you traverse different sections, solve puzzles, and survive the horrors lurking in the shadows of a twisted apartment complex. Inspired by an Argentine local urban legend.

title: Q2Jump
description: Jump is a mod for Quake II where instead of plain deathmatch and killing, the idea is to jump around various jump maps in the fastest possible time. There are all sorts of different jumps you need to pull off, from double and triple jumps to circle and ladder jumps. Quake II's equivalent of DeFRaG.

title: Dad
description: "DAD" is a horror game with a bizarre style and story. Inspired by horror and suspense films from the 80s and 90s. With PS1 style graphics.

title: Pillow Fight
description: A short, free deckbuilding game where you count sheep in order to defeat different "enemies" of sleep and learn some real sleep tips along the way!

title: Mourning Tide
description: Mourning Tide is a first-person fishing horror game. A guilt-ridden fisherman ventures into unknown waters. Each catch reveals haunting reminders of his past sins. Unravel the mystery and seek redemption, or be consumed by the mourning tide...

title: Threewave Capture
description: Threewave Capture is a modification for Quake made by Dave 'Zoid' Kirsch. CTF introduced a couple of things in addition to goal orientated teamplay: runes and a grapple hook. A version of it is included in Quake Remastered.

title: Solar Dominion
description: Its Sentries versus Serpents in this multiplayer shooting adventure. Team up or compete against one another to earn rewards.

title: Threewave
description: Threewave is a remake of the namesake mod for Quake III Arena, featuring other gamemodes like Rune Free-for-All and Capture-Strike. Much of its content was later added to Quake Live.

title: Helbreath Argentina
description:
Helbreath is a dark medieval MMORPG featuring intense PvP, strategic alliances, and a trade-centric economy. Choose between two warring factions and immerse yourself in epic battles and quests in a vast fantasy world.

Helbreath es un MMORPG medieval oscuro que presenta un intenso PvP, alianzas estratégicas y una economía centrada en el comercio. Elige entre dos facciones en guerra y sumérgete en batallas y misiones épicas en un vasto mundo de fantasía.

title: Project Astrid
description: Shroud announces Project Astrid: The new Open-World Survival Shooter game he’s been working on alongside Sacriel and Splash Damage to bring forth a new era of gaming. Splash Damage has over 20 years’ experience working on some of the biggest IPs in the world; Halo, Gears of War, Doom & more. Combined with my expertise in the FPS Industry - I believe we will create something truly special.

title: Dontrel Dolphin 3
description: The evil wizard Bretinado has captured the Trellings of Trelland. He also wants the mysterious gems of virtue to give him enough power to destroy the realm. Only Dontrel Dolphin has the ability to stop the villain. Help the dolphin knight in his next exciting adventure!

title: Loki's Minions Capture the Flag
description: LMCTF was released a day after the Quake II SDK was released and soon became very popular. Its defining feature, compared to the later official remake of Threewave, was the use of an off-hand grappling hook, which allowed the player to fly through the air while still being able to fire their weapon.

title: Tupi: The Legend of Arariboia
description: Tupi: The Legend of Arariboia is a turn-based roguelite role-playing game based on the story of the Indigenous hero Araribóia and the set of myths that make up South American native mythology as a whole.

title: Kamaitachi no Yoru x3
description: ​Kamaitachi no Yoru x3 is a collection commemorating the 30th anniversary of the renowned sound novel series "Kamaitachi no Yoru." This compilation includes the main stories of "Kamaitachi no Yoru," "Kamaitachi no Yoru 2," and the series' third and final installment, "Kamaitachi no Yoru x3." Even newcomers can fully enjoy the series, as the relationships between characters and past incidents are thoroughly explored. ​

title: Natsu-Mon: 20th Century Summer Kid: Broadcast Over Sunset
description: This is paid downloadable content for Natsu-Mon: 20th Century Summer Kid, featuring a brand new area to explore and new events to experience.

title: Purple: Director's Cut
description:
It’s 1996.

You play as Randall Purpura, a 23 year old man who has just been released from a lengthy hospital visit for mysterious reasons. He lives in a small studio apartment in LA California.

He meets Mya, his new neighbor who wants to become quick friends with him.

He also meets Tate, the handsome man down the hall. He never seems to be home when you want him to be.

Explore the city, solve puzzles and try to unlock the mysteries of Randall’s past.

title: Conflict FPS
description: A strategic team-based first-person shooter. Battle it out in this fast-paced multiplayer shooter. Several game modes to choose from and a range of different maps.

title: Those Days
description: Those Days is a casual gay adult visual novel about a guy who decides to spend a few days in his family's farmhouse. There he meets Cott, Salmi, and later on, a few other characters that will make his vacation a bit more interesting.

title: RoboKiden
description: RoboKiden is an innovative team-based action game where five players collaborate to control a single mecha in strategic battles. Integrating Web3 technology and blockchain, the game uses the $KIDEN token for in-game transactions and NFT trading. Players can earn and trade $KIDEN, enhancing gameplay with digital ownership and economic opportunities. Developed by The Breach Studios and powered by Elixir Games, RoboKiden offers a unique gaming experience with vibrant characters and dynamic battles.

title: Deep Rock Galactic: Season 5 - Drilling Deeper
description:
Hello Miners, Welcome to SEASON 05 - DRILLING DEEPER!
Management’s got their sights set on mineral riches deeper down toward Hoxxes’ core, which means we’re increasing your depth of operations. You’re venturing down deeper than ever before, claiming unprecedented treasures for the company, and confronting all the lethal horrors that stand in your way.
In other words, it’s another great day at work.

title: House Builder: Medieval
description:
"House Builder: Medieval" DLC for the game House Builder on Steam allows you to explore medieval construction. Here are the details of the three new houses you can create:

1. Water Mill House: The first mills were built around 1 B.C. They were equipped with a water wheel used to grind cereals and produce flour and grains. At this DLC level, you can move into a medieval mill and become a miller!

2. Blacksmith's House: Blacksmiths were important professionals in the Middle Ages. They made horseshoes for horses and also produced barrels, nails, and other useful tools. With the DLC, you can feel like a medieval blacksmith and build your own house, including a workshop.

3. Windmill House: Windmills, powered by wind, were used to grind grains. They were invented in the ninth century in Eastern Persia and spread to England and the Netherlands. At the DLC level, you'll construct a wooden windmill, which will also serve as your home!

title: Five Laps at Freddy's
description:
Welcome to Five Laps at Freddy's, The premier animatronic kart racing circuit featuring you favorite and lovable Fazbear friends! Sponsored by Fazbear Entertainment

Select one of 12 of your favorite animatronic #FNaF characters and race on sixteen tracks set across 4 cups! Each track is based on your favorite locations from Five Nights at Freddy's lore, including Fazbear Hills, Midnight Motorist and more!

title: The Blue Pendrive
description: This is a fan-made adaptation of a story written by ‪Sinuois‬, called "El Pendrive Azul" or "El USB Azul"

title: Etera
description:
Immerse yourself in a boundless adventure at the heart of 'Etera,' an extraordinary journey through an imaginary world.

Explore scenarios rich in detail and complexity, where the thin line between reality and fantasy dissolves. Navigate through environments so realistic they seem tangible, yet surreal enough to capture your imagination with a unique blend of familiar and unexpected elements.

Every moment will mark the pace of your quest, influencing the plot and direction of your journey. Face challenges in a mutable timeline, where the past and the future intertwine.

Indulge in the luxury of experiencing the magic of never-before-seen worlds, where climatic adversities become either a precious ally or a insidious adversary.

title: YeGung
description: This game is a bow action RPG game, so you can advance without developing your character, and you can easily defeat enemies as you strengthen your character. Features include main quests, daily quests, field hunting grounds, reinforcement, and stores.

title: Beauties! They're All After Me
description: In this thrilling romance game, players are a working-class hero meeting six girls: a loli, a mature woman, a housewife, a soft girl, a domineering CEO, and a cute, naive girl. As he gets involved with them, he awakens a cheating system—can you believe it?! Make your final choice now!

title: Lewd Hentai Puzzle
description: A classic puzzle game to lift your spirits. And five beautiful girls will keep you company!

title: Glen: A Dull Journey into the Unremarkable
description: This is a game for dull people with short attention spans. You can probably clock it in 10-20 minutes! You'll perform tasks like paying your bills, watching some paint drying and reading local council regulations. It's dull and relatable. Should you buy it? Well, up to you, but I appreciate you all.

title: 13F
description: You are a tired office worker who has been working overtime until late at night due to a heavy workload and is trapped in a strange office building. You have to get to the first floor quickly and go home to rest, because you have to go to work tomorrow morning!

title: Cassiculus
description: This terrifying first-person horror experience immerses the player into a world of isolation, fear, paranoia and claustrophobia as you make your way through the Oberon Cave. Throughout the game, you will experience atmospheric environments, disturbing audio and horrifying visuals.

title: Dream City
description: A Metroidvania-like decryption game. Players come to a mysterious building with rich and interesting interactive props. Players need to learn to use these props to overcome difficulties and leave the building

title: Pedro Temple
description: An action arcade platformer!

title: Muksha Space
description: A spiritual yoga game that focuses on self-dialogue and emotional experiences. In the space of meditation, players are encouraged to engage in dialogue with their inner selves, contemplate the meaning of life, and understand the true essence of liberation and redemption.

title: I Commissioned Some Bunnies 9
description: I paid artists to hide bunnies and carrots in 15 artworks. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

title: The Ambush!
description: The Ambush! is an intense and exciting game of strategy and action, where players take on the role of a group of policemen rushing to defend a bank from a group of dangerous thieves.

title: Run Run Boy 2
description: "Run Run Boy 2" is an exciting and adrenaline-fueled game that puts your skills and reflexes to the test.

title: Lens Adventure
description: Lens Adventure is an action puzzle game where you play as Talia, a Magic Academy graduate student. Use the camera's time-space magic to solve puzzles: create platforms by photographing objects and use time magic to undo mistakes. Can you return to the academy before the dorm lights go out?

title: Where Are the Creatures of Mountains and Seas
description: The mythical creatures in the Classic of Mountains and Seas have all escaped. You need to analyze over a thousand characters in 12 Chinese cities, recall over a hundred mythical creatures and races, please embark on an exciting journey.

title: Mazzle
description: Mazzle is a straightforward and surprisingly difficult celebration of the simple beauty of maze and jigsaw puzzles.

title: Wicked Arcana
description: Step into the mystical world of 'Wicked Arcana, where ancient runes unlock powerful magic and hidden truths in this early access demo.

title: Parking Expert 2!
description: Get ready to put your parking prowess to the ultimate test and become the ultimate Parking Expert in this thrilling sequel!

title: Hide and Seek 2
description: Hide and Seek 2 takes the classic game to the next level with new challenges and obstacles.

title: City Rickshaw Transporter
description: "City Rickshaw Transporter" is a fun and exciting game that lets you experience the joy of being a rickshaw driver in a bustling city.

title: Keyboard Tennis
description: Keyboard Tennis, a keyboard-based tennis game, offers both fun and competitive experiences. Players aim to swiftly and accurately return the ball to their opponent using keyboard keys, requiring fast reflexes and precise timing.

title: Quescaper
description: You were thrown into a dungeon with the undead and only a sword was left for defense. Can you get through this underground maze and survive?

title: Steam Spire Chronicles
description: Steam Spire Chronicles is a combo-focused action roguelike set in a fantasy steampunk universe. Fight your way through an ever-changing labyrinth against creatures and automatons alike, picking up unique items that can change how you play!

title: Lovely Traps Dungeon
description: Your quest : Guide a golem through mad dungeons filled with platforms, traps and puzzles. Recover lost madn-- knowledge at all cost (golems are just moulded clay after all)

title: Psychopath Massacre
description: George Dinescu kidnapped you in his home in Romania. Get out alive while utilizing a V.H.S camera to film everything that happens inside. Torture, murder, and dismemberment take place inside the house, exposing the frightening legacy of a serial killer's decade of terror.

title: Pralai Song of The Last Empire
description: Korn Kachakon, a high school student, finds a painting of an ancient emperor at an art gallery. Unfortunately, a guard knocks him unconscious, and his spirit is whisked to the realm of "Pralai," where he's tasked with changing an ancient kingdom's fate.

title: Koi Land
description: "Koi Land" is a highly relaxing idle game. Purchase various types of koi fry, raise them over time, and sell them to earn money! Unlock multiple varieties of koi, listen to soothing music, and enjoy the sight of colorful koi as they accompany you through pleasant times!

title: Teenage Wasteland
description: Teenage Wasteland is a hugely detailed, open world RPG set in the early 2000's! With over a hundred perks, dozens of cliques to help/harass, and hundreds of choices, you can be the teen YOU want to be...

title: Gifted: The Tombs
description: Gifted: The Tombs is a fantasy rogue-like with extraction elements. 1 player local, 1-4 players internet/LAN based multiplayer. Third person melee combat, collect items and gear on each floor to progress lower and lower.

title: Unlighted
description: You will play as a test subject that works for a company called Umbral Alchemy, dedicated to the research of stones with mysterious properties never seen before by humans. Thanks to you they hope to discover the origin of these strange materials, but it won't be an easy path.

title: Eternal Rain
description: Dive down into the ominous world of Eternal Rain, a dark-themed Shoot 'Em Up game that throws you into a relentless onslaught against hordes of nightmarish enemies. Unlock new characters with unqiue powers and survive the everlasting rain.

title: City Find All
description: City find all is an exciting 3D puzzle game for finding objects in a cozy town. There are many objects on the location, there are numerous buildings, benches, signs, and other urban decorations. The player must explore every part of the location to find the necessary items.

title: Morning
description: This is a 2D game. Players operate the mouse, click to explore and obtain props, watch dialogue to advance the plot, and play the role of the protagonist alone in a house late at night, exploring daily and unfamiliar things, and unfolding the truth of her life.

title: Cursedville
description: A party game for 4-10 players. Play as a peasant or werewolf, cooperate with your friends and survive or hunt before all the nights are over.

title: Glow Up 1
description: Glow up the characters for each of the 9 stages, Units are divided into red and blue teams for auto-battle. Click to predict the winning team. If you guess right, you will be able to see the whole of the characters that have been Glow up.

title: I Made Myself a Ship
description: Build progressively bigger, faster, tankier, more agile, more dangerous, more complicated, more projectile-y-ier ships in your goal to destroy and collect everything.

title: Foxy J.A.B.S: Just Another Bubble Shooter
description: Foxy J.A.B.S (Just Another Bubble Shooter) is a simple and relaxing "Match 3 game" for everyone.

title: First Person Stapler
description: Clear targets in your office call center and race to the exit in this ridiculous, stapler-centric target shooter.

title: War Laboratory
description: This is a battle simulation game that uses real maps as combat scenes. The design purpose of this game is to simulate real-life battles in a game like manner, providing military enthusiasts and even military staff with the means to analyze and simulate real-life battles.

title: Rotosaurus Adventure
description: Rotosaurus Adventure is a puzzle game with a twist. Rotate the world to traverse obstacles and find a way into the goal. Manage boxes, avoid spikes, and use other tools in creative ways to overcome mind-twisting challenges!

title: Rogueween
description: Rogueween is a roguelike, bullet hell, top-down arena shooter game where candies grant shooting abilities, treats provide power-ups, tricks offer extra challenges, and you battle waves of Halloween-themed enemies in this action-packed adventure!

title: In Service of the Queen
description: Embark in this paced time and resource management where you coordinate the workers, build and collect resources to perform the task, In Service of the Queen!

title: Startup Quest Bakery
description: Embark on a brief entrepreneurial journey to establish and manage a socially responsible bakery. Obtain permits, prepare the space, choose your equipment, and produce various breads. Aim for profitability while positively impacting society and the environment.

title: My Girlfriends
description: This is a simulated love game, players through dating to enhance intimacy with girls. To upgrade your relationship with a girl.

title: Fix the Robot!
description: With a limited number of levels, every repair task is a testament to your skill and ingenuity.

title: The Real Driver
description: What sets "The Real Driver" apart is its unique requirement: all cars are equipped with a manual gearbox.

title: Feline Survivor
description: Feline Survivor is a rogue-lite game that combines classic Monopoly and Backgammon.You'll travels different planets, defeat countless monsters, and build the perfect map loop and weapon combos in this game of luck and tactics, until you finally find the secret treasure guarded by the monsters.

title: Selenaut Quest
description: A fun and addictive arcade game set in space.

title: Don't Be a Hero
description: This is a story about overcoming challenges and becoming a hero. A total of four trials await you, and you must defeat several powerful enemies in order to pass. Every battle is difficult, you must read the enemy's moves, choose the right aid, and adopt the right strategy to win.

title: Ties: Soul Link
description:
TIES: Soul Link is an Emotional and Brutal 2D Metroidvania, combining Action RPG elements with Adventure Platformer.
An exciting story of resilience and overcoming fears. Explore incredible cities in a world in decline, set in the year 2097, full of secrets and with brutal and bloody gameplay.

title: Chicken with Robot Legs
description: Chicken with Robot legs is a Runner-Vania game where you explore a map and find secrets while constantly moving, your only objective is find a way home. Find upgrades that let you explore further and further while unravel the secrets of this unknown place.

title: Hentai Tales: Backyard 33rd
description: A small town close to the beach. Summer vacation has just begun. While you were enjoying your coffee in this cafe, you fell asleep without realizing it. When you wake up again you find yourself locked in a basement. What will happen there?

title: The Flying Farm
description: Epic Journey to the moon, rescue the Baby Starling! Travel the world and help Barney the farmer to bring back the baby star to his parents in this captivating time management game. This won't be easy, as you'll travel in the sky, in the ocean or on a blazing hot volcano before reaching the Moon!

title: Abuga Warp Zone
description: Play as Abuga through nearly 50 challenging but exciting levels. Warping through and making your way from start to finish. Be careful though, not all warps are there to help you and who knows what other obstacles lay ahead as you progress further. Enjoy your stay at the Warp Zones in StrangePlace!

title: Falling With Ice Phoenix!
description: Falling with Ice Phoenix! combining the classic gravity fall platformer, sprited and high-octane action game, you and the cutie monster girls venture downwards to find the lost orb, facing traps and sexy monster lords ahead, an exciting adventure to the unknown lays ahead...

title: Island, Sex & Survival
description: You began a new life on the mysterious deserted island after drifting there due to a shipwreck, starting from scratch. Building a base, exploring different areas of the island, living alongside various female characters you encounter, and experiencing all sorts of miraculous events.

title: Sweet Office 2
description: Sweet Office 2 - is a simple and beautiful jigsaw puzzle game with relaxing music accompaniment. After completing the level, you can enjoy the girl's photo in the gallery.

title: Brutus Maximus
description: Embark on a hellish road trip around the Roman Empire. From Teutoburg to Rome, slay anything standing in your way, survival roguelite-style. Unlock new heroes, weapons, and skills to create synergies. Wipe out entire Roman legions in this hack-and-slash, stab, and shoot survivors game.

title: There's No Aliens
description: There's absolutely no aliens! We all know they are a myth and nobody ever seen one!

title: Kittens & Coffee
description: Embark on a tycoon adventure in Kittens & Coffee! Manage a cat-filled cafe, attract feline customers, and build a thriving empire. Customize with special cats, unlock upgrades, and explore quirky achievements. It's a whimsical journey where cats and coffee create a purr-fect experience!

title: From The Ground
description: FROM THE GROUND is a third-person PvP shooter. Play as juicy characters and face off yourself on the battlefield in a wacky universe.

title: Mec Me Loffa
description: Choose the right weapon for the right enemy and defeat Mec, the Final Boss...entra?

title: Cascadence
description: Survive and ultimately escape a foreign world using your creativity to assemble defenses with physics-based building.

title: Tamu
description: TAMU Open your eyes to a dark world and confront your deepest fears. TAMU drags you into a terrifying adventure where nightmares reign and reality blurs with dreams. In this mansion filled with horror and uncertainty at every corner, are you ready to fight for survival?

title: Contained
description: Contained is a monster pet simulator in a sci-fi base. Take care of your monster and use its powers to keep the base running. As it grows, you can discover new skills, moods, resources, and rooms. But beware, this monster can be wild!

title: Rogue Tiles
description: Rogue Tiles merges tower defense with roguelike elements, offering a dynamic experience where you shape the expanding path. Unlock, build, upgrade, and defend against waves of enemies.

title: Roller's Escape
description: Roll, flip, and problem-solve your way through this geometric platformer. You play as a cube that can change into a sphere to roll through levels to reach a goal. Overcome obstacles and reach the finish line. Will you rise to the challenge?

title: Project Hover
description: Antigravity racing game with multiplayer and single-player. Each player can either lose his hover or take over the hover of another player in online full loot PvP mode.

title: Case Zero
description: Case 0 is a short horror game where you try to escape a deranged, all consuming beast as it hunts you down.

title: Get More Fries!
description: "I'm a seagull, and I'm not just after your fries, I'm also gonna poop on humans! You guys better watch out!" This is a 3D game with some action elements

title: Bugtopia
description: In Bugtopia, you can purchase and raise insects to create your own eco-box. Sell them for profit or keep them in the eco-box for continuous idle income. Buy more diverse eco-boxes, decorate them, and enjoy a wonderful summer with the insects!

title: Dokoda
description: DOKODA is a hidden-object puzzle game set in 18th-century Japan. Players assume the role of Komaru, a recent recruit at the Museum of World Civilizations. Komaru's mission is to venture back in time to Edo Period Japan and retrieve a variety of artifacts to give mankind a new hope for the future.

title: Ukrainian Fight Drone Simulator
description: "Ukrainian Fight Drone Simulator" is an ultra-realistic combat simulator for future military personnel and FPV enthusiasts. Improve your piloting skills, learn mission planning strategies, and feel the adrenaline of modern combat!

title: To Hell and Back
description: Traverse the landscapes of Heaven and Hell in search of your loved one's lost soul and rescue them from Purgatory.

title: Awaken: Hentai Dice
description: Awaken: Hentai Dice is an exciting adventure for adults. Magic exists among us, but is not available to everyone. Fulfill the prophecy using ancient dice, bring male magic back to our world and don't get caught by the Inquisition.

title: Evil Corporation
description: Evil Corporation is a co-op horror exploration game. Travel through eerie levels, while avoiding creatures and other dangers, trying to get even with the Corporation.

title: The Shadowed Rune
description: 'The Shadowed Rune' is a challenging roguelike game that you can play solo or in two-player co-op. Combine the power of runes to discover new spells and ascend the tower to break the curse.

title: Truck Manager
description: Create and manage your own truck company. Create routes and transport cargo all over the world while you expand your fleet of trucks and logistics centers. Truck Manager is among the most realistic of the simulator genre - so prove yourself and beat your friends and other real life managers.

title: Battle Grid Arena
description: Ready for a stress-free strategy game with a twist? Battle Grid Arena lets you transform heroes into beasts, gather ressources, build a base, and recruit monsters mid-battle. Engage in tactical combat and humorous romantic adventures. It's strategy gaming with a smile!

title: Nora: In Search of Hidden Ingredients
description: Help Nora find the missing items around her house! Try the regular difficulty mode as well as shadows and dark mode.

title: Who Am You?
description: Who am “you”? Who am “you’”? depends on only the selection of “me”. There would be 7 days to find who you are. You may or may not notice the "I" at first during that time.

title: SirKwitz
description: Dive into SirKwitz: a beginner-friendly edutainment game that makes learning programming easy & fun! Explore 28 puzzles across four topics to master the very core concepts behind programming and develop your problem-solving skills. Ideal for those that think coding & programming are scary words!

title: Runi's Math Castle
description: Navigate the Math Castle solving addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and number matching to earn Gold Stars unlocking Characters and Mini-Games: 3 in a row Tic-tac-toe, Memory card match, timed jumping in Spire Run, and Dance Party patterns. Come play again to beat your high score!

title: King of Snatchers
description: King of Snatchers is a story-driven multiplayer snatching game where players will try to complete an investigative quest by an AI. Through this gaming platform, the AI will be able to gather data regarding a catastrophe set to happen in the future. Players will compete to snatch important data.

title: Sleep Stream
description: Sleep Stream is a roguelite survivor game that exquisitely combines the fun factors of roguelite with the tension of survival. Host a bloody livestreaming to fall asleep with synergy combinations and equipment enhancements to match Layla's various personas.

title: Cats Hidden Around the World 2
description: Find 1500 cats hiding in over 15 iconic locations such as Dubai, Rome or Bangkok in this cute hand-drawn hidden object game.

title: Life of a Thug
description: This game throws you into the shoes of a character struggling to survive in a corrupt ghetto overrun by gangs, mafia bosses, and crooked politicians. This is no ordinary RPG; Life of a Thug is designed for players who dare to delve into the heart of darkness and pay the price of their choices.

title: Unkillable Robots
description: UNKILLABLE ROBOTS is an exciting game set in the distant future, where robots have taken over the whole world and are divided into two camps. Some robots strive to restore order and peace, while others crave destruction and chaos.

title: Biblios: Tome of Darkness
description: Biblios: Tome of Darkness is a fast paced first person shooter inspired by the biggest hits of the 1990s and Boomer Shooter revival. Fight a host of unique and challenging enemies, wield a powerful arsenal of weapons, and search high and low for secrets and lore notes to reveal the mysterious motives of the evil Acolytes of Seth.

title: Demon Still Alive
description: Demon still alive is a metroidvania with brutal action – platformer using skilled combat set in the nightmare world of Demons. Explore, upgrade your abilities , unleashed the power of fire and ice and executes the enemies that stands between you and your destiny.

title: Time is Life
description: Explore Islands and the ocean in a Singleplayer or a Coop adventure. Relaxing gameplay, music and hundreds of unique activities to do. Whether you are an Explorer of the unknown, a Farmer that wants to tend to thousand of crops or someone who enjoys combat through boss battles. This game is for you.

title: Dreams of Sand
description: Solve block-based puzzles, manipulate time, wander through Reverie's dreams in the sand - relive and choose how they recount their life's memories just so.

title: Cosmula
description: Engage in an intense space shooter that you can play singleplayer or multiplayer with up to six players. Play a variety of different spaceships, each with their own unique stats, components, and playstyles!

title: Bober Bros: The Hole
description: [Bober Bros] The Hole is a first-person horror game that puts you in the shoes of a paranoid recluse whose life takes a dark turn when a mysterious hole appears in his apartment. Through this ominous hole, anyone—or anything—could be watching him...

title: Pawn Planet: First Sales
description: Manage your own pawn shop in the weird galaxy. Purchase and sell different items, attend auctions, stop thieves and keep the shop going!

title: Ready, Set, Plumb!
description: Ready, Set, Plumb! is a fast-paced puzzle game, where your goal is to place the pipes on the main board to prevent the toxic leak

title: Bulbs 2.0
description:
Combine color mixing and logic for some puzzle-solving fun in Bulbs 2.0, featuring over 100 stimulating levels to solve!

Red plus blue makes purple, blue plus yellow makes green, and white contains every color. In Bulbs 2.0, you’ll combine the satisfying art of color mixing with logic for a truly stimulating puzzle game experience!

Your board is filled with colored bulbs that will reverse their specific share of light on their own cell, along with the surrounding eight. If you “reverse” a red bulb, a neighboring blue one will change to purple. Any nearby purple ones? Those will swap back to blue! Your goal is straightforward, but challenging: Swap the colors until the entire board is white. With a limited number of moves and more than 100 levels of varying size, can you illuminate your way through the game?

title: The Bucketlist Tourist
description: The Bucketlist Tourist is a physics-based multiplayer party game where players complete tasks and capture them photographically. In the battle for the best snapshot, they share only a single camera.

title: Devil's Way
description: A nightmare that starts with hallucinations in a forest where we don't know where... Demons that resemble familiar faces are after us. Is it real or a game of your mind? The game invites you to a challenging journey in the dark.

title: Direction! Level Up!
description: Upgrade your skills by accurately pressing the arrow keys! Monsters are approaching your crystal, and it's up to your speed and reaction time to defend it. Of course, if you have a good sense of rhythm, you'll become even more powerful!

title: Rogue's Realm: The Old God
description: Merged "Rogue-like" and "Auto chess" genres, crafting unique gameplay. Combine abilities from four classes, enjoy dynamics and adrenaline, customize characters. Get ready for surprise-filled battles!

title: Told God: The Legacy of Cthulhu
description: This is a Cthulhu theme survival adventure game. You can play Vincent, the descendant of the survivors in "The call of Cthulhu", and a mysterious woman of unknown identity, in a island in the South Pacific Ocean, experiencing the thrilling adventure that makes human beings become "originer".

title: Janko
description: Explore Janko's a popular restaurant established in the 80's that mysteriously closed down in the 2010's. You will have to run and hide or fight the danger that lies beneath.

title: Trade And Fight
description: Explore, trade with towns and villages, and fight enemies.

title: Magic Cube in Strange World!
description: Welcome to Magic Cube in Strange World! You're a cube, you've got a grappling hook, and your goal is to reach the top of this strange course.

title: Onslaught on the Solar Frontier
description: Take on the enemy onslaught in this top-down cover shooter roguelite.

title: Gunswitch
description: GUNSWITCH is a top-down arena shooter: Mow through hordes of demonic aliens. Upgrade your weapons to fire thousands of bullets within seconds. Escape space prison with your robot squad. Switch your loadout on the spot to adapt and become a killing machine.

title: LivingForest
description: From a first or third person perspective, living this forest.

title: Rum N' Gold Royale
description: Set sail in Rum N’ Gold, a naval Battle Royale action. With tactical combat, ship customization, and a relentless storm, every round is a thrilling adventure. Go solo or form a fleet with your friends and fight to be the last ship sailing!

title: Lost in the Mine
description: Joe has been trapped deep in the mine after an earthquake. Help him navigate the dark tunnels of the mine and face its dangers until he finds the exit.

title: Bored Wife
description: Mrs. Moore, an bored housewife, finds herself trapped in the monotony of her life. She feels the invisible chains of family duties, lost in the routine. Then, unexpectedly, a unique opportunity secretly presents itself to her, offering a chance to change her life.

title: Skelet_666
description: Kitschy vintage GZDoom powered FPS: First Person Slasher. ~Awaken! Slay SKELET_666! Head to Old Arath! Take the Forgotten Sword to the kingdom Old!

title: TRex Hero
description: TRex Hero is a hilarious action game where you must literally run from one side of the screen to the other to save your life, while rescuing future generations of dinosaurs from an asteroid rain. Avoid the funny effects caused by the asteroids, while taking advantage of powerful power-ups.

title: Snake Crossing
description: Classic snake game with modern rules and infinite exciting. Play alone or with friends to fight against AI.

title: Shadow Mansion
description: By playing this product, you will push the limits of fear and go after dark secrets. If you dare, step into this scary adventure and unravel the mansion's dark past!

title: Top Shot
description: A Sci-fi Arcade shooter, fly around the screen space and shoot down enemies, gather minerals and exchange them for skills and ships

title: Legend of Merchant 2
description: Collect simulation management game with no bankruptcy or death. Resources can be obtained through farmland, cooking, or wild collection, and can be directly sold to shops or used to complete residents' commissions to earn money.

title: Next of Kin
description: Next of Kin is an emotional story about Thomas's endeavors to find his lost wife, Martha. Solve puzzles, find clues, and uncover the truth of Martha's disappearance.

title: Candy & Toys Store Simulator
description: Run your own candy and toys store. Place online orders for supplies, receive them via delivery truck, stock shelves, set prices, take payments, expand, and design your store. Hiring staff and dealing with shoplifters are upcoming.

title: Emiko's Pledge 4
description: Emiko's Pledge 4 is a 2D platform action game based on the story of a half-demon girl called Emiko, who wants to become the best warrior of the Ettaze state and abroad, as well as protect the weak.

title: Detective AnnIntae: Missing Basketball Court
description: Solve the disappearance of the basketball court with Detective Ann Intae of JooJoo City!

title: My Femboy Roommate
description: In this choice-based visual novel, you move into a new house with a new roommate who you come to find is a... Femboy!? Now that you are living under the same roof, build your relationship with him to achieve different endings and branching paths, with unique scenes and outcomes.

title: Sunshine In WoozaVille!
