description: Inspired by old internet cartoons, you take on the role of "The New Guy" in 'Sunshine in Woozaville!' You'll hang out with Ian and his buddies, exploring Woozaville's colorful world. Sometimes, you'll be right in the middle of the action, making choices that steer the story.

title: Amber Alert
description: Step into the shoes of a policeman in "Amber Alert," a survival horror game. Responding to a late-night call, you find a sinister cult of women abductors. Your mission: rescue a captive girl. Navigate perilous streets, evade cult members, and survive.

title: Star Patrol Nova
description: Star Patrol Nova is a sci-fi narrative driven deckbuilder inspired by science fiction anime of the late 70's and early 80's. Take control of a team of four Star Rangers as they defend the Free Star Systems from a deadly new enemy.

title: GastroRun
description: Gastro Run is a fast-paced educational adventure game full of obstacles, boss fights, races, withlessons placed throughout the game. You play as Gastro, a witty nano-bot whose goal is to help patients with enzyme deficiency break down food as it travels through the digestive system.

title: Brendon's Water Polo
description: Where we celebrate the action-packed Water Polo sport, hitting a yellow ball back and forth until one player manages to get past their opponent. First to seven points wins!

title: Macie's Magic Melee
description: Macie wants more plushies! Who could say no to their loving daughter? Battle, dash, and shoot through a magical arena to win. Collect items to boost your odds against the arena's enemies and secure a swift victory. Best of luck!

title: A Few Days With: Tiffany
description: Embark on a sensual butterfly-hunting adventure with Tiffany, a charming young woman. In this hidden object game, explore each location to discover what lies beneath Tiffany's enticing layers.

title: Zombots: Invasion
description: Zombots is a fast-paced, wave-based survival FPS where players will have to utilize unique weapons, powerful upgrades, and exciting abilities to fend off hordes of invading robot zombies!

title: No More Humans
description: NO MORE HUMANS is a top-down single player wave based shooter, where you play as one of the unique survivors slaying and surviving waves of nightmarish enemies. Choose and modify your weapons and defeat fearsome bosses across different environments. Will you survive or die with the world?

title: MagnetWorks
description: A puzzle game using magnets. A table puzzle to be solved by using the pulling and repelling forces of magnetism. Place the magnetic pieces and guide them to the goal point.

title: Anomalous Crossing: Shibuya
description: Suddenly, you find yourself standing at an empty ticket gate at Shibuya Station. Exit Shibuya Station, cross the scramble crossing, and head towards Center Street. However, please be careful about any anomalies.

title: Commando
description: Commando is a multi-player third-person shooter with a fun, toony, style; a class and team based dynamic; powerful and varied abilities and equipment; and an array of vehicles. Choose your class, choose your loadout, go to battle and fight for control of objectives to win the war!

title: Bluma
description: Join Bluma in this puzzle-platforming adventure where you make the platforms. It’s up to Bluma and her magical tail to unite the realms by solving physics-based puzzles and farming vegetables.

title: Roshpit Champions 2
description: Roshpit Champions 2 is a distinctive Online Action RPG. Players explore hand-crafted maps filled with omnifarious monsters, powerful bosses, and legendary equipment. Design a personalized combat style and carve out your own unique builds - in hopes of overcoming the will of an Ancient God.

title: The Hustlers
description: Join the league of hustlers, a secret organization of revolutionaries, cheating card players, swordsmen and detectives. A game that mixes classic adventure games with card tricks, duels and investigation in a plot to uncover the truth.

title: Canyons
description: Canyons is a third-person extraction shooter set in a procedurally generated post-apocalyptic world. Fight for your existence in 4 player co-op or solo, control massive Crawlers, build a settlement for survivors, and conquer this savage world!

title: Luminous Threads: A Visual Novel
description: Luminous Threads: a cyberpunk visual novel with captivating graphics and music. You are Juno, a teenage girl getting evidence to clear her brother's name. Choose who helps you solve the mystery. With multiple endings, your actions in flashbacks may even change whodunit, with what and where!

title: Table Flip Simulator
description: Had a stressful day? Blow off some steam in Table Flip Simulator! This physics-based puzzler allows you to unwind as you throw or smash items with hilarious effects. From working as a barista to becoming the President of Antarctica, you can go beyond flipping the table – the world is yours to wreck!

title: Invaders X
description: Crack space ships, Improve your machine, and Get New Lead Pilots to the Resistence, through fantasy "Worlds", and some also known to us across the Solar System. In a 2,5D "Fixed Shooter" based on the old style of the iconic Space Invaders. .. from a time where much less, seemed much more.

title: Bandit Trap
description: Defend your home against a bandit invasion using inventive boobytraps as a Trapper, or join a team of three Bandits and try to get away with the loot! Introducing BANDIT TRAP—a fresh 3vs1, chaotically fun, physics-driven online multiplayer game for the whole family.

title: Trial of Sacrifice
description: A cult, devoted to the dark god, Chernobog, has opened a rift between the mortal world and Chernobog's realm, where he has been imprisoned for centuries. From within the rift, darkness spreads out and threatens to envelope the entire world.

title: Twilight Canyon
description: A free perspective survival pigeon game! Select up to 7 soul stones with different mechanisms to assist in battles, and use skills to cast 5 magic arrays with different functions! And these attacks will also contain elements. You will combine these to form a diverse genre.

title: The Jiang Shi 2: Curse of Soul
description: This is an independent development game based on the Chinese folklore "JiangShi", with a 2.5D horizontal operation perspective as the main focus, and features exploration, decryption, fighting, capture and other game features and gameplay.

title: A Room With a Ghost Girl
description: Terau Mare is a shy girl moves to Tokyo to go to university, and her new house, Hakusan-so, is like an abandoned. As soon as she enters the room, Mare meets a ghost girl, Furuzaki Yuika. Yuika says, "I'm going to kick you out of here soon." But...

title: Plaza Security
description: This game is a bland of 4 line rhythm mechanics and tower defense. You are a plaza security guard trying to defend waves of looters. As you go further you begin to discover some interesting events.

title: Paplion
description: Fight along with your Papling through the worlds inside a mysterious book called Paplion! Explore unique biomas, befriend new Papling and make them stronger through evolution to defeat your enemies in this classic style monster-catcher RPG and 2D platforming adventure.

title: FantasyKingdom
description: FantasyKingdom is an exciting hidden object 3D puzzle game in a fantasy-medieval setting. There are many items on the location, like numerous trading tents, fortress walls, village houses and other medieval decorations. The player must explore every part of the location to find the necessary items.

title: Greedy Goose
description: You play as a brave goose who has decided to embark on an exciting journey. Your goal is to reach the end of the level, collecting as many coins as possible.

title: Sand In a Box
description: Sand in a Box is a 'falling sand' game that simulates thermal flow, electricity, radioactive decay, and gravity. Create art, experiment with physics, and craft your own simulation rules with user-friendly mod support!

title: I Commissioned Some Bunnies 4
description: I paid artists to hide bunnies and carrots in 15 artworks. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

title: I Commissioned Some Bunnies 5
description: I paid artists to hide bunnies and carrots in 15 artworks. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

title: Let's Learn Japanese! Kanji Sudoku
description: Play Sudoku, with kanji! With over 50 levels and 4 different game modes, learn and practice Japanese number kanji at your own pace.

title: The Overseer
description: You are an Overseer on duty. Cycle through the camera feeds looking for anomalies. Upon finding one, report it quickly. Too many anomalies can lead to severe distortions in reality and result in deaths, including yours.

title: Heartbreaker: The Visual Novel
description: A retro-styled psychological-thriller visual novel with dark yuri themes, about an Osakan college student who stalks her love interest and bumps off any rivals who get in the way.

title: PhoboPhobia
description:
Enter the depths of your mind in a 2D Roguelike - Dungeon Crawler game that will challenge your skills.

Immerse yourself in a labyrinthine neural world, where you will face the worst phobias.

Collect resources, items and meet people who will help you on your path to improvement as you unravel the mysteries of your psyche.

title: The Elder Scrolls Online Collection: Gold Road
description:
Pre-purchase now to get immediate access to a new mount and additional rewards at launch.

The Elder Scrolls Online Collection: Gold Road is ideal for adventurers who wish to access all major Chapter zones and quests found across Tamriel. The Collection: Gold Road includes the Gold Road Chapter (available at launch) in addition to the base game AND all previous Chapters (available immediately).

title: The College Brickout
description: Get ready to experience the ultimate gaming adventure with THE COLLEGE BRICKOUT. This game features popular artist Kanye West as the protagonist, where players have to help him navigate through various challenges and obstacles to reach his ultimate goal, with it's new and sealed packaging, this game is a must-have for any video game enthusiast. The game is compatible with PlayBlocks 2 and promises hours of entertainment and fun. So, gear up and get your hands on the most exciting game of the year, THE COLLEGE BRICKOUT!

title: Goat Simulator 3: Multiversal Traveler's Edition
description: This bundle includes the base game of Goat Simulator 3 and the Multiverse of Nonsense DLC.

title: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun - Forges of Corruption Edition
description: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun - Forges of Corruption Edition is the most complete way to experience the ultimate Warhammer 40,000 homage to retro shooters, including the base game and Forges of Corruption DLC.

title: Salvation Hours
description: Salvation Hours is Single player - First Person Shooter, based on the true story of Benghazi 2012 Attack on American Consulate. Play as one of the GRS Operatives in this slow paced and tactical shooter, developed by one-man development studio 'Wolf Wire Studios'.

title: Scrap Age Survivors
description:
Liberate the Rust Wanderers from the evil grasp of the Dominant Hand! Equip up to hundreds of thousands of load out combinations in this fast paced survivors style game!

Aid the Rust Wanderers in their quest for survival and peace in a post-apocalyptic world under the violent control of the Dominant Hand. Take on the role of ORIN and his friends while you take the fight back to your oppressors. Equip a variety of weapons and upgrade your robot as you harvest and collect the valuable scrap from your enemies. Enjoy nearly five hundred thousand possible loadouts for your bot by mixing and combining weapons and valuable quantum gems, creating a unique experience every game.

Venture into the Slaglands across three huge maps, with more on the way, laying waste to hundreds of enemy bots! Gain your independence from the Dominant Hand, just don't become Spare Parts yourself!

title: Crystal Wish: Bits Collection
description: Crystal Wish: Bits Collection is a collection of 6 different minigames featuring the many cute girls of Crystal Wish!

title: Bunny E-shop
description: Experience a hilarious and adorable e-commerce game in a magical world where humans and monsters are at war. Help a humble rabbit fairy expand her online store selling homegrown carrots. Uncover hidden secrets while growing the business and becoming a successful entrepreneur.

title: Synaxarion: Great Martyr Theodore the Tyro
description: Holy Great Martyr Theodore the Tyro (or Theodore the Recruit) lived in the early 300s. This Synaxarion will step through his story as it is known today.

title: Shin Megami Tensei V: Vengeance - Safety Difficulty
description: Adds the "Safety" difficulty option, suggested for beginners or those who want to enjoy the story. This difficulty is recommended for those who have little experience with RPGs.

title: Moonstone Island: Cozy Comforts DLC
description: It's almost time for the holiday season, and you know what that means: FESTIVE DLC!

title: Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night - Classic II: Dominique's Curse
description: Classic II: Dominique's Curse brings retro-gameplay action to Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night! Featuring a larger map, canon Bloodstained storyline and brand-new gameplay, it's a brand new, old-school adventure. Which ending will you get?

title: Shin Megami Tensei V: Vengeance - DLC All-in-One
description:
The DLC All-in-One bundle set includes the following:
• DLC Content - Mitama Dance of Wealth
• DLC Content - Mitama Dance of EXP
• DLC Content - Mitama Dance of Miracles
• Demon Subquest - Sakura Cinders of the East
• Demon Subquest - Holy Will and Profane Dissent

title: Gimmick! 2
description: Embark on a sparkling journey in this long-awaited sequel to SUNSOFT’s legendary 8-bit platformer Gimmick! Solve puzzles, trick enemies, and explore a physics-based playground. Yumetaro is back!

title: Galaxy Flavored Heroes
description: Join our Heroes in this top-down 2D action-adventure game as you shoot your way through baddies then rumble it out with a boss fight. Select any stage and show 'em a fight!! Part of a Complete Breakfast!!

title: Happy Sawland
description: Embark on a journey to reach the far lands of «Happy Sawland». Go forth, the seeker of «Happy Sawland». No hesitation before the many challenges you are to come across! Jump and dodge until the goal is reached!

title: Kiborg: Arena
description: Fight for cash and glory in a prison planet’s Coliseum in this free prologue to KIBORG, the fast-paced action rogue-lite with brutal, cybernetic-enhanced combat.

title: Knyaz' Vladimir
description: Knyaz' Vladimir is an action platformer for Windows based on the cartoon of the same name, developed by PiPE Studio and published by 1C on May 5, 2006.

title: 10 Gnomes 1: The Rooftops
description: For all of You that enjoyed search for secret items in Submachines, or the bird quest in DayMare Town. This is a game created entirely on the idea of finding hidden objects (Gnomes in this case). You have 10 minutes to find 10 Gnomes – navigate via the normal point and click manner.

title: 10 Gnomes 2: Walk In the Park
description: Second episode in the 10 Gnomes series. Once again your task is to find 10 of those pesky gnomes in less than 10 minutes.

title: Divinastros
description: An astronomical gambling game. Fight the Olimpians while each Zodiac sign affects your cards differently in a deeply satisfying deckbuilder game. Fight Greek beasts, discover Tarot Cards and climb the Olimpus searching for revenge.

title: Scorchie Adventures
description: A platformer game in which you play as Scorchie, a friendly and hyperactive will-o'-wisp who's able to pass through a variety of obstacles using their dash ability and fire properties.

title: Escape Simulator: PowerWash DLC
description: Experience a brand new escape room set in the iconic PowerWash garage! Play solo or in co-op, in VR or flat mode. Solve tricky puzzles, clean away grime for clues, and enjoy new 3D editor props with a rocking new soundtrack.

title: Inspector Schmidt: The Ebbing
description: In this detective RPG, you untangle a thick web of intrigues, lies, and secrets that surround a mysterious death. Find the origin of eerie telegraph signals, question the villagers, decipher the strange symbols that are suddenly appearing all over town - and hide from the danger lurking in the moor.

title: Riddle Tower
description:
Will you manage to help Prince Monkid, dear friend?
Climb all levels to finish the game. In the levels you will find fun riddles, math puzzles and complex rebus. Just be patient because some are really hard.

Solve your daily riddle to climb to the top and if you stuck don't worry as if you use some hints you get riddles and answers to help you continue your journey.

title: Bubsy In: The Purrfect Collection
description:
Is Bubsy a celebrated icon from the mascot wars of the early 90s or a platforming punchline? The team at Limited Run has built a new collection to find the answer. Bubsy in: The Purrfect Collection explores the franchise's troubled history and enduring popularity.

Bubsy in: The Purrfect Collection is a playable history that includes games, artifacts and interviews. All of the games have been carefully updated for modern PCs and consoles using Limited Run’s proprietary Carbon Engine. Along the way the team was able to smooth out some of the games’ rough edges.

At the helm of the project is Limited Run’s Audi Sorlie, a producer, author, Bubsy World Heavyweight Champion and arguably the world’s foremost expert on the furry franchise. Together with the team at Limited Run and Atari, he has created the ultimate retrospective celebration of Bubsy, the 3’6” tall 80 pound bobcat (with a pet armadillo named Arnold). What could possibly go wrong?

title: Demons
description: Demons is a co-op horror card game for 1-4 players. An evil cult tries to unleash an ancient demon and all that stands between them and the apocalypse is you, your friends and a deck of cards.

title: Stickers for You
description: This game was created for game streamers. It is nothing but pain. We do not recommend purchasing this game except for distributors. All you have to do is collect 100 stickers hidden in a closed city. But you probably won't be able to complete it alone.

title: Puzzle Kids
description:
Help your old mysterious grandfather to sort through his basement of relics and put together all those puzzles he hasn’t had time to piece together yet!

You better hurry though because time is running out, and you may have to sacrifice something valuable to keep going.

Puzzle kids is a local multiplayer game where you and three others must work together to finish jigsaw puzzles by picking up and placing down pieces.

But the light is slowly going out and you need to burn things to keep it alive.

Complete a majority of the puzzle to proceed to the next one. In levels with multiple puzzles you have to build the correct puzzle in the correct frame.

title: Cart To The End
description: Cart To The End is a First-Person Multiplayer Game where you must ride all the way to the end avoiding different kinds of obstacles and escaping other players which can kill you and make you suffer.

title: Raccooneering
description:
Build. Flail around wildly. Rebuild. Help Björn the raccoon build the ultimate escape vehicle out of garbage.

*Raccooneering* was made in 5 days in Jaunpils Castle for Castle Game Jam 2023.

title: Viva Veloce
description: Viva Veloce is a retro top-down street racing game with everything modernized. Race! Earn money! And be the king of the streets of Rome with your tuned, 4 wheeled, monster.

title: KittyToy
description: Take care of and adopt stray kitties. Buy toys and decorations for your house and yard!

title: Shadow Trick
description: Turn into a shadow and clear all the levels. Shadow Trick is a cute platformer game starring a wizard able to switch between the real world and the shadow realm. Keep an eye on your shadow and don't let your eyes trick you!

title: Secret Cats: Pirates
description: Dive into the enchanting world of "Secret Cats - Pirates" a hidden object game where your mission is to uncover every cat hidden within stunning hand-painted artwork. Let your keen eye and curiosity guide you through this captivating journey.

title: Cock
description: Do you like Cocks and clicking? then this game is just for you! Click to make your cock bigger and earn new cocks every couple hours by playing.

title: Set Yourself on Fire
description: A linear visual novel. ------ A quiet town awaits death. Stagnation is the default state of being. Two aimless young women fall in love.

title: Reimu Needs Help!? Aunn-chan to the Rescue!
description: Reimu Needs Help!? Aunn-chan to the Rescue! is a Touhou Project fan game in which Komainu Aunn helps Hakurei Reimu resolve a series of problems. Players stop slot reels to select an adjective and a noun, combining the two words into an item that may address Reimu’s current request. Each stage requires enough suitable items to be delivered before time expires, while ineffective combinations can reduce Reimu’s satisfaction.

title: New Super Mario Bros. Versus: Doodler's Mayhem
description: A mod for Mario Vs Luigi that adds multiple new stages and characters ft. Green Greens and many others

title: Airplane Tycoon: First Class
description: In 2001, two years after its German release (and three years after the series' inception), Airline Tycoon First Class was the first installment to be released in English by Monte Cristo. As it was the first game in the series to be released in the United States and the United Kingdom, the publisher decided to remove First Class subtitle from the game box and manuals, though it remained in-game. Features added in First Class include ten brand new missions, multiplayer mode with up to 4 players, new MIDI music, cargo transportation and more.

title: Airplane Tycoon: Evolution
description: In 2002, Airline Tycoon Evolution, second Airline Tycoon re-release was published by Monte Cristo. The game introduced ten new missions, possibility of buying self-designed aircraft (and possibility of sharing these planes via Internet), possibility of hiring aircraft security agents, five new sabotages and more.

title: Afterlife: Rickard's Quest
description: A freeware retro action platform adventure game.

title: Peer to Peer
description:
Your choices define who you are. But what if you don't make them consciously?

Peer To Peer is a short first-person social experiment where the player gets to experience situations where they'll have to pick which scenario they want to unfold. There is no traditional win-or-lose situation here, the player leaves with a newfound sense of their own personal behaviour.

title: Fighting Force Collection
description: Who doesn’t love a good brawler? In Fighting Force, you and up two three friends have a simple, four step strategy: break things, get weapons, use those weapons to pummel people, and repeat as needed. It’s straightforward streetside carnage with a 3D flair.

title: Grocery Simulator
description: Experience the thrill of managing your own grocery store, from stocking shelves to handling customers, and transforming a small shop into a thriving supermarket. Control prices, Order goods, Hire Staff, Fight with Thieves and much more.

title: Magic Star
description:
Idol development system, popular social music game! Welcome everyone to Nico's singing and dancing world~

Magic Star is a music game with a lively style using the concept of idols!
Gorgeous costumes, personalized mounts, massive music songs, everything you want is here. Scroll down quickly and let Nico introduce it to you, idols!

title: Sealed
description: Sealed is a horror game that will immerse you in a disturbing and mysterious experience. You will find yourself trapped in a haunted hospital, where every shadow and every whisper will remind you that you are not alone.

title: Storyshift Asriel Battle!
description: Finally your little journey through Snowdin has come to an end. But there's still one obstacle on your way. This adorable fluffy monster means no harm to you, but it's your duty to finish his game with you. Give him what he wants!

title: Pokémon Eclesia
description: Pokémon Ecclesia is a Pokémon fangame created by pingupollas. This game combines humorous elements with a serious main plot and innovative mechanics. It is heavily influenced by OT, as well as the games Fear and Hunger and Bloodborne.

title: Nehonobasa
description:
This is a bullet hell shooter. It might be hard.
Defeat all 4 stages + the final boss.
Shoot bombs with the X key. Shooting a bomb into a bomb
will increase the attack range and wipe out all bullets and enemies on the screen.
Also, if you have at least one bomb
even if you get hit, you won't miss because it will be an auto bomb.

title: ChatTDT: Tower Defense Twitch
description: Dive into the dynamic world of "ChatTDT: Tower Defense Twitch" where your Twitch chat becomes an integral part of the action! Designed to seamlessly integrate with the Twitch API, ChatTDT offers a unique and interactive tower defense experience that engages both streamers and viewers like never before.

title: TC!Underfell
description: Welcome to Underfell, an alternate universe of Undertale where the various monsters in the underground are vicious, where the law Kill or be Killed was firmly established. Never has the monster race been so divided before, gangs, mobs, a once united kingdom has now fallen and erupted into pure chaos. Can you survive the horrors of the underground?

title: Tender Frame Cocoon: //Rhapsody of Cross-Pollination
description:
Deidamia Leonte has crash-landed on a desert planet... alongside the leader of the warring faction's elite cell.

The newest chapter in the long-running TENDER FRAME franchise is here.

title: Great Time Trio Remake
description: The events of the game take place after a temporal paradox caused by the Anomaly/Player, this event causes the judges from the Underfell, Fellswap & Storyfell universe to come together in a single timeline to fight the player together.

title: Desktop Pals
description: Desktop Pals is a simple 2D Game which allows you to share your desktop and interact with a cute cat! Scratch the cat when it is looking for love and hear it purr!

title: Kiwi Game
description: KIWI GAME is a game about kiwis. Two in fact. One to be rescued from the evil farmer who thirsts for the sacred power of kiwis, and the other to explore a metroidvania-lite map by gaining new abilities, braving challenges and outsmarting puzzles in order to find the one she loves.

title: Let's Learn Japanese! Complete Collection
description: A bundle of every game of the Let's Learn Japanese! series.

title: 50 Floors: The Paranormal Investigators Prologue
description:
After a conversation with President of Underwood Corporation, you must urgently go to the studio for the shooting of a new episode of the Paranormal Investigators TV show. Unfortunately, the elevator is broken and you need to go through 50 floors on the stairs, but there are 3 simple rules:

1. If there is no anomaly, go down to the floor below.
2. If there is an anomaly, return to the floor above.
3. The corridor is safe, but if it changes, the rules will change.

50 Floors: The Paranormal Investigators Prologue is inspired by games like The Stanley Parable, PT, The Exit 8, and narrates what happened a couple of hours before the events in the Paranormal Investigators.

title: Risk of Rain 2: Devotion Update
description: Packed with an array of exciting content, this free update addresses various item and map bugs across both the base game and the Survivors of the Void expansion. It also includes a super awesome collaboration…..

title: Slot Waste
description: An episode-length first-person factory simulation. Navigate through a series of 10 unique and weird mini-games. What are you producing and who are you making it for?

title: KiwiFlight
description:
A Kiwi looks upon the sky, with dreams to fly, and one day gets a chance to make its dreams a reality when it gets tossed into a world of forgotten warriors and broken dreams.

KiwiFlight is a 2D, Platformer, Metroidvania game, made with the Unity Engine, taking heavy inspiration from Hollow Knight, Ori and the Blind Forest, and the works of H.P Lovecraft.

Was created from a 2-man team, consisting of myself and a fellow classmate. Created for our Final Year Project in the span of less than 3 months.

title: Omega No Sunshine 2
description:
This game is an arcade-collectathon-exploration game where an unknow being is doing its best to avoid the end of his/her world because of the sun disappearing. Through different places the player have to run and collect sun rings to progress ever further. The game include a story, additional content and a rpg oriented dlc. The base game minimum game time is at least about 16hours.

This video game is born after omega no sunshine 1 (2019) made by the galoxyum studio.

title: Starborn Survivor
description: Starborn Survivor is a sci-fi action roguelite where you control a robotic warrior fighting relentless alien hordes. Navigate, shoot, upgrade, and strive to survive for as long as possible! Tailor your loadout and adapt to the increasing challenges in this thrilling bullet-dodging adventure.

title: Fate/Samurai Remnant: Additional Episode 3 - Record's Fragment: Bailong and the Crimson Demon
description:
Mysteriously disappearing children. Rumors of evil spirits in Yoshiwara.
A strange voice calling out to Miyamoto Iori. A suddenly attacking bird monster.

In the midst of all these strange incidents, Yui Shousetsu appears in the form of a child and declares that if nothing is done, Edo will be destroyed.

With the Spirit Font in turmoil, aspirants of the Waxing Moon join together to face a new anomaly.

Among them is a newly arrived Servant, an unrivaled spear-wielder, Rogue Rider Zhao Yun.
“Feel the sting of Zhao Zilong's spear!”

title: Burden of Truth
description: The Burden of Proof saga continues! Step into the shoes of legendary prosecutor Conrad Cross during a pivotal moment of his journey. Investigate crime scenes, solve mysteries using evidence, and make your case in the courtroom. The burden lies with you to unravel the truth!

title: Kiwi Hop
description:
Embark on an exhilarating adventure with KiwiHop, where you take command of New Zealand's diverse bird species and navigate the challenges of survival in the stunning NZ bush. Explore the unique world of native New Zealand birds while enjoying an educational twist – uncover fascinating facts about these avian wonders after every gaming session. Immerse yourself in both entertainment and learning as you hop through the captivating landscapes of KiwiHop!

KiwiHop is completely ad and micro-transaction free for piece of mind.

title: Kiwi In Arms
description:
The kiwi took the arms !

Use your arms to defeat that mighty eagle !

title: Kiwi Climber
description: Can a kiwi climb a mountain?

title: Blinky Bill's Ghost Cave
description: Blink Bill's Ghost Cave is an interactive story book with some smaller games and activities besides the main story.

title: Capture the Intelligence
description: A relaxing night of Capture the Flag turns into a night of terror for the BLU Spy. Crawl through five levels of familiar Source Engine environments and avoid the twisted RED team as you try to, of course, capture the intelligence. Can you survive? Will you capture the fabled intelligence?

title: Dragon Age II: Ultimate Edition
description: You are Hawke, a refugee seeking to escape the darkspawn-plagued land of Ferelden and become Champion of Kirkwall. Rise to power and fight epic battles while making decisions that determine the course of civilization.

title: Tsurikkuma
description: Tsurikkuma is one of the games that can be played on Nico Nico Live.

title: Off Air
description: Jump, slide, and smash your way through an arena of blood thirsty robots in Off Air. A first person shooter where there are only two rule: Survive and Smile for the camera. Use your wits and speed and dodge around waves of enemies in an ever devolving world of chaos and lead.

title: Dream Gen
description: Build your dreams in this polyrhythm designer. Dream Gen is all about crafting relaxing or chaotic melodies, which can be played out for hours on end.

title: Sloppy Forgeries
description: Sloppy Forgeries is a fast-paced competitive painting game. Practice your skills by butchering iconic masterpieces in one of the few drawing games that measures accuracy pixel-by-pixel in real-time. Choose from 50 meticulously abstracted paintings from art history and get to work!

title: Supermarket Owner Simulator: Business
description: Welcome to Supermarket Owner Simulator: Business, the ultimate supermarket management experience! Step into the shoes of a budding supermarket manager and embark on an exciting journey to build and manage your supermarket empire. Your adventure begins with the opportunity to design and customize your supermarket from the ground up. From choosing the perfect layout to picking the products that will fly off the shelves, every decision you make will shape the success of your store.

title: 11 Years
description: A 3D marine survival game playing as a Clownfish surviving from harmful human activity in coral reefs.

title: Te Amo Mamá
description: Te Amo Mamá is a 2D side scroller that exposes players to the (often underrepresented) experience of motherhood. Become a mother hen who guides and protects her chick as they make their way back to their flock.

title: Oak Beats
description: Music Game

title: 2 American
description: 2 American is a dialogue centered side scroller where you play as Ashley Trinh, a first-gen Asian American, who has trouble communicating to her immigrant parents due to a language and cultural barrier. In this game, we highlight the frustration of having decisions made for you and not knowing how to talk to your parents about it. 2 American serves as a window into some of the hardships a child of immigrants born in America might have to deal with in their immigrant household such as not understanding what your parents are saying when they speak to you, being compared to your more successful cousin, and arguing about what career you must have in the future.

title: Zombie Survival
description: The zombie apocalypse has arrived and you will have to keep everyone alive. Discover the terrifying story of these 4 characters.

title: Illuminate
description: Illuminate is an immersive 2D platformer where one plays as a lightbulb who must endure a journey through the streets of the Mission District. Throughout the game the lightbulb is following his family's trail, who have disappeared from Mission District due to displacement.

title: Radikal Fighters
description:
Radikal Fighters is an exciting action game with vibrant, cartoonish visuals, that offers two thrilling game modes:

Battle Royale: Dive into a chaotic free-for-all where only the last fighter standing wins. Explore the vibrant streets of Radikal City, filled with surprises and hazards. Use your unique perks, weapons, and gear to outsmart and outfight other players in fast-paced, intense battles.

Paint Rush: Engage in an exhilarating team-based mode where three teams compete to dominate the arena by coloring as many dots as possible in their team's colors. Collaborate with your teammates, strategize to cover the most ground, and thwart your opponents' efforts in this fast-paced, color-splattered frenzy.

Get ready to jump into the action and prove your skills in the absurd world of Radikal Fighters!

title: Nightshift Galaxy
description: Play as a freelance mecha-pilot in a satirical anime-scifi setting. Arcade-style combat with transforming-robots, spider-tanks, and high-speed fighter-jets.

title: Crockpot
description: Discussion.

title: Polynya
description: Polynya is an atmospheric quiet walking simulator about taking a walk around a frozen lake with your little kid on a sled. Leave your trace in the deep snow or just lay down and stare into the sky. Maybe something or somebody can be found there behind the snow covered pines. Maybe something awaits in the dark water.

title: Teeth of Glass
description:
It begins with one cut.

You play as Doctor Joshua Hagstrom, as he finds himself trapped in an otherworldly fever dream. Just who is the mysterious patient? How can Dr Hagstrom escape? And will he live to see his family again?

Teeth of Glass is a short point & click horror fever dream, with two different endings.

title: Warframe: Jade Shadows
description: Jade Shadows contains significant spoilers for Warframe! To ensure that all Tenno enjoy the best possible experience, we ask that you allow others to complete the Quest at their own pace, and to please be kind. If you’d like to discuss the Quest after playing (and we certainly expect that you will), please use spoiler tags so everyone can experience it as intended. Thanks, Tenno.

title: Potion Quest
description:
A puzzle game where the player must complete recipes by knocking potions into the recipe area as they drop from above.

You have limited time so must act fast and get the recipes completed.

title: Smaze
description: An NES style fan demake of the hit sony exclusive sci-fi FPS Haze.

title: Where Kiwis
description: Search for 100 Kiwis. A carefully hand drawn scene filled with cute characters. The process is short and won't take up too much player time. You can choose your favorite dyeing for the convenience of color blind players. Extremely easy to achieve.

title: Where Foxes
description: Search for 100 foxs. A carefully hand drawn scene filled with cute characters. The process is short and won't take up too much player time. You can choose your favorite dyeing for the convenience of color blind players. Extremely easy to achieve.

title: Where Birds
description: Search for 100 birds. A carefully hand drawn scene filled with cute characters. The process is short and won't take up too much player time. You can choose your favorite dyeing for the convenience of color blind players. Extremely easy to achieve.

title: Where Ghost Cats
description: Search for 100 Ghost Cats. A carefully hand drawn scene filled with cute characters. The process is short and won't take up too much player time. You can choose your favorite dyeing for the convenience of color blind players. Extremely easy to achieve.

title: Super Bafo Championship
description: On the street in your neighborhood, the biggest Bafo competition in history is taking place. Face powerful opponents in turn-based combat and collect all the cards to be known as the Grand Champion of Bafo.

title: Dogfights in SLZ
description: Smear the skies with pieces of alien spaceships in Dogfights in SLZ, an arcade shoot'em up with a challenging and addictive aerial combat game.

title: One Step to Rest
description: Cross an unknown nation to escape a devastated and scarce place, seeking a land full of resources to bring rest and prosperity to its people, who bet their very lives on your journey. Defeat monsters trying to stop you in a hack'n slash, procedurally generated game!

title: Zilado!
description: Join a friend and travel through the state of Maranhão by train preventing it from stopping because of its broken wagons by solving small puzzles on this co-op platformer game

title: Brotes
description: A kiwi and his brother who is a little plant live their adventures and stuff. You meet nice people, very nice people and people who are a little sassy but who are nice all the same. You hit the A to roll which is super funny. You can also tap on happy birthday.

title: SoulSync City
description: A cyberpunk movement shooter based on momentum and speed.

title: Voxelgram: DLC #1
description: An animal themed DLC pack for Voxelgram with 82 puzzles and 6 dioramas.

title: Beatblock
description: Spin to win, and move your paddle around to hit blocks to the beat. The song revolves around you, and it's your job to keep up.

title: Battle Factory Showdown
description:
Battle Factory Showdown is a Pokémon fan game developed in RPG Maker XP with Pokémon Essentials.
The game is entirely dedicated to the famous Battle Frontier facility "Battle Factory."
Rent a team of 4 Pokémon from over 250 available and engage in an endless series of double battles; will you be able to defeat all the bosses and set a new world record?

title: Auti-Sim
description: This game was developed during Hacking Health Vancouver 2013 hackathon. The player navigates through a playground as an autistic child with auditory hypersensitivity. Proximity to loud children causes sensory overload for the player, impacting cognitive functions. This impact is represented as visual noise and blur, as well as audio distortion. Participants described the experience as visceral, insightful and compelling.

title: F.R.A.G.G.
description: Step into the future of gaming with F.R.A.G.G, the ultimate arena combat experience powered by Unreal Engine 5. Prepare yourself for next-generation graphics, intense multiplayer and singleplayer gameplay, and a universe brimming with excitement and competition.

title: OverField
description: Over Field is a Cozy Miniature World Exploration & Light Social RPG game for iOS, Android, and PC.

title: Bear Warrior
description: Be a hero Bear with sword and bow and kill fat sumo and find hidden golden skulls

title: In the Abyss
description: A platformer with gravity-changing portals.

title: Mobile Dungeon
description: From the creators of Shakes & Fidget, join us in a new epic fantasy RPG adventure. Get ready to accept our new quest and embark on the wackiest dungeon crawler!

title: Logan Kart 8
description: Satiricial Mario Kart 8 fangame featuring bizarre self-insert and parody characters, a wonky physics engine, and a melancholy soundtrack.

title: Mung Daal: Vietnam
description: Satirical fangame based on the classic 2000s cartoon "Chowder", in which the usually goofy father-figure Mung Daal is thrown into the Vietnam war.

title: Farming Simulator 25
description: Farming Simulator 25 floods the fields with a host of new machines, gameplay features, visual upgrades, and even fresh water to grow rice - adding even more agricultural depth and diversity to the family-friendly series.

title: A Trick and a Treat: Dead Letters (And One Other)
description: A Trick and a Treat is a Halloween visual novel featuring two stories: Dead Letters, a horror story in which a man working at the post office opens a letter and learns of something he shouldn't have; and Vamp Me!, a comedic story in which a woman comes home from a Halloween party to see her roommate in the midst of performing a ritual in their living room.

title: The Intern of Christmas Present
description: The Intern of Christmas Present is a visual novel where Pressie's last trial before becoming a holiday specter is turning the heart of Girl Dracula, enemy of Christmas. It is a sequel to the story "Vamp Me!" in the developer's previous visual novel, A Trick and a Treat.

title: It's Just A Prank
description: It's Just A Prank is a first-person horror game about kids playing pranks on each other until a PRANK GOES WRONG. Experience suspense, fear and unexpected twists as a simple joke becomes a nightmare.

title: Aces of Thunder
description:
Experience the thrill of aerial combat like never before with Aces of Thunder, the ultimate flight simulation game with high fidelity graphics and unmatched immersion. The game was made specifically with capabilities of latest generation VR helmets in mind.

The game's physically accurate flight and damage models derived from the popular War Thunder military action game ensure a high level of realism. The battles take place exclusively from the cockpit view to provide ultimate immersion and fully supports HOTAS controls. Aces of Thunder features a set of the most legendary WW1 & WW2 aircraft available to hop in and fly right upon purchase.

title: The Sumerian Game
description: A game of strategy and management. The Sumerian Game is one of the earliest computer games. Developed and programmed between 1963 and 1965, it was designed to teach children math, economy and ancient history. The source code was lost but now you can play it again.

title: Reconnected
description: Since moving out of her parents home 5 years ago, Elle has been living as herself with her best friend Roxanne. She works at her job for a majority of her time and lives a decent life. That is, until she receives a message from someone in her past and her life is shaken up once again.

title: Doodle Hunt: Search Hidden Items
description: Doodle Hunt is a delightful seek-and-find game set in hand-drawn cityscapes. Explore charming maps, locate hidden items, and watch them come to life in color! An enchanting adventure for all ages.

title: Lajoy Teckna
description: What lurks in the dark? Survive a shift at the worn-down Rotwheel family storage facility against a slew of murderous cyborgs and hardware malfunctions. Survive the shift and earn your freedom!

title: Hobo Life: Greg's Christmas
description: Someone has stolen all the crack in the city, so you team up with the Brick Guy and try to find a way to bring happiness and crack across the city once more.

title: Korea. IL-2 Series
description: Korea. IL-2 Series is a next-generation flight simulator set during the Korean War. Climb into the cockpit of early jet fighters and shape the outcome of legendary aerial battles.

title: The Occultist
description: The Occultist is a first-person narrative thriller. You play as Alan Rebels, a paranormal investigator who travels to an abandoned British island after his father's disappearance. Explore GodStone island, face supernatural entities, and uncover long-buried occult rituals.

title: Catalina's Horror Adventure
description: Catalina's Horror Adventure it's a game of terror, shooting, adventure and humor. Our mother shows us a treasured place from her childhood, an abandoned arcade. After trying to turn on the light, our protagonist appears in a totally unknown place; "The World".

title: G-Sector
description: G-Sector is a 3D action game based around hoverboard combat--a hybrid of an extreme game and a third-person shooter. Players control the heroine, Cyra, as she hoverboards through futuristic cities and arenas. Gameplay is based on ramps and tricks you use to build velocity and avoid opponents' shots. Using a chase-cam and a customizable mouse/keyboard interface, G-Sector should be familiar to players of 3D shooters.

title: Anzu Castle Gracula
description: Castlevania-style platformer

title: UAC Storage Surplus Project
description: The year is 2123. The UAC accidentally added 20 zeroes to its order of 1 crate. You are hired to vanquish the menace of the ludicrous amount of crates. Go, little Cratemaster, the Containment Area needs you!

title: Your Journey Begins
description: A 5 level episode for Heretic.

title: Lunar Strain
description: Lunar Strain is a new Moon-themed episode megawad for Doom 2 designed for limit removing source ports (complevel 2) made by the various members of Doomer Boards, led by Matador. There are 22 levels plus a credits map but there are also two curiosities in the MAP31/32 slots. MAP31 is a demo map showcasing the new monsters/props. MAP32 is a color swapped version of MAP13.

title: Road to Hades
description: A 32 map Boom compatible megawad for TNT:Evilution.

title: Two Tone Jam
description: Two Tone Jam was a jam that required participants to combine two different colors, themes, or motifs! It was a speedmap event (~48 hours) using the venerable Copper mod as a base and 9 maps were created.

title: Egyptgington
description: Medium-sized Egyptian pyramid level, originally started for the Retro Map Jam 6 community event.

title: Heart Dungeon
description: Heart Dungeon is a roguelite action game with visual novel elements that follows a boy called Leo who gets inside a video game that manifests elements of the psyche of whoever enters it. He will use this dimension to fight the illness that afflicts his mother and understand what is going on in his own heart.

title: Sun's Edge
description: What would you do if the world was ending? In Sun's Edge, you are a ranger exploring the island of Solasta, trying to find a way to keep the world from falling to darkness! In this Aztec themed adventure game, you will need to fight, climb, and solve your way out of problems. Everyone is counting on you!

title: Short Adventure
description: An RPG that uses the ATB battle system seen in early Final Fantasy games, Short Adventure follows a diseased young woman who goes from every day college student to criminal to outcast as she tries to cope with her life changing quickly.

title: Stuck in a Yandere Visual Novel... HELP!!
description: Stuck in a Yandere Visual Novel... HELP!! is a comedic BxB visual novel with two love interests to romance escape from.

title: Ultimate Rock Climbing Challenge
description: Experience risk in truly wild conditions - become a rock climber !

title: Is it Wrong to Want to be Locked up, Toyed with and Tortured by a Hot Guy?
description:
Mamiya Hibiki is a regular guy with not so regular interests. He’s a huge fan of the decade-old drama series Possessive Boyfriends, and his favourite character by far is Kirisaki Shin: a deranged yandere who expresses his love with continuous threats of entrapment, torture, and murder.

Hibiki might enjoy fictional characters threatening to kill him, but he’s far less receptive about real men teasing him about these desires.

That’s what Hibiki thinks, at least – until he runs into his silver-tongued tormentor yet again, and things start to get serious…

title: Gods vs. Horrors
description: Recruit gods from different mythologies, buff and upgrade them, arrange them in perfect formation, and create thousands of synergetic builds! Gods vs Horrors is a roguelike card autobattler in which you coordinate gods to defend the Earth against cosmic horrors.

title: DeathJack
description: Play Blackjack where the wager is your life. Do you have what it takes to beat the host? Let's find out...

title: Nick Jr. Party Adventure
description: Guide Dora, Blue, Chase, Molly, Santiago, Darington and many more around a variety of interactive challenges as they get ready to celebrate the Friendship Fiesta, and explore the Nick Jr. universe in 72 levels across six different themed worlds. Nick Jr. Party Adventures features solo mode or up to 2 player local co-op.

title: Cattle Country
description: Howdy partner! Welcome to Cattle Country, the only Cozy Cowboy Adventure Life Sim. Become a determined pioneer traveling west to start a new life. Make a home in the mountains, take on bandits, discover dastardly plots, build a farm, develop your town, and make friends with fellow residents.

title: Rootin' Tootin'
description: A 2v2 cowboy platformer game where players aim to win by collecting coins and items and shooting opponents.

title: Reproach
description: Reproach is a narrative beat 'em up with time-travel and gay cowboys. Help 50’s detective Stout and his new friends, the hard-core band Potus Flotus, to close time rifts across space-time and save his detective partners scattered across time.

title: Tiny Cats
description: Tiny Cats is a mysterious hidden cat-detective game where you need to find all the hidden and deeply hidden cats in the mansion. Save each cat from the mysterious magic that keeps them trapped inside. And uncover the mystery of your late aunt's house.

title: Alkahest
description: Alkahest is an Action-Adventure RPG set in a murky medieval world. Where satisfying melee combat with highly interactive environments takes center stage. Explore realistic locations, learn alchemy and make a name for your family.

title: Sigils of Nightfall
description: Sigils of Nightfall is a roguelike deckbuilder that combines dungeon crawling with elements of the award-winning RPG, Mörk Borg. Embark on a dark journey, improve your character, and survive at all costs — or be consumed by the horrors lurking in the darkness.

title: Ultimate Jello Party
description: Ultimate Jello Party is a multiplayer party game that combines elements of card, board and minigame battles. Challenge up to 3 friends and mess up the game with your strategies! Earn coins, plan your moves, collect and accumulate jellies to become the big winner.

title: HiPurrLand
description: Hundreds of cats and fifteen brand-new levels await your exploration!

title: Hidden in Clickville
description: Discover the charming inhabitants of Clickville across the four seasons, as you assist them in locating their misplaced items. Search for all the hidden objects across various levels. The grateful townsfolk of Clickville will be sooo happy! Surprise bonus level for you!

title: 100 Hiddensaurs
description: 100 Hiddensaurs is a hidden object game with dinosaurs. The game is drawn by hand.

title: Fighting of School
description: Fighting of School is a fighting game, inspired by anime and games from very famous fighting game franchises, it mixes 8-bit elements with 16-bit sounds.

title: Ring Academy
description: In 'Ring Academy', you'll embark on a surreal journey as the newest student at a school like no other. Your path to navigating this bizarre institution involves throwing rings to progress through levels, each more whimsical and eerie than the last. Prepare for the strangest classes you've ever attended, taught by eccentric teachers who are anything but normal.

title: Les Guignols de l'info: Le Cauchemar de PPD
Blockage
description: Find the source of your strange symptoms.

title: Glogwillette
description: An adventure for the family... use the Arrow keys, E to shoot (only if a baddy is nearby!), and sometimes you will need to use the mouse

title: Pre Post-Modernistic Post-Ironic Dadaism: Dating Simulator
description:
Are you a stunning single bachelor OR bachelorette?!?!

Do you long for true companionship?

Are you attempting to populate a newly discovered planet, but are worried that your offspring won't be genetically suited to survive in a new environment?

title: Enter the Void to the Holy Mountain
description: A trans-dimensional life form explores the universe. Through the enormous amount of knowledge it accumulates, it doubts its own existence. Fleeing the intensifying feeling of loneliness, it gets lost on Earth. In the process, it penetrates deep into the consciousness of a civilisation that is helplessly overwhelmed by its own permanently changing reality and its technical developments. One day, the life form plays the 5-dimensional game "Bullets are round so their thoughts can change direction.", and an idea emerges that changes everything.

title: The Jingol
description: The teachings of his excellency: Jingol.

title: Dead Rising Deluxe Remaster
description: Dead Rising returns with modern graphics! More than just a remaster, this Deluxe Remaster is a full graphical overhaul of the first game in zombie-slaughtering action game series "Dead Rising." This remaster has also been fully voiced, supports auto-saves, and has various other quality-of-life features. Witness the unmatched mayhem and freedom for yourself!

title: Spear of Destiny
description: A bundle with Spear of Destiny and its Mission Packs was released on GOG.com and Steam under the name of "Spear of Destiny" by id Software. Due to Bethesda merging Wolfenstein 3D and Spear of Destiny into a single bundle, this bundle with the mission packs got delisted, which means that the packs are unavailable for new buyers.

title: Popgoes Arcade: Fighting Chance
description: "Fighting Chance" is an upcoming FREE major update for POPGOES Arcade on Steam. My final attempt at perfecting the original vision for the game, giving those who enjoyed the game a reason to play it again, and those who didn't enjoy it a reason to give it another try.

title: There's No Monsters
description: Have you checked under the bed? Or in the closet? We guarantee there's no monsters there!

title: I Commissioned Some Bunnies 10
description: I paid artists to hide bunnies and carrots in 15 artworks. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

title: RoboGal: Gaga Delta Lady
description: Rei-Bo was living peacefully on the island of Plutobell, until a giant spaceship crashed into the place! This is a fun and humorous saga to solve this incident full of obstacles and traps! Choose the levels in the order you want, defeat the ship's members and get their weapons in RoboGal!

title: Kitty Rhythm TD
description:
Welcome to the fair!
Help the cats to cheer up with music so the ball will be a success!
In this game, the song’s beat dictates when every move will happen.

title: A Mask's Tale
description: A Mask’s Tale is an investigation and suspense game that takes place in an alternative version of the city of São Paulo. In this dystopian reality, people are forced to wear masks, hiding their faces and identities.

title: Cursor & Meow
description: In Cursor & Meow, many cats crave your attention, but not all of them will be easy to catch. To find some of them, you'll need to use a lot of concentration, dexterity, and logic! The game features numerous puzzles, challenges, and mini-games that will make your search entertaining and varied.

title: CorActio
description: CorActio is a 2D platformer with puzzle elements set in an alternate, polluted version of our world. Developed by the indie studio Delusional Ram, this game immerses players in a mission to cleanse the environment from the relentless industrial pollution.

title: Beach Bums
description: Beach Bums is a cheeky 2D hidden object memory game in which the player must reunite beachgoers with their swimsuits after a tidal wave washes them away.

title: Garuya and the Kaleidoscope of Syzygy
description:
"During the night, monster ruins are rising from the skies, ancient prophecies speak of a new syzygy."

An epic platform RPG where you play as a wizard named Garuya who wants to investigate the strange return of ruins from a distant past that are appearing throughout the land of Foltabur.

title: Fallout 76: Season 4 - Cold Steel
description:
Cold Steel is a board game based on the fictional cartoon adventures of Armor Ace and his companions, the Power Patrol. It was created and published by Dynamite Animation Company.

In the wake of the American "liberation" of the Yukon Territory, a damaged Assaultron uploads its consciousness into a suit of T-45 power armor and is reborn as Commissioner Chaos. The rogue A.I. forms the Yukon Five, a group of anti-imperialist robots which threaten to halt the march of Manifest Destiny.

title: Fallout 76: Season 5 - Escape from the 42nd Century
description: Escape from the 42nd Century was the fifth season in Fallout 76. It began on July 7, 2021, with the release of the Steel Reign update. It follows Armor Ace and the Power Patrol in Cold Steel and was followed by The Unstoppables! vs The Diabolicals.

title: Fallout 76: Season 6 - The Unstoppables! vs The Diabolicals
description: The Unstoppables! vs The Diabolicals was the sixth season in Fallout 76. It began on September 8, 2021, with the release of the Fallout Worlds update. It follows Escape from the 42nd Century and was followed by Zorbo's Revenge.

title: Fallout 76: Season 7 - Zorbo's Revenge
description: Zorbo's Revenge was the 7th season in Fallout 76. It began on December 8, 2021, with the release of the Night of the Moth update. It follows The Unstoppables! vs The Diabolicals and was followed by A Better Life Underground.

title: Fallout 76: Season 8 - A Better Life Underground
description: A Better Life Underground was the 8th season in Fallout 76. It began on March 1, 2022, with the release of the Invaders from Beyond update. It follows Zorbo's Revenge.

title: Raider's Saga
description:
Raiders Saga is the ultimate gaming experience of 2024, where chaos and beauty collide in a Cybernetic Anime Themed Viking Saga.
Engage in Seasonal Matchmaking to delve into the realms of PvP, PvE, and Raider Racing! Battle it out in PvP Arena Deathmatches and intense PvP Capture the Flag modes, showcasing your skills like never before.

Feel the itch for speed?
Join our Matchmaking Racing Odin’s Cup to satisfy your racing desires!

But wait, there's more!
Embark on epic adventures with friends through our PvE Matchmaking, conquering Dungeons and Raids as you strive to become the next(esports) legend.

Join Raiders Saga today and immerse yourself in a world where legends are born and epic tales unfold!

title: ECWolf
description:
ECWolf is an advanced source port for Wolfenstein 3D, Spear of Destiny, and Super 3D Noah's Ark based off of the Wolf4SDL code base. ECWolf pulls a substantial amount of code from ZDoom and aims to provide a wide array of mod editing capabilities without the need to modify the source code.

For players, ECWolf provides many useful features such as better control binding, support for wide screen resolutions, and unlimited save slots.

title: Undertale: Promised.
description: Undertale Promised. A fight against Sans but pretty early on in the story.

title: Multiplayer Werewolves
description: Multiplayer Werewolves - You and Your Team are the last remaining Humans on Earth. Can You Survive ?

title: KitBashers 2: Multiplayer
description: KitBashers 2 [Multiplayer] - Bad Dudes are attacking Planet KitKa. Queen Calica needs Your Help. The Kits are getting Bashed. You and Your team must take out ALL Aliens and Save the Planet.

title: Jet Fighters with Friends (Multiplayer)
description: Single Player OR Multiplayer Jet Fighter Game with OR without A.I. Bots.

title: Grokai
description: Grokai - An A.I. Generated Text Based "Choose Your Own Adventure" Game

title: Trepang2: Bladekisser DLC
description: Shoot and slice your way through enemies with the Trepang2 Bladekisser DLC. Embark on new missions in new areas, and engage in close, brutal combat with your sword. Are you worthy enough to wield the blade?

title: MechaBlade Hero
description: MechaBlade Hero is an indie action adventure game where you control a robot fighting your way through an army of robots to get out of a giant tower. Face enemies and gain new weapons, solve puzzles and platform challenges in this challenging hack and slash.

title: Star Wars: Bounty Hunter
description:
Star Wars: Bounty Hunter (released in Japan as Star Wars: Jango Fett) is a Star Wars video game developed and published by LucasArts for the GameCube and Sony PlayStation 2, released in 2002. In the game, players play as the bounty hunter Jango Fett, featured in the 2002 film Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones, to which this game serves as a prequel. Both Temuera Morrison and Leeanna Walsman reprise their roles from the film as Jango Fett and Zam Wesell, respectively.

The main objective of Star Wars: Bounty Hunter is to hunt Dark Jedi Komari Vosa. During the game, it is revealed why Jango Fett was chosen as the template for the Grand Army of the Republic, how Boba Fett, his cloned "son" was born, and how Jango acquired Slave I.

Players also fight many "bosses", such as Montross and Longo "Two-Guns". There are also side objectives, such as collecting secondary bounties, that open special bonus items in the game. When the player beats a chapter, blooper reels - comedic machinima productions - are unlocked.

title: Castle Come
description: Castle Come is a walking fortress roguelike. Scout a strange land full of bandits in search of new parts, defeat enemy castles and scavenge the wreckage, recruit crew to man your growing arsenal of weapons and build your way from an agile fortling into a deadly, hulking, monster machine.

title: Rarity
description:
slowly reassemble the new landscapes

Short little 3D, first person narrative game about life continuing after COVID and the weird time skip that occurred for people as their lives drastically changed in an ephemeral but 3 year time period.

Explores themes around University, friendships, the feeling of time passing and it being over before it's begun.

title: Odeio Sonhar
description:
A Yume Nikki Fangame for Dream Diary Jam 8.

Play as Ivy, a young adult who comes to grapple with their own identity and family as they engross themselves in the world of a TV Show, simply titled, "Frank Show." Learn about yourself, change your body, and come to grips with the things that lay in the recess of your mind.

title: Lapis Lazuli
description: Lapis Lazuli is a Yume Nikki fangame for Dream Diary Jam 8, where you can explore the dreams of a young boy named Yasuo.

title: Camera
description: A Yume Nikki fangame for the Dream Diary Jam 8.

title: Yume Nikki Space
description: Madotsuki has dreamed so hard that she explored every corner of the dream world countless times... until Masada took Mado to a new space... a YUME NIKKI SPACE.

title: DNA Subject: Lucy
description: DNA Subject: Lucy is a Yume Nikki fangame where you explore the dreams of Lucy, a young girl who isolates herself from the rest of the world. An entry for Dream Diary Jam 8.

title: Break a Leg
description: Break a Leg is a series done over YouTube shorts where the top comment got the next addition to the game. Break a Leg is a game where your primary goal is to break your leg. Once you do, you did it. You won. Therefore, there's no more reason to keep playing this game.

title: Smol Survivors
description: Smol Survivors is a 2D reverse bullet-hell where you open portals to new worlds and then fight off hordes of hostile inhabitants. Collect weapons, upgrade them, then combine them into super weapons to wreak havoc!

title: The Sims 4: Lovestruck
description: Explore romance as you match with alluring Sims and plan exciting dates in The Sims 4 Lovestruck Expansion Pack.

title: Macis
description: Macis is a platform game focused on exploration. In this game, you control a young Chia in a search for her parents, who mysteriously disappeared when she was a child. Your main suspect? The one responsible for security in the city where she lives. Finding her parents seems like an impossible challenge, but alongside her team of bounty hunters, she is confident that she can finally find out what happened.

title: The Restless Sheep & The Lone Wolf: A Tale of Cutthroat Lovers
description: In this twisted love story of a visual novel by CLOCKUP, an insomniac must decide whether to protect his position as a yakuza bigwig’s pet killer or the mysterious woman who can put him to sleep.

title: Clickolding
description: The man in the corner of your hotel room wants you to click something. He wants to watch you click it.

title: Relic Abyss
description: Experience a unique hand-crafted Bullet Heaven Roguelite RPG set in a Fantasy x Sci-fi world filled with might, magic, and lost technology! A mysterious tale centered around a world-devouring Abyss awaits...

title: Yume Nikki Ware
description: WarioWare, but it's Yume Nikki!

title: Polis 2: Någon ljuger
description: Polis 2 is a Swedish game where you play as a leader of the murder investigation unit of the police force and the task is to solve a murder case which starts with the finding of a dismembered arm in a lake. The gameplay consists of you assigning team members tasks, interrogation, and collect evidence whereof lamps will indicate progress of how much has been collected. Once enough evidence is collected the player can eventually put together who the murderer is. The game was released with its own localization in Denmark under the title 'Mistænkt'. It also changed the case introduction a bit where instead it is a woman who washed ashore on the beach.

title: Polis
description:
Polis is a Swedish game where you play as a leader of the homicide investigation unit and the task is to solve a 3 different murder cases.

The gameplay consists of assigning team members to find evidence as well as conduct interrogations. Eventually you will have enough to put together who the murderer is.

After the initial release the game was re-released in three separate acts representing the 3 cases:
- Polis: Det röda fallet
- Polis: Det gula fallet
- Polis: Det blåa fallet

title: Minty Monkey
description: Minty and her friends embarked on an adventure to defeat the terrible King Krumpa and recover the fragments of the mystical jewel.

title: Eternal Escape: Castle of Shadows
description: This is a light puzzle game set in a vampire manor, inspired by the experience of playing the "Castlevania series" and combined with an understanding and reflection on vampire culture.

title: One Last Raid
description: An arena based roguelike action RPG where you play as a skeleton warrior, who fights waves of enemies with diverse abilities. Each run you create a unique build by selecting different skills on each level up and picking up loot from fallen enemies.

title: Attack on Mutation Station
description: A genre-hopping mystery about neon spaceships, alien plants, digital demigods, and the nature of reality.

title: Raccoonwave
description: A game about a raccoon and self-worth.

title: Mini Reaper
description: Mini Reaper is a short indie chaser-horror 3D platformer themed after retro game creepypasta and game emulation. The gameplay revolves around collecting souls in a mansion while avoiding the chasing monster.

title: Raccoon & Possum Just Want to Read a Book
description:
Pages on the wind.
One keyboard, two garbage pals:
Raccoon and Possum.

Avoid obstacles and collect the pages to unlock actual pages from an actual book you can actually read. Jump over things. Jump on things. Jump on your buddy. Jump on your buddy while your buddy is also jumping. Just don't jump in pits or on birds or on those good lads who're just having a snooze and shouldn't be woken.

Press H if you get stuck.
If you get really stuck, go to Read or Title to get a new level.

title: Cambo: Webbed Fist
description:
There comes a time in every capybara's life when they must set peace aside and don the red headband of strength to become the Capybarbarian, protector of the waterways.

For Cambo, this is that time.

Use your webbed fists, foraging, and digging skills to defeat the invaders and reunite with Capybarbara. Keep fighting: In the end, either they die, or you do.

title: Tanuki No Tabi
description: Taunki No Tabi (Tanuki's Journey) is a top-down, action-adventure shooter developed in Singapore polytechnic by pyu pyu production. There are three clans living in harmony, the Tanuki, the Saru and the Kitsune. Each individual species has an unique ability blessed upon a selected few by the Gods. The blessings obtained helps the races to prosper and live together peacefully. You get to play as Kotarou, a Tanuki that seeks to grow stronger and rescue his sister from the Kitsune who became greedy for power. Explore the world and earn gifts from the gods scattered across the land!

title: Akirao: A Researcher Awakens
description:
In Akirao, you step into the shoes of a disoriented researcher who awakens on a mysterious train with no memory of how he got there. Your head throbs, and a sense of unease grips you as you struggle to piece together the events that led you to this unsettling place.

Dive into the depths of mystery as you navigate through the eerie experiments conducted on you. Can you complete your missions, uncover the truth, and find your way to freedom?

title: Babylon X
description:
Alternative history of the Ancient World: Mesopotamia, 6000 BC. A technological revolution against the backdrop of an impending apocalypse.

Energy, gravity, and its connections with ancient magic were discovered, leading to technological advancements in Babylon and Egypt. At that point, the struggle for resources had begun.

A former prophet who is now a runaway slave and avenger joins forces with a young moon cult priestess to prevent the imminent construction of the Tower of Babel. Betrayed by all, he starts a new life and finds love in a world that is about to end.

title: Platinum White
description: You have less than 8 minutes to remember what you can. It won't be enough time to remember everything. Run around and explore a lonely landscape or sit in the same spot, waiting. The Platinum White will come either way.

title: Sofie: The Echoes
description: Sofie: The Echoes is a third-person action-adventure game that immerses players in a story-driven experience. Explore diverse environments, solve challenging puzzles, and unravel the mysteries surrounding Sofie’s family.

title: Tan-Tan-Tanuki
description: Tan-Tan-Tanuki is a 2d platformer that I made to make it fun to learn about Yokai and to introduce people to the world of Yokai and Japanese folklore.

title: Unplagued
description: Play as plague doctors with your friends in this multiplayer co-op medieval horror! Purge the plague. Create the cure. Escape the mutated creatures. Make the queen proud.

title: Ace Attorney Investigations 2: Prosecutor's Gambit
description: Prosecutor's Gambit is the second of Edgeworth's solo outings. Featuring new characters and the new "Mind Chess" gameplay mechanic, this title also expands on the crime scene re-creation gameplay mechanic introduced in the first entry. With his right to investigate crimes stripped from him, Edgeworth is left wondering if he should continue to pursue the truth as a prosecutor or as a defense attorney. Just what will his ultimate answer be...?

title: Saints Row: Saints Criminal Customs
description: The Saints Criminal Customs includes two specially adorned bonus items; the elaborately styled Saints Custom Convertible and the equally signature Saints Custom Stab Jacket.

title: Tanuki's Dream
description: Tanuki's Dream is a 2D top-down, arena-like dungeon crawler. Defeat enemies to appropiate their abilities and use them to your advantage! Fight your way through the kappa-infested swamp and find the hidden Tanuki village.

title: Undertale Patience
description:
Welcome to UNDERTALE PATIENCE. In this RPG Fan-Prequel UNDERTALE, you control the first human who falls underground in the world of monsters.

the fan-game was canceled unfortunately because the creator passed away, Rest in peace.

title: Tanuki Tales
description:
Oh no! The nut-collecting tanuki is far away from home and a dangerously curious girl has taken an interest!

Take part in a magical and whimsical adventure as you help the tanuki return home through 3 seperate worlds containing several obstacles and enemies hindering your path!

title: NPC Adventure
description: Play as Greg, a lowly shopkeeper, on a RPG adventure to do the knight’s job and defeat the evil King in this game made for the Game maker’s Toolkit Jam 2023.

title: Procelio
description: Procelio is a multiplayer voxel-based vehicle builder and shooter. Create your chassis and combine movement parts, guns, and other functional utilities to create a remote-controlled war machine, then duke it out with others in the war tearing its way across the Martian frontier.

title: A2C: Ayry Seems to be Playtesting a 2D Runner Shooter from Cci
description: A 2D runner shmup(shoot-em up) where you may or may not save a nation by beating a game. Shoot and dodge bullets while you keep running and jumping! Enjoy a story where you play the game made by Cci while Ayry and Cci banter with each other(and talk about the world of Nosolute and game development)!

title: Nobunaga's Ambition: Tenshouki with Power Up Kit
description:
Nobunaga's Ambition: Tenshouki with Power Up Kit is an expanded version of the historical strategy game Nobunaga no Yabou: Tenshouki, where players attempt to unify Japan during the Sengoku period.

This edition adds new scenarios, additional officers, gameplay events, AI improvements, and in-game editing features that expand the strategic options available in the original release.

title: Vaygren: Lustful Temptation
description: Vaygren: Lustful Temptation is an erotic visual novel with multiple routes and unlockables. The game features fully animated scenes and stunningly beautiful fantasy women. You’ll be meeting, flirting, frolicking, and fighting alongside these women in a high-stakes adventure.

title: Sky Dust
description: Sky Dust is set in a cyberpunk universe, taking place in a future where society has collapsed following a global disaster, and the lines between morality and ethics have become blurred.

title: We Are Saved
description: "We Are Saved" is a short, free, first-person horror game. You are trapped alone in an underground factory rumored to be a site of cat abuse. While being pursued by the deranged inhabitant of the abandoned factory, your mission is to rescue the pitiful cats and aim for escape.

title: I Am Not Crazy
description: After losing his daughter and wife, he became depressed and tried to kill himself many times. While she was unconscious, her head hit something hard and she went into a vegetative state. He didn't know where he was. All he wanted was to be reunited with his wife and daughter. He tried everything for her. AND... "Our character is trying to kill himself in a vegetative state."

title: WW2: Bunker Simulator - Origins
description: Take control of the Wehrmacht officer, the original commander of the bunker, before the 101st Airborne Division took him out. Together with your subordinates try to stop the Allies Normandy offensive. The tables have turned!

title: Penultima
description: Mecha Anime Rivalry.

title: Dragon Ball: Sparking! Zero - Ultimate Edition
description:
DRAGON BALL: Sparking! ZERO takes the legendary gameplay of the Budokai Tenkaichi series and raises it to whole new levels. Learn and master an incredible roster of playable characters, each with signature abilities, transformations, and techniques. Unleash the fighting spirit within you and take the fight to arenas that crumble and react to your power as the battle rages on.
The Ultimate Edition includes:

DRAGON BALL: Sparking! ZERO base game disc
Collectible lenticular card with Ultimate Edition upgrade pack voucher
Season Pass - 3 Packs including Dragon Ball Super: SUPER HERO and Dragon Ball DAIMA content that contains more than 20 playable characters.
Season Pass Bonus - Summon Shenron and 3 Days Early Access to the 3 DLC Packs
3 Days Early Access
Ultimate Upgrade Pack - including the following in-game items:
Goku (Super) Costume with Power Pole
Emote Voice Set
2 player card backgrounds
1 customization item that increases a character's fighting ability
Ultimate Edition Bonus - Summon Super Shenron

title: Midnight Myths
description: A First Person Horror game where you play as a new hired park ranger doing simple park ranger tasks and observing wild life. Some wildlife being creatures from American Folklore.

title: Abrapalabra: La Magia de Aprender a Leer
description: The software Abrapalabra was designed for children between 6 to 11 years old to develop their skills of writing and reading. It is a complete software with 2 CDs full of interactive activities to develop these skills.

title: Never Really Alone
description: A stressful day is not always saved by a good night's sleep. A girl alone in her new foster home finds any excuse not to go to bed. A short horror RPG made for an alternative game development class at the University of Utah.

title: Glass Masquerade 3: Honeylines - Folks & Spirits
description: The "Folks & Spirits" puzzle set contains 10 new puzzles representing 2 new themes with 5 puzzles in each, respectively - FREE demo puzzles included!
