Well, the ﻿participating chefs had a selection of 12 different design restrictions on offer, of which they had to use at least ﻿3﻿﻿.

title: Deltatraveler: Section 3
description: Hell's Forest (or, alternatively, Section 3) is the third Section of Deltatraveler, taking place in the world of GG!Underfell.

title: Spooky Pixel Hero
description: A chilling homage to retro gaming – Rediscover the magic of classic games and retro platformers with a terrifying twist. SPOOKY PIXEL HORROR combines the beloved aesthetics of vintage 2D pixel games with a deeply immersive horror narrative that will keep you on edge.

title: Doomium
description: DOOMIUM is a Community Project of megawad worth of short, explosive, and fun ﻿maps made by collective effort of 25 mappers, ranging from mini techbases to dimension-crossing temples and mysterious realms in search for the purest element of Doom.﻿

title: OverTrip
description: A skill-based third-person shooter, where the thrill of competition meets the world of skill-based token betting and the captivating integration of diverse NFT collections.

title: Helltown: Revival Update
description:
Get ready to experience the chilling horrors of Little Vale like never before! Helltown has been completely remastered with the Revival Update, featuring enhanced environments and animations, reimagined characters, new dialogues, and redesigned gameplay sections.

But that's not all! Not only have the soundscapes been improved, but the game also now features a spine-tingling soundtrack by none other than Ockeroid, composer of the fabulous Crow Country game!

New scares await you in this free update, but will you have the courage to face the terrors lurking in the shadows? Or be brave enough to play through the game's different endings? There's only one way to find out...

title: Omnimancer
description: Roguelite-style game in which you must explore an ancient tomb filled with dangers and practically infinite magic

title: Tides of Tethys
description:
Tides of Tethys is an immersive underwater roguelite simulation game centered around exploring and surviving the uncharted depths of an alien world, while building and maintaining modular outposts.

Players will lead expeditions of Knights into the unknown, in the hopes of rebuilding their long lost kingdom and unifying the houses of Tethys once again.

As they dive further into the Abyss, they will discover compelling new places, uncover lost technologies, and conquer a variety of dangers that lurk beneath the surface.

title: Kowai Mono ni ha Futa wo Shiro
description:
Everyone is living covering up something. They pretend not to notice it."

A direct mail from a famous event planning company. It contained a notice of a summer ghost story event called "Hyakumonogatari" and a call for participants.
You, a horror and occult enthusiast, decided to go to the event by yourself.
There, you meet a childhood friend you haven't seen in 10 years and also your current best friend (?). You were happy to meet them so unexpectedly, however......
The lid of your memory is lifted as you are led through a "scary story. What will become of them, tossed about and confused by the past and the present?

title: The Restless Sheep & The Lone Wolf: Woolly Eyes Gaiden
description: The romantic noir visual novel The Restless Sheep & The Lone Wolf returns to Kabukicho in this unhinged simul-quel. Me, Azami, and the whole ragtag gang rampage through five all-new short stories!

title: Chronicle: Rewritten
description:
Chronicle: Rewritten is a recreation of Jagex's original collectable card game, Chronicle: Runescape Legends. The game was taken offline on the 6th of August 2018 and hasn't been accessible ever since. Until now!

This remake is built from the ground up with the goal of having this game playable until the end of time. As long as there is a download available somewhere, you will be able to play it!

title: Soul Park
description: Build an infernal fun park, judge your customers' sins and give them what they deserve: a HELL of an entertainment!

title: Diamond Detective
description: Stop thief! Calling all detectives! The city of Gemopolis has fallen victim to a clever jewel thief. Private eyes have work to do in Diamond Detective.

title: The Man in the Fields
description: The Man in the Fields is a first person horror game based on a ritual of the same name. Once you summon The Man in the Fields, every door and item in your house will be opened. Close everything in time to prevent it from getting in.

title: SpongeBob SquarePants Bubble Rush!
description: SpongeBob SquarePants Bubble Rush! is an Action game, developed and published by Big Fish Games, which was released in 2006.

title: Pixel Gun World
description: Pixel Gun World is a free multiplayer shooter. Play with your friends, classmates, fellow students and colleagues! Fight against other players in PvP mode and try to survive in the Arena mode! Buy and improve your armor and weapons! Become one of the best pro players of Pixel Gun World!

title: Total Extreme Wrestling IX
description: The 9th game of the wrestling booking sim franchise.

title: Minha Casa
description: Awakened in the middle of the night by her own anxiety, Robertha will have to face her own demons beyond her own home.

title: BloodBoarderz
description: Race to the finish line and satisfy your murderous wishes while you go down the bloody mountains dodging obstacles and slaying your enemies!

title: Toon Troops Strategy
description: Toon Troops Strategy, where strategic thinking meets cartoon mayhem! Engage in tactical battles, outwit your opponents, and lead your colorful cast of characters to victory in this charming adaptation of the classic capture the flag style game.

title: Melty Amethyst
description: The full-voiced otome vishual novel that adds colour to ordinary life.

title: Skinless The Horror Story Quest
description: In "Skinless The Horror Story Quest," journey through a nightmarish blend of reality and hallucination. Wake up in a haunting hospital, face your fears in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by zombies, and confront the doctor behind the epidemic. Can you escape the darkness within and without?

title: Run Mr. Robo!
description: They kicked you out of the city and now you want REVENGE!! unlock costumes and kill all the mayor's henchmen in this fast top-down-shooter, but watch out! only 1 hit and you die (unless you equipped the shield of course)

title: Realize Me
description: Main character is a nerd who attends a vocational school, but aims at becoming a scenario writer. He wants a girlfriend, but is afraid to confess his feelings, so he becomes obsessed with game girls instead. One day he starts to play a trial version of a new game and manages to call the heroine to his room. She seems to have an ability to open the gate between the fictional and real world. She looks very friendly, but she's a heroine from a 18+ game, right?

title: Astercys
description: Step into an alternate realm where you traverse through different dimensions, survive spinning battles, and indulge in plenty of pineapple!

title: Kakos
description:
An upcoming card game where you can duel the underground folk. Explore the caves.
Discover the hidden history. But you should NEVER break the rules!

title: Au Revoir
description: Use your investigative skills in this point-and-click adventure to retrieve human minds stored in synthetic brains in 2071. Immerse yourself in a retro-futuristic world with neon-noir graphics from the 90s, and uncover a conspiracy that will challenge everything you know.

title: Kevurah Horror Tale
description: In Kevurah, you drive through a forest where you must reach a funeral that you must organize, bringing the various objects you have in your car into the funeral. All this while something torments and pressures you about the funeral.

title: Touch of Madness
description:
Touch of Madness is a 2D survival horror with 1-bit art. The game is heavily inspired by genre classics, especially Resident Evil and Silent Hill.

Explore the scenarios looking for information and items. Manage your resources through your inventory and survive the horror while trying to uncover the mysteries of the main story.

title: Project Arrow
description: Project Arrow is a 2D platformer game with puzzle environment elements. The game follows the story of an archer cat attempting to find its way home in a strange and mysterious world.

title: Death by Hype
description:
Death by HYPE is a melee Boomer-Shooter focused on fast-paced combat. The game takes place in the middle of the HYPE virus pandemic, and you (as an essential worker) must attend your shift at the beloved restaurant chain KAFC (Karlos Frango Cozinha), to sustain the needs of never-ending HYPEhead shoppers. In an unfortunate-- but predictable turn of events, your coworker bites your hand, and with the imminent infection ready to take its toll, you decide to go out by fullfilling your lifelong dream: taking out your pent up frustration on all your HYPE-ified customers.

Punch, slice, and stab through the maze corridors of the mall. Enter the stores and find out what happened with the other employees and survive as long as you can in this arcade boomer-puncher experience.

title: Winter Winds
description: Winter Winds is a grim fantasy RPG where you play as a mute, recently resurrected sadist with the mission to return the missing sun to the sky.

title: Beauty Jigsaw
description: "Beauty Jigsaw" is a beautiful girl puzzle game with exquisite picture. We recommend that you open this game at your leisure time, while brewing a cup of fragrant coffee, and then enjoy a relaxing puzzle time ^_^

title: Creepypasta Land MV Edition
description: Creepypasta Land MV Edition is the same old Creepypasta Land but with full new graphics, new items, new secrets, new battle system, new maps, extra stories and a lot of new secret stuff!!!

title: Day of Atonement
description: This game is a puzzle based on the Day of Atonement. The player is the High Priest and must complete all the duties for the Day of Atonement.

title: Gilded Gears
description: An action platformer where you are a robot who wakes up in a factory with crazy robots who are definitely not going to be friendly. Escape the factory by using and acquiring skills if you can!!!

title: Dragon Ball Z: Kakarot - Legendary Edition
description:
The Legendary Edition includes:
• Full game
• Season Pass (2 original episodes and a new story arc)
• Season Pass 2 (3 new story arcs)
• 2 Cooking Items that give your character temporary and permanent Stat boosts
• Tao Pai Pai Pillar

Relive the story of Goku and other Z Fighters in DRAGON BALL Z: KAKAROT! Beyond the epic battles, experience life in the DRAGON BALL Z world as you fight, fish, eat, and train with Goku, Gohan, Vegeta and others. Explore the new areas and adventures as you advance through the story and form powerful bonds with other heroes from the DRAGON BALL Z universe.

• Experience the story of DRAGON BALL Z from epic events to light-hearted side quests, including never-before-seen story moments that answer some burning questions of DRAGON BALL lore for the first time!

• Play through iconic DRAGON BALL Z battles on a scale unlike any other. Fight across vast battlefields with destructible environments and experience epic boss battles against the most iconic foes (Raditz, Frieza, Cell, etc.). Increase your power level through RPG mechanics and rise to the challenge!

• Don’t just fight as Z Fighters. Live like them! Fish, fly, eat, train, and battle your way through the DRAGON BALL Z sagas, making friends and building relationships with a massive cast of DRAGON BALL characters.

title: Hipatya in I wanna world
description: Dive into a challenging and exhilarating adventure with "Hipatya in I Wanna World"! Created for the popular streamer Hipatya, this game combines the intense platforming action of "I Wanna Be the Guy" with unique and creative levels designed to introduce newcomers to the thrilling world of precision platformers. Tailored for novices, "Hipatya in I Wanna World" offers a perfect balance of challenge and accessibility, ensuring a rewarding experience for all players.

title: Quest for Jesus
description:
In a pretend educational game about Jesus, you play as Jonas, a guy learning about how awesome Jesus is.

Find Jesus and save another soul, learn about the deadly sins and how to please your Creator.

Though somewhat exaggerated, the game is not made to offend people of any faith or lack thereof, but takes the topic rather lightheartedly. Beware: Even some valid points may occur!

title: Dream Warrior
description: Dream Warrior is a streamlined, retro RPG modeled after the 8-bit classics, but without the filler. Except in this game you are not a great hero. No, you are the town drunk.

title: The Goddess Robbery
description:
This game is a small adventure (point and click) with two scenes, it can be completed in a few minutes.

Robert Robie's passion is to steal artworks. This time he wants the famous Snake Goddess. Can you steal it?

title: Flow Fox
description: Flow Fox is a fast paced precision platformer game, with some foddian elements to it. You start outside and must run across the scenary to the entrance, where you then must climb across different terrains that will demand you to be fast, precise, and think!

title: Ginger Shroom Journey
description: Jump into action in this addictive platformer where your goal is to collect as many coins as you can! Harness the power of mushrooms to find your way out. But beware! Traps and monsters lurk around every corner, ready to challenge your reflexes and strategy. How far can you push yourself?

title: Castaway Coconuts
description: FPS Stealth action game starring the Hanks. Eliminate pirates that have invaded the island and also happen to look like Tom Hanks.

title: NextWorld2
description:
NextWorld2 is a fantasy MMORPG set in the divided world of Kigan, where two rival kingdoms, Selakim and Quila, struggle for dominance. Players can choose from four classes: Warrior, Shaman, Assassin, and Ezra, and explore a vast open world filled with quests, mounts, dungeons, and large-scale community events.

The game emphasizes real-time combat, crafting, exploration, and both PvE and PvP content. Currently available in Hungary, NextWorld2 has thousands of active players and continues to grow with new content and future international expansion plans.

title: Lost in Limbo
description: Face the nightmares of your childhood and unveil the truth behind your summoning to the realm of Limbo. Fight your way back home with the help of seven deities sworn to be your protectors. Will love be the key to your freedom, or the first chapter of your downfall?

title: BigFool
description: A small little game where your friends and you have a once in a lifetime opportunity: Hunt BigFool. BigFool is an elusive, fearsome creature of the night from unknown origins. Explore the Crimblr Forest and various points of interest, keep an eye and an ear out, and take down this iconic beast.

title: Vyanka's Memories
description: Vyanka's Memories is a platform-style game with metroidvania elements. Vyanka is a monster hunter who was called to her home village to protect it from a vampire. In the confrontation, she loses all her memories and powers and must remember them by defeating monsters in different biomes.

title: Gaggi Clicker
description: Welcome to Gaggi Clicker, the ultimate click-and-collect game! Immerse yourself in the world of "Gaggis" – enchanting little creatures just waiting to be collected by you.

title: Rogue Jungle
description: Rogue Jungle is an Action-Roguelike, where you have to fight & explore your way through a procedurally generated jungle. Find new weapons on your journey and face a Boss Enemy at the end of each run!

title: Spitfire: Moonpies Mission
description: Spitfire – Moonpie’s Mission is a side-scrolling rail shooter musical adventure with a handcrafted world, a musical vibe, and a focus on boss battles inspired by the action hero cartoons of the '90s.

title: Haven: Episode 1
description: After apocalypse humanity lives in a huge complex called Haven

title: The Cell
description: A Free Short Game For Ludum Dare 38

title: Super Hook Girl
description:
Freeware grappling hook game released by QPIC in 2014.
It is a predecessor to New Super Hook Girl.

title: Super Hook Girl Gaiden: For Smile Giving Birthday
description:
This is a freeware adventure game released by QPIC in 2017.
It is a spin-off of New Super Hook Girl, and it depicts the protagonist's past.

In-game time progresses as the player performs certain actions, which change the conversation with NPCs, the state of the field, and other aspects of the game.

title: Football Referee Simulator
description: Football Referee Simulator—the groundbreaking mobile game that puts you in the referee's shoes! Are you ready to kickstart your career in the lower divisions and ascend to legendary status by overseeing thrilling finals?

title: To The Grave: The Wildlands of Faenora
description: Inspired by strategy RPG classics, To The Grave: The Wildlands of Faenora is a roguelite tactical RPG where you lead a customizable squad in turn-based combat, navigating dynamic paths, battling mythical creatures, and discovering epic loot in a pixel art medieval fantasy world.

title: Old Coin Pusher Friends 3
description: In this installment, there is a Sugoroku themed around the old Japan, with various events triggered by the squares you land on. Work together with other players to defeat yokai, and aim for the jackpot. As you progress in the game, you can enhance your abilities with various upgrades.

title: Berserk B.I.T.S
description:
Train and level up your B.I.T.S (Battle.Intelligent.Teammate.System). Team up with your digital buddy collect battle chips and take on the internet. Battle viruses explore new biomes and defeat powerful bosses!

Berserk B.I.T.S is an idle-rpg, auto-battler, chip-collecting game that runs on your desktop alongside your other applications. Re-position the game so you can comfortably work and monitor the progress of your B.I.T or minimize it completely and let it go in the background!

Collect and craft a plethora of battle chips to be used in real-time during battle. Each battle chip is placed in an ever growing library that you can strive to fill out. Get medals for completing tasks or kick back and spend time decorating your perfect HOME NET.

Level up your B.I.T by dropping them on a mission and taking on the internet, exploring different biomes! Be involved and monitor their battles and use battle chips you've collected in real time and help your B.I.T succeed - or sit back and relax, work on other tasks while you send your B.I.T to handle business!

title: The Legend of the Blue Sword
description: The evil necromancer has taken over the Castle. As the heroic warrior of this land, it is your task to slay this foul sorcerer and banish him from this realm once and for all.

title: The Jumper Ninja
description: The Jumper Ninja is an exciting action-packed game that puts you in the shoes of a skilled ninja.

title: SiMarket: Supermarket Simulator
description: Manage your supermarket in siMarket! Purchase products, stock shelves, serve customers, hire staff, and expand your store. Can you turn your small shop into a retail empire?

title: HolySpirit
description: Holyspirit is a 2D isometric hack'n'slash game. A hack'n'Slash is an action role playing game, like Diablo. You play a Holyspirit, which is an old corrupted soul who has been enlisted in God's army. You must liberate the country from the evil who has been unleashed against the living ones. The game is developped in C++, with the SFML. Official demo announced for 2011.

title: Genshin Impact: Summertide Scales and Tales
description:
Version 4.8 of Genshin Impact, which includes:
• New character: Emilie
• New limited-time area: Simulanka
• New story quest for Emilie
• New outfits for Nilou and Kirara
• New quality of life features
• New main event: Summertide Scales and Tales
• …and more!

title: Sunes Party
description: It's time to arrange a party, Sune thinks as he lies on the bed and thinks. But he can't put together it himself. So you must help him.

title: Last Epoch: Harbingers of Ruin
description:
The Harbingers of Ruin update comes to Last Epoch.

Join us as the fight for Eterra continues with the launch of Cycle 1.1 - Harbingers of Ruin.

title: Bad Omens: 8th Apartment
description: You play as a student named Lisa, who has just moved in with her university friend. But instead of a carefree student life, Lisa faces events full of despair and fear when she is left alone in her apartment number 8...

title: FelisBelus
description: A funny game to represent our pet cats and keep a record and memory of them forever.

title: The Ghosts of Blackwood Manor
description:
The Ghosts of Blackwood Manor is an award-winning interactive horror from Stefan Vogt, the acclaimed author of Hibernated and The Curse of Rabenstein.

Take on the role of novelist Thomas King and his wife Cora as they move into a remote Scottish manor house, just days before Christmas 1986. Seeking inspiration for his next book, Thomas begins to explore the history of Blackwood Manor, only to uncover a dark secret that dates back centuries to the days of the Great Scottish Witch Hunts.

The Ghosts of Blackwood Manor is a complex interactive fiction piece written in Infocom's advanced Z-machine format XZIP. The game has three different endings, a bad, a neutral and a good ending, depending on the player's choices. It is very likely that the player, on a first playthrough, will not reach the good ending, even though it is possible. Reaching the bad or neutral ending first is part of the experience and helps the player understanding the true intentions of some of the NPCs and the impact of decisions made, so they may be reconsidered.

title: Battle Robots: Confrontation
description: Battle Robots: Confrontation is an online PvP shooter in a sci-fi setting. Construct, upgrade and customise your robots, squad up with other pilots and unleash your power in epic battles on maps with many tactical options!

title: Black State
description: A secret group of scientists called the Architects summons you for a mysterious mission. Save the captives and uncover the truth behind a cataclysmic event. But none of you know what's behind the doors. Are you ready to open them?

title: Darum
description: A mystery behind the human mind (free game)

title: 7imit5
description: A RPGMaker Surreal Horror Game.

title: Night Machine
description: We’ve just learned the Moon is a giant alien doomsday factory, which is kind of a bummer. You've been chosen to operate a spaceship into the core and destroy it for us. Think fast, adapt under pressure, and deploy powerful combinations as you fight your way through in this real-time card battler.

title: NBA 2K25
description: Stack wins, raise banners, and make history in NBA 2K25. Command every court with authenticity and realism Powered by ProPLAY, giving you ultimate control over how you play in NBA 2K25. Define your legacy in MyCAREER, MyTEAM, MyNBA, and The W.

title: Sorcero
description: In Sorcero, your goal is to command thousands of units into epic battles while supporting them with powerful spells cast from your mage tower. The game features both a campaign mode and a skirmish mode. In the campaign, players will face a series of challenging skirmishes, upgrading and choosing their spells and units between battles to prepare for the next encounter.

title: East Wood Carnival
description: A PSX retro horror game made by a sixth grader. Your car runs out of gas on your way to an abandoned carnival now infested with danger at every corner.

title: Watch Dogs 2: San Francisco Edition
description:
Watch Dogs 2 San Francisco Edition Includes:
The Game
Lithographies
24cm Marcus Figure
Map of San Francisco
SF-Themed Laptop Stickers
Exclusive Collector's Box
Use hacking as a weapon in the massive & dynamic open world of Watch Dogs 2.

title: Fishlike
description: High speed microgames involving fish, fishing, and fishlike activities.

title: The Test of Insanity
description: Ever argued with a squirrel? Welcome to The Test of Insanity by Big Nuts! Dive into twisted puzzles, quirky quizzes, and bizarre mini-games. It's not just a game; it's a brain-bending adventure. Think you can outsmart the madness? There's only one way to find out. Play now and embrace the insanity!!

title: Alessia's Dollhouse
description: Alessia's Dollhouse is a first-person psychological horror game that will take your breath away. In the dead of night, on a deserted road, you take on the role of Darren, an ordinary pizza delivery guy, in a creepy dollhouse filled with sinister secrets. But this time, your delivery address will drag you into an unimaginable vortex of horror.

title: Type To Report
description: This is an I'm on observation duty fangame where you need type the location of where the anomaly is to fix anomalies.

title: Delve into Pawssion
description:
Delve into Pawssion is a NSFW Adventure/RPG combined with mild Visual Novel mechanics, such as building up affection with characters, completing their quests, making choices that can alter some scenes, and rewards or reactions from characters.

This game is heavily based on rewarding the player with NSFW art.

title: Double Dragon Revive
description: Double Dragon Revive faithfully reproduces the thrill of old school side-scrolling action games, with updated controls and difficulty settings for the modern era, and utilizing Arc System Works’ fighting game development experience. Jimmy Lee, Billy Lee, Roper, Abobo, and more will appear in stylish 3D.

title: Astoria: Fate's Kiss
description: Just one kiss will change the fate of Olympus forever.

title: Deltarune: Frozen Heart
description: The end of the Snowgrave Route seen from another place. While Kris gets torn to pieces by a bootleg Mettaton NEO, Susie have to face Noelle, lost in the trance of the Thorn Ring, before she freezes her to death! And who knows, maybe the situation can get even worse than that?

title: Cold Shuulathoi
description:
Cold Shuulathoi is an unofficial mod for Doom II.

Doomguy is sent to an Arctic part of Mars to stop the summoning of a demon called the Shuulathoi. The base looks gothic, and some monsters have taken it over.

title: Digital Dreams
description: Digital Dreams is a acid fueled trip into the digital realm, an assault on your senses, and a dive into an alternate reality. A set of 8 maps, mostly around the micro-slaugter/lock in fight framework, but not shy of Tyson designs or platforming only maps.

title: Monuments
description: Three monumental maps (big, bigger, biggest), at least one secret map and a cosy grove to hang out in after completing the final map. The maps are﻿ combat-heavy ﻿and cont﻿ain elements of slaughter,﻿ ﻿﻿but the en﻿emy counts are n﻿o﻿t out of this world and t﻿h﻿e combat is varied in style and intensity.

title: Paint it Doom
description:
Paint it Doom is a conceptual successor to DIY, in that both are made out of solid colors. The sprites aren't crunched in this one though.

The wad is divided into 2 episodes:
Liberal Arts - which is a mainline progression consisting of 19 maps. Some of the later maps are pretty slaughtery.
Radicalized Arts - which is 3 misfit maps that couldn't be reconciled with my vision.

title: Parallel Doomensions
description: DoomWorld community project of 28 Quake 1 styled maps with bespoken music credits by John S. Weekley and Josie Bullock.

title: Plutonic Visions
description: Plutonic Visions is a 22 map wad for The Plutonia Experiment. Features mostly very short, action packed maps inspired by Plutonia's first two episodes, with some longer ones inspired by the final third sprinkled in for good measure.

title: Voyager EP
description: Voyager EP is a single-player/co-op WAD containing five adventurous, space-themed maps, offering a wide range of gameplay experiences ranging from fierce action to gentle exploration. Each map took direct inspiration from one of the five tracks featured on Tristan Clark's Voyager EP, released in 2021. This mapset was created to show our appreciation for @Tristan and his extremely respectable body of work, musical and otherwise, and additionally to commemorate his 27th birthday this July!

title: Shift 87
description:
Shift 87 is a first person observation horror game.
Keen investigators can find a total of 66 anomalies throughout 3 levels of handcrafted, highly atmospheric environments.

Runs are randomly generated, featuring small and subtle as well as horrifying and unmissable anomalies to provide a gameplay experience that is uniquely different and exciting each time. Players can expect a playtime of around 2-3 hours for a full playthrough.

title: Retail Company Simulator
description: Run your retail company in this free prologue version of the game. Sign contracts with leading brands, order new products, meet customer needs, and never let your customers leave the store empty-handed. Hire new workers, expand your store, and enjoy the growth of your retail company.

title: Les Guignols de l'info… le jeu !
description: Les Guignols De L'Info...Le Jeu ! is a point-and-click game based on a French satirical TV program. You play as a new TV reporter who has just joined the WCI, an information channel. Your goal is to get the best scoop from famous people from various fields such as sports, politics, and movies. Your ultimate aim is to replace the main presenter, PPDA. The game does not have an inventory system; instead, you are equipped with a video camera that has a limited battery. You must record pictures and/or sounds that align with your mission briefing, but you have to make choices quickly as there are many characters to interact with and a time limit. The game occasionally includes puzzle elements, such as creating a "portrait robot" or selecting the right dialogue.

title: World Crafter TD
description:
A highly addictive survival crafting tower defense game!
Gather, craft, build turrets, shoot guns, and expand the land to defend against waves of enemies in World Crafter TD!

title: Step by Little Step
description:
Bring your cat back to the world of the living.
The rules are simple, as they are familiar:
Do not look back.
and everything will be just the way it was before.

title: Planet Coaster 2
description: Dive into the thrilling world of Planet Coaster 2! Construct the theme park of your dreams with an intuitive piece-by-piece building system, as you meticulously craft and customise every aspect of your park down to the smallest detail. From towering rollercoasters to spectacular twisting water slides, let your imagination reach new heights to delight and thrill your guests.

title: Pokémon Hidden Place
description: A Pokémon fangame.

title: Fontemon
description: Fontemon is a Pokémon parody, made with a game engine inside a font. This means the game runs wherever you can install and choose a font. The game is structured akin to a "choose your own adventure".

title: Stress
description: Survival horror adventure game with rpg elements, set on dystopian town under a zombie outbreak of unknown origin. The player must investigate, solve puzzles and fight zombies to survive and uncover the truth behind the disaster. Gather weapons and resources to defend yourself from the "returned" and avoid getting infected and suffering of 'stress', which will accelerate the infection.

title: Subspace Continuum
description: Subspace Continuum is a player-maintained online shoot ‘em up game enjoyed by people from all around the world - many of whom remain addicted to the fast paced explosive battles! Gameplay is extremely competitive and there are cup leagues, tournaments, cash prize events, a variety of team & squad based competitions. This completely free game also has a pretty interesting player community with its own history which is so in-depth that books could probably be written about it!

title: Vanity Fair: The Pursuit
description: Players follow Lu Yuan through important stages of his life and experience his growth trajectory from youth to maturity. It will take you to relive those decisions that you have never tried to make in reality, and feel the different life brought about by each choice.

title: Late Night at the KWL
description:
Years ago, I worked for a radio station. The KWL.

Strange place.
It didn't run any songs, or interviews, or news. Just stories. Any genre. Any length. So long as it was original.
I was one of the two people in charge of writing them.

We worked nights to have everything ready for the morning recording.

I still remember the night I decided to quit.

title: An Other Golf Game
description:
An Other Golf Game is not your typical openish world sandbox life-sim survival golf game experience featuring permadeath. Finally, now you can suck at golf virtually as much as you suck in real life.

You'll learn the art of golf on your own terms: picking clubs, assessing the wind, and, of course, tracking down that stray ball no matter where it lands. It’s a game for those who want to discover, adapt, and make every inch of progress on their own.

Beyond the golf course, life goes on—literally. You're living out entire days, where golfing may or may not be part of it, it's entirely up to you. You’ll have to keep yourself alive, managing food, water, and sleep while earning enough cash through odd jobs to keep your golfing dream alive.

It’s a game that tests patience, resourcefulness, and adaptability. If you’re willing to roll with the quirks, laugh off the Early Access growing pains, you might just discover an experience that’s both unexpectedly rewarding and thoroughly unconventional.

Welcome to An Other Golf Game. Good luck out there, and happy golfing… if you can survive long enough to get to it!

title: State of Presence
description: State of Presence is a point-and-click visual novel that toys with the concept of existence and physicality. Players will delve into the afterlife of Kacper Takarski as he copes with his untimely death and the new environment he's found himself in. Exploring an unfamiliar city, Kacper must string together the remnants of his past in order to understand what became of him.

title: Sunky the PC Port
description: An awesome parody of SONIC-PC (by JoeDoughBoi and John-Kun) in which Sunky needs to invite 1 more friend to start a DANCE PARTY!

title: Blaze From Outer Space
description: Blaze crashes upon a planet and needs to find a way to escape from there

title: Y
description: Text-less adventure

title: DeckHex
description: Dark Sci-fi Adventure

title: Class of '09: The Flip Side
description: The final chapter of the Class of '09 VN series... this time from a different perspective! Join Nicole's best friend Jecka as you help her navigate the pitfalls of post-grad life! See what 2009 was truly like in this fully voiced interactive sitcom!

title: Feed Da King
description: An idle clicker game that features moments of active and passive play, with a dynamic window system that allows you to toggle the game on top of other applications and adjust it to your preference.

title: Champion's Ashes
description: Champion's Ashes is a mod for Dark Souls III that overhauls the game by enhancing and balancing various elements. It introduces new gameplay mechanics, such as improved combat and altered enemy placements. The mod also adds new items, weapons, and spells while rebalancing existing content to create a more challenging and refined experience.

title: RandoJumper
description: A precision platformer of a pirate who is out there to prove himself that he can reach the top!

title: Pixel With Your Friends
description: Pixel With Your Friends is a color-by-numbers game where you have to restore artworks pixel by pixel for a museum. You can color the artworks alone or together with a friend online.

title: Assassin's Creed Revelations - Signature Edition
description:
The pre-order version available at North American Gamestop locations.

The Signature Edition of the game includes:
• A bonus singleplayer gameplay mission (Vlad the Impaler's Tomb)
• An exclusive multiplayer character (Ottoman Jester)
• Weapons capacity upgrades (Crossbow, bomb, and gun)
• An animated short film based on the "Assassin's Creed" universe (Assassin's Creed Embers)
• An "Assassin's Creed Revelations" original game score soundtrack

title: Undertale Green
description: Undertale Green is a Fangame project where you follows the fifth human, Olive, the soul of kindness through their journey into the underground, in order to find the king of monsterkind. But will they makes friend on the road ? it's up to you to decide their fate, in brand new areas, and with brand new monsters to discover!

title: Mega Man Sunrise
description: A Gameboy Mega Man inspired fangame. After Dr. Light created a new highly intelligent robot by the name of "Trance", Dr. Wily manages to kidnap her and reprogram her for his evil purposes. It's up to Mega Man to once again put a stop to Dr Wily's evil scheme and bring back Trance to reason.

title: Mischief Castle
description: This is a Platformer Adventure Game for the NES, with gameplay similar to other platforms of that time. Simple jump and shoot. Navigate five maze levels each with unique enemies and bosses. Find hidden secrets and power-ups.

title: Finding Buddies
description: Daniel has just started his adult life. Despite his sad past, he managed to move on and re-socialize. So many responsibilities are coming and it is up to you to decide how he will handle all of this. The great thing is that maybe you can find some cute guys along your path

title: Tube Noodles
description:
Last night you tried this new "tube noodles" stuff for dinner. It tasted just... ok.

Now, why is your stomach speaking to you? And why does it keep telling you to EAT?

title: House of Torment
description:
Experience the chilling terror of "House of Torment," a gripping horror game where you, Andrew Carter, wake up lost in a dark forest with no memory of how you arrived and only a flashlight to guide you. Desperate for shelter, you stumble upon a mysterious house. Inside, you must uncover the dark secrets of its infamous owner, the renowned streamer Asmongold.

Navigate eerie rooms, solve intricate puzzles, and avoid terrifying encounters, as you are not a fighter. Survival depends on your wits and stealth. With stunning graphics and immersive sound design, your journey through the House of Torment will be a spine-chilling experience.

Can you unravel the mysteries and escape the house? Download now and face your fears.

title: Sonic The Fighters Blitz Hyper Edition
description: Sonic The Fighters Blitz Hyper Edition (STFBHE) is the continuation of Sonic the Fighters Blitz (STFB), a 2D re-imagining of the arcade game Sonic The Fighters created by Restless Dipstick. STFBHE aims to rebalance and expand upon the original STFB.

title: The Last Goodbye
description: In the shadowy fairy tale metropolis of Prava, the world-weary gun-for-hire Lucille - better known on the streets as The Banshee - takes a job from enigmatic entrepreneur Ark McLean. Her target: Bullseye, the deadliest gangster in town. On her travels through the criminal underworld she meets all manner of friends and foes, with plenty of action and intrigue along the way.

title: Ferral Quest
description:
Open world. With different biomes: forest, jungle, desert, wasteland snowy, volcanic. In addition to dozens of dungeons to explore and hidden secrets.
Open world PVE missions, special dungeons.
Raid Bosses and Wanderers to hunt scattered around the world.
Progression from Tier 0 to Tier 10.
Develop your skill tree to make your character unique.
Different buffs and equipment so you can forge your strategy in battle.
Get the best equipment by destroying big bosses in their dungeons.

title: Dooming The Bar
description:
Dooming The Bar is a project centered on bringing the Half-Life 2 beta's City 17 into Doom, composed of a fully playable 8-map journey from the Industrial sector through to Kleiner's lab as per 2001 and 2002 concepts, plus two bonus maps.

You'll see famous landmarks like the Stenographer's Chasm, Terminal Plaza (with pendulum script!), Consulcast, Manhack Arcade (both versions!) and more on your travels.

title: Peacely Online
description:
Embark on an epic adventure in Peacely Online, a captivating 2D top-down pixel art MMORPG. Enter the peaceful world of Peacely, a realm without ego,

Explore diverse maps, complete thrilling quests, and battle fearsome monsters to progress through the game. Collect gear and items from loot drops and customize your character.

Start your journey in Peacely Ville, where you have a cozy home to return to and numerous NPCs to interact with. Alongside loyal pets that aid in your battles and a vibrant community of players to chat with, Peacely Online promises an immersive and enjoyable gaming experience.

title: Virtual Firearm Simulations
description: Virtual Firearm Simulations is a low-poly gun building simulator with over 40 accurately modeled weapons.

title: AI Senshi Neuro-sama
description: A 2D "beat'em up" fan game based on the Neuro-sama universe with hand-drawn graphics and animation, made in 2024 by a solo developer Azzypics.

title: Was God Birthed!?
description: Explore a lush, liminal museum with surreal suprises at every turn as you avoid your dad with your wits and scooter, and make it downstairs in time to catch the Club Ruby Rave!

title: Nobunaga's Ambition: Kakushin - Power Up Kit
Nobunaga's Ambition: Reppuuden - Power Up Kit
Nobunaga's Ambition: Soutenroku - Power Up Kit
1987: Rescue in Berlin
description: Will you be able to find the floppy disk and return safely?

title: StreamerBeater
description: It's free, try it ;) Third person souls-like featuring a solid combat mechanic, 5 explorable levels, 3 big boss fights, mobs, cutscenes, unlockables, and a main story.

title: The Case Book of Arne: Interlude
description:
Get a taste of Lynn and Arne's everyday life between cases!
There's a lot more to Lynn's life in the other world than you see in the main story!
Take the curious events at the Lugenberg Festival...
Unravel a new mystery in this Interlude chapter,
which takes place between Cases 1 and 2.

title: WhereHurt
description: Immerse yourself in WhereHurt, a psycho-horror game where reality and nightmare collide. Navigate your home, city, and workplace, racing against time to escape inner demons and societal mental barriers. Can you solve the puzzles and confront your fears, or will you be lost forever?

title: Souvenirs
description: Explore a house in search of Leonardo's memories. Souvenirs is a merge like strategy game, created by a tiny independent French studio.

title: Son and Bone
description: Son and Bone is a fast-paced first-person shooter where you take on the role of Sam Judge, a Sheriff, that after tracking down a notorious bandit who attacked a farm and kidnapped a local, has found himself on an alien world overrun by prehistoric creatures and dinosaurs.

title: Cluminati
description: Test your linguistic skills in Cluminati, a puzzle word game where you decipher clues to unlock passwords and join a secret society. Use your wits while racing against time to advance through 13 challenging rounds of initiation.

title: Street Fighter 6: Year 2 Character Pass
description:
The Street Fighter 6: Year 2 Character Pass includes 4 characters as they are released, Outfit 1 colors 3-10 for those characters and 4200 drive tickets.

The characters included are M. Bison, Terry, Mai and Elena.
Terry and Mai from Fatal Fury will be the first guest characters to appear in the main Street Fighter series.

title: Memory Ghosts
description: A paranormal otome where there's no escape from what haunts you.

title: Big Boo's Haunt
description: This map is based on Big Boo's Haunt from Super Mario 64 but with changes/improvements all over the place (for instance, you can actually see through all the windows, which you couldn't in Super Mario 64).

title: Lethal Lava Land
description: A map based on Lethal Lava Land from Super Mario 64.

title: Shifting Sand Land
description: A map based on Shifting Sand Land from Super Mario 64.

title: Wet-Dry World
description: A map loosely based on Wet-Dry World from Super Mario 64.

title: Tick Tock Clock
description: A Duke map based on the Super Mario 64 course of the same name (and not based on the Mario Kart course of the same name).

title: L.A. Meltdown 2047
description: A large map that reinterprets all of episode 1: L.A. Meltdown.

title: Shrapnel City 2096: Trapped In The Future!
description: Just like L.A. Meltdown 2047 did with episode 1, Shrapnel City 2096: Trapped In The Future! reinterprets all of episode 3 in just one big level.

title: Winterfall
description: After a few days of R&R, Duke Nukem returned to his work for EDF. Now he's a Detective Nukem and his job is to look after the Little Bigville, the little snow town on the edge of nowhere....

title: Pyratel
description: This map is partially inspired by a known pyramid-shaped hotel in Las Vegas.

title: Der Zorn Gottes
description: A map that takes place on an oil drilling platform.

title: Poison Heart
description: Poison Heart is a snowy city / Xmas-themed / hi-tech level that should last you about 50 mins on your first playthrough.

title: Factory Parking
description: A Doom-style map (more abstract and less realistic, among other things) that takes place in some parking lots/garages that have been invaded by the aliens.

title: Precipice Pain
description: A Doom-style map that revolves around a big vaguely hellish rock formation, on which Duke has to "climb" (jump, fall off ledges, etc.) up and down a lot.

title: Yami no Koe II
description: Sayoko sends K off the island to a secluded private academy, where she makes an ally of the principal and begins to influence the students and faculty, slowly degenerating the entire school. However, one of the students is a miko who resists K's influence.

title: Flowers: Kokoro no Hana
description: Ryusei Ryousen is a 2nd year high school student. His school has just recently been co-educated from all girls school. There are only three boys in school and a lot of wonderful girls around the hero. Which one will be chosen by the April?

title: Brutalist
description: Brutalist is a third-person meditative game where you need to follow paths, find passages, solve riddles, watch out for radiation and monitor oxygen levels. And all this is surrounded by an atmospheric abandoned concrete world.

title: Sector 666
description: 10 levels created by modder Skillsaw in 1998 famously his first work.

title: Duke Tournament
description: It has one single-player episode "Annihilation" (of five levels) & a dukematch episode of eight levels.

title: Shocking Twist
description: A new single map by Magnarj

title: MSSP8
description: Typical city level - more city style than O'Boy was.

title: MSSP 9: New Pietniemi
description: A "New LA" type map with some "Freeway" and V5 influences thrown in as well. The map is named after the neighborhood where Mikko Sandt grew up.

title: Chillin'
description: This map focuses on an alien spacecraft and some buildings around where it landed; by the time Duke gets there, there are way too many aliens in the area just kinda chillin'.

title: Sikhl
description: Sikhl is set somewhere in the southwestern USA. There's been various reports of EDF troops getting fired upon by unknown assailants near a vast canyon area. Duke's been ordered to travel there and find out what's going on.

title: Nuclear Plant 2024
description: Nuclear Plant 2024 is a map of Doom: E1M2 but Reimagined!

title: The Immortal Lock
description:
You are Ranger, an operator of the UTJR stationed at a secret, multinational research facility in Finland. You are being deployed to investigate the disappearance of a survey team that went missing beyond the slipgate, cast into the farthest reaches of existence. Yet through the thin veil of reality, you find only a desolate plane of flesh and despair, and a dread voice that beckons your name.

This map is larger than an entire episode, if played in its entirety, and is best experienced in segments. It includes a story, extremely challenging fights, trick jumping, and a vast amount of large secret areas, but is difficulty scaled to accommodate everyone.

title: Site Z-374
description: An expanded version of ExaByt's Quake Brutalist Jam 2 map and now using Alkaline.

title: Missing Coordinates
description: A short map based on Markie's Quake Builder Block 1.

title: 1024 Cement Mixer
description: A short aggressive map within a 1024 player-bound volume.

title: Osterity
description:
Burdensome regulations have long stymied the United Aerospace Corporation's ability to innovate in the energy sector. However, recent pro-business rulings represent a welcome change of pace, clearing the way for us to open an exciting new facility in the Lone Star State. Come on down 'n' see us sometime, y'all!

OSTERITY is a 7+1 map vanilla "mega episode" for the Doom 2 IWAD, powered by OTEX. A 3-episode, Doom 1-inspired megawad squeezed into just 7 maps. The basic formula is to alternate sprawling megamaps with short boss/challenge maps, though the rules are bent a little towards the end.

title: E4M1 remake
description: It's a short map (5-10 minutes) inspired by E4M1. The visuals are kept minimal to stay true to the spirit of the original map.

title: 17 Bucks: Floor 1
description: 17 Bucks is a Friday Night Funkin' mod centering around internet personas and original characters.

title: Memoirs of an Angel
description: A fantasy-themed otome visual novel with stat-building and mini-games.

title: Restless Dreams
description: Before you realize it, dreams have become a curse. Wander through a darkened room and descend into the depths of her mind. A story-driven first-person horror game that leads you into an abyss of anguish and despair. Dedicated to those who once pursued their dreams—and to those who still do.

title: My Buddy Did Something Weird And Now I Have Feelings For Him??!?!?
description:
Can one little thing change the way you feel about someone?

Everything points to 'yes' when Vale and Lawrence's Quality Bro Time becomes a little too cozy…And gay panic ensues.

title: Blitz
description: Blitz is a challenging, fast-paced platformer with infinite procedurally generated levels. Build a new unique character each run and fight one action-packed room after another! Dropkick, decapitate, and incinerate your foes. Do you have what it takes to conquer Blitz?

title: Cinematic Mod
description:
What is Cinematic Mod?

Cinematic Mod (CM) is a Half-Life 2 modification, that adds more details and a darker look to the original Half-Life 2 series.

Imagine, a Hollywood producer got his hands on the game. The result would be similar to what the Cinematic Mod is: a graphics blockbuster, redesigned to the typical game to movie adaption with an orchestral soundtrack and beautiful people everywhere.

title: 2121 AD
description: Duke has traveled a century into the future, to the year 2121 A.D. He was invited there not only to fight off the latest swarm of invaders, but also to be a special guest on a Los Angeles TV talk show about time travelers.

title: Seedsow Lullaby
description: "My mother, my daughter, and me—three sixteen-year-olds on an extraordinary adventure."After traveling through time to meet their sixteen-year-old counterparts, three generations of women set off on an adventure through the Land of the Gods. What could await them at the end of their journey?

title: Slaughterfest
description: A very hard map filled with all sorts of monsters. Slaughterfest takes place in a seaside town and you start with no weapons.

title: Sludge Plunge
description: Sludge Plunge is a map set in swamp area.

title: Grey Lights
description: A hub-style city map with all the usual urban locations from Shop-n-Bags to Sushi restaurants

title: Close Range
description: Duke is now forced to deal with everything from simple Troopers to fat Commanders using nothing but his mighty boot and tripmines.

title: Naked Dash
description: Duke has been captured yet again! This time things are looking real bad: aliens took Duke to their base and put him in a prison cell. Our hero must survive a venture through the "Naked Dash": a surreal office complex built by aliens for entertainment purposes and filled with deadly traps and puzzles. Will Duke be able to make it through this doomed office fortress which took lives of many men before him? More importantly, will you help him escape?

title: Canyon
description: Survive in the desert by hunting prey, and evolve as you raise your kids and help them reach adulthood. You are a lizard that founded its den after being stranded in a canyon land. There are dangers around that can surprise you and the risk of starvation is looming over you and your children.

title: Elemental Cube
description: "Elemental Cube" takes you on a challenging and thought-provoking journey through a magical world. This single-player puzzle game consists of 50 unique levels, each requiring players to overcome obstacles with strategy, logic, and creativity. At the heart of the game is a mystical cube, with each face representing one of the four fundamental elements: fire, water, earth, and air.

title: Ruinas
description: Duke has gotten lost and ended up in some unknown ruins plagued by aliens. Duke will have to manage to find his way out of the ruins.

title: Hostile Terrain
description: This map is based on a Quake map all the way from 1997 called F**ing hostile.

title: Pjsloth1
description: A simple layout built into outdoor terrain with a heavy focus on combat.

title: Racing Bros: Mafias Revenge
description: Welcome to a new racing bros party adventure that will challenge your skills once more. Try the epic extraction challenge across the world or fight against your friends in crazy party modes. Are you ready for some more racing bros?

title: The Aztec Ruins
description: Aztec temple inspired map.

title: Tropical Alien Massacre
description: Small city map located on a tropical island.

title: Duke 3:16
description: Duke is off relaxing in a secret location. The aliens have infiltrated EDF headquarters and taken key leadership hostage. The ransom is the location of Duke.The aliens are methodically cutting off all escape routes. The only way left out is through the tunnel at the railstation.

title: Duke 6:8
description: Duke 6:8 picks up where Duke 23:4 left. Duke must find his way through a dam in order to exact vengeance on his treacherous EDF buddies.

title: Duke 12:12
description: Duke is back in town after having cleared a nearby dam of alien scum in Duke 6:8.

title: Puzzle Dungeon!!: Earthmage Erin
description:
Puzzle Dungeon!! is a series of games where fantasy classes solve puzzles themed after their abilities!

In Puzzle Dungeon!!: Earthmage Erin, play as Erin, an Earthmage with the power to control gravity. Solve 30+ puzzles in themed dungeons to rescue Erin's lost goats and bring them back to her farm.

title: Jade Base
description: This level is a sequel to the Alien Planet. Duke arrives at moon of the planet Jade.

title: Mind Storm
description: This level is inspired by other bizarre-like levels:Asylum, Bizarre, Phantasm

title: Transport 2
description: This map is a sequel to jade base. It's a large, sometimes difficult level which should provide a challenge to even the most seasoned of players

title: Dawn in Arctic
description: In the end you stand on the cliff... silence... after the battle sun has risen... It is the very end...

title: Alien Space Station
description: Duke infiltrates an alien space station in orbit around Earth. His job is to kill everything that moves and take out the control room.

title: 15 Minutes
description: Reality shifts. Time loops. You're trapped underground with only 15 minutes and something’s changing the rules. Spot the anomalies. Find the way out before the map turns against you or you might just run out of time. What you see may not be real.

title: Popcorn Fever
description:
Popcorn Fever is a “suika game” featuring popcorns, developed by Yunicorn Studio !

Need a coffee break, stuck in a long commute, or just want to pass the time? Start a game and merge as many popcorns as you can!

Aim, drop, and merge the popcorns to score points. Customize your game by unlocking unique and surprising powers. Find your own style and climb the leaderboard !

Will you reach the top of the best player pantheon?!

title: Nordhold
description:
Build a city and defend it in this Tower Defense game blending Roguelite mechanics with turn-based building Strategy. Choose your hero, utilize synergistic tower upgrades, and face epic battles in procedurally generated landscapes.

Nordhold is a tower defense game for strategy enthusiasts who crave high replayability through endless combinations. Build and manage a cozy medieval Nordic village while enjoying deep tactical gameplay that doesn’t require extensive learning.

title: You Have To Climb Out
description: A short puzzle/story game about a frog who has fallen into a cave after digging too deep

title: Bou's Revenge
description: A short 3D horror inspired by Pou the famous mobile game. the game starts with you taking care of Bou but then things starts to get weird...

title: Arc Nova Base
description: A huge space-station where things have gone awry

title: Underground Fortress
description: The sequel to West Alien Train.

title: West Alien Train
description: Duke must find an alien semi-organic train that is heading west and wipe all those aliens before they trash the next city

title: Alien Sanctuary
description: An alien base on a distant planet.

title: The Sub Shop
description: Duke finds himself in a rocky area close to the sea.

title: Seaquest
description: This time Duke is sent to some sort of a submarine base. The alien vermin has taken over a fortress by the sub base and it's your job to cleanse 'em out.

title: Wang Nukem
description: An urban map with a street section and a train station inspired by Shadow Warrior.

title: Castle Karthenfrost
description: A Medium-to-large Knave map which uses Arcane Dimensions, set in the cold wasteland realm of Karthenfrost. Has a moderate amount of monsters.

title: High Noon In Akhetaten
description: A Quake map largely based off of Serious Sam's Karnak level.

title: The Monastery of Mount Cinburron
description: Command noticed an anomaly in their Slipgate network. After sending a few scouting parties into the anomaly, none of which have returned, they are starting to fear the worst. They sent you in to investigate the anomaly and report your findings upon your return.

title: Silver Gene: The Mutia Chronicle 1
description:
The protagonist, a university student named Yuji Shibata, encounters a naked girl crouching in a garbage dump one night. The girl has animal ears and a tail, unlike a human, and she has lost her memory. The protagonist names her "Mii" and takes her in, helping her to regain her memory. Who exactly is she?

This game is a remake of "Radical Sequence" the first in the Gao Gao! Series released by Four-Nine, consisting of 8 chapters and progresses as a traditional ADV where you make choices. the game featured command selections like "look" and "talk," like many other PC-9801 ADV but in this revamped entry commands have been removed for smoother progression.

title: Yuugao
description: Infamous doujin game also known as Cruel Kanon.

title: Honkai: Star Rail - Finest Duel Under the Pristine Blue
description:
Version 2.4 of Honkai: Star Rail, which includes:
• New characters: Yunli and Jiaoqiu
• New path for March 7th: The Hunt
• New Trailblaze Continuance: Finest Duel Under the Pristine Blue
• New area: The Shackling Prison
• …and more!

title: Murder in the Maze
description: Play as Mappy , as you go from game to game, looking for clues to solve the murder of Pac-Man!

title: Alter A.I.L.A. Genesis
description:
Alter A.I.L.A. Genesis is an expanded and heavily reworked remake of the original Alter A.I.L.A., with a completely redesigned combat system and the multiple story paths removed in favor of a single, longer, slightly more humorous storyline.

The game takes place in a post-apocalyptic world. You play the role of a young man known as Leon, who seeks to survive in the harsh environment he is brought into.

Exploration is done mainly via a side-scrolling view. In certain areas, an exclamation mark will sometimes appear, indicating the presence of hostiles. Press Z when this happens to initiate battle, or wait to let it pass. Sometimes battle will be unavoidable. When walking, enemy encounters won't occur.

The battle system revolves mainly around each character's Abilities, which are a set of commands specific to that character. Abilities require AP and EX to use. AP is gained every time a character takes a turn.

title: Waco Resurrection
description: Revisiting the 1993 Waco, Texas incident, gamers enter the mind and form of a resurrected David Koresh and advance towards salvation or destruction by wielding weapons, collecting followers and voicing messianic messages.

title: Train Sim World 4: LIRR Commuter - New York: Long Beach, Hempstead & Hicksville
description: Time to truly experience America's busiest commuter railroad in Train Sim World 4! Return to Long Island and delve deep into an enhanced New York - Hicksville, now including the Long Beach branch, new lighting and skies, overhauled signalling, an all-new bustling timetable, and the LIRR M9!

title: Unravel Trigger
description:
The Frost Neutral Territory - a buffer zone between the superpowers of the Karg Federation and the Vilcar Empire. A tourist hotspot, yet a melting pot of constant conflict with its diverse immigrant populations.

Sakaki Kai, the protagonist, is an investigator at the Trigger Detective Agency based on this neutral ground. His mission? To track down his childhood friend Yuzuriha Saina, who vanished during the last great war.

While there have been scattered sightings of Saina in this area, her trail has gone cold.

Then, from a hilltop overlooking the city, Kai crosses paths with Millie - a young girl reaching up towards the sky. Much like Saina from years past, Millie laments the endless cycle of violence and yearns for peace. This meeting isn't just a big deal for Kai or the neutral district—it will shake things up for the whole world.

A tale of confronting lost pasts to stride towards a new future - the curtain rises here.

title: Filler
description: The aliens have taken over another city and it's your mission to kill them all and find your way to the bus station, hop a bus, and get out.

title: The End of the World
description: Yet another city at night - except this particular one is under a pretty fucking serious type of attack. You wake up to an alien ship having just crashed right down your apartment building.

title: Wide Awake!
description: A city block at night. Local amenities include a swimming pool, apartments, a grocery store, a sewer system and more. Duke wakes up in his hotel room, finds out that the city is under attack.

title: Tit-E-Bar
description: It's a direct continuation to Koodbool, but way closer to the original Duke 3D base level format with a layout-centric theme, falling under the Old Limits and with a non-Euclidian progression inspired by Lunatic Fringe.

title: Downtown Ride
description: A medium sized city map.

title: SM64 The Green Stars PC
description: A port of SM64 The Green Stars playable on PCs.

title: The Last Pissed Time
description: Duke is held hostage in a prison cell by those alien bastards. He must escape and shut down their power plant.

title: Koodbool
description: Neo L.A.: the distant future of 2024. Retired for eons since a series of legal disputes, Duke Nukem is off to a literal fresh start, festively spending Christmas eve alone, homeless and panhandling.

title: Hostile Waters
description: Once more duke finds himself in the middle of a hostile situation, this time aboard a half flooded nuclear submarine, grounded on the rocks in the middle of the ocean on a dark stormy night.

title: Big Orbit
description: A large starship orbiting earth which duke will dock within a shuttle

title: Quest
description: Duke Nukem mysteriously lands in the Underworld. This world is very different from our world. There are no police, no beer, and no girls. Duke Nukem has to find his way out. The only way out is through the demonic portal, can he survive?

title: Apprehension Arizona
description: A map set around the Arizona desert in which Duke must infiltrate a former EDF base that has been overrun by alien maggots.

title: Baptized In Lunar Dust
description: A linear moon base map. The sequel to Apprehension Arizona.

title: Downtown Journey
description: An entire new episode for Duke Nukem 3D Atomic made in a Pentium MMX.

title: Duke Craft
description:
Duke Craft is a combination of DN3D mechanics and Minecraft-like level design. The story is simple - aliens stole Duke's hard earned diamonds and he has to get them back.

The map includes some features taken from Minecraft, like crafting or using of torches to light the areas.

title: Duketroid
description: A conceptual Duke map which replicates the fundamental game design concept behind Super Metroid, Castlevania: Symphony of the Night and many others in that genre.

title: Siebenpolis
description: A city at night with mostly vertical action and a yellow GB-esque colour pallette.

title: Duke 2070
description: Made for the 9th annual map contest of Duke España. It's a very large city from the author of the Doom II Planisphere (extremely large city) levels.

title: The Rock
description: You are on a island prison and have to fight your way through from the front gate right into the heart of the prison

title: Turnpike
description: A (very loose) remake of the classic Duke 3D episode 3 secret level by Allen Blum, "Freeway", originally started during a Duke4.net "mappening"

title: Salvage Title
description: A speedmap in an urban, junkyard & drive-in theather-themed level, with emphasis on layout & flow.

title: Bloodstone Courtyard
description: A short doom-style level.

title: Mega Plaza Shopping Center
description: Aliens captured a shopping center in Los Angeles.

title: Anorak City
description: A grand city map while being the sequel to Happy Hangover and the prequel to Bottles to The Ground

title: Daggers Cavern
description: Duke comes across a pirate hide-out in an underground cavern.

title: Supa3
description: Another city map, covered in beautiful snow!

title: Supersonic Mario
description: Supersonic Mario puts Mario from Super Mario 64 into Rocket League.

title: Duke Mansion
description: Haunted Mansion community CBP map in the spirit of Halloween.

title: Bridge Between Two Islands
description: Duke's mission is to destroy the big gun on the top of the island.

title: Doombox
description: Doombox is a survival bullet-heaven roguelike where a bazillion creatures emerge from somewhere. Craft a bunch of nifty guns, wear silly hats, and kill the crap out those creatures with over-the-top builds all fueled by the power of your DOOMBOX

title: 2-Hour Community Build Project
description: A community project with the simple rule: No more than 2 hours to add to the level. The end result was this large, incredible map.

title: Community Build Project 9: Halloween-2020
description: A community map that is similar to an episode, separated by portals.

title: 1.5-Hour Community Build Project
description: Compared to previous 1/2-hour CBPs, which had several people working on a single map, this 1.5-hour CBP had several people each working on their own mini maps.

title: Suburban Hive
description: Suburban Hive is a large map which owns hundred aliens to blast

title: Suburban Hive II: Crimson Moon
description: Crimson Moon is the sequel to Suburban Hive, made by dozens of talented mappers.

title: Viking Heroes V: Collector's Edition
description: Embark on a festive journey as the vikings prepare for Yule!

title: Scoop it! Goldfish
description:
It's time for a carnival game classic: goldfish scooping!
Scoop as many as you can and become a master!

title: Monument: Invasion
description: Old-school first person shooter

title: Neckbreak
description: Fight your way out in this dirty retro-styled tactical FPS.

title: Mystery Detective Adventure
description: Mystical events haunt locals.

title: Hole Theory
description: Eat everything

title: Musician Simulator
description: Make your career as a musician. Start as a street singer, become DJ in local pub, organize concert at a local hall, play at a largest music festival in your country. Create your own live music using musical instruments. Sing using real microphone in karaoke mode. Become a worldwide known musician.

title: Let's Aim Shooting Gallery
description:
Gear up for a carnival game classic: shooting gallery!
Hit as many targets as you can and become a shooting gallery master!

title: Starslave
description: An Egyptian ruin with a dark secret. Contains a story, lots of quad runs, randomized elements, and plenty of secrets. Runs on the Copper mod, which is included.

title: Construction Simulator: Customization Kit
description: The construction site is your runway, so pimp your helmets and bring some color to your construction work! The Customization Kit contains additional styles for your personal protection equipment. Customize your helmets with 9 different fun and colorful designs, ranging from fiery flames to classy dots, and choose from a selection of ear protection and glasses.

title: Torture Jam 1
description: The God of flesh and desire has such sights to show you. But in order to be granted that privilege, he demands tribute in form of good suffering. He has graciously given Map-Center's community time to create a Strogg inspired torture maps worthy of his magnificence. Featuring seven new maps, a hub level, final boss and several intermissions.

title: Boss Speedjam 1
description: A short expansion, featuring a hub level and several new maps where each boss encounter is more than just shooting a bullet sponge.

title: Blake Turner: Ace Attorney
description: A little girl is found dead at the foot of a cliff, but her body suffered such injuries that it is not identified. A clumsy witness, a shabby prosecutor and a sharp attorney may lead to a "Not Guilty". Then who did really kill her?

title: NTE: Neverness to Everness
description: NTE: Neverness to Everness is a supernatural open-world RPG developed by Hotta Studio. The story begins in the city of Hethereau, where you play as its first "unlicensed" Anomaly Hunter. You'll join the crew at Eibon, a rundown antique shop that keeps the lights on by taking Anomaly commissions from anyone willing to pay. Alongside a diverse cast of extraordinary companions, you'll unravel urban mysteries, ride out adventures full of laughs and heartbreak, and write your own stories in the neon-lit streets.

title: So Many Words
description: Find the hidden word, each word guess is met with feedback indicating the correctly positioned letters. This is a word game that requires mastery of the English language, logic and a bit of luck. Choose to test your skills with words ranging from 4 to 9 letters in length.

title: ShedHorror
description:
You've cornered yourself in a tiny shed in an attempt to hide from the creature that has been hunting you down. Now your best chance at survival is to keep the creature at bay from within the shed until dawn. However, all you have to work with is a flashlight and your ears.

This game contains an abundance of RED. If you're suffering from erythrophobia, you'll have a stroke playing this game.

title: Hexual Deflection
description: Hexual Deflection is a minimalistic Multiplayer Arena RTS with Tower Defense Mechanics where you do not only defend against enemy units with towers but also send your own units onto enemy towers. Your goal is to be last player alive on the board. Fast paced and chaotic gameplay may require you to quickly adapt to changes on the playfield.

title: Red Door Ylw Door
description: Red Door Yellow Door is a first-person psychological horror game. Starting with what seems like a normal ritual but quickly revealing its sinister nature. Beware, something malevolent lurks in the shadows.

title: Pixelite
description: Pixelite is a 2d MMORPG free to play game.

title: Teenage Lawnmower
description:
You're seventeen and your life is a living hell. Between your alcoholic mother and her abusive boyfriend you've got nowhere to go until one day the glistening metal exterior of the family lawn mower catches your eye and changes your destiny forever.

Become an entrepreneur and change your fate in this humorous, story-based 3D simulation by Seth A. Robinson. Can you make money mowing lawns while helping your mom kick her alcohol (and possible drug) abuse? A twisted mix of simulation, interactive story, and arcade action.

title: NPC Adventure: Post-Jam Edition
description: Play as Greg the shopkeeper in his journey to take down the king and be part of the knight's story with upgraded battle mechanics, foes to fight, and friends to talk to.

title: The Dinner Heist
description:
The Dinner Heist is a hard platformer game where you play as a rat who has gotten down on hard times. It is your job to help him steal a meal from this prestige factory that creates food.

Developed By TapeTracker

title: Dragon's Dogma II: Dragon's Dogma Music & Sound Collection - Custom Sounds
description: Change some in-game music and sound effects to those of the original Dragon's Dogma.

title: Spellfarers
description: Farm, fish, craft, and cast spells with your friends in this idyllic, magical multiplayer farming sim. Befriend the townsfolk of Wenngrove, learn their trades and stories, tend your home with your friends and Familiar, and make magic in Spellfarers.

title: Little Bear
description: Venture into a fantasy world in search of honey for your family.

title: The Paradogx Incident
description:
Step into "The Paradogx Incident," where puzzle-platforming meets rhythmic precision. Guide Dox the dog through mind-twisting, recursive puzzles in a dynamic, beat-driven world and rhythm levels.

Enjoy full controller support and an adaptive soundtrack that changes with every dimension.

Experience a unique blend of genres in this innovative adventure!

title: Art Shop Simulator
description: Buy and sell art, manage employees, and grow your shop in this immersive simulator set in Europe. Curate a unique collection, attract customers, and become the premier art dealer. Transform your humble gallery into a thriving art empire!

title: Armored Shell Nightjar
description: Operate Armored Shell Nightjar as you scale a mountain to deliver valuable data.

title: Dead by Daylight: Tomb Raider Chapter
description: Dead by Daylight: Tomb Raider includes new Survivor Lara Croft, and 3 unique character Perks: Finesse, Hardened, & Specialist. Purchasing this add-on unlocks an exclusive Charm: Climbing Axe.

title: Bunny Log Jumper
description: Bunny Log Jumper is an adorable and addictive game where you control a bunny hopping over wooden logs to catch carrots. With captivating visuals and simple gameplay, it challenges your skill and reflexes as you aim for the best score.

title: Primordial Soup
description: A pack of three early prototype maps that take a behind-the-scenes look at Quadrilateral Cowboy's development.

title: Err: The 1990 Incident
description: The night before the Tokyo Toy Show in 1990, an unknown person broke into Sega's HQ, the cartridge that was meant to be shown got replaced by a different one. This resulted an incident happening and the company threw it out in the garbage. One day, while scrolling through eBay, you managed to find the cartridge from the Tokyo Toy Show, since it was a once in a lifetime opportunity, you bought it because you were curious to find what's in it.

title: Tiny Pixels Vol. 1: Ninpo Blast
description: Jump on your hoverbike and blast off for unlimited ninja-themed bullet hell mayhem!

title: Cheating Reset: Uwaki Reset
description: A happy life of living together. I thought it was going well all this time. Let's start over. Let's go back to six months ago...

title: Ancient Phantasma
description: Emerge as the hero of Sandoria in an epic fantasy RPG!

title: Sonic [Unl]
description:
In 2010 an unknown rom was posted on the romhacking community of Sonic the Hedgehog. The rom in question was found near an abandoned nursery under broken condition. The rom was eventually dumped for all to play.

This rom became infamous for not having the greatest controls, and it appeared to be very glitchy. Some the glitches were that collision was off, and enemies spawned less frequently, it was removed on October 30th of 2010.

One user managed to grab it in time, and played the hack for themselves, and it wasn't just glitches that they saw.

title: Diamond Painting ASMR
description: Let your imagination shine as you create stunning art with diamonds!

title: Cats Baseball
description:
A baseball game where the outcome is decided by dice.
Even if you don't know the rules of baseball, anyone can enjoy it easily!

title: Vanlen Poison Forest
description: A really mean girl's adventure through a forest

title: Proxy Adventure: Small Test
description: Control the proxy to battle enemies, upgrade skills and stats, and find new weapons in this side-scrolling fantasy adventure game.

title: A Last Ditch Effort
description: A Last Ditch Effort is a short horror puzzle game that's inspired by outer wilds.

title: Legend of Lu: Remastered
description:
Relive the classic in this amazing updated experience with “Legend of Lu: Remastered”. It's the same ol’ capybara you loved from way back when but with new updated graphics and extra digital content for you to enjoy.

Follow the journey of the martial arts fighter Luis the Capybara to save his (retiring) Master!

title: Lean Simulator: Desperation
description: A Meme Clicker game gone wrong. How long can you survive?

title: Railway Empire 2: High Voltage
description: Strap in and turn up the power! Railway Empire 2 - High Voltage is ready to charge into the age of railway electrification. With 10 brand new electric locomotives, tycoons become well-equipped to conquer the steep mountains and impressive gorges of the Swiss Alps.

title: Cosmic Drift
description:
Send your rockets to drift around the Planets !
Also play with your viewers on Twitch !

title: Direct Line
description: You bought an old-fashioned phone from a yard sale, thinking it would look cool in your room...until it rings in the middle of the night. You answer, only to hear a mysterious voice that claims you called them. Wait... then why did the phone ring?

title: Half-Life: Another Story
description: Another story about HECU soldier in the Black Mesa Research Facility.

title: Orcs Must Die! Deathtrap
description: Orcs Must Die! Deathtrap is an action-packed third-person shooter and trap defense game. Evolve as an orc-slaying War Mage through rogue-lite choices and obliterate, eviscerate, and incinerate massive hordes with up to four players.

title: EA Sports FC 25
