description: EA SPORTS FC 25 gives you more ways to win for the club. Team up with friends in your favourite modes with the new 5v5 Rush, and manage your club to victory as FC IQ delivers more tactical control than ever before.

title: Ready or Not: Home Invasion
description: Los Sueños - STATE OF EMERGENCY: Los Sueños Police Chief Galo Álvarez issues an emergency broadcast in response to the devastating impact of the record-breaking Category 5 Hurricane Antonio across Los Sueños. Home invasion occurrences widespread and met with disaster response by LSPD SWAT.

title: Exorcist: Reviewer of Minds
description: Everyone must resist the relentless unfairness with the cards they've been dealt. Use the randomly distributed holy verses to identify the names of the 10 demons. Save 5 people and exorcise the sixth threat lurking in the shadows. This is a compact game of continuous gambles and judgments.

title: Yeah! You Want "Those Games", Right? So Here You Go! Now, Let's See You Clear Them! 2
description: "Those Games" are back! Play through familiar minigames to your heart's content! Take on five different minigames with a total of 250 stages! Sit back and play fully, thoroughly, and enjoyably!

title: Mithrun Calls
description: a short visual novel where mithrun chats with a few people

title: O'ermorrow
description: 'O'ermorrow' is a dark-fantasy romance with two endings. Version 1.0 of the game was made within 10 days for the O2A2 VN Jam 2024, a micro Visual Novel jam with strict asset limitations and a 1000-word limit.

title: Cupid's Kiss
description:
Your designated Cupid has had more than enough of your nonsense, thank you very much.

Cupid's Kiss was made in five days under the constraints of O2A2 Jam 2024.

title: The Toy Factory
description: After a hard night drinkin' Duke wakes up in the basement of his office building.

title: Vivitter: Additional Mini-game - "Bull Bull Swing"
description: Ferocious Dog Challenge! Fly as Close as You Can!

title: Vivitter: Additional Mini-game - "Chicken Jones"
description: Ancient Ruins Challenge! Draw Equal Weights!

title: Vivitter: Additional Mini-game - "Back to the Chicken"
description: Back to the original era! Match the speed and dash through!

title: Vivitter: Additional Mini-game - "Chicken Race"

description: Mason is assigned a new job from the big boss when strange things start happening and he discovers the true meaning of fear... Horror in Da Hood is a gripping first-person horror game set in the hood, where the supernatural lurks around every corner. Are you brave enough to face the real terror?

title: Shoulders of Giants: Ultimate
description: Simultaneously control a sword-wielding robot and a gunslinging space frog in Shoulders of Giants, an explosively colourful sci-fi roguelike. Play alone, with a friend, or as part of a four-person team, cutting through waves of enemies on a quest to rescue the galaxy from the forces of Entropy!

title: Honkai Impact 3rd: Fading Dreams, Dimming Shadows
description:
Version 7.6 of Honkai Impact 3rd, which includes
• New Part 2 Story Chapter 3-EX: Bitterness for a Sleepwalker
• New S Rank Valkyrie: Jovial Deception: Shadowdimmer (Songque)
• New AstralOp: Serapeum
• New Featured Event: Schicksal Work Guide
• New Event: Powered Duo
• ...and more!

title: The Final Ultra Super Duper Cube Cavern Deluxe GOTY Edition
description: An action packed "shoot-em-up" through the treacherous underworld from Cube Cavern!

title: Siren Head: Stranded
description:
Your car ran out of gas on a nearly abandoned country road in the middle of nowhere. Stranded and alone, your only hope to leave this unsettling dark forest is a gas station that's down the road. But something else lurks in these woods and stalks you from afar, taunting you with horrifyingly unnatural and alarmingly loud sounds. Can you escape with your life?

Your flashlight is your best friend in this hellish soundscape. It will help you find your way. But be careful, that ... monster ... hears your every move.

title: Trip's Voyage: Gem Rush
description: A fast-paced, arcade-style minigame about chasing a high-score while being chased by some ghastly foes! Originally a minigame called "Well Raider" from the game Trip's Voyage made inside Dreams for the PS4/PS5.

title: Chick That Never Skipped a Leg Day
description: Can you reach the top? Chick That Never Skipped a Leg Day is a brutal-cute 3D precision climb. A tiny chick. Massive legs. The Golden Leg Press awaits. Solo or online with friends.

title: Merely A Chip
description: You're Nelson, Perhaps waking up in the middle of the night is common, but not for Nelson. He's hungry and wants to eat something, but when he checks the kitchen, he can't find anything. He decides to buy some chips in the supermarket and head back home.

title: Whiskers in the Dark
description:
Lurk through the underground tunnels as you stealthily make your way through them in Whiskers in the Dark.

Play as a small cat confined to the space of the shadows, hiding away from the lights (and whatever's out there) seeking to hunt you down. Carefully make your way back to the other cats who've already made their escape, but be careful not to get caught!

title: Tale of Two Sides
description: Through a terrible accident, you've split-apart the world into two! But you've also gained the unique ability to phase between them! Use your newfound power to undo your mess and re-unite the two sides!

title: The Lost Frames
description:
This game was made for the Mini Jam 62: Colors.

The world used to be more fluid, but some great calamity has forced the world into two frames. It is your job to go to the three worlds and bring back the animation key frame gems, only then will fluid motion be brought back to the world.

title: Echoes from the Abyss
description:
"Echoes from the Abyss" is a chilling first-person horror game set in an abandoned military bunker. Unravel the dark secrets hidden within as Maya, the daughter of a former soldier. Embark on a harrowing journey to uncover the truth behind her Father's haunted past. Solve puzzles, make your way through the bunker and confront abominable horrors in a quest for answers that could forever change her life.

The game contains flickering lights, depiction of suicide and blood.

title: Broken War
description: Broken War is an intense first-person shooter that combines different multiplayer modes.

title: Boba Monsters
description: Boba Monsters is a bubble tea making dating sim. Craft creepy boba concoctions, unlock bizarre toppings, and chat with an array of monster customers. Make their favorite recipes to win their hearts–or else you’re doomed to become the undead.

title: Spinny Fan Zone
description: Steal a briefcase!

title: Drop Pockets
description: The billiards roguelike. Strategic, physics based combat against Pool Sharks who don't play by the rules. Pocket your balls and clear out your opposition in this chaotic game of pool!

title: Cartenstein
description: A short story about being a master Card Collector.

title: My Assassin Bodyguard
description:
You grew up as a part of the Time Vessel Association. One day, your friend goes against the group and is killed, making you realize how insane the Association actually is. They never cared, and never will. You want out of it, so you decide to leave everything behind and run away.

Little do you know, they send a famous assassin after you. Can you make it out alive and maybe seduce the infamous Toji Fushiguro along the way?

title: A Grave Mistake
description: You're a gravedigger out digging graves, but you accidentally summoned an apocalypse, oops! Do you have the smarts to take control of the situation and stop the cataclysm?

title: Interstellar Interruption
description: Scifi Mystery

title: Morning Shift
description: Short Adventure Game

title: Toiletisia vs. Evil
description:
Have you ever dreamed of playing a video game about a toilet who battles devil worshippers?

Then today's your lucky day!

This is a game about a beautiful toilet police officer who has to deal with an evil cult that summoned an ancient evil demon in a creepy mansion.

title: World Weaver
description: Confront the World Weaver

Starring Cristobalín, a somewhat lazy student who must prepare for the Conquest of Granada if he wants to pass his History class. While studying in the library, he falls asleep and begins to dream something "incredible." A fun adventure, lacking in humor, and through which you'll also learn about the Conquest of Granada.

title: TWHL Tower: Source
description:
TWHL Tower: Source is the follow-up to the collaborative mods TWHL Tower and TWHL Tower 2. Each level is made by a different creator with the only limit being the size of the map. Other than that, every floor has unique and varied gameplay ranging from puzzles and platforming to intense combat sections.

TWHL Tower: Source expands on the previous mods by using Half-Life 2's Source engine together with the community made Mapbase mod to allow for even more unique gameplay possibilities. The mod features 18 floors by 15 different authors, 5 unlockable bonus maps, and over 20 in-game achievements for those seeking extra challenge.

title: Cupid's Chatroom
description: Find your true love with the help of Cupid's chatroom, a mysterious server that won't let you leave!

title: The Ice Cream Culprit
description: Your girlfriend's limited edition ice cream has been stolen! Was it you? Will you help her find it? All that is to be decided by 4 different endings.

title: Crash Bandicoot World
description:
Crash Bandicoot World is a Crash Fan-made game made by me
Looks like cortex have a new plan and crash have to stop him once again before it's Too Late
Join Crash in his new adventure !

title: Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea: Amaranthine Moon
description:
Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea: Amaranthine Moon is the otome standalone sequel to Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea, a Victorian vampire visual novel previously released in 2021. This visual novel is set around 5-6 years after the events of the first visual novel, following Lucie as the main character now that she's an adult.

Determined to make her own destiny as she turns 18, the young head of her family Lucie plunges headfirst in the conniving world of business dealings. Before she's able to seal the deal on a revolutionary treatment to vampirism, her business partner suddenly dies. Lucie finds herself embroiled in the middle of the mysterious death of her former partner and an event from a decade prior...

title: 124 Handle of the World
description:
Ever got that eerie feeling when you're in a bus, late at night? Ever thought about how much stronger that feeling must be when YOU'RE the driver? What may driving with the bus empty late at night feel like? This thought is what set me up to make this game.

In a PS1 style setting, you are a bus driver completing your night shift. You are getting tired, getting the last people off the bus to their destinations, until you're all alone. What might happen?

title: Arkanoid
description:
An unofficial port of Arkanoid for the LowRes NX fantasy console.

The game includes the 32 levels from the original version, along with the final boss, who requires 20 hits to defeat. The levels are arranged to closely resemble those of the original game; however, notable differences exist due to technical constraints. While the original game supported up to 15×15 blocks per level, this version allows a maximum of only 6×5 blocks.

title: Founder of the Final Cult
description: Can you survive against crazy cultists and be the last cult standing?

title: Zort
description: Zort is an action, adventure, and horror game that can be played with up to 4 people. Explore maps with your friends and have fun while escaping from various creatures. Experience a realistic horror experience with in-game voice chat with your friends!

title: SNK vs. Capcom: SVC Chaos
description:
SNK and CAPCOM legends clash in this star-studded crossover fighting game!
The 2003 arcade hit SVC CHAOS is back and better than ever!

SVC CHAOS—a dream match of epic proportions! Worlds collide as 36 iconic characters across various series from SNK (mainly THE KING OF FIGHTERS) and CAPCOM (mainly STREET FIGHTER) do battle in a frantic fight to the finish! Brand-new rollback netcode and tournament modes allow for fun, fast-paced online matches—all while still retaining the classic visuals and controls of the original fan favorite. Also comes with a hitbox viewer and a gallery mode! Rise up and throw down with players all around the world in this new evolution of the SVC CHAOS legacy!

title: Just Pizza
description: Welcome to Just Pizza, a game that turns your love for pizza into an exciting and rewarding experience! This game is all about clicking on a pizza to earn more pizzas. The more you click, the more pizzas you get. It’s as simple and fun as that!

title: Keyframes
description: Between exams, friendships, and figuring out what a savings account is, college might just be one of the busiest times of your life. No one said adulthood was going to be easy, but it’ll be a little less painful to navigate with your two best friends by your side... and three new chance acquaintances, who happen to be the right people at the right time.

title: Locally Sourced Anthology I: A Space Atlas
description: Locally Sourced Anthology I: A Space Atlas is a collection of 8 experimental games, each developed by a different indie team, with each game focusing on a different

title: Termination Mental
description: Small base level, a remake of the original Termination Central (E3M1).

title: The Palace of Fear
description: A dark turtlemap remake of e4m4. Uses Quoth entities, so you need that mod installed.

title: Data Download
description: A map built with no more than 256 brushes. Your mission is to download some data, but there are a couple of enemies who try to prevent that. Fast and frantic non-stop action.

title: Amphitheater Of Abaddon
description: Small to medium-sized Wizard-style level. It is the follow-up to The Subterrestrial Hangar and as such again features three distinct route choices.

title: Catatonic Fits of Despair
description: Medium-sized spacious metal/runic-style fortress.

title: Shut Up, RPG!
description: Medium sized chain map by Than, Gibbie, RPG, Nightbringer.

title: Temple of Quake
description: Small to medium-sized runic-style temple with a graveyard in rocky surroundings. The level can be finished fairly quickly, but in order to visit all areas and get better equipment it requires exploration and secret-hunting.

title: The Slipgate Massacre
description: Remix/remake of the original E1M1 - The Slipgate Complex, but larger and more spacious, with many new and expanded areas.

title: The Subterrestrial Hangar
description: Small idbase level set in a miliary base/hangar. It features three distinct route choices: normal combat, permanent quad damage, and slime maze, and is supposed to be the first map of an episode focusing on these route mechanics.

title: 99 brushes or less
description: Speedmapping pack featuring six SP levels.

title: We got bored lol
description: Six small ~2-hour speedmaps + a start hub, all following different themes and based on the Copper mod (included). It comes with a custom music track.

title: BigMcGee
description: 14 speedjam SP levels made on a 64 unit grid, three custom skyboxes, and four music tracks.

title: Blood Foundry
description: 3 vanilla speedmaps made by Egg Boy.

title: Reconditus
description: Reconditus is a 4 map (+ epilogue) mapset that takes place in a world where temple-like structures have been slowly assimilated by tech/alien stuff.

title: Something Bad is on the Moon
description:
Found Footage: Apollo 17

The Apollo 17 mission was the last publicly disclosed mission to the moon.

Since then, numerous missions have been launched in absolute secrecy.

Something very bad happened on Apollo 17, and we recorded it.

title: Left 4 Dead 2: Alien Trilogy
description: A custom campaign for Left 4 Dead 2 based on the video game Alien Trilogy.

title: Legends of Kailrate
description: Help Kailrate defeat enemies as the waves progress. Be careful of bosses, they are sometimes dangerous!

title: Hexagod
description: A minimalist roguelike village builder where you place hexagon tiles, manage resources, and command your villagers.

title: Pong Consoles Simulation
description:
These are simulations of some of the most popular Pong consoles from the 1970s. The consoles included are:
Atari Home Pong (C-100)
Atari Super Pong (C-140)
Coleco Telstar
Nintendo Color TV-Game 6
Nintendo Color TV-Game 15

title: MultiVersus: Season 2 - Back in Time
description: In Season 2 unlock Samurai Jack through the new battlepass, and explore a new set of rifts to unlock Beetlejuice. There will also be new unlockable cosmetics, the Water Tower stage, and the return of ranked mode.

title: Vectic: Boosted
description:
Vectic: The motorsport of the future.

Every year the Vectic League draws millions of fans from all over the world.
This season you will not be one of them.
This season you will be a contender.
Race with skill, speed and daring to claim your place in the record books as a Vectic legend.

Vectic uses a turn based system to bring you a new racing experience. To be victorious is to be not only the fastest but also the smartest. Gain the edge by picking your way through obstacles, optimising corners or landing the perfect hit with a laser beam. Prevail on over 40 hand built race tracks.

title: Bonk Jam!
description:
Ranger has gotten a hold of a new melee weapon: the Bonk Hammer!
The Hammer allows the player to jump higher, move faster, and fight harder!
This mod (built on Copper) also includes two additional monsters: our good friend the gaunt from Quoth (with reworked code), and Dwell's brute! Across the set of maps, you will encounter Bonk runes, which can be used to purchase awesome skins for the new hammer in the start map.

title: Tremors: Rebirth
description:
A video game movie that allows you to experience Tremors.

The map is huge and full of stuff from the first movie!

title: Deliver to When You Came
description: Deliver the meal. Don't become one yourself. An open-ended puzzle platformer based around physics and AId

title: World Domination wit Cam
description:
World domination is not easy. Join me as we figure it out together. I think it kind of goes like this, yeah that's the way, you're killing it!

A sort of boss battle, sort of actiony game, but don't worry, you can't die! Move the mouse around to trigger actions with the beat.

title: Sudo K.O.
description: Fill sudokus to fight against monsters and gain better loot as a reward. How far can you go without perishing? Claim your spot on the online leaderboards!

title: Eternal Fighters
description: Dive into Eternal Fighters, a fast-paced 2D fighting game that blends classic arcade action with modern dynamics. Choose from a roster of ninjas and warriors, each with unique abilities, and master modes like Arcade, VS, and Online. Prove your skills and become the ultimate Eternal Champion!

title: Snow Bros. Wonderland
description: Boasting gorgeous 3D isometric graphics, Snow Bros. Wonderland has the brothers defending Snow Land from The Great King of Evil! Armed with an endless supply of ice pellets, gamers can turn monsters into snowballs which can be kicked to destroy a whole horde of enemies! Chain your attacks to defeat several bad guys at once and use your snowball skills to take down massive bosses.

title: Guilty Gear: Strive - Additional Character 14: Queen Dizzy
description: Adds Queen Dizzy to the roster of playable characters
1024³ 6 SP maps by efdat, Hrimfaxi, neg!ke, and Spirit

title: Guilty Gear: Strive - Additional Character 15: Venom
description: Adds Venom to the roster of playable characters

title: Guilty Gear: Strive - Additional Character 16: Unika
description: Adds Unika to the roster of playable characters

title: Guilty Gear: Strive - Additional Character 17: Lucy
description: Adds Lucy to the roster of playable characters

title: A Better Tomorrow
description: Join the green revolution! Relax and learn about clean energy in this cozy, minimalist 2D city-building strategy game. Build windmills, solar panels, and more to provide energy to villages and cities while protecting the environment. Let's work together to make 'A Better Tomorrow'!

title: Feindlich Sewers
description: Medium sized castle / medieval sewers map with Makkon textures. Requires Copper v1.19+ (NOT included). The author's first release.

title: Null Bearing Redux
description: Large industrial dock-themed map with lots of exploration, using Makkon and MG1 textures. This is an updated overhaul / redesign of the author's previous release Null Bearing (2020).

title: Big Boy's Birthday Party
description: Large, open medieval castle with courtyards, a throne room, a wine cellar, and a dungeon.

title: Hard Driven
description: Medium / large-feeling metal sci-fi playground with Makkon3 textures. "Big Boy is defragging his hard drive. He must be stopped."

title: Under A Stone Blanket
description: Small tomb / crypt brick map built within a 1024^3 volume, textured with Makkon and based on Progs_dump (included).

title: Low Gravity
description: Two-day speedmapping event following a "low gravity" theme with 10 small to medium-sized levels and a start hub. It runs on the SMP mod (included) and comes with a custom skybox and a music track.

title: The Doomed Cathedral
description: Medium-sized cathedral with a base area.

title: Io. Loki Patera.
description: Large industrial sci-fi map with some Doom and Makkon textures, a few hundred monsters, and lot of secrets.

title: Io. Brimstoneburg.
description: Large lava castle / tomb map for vanilla Quake.

title: Io. Lava Cleaning Base
description: Large industrial factory/refinery level with a few arcane elements.

title: Guilty Gear: Strive - Blazing Edition
description: The Blazing Edition of Guilty Gear: Strive includes the base game, the 4 Season Passes, the Ultimate Edition Content Kit and the Guilty Gear 25th Anniversary: Special Additional Color Pack.

title: Azrael on the Boundary of Life or Death
description:
Rihito Souda has just started working for a major construction company in April.

Even though he is assigned to a different deparment than the one he was hoping for, he meets a senior employee by the name of Reimi Nagashima, and he slowly begins to fall in love with her.

He has a rewarding job, kind parents, and awesome friends.... All of these things seemed ideal, until one day he begins to have terrifying nightmares.

The frequency of these nightmares increases with each passing month and slowly begins to consume his life.

title: Search and Rescue: Mount Rainier National Park USA
description: Welcome to Search and Rescue | Mount Rainer National Park Washington USA

title: Free Chess: Soviet Set
description: 1950s Soviet Latvian Chess Set

title: It Could Happen to You
description: Your peaceful holiday is interrupted when the small village you’re visiting in becomes terrorized by strange lights on the sky and enigmatic men in black. Some villagers have gone missing, everyone is afraid. Dive into a thrilling adventure with branching narrative and a unique visual style.

title: The Biggleboss Incident
description: There is NOTHING sinister happening at Biggleboss Inc. Or at least that’s what the company motto says. Tom doesn’t have time to debate semantics, though; he’s dangerously late for work – and he hasn’t even started his big Project AGER pitch. …Or is that just what they want him to think?

title: Vengeance Hunters
description:
Vengeance Hunters is an adrenaline fueled Neo-Geo hardware developed beat’em’up that lets you and a friend in local co-op fight mutants, zombies, punks, gangsters, lab techs with bombs (you read that correctly), suited mystery men, cyborgs and more across multiple stages, sub-levels and secret areas.

You'll be focused on fast and frantic action, combos and even a small bit of story. Vengeance Hunters features an amazing OST as well as incredible pixel art. Combat isn't the standard era combat that you've seen over and over since the 90's. Each playable character has their own Signature Move and style that will greatly change how you play.

title: Exodus: Creepy Time
description: Join the battle in the dark world of the Middle Ages, shrouded in evil and magic, as brave knights, each of whom fights to save their native lands from mystical threats. "Exodus: Creepy Time" is an exciting shoot 'em up with a top view, combining elements of roguelike and arcade games.

title: The Traveler
description: Lost and alone in a cave, you start your adventure jumping and ducking your way through enemies and different environments. Collect coins to upgrade your player & unlock new abilities. Maybe then you'll find the ancient relics that start to reveal how you got here, and maybe...the way out.

title: Solitary Sentinel
description: Welcome to Solitary Sentinel, a captivating single-player roguelike tower defense experience where you must defend against constantly evolving enemies by upgrading a single tower. Enjoy simple controls, and deep strategic gameplay as you fend off the relentless onslaught!

title: Stellar Larceny
description: Embark on a cosmic heist in this zero-gravity adventure! Maneuver the galaxy as a sentient robot armed with a magnet, jetpack, and gravity boots. Your mission? Infiltrate facilities, find parts, and return life to your friend - while running from a mysterious company intent on shutting you down.

title: Fakutori
description: Fakutori is a laid-back and colorful automation game; place machines, discover new elements, and try to craft the elusive legendary blocks! No limits, no pressure, just blocks!

title: Heartspell: Horizon Academy
description: Match gems, level up, and date wizards in this match-3 visual novel with a lot of heart and a little spice. Form deep relationships with faeries, sirens and werewolves, each with their own endearing personalities and challenges. Make choices that affect your relationships, and their destinies.

title: No spikes, please!
description: Avoid the spikes, reach the flag.

title: Submergent
description: Explore and navigate an underwater cave in your submarine.

title: Good Soup
description: Play as a mischievous ghost in this cozy point-and-click adventure! Follow Amber, a "girlfailure" culinary student, through her daily routine. Interact with her world to improve her day, make her life harder, change her future, or simply give her a good scare. Every choice is in your hands!

title: Whiskerwood
description: Establish a home for your industrious mice under the oppressive paw of your cat overlords in this city builder featuring complex simulations, intricate production chains, and the age-old rivalry between cat and mouse.

title: A Candle to the Unknown
description: A child is sent to an abbey, leaving his ill mother alone.

title: Niraya of
description: "Niraya of " is a Japanese horror game inspired by the Buddhist beliefs. The game focuses on a unique system where players "avoid" the attacks of various monsters. This, combined with the fear of exploring eerie environments and solving puzzles, is a major draw of the game.

title: Slime Scramble
description: Become the ultimate slime! Eat green slimes to grow, dodge the red ones, and see how big you can get in this cozy yet challenging slime scramble!

title: A Walk in the Park
description: There is a fireworks event in the evening and your friend knows just the right place to watch it. All you have to do is get there through this perfectly normal park. Just follow the arrows and you'll reach your destination. Eventually. How hard can that be?

title: Payout: Shop Simulator
description: Build and manage your shop, deliver physics-based products using Van, Forklift and Truck. Hire workers to speed up your progress

title: Merge Marbles
description: Merge Marbles is a relaxing puzzle game where your goal is to merge as many pairs of the same coloured marbles as you can. Each time you merge a pair it creates the next tier all the way up to the big pink marble. Try your best to merge the pink marble to clear as much space as you can!

title: Elden Ring: Dark Moon
description: An overhaul focused on new content and fashion souls, based on Elden Ring: Shattered

title: Dungeon Beach
description: Cute and sexy seaside random dungeon action

title: The History of Magic Tower: Opening
description: "The History of Magic Tower: Opening" is a fantasy adventure game based on the "Magic Tower" game mode. This work is set against the backdrop of various traditional magical tower worldviews and tells the story of events that occurred before the time point of the classic game "50-layer Magic Tower".

title: This Company of Mine
description: In the urban workplace, you will hold great power and it's time to decide the fate of others. Eliminate those guys you don't like and hire those you like. This is a company that belongs to you!

title: Kioku Hanabi
description: Remember the color, location, and timing of the fireworks that were launched, and try to launch them in the same way. Although the rules are simple, it is deep and you will be drawn to the beautiful visuals.

title: Rangarok End Girls
description: Girls, resist the world and burn your lives! Full-voice stylish action!!

title: Ten Seconds Hero 1
description: Open world,RPG,Build,All Monster and NPC can be controlled.

title: Fushigi na Sekai no Kankou Nikki
description: This game is finding them and trying to clear the game. I can't give away any secrets, so I can't give you any detailed explanations. You'll just have to buy it! Tom: "But it's only available in Japanese language. Is there no English version?" "sorry. then I took an arrow in the knee... "

title: Do Not Look at the Moon
description: The moon, once serene, now portends doom. Air raid sirens blare, TVs warn: "Do not look at the moon." Your world's turned upside down. Messages flood in, all asking: How to survive in this world of bizarre rules?

title: Employee Rules of the Night Strings
description: This is a bartender simulation game. While mixing drinks that satisfy customers, you also need to carefully identify whether the guests in front of you are human or something similar to human.

title: Macabre no Zantou: Remnants of the Macabre
description: Navigate 1980s Japan as a schoolgirl in this Junji Ito-inspired horror game. Each choice shapes your fate, leading to safety or deeper into the macabre. Uncover hidden horrors in an urban street filled with sinister details. Will you find your way home, or be consumed by the unknown?

title: Dwelling
description: In "Dwelling," a police officer investigates terrifying events in an abandoned school. Uncover the truth, survive the horrors, and solve the mystery hidden within each floor.

title: Dino Tribe: New Era
description: Create your dino chief, lead your tribe. Survive waves of enemies, explore and settle on foreign islands. Find a way to avoid extinction!

title: Jumper, Jumpy Time Attack Adventure
description: Jumper is a 2D platformer arcade style, the goal is to stay alive as long as possible, jump on as many platforms as possible but be careful for traps ! As the score is increasing so is the difficulty and the speed.

title: Private Mining Company
description: Private Mining Company is a tower defense game with perma-death and extraction elements. Keep your soldiers while you complete contracts, as long as they aren't killed. Make money defending mining outposts on hostile alien planets. Balance mining upgrades and growing your army.

title: Nucleuz Underground
description: The planet is dying, a team has been created that has to go underground, in the exile of the machines and hit the core. Only in this way, humanity will be able to survive and we have the mission to do so every day. A classic 2D platform game, in a dystopian and survival future. Join the team. Now.

title: Field of the Dead
description: Field of the Dead is a post-apocalyptic sci-fi horror game where you battle undead and mutants with space weapons. Level up, fight bosses, acquire rare gear, and explore infested areas to uncover the apocalypse's secrets. Supports single-player and up to four-player multiplayer.

title: Herta's Chess Game
description: Herta's simulated universe network is interconnected throughout the universe. Pack your luggage and enter Herta's world with your friends. In this fan game, you will use the simulation data of each original character to have a strategic showdown with Herta.

title: Carpe Noctem
description: A yuri visual novel about a vampiress and a monster hunter falling in love in Victorian England.

title: Flappy Horse
description: This is a game where you guide this crazy looking horse through hurdles to try and gain the best score you can! As you Flap through the game you collect sugar cubes which you use in the shop to buy upgrades to get even better scores an even more sugar cubes.

title: Floors
description: Embark on a procedural liminal journey filled with eerie, unfriendly faces. Walk, explore, and descend to the first floor to escape. No monsters will chase you, but they can watch and appear when you aren't looking. This can evoke a fear of an endless labyrinth and create a sense of anxiety.

title: Dorf the Dwarf
description: Dorf the dwarf is a puzzle game which replicates the classic game Zeek the Geek. You play as Dorf, a dwarf adventuer, who dares into the dungeons of Koganusân , ruins of a dwarf fortress, to loot treasures, while avoiding ghosts, elephants and deadly traps, and solving puzzles.

title: Oh, honey! Anime clicker!
description: Welcome to Oh, Honey! Anime Clicker!, a simple clicker game set in a delightful anime-style! In this game, you'll tap to accumulate points.

title: Gears Unchained: The Rise of Revolution
description: In a futuristic city under dictatorship, a brave mechanic with an illegal electronic arm rises up against the dictator. Face dangers, unravel intrigues and overcome deadly obstacles, approaching an epic final showdown.

title: Find Colibries
description: Test your attentiveness in the captivating world of Aztec jungles in the game Find Colibries and find all the hidden birds!

title: Mushroom
description: Mushroom is a clicker game. You will see the visions after eating poisonous mushrooms. You will get a mushroom every x hours. Collect more to win the world.

title: Dice Dice Dice
description: This is a casual deck-building game based on dice rolling. Players will rely on their choices and some luck to achieve victory.

title: Laser Sounds
description: You are a mercenary hired by the Space Company to inspect the space station, which has not been heard from for years, because of the news you have received that some experiments are being carried out. Your goal is to clear everyone from this space station.

title: Simulation: Catalyst
description: In this game you can enjoy a semi-causal 2d platformer while fully immersing yourself in a 3d parallax environment.

title: Toilet
description: A casual puzzle game. Go to the toilet, one must also strategize.

Written inside is only one sentence.

description: Embrace the fitness revolution! Workouts become fun games. Say goodbye to boring routines and hello to thrilling, sweat-filled adventures. Get fit and have fun! Join now!

description: Drive your pickup truck through seemingly peaceful countryside valleys, deliver much-needed goods to local townsfolk and unravel the small town mystery. Beware, the old forest is watching.

title: Norbert's Diary
description: Norbert's Diary is a retro-themed psychological horror game set in the 2000s. In it you will learn the story of Norbert, the guy who opened a gas station in the forest. You have to earn money and serve customers, but who knows what, or who, can kill you.

title: EgoVersus: The First Strike
description: A fast-paced sci-fi first person shooter. Classic fps multiplayer, zombie mode (coming soon), and battle royale mode (coming soon) with rich story, and unique characters. EgoVersus: The First Strike aims to bring the old school FPS experience back to the modern gaming industry.

title: Backrooms: The Labyrinth
description: Explore non-linear paths and evade lurking monsters as you uncover the mysteries of this eerie maze. Beware of the sinister entities that inhabit the shadows, ready to drag you deeper into the unknown.

title: Click Me: Hentai Adventure
description: Welcome to our exciting clicker game where you interact with charming characters! Choose from a variety of attractive girls, uncover their outfits, and experience different levels of nudity. Satisfy characters to add intrigue and diversity to gameplay.

title: Gamer Stories: Dating Real Japanese Female Gamers
description: This is a game where you can date real Japanese female gamers. Through dates, you can learn about each character's actual life experiences and hardships, getting to know them deeply. All of them share the common trait of being gamers, so you, who love games, will have lively conversations with them.

title: The Colony: New Haven Chronicles
description: New Haven is a utopia under a red moon, turned into a dystopian nightmare. You are a prisoner with no name, waking up in the middle of an emergency. Fight for survival guided by an enigmatic voice in your head, explore a falling world, solve puzzles, and unravel dark secrets.

title: HeartWare
description: Yours decisions matters, leading to multiple unique endings that reflect your influence on Iris’s fate.

title: The Lost Gallery
description: Works of art are attacking people, turning an exhibition into a bloodbath in a single night. At the same time, you – a phantom thief – happen to be there to steal a valuable masterpiece.

title: The Curse of Elmwood
description: You hear quiet whispers from deep inside the house, but no one sees. You begin to feel that you are not alone in this house. Curse of Elmwood is an atmospheric horror where you find yourself trapped in a gloomy 18th century mansion, steeped in mystery and horror.

title: Forgotten Bunker 1939
description: step into the boots of Private Jacob, an American soldier caught in the fury of a World War II bombing raid. Desperately seeking refuge, Jacob stumbles upon a terrifying mysterious bunker, which turns out to be a demonic time portal.

title: Royal Revolt Survivors
description: Thrilling 1-4 players co-op survivor gameplay combined with stunning graphics, where powerful Warriors battle through hordes of vicious enemies using a blend of melee and ranged weapons.

title: Frog Holm
description: Unexpectedly, you become the owner of a pub that has seen better days. During the day, set sail to explore a variety of new islands, each with its own unique treasures and ingredients for your cocktails. Can you restore the pub to its former glory? Dive into this charming adventure and find out!

title: Mini-Tank Arena
description: Mini Tank Arena is a 4v4 multiplayer battle Arena shooter, play on different maps experience the battle styles of each unique tank, and see how each tank can synergize with other tanks to help elevate the playing field.

title: Containment Breach
description: Containment Breach is a wave-based zombie survival game with a unique shooting mechanic. Earn points to unlock doors, buy and upgrade weapons, perks, and equipment. See how fast you can escape the facility or choose to stay and go for the highest round possible.

title: Master of Love
description: Single and unemployed, 33-year-old Jun-Ho finds himself transported back in time ten years. He takes the chance to romance five women from his past – and get it right this time. Unlock five unique endings in Master of Love, an FMV game that offers the ultimate K-drama experience.

title: Aotenjo: Infinite Hands
description: The Mahjong Roguelike. Aotenjo is an deckbuilder where you will use Mahjong styles all over the world to beat innate threats, play different Patterns and combos, reach the "bottom" of Aotenjo, and discover ancient secrets....

title: Morimens
description: Morimens is a roguelite card-battling game set in a world inspired by the Lovecratian mythos. Something is wrong with Kadath. Bond with hauntingly beautiful Awakeners, build a deck from the remnants of their power, and push deeper into the mist—where the events get stranger, the cards get darker, and the truth is something you may not survive knowing.

title: Robabekya
description: You envision a futuristic scenario where humans coexist in an open world alongside robots disguised with human-like skins, equipped with dynamic and adaptive system where AI learns from previous engagements, adjusts tactics, and becomes increasingly proficient in combat scenarios.

title: Circle TD: Defence War
description: A tower defense game.In the wave after wave of enemy attacks like a tide, constantly configure defense tower ties, player talents, props and equipment, build a powerful defense position, and eliminate the enemy before they fill the map!

title: Inventory Quest: Hero's Hoard
description: Inventory Quest: Hero's Hoard is a short and fast-paced inventory management and loadout optimization game. The player must upkeep a hero's loadout from random item drops and try to survive as long as possible to achieve a new high score.

title: Hypno
description: Mind melting audio-visual orgasm! A game of quick reflexes, precise timing and fast-paced strategic decisions at higher levels with simple enough mechanics anyone can grasp, yet with enough depth only few will ever truly master.

title: The Supper: New Blood
description: Do you hear the doorbell, Stewie? Your first guest is here...and something tells me they’ll never leave this motel...

title: Can't Revert
description: Can't revert is a first-person psychological horror game. You repeatedly find yourself in a house where your wife and son are dead. Discover hidden clues in the house and uncover the secrets of their deaths. Experience the constant tension and fear in the repetitive space.

title: Szikra
description: A relaxing, 2.5D side-scrolling short game set in a unique steampunk/fantasy environment. Find your way through vast fields, magical forests, and giant gears in a steaming factory to reach the twisted circus where your friend is locked up. Jump, find switches, push boxes around to get there.

title: Save
description: Save is a survival deep sea horror game for 1-4 online co-op game, sets in the eerie depths of an abandoned 6,000-Ton Ship 'SENARA', where every shadow holds a secret, and every corner could be your last. Unravel the mysteries and safely escape avoiding relentless threats that prowl in the darkness.

title: Express Car Wash Simulator
description: Use colorful soaps and enjoy the satisfaction of a perfect clean. Collect rare vehicle cards to unlock iconic rides, add new services to your shop, and expand your craft. But stay sharp - taking down non-paying customers with a tennis ball gun is all part of the job!

title: Sigma War Notes
description: This is an ACT action game that can achieve a satisfying sense of impact through simple operations.

title: Idol Party
description:
“WOW,you can really dance!” Welcome to IDOL PARTY. Immerse yourself in dance and song to find friends in this social game. Charm your love with moves and melodies, pledge togetherness, marry, and start a family. Tired? Farm or play mini-games for endless fun!

"Idol Party" is a music game with a lively style using the concept of idols!
Gorgeous costumes, personalized mounts, massive music songs, everything you want is here.

title: Guns are Funs
description:
Guns are Funs is an arcade game that combines elements of a shooter, runner, and tower destruction. Immerse yourself in the world of toy soldiers who wage fierce battles for power and influence in the room. Bright dynamic battles, unique missions, and a variety of game modes await you.

The story campaign is divided into chapters, each offering distinct missions that challenge your skills across different aspects of the game. And if you're looking for some non-stop fun without the narrative, dive into the sandbox mode — where you can explore all game elements and compete for the highest score.

Assemble your army of toys, crush your enemies' towers, and prove that even the smallest soldiers can become the greatest heroes!

title: Before Exit: Supermarket
description: Before Exit: Supermarket combines features from roguelike with walking simulator. As Supermarket employee you clean up damaged items, wipe up stains, and turn off the lights. Your task is close the store behind you, hoping that all tasks have been completed.

title: Holiday Farm
description: A sandbox game that simulates life on a farm. Experience life, growing vegetables, raising animals, diving in mineral water on a happy island.

title: Try to Survive Today
description: A three-dimensional shooter with an isometric camera or a first- or third-person view. You in a fur suit shoot all sorts of devils and robots spawning from everywhere. By gaining experience for destroying enemies, collecting their souls, you upgrade your tree of characteristics

title: Anomalum
description: You’re trapped in an endless nightmare. Observe your surroundings carefully and check the clock to escape from Anomalum.

title: Hexeract
description: Roguelike deck-building game on hexagonal tiles. Enjoy a dopamine-boosting experience by maximizing the synergy of your deck and tiles.

title: Rebirth! New Lover
description: Song Xuan unexpectedly traveled to ancient times, where he met several emotional partners who sincerely treated him. There are Qing'er,Xiaobai, Gu Qiuhan,Lin Miaoxian and Mingyue Rao. He had so many humorous and sweet love stories with them.

title: Savior Quest
description: "Savior Quest" is an ARPG with a behind the scenes perspective. By taking missions in the main city and challenging various powerful boss, players can obtain random equipment with various entries.

title: Unreal Wukong
description: " Unreal WuKong" is an open-world action RPG based on the classic Chinese mythological novel, "Journey to the West." You will play as the Monkey King, Sun Wukong, embarking on a perilous and wondrous adventure to save the world by vanquishing demons that have traveled from the future.

title: Lightracer: For Judge
description: In a dystopian future, as The Judge with immense power, you journey through space to find hope in a divided society. This sci-fi adventure explores hope amidst adversity.

title: Sword & Seek
description: Sword and Seek is a cozy fantasy hidden object game set in a medieval world, where players embark on a journey to receive the blessing of the goddesses to become adventurers.

title: Dual Eclipse
description: Restore order to the cosmos by seeking out a Prismatic Dragon imprisoned in the stars. Delve into dungeons, evade traps, and discover secrets. Seek adventure as one of three classes in this trick-taking RPG.

title: Ninja Monkey
description: Battle waves of bees, choose upgrades each round, and defeat challenging bosses. Unlock new classes, maps, weapons, and abilities while refining your build and mastering platforming skills!

title: Pirate Hunter: Somali Trap
description: In the middle of the South Pacific: modern pirates are making the waterways that are so important for international trade unsafe. In order to deal with this ever-growing threat, a mercenary group called The Pilgrims appears on the scene, earning their money with protection missions...

title: BeYourCat
description: "Be Your Cat " is a real love game,like an experience in life, one interesting dream. We all wish we had superpowers, but what would you do if one day you had superpowers, but not like Superman? What will you do with your limited abilities? How does it affect and change the people around you?

title: Click Painter
description: Click Painter is a Minesweeper-like puzzle game with colorful pictures, comfortable rest, and new ideas.

title: Darwin
description: Enter a tough-as-nails retro old school trip, Darwin is a daunting gauntlet of a speedrunning platformer. It requires the player to move fast and be agile, but to also be prepared to die. Again. Again. And again. Can you survive the trials in Slugtopia, defeat the nasty Wormilon, and make it home?

title: Chiral
description: A sci-fi dark-comedy puzzle game. In Chiral, you'll assume the role of a disembodied brain in a jar, paired with a digital AI companion. Together, you'll navigate a labyrinth of mirror, laser, and gravity puzzles that will challenge your spatial reasoning and leave you both laughing and bewildered.

title: The White Room
description: Locked in the white room and you are slowly losing your mind. Not sure what is real anymore and you must escape.

title: Into the M.A.W.
description: In this action-packed co-op adventure, four players must unite to crew a spaceship through a web of interconnected story missions. Choose your role—Captain, Pilot, Gunner, or Engineer—and make decisions that shape not only your journey, but the future of a galaxy on the brink of war.

title: GreenWood Defense
description: Defend your captain using units to fight off invading frogs. Level up your units to unlock their new abilities, purchase upgrades, and gain special abilities to win battles against the invaders.

title: Age of Defense: Prehistory
description: The most addicting tower defense game, packed with monsters and tough defenders, all of which fit perfectly into the cartoonish environment. Prehistory is a prologue for the main story Age of Defense.

title: Cosplay Crisis: Succubus Invasion
description: Cosplay Crisis is an Action roguelite bullet heaven with an animecon theme. A Succubus, intent on winning the Convention's cosplay competition, charms the men in attendance to destroy her competition. Now the girls must take up arms to protect their costumes, or be stripped and sent home blushing!

title: TCG Card Shop Simulator
description:
Open your own local game store. Stock shelves with the latest booster packs, or crack them and collect the cards for yourself. Set your own prices, hire staff, host events, and expand your card shop.

TCG Card Shop Simulator is a trading card shop simulation where you sell card booster packs to earn money and build your card shop business.

title: Kemopop!
description: Fast puzzles, cute boys~! A food-themed physics puzzler where you undress your waiter. A kemono game, by kemono artists.

title: Backrooms The Company
description: backrooms horror game

title: Temporal Titans
description: Temporal Titans is a Tower-Defense game with Time Travel. Send mechs back to previous waves to prevent your defeat, and protect your salvage team from the monstrous Krell as you scavenge the ruins of a lost earth. Rewind, rethink, and reclaim the future!

title: I'm Not Crazy
description: I'm Not Crazy is a surreal top down puzzle adventure game. Solve puzzles, explore and play micro games.

title: Short Snow
description: SHORT SNOW! Realistic open-world survival experience, you find yourself lost in a vast, snow-covered forest after a harrowing plane crash. With temperatures plummeting and hunger gnawing at you, will you succumb to the forces of nature, or will you conquer the frozen wilderness? The choice is yours!

title: Yokai Rescue
description: Ascend through a futuristic tower in this fast-paced action platformer. Use your Yokai abilities to move swiftly in the air and pierce through your enemies to defeat them. You are the last Yokai capable of saving your people and liberating your homeland from the Selvo robot control.

title: Gravity Sphere
description: Gravity Sphere is a 3D puzzle game where you use gravity fields to manipulate and guide projectiles through increasingly difficult levels. Strategize, aim, and solve challenging puzzles in a futuristic, physics-based environment.

title: Carl und Cari: Trubel in Tierstadt
description: Jump into Carl and Cari: Trubel in Tierstadt, an interactive educational game in which you have to help Tierstadt and its animal inhabitants with their jobs in order to save the big town festival. Get to know different training jobs and their training opportunities in a playful way.

title: W.O.T.E: Waking On The Endtimes
description: Embark on this journey with W.O.T.E, an action-adventure game with simple and captivating visuals. Norah is in a world overrun by strange creatures, full of challenges, secrets to uncover, collectibles to find, and missions to complete to restore peace. Available in Portuguese (BR) and English.

title: FFS, Another Northern Duke?!
description: There's only one goal here: survive. Seduce the Duke?! Expelled from the modern world into a novel, you occupy the body of a minor villainess, on her way to marry the beastly Duke of the North. (Why does that sound familiar...) A Fantasy + Romance + Slice-of-Life Otome Visual Novel.

title: Barrok
description: An arcade racing game in which you try to be first by beating other competitors.

title: Spammerina
description: Ever wanted to just Spam a bunch of Spells? Discover and Enhance your new favourite spells to slay a myriad of monsters! Loot, Explore, and Uncover the Secrets of The Dark Continent! Blast beasts with Blood magic, Divine Judgement, and more! The Dark Continent is waiting...

title: Project Unknown Designation
description: Meet your friends at their cabin in the woods. What lies ahead?

title: Swordia
description: Traverse Swordia, a community-driven MMORPG with skill-based progression, PVP, PVE, and endless possibilities. Inspired by the classics, experience a mix of dungeon crawling, farming, mining, and more. Help development with your choices and feedback.

title: Yin-Yang Ping-Pong
description: Something to look at.

title: Turte
description: Turte is a simple yet engaging game where players click on a turtle to increase their score. With straightforward mechanics and an easy-to-understand interface, Turte offers an enjoyable experience for players of all ages.

title: Kioku
description: Reclaim the memories you lost, fight for what is rightfully yours. Explore worlds that seem familiar but not quite. You progress through places that resembles memories you once had. Push forward until you find the reason you're here.

title: Tempter
description: "Tempter" is a suspenseful first-person horror game that shows how humans can be even more dangerous than demons when they gain power. It centers on the struggle to save one's soul against a demon after breaking a pact.

title: Lusófona Games Collection 2024
description: Lusófona Games Collection 2024 is a curated bundle showcasing the best student projects developed during the past academic year at Lusófona University. Play the games and take a behind-the-scenes look at our students' journey to becoming the next generation of videogame developers.

title: Wanted: Yokai Uprising
description: Wanted: Yokai Uprising is a cooperative first-person shooter. Take down waves of yokai solo or with a partner. Choose between two mercenaries with unique play styles to complete the mission assigned to you and defeat the city's most wanted boss.

title: Realpolitiks 3: Earth and Beyond
description: Prove your political brilliance in a grand strategy like no other: pick any contemporary country, set up your government and navigate the pitfalls of domestic and international politics. A glorious destiny awaits - the domination of not just the Earth, but the whole Solar system!

title: Exposure Office Simulator
description: Exposed Office Simulator is an office touching game. By touching the breasts and other parts of the body, the game makes you feel as if you are touching them, as you become animated by touching them.

title: The Rolling Room
description: Unleash your creativity in "The Rolling Room," the ultimate design and decorating game! Transform ordinary rooms and unique spaces like camper vans and buses with stunning realism.

title: Metal Bunny
description: Feel the thunderous beats in your bones and let the electrifying guitar riffs guide your way. It's not just a game, it's a headbanging adventure!

title: Jellies of the Deep
description: Explore a dreamy, hand-drawn world where little deep-sea jellies roam. Jellies of the Deep is a relaxing, hidden object and spot-the-difference game in one.

title: Keyboard Souls
description: Oh my friend, are you one of the strongest typists in the world? Come and try this typing rouge shooting game, practice and become more stronger. Finally you will prove yourself.

title: Mad & Max: The Best Survival Game with Zombies and Dinosaurs
description: Welcome to the Apocalypse! Do dinosaurs rule the earth? Not only them, but also zombies! Why? Because they can.

title: Itsy
description: Itsy is a heart tug the length of a bus ride. A narrative climb up the waterspout about the struggles of Autism-burnout. Play for story (progress saves), or endlessly & conquer the leaderboard. You ever felt endlessly stuck? So has the Itsy Bitsy Spider. Together, can you both help him out of it?

title: Moon Tower
description: Play as a mechanical being, defeat all enemies, and retrieve the crucial item. Moon Tower is a fast-paced game where you must constantly dodge enemies and eliminate them within each room. Gain different abilities to strengthen yourself and enhance your power.

title: Anoxia Station
description: After a supervolcano eruption, Earth has become uninhabitable and humanity is on the brink of extinction. We need to go underground. Anoxia Station is a dark strategy game in which you manage a mining station and fight for survival, extract resources and take life or death decisions over your crew.

title: Obi3011
description: This is cyberpunk themed, pixelated love adventure text game. A rainy encounter and an inevitable cohabitation lead to a journey of mistaken identity. As a robot, your funny love adventure story with your beastmen partners unfolds from here.

title: Avian Enigma
description: Avian enigma is a sci-fi visual novel game featuring in a world where birds have become extinct. The story begins with a young man working in a factory accidentally saves a bird. Soon, a girl who has a mysterious relationship with birds appears in front of him. A romance with a tiny twist begins.

title: The Last Ramparts
description: Humanity Has Been All But Destroyed. Find The Last Remaining Few And Protect Them. Discover Unknown Places Along The Way.

title: Aesthetic Clicker
description: Aesthetic Clicker is not your average clicker game! Click the sun to get collectable items from time to time.

title: The Last Hollow
description: Step into the mysterious world filled with secrets, puzzles, and challenging paths. Embrace your destiny as the chosen hollow from a forgotten dark land to save dark hollows waiting for salvation.

title: Until Oblivion
description: Until Oblivion is an atmospheric narrative game that follows 17 year old nobody Emma Wilson as she tries to rekindle a dying relationship in a dying world. Join her in an increasingly nightmarish Halloween party and find out if anything (or anyone) is worth anything at all.

title: Bigfoot Life
description: A simulator game where you live life as Bigfoot. Catch fish, forage for mushrooms and berries, build shelters, and more. Survive and live your best Bigfoot Life.

title: Izgub 2001
description: You decide how a civil war in the country of Izgub is supposed to end. Visual novel with strong themes of war, political violence and moral dilemma.

title: Skeletal Skism 2
description: War rages on between the undead... All for one sole purpose: to determine the ONE - TRUE - SKELETON - KING. Do you have what it takes to claim the crown?

title: Oceanlust: Erotic Descent
description: Who can say no when the opportunity of a lifetime drops into their lap? A submarine tour of the world’s most famous shipwreck alongside the sexiest girl you’ve ever met. Sure, there were a lot of waivers to sign but it’ll be fine. They know what they’re doing… Right...?

title: Hour of Survival: Zombie Craft
description: Navigate a post-apocalyptic world, where every decision can mean life or death. Scavenge for food, water, and supplies to keep your character alive in the face of constant danger.

title: Haunted Elevator
description: Play as a photographer compelled by a haunted elevator to uncover a tragic story. Find dark secrets about your company, using your camera and choices to seek justice or follow a darker path. The outcome is in your hands.

title: Tempus Triad
description: In Tempus Triad, dive into an ancient first-person horror scenario where a scientist is thrust into an era where huge predators dominate the land.

title: Too Angry To Die
description: Take control of Gideon Rageblade in this action-filled clicker game. Click to destroy endless waves of enemies, face epic bosses, and earn unique drops. Embrace the rage and irony in a quest that proves dying once was just a fluke—he's too angry to die again.

title: Love in Space
description: It is the year 2009. A short time after "the incident". Mankind has fled the scorched crusts of planet earth for a better life in space. Those unlucky few who still reside on earth are forced to live beneath the sea in leaky metal domes. This includes you... 50% Visual Novel - 50% Karaoke-Musical.

title: Corn
description: Corn — the interactive clicker featuring America's favorite fruit, brought to you by the developer of Cuckold Simulator. Buy corn, collect corn, trade corn. We love corn!

title: Day Off: Moonriver Incident
description: An atmospheric 2D top-down shooter with an open world and physics. Step into the role of a police officer from an old horror movie. Discover what happened in the town of Moonriver. Use your brain against zombies - create barricades with the furniture, stay quiet, or unleash full-blown action!

title: Huntin' Ducks
description: Arcade shoot-em-up roguelike with a unique combo mechanic. Variety of items to choose from. Endless, play as long as you can survive.

title: The Test Game
description: Escape from an abandoned island by collecting points, food, and resources. Fight to survive. Discover the underwater world and get the best high score to unlock various in game achievements. The Test Game, my first game ever!

title: Inspection Report
description: Inspection Report is a horror / point & click game focused on exploration and dialogue. Fulfill your duties as a building inspector and uncover the secrets of an abandoned property in total dark using only a flashlight.

title: Fluffy Sailors
description: Fluffy Sailors is a charming action-roguelite where you fight in thrilling real-time sea battles between adorable animal pirates. Fire them at your enemies, capture their ships, and fulfill Her Majesty's royal mission!

title: On a Journey RPG
description: A Golden-Age of 2D JRPG's returns with Turn-Based Combat & Retro-Inspired Graphics! Adventure across the world, meet new friends and unlock powerful Summon Monsters as you battle against a truly formidable enemy in this Story-Rich JRPG

title: DinoTribe
description: Create your dino chief, lead your tribe. Survive waves of enemies, explore and settle on foreign islands. Find a way to avoid extinction!

title: Lunar Nightmare
description: Lunar Nightmare is a retro-inspired sci-fi thriller, set on an abandoned Moon base, where you have to solve the mystery behind missing crew members, ancient discoveries around deep down the Lunar surface, rouge-AI trying to control your fate and ghastly androids to revolting against your command.

title: Sim Solver
description: With the help of a companion, the program charged with running these simulations. You'll debug viruses by solving puzzles, shooting your way through hostile code, platforming around any number of obstacles, and exploring areas for key items that take you deeper into the simulation!

title: Glowie Rammer
description: The glowies are out to get you! You just run them over, that's what you do. Fast-paced racing meets spine-chilling horror. In this endless runner, you are not just racing against time but also against the ones who glow in the dark.

title: Collectibles!
description: Collectibles! — a true paradise for collectors! Collect unique items, share them with friends, and show off your achievements on the leaderboards!

title: Cut the Birch
description: Take on the role of a hero whose main task is to cut down birch trees and destroy enemies. Use an axe and magic to do this. Acquire items and improve skills.

title: Robin: The Twisted Timber Trail
description: Join Robin and navigate narrow wooden paths, solve puzzles, and help animals and villagers as you uncover hidden trails and secrets.

title: SCAD
description: Scad is an action packed roguelite apocalypse adventure. Fight against zombie hordes, craft & upgrade new weapons and prepare for new missions.

title: Asylum Revenge
description: "Asylum Revenge is an action and horror game set in an asylum. Players will follow Jessie Frost on her quest for revenge."

title: Paw Paw Death Festival
description: A simple job to execute sinners in a surrealistic way! Three casual party modes for free thinking and creative dark humor + with a great ridiculous comment function to get the audience together on your live streaming.

title: City Park Play Date
description: City Park Play Date is a kinetic (linear) short story. It is a true AVN, but linear by design, telling a very specific story. You play as James, the protagonist of our story. James is lucky in life, but not in love. Our story explains how that changes for him and opens his eyes to what is possible.

title: Echoes of Dread
description: Echoes Of Dread is a first-person psychological horror game. Explore the mansion, solve puzzles, and uncover the secrets hidden within. Prepare for unexpected encounters with terrifying entities. The game features an intense atmosphere, non-linear storytelling, and unique moments of horror.

title: Gwihyang: Homecoming
description: "Gwihyang" captures the traditional image of Korea, giving it a new experience. A tense adventure unfolds in which you escape the threat of monsters in the changing space and use items to escape. Hope you can enjoy fear and fun at the same time through this "Gwihyang" with Korean sentiment.

title: Influencer Boxing
description: Step into the ring with "Influencer Boxing," a thrilling game featuring 12 of your favorite social media stars. Each influencer brings their unique style and charisma to intense boxing matches, set in dynamic, visually stunning arenas

title: Taking the Cross
description: Taking the Cross allows you to control Christian Armies fighting for the holy land, inflict crushing defeats on your enemies and win glory for the faith!
